items.desc: Chi siamo Mamazen X nasce dall’esperienza di Mamazen, uno dei venture studio pionieri in Italia. Negli ultimi anni abbiamo costruito un modello di company building che combina capitale, competenze operative e capacità di execution, accompagnando i founder dalla validazione delle idee alla creazione e crescita di nuove imprese. Attraverso il nostro fondo abbiamo raccolto €10 milioni e lanciato 11 startup, tra cui Morsy, Deeva e Pelomatto. Abbiamo sviluppato competenze e metodologie che ci permettono di costruire aziende in modo sistematico, lavorando direttamente su strategia, prodotto, tecnologia, go-to-market e crescita. Oggi portiamo questa esperienza in Mamazen X, con una nuova ambizione: sfruttare l'AI per cambiare radicalmente il modo in cui vengono erogati i servizi professionali e costruire una nuova generazione di aziende AI-native. Lo facciamo insieme a founder che conoscono a fondo un problema e vogliono trovare un modo migliore per risolverlo. Li affianchiamo fin dall’inizio con capitale, esperienza imprenditoriale e competenze operative e tecnologiche. Entrare adesso significa contribuire alla nascita di più imprese, lavorando su problemi reali e costruendo soluzioni che possano essere riutilizzate e migliorate nel tempo. Avrai l'opportunità di vedere da vicino come nasce un'azienda, dalla definizione del servizio ai primi clienti. Partiamo dall’Italia, con l’ambizione di costruire aziende che possano crescere anche all’estero. Il ruolo Cerchiamo un Founding AI Engineer che contribuisca a costruire le fondamenta tecnologiche di Mamazen X e delle aziende che nasceranno dallo studio. Sarai tra le prime persone a sviluppare la nostra infrastruttura AI condivisa. Avrai autonomia nello sviluppo e nelle scelte tecniche quotidiane, lavorando a stretto contatto con founder, sviluppatori e un network di advisor tecnologici esperti con cui confrontarti sulle decisioni architetturali più importanti. Una parte centrale del lavoro sarà progettare, sviluppare e portare in produzione applicazioni che utilizzano l'AI per automatizzare attività, gestire processi e trasformare il modo in cui vengono erogati i servizi. Contribuirai inoltre alla costruzione di una base tecnica comune: componenti, integrazioni e strumenti riutilizzabili che permettano alle nuove aziende di partire più velocemente. Ogni azienda manterrà autonomia sul proprio codice e sulla propria infrastruttura. Lavorerai direttamente con il team dello studio e con i founder. In alcuni progetti realizzerai le prime soluzioni; in altri contribuirai a valutare la fattibilità tecnica, sviluppare prototipi o risolvere problemi specifici. Non cerchiamo qualcuno che abbia già tutte le risposte, ma una persona capace di costruire, sperimentare, prendere decisioni e crescere insieme allo studio. È un ruolo operativo: scriverai codice, affronterai problemi tecnici concreti e vedrai direttamente l'impatto del tuo lavoro sulle aziende che stiamo costruendo. Di cosa ti occuperai Costruire applicazioni e workflow AI Progetterai e svilupperai sistemi che integrano modelli linguistici, dati, API e strumenti software per automatizzare processi reali. Lavorerai su problemi come l'acquisizione e l'elaborazione di documenti, l'estrazione e la verifica delle informazioni, la gestione di workflow e l'integrazione con strumenti esterni. Dovrai considerare non soltanto se una soluzione funziona, ma anche come renderla affidabile, utilizzabile e sostenibile nei costi. Sviluppare componenti riutilizzabili Contribuirai alla progettazione e allo sviluppo della base tecnica comune alle aziende dello studio. L'obiettivo è identificare ciò che può essere condiviso — per esempio sistemi di gestione dei documenti, integrazioni, workflow, autenticazione, monitoraggio e valutazione delle applicazioni AI — e trasformarlo in componenti semplici da utilizzare e mantenere. Avrai spazio per proporre scelte tecnologiche e soluzioni architetturali, confrontandoti quando necessario con gli advisor e con gli altri sviluppatori. Lavorerai con i team delle aziende per migliorare questi strumenti sulla base delle loro esigenze concrete. Collaborare con founder e team tecnici Aiuterai i founder a tradurre problemi operativi in soluzioni software. Parteciperai alle discussioni su cosa automatizzare, quali strumenti utilizzare e come gestire i casi in cui l'AI non è sufficientemente affidabile e serve l'intervento umano. Lavorerai anche con gli sviluppatori delle singole aziende, condividendo soluzioni, contribuendo alle code review e affrontando insieme i problemi tecnici. Portare le soluzioni in produzione Non ci interessa costruire soltanto demo o prototipi. Dovrai sviluppare applicazioni che possano essere utilizzate da clienti reali, occupandoti anche di test, deployment, monitoraggio, gestione degli errori e manutenzione. items.desc: Would you like to build the data foundation for Ambu’s next generation of AI products? Do you enjoy working with clinical data and ensuring its quality? Are you motivated by collaborating across disciplines to create datasets that support AI development and evaluation? Then this might be your defining moment. Join us as AI Data Specialist in our Algorithms & AI department in either Augsburg, Germany, or Ballerup, Denmark. Together, We Shape What's Next At Ambu, your expertise can make a difference to the people delivering and receiving care. Across our portfolio, our products support more than 100 million patients worldwide every year. As part of Global R&D, you’ll join skilled colleagues who share their knowledge, take ownership and work through challenges together. You’ll contribute to a strong innovation pipeline spanning devices and digital solutions, with EndoIntelligence™ bringing hardware, software and AI together to support the full endoscopy workflow. About The Role As an AI Data Specialist, you’ll contribute to the planning, execution, documentation and communication of data activities across AI product development projects. Your work will span early feasibility studies through product validation and market release. Working closely with AI engineers, clinical stakeholders, data specialists and project teams, you’ll help ensure that datasets are clinically relevant, representative and suitable for AI development and evaluation. You’ll contribute to activities ranging from defining data requirements and planning collection through annotation, quality review and dataset maintenance. You’ll have the opportunity to deepen your expertise in clinical data and AI product development, learning from colleagues across technical and clinical disciplines while seeing how your work supports the development of medical technology. Key Responsibilities Your main responsibilities will include: Contribute to defining data requirements based on intended clinical use, including dataset composition, representativeness, bias assessment and validation considerations. Support statistical analyses for performance evaluation, subgroup analyses and AI product validation. Collaborate with clinical experts and project teams to gather insights, support prototype evaluations and develop annotation strategies. Support assessments of data-related risks, quality, feasibility and regulatory considerations throughout the product lifecycle. Assist with data acquisition planning and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to support data collection. Support data governance activities, including anonymization, annotation planning, data quality review, traceability and dataset maintenance. Contribute to design control, verification, validation and regulatory documentation for AI-enabled medical devices. Suggested candidate profile Skills Skills and experience can be earned in many ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be fully described on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this position if you have: An MSc or PhD in data science, statistics, biomedical engineering, medical informatics, clinical research, medicine or a related field. Knowledge of statistics, performance evaluation, data quality and representativeness. Experience working with datasets, annotation activities, data validation or data quality assurance. An understanding of clinical workflows and an interest in clinical data handling. Knowledge of data-driven products, research projects, clinical studies or AI/ML development. Fluency in spoken and written English. You’ll typically bring two to five years of relevant professional experience. We also encourage candidates with different experience levels to apply if their skills and background match the role. Familiarity with design control processes and relevant regulatory frameworks, such as the EU MDR, FDA guidance for AI/ML-enabled medical devices or the EU AI Act, would also be valuable. You bring an analytical and structured approach and enjoy working through complex questions with colleagues. You’re comfortable collaborating across clinical, technical and data disciplines, sharing your knowledge and learning from others. You contribute to an inclusive environment where people support one another and work towards common goals. About The Team You’ll join our global Algorithms & AI department, consisting of 18 colleagues across multiple sites. The department is part of Software & Electronics within Ambu R&D and brings together expertise in AI development, image processing and data management. We work in a scaled agile environment and collaborate closely with Clinical Affairs and other software teams. You’ll have colleagues with different technical and clinical perspectives to exchange ideas with and work alongside as you address the data challenges involved in developing AI products.You will report to the Team Manager for Data Management. items.desc: Descrizione dell'azienda NeoAdvagency combina strategia di business, creatività, marketing e intelligenza artificiale per individuare inefficienze, ridurre i costi e progettare soluzioni con impatto economico misurabile. L’agenzia analizza mercati, posizionamento del brand e opportunità di crescita commerciale per trasformare il potenziale delle aziende in risultati concreti. I team lavorano in modo interdisciplinare, integrando dati e insight di mercato con tecnologie avanzate di AI. Chi entra in NeoAdvagency trova un ambiente orientato all’innovazione, alla sperimentazione e alla misurabilità delle performance. Descrizione del ruolo Artificial Intelligence Engineer è responsabile della progettazione, sviluppo e integrazione di modelli di intelligenza artificiale all’interno delle soluzioni di marketing e business di NeoAdvagency. Nel lavoro quotidiano la persona si occupa di analizzare requisiti funzionali, progettare architetture di machine learning, addestrare e validare modelli e ottimizzarne le prestazioni in contesti reali. L’Artificial Intelligence Engineer collabora con team di marketing, strategia e sviluppo software per tradurre esigenze operative in sistemi basati su neural networks, pattern recognition e natural language processing (NLP). Il ruolo prevede attività di documentazione tecnica, manutenzione del codice e monitoraggio continuo dei modelli in produzione. Si tratta di un contratto di collaborazione, in modalità completamente da remoto, con possibilità di interazione con team internazionali. Qualifiche Competenze in computer science e software development, con esperienza nella progettazione, implementazione e gestione di applicazioni data-driven. Solida conoscenza di neural networks e pattern recognition per la costruzione di modelli predittivi e sistemi di classificazione complessi. Esperienza in natural language processing (NLP) per l’analisi di testi, la costruzione di chatbot, sistemi di raccomandazione e strumenti di understanding del linguaggio. Laurea in discipline tecnico-scientifiche (informatica, ingegneria, matematica, fisica o affini) e familiarità con linguaggi di programmazione come Python e framework di machine learning. Capacità di lavorare in team multidisciplinari, attenzione alla qualità del codice, buona comunicazione scritta e parlata, autonomia nella gestione del lavoro da remoto.

Wil jij werken binnen een dynamische
items.desc: Zie jij het voor je om volledige ownership te krijgen over jouw eigen greenfield projecten, waarbij je zelfstandig AI-agents, webapplicaties en API-integraties bouwt? Wil je daarnaast zelf technische keuzes kunnen maken op het gebied van tooling en oplossingen ontwikkelen die direct worden ingezet door een snelgroeiende e-commerce organisatie met miljoenen bezoekers per maand? Wil jij werken binnen een dynamische scale-upomgeving waar ambitie, zeggenschap en initiatief centraal staan? Wil je de nieuwste tooling implementeren en aan de basis staan van een grootschalige AI-transformatie met volop kansen voor persoonlijke groei? Zeg jij ja tegen werken met de nieuwste AI-tooling, vier thuiswerkdagen per week, een MacBook Pro van de zaak en de mogelijkheid om mee te groeien met een organisatie die haar omzet wil opschalen van €50 miljoen naar €200 miljoen? Heb jij ervaring met softwareontwikkeling, een passie voor AI-integratie en automatisering en zoek je een omgeving waarin je daadwerkelijk nieuwe oplossingen kunt bouwen? Lees dan verder. Jouw werkgever: een snelgroeiende e-commerce scale-up bouwt met AI aan de volgende groeifase Hoe zou je het vinden om te werken bij een ambitieuze e-commerce scale-up die de komende jaren wil doorgroeien van €50 miljoen naar €200 miljoen omzet? GTE Brands heeft de ambitie om uit te groeien tot een van de grootste spelers binnen e-commerce en op termijn te concurreren met organisaties als bol en Amazon. De organisatie verkoopt producten via een portfolio van zelfstandige webshops. Iedere product categorie wordt ondergebracht in een eigen niche markt, waardoor merken zelfstandig kunnen groeien en gericht kunnen worden gepositioneerd. Achter deze webshops moet echter een steeds slimmer en schaalbaarder IT-fundament komen te staan. Juist daar ontstaat de technische uitdaging. Hoe zorg je ervoor dat afzonderlijke webshops, systemen en bedrijfsprocessen met elkaar samenwerken? Hoe integreer je AI op een manier waardoor medewerkers niet voor het systeem werken, maar het systeem voor hen? En hoe bouw je een platform dat miljoenen bezoekers , grote hoeveelheden productdata en tientallen geautomatiseerde processen kan ondersteunen? GTE Brands staat aan het begin van een grootschalig IT-traject. Het huidige tech team bestaat uit vier IT-professionals en wordt verder uitgebreid. Je komt dus niet terecht in een organisatie waarin alle architecturale keuzes al zijn gemaakt. Je krijgt juist de kans om vroeg aan te sluiten, eigen projecten op te zetten en mee te bouwen aan de technische structuur voor de komende jaren. Jouw baan: Medior AI Engineer Als Medior AI Engineer bouw je AI-oplossingen waarmee GTE Brands bedrijfsprocessen automatiseert, webshops optimaliseert en sneller kan opschalen . Je werkt niet uitsluitend met AI om sneller code te schrijven, maar je verwerkt AI daadwerkelijk in de producten, systemen en werkprocessen van de organisatie. Iedere engineer krijgt ownership over een eigen project. Samen met interne stakeholders onderzoek je waar tijd verloren gaat, welke processen de schaalbaarheid beperken en waar automatisering de meeste waarde kan toevoegen. Vervolgens ontwerp en bouw jij de oplossing van A tot Z. Daarbij kun je denken aan projecten zoals: Een tool die met AI productfoto’s genereert en optimaliseert AI-oplossingen waarmee productinformatie en productpagina’s worden verbeterd Marketingtools die automatisch advertenties en creatief materiaal genereren Een systeem dat op basis van klant- en productdata relevante upsells selecteert API’s waarmee verschillende webshops, systemen en databronnen met elkaar communiceren Een WhatsApp Business-agent die kandidaten of andere gebruikers automatisch screent AI-agents die veel gestelde klantvragen afhandelen Automatiseringen waarmee interne processen sneller en consistent verlopen Jouw impact is direct zichtbaar en je zorgt ervoor dat het opschalingsproces van het gehele bedrijf in een hogere versnelling komt. Geen ellenlange goedkeuringsprocessen, wachttijden of onnodige vergaderingen, maar directe actie en impact. Hierdoor bouw je niet alleen interessante technische oplossingen, maar zorg je er ook voor dat collega’s meer tijd overhouden voor het werk waarin menselijke aandacht en expertise daadwerkelijk het verschil maken. Omdat het IT-landschap nog in de kinderschoenen staat, ligt de nadruk voornamelijk op nieuwbouw. Geen eindeloos onderhoud aan verouderde systemen, maar greenfield oplossingen die je vanaf de basis ontwerpt en met volledige technische ownership realiseert. Doorgroeimogelijkheden: Doordat de groeiambities binnen het bedrijf groot zijn, zullen er de komende jaren veel doorgroeimogelijkheden ontstaan, zowel horizontaal als verticaal. Het technische team zal groeien, waardoor managementfuncties kunnen ontstaan en belangrijke architecturale keuzes moeten worden gemaakt. Je groeit dus niet alleen mee binnen een bestaande functie, maar krijgt ook de mogelijkheid om je rol mede vorm te geven terwijl het team en …

Contexte du projet : L'H.U.B met en place un dispositif de gouvernance de l'intelligence artificielle reposant sur un point d'entrée unique, un registre des systèmes et une instruction technique préalable à toute mise en service
items.desc: Dans le cadre de la mise en place de la gouvernance de l'intelligence artificielle, et afin de renforcer l'équipe en place, nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) Ingénieur(e) d'évaluation IA. Contexte du projet : L'H.U.B met en place un dispositif de gouvernance de l'intelligence artificielle reposant sur un point d'entrée unique, un registre des systèmes et une instruction technique préalable à toute mise en service de solution utilisant l’IA. Ce dispositif est instruit par une cellule IA qui évalue, documente et surveille les systèmes. L'Ingénieur(e) d'évaluation IA en constitue la capacité technique : il ou elle éprouve les systèmes proposés, en vérifie les performances sur les données de l'institution et en assure la surveillance une fois en service. Les dossiers couverts concernent aussi bien les développements en interne de solution IA que les dossiers de logiciels IA proposés par des fournisseurs externes. Description générale de la fonction : En tant qu'Ingénieur(e) d'évaluation IA, vous êtes rattaché(e) au Business Intelligence Competence Center (BICC). Vous portez l'évaluation technique des systèmes d'intelligence artificielle soumis à l'institution, de l'instruction du dossier jusqu'au suivi en vie réelle. Vous intervenez sur l'ensemble des sites de l'H.U.B et travaillez en lien étroit avec les services du DSI, le médecin référent IA, les collègues du BICC, le CISO et le DPO. Vous disposez pour cela d'un environnement d'évaluation dont vous assurez vous-même la conception et l'exploitation. Vos principaux rôles et responsabilités : Instruire le volet technique des dossiers d'intelligence artificielle qui transitent par la cellule IA Evaluer les dossiers selon les axes suivants : architecture, données mobilisées, intégration au système d'information, exploitabilité, performance et dette technique induite Vérifier le respect des exigences techniques et d'interopérabilité de l'institution et contribuer à la rédaction des clauses techniques des cahiers spéciaux des charges Documenter chaque évaluation sous une forme opposable, versable au registre des systèmes et réutilisable lors des revues périodiques Préparer une note détaillée de cette évaluation pour prise de décision au DAC (Data Access Commitee) et au comité IA • Concevoir et mettre en œuvre de bout en bout les pilotes d’évaluation des dossiers IA Concevoir les protocoles de validation des pilotes Outiller la mise en œuvre des pilotes Installer, configurer et administrer les environnements d'évaluation, en bonne collaboration avec le service Infrastructure du DSI : serveurs Linux, serveurs équipés de GPU, conteneurisation et chaînes d'intégration et de déploiement. Constituer et maintenir les jeux de données d'évaluation et les environnements de test, dans le respect des principes de minimisation et de traçabilité Evaluer la performance des solutions internes et externes, identifier les biais et risques potentiels Accompagner la mise en production des solutions validées, documenter ces solutions et garantir un monitoring permanent Déployer et éprouver des modèles auto-hébergés sur l'infrastructure interne, notamment des modèles de langage à poids ouverts, et documenter les besoins en ressources, les performances et les limites observées Supporter au besoin la mise en place des solutions externes, notamment la partie intégration des données et droits d’accès Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique et les procédures opérationnelles standard. Mettre en place et exploiter le monitoring en vie réelle des systèmes en service : indicateurs de performance, détection de dérive, seuils d'alerte et d'arrêt. Contribuer à l’évolution de la maturité IA de l’institution en respectant le cadre légal (GDPR) Connaitre et appliquer les principes légaux de l’utilisation des données (GDPR), informer des risques potentiels de non-respect Contribuer à la formation et la diffusion d’une culture technique autour de ces outils. items.desc: Vill du använda din expertis inom äldre handskrift för att träna framtidens AI? KB söker nu en eller två forskningsassistenter som vill arbeta med transkribering och göra vårt gemensamma kulturarv sökbart för alla. Arbetsuppgifter Som forskningsassistent med inriktning mot AI-assisterad transkribering arbetar du med att skapa högkvalitativa träningsdata för KB:s AI-modeller. Tyngdpunkten ligger på att transkribera och kvalitetssäkra maskinlästa texter från våra samlingar. Arbetet är till stor del distansbaserat, vilket innebär att du planerar och utför dina uppgifter självständigt i samråd med projektledaren. Du rapporterar till enheten för FoU och KB-labb och blir en viktig länk i vårt arbete med att bygga modern forskningsinfrastruktur. Som medarbetare på KB bidrar du med din erfarenhet och kompetens till den ständiga utvecklingen av KB:s verksamhet och medverkar till ett bra och respektfullt arbetsklimat. Kvalifikationer och personliga egenskaper För att lyckas i rollen behöver du: Akademisk examen på masternivå inom humaniora (t.ex. historia, språk, arkivvetenskap) eller annan erfarenhet som vi bedömer som likvärdig. Gedigen och dokumenterad erfarenhet av att transkribera handskrivet källmaterial från 1500- till 1700-talet. Specialist på handskrifter och har en dokumenterad förmåga att läsa svårtydd skrift med hög precision. Meriterande är Erfarenhet av transkriberingsverktyget Transkribus. Erfarenhet av forskningsprojekt eller arbete med digitalt arkivmaterial. Kunskap om AI-baserade metoder för textigenkänning, särskilt HTR (Handwritten Text Recognition). Personliga egenskaper Vi söker dig som är självständig och disciplinerad. Du trivs med att arbeta fokuserat på egen hand och tar ansvar för att leverera enligt tidsplan. Du är noggrann och har ett öga för detaljer, vilket är viktigt för att säkerställa exakthet i träningsdata. Samtidigt arbetar du effektivt och kan hålla ett bra tempo utan att göra avkall på kvaliteten. Du har ett strukturerat och metodiskt arbetssätt som gör att du har lätt för att sätta dig in i och tillämpa specifika transkriberingsprinciper och tekniska ramar. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. Anställning och tillträde Vi söker en eller två forskningsassistenter för tidsbegränsad anställning i upp till ett år. Vi har möjlighet att erbjuda heltid, men är även öppna för deltidsanställning. Antalet anställningar och tjänstgöringsgraden bestäms utifrån verksamhetens behov och de sökandes förutsättningar. Ange gärna i din ansökan vilken tjänstgöringsgrad du är intresserad av. Tillträde snarast eller enligt överenskommelse. Placering är i Stockholm men arbetet kan till stor del utföras på distans. Ansökan Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-12-08. I denna rekrytering använder vi urvalsfrågor i stället för personligt brev. Bifoga ditt CV och besvara frågorna med konkreta exempel på din kompetens och erfarenhet. Dina svar kommer att användas som underlag i urvalsprocessen. Kontaktpersoner Vill du veta mer om jobbet välkommen att kontakta enhetschef Love Börjeson 010-709 31 48, eller Robin Böckerman 010-709 38 11. För anställningsvillkor och process kontakta HR-partner Felicia Gustafsson 010-709 38 25. Fackliga kontaktpersoner är Fernando Sequeira Silvestre, ST KB, och Karl Isaksson, SACO KB, båda nås via växeln 010-709 30 00. Enheten för FoU och KB-labb Enheten för FoU och KB-labb är en tvärvetenskaplig forskningsmiljö med över 15 medarbetare: humanistiska forskare, datavetare och utvecklare. Här finns kompetens inom såväl samlingsnära forskning som AI, språkteknologi och digitala metoder. Enheten ingår i avdelningen för forskningsstöd och samlingsförvaltning Om Kungliga biblioteket Kungliga biblioteket (KB) är Sveriges nationalbibliotek. Våra samlingar sträcker sig mer än tusen år bakåt i tiden och växer varje dag. Vi har allt från handskrifter, böcker och tidningar till musik, film och datorspel. KB bevarar och tillgängliggör vårt kulturarv och främjar samverkan mellan Sveriges bibliotek. Ytterst handlar uppdraget om demokrati, jämlikhet och fri åsiktsbildning. Dessutom är KB en arbetsplats för forskare, studenter och ca 330 medarbetare. Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats som präglas av ansvar, öppenhet, tillit och lärande. Vi vill ge lika möjligheter för alla och värdesätter jämlikhet och mångfald i vår verksamhet.

items.desc: About The Role We are seeking an exceptional graduate to join Stalis as a generalist across our technical and operational functions. You will work closely with teams across the business, developing a deep understanding of how healthcare data moves through our systems and identifying opportunities to apply programming, modern tooling, and AI to improve how we work. Over time, as Stalis’s data intelligence capability matures, you will have the opportunity to contribute directly to machine learning and analytics work that shapes our next generation of products. The Reality of the Work This is a broad role, and not every task will be glamorous. Much of the early value comes from genuinely understanding how work is done at Stalis today - which means doing the work, not just observing it. Some of your time will be spent on detailed, careful data tasks that are essential to our clients. The opportunity is to use that understanding as the foundation for automation, improvement, and new capability. The best ideas will come from the ground up, and we expect you to find them. What you’ll actually do Work alongside our data migration and engineering teams on live client projects, contributing to the day-to-day delivery of healthcare data work. Identify inefficiencies, repetitive tasks, and fragile processes - and build the scripts, tools, and small systems that fix them. Write and maintain code, primarily in Python & SQL, to automate workflows, process data, and support internal operations. Apply and experiment with AI tooling - LLMs, embeddings, classifiers - to problems across the business where they add real value, and be honest about where they don’t. Communicate your work clearly, in writing and in person, to colleagues who are not data scientists - so that your improvements get adopted rather than sidelined. Over time, contribute to Stalis’s emerging data science and machine learning capability, including schema mapping, clinical data analytics, and data products. Requirements Who we’re looking for You will need most, if not all, of the following: Academic background. A strong degree from a top university in a quantitative or technical discipline - physics, engineering, computer science, mathematics, or similar. Genuine technical aptitude. Comfortable writing code, and keen to write more of it. We are not looking for a particular stack or prior industry experience, but you should already be writing code for fun, coursework, or projects, and be able to pick up new tools quickly. AI-savvy. Fluent with modern AI tools as a day-to-day part of how you work and think. You know what LLMs are good at, what they’re bad at, and how to use them without being credulous about their output. Self-directed. You find problems, scope them yourself, and take them to a useful end state without being spoon-fed tasks. You are comfortable operating under ambiguity and choosing what to work on when it isn’t obvious. Discerning and pragmatic. You can tell the difference between a problem worth solving properly and one worth a fifty-line script today. You don’t gold-plate. Strong communicator, in writing especially. You can write a short memo or a handover document that brings people along. In a small, distributed business, this matters more than people think. Emotionally intelligent. Improvements to how people work can feel like criticism, even when they aren’t. You can read a room, win people over, and work collaboratively with colleagues who know things you don’t. Domain-humble. You are curious about how Stalis works today before you try to change it. You understand that experienced colleagues know things that aren’t written down, and you treat that knowledge as an asset. Benefits What you’ll get from us Unusual breadth of exposure for a graduate role - you will see how a specialist healthcare data company actually runs, from the data up. A path into machine learning and data science work as Stalis’s data intelligence capability develops, with real problems and real data to work on. Direct access to senior colleagues, reporting to the Head of Data Science, and genuine influence over how the company evolves. A role that will grow as quickly as you do.

items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Contexte Notre client est un acteur du retail media , adossé à des groupes majeurs de la distribution et de la communication. Il accompagne des marques dans la conception et l’activation de campagnes publicitaires multicanales, en s’appuyant sur les données et les canaux digitaux d’un grand distributeur. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez échanger avec des interlocuteurs techniques et métier. Vous avez un anglais professionnel . Atouts : expérience en prévision de campagnes, optimisation, méthodes de similarité comme KNN ou évaluation d’impact par comparaison de groupes.

items.desc: Vil du bygge AI-agenter hos AIMZ? Vi ser etter et stjerneskudd av en utvikler – en problemløser med bakgrunn fra analyse eller maskinlæring som har lyst til å bygge AI-agenter som jobber med ekte tall. Det er hvem du er som betyr noe for oss, og vi vil gjerne høre fra deg, enten du er nyutdannet, erfaren eller selvlært. Rollen Vi har bygget vårt eget rammeverk for AI-agenter som jobber med kundenes prosjektdata. Sammen med agentrammeverket blir AIMZ en arbeidsbenk for prosjektledere, der agentene analyserer, rapporterer og gjør prediksjoner basert på historisk data. Din jobb blir å videreutvikle rammeverket og jobbe i resten av løsningen der problemene fører deg. Hva kan vi tilby deg? Hos oss i AIMZ blir du en del av en sammensveiset og sosial gjeng. Her blir du sett, hørt og verdsatt, og vi setter pris på dine ideer. Du får jobbe tett på forskning på kostnadsrammer i byggebransjen, i samarbeid med SINTEF og med støtte fra Forskningsrådet. Vi holder til i nye og moderne lokaler i Construction City på Alnabru, med gode kollektivforbindelser, god kantine og gratis trening. Du får god lønn ut fra kompetanse og erfaring, og mulighet for opsjoner. Vi er stolte av arbeidsplassen vi har skapt – et sted med interessant arbeid, et ordentlig godt miljø og flinke folk som jobber godt sammen. Jobben din Evals – er svaret riktig? Hvordan vet vi at agenten svarer riktig? Du bygger målingene som forteller oss om en ny prompt, en annen modell eller et nytt verktøy som gjør agenten bedre. Tool use med human-in-the-loop Gi agenten hender! Den skal kunne gjøre endringer i data selv, i første omgang med bekreftelse fra brukeren, og etter hvert på egen hånd. Reasoning på ekte tall Lær agenten å svare på «Hvorfor har kostnadsprognosen økt de siste to ukene?», ikke bare «Hva er den nå?». Prediksjon og risiko Hvor ender prosjektet, og hvilke prosjekter i porteføljen har størst risiko for kostnadsoverskridelser? Du bygger modellene som gir agenten svar på disse spørsmålene, og undersøker hvor godt de treffer. Knowledge og retrieval Agenten bygger sin egen kunnskapsbase og søker i prosjektenes historiske data. Din jobb er å sørge for at den husker det som betyr noe, og finner det når det gjelder. Context engineering Hvordan holder vi lange samtaler relevante, raske og kostnadseffektive, også når konteksten vokser? Det blir en av problemstillingene du får bryne deg på. Hvem er du? Du er nysgjerrig av natur, tenker rasjonelt og har sans for matematikk. Du liker å gjøre et uklart spørsmål om til noe som kan måles. Du har utdanning innen realfag eller informatikk, eller har tilegnet deg tilsvarende kunnskap på andre måter. Du har bakgrunn innen dataanalyse eller maskinlæring, er god på programmering og har lyst til å bygge, ikke bare analysere. Du søker deg til de vanskelige problemene og gir deg ikke før du har funnet rotårsaken. Du kan vise til noe konkret du har løst gjennom studier, jobb eller egne prosjekter, og du snakker norsk. Det er et pluss om du: Har erfaring med finansiell modellering, prediksjon eller porteføljeanalyse Har erfaring med språkmodeller og forstår hvorfor de tar feil Liker å teste hypoteser før du konkluderer Hvor lenge du har vært i arbeidslivet, er mindre viktig for oss enn hva du kan og hvordan du tenker. Er du stjerneskuddet vi ser etter? Vi har lyst til å bli kjent med deg og måten du tenker på. Send oss en CV og en kort beskrivelse av et vanskelig problem du har løst i studier, jobb eller andre prosjekter, på maks én side. Fortell oss: Hva problemet var, og hvorfor det var vanskelig Hvordan du gikk frem, inkludert komplikasjoner underveis Hva løsningen ble, og hvilke vurderinger du gjorde Har du skrevet kode, en oppgave eller noe annet du vil vise oss, legg gjerne ved en lenke. Vi gleder oss til å se hva du har fått til! Er dette noe for deg? Ta gjerne kontakt med Espen Hedley Nilsen på e-post espenhn@vhr.no eller mobil +47 968 53 770.

items.desc: Job Description Ready to turn your curiosity into real impact? Want to help shape what comes next in healthcare? At Angelini Pharma, we believe true innovation happens when bold thinkers are given the space to challenge the status quo and bring fresh perspectives to the table. Our Early Career Program is your opportunity to step out of the sidelines and make a tangible contribution from day one. Working alongside experienced professionals, you will bring your energy to meaningful projects, push new ideas forward, and help create solutions that genuinely improve patients’ lives. Driven by purpose, guided by leadership. Our selection process includes a virtual assessment built around four pillars based on our Leadership Model. It shapes how we decide, deliver, collaborate and challenge ourselves every single day, at every level, starting from your very first one. This Leadership Model is our DNA, one way of working: Decide – Put Patients First. Clear, courageous choices based on facts and ethics, always prioritizing the patient. Deliver – Make Our Ambition Happen. Turning ambition into fast, high-impact results with accountability and agility. Collaborate – Generate More Value Together. Breaking silos to work across teams and achieve more together. Challenge – Find Solutions & Move Forward. Speaking up with courage and substance to continuously improve and move forward. This is an engaging, interactive experience designed to let you show how you decide, deliver, collaborate, and challenge. A chance to be yourself and see whether our values match yours. If they do, you will feel right at home here. Over 24 months, you will grow through a series of rotations designed to fast-track your development and give you a broad, real-world view of our business. Over two years, you will work side by side with inspiring leaders, take on real responsibilities, and explore different team dynamics. It is an opportunity to help you make real decisions, develop a versatile and business-ready profile, and make your voice heard. Rotations That Grow With The Company. We are a company in deep transformation, and your journey will reflect it. Rather than following a fixed path, your rotations will be shaped around the business priorities and projects that matter most at each stage, giving you the chance to work where you can learn the most and make the greatest impact. Each step is an opportunity to broaden your perspective, connect the dots across the organization, and take on increasing responsibility. A World-class Learning Experience. Learning is at the heart of the program. Alongside hands-on experience, you will be part of a dedicated Academy. At the end of each rotation, high-quality Masterclasses will help you consolidate what you have learned, sharpen your leadership skills and get ready for your next challenge. It is a learning journey built to develop the leaders of tomorrow, together with a community of fellow graduates who share your drive. Background: Master's degree in Computer Engineering, recently completed or to be completed by March 2027. Excellent academic results; a thesis, project or internship in data, AI, cloud or cyber security is a plus. Other skills: good knowledge of at least one programming language (e.g. Python) and of SQL and databases; familiarity with machine learning concepts, cloud platforms (e.g. Azure, AWS) and networking and security fundamentals; fluent English, written and spoken (Italian is a plus); analytical mindset, problem-solving attitude and genuine curiosity for new technologies; team spirit, clear communication and the drive to take ownership of your work. Why join us? At Angelini Pharma, an international pharmaceutical company and part of Angelini Industries, we research, develop, and commercialize health solutions with a particular focus on Brain Health, including mental health and epilepsy, as well as Rare Diseases and Consumer Healthcare. Founded in Italy at the beginning of the twentieth century, today we operate directly in 20 countries, with more than 3,000 people, and our products reach patients in over 70 countries, also thanks to strategic alliances with leading international pharmaceutical groups. In 2026, we took a decisive step in our global growth, expanding in the U.S. market and strengthening our commitment to neurological Rare Diseases. Behind every milestone, there are people. That is why we have been certified Top Employer year after year, including in 2026. Joining our Early Career Program means stepping into a company in full growth, where curiosity is rewarded, early ownership is encouraged, and your ideas truly matter. Curious to see where your potential can take you? We would love to hear from you! Apply now and start shaping the future of care with us.

Vi ser gerne, at du: Har erfaring med AI-baserede udviklingsværktøjer som Lovable, Cursor eller lignende. Har forståelse for programmering, API'er, databaser og automatisering. Er selvstændig, løsningsorienteret og god til at tage ejerskab. Er nysgerrig og har lyst til konstant at lære og udvikle dig. Hvad tilbyder vi? En fuldtidsstilling i en ambitiøs virksomhed i vækst. Stor faglig frihed og indflydelse på vores digitale udvikling. Spændende og varierede projekter inden for AI og automatisering. Tæt samarbejde med ledelsen og kort vej fra idé til handling. En uformel arbejdsplads med ambitiøse kolleger. Løn efter kvalifikationer. Stillingen er primært fysisk på vores kontor med mulighed for lejlighedsvist hjemmearbejde. Er du interesseret? Send os dit CV og en kort beskrivelse af dig selv. Har du tidligere udviklet digitale løsninger, bygget automatiseringer eller arbejdet med AI-projekter, vil vi meget gerne se eksempler – uanset om det er professionelt eller i din fritid. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Du bedes sende din ansøgning samt CV til: philip@fairpris.dk

items.desc: Leader français de l’assurance auto en ligne depuis 1992, Direct Assurance, entité du Groupe AXA, propose également des offres d’assurance habitation, moto et santé. Aujourd'hui, plus de deux millions de clients nous font confiance grâce à un tarif adapté et une gestion des sinistres personnalisée. Dans un marché assurantiel très compétitif, Direct Assurance conçoit des solutions adaptées aux besoins de ses clients en défendant leur pouvoir d’achat. Nous faisons de l'expérience client une priorité en mettant à disposition une gamme de produits simple, claire et performante. Si vous recherchez un environnement convivial, dynamique, digital et tourné vers l'innovation, au sein d'une entreprise en croissance, rejoignez-nous ! Vous allez aimer grandir à nos côtés. Vous allez aimer innover avec nous. Vous allez aimer que nos clients nous adorent. VOTRE RÔLE ET VOS MISSIONS Au sein de la Direction Technique Intégrez l’équipe prime commerciale Auto et contribuez à des projets data ambitieux à fort impact pour plusieurs millions de clients. En utilisant Python et des environnements cloud, vous développerez et automatiserez des modèles de machine learning avancés : classification pour la conversion client, modélisation d’élasticité, prédiction des prix concurrents, modélisation de la valeur client et analyse des comportements. Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des modèles (feature engineering, industrialisation avec MLFlow et CI/CD, monitoring du drift, visualisation sur dashboard) dans une démarche MLOps moderne. Ce stage vous offrira une expérience complète de la data science appliquée, mêlant challenge technique, innovation produit et impact business concret. VOTRE PROFIL Nous recherchons un profil avec les compétences suivantes : Compétences et formation : Etudiant en dernière année d’une école d’ingénieur (X, Centrale, ENSAE…) ou ayant suivi une formation en Data Science / ML Engineer. Compétences techniques : Bonne maîtrise en probabilités, statistiques, et modélisation. Bonne maîtrise en programmation (Python, R, SQL, Git). Des connaissances en provisionnement sont appréciées. Compétences personnelles/relationnelles : Forte rigueur Qualités de formalisme et de pédagogie Goût pour le travail en équipe, forte motivation et implication Autonomie et force de proposition Le poste est basé à Suresnes (92) à proximité de la Défense. POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? Nous sommes persuadés que pour bien prendre soin de nos clients, nous devons commencer par bien prendre soin de nos collaborateurs ! Les avantages que nous proposons à nos salariés sont nombreux. Nous choisir, c’est bénéficier : D’un package de rémunération complet comprenant un salaire fixe, un complément de rémunération variable, des primes, de la participation et de l’intéressement, la possibilité d’acquérir des actions AXA, ou encore des solutions d’épargne avantageuses ; D’un cadre de travail flexible jusqu’à 3 jours de télétravail possible par semaine (selon profil du poste), des tickets restaurant pour les jours télétravaillés ou encore une participation à l’achat d’un écran ou fauteuil ergonomique ; D’une politique visant à concilier vie personnelle et vie professionnelle avec 28 jours de congés payés, entre 14 et 16 RTT selon les années, des formules de travail à temps partiel ou encore des jours d’absence rémunérées pour la rentrée scolaire ou un déménagement par exemple ; De la possibilité de s’engager pour une cause qui vous tient à cœur grâce à nos associations telles que AXA Atout Cœur, AXA Compétences Solidaires ou encore AXA Prévention ; Et bien plus encore ! Perspectives de développement des compétences et de carrières immenses, CE, conciergerie, offres privilèges, soutien en cas d’épreuve personnelle…On s’arrête là, la liste est longue En lien avec nos engagements, nous célébrons chaque arrivée en agissant en faveur de la reforestation mondiale : nous plantons un arbre pour chaque recrutement. Alors, prêt à postuler ? VOTRE ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL Notre raison d’être chez AXA ? Chaque jour, nous agissons ensemble pour le progrès humain en protégeant ce qui compte dans + de 50 pays. Accompagner près de 95 millions de clients à chaque étape de leur vie, une mission qui donne le sourire et envie de se lever le matin à nos employés et agents (+ de 145 000 dans le monde !). Chez AXA, nous sommes riches de nos singularités et accueillons tous les profils dans leur diversité. Au-delà de mener une politique inclusive engagée, nous agissons au quotidien en tant qu’employeur citoyen et responsable pour des causes sociétales & environnementales. Ces ambitions vous parlent ? Alors rejoignez un des leaders de l’assurance et venez changer le monde avec nous ! Nous faisons de l’expérience collaborateur notre priorité. Nous proposons des parcours de développement professionnel en adéquation avec la transformation digitale du secteur de l’assurance pour enrichir votre panel de compétences. Job Description We are looking for a Data Engineer Trainee interested in Azure Databricks and modern cloud data platforms to join our data engineering team. The candidate will develop and support modern data pipelines and Lakehouse architectures, leveraging Azure Databricks, Spark, and Azure Data Factory, while integrating with existing SQL Server-based data warehouse environments. The role offers an opportunity to learn and grow within a modern cloud data ecosystem while contributing to analytics and business intelligence initiatives. Key responsibilities: Support and evolve existing SQL Server data platforms and ETL solutions Develop and maintain data pipelines using Azure Databricks Learn and contribute to data transformations using PySpark and SQL. Develop ETL/ELT pipelines orchestrated through Azure Data Factory Assist in integrating data from multiple sources into analytical platforms. Help maintain data models and data warehouse structures. Ensure data quality, scalability, and performance of large-scale data processing pipelines Collaborate with BI teams to support Power BI and reporting platforms Participate in the implementation of modern cloud-based data architectures under guidance from senior team members Qualifications Bachelor's degree (completed or in progress) in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems or a related field. Understanding of data warehousing concepts. Basic understanding of databases and SQL. Basic understanding of basic data processing and ETL/data pipelines concepts. Basic knowledge of Python or another programming language. Interest in Data Engineering, Cloud Technologies, and Big Data concepts. Strong willingness to learn new technologies and work in a collaborative environment. Good English communication skills. Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Good communication and collaboration skills Team player with a proactive mindset Eager to learn and continuously develop technical expertise Adaptable and comfortable working in dynamic environments Nice to have Familiarity with Power BI, Databricks or other cloud platforms. Familiarity with Azure Data Factory Familiarity with Delta Lake and Lakehouse architectures Familiarity with Git or other version control systems. Familiarity with AI tools, such as Microsoft Copilot. items.desc: Would you like to build the data foundation for Ambu’s next generation of AI products? Do you enjoy working with clinical data and ensuring its quality? Are you motivated by collaborating across disciplines to create datasets that support AI development and evaluation? Then this might be your defining moment. Join us as AI Data Specialist in our Algorithms & AI department in either Augsburg, Germany, or Ballerup, Denmark. Together, We Shape What's Next At Ambu, your expertise can make a difference to the people delivering and receiving care. Across our portfolio, our products support more than 100 million patients worldwide every year. As part of Global R&D, you’ll join skilled colleagues who share their knowledge, take ownership and work through challenges together. You’ll contribute to a strong innovation pipeline spanning devices and digital solutions, with EndoIntelligence™ bringing hardware, software and AI together to support the full endoscopy workflow. About The Role As an AI Data Specialist, you’ll contribute to the planning, execution, documentation and communication of data activities across AI product development projects. Your work will span early feasibility studies through product validation and market release. Working closely with AI engineers, clinical stakeholders, data specialists and project teams, you’ll help ensure that datasets are clinically relevant, representative and suitable for AI development and evaluation. You’ll contribute to activities ranging from defining data requirements and planning collection through annotation, quality review and dataset maintenance. You’ll have the opportunity to deepen your expertise in clinical data and AI product development, learning from colleagues across technical and clinical disciplines while seeing how your work supports the development of medical technology. Key Responsibilities Your main responsibilities will include: Contribute to defining data requirements based on intended clinical use, including dataset composition, representativeness, bias assessment and validation considerations. Support statistical analyses for performance evaluation, subgroup analyses and AI product validation. Collaborate with clinical experts and project teams to gather insights, support prototype evaluations and develop annotation strategies. Support assessments of data-related risks, quality, feasibility and regulatory considerations throughout the product lifecycle. Assist with data acquisition planning and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to support data collection. Support data governance activities, including anonymization, annotation planning, data quality review, traceability and dataset maintenance. Contribute to design control, verification, validation and regulatory documentation for AI-enabled medical devices. Suggested candidate profile Skills Skills and experience can be earned in many ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be fully described on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this position if you have: An MSc or PhD in data science, statistics, biomedical engineering, medical informatics, clinical research, medicine or a related field. Knowledge of statistics, performance evaluation, data quality and representativeness. Experience working with datasets, annotation activities, data validation or data quality assurance. An understanding of clinical workflows and an interest in clinical data handling. Knowledge of data-driven products, research projects, clinical studies or AI/ML development. Fluency in spoken and written English. You’ll typically bring two to five years of relevant professional experience. We also encourage candidates with different experience levels to apply if their skills and background match the role. Familiarity with design control processes and relevant regulatory frameworks, such as the EU MDR, FDA guidance for AI/ML-enabled medical devices or the EU AI Act, would also be valuable. You bring an analytical and structured approach and enjoy working through complex questions with colleagues. You’re comfortable collaborating across clinical, technical and data disciplines, sharing your knowledge and learning from others. You contribute to an inclusive environment where people support one another and work towards common goals. About The Team You’ll join our global Algorithms & AI department, consisting of 18 colleagues across multiple sites. The department is part of Software & Electronics within Ambu R&D and brings together expertise in AI development, image processing and data management. We work in a scaled agile environment and collaborate closely with Clinical Affairs and other software teams. You’ll have colleagues with different technical and clinical perspectives to exchange ideas with and work alongside as you address the data challenges involved in developing AI products.You will report to the Team Manager for Data Management. items.desc:
Company:

 General Summary: 
 General Summary: 
 Qualcomm is leveraging its strengths in compute, connectivity, and AI acceleration to play a central role in the evolution of Cloud AI. The Qualcomm Cloud AI team develops hardware and software platforms enabling efficient inference of large-scale foundation models.
 We are seeking a Staff Engineer – AI Model Optimization Architect to lead end-to-end model transformation and optimization for LLMs, VLMs, diffusion, and multimodal models on Qualcomm inference accelerators. This role works closely with compiler, performance, and accuracy teams to translate models into accelerator efficient execution while balancing throughput, latency, memory, and quality. The scope spans Day0 enablement through production deployment, with a strong emphasis on scaling optimizations to future architectures.
 Key Responsibilities 
 · Architect and deliver model optimization strategies that transform PyTorch models for efficient inference on Qualcomm accelerators.
 · Drive graph capture and deployment using PyTorch, ONNX, and torch.compile, including model rewrites and graph-level transformations.
 · Design and implement fusion kernels using DSL based approaches (e.g., Triton), enabling fused operations and performance critical algorithmic rewrites.
 · Partner deeply with compiler, performance, and accuracy teams to co-design lowering strategies, kernel fusion, layout decisions, and runtime integration.
 · Profile and optimize LLM/VLM/diffusion inference for throughput and latency across batch sizes, sequence lengths, and serving modes.
 · Own transformer specific optimizations including KVcache management, decoding behavior, and long context performance.
 · Enable and optimize continuous batching (dynamic/iteration-level scheduling), understanding its impact on memory, scheduling, and tail latency.
 · Architect and scale distributed inference strategies (e.g., sharding and parallelism) across multi-core and multi-device systems.
 · Establish reusable approaches to scale model optimizations to new hardware architectures, creating robust patterns and tooling.
 · Debug complex performance or stability issues to root cause and drive production ready solutions.
 Required Qualifications 
 · Expert level expertise in PyTorch and inference focused model optimization; strong Python engineering skills.
 · Hands on experience with torch.compile / TorchDynamo or related graph capture and compilation workflows.
 · Deep understanding of transformer architectures, attention mechanisms, MoEs, and performance trade-offs.
 · Practical experience with KVcache behavior, serving time optimizations, and memory/performance tradeoffs.
 · Strong foundation in computer architecture, ML accelerators, and distributed systems.
 · Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical efforts and influence design decisions.
 · MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
 Preferred / Bonus Qualifications 
 · Experience developing fusion kernels using Triton or similar DSLs, and collaborating with ML compiler teams.
 · Familiarity with LLM serving stacks and continuous batching systems.
 · Background in numerical methods, performance/accuracy trade-off analysis, or evaluation frameworks.

A gateway to Europe, Cork airport provides access to almost 50 international destinations including transatlantic air routes.

Your scope is as wide as a CEO/COO’s: strategy, operations, finance, legal, people, product marketing and launches. The difference is how you do it. In a classic company, the right hand coordinates people and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the
items.desc: You dream of a new challenge, of being able to make a company scale and feel that you have a real impact. If you dream of a life that is more like an adventure than a stable life, then becoming the AI-native right hand of our CEO is for you. This isn’t another chief of staff or right hand job. Most companies call themselves AI-first because they gave everyone a ChatGPT licence. We think that’s level 2, and there are 10. At Paradox our ambition is $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents. Here, AI doesn’t assist the work. It runs the loops, in every department. Your job is to make that true for the whole company, side by side with the CEO. But wait a minute. Deep inside you are looking for a new adventure with… Freedom: working remotely or hybrid, and being trusted to deliver Ambition: building one of the first truly AI-native companies, with teammates who push AI to its limits every week Impact: changing the trajectory of a whole company, not one line of a roadmap, with a product that transforms people’s lives at scale Then, you have found the next adventure that will fulfill you. WHAT AI-NATIVE MEANS AT PARADOX In a company of fewer than 10 people, the right hand used to be the person who absorbed everything the CEO couldn’t do. Here, the right hand builds the machine that does it. Our company has to be able to: Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, offers, decisions, procedures, member stories and past experiments, in one shared company brain that every person and every agent reads before acting. Turn every decision into execution. A meeting, a voice note or a call with the CEO becomes briefs, tickets, follow-ups and deadlines, without anyone retyping it. Act across every tool. Not a chatbot in a tab: agents read and write in our whole stack, from code to CRM, billing, analytics, ads, email, calendar and documents. Ship. Produce the analysis, the contract draft, the page, the offer or the process, and put it live. Measure with real KPIs. Revenue, cash, margin, retention and the transformation of our members, not activity. Learn and loop on its own. Keep what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting. People set the ambition, the taste and the standards. The machine runs the loop, and gets better every week. This is already real. Our company brain holds our decisions and procedures. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment with its result. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars and audit our tracking after every live. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day, by text and by voice. But maybe YOU WONDER WHAT’S OUR STORY? We believe self-help is broken. Most people use learning platforms the same way: generic theory, a quick high, no real change. They deserve more than content and more than motivation. They deserve a system that knows them , one that adapts, challenges and grows with them. That’s why we merge: Human Intelligence (coaches, peers and mentors) Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals) Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys) into one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS, the Operating System for Human Greatness, augmented with AI. Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world, and for something that will outlive any individual, its founder included. Here’s the bet: A small team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size. And that’s where you come in. YOUR MISSION Reporting directly to the founder and CEO, you will help him run and grow the company. Your scope is as wide as a CEO/COO’s: strategy, operations, finance, legal, people, product marketing and launches. The difference is how you do it. In a classic company, the right hand coordinates people and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls. With fewer than 10 people, there is no department to hand things to. You build it. YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS 1 - Be the CEO’s operating system The old way: a chief of staff takes notes in meetings, chases people by email and builds the weekly report by hand. At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every CEO decision into execution. Meetings, voice notes and calls become briefs, tickets and follow-ups. Every Monday, the CEO gets one brief: what moved, what’s stuck, and what needs his call. You decide what the CEO must see and what he never needs to see again. items.desc: Zie jij hoe digitale tools het werk van mensen écht makkelijker kunnen maken? Word je enthousiast van een slimme automatisatie, een gebruiksvriendelijke SharePoint-omgeving of een AI-toepassing die een concrete vraag oplost? En deel je die kennis graag met collega’s én klanten? Dan hebben we bij MONDEA een uitdaging voor jou. MONDEA begeleidt publieke en non profitorganisaties bij hun strategie, organisatieontwikkeling en resultaten. Dat doen we samen met de klant, vanuit een aanpak die past bij de vraag en de organisatie. Als Microsoft 365 & AI specialist werk je mee aan onze eigen digitale werking én ondersteun je klanten bij hun digitale uitdagingen. Je combineert technische kennis met inzicht in hoe mensen samenwerken en organisaties functioneren. Voor deze functie zoeken we een collega in loondienst. Je maakt deel uit van onze backoffice en werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit verschillende expertisedomeinen. Ongeveer de helft van je tijd zet je in voor MONDEA zelf. De andere helft werk je mee aan opdrachten bij klanten. Afhankelijk van de projecten en de noden kan die verhouding tijdelijk wijzigen. Wat kan jouw job inhouden? Bij MONDEA is geen dag helemaal dezelfde. We geven je graag enkele voorbeelden van wat je kan doen. Je versterkt onze eigen digitale werking. Je bouwt mee aan een gebruiksvriendelijke digitale werkplek in Microsoft 365. Je ontwikkelt en verbetert SharePoint- en Teams-omgevingen. Je onderzoekt samen met collega’s hoe we processen slimmer kunnen organiseren en repetitieve taken kunnen automatiseren. Je gaat aan de slag met Power Apps en Power Automate om praktische toepassingen te bouwen en te verbeteren. Je verkent hoe we Copilot en andere AI-toepassingen zinvol kunnen inzetten. Je helpt collega’s op weg en zorgt ervoor dat oplossingen ook achter de schermen goed beheerd kunnen worden. Je gaat samen met klanten aan de slag. Je luistert naar hun vragen over digitale samenwerking, intranet, automatisatie en AI. Je vertaalt hun noden naar een haalbare aanpak en concrete oplossingen. Je bouwt of verbetert bijvoorbeeld een SharePoint-omgeving, een digitale werkplek of een automatisatie. Je begeleidt medewerkers bij het gebruik van nieuwe toepassingen. Zo help je organisaties vooruit met digitale oplossingen die aansluiten bij hun werking en die medewerkers ook echt gebruiken. Wie zoeken we? Je hoeft geen expert te zijn in elke tool die we hierboven noemen. Je brengt een stevige basis mee en hebt goesting om je expertise verder uit te bouwen. Je hebt ervaring met Microsoft 365, in het bijzonder met SharePoint en Teams. Je hebt ervaring met het bouwen of verbeteren van oplossingen in Power Apps en/of Power Automate. Je ziet kansen in AI en wil je verder verdiepen in toepassingen zoals Copilot en Copilot Studio. Je denkt mee over de vraag achter de vraag en zoekt een oplossing die past bij de gebruiker en de organisatie. Je kan technische mogelijkheden helder uitleggen aan mensen met verschillende niveaus van digitale kennis. Je werkt graag samen, maar kan ook zelfstandig je werk organiseren en verantwoordelijkheid opnemen. Je hebt oog voor privacy, informatiebeveiliging en een zorgvuldige opvolging. Ervaring met het begeleiden van klanten of gebruikers is een troef. Kennis van lokale besturen, andere overheidsorganisaties of non profitorganisaties is mooi meegenomen. In deze concrete functiebeschrijving vind je nog meer info. Is er een match met ons MON DNA? Ons MON DNA bepaalt mee hoe we samenwerken, keuzes maken en het verschil maken bij klanten én binnen MONDEA. Onze waarden vormen daarbij het kompas. We zoeken daarom een match tussen wie jij bent en hoe wij werken. Kan jij je hierin vinden? Je hebt goesting om publieke en non profitorganisaties vooruit te helpen. Je krijgt energie van afwisseling en nieuwe uitdagingen. Je neemt initiatief, ziet kansen en denkt oplossingsgericht. Je werkt zelfstandig en neemt verantwoordelijkheid op. Je luistert om te begrijpen wat iemand nodig heeft. Je deelt je kennis graag en werkt vlot samen met collega’s en klanten. Je combineert een doordachte aanpak met de wil om dingen concreet te maken. Wat kunnen wij jou bieden? Je gaat als medewerker in loondienst aan de slag bij MONDEA. Voor deze functie voorzien we geen samenwerking op freelancebasis. Je komt terecht in een warm team van gedreven en getalenteerde Mondeanen. Je combineert de uitbouw van onze eigen digitale werking met afwisselende opdrachten bij klanten. Je krijgt ruimte om te groeien en bij te leren, onder meer via interne opleidingen en vormingsdagen. Je werkt samen met collega’s uit verschillende expertisedomeinen en krijgt de kans om mee vorm te geven aan onze digitale dienstverlening. We bieden je een marktconforme vergoeding en een uitgebreid pakket aan extra’s. Wil je graag weten wat dit concreet betekent, neem contact op via hr@mondea.be. BBQ’s op vrijdag, gezellige familiedagen en fijne teamactiviteiten krijg je er gratis bij. Hoe verloopt de selectie? Solliciteer uiterlijk op 4 …

items.desc: Motiveres du af teamwork og opbygning og udvikling af AI i krydsfeltet mellem forretning, data og teknologi? Så har du nu chancen for at få en central rolle i et greenfield IT-miljø, der er unikt i størrelse, opgave og karakteristika. Om os Program for Digital og Operativ Transformation skal sikre koncernens fremtidige IT-understøttelse, og bidrager dermed til den digitale transformation og til at styrke Forsvarets kampkraft. Du bliver en del af Digital Backbone afdelingen, der står for den konkrete etablering af IT-platformen med kolleger, der er spænder fra selvlærte til forskere. Om stillingen Vi søger en fagligt forankret holdspiller til sektionen for AI Design og Engineering. Sektionen er under etablering, og skal designe og implementere en standardiseret, sikker AI platform til datahåndtering, modeludvikling og optimering, samt initial drift til understøttelse af den skalerbare Digital Backbone. Vi søger en dataprofil med stærk teknisk forståelse for ontologier, semantisk modellering og komplekse datastrukturer, som kan være med til at etablere og udvikle Forsvarets ontologi. I krydsfeltet mellem forretning, data og teknologi skal du kunne forstå, hvordan forretningsbegreber hænger sammen, hvordan de er repræsenteret i eksisterende data og systemer, og hvordan disse sammenhænge kan omsættes til en konsistent og skalerbar semantisk model. Du vil arbejde tæt sammen med både forretningsområder, machine learning engineers, arkitekter og andre tekniske profiler. En central del af rollen bliver at skabe forbindelsen mellem organisationens begrebsverden og de underliggende datastrukturer. Dine primære opgaver vil være: Drive den indledende kortlægning og modellering af organisationens ontologi, herunder begreber, entiteter, egenskaber og relationer. Analysere eksisterende datamodeller, datastrukturer, metadata og datakilder for at forstå, hvordan centrale forretningsbegreber er repræsenteret. Omsætte komplekse forretningsbegreber og domæneviden til strukturerede og teknisk anvendelige modeller. Identificer semantiske overlap, uoverensstemmelser, afhængigheder og mangler på tværs af data og systemer. Definere sammenhænge og mappings mellem forskellige datamodeller, begrebsmodeller og informationsstrukturer. Bidrage til principper for, hvordan ontologien integreres med den eksisterende dataarkitektur og anvendes på tværs af ontologien. Samarbejde med tekniske teams om at sikre, at ontologien kan understøtte dataintegration, analyse, søgning og fremtidige AI-baserede anvendelser. Undersøge, hvordan AI og automatisering kan anvendes til eksempelvis klassifikation, begrebsidentifikation, relations ekstraktion og berigelse af ontologien. Vi garanterer en varieret hverdag i et miljø med start-up ånd, hvor et stort ansvar går hånd i hånd med stor indflydelse. Du får mulighed for fleksible arbejdstider, personlig og faglig kompetenceudvikling, arbejdsgiverbetalt pensionsordning og betalt frokostpause. Om dig Du har en relevant IT-uddannelse og en solid IT-erhvervserfaring, idet vi vægter faglighed og nysgerrighed højere end formelle papirer. Er du den rette profil, tilbyder vi den nødvendige oplæring og adgang til de rette værktøjer, så du kan løse opgaverne. Vi forestiller os, at du har: Solid erfaring med ontologier, semantisk modellering, knowledge repræsentation eller data lineage områder. Stærk forståelse for datamodellering, datastrukturer, metadata, relationer og integration mellem forskellige datakilder. Forståelse for den konceptuelle og den tekniske side af data og kan omsætte mellem forretningsmæssige behov og tekniske modeller. Erfaring med komplekse og heterogene datamiljøer og kan identificere strukturelle og semantiske sammenhænge på tværs af data. Baggrund inden for eksempelvis data engineering, data science, analytics, informationsarkitektur eller lignende. Stærke analytiske og konceptuelle evner og trives med problemstillinger, hvor løsningen ikke er defineret på forhånd. Erfaring med eller interesse for AI, machine learning eller NLP og kan se, hvordan disse teknologier kan understøtte semantisk modellering og dataarbejde. Du kan kommunikere tekniske og konceptuelle problemstillinger klart til både tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter. Du behersker teknisk engelsk og har kørekort til almindelig bil (kategori B). Ansættelsesvilkår Er du akademiker ansættes du i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række akademikerorganisationer for akademikere i staten (Akademikeroverenskomsten). Har du en IT-faglig uddannelse eller en anden relevant uddannelse ansættes du i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) og organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere. Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, tilpasser vi funktionen. Der er mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen …

items.desc: The Slash team and its mission Slash connects with Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 to protect employees against phishing attacks. When an email looks malicious, Slash warns the employee inside the email, before they click. When the threat is confirmed, Slash removes it from every mailbox in the company. When someone seems to impersonate a colleague, Slash checks with that colleague directly in Slack, Teams or Google Chat. To catch them, Slash combines technical signals with an analysis of each email by LLMs, and learns from every attack our customers confirm. The hard part is precision. A security alert on a legitimate email costs the customer's trust, and an attack we miss can cost them money. Slash is built by a small team that also builds Inbox and Ask Albert. We are hiring an ML engineer to grow the detection work. Requirements What you will do Make the verdicts right. Improve the models that decide when Slash blocks, warns or stays silent: learned scores fitted on admin verdicts, the signals they read, and the prompts of each attack classifier. Every change is measured before it ships. Own the evaluation. We evaluate on labelled datasets and compare two runs verdict by verdict (what flipped to correct, what regressed). You will grow the labelled corpus, keep the benchmarks honest, and tell real gains apart from model noise. Choose models and providers on evidence. Our classifiers run on LLMs served through AWS Bedrock and Azure OpenAI. You will benchmark new models, structured outputs and prompt optimization methods, and own the migrations. Extend the memory of known attacks. Improve how confirmed attacks are embedded, retrieved and used as precedents, so Slash catches the next email of a campaign it has already seen. Bring new signals to the classifiers. Text extracted from attachments, pages behind links and QR codes, calendar invitations, sharing platforms: help decide what the models read and how. Detect compromised accounts. Contribute to the account takeover detection we are building: learn each employee's normal sending behaviour, combine it with Google and Microsoft security signals, and decide when an account looks compromised. Ship to production. You write the code that runs on live email traffic, and you follow it after release. Our codebase is in Elixir: no prior experience is needed, you will pick it up with the team. Our technical stack Detection and ML : LLMs on AWS Bedrock and Azure OpenAI, embeddings with pgvector, versioned datasets and benchmark runs in PostgreSQL, OCR for attachments. Backend : Elixir, Phoenix, PostgreSQL, Oban, LiveView. Ops : AWS, Terraform, Datadog, Sentry. AI tooling : Claude Code, Codex, Cubic. Who you are Level : 3 years of experience or more. Must-have You know classical ML: you build an evaluation set, pick the metric that matches what each error costs the product (precision, recall, false positive rate), then build features, fit a model and set its threshold. You have shipped LLM-based features with clean, tested code and structured outputs, and you followed them once live. You are at ease with exploratory work: you take an open question, prototype it quickly, and can tell a real gain from noise before anything ships. You have experience as a software engineer in at least one language such as Python, Rust or Go: clean, tested, reviewable code, and SQL. You use AI coding tools every day. You are a doer: you take a vague problem, scope it, and get it to production. You can explain a result in a few sentences, to an engineer as well as to a PM. You are fluent in French and English. You live in Paris or are ready to relocate. Nice-to-have Experience with classification on text or email data, fraud and anomaly detection, or security. Embeddings and retrieval (vector search, pgvector). Fine-tuning or evaluating open-weight models. LLM model comparison, cost and latency trade-offs, prompt optimization methods (DSPy, GEPA or similar). Reading and applying research papers. Benefits It will be a cultural fit if You're a doer: not afraid to get your hands dirty and get things done. You have high standards: expect performance to be nothing short of the best. You are an enthusiastic at heart: exhibit passion and excitement over work. Why join us at Riot Join a financially-healthy company: we're financially strong and highly capital-efficient. Fundraising fuels our momentum, enabling us to scale faster and unlock new growth opportunities. Contribute to a fast-growing startup with a strong vision and high ambitions, backed by clear business goals. We've tripled our revenue over the past two years, and we plan to grow from €20M to €30M ARR in 2026. Experience the energy of a collaborative team in our modern and cosy office located in heart of Paris: République / Canal Saint-Martin Recruitment process ️ First call with Thomas, Talent Acquisition Manager (30') Technical interview with Roman, Engineering Manager (45minutes) Onsite interview with Roman and future teammates …

items.desc: About the role: We are looking for an experienced Test Engineer – HIL who thrives in the broad spectrum between initial concept, quick prototyping and final validation for cutting-edge autonomy products in the Land Domain . You will drive building and refining our HIL and HW Test Bench infrastructure together with the HW team, and establish automated component- or subsystem-level tests on this infrastructure as an essential part of our overall test strategy. What is your Day to Day Mission: Design, build and configure HIL test benches, hardware test setups and breadboards based on individual project requirements. Develop and maintain automated tests for components and subsystems. Integrate relevant hardware, sensors, interfaces and software into the test environment. Execute test campaigns and assess the resulting data. Define clear pass, fail and invalid test criteria , including for early-stage systems where specifications may still be evolving. Analyse test failures and distinguish between actual product issues and problems caused by the test setup. Provide engineering teams with clear, actionable feedback based on your test results. Collaborate closely with hardware, software, autonomy and systems engineering teams. Continuously improve our test infrastructure, processes and overall verification and validation approach. What you bring to the team: Strong hands-on experience with HIL/HW testing, test benches and test automation , ideally in autonomy, robotics or similar complex systems. Solid understanding of sensors, perception, path planning and motion control , combined with the ability to troubleshoot hardware and software integration issues. A pragmatic and analytical approach to testing, including defining meaningful test criteria and pass/fail conditions , even when requirements are still evolving. A hands-on and resourceful mindset , enabling you to create effective test environments and find practical solutions in fast-moving prototype projects. Strong communication and collaboration skills to analyse failures together with engineering teams and translate test results into clear, actionable feedback . A self-driven and adaptable working style with the motivation to take ownership and move challenging projects forward. Your Benefits: Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities. About us: Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.
