items.desc: Kendis is building the next generation of AI-assisted planning and delivery experiences for enterprise teams. We are looking for a curious, analytical, and product-minded person to help shape how AI works across Kendis. This is not a traditional AI engineering role. You will focus on the quality of the AI experience: how Kendis understands context, generates useful information, presents insights, responds to different user needs, and supports better decisions. You will work across prompts, AI-generated reports, dashboards, summaries, recommendations, contextual guidance, and new interface concepts. Your responsibility will be to turn AI capabilities into experiences that feel relevant, reliable, and genuinely useful to our customers. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys experimenting, analysing results, identifying patterns, improving language and workflows, and thinking deeply about how people interact with intelligent software. What you will work on You will: Design, test, and continuously improve prompts and AI instructions used across Kendis. Evaluate AI responses for accuracy, relevance, clarity, consistency, and usefulness. Explore how different prompts, context, user roles, and data inputs affect output quality. Develop test scenarios covering different industries, teams, planning situations, and data conditions. Help define how Kendis should provide contextual summaries, recommendations, explanations, and next steps. Shape AI-assisted reports, dashboards, planning views, and decision-support experiences. Work with product and design teams on new AI interaction patterns and interface concepts. Identify weak, inconsistent, or misleading outputs and determine how they can be improved. Create high-quality examples and evaluation criteria that define what a good result should look like. Analyse customer feedback and usage patterns to understand where AI provides value and where it causes friction. Collaborate with engineering teams to improve the context and information supplied to AI models. Help ensure that AI-generated content follows the appropriate tone, terminology, structure, and level of detail. Compare different models and approaches from a product-quality perspective. Contribute ideas for entirely new ways AI can improve planning, tracking, reporting, and portfolio-level decision-making. What we are looking for You do not need to be an AI engineer. We are more interested in how you think. You may come from product analysis, business analysis, UX research, UX writing, quality assurance, consulting, data analysis, product operations, customer success, or another analytical background. You should have: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written communication and attention to language. The ability to recognise subtle differences in quality, tone, relevance, and meaning. A strong interest in AI products and how people use them. The ability to test ideas systematically rather than relying only on intuition. Good product sense and an understanding of what makes software useful and easy to work with. Curiosity about enterprise workflows, reporting, planning, and decision-making. Comfort working with incomplete information and experimenting until a better solution is found. The ability to work closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and customer-facing teams. Helpful, but not required Experience in any of the following would be valuable: Prompt design or evaluation of generative AI applications. Product management or product analytics. UX writing, interaction design, or user research. Software testing and quality assurance. Business intelligence, dashboards, or reporting. Agile planning, portfolio management, Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar enterprise tools. Basic familiarity with structured data, APIs, JSON, SQL, or analytics tools. What success looks like In this role, success means: AI outputs become more accurate, relevant, and consistent. Users receive information that reflects their actual context rather than generic responses. AI-generated reports and insights require less manual correction. New AI experiences are tested and refined before reaching customers. Product teams have clear quality standards and examples for AI behaviour. Customer feedback leads to measurable improvements in the Kendis experience. AI becomes a natural and valuable part of how customers plan, understand progress, and make decisions. Why join Kendis You will have the opportunity to influence AI features from an early stage and help define how intelligent enterprise software should work. Rather than improving a single chatbot, you will contribute to AI across the complete Kendis product experience—from planning and dependencies to risks, objectives, reports, dashboards, and portfolio-level insights. This role offers room for experimentation, ownership, and direct impact on the future direction of the Kendis platform. Job Type: Full-time Pay: 1,500.00€ - 3,000.00€ per month Work …

items.card: YOUR MISSION Reporting directly to the founder and CEO, you will help him run and grow the company. Your scope is as wide as a CEO/COO’s: strategy, operations, finance, legal, people, product marketing and launches. The difference is how you do it. In a classic company, the right hand coordinates people and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the
items.desc: You dream of a new challenge, of being able to make a company scale and feel that you have a real impact. If you dream of a life that is more like an adventure than a stable life, then becoming the AI-native right hand of our CEO is for you. This isn’t another chief of staff or right hand job. Most companies call themselves AI-first because they gave everyone a ChatGPT licence. We think that’s level 2, and there are 10. At Paradox our ambition is $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents. Here, AI doesn’t assist the work. It runs the loops, in every department. Your job is to make that true for the whole company, side by side with the CEO. But wait a minute. Deep inside you are looking for a new adventure with… Freedom: working remotely or hybrid, and being trusted to deliver Ambition: building one of the first truly AI-native companies, with teammates who push AI to its limits every week Impact: changing the trajectory of a whole company, not one line of a roadmap, with a product that transforms people’s lives at scale Then, you have found the next adventure that will fulfill you. WHAT AI-NATIVE MEANS AT PARADOX In a company of fewer than 10 people, the right hand used to be the person who absorbed everything the CEO couldn’t do. Here, the right hand builds the machine that does it. Our company has to be able to: Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, offers, decisions, procedures, member stories and past experiments, in one shared company brain that every person and every agent reads before acting. Turn every decision into execution. A meeting, a voice note or a call with the CEO becomes briefs, tickets, follow-ups and deadlines, without anyone retyping it. Act across every tool. Not a chatbot in a tab: agents read and write in our whole stack, from code to CRM, billing, analytics, ads, email, calendar and documents. Ship. Produce the analysis, the contract draft, the page, the offer or the process, and put it live. Measure with real KPIs. Revenue, cash, margin, retention and the transformation of our members, not activity. Learn and loop on its own. Keep what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting. People set the ambition, the taste and the standards. The machine runs the loop, and gets better every week. This is already real. Our company brain holds our decisions and procedures. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment with its result. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars and audit our tracking after every live. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day, by text and by voice. But maybe YOU WONDER WHAT’S OUR STORY? We believe self-help is broken. Most people use learning platforms the same way: generic theory, a quick high, no real change. They deserve more than content and more than motivation. They deserve a system that knows them , one that adapts, challenges and grows with them. That’s why we merge: Human Intelligence (coaches, peers and mentors) Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals) Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys) into one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS, the Operating System for Human Greatness, augmented with AI. Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world, and for something that will outlive any individual, its founder included. Here’s the bet: A small team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size. And that’s where you come in. YOUR MISSION Reporting directly to the founder and CEO, you will help him run and grow the company. Your scope is as wide as a CEO/COO’s: strategy, operations, finance, legal, people, product marketing and launches. The difference is how you do it. In a classic company, the right hand coordinates people and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls. With fewer than 10 people, there is no department to hand things to. You build it. YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS 1 - Be the CEO’s operating system The old way: a chief of staff takes notes in meetings, chases people by email and builds the weekly report by hand. At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every CEO decision into execution. Meetings, voice notes and calls become briefs, tickets and follow-ups. Every Monday, the CEO gets one brief: what moved, what’s stuck, and what needs his call. You decide what the CEO must see and what he never needs to see again. His time goes to vision, product and members, not to coordination. 2 - Run strategic projects as a Pirate Squad of one, plus agents Depending on your zone of genius, these are examples of strategic …

items.desc: Locatie: Amsterdam Dienstverband: Stage Werktijden: 3 tot 5 dagen per week · 3-12 maanden (in overleg) Clappform zoekt een enthousiaste student met een passie voor data, AI en digitale dashboards. Tijdens deze afstudeerstage als Data Scientist werkt de stagiair aan uitdagende vraagstukken rondom digitalisering. De stagiair analyseert complexe datasets, ontwikkelt voorspellende modellen en ontdekt trends en patronen die leiden tot inzichten voor klanten en strategische beslissingen. Samen met een gedreven team levert de stagiair met data direct maatschappelijke impact. Over Clappform Clappform is een Nederlands low-code dataplatform dat organisaties helpt datagedreven te werken. Het platform koppelt bronsystemen, controleert de data bij elke import en maakt ze inzichtelijk via dashboards, kaarten en API-koppelingen. Met Clappform kunnen overheden en organisaties sneller en beter beslissingen nemen op basis van actuele en betrouwbare informatie. De oplossing is cloudgebaseerd, veilig (ISO-gecertificeerd) en flexibel opgebouwd volgens moderne architectuurprincipes zoals microservices en Common Ground. Gemeenten, provincies, woningcorporaties, afvalstoffendiensten en retailorganisaties gebruiken Clappform, onder meer voor leefbaarheid, woningbouw, duurzaamheid en de energietransitie. Dat levert directe maatschappelijke impact op. Het platform bestaat uit meerdere modules die continu in ontwikkeling zijn: van datavisualisatie tot interactieve componenten en tooling waarmee onze klanten zelf aan de slag gaan. Clappform stemt de data-analyse die de stagiair oppakt af op de interesses van de stagiair en op wat er op dat moment speelt. Werkzaamheden Verzamelen, verwerken en analyseren van grote datasets met behulp van geavanceerde analytische technieken en tools Ontwikkelen van algoritmes en modellen om complexe problemen op te lossen en voorspellingen te doen Identificeren van trends, patronen en inzichten in de gegevens om strategische aanbevelingen te doen voor verschillende afdelingen Samenwerken met interne belanghebbenden om zakelijke behoeften te begrijpen en data-oplossingen te ontwikkelen Communiceren van complexe analyses en resultaten aan zowel technische als niet-technische belanghebbenden op een duidelijke en begrijpelijke manier Gevraagd profiel De stagiair is een hbo- of wo-student in de richting van AI, Data Science, Wiskunde of Informatica, wil werkervaring opdoen in een technologiestartup en zich in korte tijd ontwikkelen. De stagiair heeft tijdens de studie ervaring opgedaan met kwantitatieve analyse of datamodellering en wil die ervaring uitbreiden. Verder geldt: Een sterk analytisch vermogen en tegelijkertijd een ‘doe’-mentaliteit Sterke communicatie- en samenwerkingsvaardigheden Kennis van voorspellende modellen, machine-learning, clustering- en classificatietechnieken en algoritmen Vaardig in Python Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal Beschikbaar voor 3-5 dagen per week; aantal maanden is bespreekbaar (ongeveer tussen de 3-12 maanden) Pluspunt: een persoonlijk project buiten de studie, uit eigen interesse bedacht en gebouwd, of een zelf opgelost probleem Wat bieden wij? Clappform is een snelgroeiend, innovatief bedrijf met enthousiaste mensen, en meerdere jaren ervaring in consulting, B2B-marketing en software. Het aanbod voor stagiairs: Intensieve begeleiding door het team gedurende de hele stage De kans om alle ins en outs van data-analyse te leren Veel verantwoordelijkheid voor een groot aantal verschillende taken Wekelijks samen sporten met het team onder begeleiding van een personal trainer (deelname vrijwillig) Lunch geregeld door kantoor Een stagevergoeding De kans om na de afstudeerstage bij Clappform aan de slag te gaan Solliciteren Stuur een cv en een korte motivatie naar info@clappform.com of t.griffioen@clappform.com. Vragen stellen of even sparren kan ook; een bericht is welkom. Meer weten over het Clappform-platform? Kijk op www.clappform.com. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

items.desc: You dream of a new challenge, of being able to make a company scale and feel that you have a real impact. If you dream of a life that is more like an adventure than a stable life, then becoming the AI-native right hand of our CEO is for you. This isn’t another chief of staff or right hand job. Most companies call themselves AI-first because they gave everyone a ChatGPT licence. We think that’s level 2, and there are 10. At Paradox our ambition is $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents. Here, AI doesn’t assist the work. It runs the loops, in every department. Your job is to make that true for the whole company, side by side with the CEO. But wait a minute. Deep inside you are looking for a new adventure with… Freedom: working remotely or hybrid, and being trusted to deliver Ambition: building one of the first truly AI-native companies, with teammates who push AI to its limits every week Impact: changing the trajectory of a whole company, not one line of a roadmap, with a product that transforms people’s lives at scale Then, you have found the next adventure that will fulfill you. WHAT AI-NATIVE MEANS AT PARADOX In a company of fewer than 10 people, the right hand used to be the person who absorbed everything the CEO couldn’t do. Here, the right hand builds the machine that does it. Our company has to be able to: Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, offers, decisions, procedures, member stories and past experiments, in one shared company brain that every person and every agent reads before acting. Turn every decision into execution. A meeting, a voice note or a call with the CEO becomes briefs, tickets, follow-ups and deadlines, without anyone retyping it. Act across every tool. Not a chatbot in a tab: agents read and write in our whole stack, from code to CRM, billing, analytics, ads, email, calendar and documents. Ship. Produce the analysis, the contract draft, the page, the offer or the process, and put it live. Measure with real KPIs. Revenue, cash, margin, retention and the transformation of our members, not activity. Learn and loop on its own. Keep what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting. People set the ambition, the taste and the standards. The machine runs the loop, and gets better every week. This is already real. Our company brain holds our decisions and procedures. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment with its result. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars and audit our tracking after every live. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day, by text and by voice. But maybe YOU WONDER WHAT’S OUR STORY? We believe self-help is broken. Most people use learning platforms the same way: generic theory, a quick high, no real change. They deserve more than content and more than motivation. They deserve a system that knows them , one that adapts, challenges and grows with them. That’s why we merge: Human Intelligence (coaches, peers and mentors) Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals) Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys) into one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS, the Operating System for Human Greatness, augmented with AI. Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world, and for something that will outlive any individual, its founder included. Here’s the bet: A small team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size. And that’s where you come in. YOUR MISSION Reporting directly to the founder and CEO, you will help him run and grow the company. Your scope is as wide as a CEO/COO’s: strategy, operations, finance, legal, people, product marketing and launches. The difference is how you do it. In a classic company, the right hand coordinates people and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls. With fewer than 10 people, there is no department to hand things to. You build it. YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS 1 - Be the CEO’s operating system The old way: a chief of staff takes notes in meetings, chases people by email and builds the weekly report by hand. At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every CEO decision into execution. Meetings, voice notes and calls become briefs, tickets and follow-ups. Every Monday, the CEO gets one brief: what moved, what’s stuck, and what needs his call. You decide what the CEO must see and what he never needs to see again. His time goes to vision, product and members, not to coordination. 2 - Run strategic projects as a Pirate Squad of one, plus agents Depending on your zone of genius, these are examples of strategic …

items.desc: Smadex is a performance advertising engine for mobile apps, enabling the world's leading marketers to grow across Mobile and Connected TV (CTV). Powered by AI models trained on real campaign outcomes, Smadex delivers profitable growth at scale. Headquartered in Barcelona, with teams across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, Smadex is a business unit of Entravision (NYSE: EVC). Our mission is to continue to improve our ad-tech platform, especially the core of it, our algorithms, to help our clients achieve their programmatic advertising campaign goals. We want to give our employees a job they’ll love, where they will be challenged to improve results through real-life engineering and data analysis and where everyone’s implication has an impact. Are you ready to be part of the new unicorn? Keep reading! As a Data Scientist embedded within our Machine Learning team , your mission is to bridge the gap between theoretical model design and real-world production reality. You will be the analytical anchor dedicated to ensuring the performance and stability of our core models ( Deep Neural Networks and Gradient Boosting decision trees ) within our high-frequency, complex auction ecosystem with millions of ad requests processed every second. We are looking for a deeply analytical individual —someone who isn't satisfied with "it works," but needs to understand the system at a fundamental level. You will apply scientific rigor to drive measurable improvements in our live bidding performance. Your Tasks and Responsibilities Deep-Dive Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of algorithms behavior in the live auctioned environment to understand how our algorithms interact with market dynamics. Model monitoring tools: Collaborate on the development and automation of advanced model performance monitoring tools. Understand our ML models in production. Develop tooling that helps the team understand why the models make specific predictions, moving beyond "black box" implementations. Experimentation: Design and analyze experiments, A/B testing, to validate hypotheses regarding bidding strategies and model improvements. System Optimization: Identify performance bottlenecks and propose architectural or feature enhancements to resolve non-optimal performance at the system level. What are we looking for Educational Background: A strong fundamental education (BSc, MSc, or PhD) in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, or Data Science . Technical Stack: Python , SQL . Statistical Rigor: A deep understanding of Statistics and Probability theory. ML Knowledge: Familiarity with core ML architectures - Gradient Boosting, Deep Neural Networks. Bonus Points (highly valued): Knowledge of Game Theory (auction dynamics). Background in Statistical Physics . Experience with Bayesian Inference . Discrete maths and graph theory Please note that we do NOT provide VISA sponsorship. Candidates without a legal permit to work in Spain won't be considered. What’s in it for you Integrate a highly motivated and young team. Great compensation package. Top location at the heart of Barcelona in a penthouse office with a rooftop terrace, barbeque, and a fully stocked fridge. Work from home: 2 days/week Private Health Insurance Access to LinkedIn Learning Meal vouchers - Tickets Restaurant monthly allowance. Monthly gym allowance: Choose between DiR Gym and Wellhub Monthly TGIF events. Regular team-building events. Fun and friendly work environment with talented marketers and engineers from over 40+ countries And more! O8XSeBwk0h

items.desc: Application Deadline: Dec. 7, 2026 Stockholm Hybrid Job Description Generative AI Designer. What are you, and what’s your purpose, really? Let’s get a bit existential here, because we want to tell you why this role exists here at Lyko. In a perfect world we want to go faster from idea to finished material, explore new creative possibilities, and make sure our creative team stays ahead of new technology. The role is brand new to us, and honestly, we don’t know exactly how it will evolve or what tools you’ll be playing with a year from now. If that makes you giggle a bit with excitement, keep reading! About the role So let’s be clear from the start: we don’t believe everything gets easy just because you hire someone who can prompt. We believe in a really good designer who finds it genuinely fun that the toolbox gets swapped out every so often. Someone who wants to help build, from the ground up, how we at Lyko work creatively with new technology. Let us paint you a picture of a possible week: On Monday, one of our brands is launching a new product. The AD has a vision, and by Wednesday it needs to be a set of images for the site and a few seconds of motion for social. No studio, no two days of buying props. You make it real, and you make sure it looks like us. On Tuesday, you turn ideas into quick visual sketches, with AI or other tools, when something needs to become physical, like an installation or store environment. And Friday afternoon is blocked off in your calendar to figure out what happened in AI this week (spoiler: the model changed. Again.). Next week, you show the rest of us what’s worth trying and what’s just hype. In practice, this means you’ll: Create stills and motion for campaigns, social media, e-commerce and our stores, often using generative tools and always keeping our brand identity in mind. Design ads, layouts and print originals, with typography, colour and composition that make the details just as good as the big idea. Build prompt templates and style references for recurring formats, so we get consistent results and don’t have to reinvent the wheel every time. Create quick, to-scale sketches when an idea needs to become something physical, like an installation or store environment. Keep an eye on new developments in AI and creative technology, testing tools and figuring out what’s actually useful. Help us evaluate and choose the platforms worth investing in. Make sure everything we put out holds up, both brand-wise and legally. Share what you learn and help the rest of the creative team get comfortable working with new technology. A year from now, we hope we have a way of working with new technology and design that you’ve helped shape, and that the whole department keeps up thanks to you. What will it look like exactly? We don’t know yet. That’s kind of the point. Our Creative Team Our creative team is small and senior, made up of copywriters and art directors, with strategy and design expertise a call away across the business. We shape brands across our portfolio, from building By Lyko from the ground up to evolving Make Up Store and Estelle & Thild, and work with strong partners across eight markets. You’ll also work closely with our content and performance teams and external partners, creating for our markets in Sweden, Norway and Finland. Around our core team, we have a trusted freelance network for production, so we can scale fast without losing creative control. The ideas, the direction and the craft stay close to home. Who are you? At heart, you’re a designer. You have a strong eye for typography, colour, composition and form, and you can explain why an image works for our brand, not just that it looks nice. That’s what sets you apart from everyone who can prompt their way to pretty pictures. You also understand that creative work needs to work in the real world. An image might end up as an ad, a product page or a print original, and you know how to take it all the way from idea to finished material. You have a solid design foundation, whether that comes from formal education, hands-on experience or both. What matters most is your ability to create great design and understand why it works. But what really makes you right for this role is how you approach the unknown. You’re probably someone who: Likes to test and try out new tools to help you in your job. Would rather be bad at a new tool for a week than great at an old one forever. Thinks in systems, not magic prompts, and sees the first output as where the work starts, not where it ends. Shares what you figure out, generously and often, because you’ll be the one making the rest of us better at this. Since the role is brand new, there’s no manual. You’ll set a lot of your own priorities, and you know when to ask and when to just try. If that sounds more exciting than scary, we should talk. Extra good if you have: Have used generative tools in real projects, not just for fun, e.g. Midjourney, Firefly, Runway, ComfyUI or …

Du bestämmer hur din dag ser ut Jobba hemifrån, på café eller från stugan. Börja tidigt, ta passen på eftermiddagen eller lägg dina timmar på några dagar i veckan. Du väljer också själv hur du tar kontakten och lägger upp ditt säljarbete, så att det passar just dig. Gör det på heltid eller vid sidan av något annat. Du säljer, vi levererar Du tar kontakten och gör affären. När kunden har sagt ja tar vi över, bygger, levererar och sköter supporten. Du behöver inte kunna koda, och all din tid kan gå till nästa affär. Ett tryggt erbjudande för kunden Kunden får ett fast pris efter en kostnadsfri offert, och slutfakturan kommer först när resultatet är godkänt. items.desc: You dream of a new challenge, of being able to make a company scale and feel that you have a real impact. If you dream of a life that is more like an adventure than a stable life, then becoming the AI-native right hand of our CEO is for you. This isn’t another chief of staff or right hand job. Most companies call themselves AI-first because they gave everyone a ChatGPT licence. We think that’s level 2, and there are 10. At Paradox our ambition is $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents. Here, AI doesn’t assist the work. It runs the loops, in every department. Your job is to make that true for the whole company, side by side with the CEO. But wait a minute. Deep inside you are looking for a new adventure with… Freedom: working remotely or hybrid, and being trusted to deliver Ambition: building one of the first truly AI-native companies, with teammates who push AI to its limits every week Impact: changing the trajectory of a whole company, not one line of a roadmap, with a product that transforms people’s lives at scale Then, you have found the next adventure that will fulfill you. WHAT AI-NATIVE MEANS AT PARADOX In a company of fewer than 10 people, the right hand used to be the person who absorbed everything the CEO couldn’t do. Here, the right hand builds the machine that does it. Our company has to be able to: Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, offers, decisions, procedures, member stories and past experiments, in one shared company brain that every person and every agent reads before acting. Turn every decision into execution. A meeting, a voice note or a call with the CEO becomes briefs, tickets, follow-ups and deadlines, without anyone retyping it. Act across every tool. Not a chatbot in a tab: agents read and write in our whole stack, from code to CRM, billing, analytics, ads, email, calendar and documents. Ship. Produce the analysis, the contract draft, the page, the offer or the process, and put it live. Measure with real KPIs. Revenue, cash, margin, retention and the transformation of our members, not activity. Learn and loop on its own. Keep what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting. People set the ambition, the taste and the standards. The machine runs the loop, and gets better every week. This is already real. Our company brain holds our decisions and procedures. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment with its result. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars and audit our tracking after every live. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day, by text and by voice. But maybe YOU WONDER WHAT’S OUR STORY? We believe self-help is broken. Most people use learning platforms the same way: generic theory, a quick high, no real change. They deserve more than content and more than motivation. They deserve a system that knows them , one that adapts, challenges and grows with them. That’s why we merge: Human Intelligence (coaches, peers and mentors) Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals) Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys) into one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS, the Operating System for Human Greatness, augmented with AI. Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world, and for something that will outlive any individual, its founder included. Here’s the bet: A small team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size. And that’s where you come in. YOUR MISSION Reporting directly to the founder and CEO, you will help him run and grow the company. Your scope is as wide as a CEO/COO’s: strategy, operations, finance, legal, people, product marketing and launches. The difference is how you do it. In a classic company, the right hand coordinates people and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls. With fewer than 10 people, there is no department to hand things to. You build it. YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS 1 - Be the CEO’s operating system The old way: a chief of staff takes notes in meetings, chases people by email and builds the weekly report by hand. At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every CEO decision into execution. Meetings, voice notes and calls become briefs, tickets and follow-ups. Every Monday, the CEO gets one brief: what moved, what’s stuck, and what needs his call. You decide what the CEO must see and what he never needs to see again. His time goes to vision, product and members, not to coordination. 2 - Run strategic projects as a Pirate Squad of one, plus agents Depending on your zone of genius, these are examples of strategic …

Vi betalar ut cirka 260 miljarder kronor varje år. Det är allas skattepengar vi har hand om. Det är ett stort ansvar. Därför tänker vi nytt och använder den senaste tekniken för att förenkla och förbättra, utveckla och leverera it-tjänsterna för den svenska socialförsäkringen. Välkommen till en av Sveriges största IT-avdelningar. Vi är tre team inom produktområde Utveckling som gör Försäkringskassans cirka 100 systemutvecklar-team produktivare. De kan fokusera på verksamhetslogik samtidigt som de efterlever och följer krav. Vi tillhandahåller allt från inköpta till egenutvecklade produkter. Gemensamt är att vi gör utveckling, produktion och support på alla våra produkter. Nu söker vi två systemutvecklare till två olika AI-native plattformar. Digital transformation av systemutveckling Du kommer integrera AI i vår mjukvaruutvecklingsprocess från verksamhetsarkitektur till produktion och support. Du driver den digitala transformationen av systemutvecklingen till AI-native och agentbaserad systemutveckling, där människor och AI-agenter samverkar för att planera, genomföra och verifiera utvecklingsuppgifter. Vi har ambitionen att alla utvecklingsteam arbetar AI-native, där AI-agenter är en integrerad del av det dagliga arbetet och självständigt kan genomföra och verifiera utvecklingsuppgifter inom definierade ramar. Ditt arbete omfattar utveckling, driftsättning, förvaltning och vidareutveckling av AI-agenter och deras förmågor, där du har nära kontakt med våra kunder, Försäkringskassans systemutvecklare. Vi arbetar med Windows (klient, server), Linux samt OpenShift. Du kommer att delta i satsningen att utveckla Försäkringskassans målplattform där våra produkter accelererar systemutvecklarnas arbete. I rollen som systemutvecklare mot AI-native DevEx-plattformen bidrar du till att utveckla en plattform där AI-agenter kan planera och genomföra utvecklingsuppgifter. Ditt arbete kombinerar utveckling, produktionssättning och support av AI-agenter och de förmågor som möjliggör agentbaserad systemutveckling. I rollen som systemutvecklare mot AI-native Kvalitet-och verifieringsplattformen bidrar du till att utveckla en plattform där AI-agenter kan testa, granska, verifiera och stödja säker och spårbar verifiering av programvara. Ditt arbete kombinerar utveckling, produktionssättning och support av AI-agenter och de förmågor som möjliggör automatiserad kvalitetssäkring och verifiering. items.desc: The Slash team and its mission 📬 Slash connects with Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 to protect employees against phishing attacks. When an email looks malicious, Slash warns the employee inside the email, before they click. When the threat is confirmed, Slash removes it from every mailbox in the company. When someone seems to impersonate a colleague, Slash checks with that colleague directly in Slack, Teams or Google Chat. To catch them, Slash combines technical signals with an analysis of each email by LLMs, and learns from every attack our customers confirm. The hard part is precision. A security alert on a legitimate email costs the customer's trust, and an attack we miss can cost them money. Slash is built by a small team that also builds Inbox and Ask Albert. We are hiring an ML engineer to grow the detection work. Requirements What you will do 🤝 Make the verdicts right. Improve the models that decide when Slash blocks, warns or stays silent: learned scores fitted on admin verdicts, the signals they read, and the prompts of each attack classifier. Every change is measured before it ships. Own the evaluation. We evaluate on labelled datasets and compare two runs verdict by verdict (what flipped to correct, what regressed). You will grow the labelled corpus, keep the benchmarks honest, and tell real gains apart from model noise. Choose models and providers on evidence. Our classifiers run on LLMs served through AWS Bedrock and Azure OpenAI. You will benchmark new models, structured outputs and prompt optimization methods, and own the migrations. Extend the memory of known attacks. Improve how confirmed attacks are embedded, retrieved and used as precedents, so Slash catches the next email of a campaign it has already seen. Bring new signals to the classifiers. Text extracted from attachments, pages behind links and QR codes, calendar invitations, sharing platforms: help decide what the models read and how. Detect compromised accounts. Contribute to the account takeover detection we are building: learn each employee's normal sending behaviour, combine it with Google and Microsoft security signals, and decide when an account looks compromised. Ship to production. You write the code that runs on live email traffic, and you follow it after release. Our codebase is in Elixir: no prior experience is needed, you will pick it up with the team. Our technical stack Detection and ML: LLMs on AWS Bedrock and Azure OpenAI, embeddings with pgvector, versioned datasets and benchmark runs in PostgreSQL, OCR for attachments. Backend: Elixir, Phoenix, PostgreSQL, Oban, LiveView. Ops: AWS, Terraform, Datadog, Sentry. AI tooling: Claude Code, Codex, Cubic. Who You Are 🪪 Level : 3 years of experience or more. Must-have You know classical ML: you build an evaluation set, pick the metric that matches what each error costs the product (precision, recall, false positive rate), then build features, fit a model and set its threshold. You have shipped LLM-based features with clean, tested code and structured outputs, and you followed them once live. You are at ease with exploratory work: you take an open question, prototype it quickly, and can tell a real gain from noise before anything ships. You have experience as a software engineer in at least one language such as Python, Rust or Go: clean, tested, reviewable code, and SQL. You use AI coding tools every day. You are a doer: you take a vague problem, scope it, and get it to production. You can explain a result in a few sentences, to an engineer as well as to a PM. You are fluent in French and English. You live in Paris or are ready to relocate. Nice-to-have Experience with classification on text or email data, fraud and anomaly detection, or security. Embeddings and retrieval (vector search, pgvector). Fine-tuning or evaluating open-weight models. LLM model comparison, cost and latency trade-offs, prompt optimization methods (DSPy, GEPA or similar). Reading and applying research papers. items.desc: About Us We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity. Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next. The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve. Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost. Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor. In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence. We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you. About The Role Applied AI Research at Callosum discovers the methods that make real AI workloads faster, cheaper and better, and turns them into systems that run in production. You will study how agentic workflows, retrieval pipelines and code intelligence stacks actually behave, then invent ways to optimise them at a systems level. A single optimisation can touch agent and workflow design, context and prompting, model choice, the serving stack and the silicon underneath. So we don't hire specialists in one layer. We hire researchers who can reason across the whole system, from agentic design down to the specifics of the model, and who have a feel for how inference and hardware shape what is possible. The role is research-led and engineering-heavy. You will need first-principles judgment to see what kind of system a problem needs, the rigour to prove that it works, and the engineering skill to build it yourself. You will sit across our research and platform functions. What you discover becomes product capability, and what you see in real workloads sets the research agenda. We run a flat Member of Technical Staff structure. Responsibility and scope grow with what you demonstrate, including leadership of the Applied AI Research function as the team scales. What You'll Work On Our research tries to construct optimal inference systems from the silicon layer all the way up to the harness: the system will learn from the actual deployment profile and tasks it is used on and optimise itself. Open problems you will own include: ⁠ ⁠Reverse-engineering agentic systems. Infer the structure of agentic systems from minimal data, and find where it spends compute it doesn't need to. ⁠ ⁠Routing. Build robust routers that send each request to the cheapest or fastest path that strictly matches or beats the incumbent model on quality. ⁠ ⁠Proving there is no regression. Design layered proxy evaluations, that bound quality ever more tightly, from coarse checks down to a granular understanding of the system. ⁠ ⁠New optimisation surface area. Extend the same automatic, detection to new optimisation techniques, and help decide which ones we pursue next. ⁠ ⁠Research that ships. Run rigorous experiments, write up what you learn, and work with our platform team to turn what works into general product capability. ⁠ ⁠Shared research infrastructure. Build the evaluation harnesses, benchmarks and experiment tooling the team runs on. How We Work ⁠ ⁠Generalists by design. Our cadence is fast and our priorities move as we learn. You will move between projects as the problem demands, so breadth and the speed at which you learn matter more than depth in one …

items.desc: Your mission is to develop intelligent optimization and decision-support solutions for semiconductor R&D and advanced manufacturing. You combine applied mathematics, simulation, optimization, machine learning and domain expertise to solve complex operational and engineering challenges. What you will do Working with academic and industrial partners, you help build imec’s next-generation Fab Digital Twin. This initiative combines operational data, discrete-event simulation, predictive models, and optimization engines to support what-if analysis and operational decision-making. Your initial focus is the optimization of fab operations, including planning, scheduling, dispatching, and simulation. Over time, the role can expand toward Scientific AI methods for semiconductor process modelling and optimization. Your main responsibilities are to: Build and validate digital twin capabilities and scalable optimization software, translating real-world operational problems into mathematical formulations, decision policies and optimization engines. Develop novel hybrid AI solutions that combine mathematical optimization, machine learning, simulation and expert knowledge to improve planning, scheduling, dispatching and operational decision-making for imec’s core R&D. Contribute to data-efficient and hybrid physics-data methods for predicting and optimizing semiconductor processes and operations as the role evolves. Collaborate with process engineers, operations experts, data scientists, and software developers to transform research innovations into deployable solutions that improve operational decision-making and engineering outcomes. What we do for you We offer you the opportunity to join one of the world’s premier research centers in nanotechnology at its headquarters in Leuven, Belgium. With your talent, passion and expertise, you’ll become part of a team that makes the impossible possible. Together, we shape the technology that will determine the society of tomorrow. We are committed to being an inclusive employer and proud of our open, multicultural, and informal working environment with ample possibilities to take initiative and show responsibility. We commit to supporting and guiding you in this process; not only with words but also with tangible actions. Through imec.academy, 'our corporate university', we actively invest in your development to further your technical and personal growth. We are aware that your valuable contribution makes imec a top player in its field. Your energy and commitment are therefore appreciated by means of a market appropriate salary with many fringe benefits. Who you are You enjoy solving complex decision-making and optimization problems. You are curious, analytical, creative and mathematically minded, and enjoy bridging theory and practice to create impactful solutions. You thrive in multidisciplinary environments where engineering, mathematics, simulation and AI come together. Minimum qualifications: A master’s degree or PhD in Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Scientific Computing, Computational Engineering, Physics, Artificial Intelligence or a related quantitative discipline. Strong foundations in optimization and simulation, complemented by knowledge of probability and statistics and proven usage of machine learning. Strong programming skills (e.g. Python) and experience with scientific computing, optimization or simulation frameworks. Ability to independently drive technical work from problem definition through modelling, implementation, validation and communication of results. You have demonstrated experience applying optimization, simulation or Scientific ML to real engineering or operational problems, obtained through industrial work, doctoral research or substantial applied projects. Desired qualifications: Experience in several of the following areas is an advantage: Formulating and solving linear, nonlinear, deterministic, stochastic, single-objective or multi-objective optimization problems using exact, heuristic or metaheuristic methods. Planning, scheduling, dispatching or simulation-based optimization in complex manufacturing or production environments. Uncertainty quantification, including propagating and calibrating uncertainty to support robust, risk-aware decisions. Physics-informed or hybrid physics-data modelling, Bayesian modelling and calibration, surrogate modelling or data-efficient machine learning. Development of AI-based decision-support systems, optimization services or digital twin capabilities within complex engineering and/or production environments. Collaboration across semiconductor, operations, software and AI teams in complex research and/or engineering environments.

items.desc: Description Role: Research Associate in Mathematical and Computational Foundations of Reservoir Computing Grade and Salary: Grade 7 - £38,448 to £46,970 per annum FTE and working pattern: 1 FTE (full-time – 35 hours per week) fixed term for 24 months Holiday Entitlement: 33 days annual leave plus 9 buildings-closed days (and Christmas Eve when it falls on a weekday). Use our total rewards calculator: https://www.hw.ac.uk/about/work/total-rewards-calculator.htm to see the value of benefits provided by Heriot-Watt University Purpose of Role We are recruiting a 24-month, full-time research associate to contribute to the UKRI-funded project “Taking Material Reservoir Computers FARR: Foundations for Adaptation, Resilience and Recovery.” Our vision is to develop theoretical and computational foundations for a new generation of adaptable, resilient, and recoverable computing systems. The project brings together researchers from Heriot-Watt, Oxford, Liverpool, Sussex, and Ulster universities to investigate reservoir computing, with a particular focus on its potential for low-power, real-time decision making in challenging environments. You will undertake original research at the intersection of applied mathematics, statistics, and optimisation to better understand how reservoir computers process and retain information. Your research will focus on characterising the behaviour of reservoir computers, investigating the role of memory in decision-making, and developing methods to quantify uncertainty. You will also develop and evaluate computational approaches that enable reservoir computers to adapt to changing conditions and recover from disruption. The successful candidate will be based in the School of Mathematical and Computer Sciences at Heriot-Watt University. You will work closely with an interdisciplinary team of researchers across the five partner institutions. This work is being undertaken in cooperation with UK Government stakeholders. The successful candidate will be required to obtain security clearance before taking up the post, and must be eligible for UK security clearance in principle, e.g., by nationality (British Citizen) or 5+ years UK residency etc. Eligibility criteria and further information on the process can be found on the UK Government security vetting website, see https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels. Key Duties & Responsibilities Conduct and disseminate original research aligned with the project, in collaboration with the wider team. Develop mathematical and statistical methods to characterise reservoir computing systems, with a particular focus on memory, decision-making, and uncertainty quantification. Develop, implement, and evaluate computational methods to investigate the adaptation, resilience, and recovery of reservoir computing systems. Work closely with the supervisory team to develop and plan research objectives. Prepare research reports and contribute to publications in peer-reviewed journals and conference proceedings. Present research findings and contribute to technical workshops, seminars, and conferences, as appropriate. Excellent time management and organisational skills, including the ability to prioritise workload. Desirable Experience in stochastic processes, dynamical systems, or time-series analysis. Experience or knowledge of reservoir computing, recurrent neural networks, or nature-inspired computing approaches. items.desc: About The Role We are seeking an exceptional graduate to join Stalis as a generalist across our technical and operational functions. You will work closely with teams across the business, developing a deep understanding of how healthcare data moves through our systems and identifying opportunities to apply programming, modern tooling, and AI to improve how we work. Over time, as Stalis's data intelligence capability matures, you will have the opportunity to contribute directly to machine learning and analytics work that shapes our next generation of products. The Reality of the Work This is a broad role, and not every task will be glamorous. Much of the early value comes from genuinely understanding how work is done at Stalis today - which means doing the work, not just observing it. Some of your time will be spent on detailed, careful data tasks that are essential to our clients. The opportunity is to use that understanding as the foundation for automation, improvement, and new capability. The best ideas will come from the ground up, and we expect you to find them. What You'll Actually Do Work alongside our data migration and engineering teams on live client projects, contributing to the day-to-day delivery of healthcare data work Identify inefficiencies, repetitive tasks, and fragile processes - and build the scripts, tools, and small systems that fix them Write and maintain code, primarily in Python & SQL, to automate workflows, process data, and support internal operations Apply and experiment with AI tooling - LLMs, embeddings, classifiers - to problems across the business where they add real value, and be honest about where they don't Communicate your work clearly, in writing and in person, to colleagues who are not data scientists - so that your improvements get adopted rather than sidelined Over time, contribute to Stalis's emerging data science and machine learning capability, including schema mapping, clinical data analytics, and data products Requirements Who we're looking for You will need most, if not all, of the following: Academic background. A strong degree from a top university in a quantitative or technical discipline - physics, engineering, computer science, mathematics, or similar Genuine technical aptitude. Comfortable writing code, and keen to write more of it. We are not looking for a particular stack or prior industry experience, but you should already be writing code for fun, coursework, or projects, and be able to pick up new tools quickly AI-savvy. Fluent with modern AI tools as a day-to-day part of how you work and think. You know what LLMs are good at, what they're bad at, and how to use them without being credulous about their output Self-directed. You find problems, scope them yourself, and take them to a useful end state without being spoon-fed tasks. You are comfortable operating under ambiguity and choosing what to work on when it isn't obvious Discerning and pragmatic. You can tell the difference between a problem worth solving properly and one worth a fifty-line script today. You don't gold-plate Strong communicator, in writing especially. You can write a short memo or a handover document that brings people along. In a small, distributed business, this matters more than people think Emotionally intelligent. Improvements to how people work can feel like criticism, even when they aren't. You can read a room, win people over, and work collaboratively with colleagues who know things you don't Domain-humble. You are curious about how Stalis works today before you try to change it. You understand that experienced colleagues know things that aren't written down, and you treat that knowledge as an asset Benefits What you'll get from us Unusual breadth of exposure for a graduate role - you will see how a specialist healthcare data company actually runs, from the data up A path into machine learning and data science work as Stalis's data intelligence capability develops, with real problems and real data to work on Direct access to senior colleagues, reporting to the Head of Data Science, and genuine influence over how the company evolves A role that will grow as quickly as you do

items.desc: Finansforbundet har pt. over 65.000 medlemmer i den finansielle sektor, og vi vokser fortsat. Data hjælper os konstant med at forstå medlemmernes ønsker, forbedre vores tilbud (f.eks. kurser, rådgivning, osv.) og udvikle organisationen. I dag bruger kolleger på tværs af huset data i deres daglige arbejde. Derfor arbejder vi ikke længere kun med at skaffe data og få teknikken på plads, men med at besvare mere interessante spørgsmål som f.eks. ”Hvorfor melder medlemmer sig ud?” og ”hvad driver deres loyalitet?” Vi søger en kollega, der vil tale med kollegerne for at forstå deres ønsker, hjælpe med at stille de rigtige spørgsmål og omsætte svarene til konkrete løsninger blandt andet i Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, SQL eller Python. Det kan være en rapport, en model, der peger på, hvad der påvirker medlemmernes loyalitet, eller en AI-agent, der gør en arbejdsgang enklere. Om teamet Vi er en teamleder, tre konsulenter og én studentermedhjælper med ansvar for business intelligence, data engineering, AI og analyser i Finansforbundet. De seneste år har vi moderniseret vores tech stack med løsninger i Microsoft Fabric og Power BI, som bruges på tværs af organisationen. Vores data engineer har ansvar for platformen og vores pipelines og udvikler også interne AI-agenter. Du får en rolle tæt på forretningen, hvor du både afdækker behov og selv er med til at bygge løsningerne. Nye ønsker til rapporter og dataløsninger bliver samlet og prioriteret i vores datadriftsgruppe, som ledes af teamets product owner. Teamet har også ansvar for at hjælpe Finansforbundet med at bruge AI på en ansvarlig og værdiskabende måde. Vi vurderer idéer, rådgiver kolleger, hjælper dem enten med at udvikle AI-agenter eller bygger selv løsninger, når det giver mening. Samtidig sørger vi for, at data og regler er på plads. Dine opgaver Du arbejder tæt sammen med kolleger og følger opgaverne fra den første samtale til en løsning, der er sat i drift. Du kommer blandt andet til at: Tale med kolleger og ledere om deres behov og omsætte dem til konkrete krav. Kortlægge processer og datakilder, så det er tydeligt, hvor tallene kommer fra, og hvordan de skal bruges. Udvikle rapporter, dashboards og apps i Power BI og Microsoft Fabric, herunder semantiske modeller og DAX. Bruge SQL og Python til analyser, databehandling og automatisering. Udarbejde statistiske analyser og modeller, for eksempel prognoser, medlemssegmentering og analyser af løn og arbejdsmarked. Analysere medlemsværdi, herunder customer lifetime value. Sætte machine learning modeller i drift og overvåge dem. Afklare behov, afprøve idéer og udvikle prototyper med AI. Udarbejde cost-benefit-analyser af nye tiltag, for eksempel kampagner. Dokumentere løsningerne og sætte dem i drift sammen med vores data engineer. Om dig Du behøver ikke at kunne det hele fra første dag. Vi forestiller os, at du: Har nogle års erfaring med analyse, BI eller data science. Stiller gode spørgsmål, lytter og kan forklare analyser til kolleger uden teknisk baggrund. Har erfaring fra en medlemsorganisation eller en anden organisation med mange forskellige behov. Har erfaring med Power BI, herunder datamodellering og DAX. Kan skrive SQL og Python. Har brugt Python til analyse, for eksempel pandas og scikit-learn. Har et godt greb om statistik og kan vurdere både mulighederne og begrænsningerne i en model. Er interesseret i at sætte machine learning modeller i drift og har måske allerede prøvet det. Er interesseret i AI og måske allerede har arbejdet med sprogmodeller. Er interesseret i operationsanalyse, for eksempel optimering og simulering. Erfaring med Microsoft Fabric er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Din uddannelse kan være inden for økonomi, statistik, datalogi, ingeniørfag eller et andet relevant område. Det vigtigste er din erfaring, din faglighed og din lyst til at løse konkrete behov med data. Det tilbyder vi Frihed til at tilrettelægge dit arbejde og ansvar for dine egne opgaver. Kort vej fra idé til løsning og mulighed for at præge, hvordan vi bruger data og AI. Microsoft Fabric, Power BI og tid til at lære nyt. Kolleger, der giver ærlig feedback og hjælper hinanden. Gode løn- og ansættelsesvilkår samt mulighed for hjemmearbejde. Finansforbundet arbejder for, at medlemmerne i den finansielle sektor trives og står stærkt i deres arbejdsliv. Det gør vi gennem forhandling, rådgivning og medlemsfordele. Vi holder til i København. Vil du være med? Send din ansøgning og dit CV senest onsdag d. 9. december. Vi holder første samtale 14. december og anden samtale d. 17. december. Forventet tiltrædelse er snarest muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at ringe eller skrive til teamleder Andreas Steinberg på 50 69 24 87 eller abs@finansforbundet.dk.

items.desc: LET’S CUT STRAIGHT TO IT At Severn Trent, we believe everyone deserves more. More care for the environment, more sustainable initiatives, and more support for the communities we serve. That's why we're on a mission to deliver bigger and better things, and we need passionate graduates like you to help us achieve our goals. Our people and culture are the heart of our success. We're proud to be in the top 5% of utility companies worldwide for employee engagement, and we’re equally proud of our strong Glassdoor score - reflecting how much our people love working here. With over 10,000 dedicated colleagues, we're looking for more brilliant people who are eager to turn challenges into opportunities for a better future. If you're excited to learn, and ready to make a real impact, we want you on our team. LET’S TELL YOU MORE Our Digital and Data Graduate Programme within Data Science & Analytics offers the perfect blend of personal and professional development. Within this programme you will have structured rotations through different technical disciplines such as Data Analytics, Data Engineering and Data Science whilst delivering tangible insights for some of the business’ most important data challenges. In a typical day you could be developing complex predictive machine learning models, presenting business critical analytics to leadership through data visualisations or even harnessing powerful AI tools to innovate our business processes. Working alongside our Innovation colleagues, you will be working on high impact analytics projects using real-world data from our operational technologies. A critical and curious mindset, along with analytical and numerical skills are key for this role. You'll need to be an excellent communicator to be able to translate complex and technical data into meaningful insights for important decision making. You will be communicating with stakeholders on multiple levels, and assessing and prioritising work based upon business value. Furthermore, you will form close relationships with the wider Asset Intelligence Teams to improve our data strategy to enhance the availability, quality, and usability of our data. We welcome all graduates from diverse backgrounds, as we know diverse minds bring new ideas and a different way of thinking. We are looking for someone who wants to build their career with us and grasp new opportunities, and in return we will support you with varied experiences, training and development to provide a grounding for your future career. HOW WILL THE PROGRAMME WORK? You will be based at Severn Trent Headquarters in Coventry, the heart of our patch. The programme requires you to complete 3 placements throughout your time in the role, gaining exposure in different areas of the department so that you are equipped with the right skills to build your career here at Severn Trent. Placement 1 – Working as a Data Engineer you will be working to transform prototype solutions built by the data scientists into robust ML pipelines that serve a production environment. You will learn about the myriad of data sources available to the Data Science team, ingesting, transforming and testing the data to enable the delivery of key, innovative data science initiatives. As part of the role, you will deploy MLOps best practices, including the monitoring of model performance over time. Placement 2 – As a Data Analyst, your strong scientific and analytical background will be put to good use working on fresh water and wastewater projects. You will build on the knowledge gained from the first placement, in databases and sources available to perform analysis of the data generating valuable business insights. You will develop analytics solutions to some of the most critical and exciting areas facing Severn Trent today. Placement 3 – As a Data Scientist, you will apply advanced algorithms and machine learning techniques to solve the business’ most challenging issues, extracting actionable insights that will make a real difference to the operations of Severn Trent. Building on prior experience in Data Engineering and Data Analysis, this placement will involve developing predictive models and supporting innovation that drives operational efficiency and resilience. In this exciting programme, you will have the chance to discuss your development and career ambitions in your 1-1 meetings with business leads, mentors, a study buddy, the cohort leader, and the New Talent Team. You'll join a caring culture that collaborates to achieve, grow, and develop. Our employee engagement scores are among the highest globally in energy and utilities. That’s why, we value in-person moments to keep our culture alive and why for this role you’ll usually find us in the office during our working hours. What You Will Learn You will expand your knowledge of; Water Treatment and Distribution Wastewater Treatment and Networks Data Engineering Data Science & Machine Learning Data Visualisation and Storytelling DevOps & MLOps …

items.desc: Job Description Grade UE06: £35,302 - £40,704 per annum College of Science & Engineering / School of Geosciences Full-time: 35 hours per week Fixed-term contract: 18 months The Opportunity SEOSAW (A Socio-Ecological Observatory for Studying African Woodlands) is an open network of researchers and long-term vegetation plots working to understand how the woodlands, savannas, and dry forests of southern and eastern Africa are changing in response to global and local pressures. Spanning 12 countries, the network maintains over 400 permanent sample plots and almost 10,000 one-off plots, and has compiled more than 315,000 tree measurements to date. Hosted by the University of Edinburgh, the University of the Witwatersrand, and the Namibia University of Science and Technology, SEOSAW brings together more than 100 researchers to generate shared data resources for conservation, climate, and land-use research across one of the world's largest savanna systems. SEOSAW is looking for a data scientist to oversee the network's growing database of vegetation, soil and disturbance data from the plots in our network. Working closely with the SEOSAW project office team and the SEOSAW members collecting data across the region, the data scientist will be the central point of contact for data flowing into the network. The role is critical in ensuring the data is collected consistently, cleaned thoroughly, entered accurately, and held ready for analysis. The position would be well suited to someone who enjoys working across fieldwork, data management, and international collaboration. This post is full-time; however, we are open to considering other working patterns. We are also open to considering requests for hybrid working (on a non-contractual basis) that combines a mix of remote and regular on-campus working. An exciting, positive, creative, challenging and rewarding place to work. To be part of a diverse and vibrant international community. Comprehensive Staff Benefits, including generous annual leave entitlement, a defined benefits pension scheme, a wide range of staff discounts, family-friendly initiatives, and flexible work options. Check out the full list on our staff benefits page (opens in a new tab)and use our reward calculator to discover the value of your pay and benefits. Championing equality, diversity, and inclusion The University of Edinburgh holds a Silver Athena SWAN award in recognition of our commitment to advance gender equality in higher education. We are members of the Race Equality Charter, and we are also Stonewall Scotland Diversity Champions, actively promoting LGBT equality. Prior to any employment commencing with the University, you will be required to evidence your right to work in the UK. If you are applying from outside the UK, the closing time shown on our adverts will automatically adjust to your browser’s local time zone. Interviews will be held TBC. About Us As a world-leading research-intensive University, we are here to address tomorrow’s greatest challenges. Between now and 2030 we will do that with a values-led approach to teaching, research and innovation, and through the strength of our relationships, both locally and globally. About The Team The School of GeoSciences explores the factors and forces that shape our world. The School aims to understand the world through fundamental curiosity-driven research and to support prescient decision-making at individual to global scales. We undertake world-leading research; offer new ways of understanding natural and social drivers of change; provide inter-and trans-disciplinary solutions; and work in partnership to improve livelihoods and explore ways to manage the environment that are both sustainable and socially equitable. With over 500 academics, researchers and research students, we are the largest and most successful interdisciplinary grouping of geoscientists and geographers in the UK. items.desc: About The Role We are seeking an exceptional graduate to join Stalis as a generalist across our technical and operational functions. You will work closely with teams across the business, developing a deep understanding of how healthcare data moves through our systems and identifying opportunities to apply programming, modern tooling, and AI to improve how we work. Over time, as Stalis's data intelligence capability matures, you will have the opportunity to contribute directly to machine learning and analytics work that shapes our next generation of products. The Reality of the Work This is a broad role, and not every task will be glamorous. Much of the early value comes from genuinely understanding how work is done at Stalis today - which means doing the work, not just observing it. Some of your time will be spent on detailed, careful data tasks that are essential to our clients. The opportunity is to use that understanding as the foundation for automation, improvement, and new capability. The best ideas will come from the ground up, and we expect you to find them. What You'll Actually Do Work alongside our data migration and engineering teams on live client projects, contributing to the day-to-day delivery of healthcare data work Identify inefficiencies, repetitive tasks, and fragile processes - and build the scripts, tools, and small systems that fix them Write and maintain code, primarily in Python & SQL, to automate workflows, process data, and support internal operations Apply and experiment with AI tooling - LLMs, embeddings, classifiers - to problems across the business where they add real value, and be honest about where they don't Communicate your work clearly, in writing and in person, to colleagues who are not data scientists - so that your improvements get adopted rather than sidelined Over time, contribute to Stalis's emerging data science and machine learning capability, including schema mapping, clinical data analytics, and data products Requirements Who we're looking for You will need most, if not all, of the following: Academic background. A strong degree from a top university in a quantitative or technical discipline - physics, engineering, computer science, mathematics, or similar Genuine technical aptitude. Comfortable writing code, and keen to write more of it. We are not looking for a particular stack or prior industry experience, but you should already be writing code for fun, coursework, or projects, and be able to pick up new tools quickly AI-savvy. Fluent with modern AI tools as a day-to-day part of how you work and think. You know what LLMs are good at, what they're bad at, and how to use them without being credulous about their output Self-directed. You find problems, scope them yourself, and take them to a useful end state without being spoon-fed tasks. You are comfortable operating under ambiguity and choosing what to work on when it isn't obvious Discerning and pragmatic. You can tell the difference between a problem worth solving properly and one worth a fifty-line script today. You don't gold-plate Strong communicator, in writing especially. You can write a short memo or a handover document that brings people along. In a small, distributed business, this matters more than people think Emotionally intelligent. Improvements to how people work can feel like criticism, even when they aren't. You can read a room, win people over, and work collaboratively with colleagues who know things you don't Domain-humble. You are curious about how Stalis works today before you try to change it. You understand that experienced colleagues know things that aren't written down, and you treat that knowledge as an asset Benefits What you'll get from us Unusual breadth of exposure for a graduate role - you will see how a specialist healthcare data company actually runs, from the data up A path into machine learning and data science work as Stalis's data intelligence capability develops, with real problems and real data to work on Direct access to senior colleagues, reporting to the Head of Data Science, and genuine influence over how the company evolves A role that will grow as quickly as you do

items.desc: Role Overview We are looking for an AI & Automation Solutions Specialist to develop practical solutions for its Supply Management and Business Intelligence functions. In this role, you will turn operational challenges into working AI and automation tools across data processes, user-facing products and administrative activities. You will rapidly prototype ideas, test their value with users and recommend whether they should be scaled, reused or discontinued. Key Responsibilities You will work with global and regional teams to identify high-value AI and automation opportunities, translating loosely defined needs into clear, testable use cases. You will independently build prototypes using generative AI, data, APIs, Python, SQL and low-code or no-code technologies. You will test solutions with users, improve them based on feedback and measure their impact through outcomes such as time savings, quality and adoption. Successful concepts will be prepared for wider implementation in partnership with technology and AI teams, with appropriate documentation, security and governance. You will also share reusable tools, practical learning and best practices across the organisation. Requirements You will have three to five years of relevant experience in applied AI, analytics, data, automation or digital products, with a proven ability to turn business problems into practical solutions. You will have hands-on experience with generative AI and large language models, strong data foundations and working proficiency in Python and SQL or equivalent technologies. You will combine analytical thinking with commercial judgement, user focus and a sound understanding of data security, governance and responsible AI. You will be comfortable working autonomously in an exploratory environment and communicating technical concepts in clear business language. Fluency in English is required. Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Azure or similar platforms will be advantageous. Exposure to procurement, supply management, global organisations or the transition of prototypes into production will also be valued.

As part of this journey, you’ll join one of our specialist tracks aligned to your interests: Data Engineer: turn data into powerful insights, working with modern analytics tools and cloud platforms to drive smarter, data-led decisions. Software Engineer: bring ideas to life by building scalable, user-focused applications using modern frameworks and full-stack technologies. This is more than just your first job - it’s a chance to grow, innovate, and shape the future of digital solutions, all while accelerating your career in a supportive and dynamic environment. At Capgemini, we are helping shape a new age of intelligence, partnering with clients across industries to harness AI, technology, and human potential to drive meaningful change. If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including: Identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service). This role is based in either Telford or Hove, and you’ll typically be in the office up to 3 days a week, so you’ll need to be within commuting distance of your chosen location. The nature of this role requires you to work on a secure site, if this isn't a suitable location for you, we encourage you to explore our other graduate opportunities with Capgemini, which are available at various locations across the UK. What you will bring To be eligible for this programme, you must have obtained, or be studying towards, a minimum 2:2 degree. If you are currently studying, you must have completed your degree prior to proposed start date. We recognise that mitigating circumstances can have an impact on academic performance. If you have experienced any circumstances that you would like us to take into consideration, please provide details in your application. Additional criteria for each track can be found below.
