​
 This is a fixed-term appointment with an initial duration of 4 years. Depending upon performance and organisational needs, the appointment may be extended up to a possible maximum duration of 8 years. 
 Location 
ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands 
 Description 
 Antenna Engineer, Antennas and Sub-millimetre Waves Section, Radio Frequency Payloads and Technology Division, Electrical Department, Directorate of Technology, Engineering and Quality.
 The Antennas and Sub-millimetre Waves Section provides functional support to ESA projects across all the various domains - navigation, Earth observation, telecommunications and secure connectivity, human and robotic exploration, and launchers - and conducts R&D in space antenna systems, sub-millimetre wave instruments and associated technologies. 
 Duties 
 The Antennas and Sub-millimetre Waves Section covers:
 analysis, engineering, radio frequency modelling and design tool development for standalone ground- and space-based antennas, including interference between antennas and with spacecraft structures or other platforms, such as aircraft, trains and vehicles;
 design and analysis of all active and passive antenna subsystems, including standalone radiators, arrays, reflectors, lens optics, dichroics and associated focal planes;
 analysis, engineering, radio frequency modelling and design tool development for sub millimetre wave instrument architectures, antennas, front-end technologies and components.
 Your tasks and responsibilities will include:
 providing expert technical support and consultancy to ESA projects, programmes and general studies in the field of space antenna systems, sub-millimetre wave instruments and associated technologies throughout all project phases;
 participating in feasibility studies, project reviews and the evaluation of procurement proposals;
 identifying critical development problems and assisting in their resolution;
 contributing to the definition of technology development requirements and work plans for the Agency’s technology programmes;
 defining, initiating and managing R&D activities covering both long- and short-term needs;
 fostering new application areas for multidisciplinary activities, placing emphasis on innovative concepts, cutting-edge technologies and system architectures;
 laboratory activities as required;
 monitoring applicable scientific and technological trends and maintaining state-of-the-art expertise;
 contributing to the dissemination of the results of the activities performed and the transfer of knowledge across the Agency. 
Your duties may also include supporting other activities within your field of competence, as required.
 Technical competencies 
 General background and specific experience in the technical domains covered by the position
 Experience in the management and monitoring of industrial activities, including participation in reviews
 Understanding of related technologies, R&D trends and the industrial landscape
 Experience with the design, development and application of relevant tools and methods
 Project support experience in a relevant domain
 Experience in the preparation of procurement activities for technology development and innovation, such as statements of work and proposal evaluation
 Experience in the development and verification of relevant technical equipment and space hardware, including laboratory and field testing

 Result Orientation
Operational Efficiency
Fostering Cooperation
Relationship Management
Continuous Improvement
Forward Thinking
For more information, please refer to the ESA Core Behavioural Competencies guidebook.

 A master's degree in telecommunications or electrical engineering is required for this post together with, 4 years of relevant professional experience.

 Solid industrial experience with antenna and/or sub-millimetre wave architectures and technologies applied to aerospace programmes would be an asset.

items.desc: About Introw Since early 2023, Introw has become the #1 AI-native, CRM-native partner management platform. We grow 4 to 5x year over year and work with companies like Adyen, Aikido and Factorial. Partnerships are how B2B companies sell through other companies: resellers, referral partners, distributors and implementers. For most of them, partners are the best-performing channel. Introw runs that channel inside HubSpot and Salesforce. Partners work where they already are: their own CRM, Slack, Teams, email, or AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT. We raised $3M led by Visionaries VC, we serve hundreds of companies worldwide, and we hold a 5.0 rating across 100s of reviews. ShareGate went live with 3,000 partners in under 10 weeks. Ringover took partner activity from 20% to 70%. Tensis grew partner-sourced revenue by 400%. Why this role matters AI is already part of how vendors and partners work with Introw: AI assistants. Vendors and partners work with Introw from Claude and ChatGPT over our MCP server. Agents in production. Our agents register deals, answer partners and update the CRM, taking scoped actions with a human in the loop. Where partners already are. Slack, Teams and email, next to their own CRM. You own that layer. As our AI engineer, you maintain and build out Introw's AI and MCP capabilities: the MCP server, the agents and everything that proves they work. This is not a research role and not prompt tinkering. You ship production AI and you own it after it ships. How we work Product, design and engineering are one job. You talk to a customer in the morning, prototype in the afternoon and ship that week. No manager layer. You own the function end to end, with every resource and all the freedom you need. Craft is the point. We make a complex product look simple, and we sweat the details. Everyone owns a piece. Every Intrower is in the ESOP. When we win, you win. Location Ghent, Belgium, from our office in the city center. Mostly in person, with a day or two of flexibility. What you'll do Own Introw's MCP server: the tools, auth and permissions that let vendors and partners work with Introw from Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants. Build and maintain our agents that register deals, answer partners and update the CRM. Scoped actions, humans in the loop, never more access than the user has. Make AI reliable: evals, tracing and monitoring, so you know an agent is wrong before a customer does. Keep it safe and enterprise-grade: customer data stays where it belongs. Follow the model and protocol landscape closely and decide what is worth adopting, and what is not. Talk to customers and partners, look at how they use our AI, and shape where agents go next together with our CPO and CTO. Use agentic coding tools every day to do in a day what used to take a week. Who you are You're an A-player who wants your fingerprints on how B2B companies will sell together with AI. The following should be how your friends describe you: Experienced. You have shipped LLM-powered features to production that real users depend on, and you have a strong track record building scalable, robust systems in TypeScript (NextJS a plus). Most strong fits have 4+ years of engineering experience, but the bar matters more than the number. Deep in AI. Tool calling, MCP, agent frameworks, retrieval and evals are your daily work. You know where models fail and design around it. An owner. You take a capability end to end and stay accountable for it in production: you spot the problem, fix it and make sure it does not come back. Pragmatic. You'd rather ship ten small improvements than write one big spec, and you pick the simplest thing that works. Excellent written English. Dutch or French is a plus. Nice to have You have built or contributed to an MCP server. Experience with HubSpot or Salesforce APIs, OAuth and permission models. Experience in a fast-growing B2B SaaS startup. Benefits Equity through our ESOP. A MacBook Pro and iPhone, fully set up for you. Fully paid phone subscription. Healthcare plan. Mobility budget. Meal vouchers. Introw merch. Regular team drinks and events, plus travel to industry events. Ready to own AI at a category leader? Send us your CV and one AI feature or MCP integration you shipped that you are proud of, plus what you would change about it today. We reply to everyone. Contact: Laurens Lavaert, CTO, on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/laurens-lavaert-2530917a/ What to expect: a quick intro call, a technical deep dive on your past work, a short hands-on exercise on our codebase, and time with the team.

items.desc: Smartlex ricerca un/una AI Engineer Junior da inserire in tirocinio nel team di ricerca e sviluppo di AnoniMiServe, per lo sviluppo di un modello di riconoscimento dei dati personali specializzato sul linguaggio giuridico italiano. Per candidarti, invia il tuo CV a g.gavarini@smartlex.eu, indicando nell'oggetto " Junior AI Engineer – Stage ". Chi siamo SmartLex Srl è uno spin-off della Scuola Superiore Sant'Anna di Pisa, che fornisce prodotti e servizi di compliance legale a organizzazioni private e pubbliche che sviluppano o adottano tecnologie innovative. Il nostro team di accademici, esperti legali, eticisti, data scientist, informatici ed esperti di intelligenza artificiale copre diversi ambiti, dalla protezione dei dati e privacy, alla cybersicurezza, all'intelligenza artificiale, alla sicurezza dei prodotti e ai dispositivi medici, fino alla responsabilità contrattuale ed extracontrattuale. SmartLex collabora con grandi aziende internazionali, PMI innovative, startup, istituzioni accademiche, centri di ricerca e studi legali per rispondere alle esigenze del settore e ai bandi di ricerca europei. Tra i prodotti sviluppati da Smartlex figura AnoniMiServe, un servizio di pseudonimizzazione dei documenti rivolto a professionisti come avvocati e commercialisti. Consente di utilizzare assistenti di intelligenza artificiale sui documenti dei clienti senza esporne i dati personali, i quali vengono sostituiti da etichette prima dell'elaborazione e sono poi ripristinati nella risposta. Il riconoscimento dei dati avviene direttamente sul dispositivo dell'utente, da cui i documenti originali non vengono mai trasferiti. La posizione I modelli generalisti per il riconoscimento dei dati personali non sono progettati per il linguaggio giuridico e, in questo ambito, non garantiscono la precisione richiesta. Il tirocinio ha l'obiettivo di sviluppare un modello specializzato sui testi giuridici in lingua italiana, sufficientemente leggero da poter essere eseguito nel browser, e di verificarne i miglioramenti rispetto alle soluzioni esistenti sulla base di risultati misurabili. Il/la tirocinante, con il supporto del tutor, seguirà le diverse fasi del progetto: analisi dello stato dell'arte; preparazione e annotazione dei dati; definizione delle metriche di valutazione; progettazione dell'architettura del modello; addestramento e confronto dei modelli; eventuale integrazione nel prodotto, qualora i risultati ottenuti lo giustifichino. In parallelo al progetto di ricerca, il/la tirocinante contribuirà allo sviluppo e alla manutenzione di AnoniMiServe, sia per l'applicazione web sia per i servizi cloud: risoluzione di bug, implementazione di funzionalità di limitata complessità, scrittura di test e aggiornamento delle dipendenze. Nel corso del tirocinio verranno utilizzate le seguenti tecnologie: Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, ONNX, Transformers.js, ONNX Runtime Web TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS Node.js, Hono AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, Cognito), AWS CDK Vitest, Playwright, Git, GitHub Actions, pnpm Requisiti. Laurea triennale o magistrale, conseguita da non più di 12 mesi, in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Matematica o discipline affini. Si richiedono inoltre: buona conoscenza di Python; conoscenze di base di sviluppo web in JavaScript o TypeScript; conoscenze di base di machine learning e NLP, anche acquisite esclusivamente in ambito universitario; familiarità con Git; capacità di utilizzare strumenti di AI a supporto dello sviluppo, comprendendo e verificando il codice generato; ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana e buona conoscenza dell'inglese tecnico. Costituiscono titolo preferenziale: tesi o progetti in ambito NLP o machine learning; esperienza con PyTorch o Hugging Face; esperienza con React o con servizi cloud; interesse per la protezione dei dati personali, il GDPR o il diritto in generale; interesse per la ricerca e consuetudine con la lettura di articoli scientifici. Cosa offiramo Tirocinio extracurriculare della durata di 6 mesi, a tempo pieno Indennità di partecipazione di 800 € mensili Modalità di lavoro prevalentemente da remoto, con incontri presso la sede di Pisa almeno due volte al mese; interazione con team interdisciplinare in presenza e da remoto Affiancamento di un tutor dedicato e partecipazione a un progetto di ricerca applicata Inizio previsto: dicembre 2026 Smartlex garantisce pari opportunità e un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. L'offerta è rivolta a candidati di entrambi i sessi (L. 903/77). Retribuzione: €800,00 al mese Sede di lavoro: Ibrido/da remoto (San Giuliano Terme, Toscana)

Forts de plus de 6 000 collaborateurs talentueux et engagés à travers l'Europe, l'Amérique du Nord et l'Asie, nous disposons d'expertises sectorielles de premier plan et d'un portefeuille de savoir-faire cross-sectoriels, nous permettant d'adresser à 360° les grands programmes de transformation de nos clients. Chez Wavestone, nous sommes convaincus que la réussite professionnelle et l'épanouissement personnel vont de pair. C'est pourquoi nous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant, inclusif et bienveillant, où chacun peut s’épanouir et atteindre son plein potentiel. Wavestone est coté sur Euronext, à Paris, et labellisé Great Place to Work®. Pour plus d'informations, consulter www.wavestone.com Tous nos métiers sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. Description du poste Contexte : Forte de plus de 450 consultants, la Business Unit CTO Advisory de Wavestone est au cœur des révolutions technologiques qui transforment les entreprises d'aujourd'hui. Notre mission ? Accompagner les projets les plus complexes de transformation digitale, de la vision stratégique à l'implémentation opérationnelle, en passant par la conduite du changement. CTO Advisory embrasse l'ensemble des défis technologiques et organisationnels du Chief Technology Officer : de l'intelligence artificielle générative aux plateformes de données modernes, en passant par l'adoption du cloud natif et la refonte des architectures legacy. Nous collaborons étroitement avec les équipes sectorielles au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires pour adresser ces enjeux de transformation de bout en bout. Au sein de CTO Advisory, notre équipe Cloud Connect réunit les expertises cloud, architecture, infrastructure, FinOps et DevOps dans une approche holistique de la modernisation IT. Nous adressons les défis de transformation des applications et socles technologiques à travers plusieurs axes stratégiques : Infrastructure nouvelle génération : Comment migrer vers des architectures cloud-native et tirer parti des dernières innovations ? #Platforms #Azure #AWS #GCP #Container #Serverless Applications intelligentes : Comment refondre les applications pour exploiter pleinement le potentiel du cloud et des technologies émergentes ? #DevOps #Microservices #Replatforming #API-First #GenAI Sourcing et gouvernance : Comment orchestrer les achats IT et assurer une gouvernance optimale des nouvelles technologies ? #Infrastructure broker #Network provider #MultiCloud #RFP-Cloud #SLA #CSMP Organisation agile : Comment créer des équipes haute performance et des processus optimisés ? #DevOps #CI/CD #TOM Cloud #Agile@Scale #SAFe #PlatformEngineering Sécurité by design : Comment intégrer la sécurité dès la conception dans un monde cloud-first ? #DevSecOps #CloudSec #ZeroTrust #SASE Performance durable : Comment allier optimisation financière et responsabilité environnementale ? #FinOps #GreenIT #SustainableCloud Si vous êtes passionné par les modèles organisationnels disruptifs (Agile, DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering), les technologies qui façonnent l'avenir (cloud hybride, Infrastructure as Code, orchestration de conteneurs, plateformes de données, IA générative), et que vous souhaitez les mettre en pratique à travers des études concrètes et des POC innovants, l'offre Cloud Connect de Wavestone vous attend ! Objectif du stage : L'Intelligence Artificielle transforme la manière dont les entreprises conçoivent, opèrent et font évoluer leur système d'information. L'émergence d'assistants augmentés, d'agents IA et de nouveaux usages d'automatisation ouvre des perspectives concrètes pour les directions IT, tout en soulevant des questions clés : création de valeur, gouvernance des usages, sécurité, industrialisation et adoption par les équipes. L'objectif du stage est de construire, tester et outiller des cas d'usage concrets de l'IA sur toute la chaîne du SI, de l'architecture applicative à l'exploitation des infrastructures, et d'en évaluer la valeur réelle pour les équipes IT. Dans ce contexte, vous serez amené à travailler sur l’un des sujets suivants : IA sur les plateformes des hyperscalers : définir, analyser et expérimenter les bonnes pratiques d’architecture et de gouvernance autour de la mise à disposition de services IA au cœur des plateformes proposées par les fournisseurs cloud du marché. items.desc: Cybrain è una società specializzata in Cyber Security e sviluppo di software innovativi, partner strategica di TEHA Group , primo think tank italiano e società di consulenza direzionale attiva anche a livello internazionale , organizzatrice dello storico Forum di Cernobbio, che ogni anno riunisce sulle rive del Lago di Como capi di Stato, vertici delle istituzioni internazionali e leader delle più importanti aziende globali. Crediamo che l'Intelligenza Artificiale stia ridisegnando il perimetro della sicurezza: agenti autonomi, LLM e sistemi decisionali intelligenti stanno entrando nei processi core delle aziende, e con loro nascono superfici d'attacco che non esistevano fino a ieri. Per noi la sicurezza non è un controllo da aggiungere alla fine: è il modo in cui progettiamo sistemi, software e organizzazioni AI-driven fin dall'inizio. Posizione: Per potenziare il team, cerchiamo un Agentic AI Security Specialist : un profilo che unisca solide fondamenta di Cyber Security: governance e offensive, alla capacità di metterle al servizio della nuova frontiera, quella dei sistemi di Intelligenza Artificiale e degli agenti autonomi. È un ruolo per chi vuole essere tra i primi a definire come si mette in sicurezza l'AI: non una casella da spuntare, ma una disciplina di execution che stiamo costruendo adesso, insieme ai nostri clienti. Lavorerai su tre fronti complementari: AI Security & Agentic Systems. Sarai in prima linea nella messa in sicurezza di sistemi basati su LLM e agenti autonomi: AI Red Teaming, test di resistenza a prompt injection e jailbreak, valutazione di rischi come data poisoning, model extraction ed exfiltration attraverso tool e integrazioni agentiche. Contribuirai a definire architetture sicure per pipeline AI e framework di controllo per agenti che operano con autonomia crescente sui sistemi dei clienti. Governance. Supporterai i clienti nell'adeguamento a NIS2, all'AI Act europeo e a certificazioni come ISO 27001 e ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System), redigendo policy e procedure che rendano l'adozione dell'AI sicura, conforme e sostenibile. Offensive Security. Condurrai Vulnerability Assessment e Penetration Testing su un perimetro ampio: WebApp, Mobile, IoT, SCADA, sistemi embedded, Cloud e naturalmente AI, insieme ad attività di OSINT, Cyber Threat Intelligence e campagne di Social Engineering, incluse quelle potenziate dall'AI generativa. Sarai inoltre coinvolto nella risposta agli incidenti, compresi quelli che coinvolgono sistemi AI, nell'acquisizione e analisi forense dei supporti di memoria, e nella redazione di report organici che traducono le attività e i findings in indicazioni concrete per il cliente. Requisiti: Il profilo ideale conosce i principali framework e metodologie di settore: ISO 27001, NIS2, OWASP (inclusa la OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications), OSSTMM, MITRE ATLAS e padroneggia l'Offensive Security lungo tutte le fasi della Kill Chain, con dimestichezza nei tool per analizzare e condurre un attacco. Cerchiamo una genuina curiosità per il mondo AI: comprensione di come funzionano LLM e sistemi agentici, delle loro vulnerabilità specifiche e delle tecniche emergenti di attacco e difesa. Non chiediamo di sapere già tutto, il campo è nuovo per definizione, ma di avere la voglia e la capacità di impararlo velocemente. Valutiamo con particolare attenzione la capacità di lavorare in team, l'autonomia organizzativa, il problem solving e l'iniziativa personale. Sono un plus la partecipazione a CTF e challenge di settore (incluse quelle su AI/LLM security) e certificazioni come CEH, OSCP, Security+, CySA+ o ISO 27001. Altre informazioni: Contratto a tempo indeterminato full time con orari e luogo di lavoro flessibili e un pacchetto retributivo commisurato a esperienza e percorso tecnico. A questo si aggiungono buoni pasto e assistenza sanitaria integrativa (Fondo Est). Percorso di formazione continua con corsi e certificazioni per un totale di 100-120 ore l'anno, con un investimento dedicato proprio all'Agentic AI Security oltre ad un programma in presenza e online dedicato da The European House – Ambrosetti che include: Project Management (con certificazione Scrum), Cyber Security (con certificazione eCPTT), Team Management, People Management e Public Speaking. Soprattutto, entrerai in un contesto giovane e dinamico, costruito sullo scambio di competenze e sul lavoro per obiettivi, dove metterai le mani sulla frontiera più avanzata della sicurezza: quella dei sistemi intelligenti e autonomi. Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle leggi 903/77 e 125/91, e a persone di tutte le età e tutte le nazionalità, ai sensi dei decreti legislativi 215/03 e 216/03.

items.desc: Founder & CEO — Pet Care AI The AI agent that actually knows your pet. Preventative care from day one of ownership. Help every new pet owner get the first 100 days right, and keep their pet healthy and happy for its lifetime. Location: London Start date: ASAP About Founders Factory: Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Created by IPO-exited founders, we offer founders capital, operational support from a team of hands-on experts, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry-leading corporate partners. Since 2015, Founders Factory's 450+ portfolio companies have secured 500+ pilots and commercial contracts with our partners. Our Studio partners with entrepreneurs at day one, developing new ideas, technologies and business models into high-growth companies. In partnership with Aviva, one of the UK's leading insurers, we are building a new portfolio of ventures out of London. About the Venture: There are 36.5 million pets in UK homes, and 62% of households own one. Owners treat pets as family and spend like it: £11.95bn a year on pets and pet products. Yet every decision over a pet's life (which breed, what food, what training, which vet, what cover) is a separate search, and most new owners are learning as they go. Getting it wrong is expensive: vet prices rose 63% between 2016 and 2023, and UK pet insurers paid a record £1.23bn in claims in 2024. General AI agents are going mainstream, but they only know what the owner remembers. We are building an agent that actually knows your pet. It starts before or on day one: helping you choose the right pet for your lifestyle, then guiding the first 100 days on nutrition, training and routine. Over time it learns your pet's breed, age, exercise and history, and shifts the focus to preventative care, so expensive problems are caught early or never happen. When something goes wrong ("my dog just ate chocolate, do I need a vet?"), it triages, connects you to a vet, and tells you what you're covered for before you book. Underneath sits a verified pet record that owners control and vets write to, so its advice starts from fact, not memory. As Founder & CEO, you will be responsible for turning a strong thesis into a scaled, defensible business. Pick the wedge. Decide where you win owners first: pre-purchase, the first 100 days, or a specific species or breed group, and prove they come back after the honeymoon period. Build the agent people trust. Take the product from concept to an agent that gives genuinely useful, safe guidance on nutrition, training, prevention and triage, with vets and televet partners in the loop. Make prevention pay. Show that better routines and earlier treatment reduce costly claims, and turn that into a model insurers and pet businesses will pay for. Own the record. Build the verified pet record underneath, with owners' permission and vets writing to it, so the agent knows more than any general-purpose AI. Launch with Aviva. Use Aviva's pet policyholders as early users and design a commercial partnership that works for both sides. Build the company. Hire the initial team, raise capital, and establish the venture as the trusted companion for every pet owner in the UK, then beyond. Your Ideal Experience: The ideal candidate has built consumer products people love, ideally in pets, and knows how to use AI to do it. Founder or early leader at a consumer pet business: pet insurance, pet care, televet, pet food or a pet subscription brand. A strong consumer product instinct: you know how to acquire, activate and retain users, and you obsess over what keeps people coming back. Comfortable building with AI: you can shape agentic products and work closely with engineers, even if you're not writing the code yourself. Understanding of the vet ecosystem, pet health data or insurance is a strong plus. Comfortable operating in ambiguity: shaping the product, defining the customer, and making irreversible calls with incomplete data. Credibility with a large corporate partner and with forward-looking venture investors. Most importantly, you care about pets and their owners, and want to build a company that keeps millions of them healthier for longer. This is your company. We're here to help.

items.desc: Founder & CEO — AI-Native Captive in a Box Self-insurance for everyone. Self-insurance is no longer just for the Microsofts of the world. Give everyone the option to get cover without paying an insurance company. Location: London Start date: ASAP About Founders Factory: Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Created by IPO-exited founders, we offer founders capital, operational support from a team of hands-on experts, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry-leading corporate partners. Since 2015, Founders Factory's 450+ portfolio companies have secured 500+ pilots and commercial contracts with our partners. Our Studio partners with entrepreneurs at day one, developing new ideas, technologies and business models into high-growth companies. In partnership with Aviva, one of the UK's leading insurers, we are building a new portfolio of ventures out of London. About the Venture: Large companies have long cut their insurance costs by setting up a captive: their own insurance company, holding capital aside to cover risks like employee injury or health, and keeping the margin when claims are low. Global captive premium is around $240bn, about a tenth of worldwide P&C. But captives are complex to set up: feasibility studies, actuarial work, legal structuring and ongoing management fees keep almost every company below the very largest out. Loss data arrives as messy spreadsheets, and UK firms have had to go offshore because there's no UK captive regime. We are building a captive that any company can set up in days, not months. AI agents take in loss runs and policies, model the retention options and draft the feasibility study. The platform then runs the captive (reserving, board packs, filings and claims data) with qualified actuaries signing off. Fronting and reinsurance partners, starting with Aviva, carry the paper. The venture holds no balance-sheet risk: it earns a feasibility fee, then an annual platform fee per captive. Jobs to be Done: As Founder & CEO, you will be responsible for turning a strong thesis into a scaled, defensible business. Size the market. Work out which UK mid-market firms have the capital and loss profile for a captive once costs come down, and which lines of risk to start with. Build the platform. Take the AI feasibility and captive management product from concept to something brokers, CFOs and regulators trust, with actuaries in the loop. Line up the paper. Agree fronting and reinsurance terms with Aviva and other partners so small captives can be written. Win the first captives. Land the first mid-market clients and broker partners, and be ready for the UK regime when it opens in 2027. Build the company. Hire the initial team, raise capital, and establish the venture as the default way mid-sized companies self-insure, then expand into group captives, cells, Europe and the US. Your Ideal Experience We are not looking for a pure actuary or a pure software founder. The ideal candidate understands how insurance works and wants to rebuild it with AI. A background in financial services or insurance: commercial insurance, broking, captives, reinsurance, actuarial or risk management. Somewhat technical and building with AI: you can design agentic workflows and work closely with engineers, even if you're not writing all the code. B2B commercial instinct: you can sell to CFOs and brokers and navigate long, considered buying decisions. Comfort with regulation: you can work with the PRA, FCA and fronting partners and turn compliance into a product feature. Comfortable operating in ambiguity: making irreversible calls with incomplete data. Credibility with a large corporate partner and with forward-looking venture investors. This is your company. We're here to help.

items.desc: Wanna join the adventure? Loft Orbital is looking for a Software Engineer to join the Dynamics team within Ground Platform. Dynamics computes the timeline of what every spacecraft in our fleet can do and when (contacts with ground stations, links, accesses, unavailability windows) and turns it into schedules: which satellite talks to which ground station, when, and in which order of priority. As our fleet grows, these services need to handle more data, more queries, and harder allocation problems. You’ll bring strong backend engineering to that challenge: making our APIs fast, our databases scale, and our contact allocation and scheduling smarter. No astrodynamics background is needed; you’ll work alongside flight dynamics engineers who bring that expertise. If you enjoy hard performance problems and optimization with real-world constraints, we’d love to hear from you. About this role: Build and optimize our scheduling capabilities: model constraints and objectives, design algorithms and solver-based approaches that produce feasible, high-quality schedules across a Who We Are Loft: Space Made Simple. Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit. We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives. With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure. items.desc: Détails de l’offre Poste proposé INGENIEUR DE RECHERCHE F/H - DRCI - DIA2M - 100% Contrat CDD Descriptif DIRECTION / SITE : Direction de la Recherche Clinique et de l'Innovation SERVICE / UNITÉ : Recherche clinique, Département DIA2M IDENTIFICATION DU POSTE Poste : Ingénieur de recherche F/H (profil chercheur postdoctoral) Temps de travail : 100 % Durée prévisionnelle du contrat : 18 mois Affectation au projet : 100 % au projet AILE Jours de travail : du lundi au vendredi, en journée Lieu de travail : Centre Hospitalier Universitaire de Clermont-Ferrand, Département DIA2M Responsables hiérarchiques : Administratif : Xavier BIJAYE, Directeur de la Direction de la Recherche Clinique et de l'Innovation Scientifique et fonctionnel : Pr Adrien BARTOLI, Responsable de DIA2M et Coordinateur scientifique du projet AILE PRÉSENTATION DU DÉPARTEMENT La Direction de la Recherche Clinique et de l'Innovation joue un rôle clé dans l'élaboration et la mise en uvre de la politique de recherche du Centre Hospitalier Universitaire de Clermont-Ferrand. Elle accompagne les investigateurs dans la gestion administrative, réglementaire et financière des projets de recherche clinique. La Direction comprend un département de recherche dédié à l'intelligence artificielle, DIA2M, prononcé « diadème ». DIA2M accompagne la recherche en IA et la recherche assistée par l'IA dans l'ensemble du Centre Hospitalier Universitaire, depuis la collecte et l'enrichissement des données jusqu'au développement d'algorithmes avancés et à leur valorisation scientifique, clinique et industrielle. PRÉSENTATION DU PROJET Ce poste s'inscrit dans le cadre du projet AILE, Intelligence Artificielle pour la Laparoscopie et l'Endoscopie, porté et coordonné par le Centre Hospitalier Universitaire de Clermont-Ferrand en partenariat avec SURGAR et YANSYS. Ce projet collaboratif sollicite le soutien du Fonds européen de développement régional, FEDER, dans le cadre du programme Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes 2021-2027. AILE vise à développer et à évaluer des méthodes d'intelligence artificielle pour l'analyse d'images interventionnelles en endoscopie digestive et en chirurgie mini-invasive. Ces technologies apporteront une assistance en temps réel aux cliniciens afin d'améliorer la précision, la sécurité et l'efficacité des procédures. DESCRIPTION DU POSTE Le candidat retenu contribuera au développement de nouvelles méthodes d'intelligence artificielle pour l'analyse automatisée de vidéos chirurgicales. Ils participeront à la structuration et à l'exploitation des données cliniques, au développement de réseaux neuronaux adaptés aux données endoscopiques et chirurgicales, ainsi qu'à l'entraînement, à l'évaluation et au transfert de ces modèles vers les solutions logicielles développées par les partenaires industriels. Le candidat retenu travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les chercheurs et ingénieurs du Département DIA2M, les équipes médicales et les partenaires industriels du consortium. Il contribuera également à la validation technique et préclinique des modèles développés. Le postdoctorant travaillera sur la théorie et les méthodes d'analyse d'images et de vision 3D appliquées aux images endoscopiques. Un endoscope étant un capteur RVB, la reconstruction de la profondeur à partir d'une seule image constitue un défi, même si les modèles récents ont néanmoins accompli des progrès considérables. Toutefois, l'assemblage de ces données de profondeur reconstruites en un modèle 3D cohérent couvrant plusieurs images reste un problème largement ouvert, en raison notamment de phénomènes tels que les occultations, les mouvements de caméra et les variations d'éclairage. Le postdoctorant développera un modèle computationnel adapté à la représentation 3D de scènes endoscopiques, en s'inspirant des maillages de surface, de NeRF et de 3DGS, une méthode permettant de le reconstruire à partir d'images issues de données réelles, en exploitant l'erreur de reprojection et les images de profondeur, ainsi que son application à des problématiques cliniques réelles. Ces problématiques pourront inclure la cartographie des polypes pour la téléexpertise, la cartographie du côlon pour l'évaluation de la couverture de l'examen et la cartographie de la cavité abdominale pour le recalage du jumeau numérique du rein. RESPONSABILITES: MISSIONS : Contribuer à la recherche scientifique et au développement technique de méthodes d'intelligence artificielle dans le cadre du projet AILE, en endoscopie digestive. Le candidat retenu aura pour missions de : Analyser les problématiques cliniques liées soit à la caractérisation des lésions, à la qualité des images endoscopiques et à l'expertise à distance ; Proposer des solutions innovantes fondées sur la vision par ordinateur, l'apprentissage profond et l'analyse vidéo ; Contribuer à la préparation, à la structuration, à la documentation et au contrôle qualité des bases de données du projet ; Développer et évaluer des modèles d'intelligence artificielle …

items.desc: JOB DESCRIPTION The Heart Failure and Cardiac Regeneration Research Group (ICREC) is offering a 3-year postdoctoral fellowship associated with a research project (PID2025-171251OB-I00). The available position is for a Postdoctoral Researcher within the project entitled “Next- Generation Decellularized and Re-Endothelialized Human Vascular Grafts for Arterial Bypass (VasCraft 2.0)”, a preclinical study led and coordinated by the Heart Failure and Cardiac Regeneration Research Group (ICREC) in collaboration with the Cardiology Department of Hospital Universitari Germans Trias i Pujol. Principal Investigator: Dr. Carolina Gálvez-Montón, Head of the ICREC Research Group. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Support surgical procedures in porcine models, including percutaneous induction of myocardial infarction, end-to-end femoral artery bypass grafting, cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR), animal monitoring and follow-up, and angiographic assessments. Perform general and specialised laboratory techniques and protocols, including cell culture, histology, immunohistochemistry, PCR, Western blotting, and other relevant experimental procedures. Develop and optimise experimental protocols related to the group's research lines. Perform statistical analysis and interpretation of experimental data. Contribute to the preparation, writing, and revision of scientific manuscripts and research proposals for both competitive public funding calls and private funding opportunities. Collaborate with other researchers in the cardiovascular field, contributing to all activities necessary to achieve the research group's scientific objectives. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE Hold a PhD in Medicine or, alternatively, in Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, or Biomedicine. Expertise in cardiac electrophysiology and arrhythmias. Strong motivation to work in cardiovascular diseases and cardiac regeneration research. Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team. Good command of English. Accreditation for conducting research involving laboratory animals (Category C). Previous experience in surgical procedures using porcine models will be considered an asset. Previous experience in the following experimental techniques will also be valued: cell culture, tissue engineering, histology, and immunohistochemistry. WHAT WE OFFER Type of contract and working hours: Permanent, full-time employment contract (Indefinido por actividades científico-técnicas- Ley de la ciencia 14/2011). Estimated Date of incorporation: January 1, 2027. Gross remuneration: 35000€ gross per year (distributed in 12 payments) Flexible payment (childminding vouchers). 23 days holiday and 5 days for personal matters. Training capsules by the company. Be part of an excellent multidisciplinary research centre with the HRS4R badge. Location on the Can Ruti Campus, a first-class translational research environment in the Barcelona area, in a very stimulating scientific environment. The IGTP offers a supportive, friendly and collaborative ecosystem to promote professional development and help you achieve your research goals. FOR MORE INFORMATION http://www.icor.cat/ HOW TO APPLY Interested persons must attach to the application: Motivation letter explaining their interest in the position. Updated CV. Contact of 2-3 references. Applications that do not meet the requirements, that are not included in the cases foreseen or that are not processed in accordance with the established procedure will not be considered in the selection process. DEADLINE FOR APPLICATIONS The call will be open until December 3rd, 2026 About us The Germans Trias i Pujol Research Institute (IGTP) is a public research centre located in Badalona. The Institute is associated with one of the major university hospitals in the Barcelona area, the Germans Trias i Pujol Hospital, and is part of the Can Ruti biomedical campus. Hos oss får du leda tekniskt avancerade projekt där människor, teknik och struktur samverkar för att utveckla morgondagens produkter. Du leder projekt genom hela eller delar av utvecklingskedjan, från nyutveckling och vidareutveckling till förvaltning och underhåll av befintliga produkter. I rollen kan du bland annat arbeta med: Planering, ledning och uppföljning av tekniska utvecklingsprojekt Koordinering av tvärfunktionella utvecklingsteam Uppföljning av tidplan, budget, resurser och projektmål Riskhantering, prioritering och hantering av förändringar Kommunikation och samordning mellan kunder, utvecklingsteam och andra intressenter Kvalitetssäkring av projektets leveranser Utveckling och förbättring av processer och arbetssätt Vi söker sig som: Har minst fem års erfarenhet av projektledning inom embedded eller närliggande teknikområden Har en ingenjörsexamen inom exempelvis elektronik, datateknik, mjukvaruutveckling eller motsvarande Har god teknisk förståelse och förmåga att sätta dig in i komplexa tekniska frågeställningar Har erfarenhet från fordons- eller försvarsindustrin Har goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska Det är meriterande om du har en certifiering inom projektledning eller en tidigare teknisk bakgrund inom mjukvaruutveckling, elektronikkonstruktion, firmware eller systemutveckling. Erfarenhet av AI och dess tillämpning inom teknisk utveckling eller projektledning är också meriterande. Som person är du strukturerad, kommunikativ och lösningsorienterad. Du har förmåga att skapa engagemang, bygga förtroende och driva arbetet framåt även i komplexa miljöer med många intressenter. Du trivs med variationen i konsultrollen och är flexibel vad gäller uppdragsplacering inom Stockholmsområdet. Eftersom vi arbetar med kunder inom försvarsindustrin kan vissa uppdrag kräva svenskt medborgarskap samt godkänd säkerhetsprövning. Vi erbjuder: Hos oss får du möjlighet att utvecklas som projektledare i tekniskt utmanande uppdrag och tillsammans med kollegor med djup kompetens inom embedded och närliggande teknikområden. Tekniskt avancerade och långsiktiga uppdrag Möjlighet att leda utvecklingsprojekt inom olika teknikområden och branscher Kollegor med djup teknisk kompetens och stark laganda Flexibla arbetsformer med fokus på balans och en hållbar arbetsmiljö Möjlighet att påverka både ditt uppdrag och din egen kompetensutveckling Vi arbetar både med konsultuppdrag hos våra kunder och med team- och projektleveranser genom vår inhouse-verksamhet. Våra utvecklingslabb ger möjlighet att arbeta praktiskt med bland annat prototypframtagning, integration, test och verifiering. Genom vårt R&D Forum skapar vi också utrymme för innovation, kunskapsdelning och teknisk utveckling. Hos oss kombinerar du variationen i konsultrollen med närheten till kollegor och ledning samt korta beslutsvägar. Samtidigt är du en del av Group och får tillgång till ett stort nätverk och bred teknisk kompetens. Om oss Embedded Solutions är ett teknikkonsultbolag med spetskompetens inom inbyggda system, mjukvaruutveckling och elektronik. Vi arbetar genom hela utvecklingskedjan, från krav och systemdesign till utveckling, test och verifiering. Vi samarbetar med teknikintensiva kunder inom bland annat fordonsindustri, energi, telekom, konsumentelektronik, medicinteknik, försvar och säkerhet samt tillverkningsindustri. Våra uppdrag omfattar både specialistkompetens hos kund och kompletta team- och projektleveranser genom vår inhouse-verksamhet. Vi är en del av Embedded Group inom Group, vilket ger oss tillgång till ett brett nätverk av specialister och kompetens inom flera teknikområden. Samtidigt behåller vi närheten, flexibiliteten och de korta beslutsvägarna i vår lokala verksamhet. Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan till oss! items.desc: Salary Range: £33,002.00 - £38,784.00 We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion, creating a community where colleagues feel respected and valued. We aim to reflect the diversity of our students and communities, and to strengthen our university through collaboration and diverse perspectives, across all roles at the University. Research Assistant Band 6 (UO24 - UO30) £33,002 - £38,784 per annum Full Time, Fixed Term for 2 years We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Research Assistant to join the recently launched £48M Wound Innovation Institute at the University of Hull. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to internationally leading research focused on understanding the role of the microbiome in skin health and chronic wound pathology. Working within a multidisciplinary team of scientists, clinicians and industry partners, you will support the delivery of pioneering research programmes designed to improve the treatment of wound infection. The successful candidate will contribute to a portfolio of externally funded academic and industry-sponsored projects. These include the development of advanced human wound microbiota and infection models through a programme funded by the National Centre for the Replacement, Refinement and Reduction of Animals in Research (NC3Rs), as well as the evaluation of innovative antimicrobial technologies for wound care. Based within our state-of-the-art research laboratories at Castle Hill Hospital, you will work with leading microbiology, genomics and imaging technologies alongside a vibrant community of researchers dedicated to improving outcomes for patients with chronic wounds. The role offers excellent opportunities to develop expertise in wound microbiology, microbial genomics and working with human tissue. The successful candidate will be encouraged to contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations and the wider research activities of the Institute. About You We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with a degree in Microbiology, Biomedical Sciences, Molecular Biology or a closely related discipline. Applicants should demonstrate experience in one or more of the following areas: Microbiology Molecular biology Clinical sample processing Genomics and sequencing technologies Experience in any of the following areas would be advantageous: Bacterial whole genome or metagenomic sequencing MALDI-TOF microbial identification Histology and/or imaging techniques We are seeking an individual with excellent organisational skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary research team. items.desc: Investigator Scientist in Cell Cycle Control (LMS 3133) Salary: £44,801 - £47,071 plus London Allowance £5,560 per annum Band (Grade): Band 4 S2 | Fixed term: 1 year | Full time | Closing date: 12 December 2026 Overall purpose: To work within the group of Dr Alexis Barr at the MRC Laboratory of Medical Sciences (LMS). To lead one or more projects within an overall programme on cell cycle entry (G0-G1-S) control in health and cancer. The Cell Cycle Control team works to understand how cellular signalling controls proliferation-quiescence decisions. The group uses genetic engineering, quantitative single-cell imaging (including timelapse imaging), 2D and 3D cell culture models, image-based screens, molecular biology and proteomics to identify and understand novel mechanisms of cell cycle control in human cells and how these are perturbed in disease states. We also collaborate extensively with researchers from other disciplines, including mathematical modellers, bioinformaticians, chemists and structural biologists to fully explore our research questions. To play a major role in the work of the research group, through the conduct of research, introduction of new ideas, dissemination of research results, support and training of others. To be a focus of expertise on cell cycle entry and it’s study using single-cell imaging and quantitative image analysis. Main duties: Under the general leadership of the Group Leader, to be responsible for all aspects of the research projects, including defining the direction of the work, conducting the research, analysing the data, preparing the work for publication and disseminating the results at meetings. To contribute to laboratory-wide discussions on developments within the laboratory, particularly in the use of new techniques or new equipment. To identify, develop and apply a broad range of techniques to pursue the research objectives including by working in collaboration with others to achieve joint research projects. To keep up to date with developments in the field, proposing or implementing changes of direction as necessary. To prepare the research for publication. To present your work at seminars within the laboratory and at external meetings. To train students, Postdoctoral Scientists and others and undertake the line management of group members where appropriate. To contribute to the MRC’s engagement with the public and in the translation of research findings into improvements in health care. Key responsibilities: The key responsibility is to undertake cutting-edge research, aimed at key questions within the remit of the research group. You will be expected to provide the intellectual energy and independent thinking necessary to deliver the research and to play a major role in shaping the overall aims and success of the group. While some advice will be available from others in the laboratory, you will be expected to have the skill and understanding to be able to act independently in solving problems, many of which may require novel approaches. This will require the integration of different activities to ensure the successful delivery of the research projects. To introduce and apply new techniques across a wide range of disciplines and to have the creativity and initiative to develop novel approaches. To interact effectively with a wide range of staff, students and others to ensure the smooth running of the research group. This will include setting an example in the effective use of resources, training others in methods and use of equipment and taking responsibility for the use of communal facilities. To potentially take on specific responsibilities for managing equipment. To write scientific papers and to present at internal meetings and at conferences . To ensure the research is conducted in accordance with good practice and in compliance with local policies and legal requirements. To recognise opportunities for the creation of intellectual property and to cooperate in patent protection and in exploitation. To identify new equipment which will assist the group programme and to present argued cases for new purchases . To identify opportunities for additional funding and to apply for external grants where appropriate. Where line management responsibilities are undertaken, these responsibilities, including staff development and performance management, should be applied in accordance with the MRC’s policies and procedures. Training will be provided if required Working relationships: You will report to Dr Alexis Barr and will liaise with other Research Support staff, Postdoctoral Scientists and students, not only in your group, but also across the LMS and with external collaborators. Equality & Diversity The MRC values the diverse skills and experience of its employees and is committed to achieving equality of treatment for all. items.desc: Join a team of energy and data professionals to develop new open datasets, data tools, and analysis that journalists and policymakers can trust. The Role Ember is recruiting an energy data analyst to build new datasets on the wider energy system. Our global electricity generation and other datasets are used by media, researchers and policymakers worldwide, and the data team is now expanding into new areas, such as electricity prices, with a focus on electrification. You will build these datasets from the ground up. That means finding and assessing sources as well as building robust, transparent data pipelines. You will also contribute analysis to Ember’s reports. The data you build and analyse feeds directly into published findings, so reliability and quality are key. This role suits someone who enjoys working on difficult data problems in a team environment with the aim of producing datasets other people can trust. We’re looking for someone who can use AI tools to work more effectively, while maintaining a high standard of reliable data. You will take datasets from first idea to publication with the support of experienced analysts and data specialists at Ember. We don’t expect you to know everything, but we’re looking for someone who is motivated to learn, enjoys solving problems, communicates well with colleagues and is keen to develop their skills through hands-on technical experience. About Ember Ember is an independent, not-for-profit energy think tank that aims to accelerate the clean energy transition with data and policy. We gather, curate and analyse data on the power sector and coal mine methane emissions, and use our findings to improve energy and climate policy. See our work at https://ember-energy.org/ and https://x.com/ember_energy Key responsibilities Finding and assessing sources, building data pipelines, validating data and documenting methods to deliver and publish new datasets, as well as maintaining and improving datasets after release Producing data analysis and insights on trends for Ember’s analyses and social content, as well as feeding analysis into Ember’s flagship reports, guided by senior Ember analysts Working with analysts in other teams to help develop and apply new methods across the organisation Contributing to existing data team workstreams, such as updating and maintaining the quality of our electricity generation datasets Helping to inform Ember’s overall data strategy by identifying and proposing new datasets, analysis and research ideas Using AI tools responsibly in pipeline development and analysis, and helping the team develop best practice Location - Remote. Must have the right to work in your country of residence. Requirements Must have Approx 3 years' experience analysing energy data with experience curating and validating data from multiple sources Experience writing Python (or equivalent) code for data pipelines that feed published datasets or data tools Experience producing analysis from energy datasets, gathering insightful findings and communicating them clearly to different audiences. Experience using AI coding tools e.g. opencode, Claude Code or equivalent, through desktop applications or CLI, with a clear approach to checking accuracy and quality control Ability to take initiative, solve problems and contribute to developing new methods Ability to develop within a team environment using tools such as git, and produce shared documentation Ability to work collaboratively, as part of an efficient and enthusiastic team, including giving and receiving feedback on code and analysis Passionate about the global energy transition Ability to communicate complex ideas clearly Fluent in spoken and written English Nice to have Prior work on electricity market or price data Experience creating engaging static or interactive data visualisations Experience with data science for energy applications, such as forecasting, statistical modelling or machine learning Experience working with cloud data solutions (e.g. BigQuery) or SQL databases Experience programmatically collecting data from APIs Languages other than English We are an equal opportunities employer committed to diversity and treating all employees with dignity and respect regardless of background. items.title: BloombergNEF Energy Storage Modeling Analyst (6 Months Contract)
items.card: You will be based in our London offices, working as part of a global research team at BloombergNEF (BNEF) – the world's leading independent provider of analysis, tools, data and research to decision makers leading change in the energy system. Our data-driven research helps clients stay on top of developments across the energy sector, supported by the unique depth and breadth of the Bloomberg Terminal and bnef.com
items.desc: BloombergNEF (BNEF) is seeking a highly quantitative and technically skilled analyst to join our Solar & Energy Storage team for an initial six-month contract. The successful candidate will develop and own quantitative models used to assess battery dispatch, revenues and economics. The candidate will use models to analyze battery storage market opportunities and how they are evolving across global power markets. The rapid deployment of battery storage is changing the way power markets operate. Understanding the value of storage requires increasingly sophisticated modeling of asset operation, electricity prices, market participation and interactions between growing storage capacity and the wider power system. BNEF is a strategic research provider covering global commodity markets and the disruptive technologies driving the transition to a low-carbon economy. Our expert coverage assesses pathways for the power, transport, industry, buildings and agriculture sectors to adapt to the energy transition. We help commodity trading, corporate strategy, finance and policy professionals navigate change and generate opportunities. OUR TEAM: You will be based in our London offices, working as part of a global research team at BloombergNEF (BNEF) – the world's leading independent provider of analysis, tools, data and research to decision makers leading change in the energy system. Our data-driven research helps clients stay on top of developments across the energy sector, supported by the unique depth and breadth of the Bloomberg Terminal and bnef.com platforms. The Solar & Energy Storage team covers the technologies, markets and economics shaping the sector globally. We forecast storage deployment and battery costs, track projects and market activity, assess policy and regulatory developments, and analyze the investment case for storage across different markets and applications. This includes quantitative modelling to understand battery dispatch and revenues, the impact of storage penetration on power markets, and the value of storage across different durations, technologies and market designs. The team translates these dynamics into transparent, data-driven insights for our clients. BNEF TEAM ETHOS: To succeed at BNEF we need people who can work in an independent manner and show initiative to develop their own viewpoints, yet be collaborative with colleagues. We don't rely on the status quo, we look for innovative yet pragmatic thinking that turns big ideas into real insights and impact. Working at BNEF sometimes feels chaotic; we need teams that are both dynamic and structured to generate the unique perspectives our clients really value. Our teams are diverse, creative, focused, and fun! THE ROLE: You will join for an initial six-month contract to lead the development of our in-house energy storage revenue models. You will build, validate and improve tools that optimize the dispatch of standalone and co-located batteries across multiple power markets and revenue streams. As a member of the solar and energy storage team, you will own the development and testing of this model and help your colleagues to blend their subject matter knowledge into the model wherever possible. You will also apply BNEF's models to assess evolving business opportunities in key storage markets. items.card: Vos missions : Concevoir et développer des modèles d’intelligence artificielle et de Machine Learning adaptés aux cas d’usage identifiés. items.desc: Nous recherchons un·e Ingénieur.e IA pour accompagner la conception, le développement et l’optimisation de solutions d’intelligence artificielle et de Machine Learning. Vous interviendrez sur des projets liés à la modélisation, à l’industrialisation des cas d’usage IA et à la mise en production de modèles, en collaboration avec les équipes Data, techniques et métiers. Vous participerez à la structuration des pipelines de données, au développement de modèles IA/ML et à leur déploiement en production. Vous contribuerez également au monitoring, à l’optimisation et à la scalabilité des solutions, tout en veillant au respect des bonnes pratiques de sécurité, de conformité et d’éthique de l’IA. Une expérience de 3 à 5 ans en IA ou Machine Learning en environnement Cloud est attendue, ainsi qu’une excellente maîtrise de Python et des principales librairies ML. La maîtrise courante de l’anglais est requise. Vos missions : Concevoir et développer des modèles d’intelligence artificielle et de Machine Learning adaptés aux cas d’usage identifiés. Structurer les pipelines de données nécessaires à l’entraînement, au déploiement et au suivi des modèles IA. Déployer, monitorer et optimiser les modèles en production afin de garantir leur performance et leur fiabilité. Collaborer avec les équipes Data et métiers pour cadrer les cas d’usage IA et définir les solutions techniques adaptées. Assurer la robustesse, la scalabilité et la sécurité des solutions IA déployées. Documenter les architectures, les modèles, les pipelines et les choix techniques. Mettre en œuvre les bonnes pratiques de conformité, de sécurité et d’éthique liées à l’intelligence artificielle. Contribuer à la veille technologique sur les solutions IA et sensibiliser les équipes métiers aux possibilités et limites de l’IA. Votre profil : Expérience de 3 à 5 ans en intelligence artificielle ou Machine Learning en environnement Cloud. Excellente maîtrise de Python et des principales librairies Machine Learning, notamment TensorFlow, PyTorch et scikit-learn. Expérience confirmée dans la mise en production de modèles IA, au-delà de la phase de POC. Bonne connaissance des pipelines de données, du monitoring de modèles et des pratiques MLOps. Formation supérieure en informatique, Data Science, intelligence artificielle, mathématiques appliquées ou domaine équivalent. Anglais courant à l’écrit comme à l’oral. Capacité à collaborer avec des équipes Data, techniques et métiers dans un environnement agile. Rigueur, esprit d’analyse et capacité à vulgariser les possibilités et limites de l’intelligence artificielle auprès d’interlocuteurs variés. Ce qu'on vous propose : Rejoindre Amaris, ce n’est pas simplement intégrer une entreprise où l’on attend patiemment qu’un poste se libère. C’est intégrer un environnement où vos performances déterminent directement votre évolution de carrière. Concrètement, voici ce que cela signifie pour vous au quotidien : 🎯 Des projets qui ont du fond 18 mois minimum en moyenne, chez des grands comptes (Orange, Sanofi, SNCF, CMA-CGM…) et avec l'appui de nos Centres d'Excellence internes. Vous avez le temps d'aller loin. 🤝 Un accompagnement qui se voit 1 manager pour 18 consultants max, des points projet structurés et un canal direct vers les RH chaque mois via Express Yourself . Nos équipes affichent 3,3 ans d'ancienneté moyenne — preuve qu'on construit quelque chose qui dure. 🚀 Une carrière qui avance vraiment ( 70 % de nos managers ont démarré au premier échelon). Âge moyen : 36 ans. Ici, la confiance précède l'expérience et la méritocratie remplace l'ancienneté. Mobilité fonctionnelle (4 expertises) et géographique (60+ pays) encouragées et accessibles. 💡 L'innovation, en pratique 291 agents IA développés en interne, +250 modules de formation, certifications Microsoft financées à 100 %. Chez Mantu, AI = Artificial Intelligence & Augmented Impact. 🌱 Un engagement RSE qui se mesure SBTi sur la réduction carbone, 32 % de femmes managers (objectif 34,3 % en 2029), engagement social via We Care Together . 👉 Mutuelle, télétravail, tickets restaurant, CET, cooptation… Nous discuterons de l’intégralité de nos avantages lors de nos échanges. Amaris Consulting, part of Mantu, est fière d'être une entreprise qui prône l'égalité des chances. Nous nous engageons à promouvoir la diversité au sein de nos équipes et à créer un environnement de travail inclusif. À cette fin, nous encourageons toutes les candidatures de personnes qualifiées, quels que soient leur genre, leur orientation sexuelle, leur origine ethnique, leurs convictions, leur âge, leur situation familiale, leur handicap ou toute autre caractéristique.

items.desc: Inetum is a European leader in digital services. For businesses, public sector organizations, and society as a whole, the group’s 26,000 consultants and specialists work every day to create tangible digital impact: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation, and the common good. With a presence in 19 countries, working closely with local communities, and alongside its major software developer partners, Inetum supports organizations in their digital transformation challenges with proximity, flexibility, and responsibility. Driven by its purpose, Inetum champions a vision of technology that is useful and well-managed, capable of unlocking the full potential of organizations and society: “Let’s make tech right.” In 2025, the group generated revenue of 2.2 billion euros. More information at: www.inetum.com Job Description As a Data Scientist, you will contribute to the industrialization and European rollout of IRIS, an AI-based platform designed to extract and understand information from business documents. You will be responsible for onboarding new document types and data points, improving extraction quality and supporting the reliable operation of AI analytical components. The role combines data analysis, model development, evaluation, prompt optimization and collaboration with business and technical stakeholders across countries. Key focus areas: · Onboarding of new document types and new data points. · Data extraction solutions and confidence-score mechanisms. · Prompt tuning, model optimization and continuous improvement. · Quality monitoring, performance evaluation and production maintenance. · Country integration support and progressive industrialization of the AI-based platform Qualifications Main responsibilities: Analyze and explore labelled and production data to understand document structures, data quality and extraction behaviour. Perform first-level quality assurance of labelled datasets; identify inconsistencies and coordinate corrections with business stakeholders. Prepare, train, evaluate and improve extraction solutions for new document types and new data points. Build and enhance data-extraction components, including confidence-score calculation and validation. Investigate failed or low-confidence values, identify root causes and update rules, prompts or datasets as appropriate. Calculate and interpret quality metrics for each data point and document type; communicate findings and recommended improvements. Tune and optimize prompts used in OCR, document understanding or GenAI-supported processing. Produce and optimize Python-based analytical models and tools, with attention to scalability, resource usage and maintainability. Ensure that code, datasets, assumptions, evaluation results and operational procedures are clearly documented and production-ready. Support recurring production runs and contribute to automation, monitoring and incident investigation together with the Support Engineer and partner teams. Contribute to country integrations and the onboarding of additional document types, while reusing common components whenever possible. Ensure model outputs are interpretable; identify potential bias, quality limitations and performance gaps in relation to business needs. Ways of working Work within one shared product backlog, one sprint goal and shared ownership across the IRIS Product Squad. Collaborate closely with the CoE AI Core Team, country stakeholders and relevant IT teams, with clear escalation to Level 3 expertise when required. Maintain clear documentation, transparent status reporting and a strong focus on service quality, delivery and continuous improvement What we are looking for: Degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related field. At least 3 years of relevant experience in data science, machine learning, data analytics or intelligent document processing. Hands-on experience developing, evaluating and maintaining data-driven solutions in a production-oriented environment. Experience collaborating with business users, developers, support teams and distributed international stakeholders. Fluency in English; another European language is an advantage. Technical and professional skills Strong Python programming and scripting skills. Sound knowledge of machine learning, statistical analysis, quantitative evaluation and experiment design. Experience with data preparation, labelling quality checks, model evaluation metrics and error analysis. Knowledge of OCR, document AI, information extraction, prompt engineering or GenAI-based processing is a strong advantage. Knowledge of Git, CI/CD practices, Jira or equivalent Agile tools. Experience with SQL, relational databases, ETL processes and BI or visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau is desirable. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, communication, collaboration, adaptability, initiative and delivery focus. Additional Information Benefits: …

items.title: Data Scientist GenAI
items.card: In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to redefine the core operative processes, leveraging ML & GenAI techniques to enhance not only efficiency but, most importantly, the overall effectiveness and quality of outcomes. You’ll collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business leaders to design and deliver AI-driven products that create tangible business value and redefine the future of ops at Prima.
items.desc: Are you looking for a new challenge? Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance? Prima could be the place for you. Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain. We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our AI team focused on bringing ML & Generative AI into the heart of our operations (e.g. claims, underwriting, customer support). In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to redefine the core operative processes, leveraging ML & GenAI techniques to enhance not only efficiency but, most importantly, the overall effectiveness and quality of outcomes. You’ll collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business leaders to design and deliver AI-driven products that create tangible business value and redefine the future of ops at Prima. Excited to make an impact? Here are the details What You’ll Do Leverage Machine Learning and GenAI to solve complex business problems, making our processes better and faster; Analyze and interpret complex data to support decision-making; Contribute directly to Prima’s long-term success and financial impact through concrete solutions. What We’re Looking For Strong academic background in quantitative fields such as Math, Physics, Data Science, or Engineering; All experience levels, including recent graduates with no prior working experience; Strong analytical and quantitative skills; Structured problem solving skills and being able to analyze and break down complex problems; Curiosity, proactivity, quick learning and an innovative mindset. Nice-to-Have Hands-on experience with Python and coding best practices; Experience with machine learning and Generative AI (openAI/Gemini APIs, agentic frameworks, …) Business proficiency in Italian or Spanish, in addition to English. €45,000 - €65,000 a year Why you’ll love it here We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.. 🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year. 🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you. 🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. items.desc: We are looking for a Data Scientist / AI Engineer to contribute to the development, optimization and continuous improvement of AI-driven solutions, with a particular focus on document processing, data extraction and intelligent automation. In this role, you will work on designing, developing and evaluating machine learning models and data extraction solutions, improving their accuracy, reliability and performance. You will collaborate with both technical and business stakeholders to understand requirements, analyze data, identify improvement opportunities and deliver scalable, production-ready solutions. The role combines data analysis, model development, evaluation, prompt engineering and continuous performance optimization. Analyze and explore labelled and production data to understand data structures, quality issues and model behaviour. Perform quality checks on labelled datasets, identify inconsistencies and coordinate necessary corrections. Develop, train, evaluate and optimize machine learning models and data extraction solutions. Design and enhance data extraction components, including confidence scoring and validation mechanisms. Investigate incorrect or low-confidence predictions, identify root causes and implement appropriate improvements. Define, calculate and interpret model performance metrics, including accuracy and other relevant quality indicators. Optimize prompts and improve AI-powered solutions, including OCR, document understanding and Generative AI applications. Develop and maintain Python-based analytical models, scripts and tools, ensuring scalability, efficiency and maintainability. Monitor model performance and contribute to continuous improvement, production support and issue resolution. Support the integration of new data sources, document types and business requirements into existing AI solutions. Ensure that code, datasets, assumptions, evaluation results and technical processes are properly documented. Assess model interpretability, identify potential biases and highlight performance limitations. Collaborate with cross-functional and international teams, contributing to knowledge sharing and best practices. Actively participate in Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, code reviews and continuous improvement activities. At least 3 years of relevant experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Analytics or AI Engineering. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Experience collaborating with technical teams, business stakeholders and distributed teams. Fluency in English; knowledge of additional languages is an advantage. Technical Skills Strong programming and scripting skills in Python. Good understanding of Machine Learning, statistical analysis, quantitative evaluation and experimental design. Experience with data preparation, data quality assessment, model evaluation metrics and error analysis. Knowledge of OCR, Intelligent Document Processing, information extraction and document understanding. Familiarity with Prompt Engineering and Generative AI technologies. Experience with Git, version control and CI/CD practices. Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools such as Jira. Knowledge of SQL, relational databases and ETL processes. Experience with data visualization and BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau is a plus. Competitive salary and the opportunity to have a meaningful job where you can make a difference The chance to continuously evolve as a professional Medical insurance & Meal tickets.
