items.desc: About Introw Since early 2023, Introw has become the #1 AI-native, CRM-native partner management platform. We grow 4 to 5x year over year and work with companies like Adyen, Aikido and Factorial. Partnerships are how B2B companies sell through other companies: resellers, referral partners, distributors and implementers. For most of them, partners are the best-performing channel. Introw runs that channel inside HubSpot and Salesforce. Partners work where they already are: their own CRM, Slack, Teams, email, or AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT. We raised $3M led by Visionaries VC, we serve hundreds of companies worldwide, and we hold a 5.0 rating across 100s of reviews. ShareGate went live with 3,000 partners in under 10 weeks. Ringover took partner activity from 20% to 70%. Tensis grew partner-sourced revenue by 400%. Why this role matters AI is already part of how vendors and partners work with Introw: AI assistants. Vendors and partners work with Introw from Claude and ChatGPT over our MCP server. Agents in production. Our agents register deals, answer partners and update the CRM, taking scoped actions with a human in the loop. Where partners already are. Slack, Teams and email, next to their own CRM. You own that layer. As our AI engineer, you maintain and build out Introw's AI and MCP capabilities: the MCP server, the agents and everything that proves they work. This is not a research role and not prompt tinkering. You ship production AI and you own it after it ships. How we work Product, design and engineering are one job. You talk to a customer in the morning, prototype in the afternoon and ship that week. No manager layer. You own the function end to end, with every resource and all the freedom you need. Craft is the point. We make a complex product look simple, and we sweat the details. Everyone owns a piece. Every Intrower is in the ESOP. When we win, you win. Location Ghent, Belgium, from our office in the city center. Mostly in person, with a day or two of flexibility. What you'll do Own Introw's MCP server: the tools, auth and permissions that let vendors and partners work with Introw from Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants. Build and maintain our agents that register deals, answer partners and update the CRM. Scoped actions, humans in the loop, never more access than the user has. Make AI reliable: evals, tracing and monitoring, so you know an agent is wrong before a customer does. Keep it safe and enterprise-grade: customer data stays where it belongs. Follow the model and protocol landscape closely and decide what is worth adopting, and what is not. Talk to customers and partners, look at how they use our AI, and shape where agents go next together with our CPO and CTO. Use agentic coding tools every day to do in a day what used to take a week. Who you are You're an A-player who wants your fingerprints on how B2B companies will sell together with AI. The following should be how your friends describe you: Experienced. You have shipped LLM-powered features to production that real users depend on, and you have a strong track record building scalable, robust systems in TypeScript (NextJS a plus). Most strong fits have 4+ years of engineering experience, but the bar matters more than the number. Deep in AI. Tool calling, MCP, agent frameworks, retrieval and evals are your daily work. You know where models fail and design around it. An owner. You take a capability end to end and stay accountable for it in production: you spot the problem, fix it and make sure it does not come back. Pragmatic. You'd rather ship ten small improvements than write one big spec, and you pick the simplest thing that works. Excellent written English. Dutch or French is a plus. Nice to have You have built or contributed to an MCP server. Experience with HubSpot or Salesforce APIs, OAuth and permission models. Experience in a fast-growing B2B SaaS startup. Benefits Equity through our ESOP. A MacBook Pro and iPhone, fully set up for you. Fully paid phone subscription. Healthcare plan. Mobility budget. Meal vouchers. Introw merch. Regular team drinks and events, plus travel to industry events. Ready to own AI at a category leader? Send us your CV and one AI feature or MCP integration you shipped that you are proud of, plus what you would change about it today. We reply to everyone. Contact: Laurens Lavaert, CTO, on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/laurens-lavaert-2530917a/ What to expect: a quick intro call, a technical deep dive on your past work, a short hands-on exercise on our codebase, and time with the team.

items.desc: Job Title: AI Engineer Entity: Aventum Group Department: Technology Location: London This isn’t a job description. It’s your invitation. At Aventum Group, we don’t hire to fill seats. We bring people in to build something real. We want people to join us (that person might be you) on our mission to be the world’s most inspiring insurance group, not by playing it safe but by delivering the unexpected and creating meaningful impact. That means backing ideas early, trusting people to own their work and giving them the space to grow faster than they thought possible. If you’re looking for rigid career paths or a one-size-fits-all management, Aventum Group probably isn’t for you. However, if you do want responsibility from day one, honest feedback and a culture that expects you to speak up, take ownership and keep getting better, then you might just be a great fit. Some people join us knowing exactly where they want to go. Others figure it out once they’re here. Both work here - the question is, will you? What You’ll Take On (The Actual Job Description) So you’re looking for a new challenge? This is your chance to step into a role with real responsibility. You’ll be given the space to own your work, supported to move as fast as you want and expected to keep raising the bar for yourself and the business. AI Engineer – Behavioural & Decision Systems. This is a hands‑on engineering role for someone who wants their models to matter. You’ll take advanced behavioural and decision‑based AI and turn it into production systems that sit at the core of live digital products. Your work will shape how our platforms predict behaviour, make decisions and adapt in real time, powering Digital Twins, agentic systems and intelligent automation across the business. You’ll operate at the point where modelling meets delivery, with real ownership from data through to live impact. What you’ll do Turn behavioural and sequential models into production‑grade systems that directly influence real decisions and outcomes. Own end‑to‑end AI pipelines, from raw data to monitored, reliable inference in live products. Embed causal thinking into how we evaluate impact, helping teams understand what actually changes behaviour and why. Build AI services that integrate cleanly into existing platforms, shaping APIs, events and decision flows alongside engineers. Bring behavioural dynamics to life in Digital Twins and agentic systems, making complex decision processes observable and actionable. This role is built for someone who backs themselves, takes ownership and wants to see their work used not parked in notebooks. If you’re motivated by pace, accountability and the chance to build systems that genuinely change how products behave, you’ll feel at home here. What it’s Like to Work Here Expect high standards - and the support to meet them. Expect autonomy (not micromanagement) and the chance to collaborate across teams, brands and borders. Here, your ideas are taken seriously, wherever you sit in the business. We invest when the right tools don’t exist. We listen when our people say something can be better. And when we win, we make sure the people building the business win too. This is a place where performance matters - but so does enjoyment, curiosity and doing work you are proud of. Who Thrives at Aventum Group? We don’t expect you to tick every box. Experience helps, but curiosity matters more. If you are willing to learn, take ownership and ask questions when you don’t know the answer, you’re already off to a great start. We look for people who: Have experience relevant to the role, whether from a similar position, education or transferable skills Confidence in communicating with others and working together A mindset focused on learning, improvement and follow-through An interest in how things work (and how they could be improved) If this sounds like you, you sound ready for a new chapter of challenge at Aventum Group. Why Apply Because you want more than a job title. Because you want to grow, not wait your turn. Because you want to be trusted to do good work (and get recognised when you do it). And because you want to help build something inspiring, unexpected and meaningful. So… challenge accepted?

items.desc: Retour à la liste des résultats Présentation INRAE L’Institut national de recherche pour l’agriculture, l’alimentation et l’environnement (INRAE) est un établissement public de recherche rassemblant une communauté de travail de 12 000 personnes, avec 272 unités de recherche, de service et expérimentales, implantées dans 18 centres sur toute la France. INRAE se positionne parmi les tout premiers leaders mondiaux en sciences agricoles et alimentaires, en sciences du végétal et de l’animal. Ses recherches visent à construire des solutions pour des agricultures multi-performantes, une alimentation de qualité et une gestion durable des ressources et des écosystèmes. Environnement de travail, missions et activités Contexte La conversion biotechnologique de la biomasse lignocellulosique (BL) en bioproduits constitue une voie prometteuse pour le développement d’une bioéconomie durable. Dans ce contexte, l’hydrolyse enzymatique, également appelée saccharification, représente une étape clé du processus de conversion. L’un des principaux défis pour améliorer les rendements de saccharification consiste à comprendre et à surmonter la résistance intrinsèque de la biomasse lignocellulosique à la déconstruction, appelée récalcitrance, qui contribue à augmenter les coûts de production des bioproduits. Alors que de nombreux efforts de recherche ont permis d’identifier divers marqueurs de récalcitrance à l'échelle nanométrique, la pertinence et l'importance de l'étude quantitative de l'hydrolyse enzymatique à des échelles plus grandes, cellulaires et tissulaires, n’ont été démontrées que récemment. En particulier, le laboratoire FARE a développé des pipelines d'imagerie 4D (espace + temps) combinant la microscopie confocale de fluorescence et des outils innovants de traitement d'images pour suivre et quantifier la déconstruction de la paroi cellulaire à ces échelles. Un des principaux défis de l’analyse quantitative de la déconstruction de la BL, à partir d’images de microscopie 4D, est la segmentation précise et le suivi des cellules individuelles, notamment à cause de la perte de l’intégrité des parois cellulaires au cours de ce procédé. Ces dernières années, le Deep Learning (DL) a surpassé les techniques conventionnelles de traitement d'images dans des tâches telles que la segmentation et le suivi d'objets. Cela est en particulier dû au fait que les approches traditionnelles de segmentation d'images nécessitent un réglage des paramètres spécifiques à l'expérience, tandis que les modèles de DL sont adaptatifs et entraînables. Forts de ce constat, nous proposons d’utiliser des modèles de DL à l’aide de Réseaux de Neurones Convolutifs (CNN), pour les étapes de segmentation et de suivi des cellules. Mission du stagiaire L’objectif est de capitaliser les séquences obtenues à partir des images 3D acquises à différents temps de l’hydrolyse enzymatique, pour chacun des échantillons de BL analysés. Un pipeline de segmentation des cellules de BL basé sur le modèle PyTorch 3D U-Net de (Wolny 2020) a été développé et entraîné au sein de notre équipe. La précision des segmentations prédites par ce pipeline a été vérifiée sur les images pré-hydrolyse de biomasses de peuplier (Faraj 2026). Cependant, l’utilisation de modèles basés sur le DL pour l’analyse d’images au cours de l’hydrolyse enzymatique fait face à la même difficulté que les algorithmes classiques : les cellules ne peuvent pas être clairement séparées à cause de la déconstruction des tissus végétaux de la BL. La mission de la personne recrutée consiste à implémenter un pipeline basé sur le DL, pour la segmentation d’images 4D, qui conserve sa pertinence au cours de l’hydrolyse enzymatique. Dans ce contexte, une stratégie consiste à propager la segmentation pré-hydrolyse enzymatique au cours du temps en utilisant les transformations qui permettent de recaler l’image brute initiale sur l’image brute à un temps donné de l’hydrolyse enzymatique (Hossein Khani 2026). Alors que des algorithmes de recalage classiques (non DL) sont utilisés dans (Hossein Khani 2026), nous proposons d’utiliser des algorithmes basés sur le DL pour l’étape de recalage également (Balakrishnan 2019). Bien qu’encourageants, nos premiers essais dans cette direction montrent qu’une marge d’amélioration est possible. Le premier objectif du stage portera sur l’écriture des scripts nécessaires à l’entraînement et l’inférence du modèle de DL de recalage d’images. Cela inclut, la préparation des données et l’évaluation de la qualité des recalages prédits. Le second objectif porte sur l’amélioration de la stratégie d’entraînement du modèle via, notamment, un agrandissement du jeu de données d’entraînement et une optimisation des hyperparamètres du modèle. Pour cela, le stage bénéficiera des ressources de calcul du supercalculateur ROMEO. Selon le niveau d’avancement du stage, d’autres objectifs pourront être considérés comme le développement « from scratch » d’un modèle de DL pour le recalage d’images et/ou …

items.card: Vos Missions Sont Analysez les avancées de l’IA neuromorphique et évaluez leur maturité pour les applications spatiales, Identifiez et caractérisez les cas d’usage à fort potentiel pour les systèmes spatiaux, Développez des démonstrateurs logiciels et explorez leur déploiement sur des architectures de calcul embarquées, Comparez les performances des approches neuromorphiques et des architectures d’IA
items.desc: Chez Thales, nous sommes fiers de travailler ensemble pour imaginer des solutions innovantes qui contribuent à construire un avenir plus sûr, plus vert et plus inclusif. Un avenir de confiance. Mais ces technologies ne viennent pas de nulle part. L'intelligence humaine est le moteur derrière la technologie qui fait la renommée de Thales. Les projets que nous conduisons sont complexes et nos clients exigeants. Pour répondre aux besoins actuels et futurs de nos clients, nous maîtrisons plus d’une centaine de disciplines, de l’optique à la physique quantique, du traitement du signal à la connectivité et à l’intelligence artificielle. Rejoindre Thales, c’est repousser les limites de la technologie et la mettre au service du progrès et du développement durable de nos sociétés. C’est donc être au cœur d’une formidable aventure technique. Une attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs au service de leur réussite. C’est pourquoi, notamment, nous nous efforçons de créer un environnement de travail accueillant et d’accorder la flexibilité nécessaire à l’équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. Nous savons que cet équilibre est essentiel à votre épanouissement et à la réussite des projets que nous vous confierons. Des parcours professionnels riches. Chez Thales, nous jouons collectif. Ce qui signifie travailler en équipe, côtoyer des experts et donc apprendre et développer ses compétences en permanence tout en faisant bénéficier le Groupe de son savoir-faire. C’est aussi la possibilité d’évoluer, de changer de fonction ou d’activité, voire de pays. Lieu : Toulouse, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Notre savoir-faire technologique Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…) Votre quotidien Le site de Toulouse Champollion regroupe les activités de l’ingénierie de systèmes satellites, de la conception et réalisation de charges utiles, et du développement et qualification de segments sol. Il intègre également un centre de recherche et un accélérateur industriel de start-up et ventures, ainsi que les activités relevant de la science des très basses températures, avec le développement et la production de refroidisseurs micromécaniques pour des marchés exigeants. Au sein de la Direction Technique de Thales Alenia Space, vous contribuez aux activités de R&D menées autour de l’intelligence artificielle pour les applications spatiales. Dans un contexte de forte évolution des technologies d’IA, vous participez à l’évaluation du potentiel des approches neuromorphiques et de leur intérêt pour les futurs systèmes spatiaux. Vous intervenez sur des sujets associant recherche, expérimentation et analyse de performances afin d’orienter les futurs axes de développement de l’entreprise. En Nous Rejoignant, Vos Missions Sont Analysez les avancées de l’IA neuromorphique et évaluez leur maturité pour les applications spatiales, Identifiez et caractérisez les cas d’usage à fort potentiel pour les systèmes spatiaux, Développez des démonstrateurs logiciels et explorez leur déploiement sur des architectures de calcul embarquées, Comparez les performances des approches neuromorphiques et des architectures d’IA conventionnelles, Proposez des recommandations et des orientations R&D pour les applications spatiales de demain. Votre profil Vous souhaitez effectuer un stage d'une durée de 6 mois? Vous Effectuez Une Formation De Niveau Bac+5 En École D’ingénieurs Ou Formation Universitaire, à Dominante Intelligence Artificielle Et Vous Avez Des Compétences Sur Les fondamentaux de l’intelligence artificielle et du machine learning, Le développement en Python, Les frameworks d’IA tels que PyTorch, TensorFlow ou équivalent, L’analyse scientifique et l’expérimentation, Bonne communication, travail en équipe, autonomie et esprit d’initiative sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnaît ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études. Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc: Wil jij als AI / Cloud Developer werken aan innovatieve cloudoplossingen en bijdragen aan de toekomst van AI-first softwareontwikkeling? Voor een ambitieuze en innovatieve IT-organisatie in de regio Amersfoort zoeken we een gedreven AI / Cloud Developer met ervaring in C# en .NET 10+ die graag verder kijkt dan alleen code schrijven. Je krijgt de kans om te werken met moderne cloudtechnologie, AI-tools en agentic engineering. Geen traditionele ontwikkelomgeving waarin je alleen bestaande functionaliteiten onderhoudt, maar een plek waar innovatie, experimenteren en technische ontwikkeling centraal staan. De organisatie ontwikkelt moderne softwareoplossingen op het gebied van data-integratie en geografische informatietechnologie. Binnen een ambitieus R&D-team wordt gewerkt aan de verdere modernisering van cloudapplicaties en de overgang naar een volledig AI-first ontwikkelproces. Wat maakt deze AI / Cloud Developer rol interessant? Je komt terecht in een technisch gedreven R&D-team waar innovatie en eigen initiatief centraal staan. Je krijgt de ruimte om nieuwe technologieën te onderzoeken, AI actief toe te passen binnen het ontwikkelproces en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van softwareontwikkeling. Een belangrijk onderdeel van de technische ambitie is het opzetten van een team van AI-agents die verschillende ontwikkeltaken zelfstandig kunnen uitvoeren. Je denkt mee over hoe deze agents worden ingericht, welke taken ze kunnen overnemen en hoe kwaliteit, security en menselijke controle worden gewaarborgd. Daarnaast krijg je de mogelijkheid om bij te dragen aan architectuurkeuzes, cloudmodernisering en de verdere ontwikkeling van het platform. Je werkt samen met ervaren collega's, deelt kennis en helpt het team continu verbeteren. Wat ga je doen als AI / Cloud Developer? Als AI / Cloud Developer werk je aan de verdere ontwikkeling en innovatie van moderne cloudapplicaties. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Ontwikkelen, moderniseren en innoveren van cloud-native softwareoplossingen; Bouwen van backendfunctionaliteiten met C# en .NET 10+; Ontwikkelen van frontend- en backendoplossingen voor web- en cloudapplicaties; Inzetten van AI-tools zoals GitHub Copilot en Claude tijdens analyse, ontwerp, implementatie, testen en documentatie; Ontwerpen en realiseren van use-cases voor een team van AI-agents; Experimenteren met agentic engineering en het automatiseren van ontwikkeltaken; Vertalen van user stories naar technische oplossingen binnen de bestaande architectuur; Meedenken over softwarearchitectuur, technische keuzes en cloudmodernisering; Werken met Azure Kubernetes, containers, API's en deployment; Schrijven van hoogwaardige, testbare en veilige code; Uitvoeren van code reviews en controleren van AI-gegenereerde code; Bewaken van softwarekwaliteit, security en privacy; Samenwerken binnen een Agile DevOps-team en kennis delen met collega's. Je bent dus niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen van software, maar speelt ook een actieve rol in het verbeteren van de manier waarop software wordt ontworpen, ontwikkeld en onderhouden met behulp van AI. Wat zoeken we? Je hebt minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar of beschikt over vergelijkbare competenties en hebt een sterke interesse in cloudtechnologie en AI. Je beschikt over: Goede kennis van C# en .NET 10+; Ervaring met zowel frontend- als backendontwikkeling voor web- en cloudapplicaties; Ervaring met of sterke affiniteit voor AI-first softwareontwikkeling; Ervaring met GitHub Copilot en bij voorkeur Claude; Kennis van cloud-native development en bij voorkeur Azure Kubernetes; Begrip van containers, API's en deploymentprocessen; Goede kennis van softwarekwaliteit, security en testbaarheid; Ervaring met code reviews en secure coding; Een sterk analytisch en probleemoplossend vermogen; Een zelfstandige, proactieve en leergierige werkhouding; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en de bereidheid om kennis te delen. Daarnaast is het een pré als je beschikt over: Ervaring met relationele databases zoals Oracle en/of PostgreSQL; Kennis en ervaring met React; Ervaring met SonarQube; Affiniteit met geo/GIS-technologie; Ervaring met Scrum en/of DevOps; Bereidheid om eventueel Scrum Master-taken op je te nemen. Een hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau is gewenst. Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal is belangrijk. We zoeken iemand die niet alleen weet hoe software werkt, maar ook nieuwsgierig is naar hoe AI het ontwikkelproces kan verbeteren. Je experimenteert, stelt kritische vragen en begrijpt dat AI-output altijd gecontroleerd en gevalideerd moet worden. Je neemt initiatief, denkt mee over technische oplossingen en vindt het leuk om samen met collega's nieuwe mogelijkheden te ontdekken. De technische stack Backend: C#, .NET 10+ Frontend: Frontend- en backendontwikkeling, React AI: GitHub Copilot, Claude, AI-agents en agentic engineering Cloud: Azure, Azure Kubernetes Data: Oracle, PostgreSQL Quality & Security: SonarQube, secure coding, code reviews …

Je krijgt de kans om je kennis van data, AI en softwareontwikkeling toe te passen in een professionele en innovatieve omgeving. Daarbij werk je mee aan concrete uitdagingen rond artificiële intelligentie, dataplatformen en digitale oplossingen. Je leert hoe nieuwe technologieën worden ingezet binnen een industriële context en krijgt de ruimte om jezelf zowel technisch als persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen. De stage is opgebouwd rond twee verdiepende onderzoekssporen: LLM Integratie op Databricks (voorbereiding Talk to Your Data): Verkennen hoe Large Language Models geïntegreerd kunnen worden binnen een Databricks-omgeving Onderzoeken hoe databronnen (tabellen, rapportages, operationele data) ontsloten kunnen worden voor een conversationele AI-ervaring Vergelijken van verschillende LLM-modellen op vlak van performantie, kostprijs en toepasbaarheid binnen BASF-context Bouwen van een eenvoudige proof-of-concept waarbij een gebruiker vragen kan stellen aan data via een Python Dash-interface AI Agents & Automatisatie (voorbereiding Agentic DevOps) Verkennen van agentic AI-frameworks en hun toepasbaarheid binnen BASF infrastructuur Onderzoeken hoe AI Agents ingezet kunnen worden voor automatisatie van data science processen Identificeren van guard rails, veiligheidsmechanismen en best practices voor betrouwbare AI-agent implementaties in een professionele omgeving Opstellen van een architectuurvoorstel ONZE IDEALE MATCH Je zit in je 3e bachelor of 1e master in Artificiële Intelligentie, Computerwetenschappen, Wiskundige Ingenieurstechnieken, Electrical Engineering (afstudeerrichting Communication and Information Technology) Je beschikt over een goede basiskennis van Python. Je hebt interesse in of ervaring met LLMs en generatieve AI Je hebt affiniteit met cloud-en dataplatformen (Azure/Databricks is een pluspunt) Je hebt basiskennis van API-integraties WAT HEBBEN WE VOOR JOU IN PETTO? Een mentor die jou begeleidt van A tot Z, met aandacht voor jouw interesses. Een kwalitatieve stageplaats waar je volop kunt leren en groeien. We garanderen dat je veel zult opsteken tijdens je stage bij ons! Zo draait onze productiesite volledig op groene stroom en investeren we in oplossingen om onze uitstoot van morgen te neutraliseren. Met meer dan 3.000 collega's met verschillende achtergronden, bieden we een inspirerende werkomgeving waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn en talenten maximaal kunnen ontwikkelen. Voel je de chemie? Grijp je kans en solliciteer vandaag nog. We kijken ernaar uit om jou te verwelkomen in ons team! #destrafsteproductiesite

items.desc: WELKOM Welkom bij BASF Antwerpen, waar we vol energie werken aan een duurzame toekomst! Ben je op zoek naar een stageplaats waar je kunt bijdragen aan een concreet project in een hecht team? Dan ben je bij ons aan het juiste adres. JOUW UITDAGING Tijdens deze stage bouw je mee aan een digitaal informatiemodel voor een industriële installatie. Je brengt technische informatie uit P&ID’s, HAZOP’s, equipmentdata, instrumentatie en DCS/PLC-logica samen in een Semantic Data Model en Industrial Knowledge Graph. Je modelleert assets, tags, functies, eigenschappen en relaties over de volledige levenscyclus van de installatie. Op basis hiervan ontwikkel je één of meerdere AI-agenten en onderzoek je de mogelijkheden voor een trainings- en simulatiemodel. Het resultaat is een demonstrator die verspreide engineeringinformatie omzet in een verbonden, intelligente en AI-ready kennisomgeving. Je werkt samen met ingenieurs en technische experten aan de analyse, structurering en modellering van industriële informatie. Je helpt engineeringbronnen te koppelen aan de Knowledge Graph en selecteert relevante toepassingen voor AI-agenten en simulatie. Vervolgens ontwikkel en test je één of meerdere prototypes met realistische technische data. Je documenteert je aanpak en resultaten en formuleert aanbevelingen voor verdere ontwikkeling. Afhankelijk van je profiel kan de focus liggen op data-engineering, automatisatie, AI, softwareontwikkeling, procesengineering of simulatie. items.desc: Ripjar builds software and data products that help our customers combat serious financial crime. Our technology identifies criminal activity such as money laundering and terrorist financing, and helps customers enforce sanctions at scale. Data is at the heart of everything we do. Much of it is multilingual text: an archive of over 10 billion news articles in 150+ languages, going back more than 30 years, alongside government sanctions, watchlist data and ownership data on 250 million organisations from corporate registries worldwide. Working at this scale means our problems are as much computational as statistical. Comparing hundreds of millions of entities, or running models over billions of documents, is intractable without the right algorithms, so careful thinking about complexity and efficient implementation is part of the job. Data Science Team Our data science team builds and maintains the models behind Ripjar's screening product. Much of the work is NLP, including named entity recognition, risk classification, entity resolution, duplicate detection, summarisation and geolocation, and we're increasingly using LLMs to push this further. The team sits within Engineering and works in short cycles, shipping improvements regularly and measuring their impact. Because our customers operate in heavily regulated environments, our models face a high level of scrutiny, so every change needs to be well tested, explainable and backed by evidence. This is a great time to join a growing team of talented technologists and data scientists building products that change how financial crime is detected and prevented. We're keen to hear from experienced data scientists at a range of levels, and the scope of the role will reflect what you bring. What you'll be doing: We're looking for an experienced Data Scientist who is motivated to solve customer problems and enjoys owning them end to end, from: Framing the problem and exploring the data Building and evaluating models Deploying, scaling and maintaining the solution in production You will work with language models, machine learning tools and large-scale distributed clusters. This role suits a data scientist with a strength in NLP and a genuine interest in computing: someone who thinks about algorithmic complexity, memory and throughput as naturally as model accuracy. You'll enjoy shipping a model that adds real value quickly and iterating on it based on real-world feedback. Ripjar equips staff with the very best AI tooling to help them work effectively via judicious review. Some recent work Ripjar's data scientists have been involved in: Entity resolution across tens of millions of news articles, at a scale where naive pairwise comparison is intractable Using LLMs to summarise news articles linking an entity to financial crime (or other similar risks), with LLM judges to monitor performance Using LLMs to run automated quality assurance on our data outputs at scale Key Tasks: Analyse large datasets using Ripjar's distributed data processing infrastructure to identify patterns and inform new analytics and models. Develop and evaluate machine learning models, including LLM-based approaches, to enhance Ripjar's products Design algorithms and pipelines that stay tractable at scale, making sensible trade-offs between accuracy, latency and compute cost. Work with Data Engineers and the wider engineering team to integrate models into our products and pipelines, then own their performance, efficiency and maintenance in production Design statistical tests, evaluate results, and document models and methodologies to the standard our regulated customers expect Work with Product and, from time to time, directly with customers to understand their needs, explain analytics, models and test results, and help resolve questions about how our models behave in practice Requirements Experience delivering data science solutions end to end, from prototype to production, including testing, deployment and long-term maintenance. Strong computer science fundamentals: algorithms, data structures and computational complexity, and how to apply them to make large-scale problems tractable. Proficiency in Python and writing production-quality, performant code, particularly with machine learning and data science libraries such as PyTorch, scikit-learn, numpy and scipy Proficiency using Natural Language Processing techniques to solve problems, ideally including Large Language Models Working knowledge of statistics Experience working with large-scale data processing systems such as Spark and Hadoop Good communication and interpersonal skills Keen to use AI-assisted coding tools (e.g. Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to speed up development and experimentation A habit of keeping up to date with developments in AI, including ML, NLP and LLMs, and judging which new techniques and tools are worth applying to real problems Cloud-based experience is desirable Experience using or implementing MLOps approaches is …

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a Delivery Consultant specialising in AI/ML and Agentic AI to join our Data & AI practice. In this role, you will lead the technical direction and delivery of complex enterprise AI engagements, working across multiple workstreams and helping customers establish repeatable capabilities for adopting AI responsibly at scale.

You will move between strategic and implementation detail: shaping solutions and delivery roadmaps around customer use cases with senior stakeholders, making architecture and engineering trade-offs, reviewing code and evaluation evidence, and removing technical blockers for delivery teams. You will operate effectively when requirements are incomplete, making evidence-based recommendations and creating clarity for customer, AWS, and partner teams.
Beyond individual solutions, you will help customers address the wider conditions required for sustained value from AI, including data readiness, platform architecture, security, governance, operating models, adoption, and value measurement. The AWS Professional Services organisation is a global team of experts that helps customers realise their desired business outcomes using AWS. We work with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud and AI transformation initiatives.
Key job responsibilities
 - Translate customer use cases and business objectives into well-scoped AI solutions with measurable success criteria, technical requirements, and an iterative delivery plan.
- Design and implement production AI solutions on AWS, including the application, data, integration, security, and operational components required to run them reliably.
- Select and evaluate appropriate AI approaches, which may include traditional ML, large language models, retrieval, model adaptation (fine tuning, continuous pre-training), tool use, or agentic workflows.
- Establish evaluation and responsible AI controls covering solution quality, safety, privacy, security, latency, reliability, and cost.
- Diagnose technical issues across models, applications, data, and infrastructure, and communicate trade-offs clearly to customer stakeholders.
- Work with customer and partner teams to integrate solutions into existing workflows and complete documentation, knowledge transfer, and operational handover.
- Use AI-assisted development practices, and contribute reusable assets and lessons to the Data & AI practice.
A day in the life
A typical day may include working with a customer team to turn an agreed use case into a detailed solution design and delivery backlog. You might review evaluation results from an AI application, investigate a quality, security, latency, or cost issue, and implement and test an improvement. Later, you may run a technical workshop to resolve data or integration constraints, pair with a customer engineer on code, or review an architecture decision with security and platform teams. You will regularly communicate progress, risks, and technical trade-offs to business and technical stakeholders. As delivery moves towards production, you will help establish monitoring and operational processes, complete documentation and knowledge transfer, and ensure the customer team can operate and extend the solution after the engagement.

items.desc:
Mission
 At the Laboratory for Quantum Magnetism (LQM) we perform fundamental research in magnetism and correlated electron materials. Our core activities span from synthesis of novel materials over in-house experimental techniques in combination with low temperature, high pressures and high magnetic fields, neutron and X-ray scattering to theory and modeling. The LQM is part of the École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL), a world-renowned research and education center, offering an ideal academic environment as well as an excellent connection to industry. 
 The available PhD position is centered around microwave spectroscopy of rare-earth quantum magnets, with a focus on entanglement between electronic and nuclear degrees of freedom, transitions between electro-nuclear states driven by external magnetic field, and how the occupancy of those states can be manipulated by external perturbations. Examples of published work can be found in Scientific Reports and Physical Review B . Alongside the above-mentioned experimental technique, our laboratory, and EPFL, offers state-of-the-art laboratories and equipment to facilitate the research. The project will be supervised by Prof. Henrik Rønnow and Dr. Ivica Živković. 
 Main duties and responsibilities
 As a PhD Student, you will be expected to: 
 Take responsibility for the development and completion of your doctoral research project 
 Make regular visits to large-scale facilities for Neutron, X-ray and Muon-based experiments. 
 Experiment design and execution 
 Analyze and interpret experimental results 
 Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals 
 Present at international conferences 
 Supervise student projects and basic administrative support 
 Contribute to teaching 
 Profile
 We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with a Master’s degree in Physics or a related field. The successful candidate should have a strong background in solid-state physics and quantum mechanics, excellent communication skills in English (spoken and written), and a willingness to learn and engage in challenging research. 
 We offer
 A challenging and exciting PhD project in experimental quantum magnetism, supervised by Dr. Ivica Živković and Prof. Henrik M. Rønnow. 
 Access to state-of-the-art experimental facilities for microwave spectroscopy of rare-earth quantum magnets. 
 Opportunities to perform measurements under low-temperature and high-magnetic-field conditions. 
 A stimulating and collaborative research environment within the Laboratory for Quantum Magnetism and the broader EPFL community. 
 Opportunities to present your research at international conferences and develop collaborations within the quantum magnetism community. 
 Informations
 Applications should include grade transcript, CV, motivation letter and three contact persons for references. For any further information, please contact Dr. Ivica Živković ( ivica.zivkovic@epfl.ch ). We encourage applications from candidates of all genders and diverse cultural and personal backgrounds . 
 The selected PhD student will need to enroll in the physics program of the EPFL doctoral school. After one year of successful probation, the initial contract will be extended up to a total of four years. Doctoral school information and employment conditions at EPFL are described at: 
 https://www.epfl.ch/education/phd/programs/edpy-physics 
 https://www.epfl.ch/education/phd/doctoral-studies-structure/doctoral-students-salary 
 https://www.epfl.ch/about/working/working-at-epfl/employment-conditions

items.desc:
Mission 
 The Nanolab at EPFL is offering a PhD position on the development of a biosensor for cardiac troponin I (cTnI), the reference biomarker for diagnosing myocardian infarction.
 Cardiac troponin I is released into the circulation within hours of damage to the heart muscle. Clinical decisions depend on detecting it at very low concentrations (single-digit to tens of pg/mL) and on tracking how it changes over time. Current high-sensitivity assays need central laboratory analysers. The project aims to bring this performance to a compact, miniaturized sensor.
 You will join a small team, working side by side with a colleague who brings a life science background. The sensor type, biorecognition layer, and general transduction method remain largely open.
 Tasks 
 Explore and compare sensor types
 Design and fabricate sensors in the EPFL Center of MicroNanoTechnology (CMi) cleanroom
 Characterize the sensors in depth: physical (SEM, profilometry, etc..) and electrical (EIS with equivalent circuit modeling, capacitance, analysis of noise and drift, etc...)
 Develop of the bio-recognition interface
 Engineer the transduction method
 Communicate project outcomes with publications in peer-reviewed journals and presentation at conferences
 Teach EPFL students and contribute to semester and master projects supervision.
 Profile 
 Required Qualifications 
 A master's degree in microengineering, electrical engineering, materials science, physics, bioengineering, or a related field.
 A strong background in device characterization: electrical measurements and ideally electrochemistry (EIS, cyclic voltammetry) or semiconductor devices.
 Hands-on lab experience, for exemple a cleanroom, microfabrication, or instrumentation project during your studies.
 A background in biochemistry, bioanalytical chemistry or biosensing is desirable.
 Comfort with data analysis and scripting in Python, Matlab or similar.
 A collaborative mindset: you will be part of a small team.
 Fluient English, written and spoken.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Cleanroom experience with photolithography, thin-film deposition or etching.
 Experience with bio-sensors and microfluidics.
 Knowledge of analog electroncis, circuit or PCB design, lock-in amplification, or instrument control.
 Experience with field-effect transistors or other semiconductor sensors (e.g. ISFETs, bioFETs).
 Familiarity with finite element modelling (Comsol or similar).
 Hands-on experience with surface functionalization, bioconjugation or immunoassays.
 What we offer 
 A fully funded 4-year PhD position at EPFL, with salary according to the EPFL doctoral scale.
 A project with clear clinical relevance and a ready-made interdisciplinary partner from day one.
 Access to the state-of-the-art research infrastructures at EPFL, e.g. Center of MicroNanoTechnology clean rooms.
 Informations 
 Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply, in one PDF:
 A cover letter (one page) describing your motivation and relevant experience.
 Your CV.
 Transcript of your bachelor's and master's degrees
 Contact details of at least two references.
 Contract Start Date : as soon as possible
 Activity Rate : 100%
 Contract Type: PhD student
 Duration: 4 years

items.desc:
You will build the foundational data infrastructure that powers cutting-edge AI applications leveraging LLMs, retrieval systems, workflows, and emerging agentic architectures.
 You will design and maintain scalable data pipelines, manage secure data environments, and prepare data for AI-driven systems while collaborating with cross-functional teams and clients. You’ll tackle real-world challenges by contributing to the development of next-generation AI systems and grow as a technologist by working alongside diverse experts across industries.
 You will design and build the scalable, reproducible data components essential for machine learning, agentic, and autonomous AI systems. You’ll assess data landscapes, apply data quality fundamentals, and prepare data for AI solutions. Additionally, you’ll learn to translate simple hypotheses into engineered features, manage secure data environments, and contribute to R&D initiatives focused on innovating and scaling next-generation AI capabilities.
 Your work will help solve some of the most complex and high-impact challenges facing clients across industries. Collaborating across QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey and QuantumBlack Labs teams, you’ll help develop innovative AI capabilities and scalable enterprise solutions. You’ll help build robust data foundations for scalable, production-ready AI systems. Your contributions will directly support the firm’s ability to accelerate AI adoption, solve complex business problems at scale, and enable clients to achieve meaningful, lasting impact.
 You’ll be based in one of our German offices as part of our global Data Engineering community. Working in cross-functional Agile teams, you’ll collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and industry experts to deliver AI solutions. By partnering with clients from data owners to C-level executives you’ll help solve complex problems that drive tangible business value and begin to build your skills as a client-facing technologist.
 Your work offers a unique opportunity to grow at the forefront of AI, data engineering, and emerging agentic technologies. You’ll develop expertise at the intersection of technology and business by tackling diverse challenges in the evolving AI landscape. Working alongside multidisciplinary teams, you’ll gain a holistic understanding of how data engineering enables advanced AI while collaborating with many leading AI and data experts in the industry.
 Degree in Computer Science/Engineering, or equivalent experience
 Experience in a data-focused role (internships, academic projects)
 Ability to write clean, well-documented code in a modern programming language, with a strong preference for Python and SQL
 Interest in or exposure to data engineering in the context of Agentic AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Business Intelligence across different types of data formats (structured vs unstructured) and processing methods (streaming vs batch)
 Familiarity with commonly used data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, PSQL, etc.), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and engineering tools (Pandas, Spark, dbt, LangChain, etc.)
 Exposure to modern software development practices, including version control (Git) and foundational concepts in DevOps and MLOps/LLMOps and CI/CD principles
 Exceptional time management in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
 Willingness to learn quickly and adapt to different project situations and tech stacks
 Experience using coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, etc.) is a plus
 Business level language fluency skills, both verbal and written, in German and English

 Tasks Looking for new challenges? The term "automation technology" is not a foreign word for you and you would enjoy helping to design modern, standardized production facilities for our new greenfield production plant in Jawor, Poland? Then you'll be right with us as a team! Start as an engineer at Mercedes-Benz Vans in Automation Technology Production Planning in Jawor as sub-project manager for plant construction and series production in Jawor.
 Production Planning for Automation Technology:
 The Control & Automation Technology team is part of the "VAN Operation Engineering" department and is responsible for planning and implementing the electrical engineering for the bodyshop, paint shop and assembly shop in Jawor. As a production planning partner, we collaborate on the rollout of the standards in the new model projects and support the live cycle of series production after the start of production. From the initial idea to implementation in the project, you can play a key role in shaping the future automation and control technology in Jawor. In addition to the projects, we support our colleagues in all VAN locations in matters of standardization and digital transformation. We are responsible for planning of the electrical engineering for automated production systems in all shops. We link planning processes, methods and tools for agile realization of projects. As a driver of innovation, we use established and cost-efficient standards globally and thereby generate levers for efficient operation. We are shaping the digital transformation of the production stages with sustainable technologies, networked systems and digital methods. With us, you take responsibility for sub-projects as well as diverse and exciting tasks with a significant impact on the entire organization
 Scope of duties:
 - Planning and implementation of electrical engineering concepts in software and hardware for production systems
 - Creation of invitations to tender, requirement/technical specifications and technical specifications
 - Controlling and checking the system design in soft- and electrical hardware and/or system progress based on the technical and time specifications
 - Preparation and execution of various acceptances based on check/defect lists and logging/controlling of the results
 - Further development of the automation standard for the VAN division
 - Development of innovation and optimization measures
 - Introduction of new digital systems and tools for increasing efficiency in the planning and production process
 - Managing projects with external and internal stakeholders
 - Advising and qualifying specialist departments on the use of innovative standards and systems
 Qualifications 
 - Degree in electrical engineering with a focus on automation technology or a comparable course of study
 - Openness to new developments
 - Willingness and perseverance to get to grips with new tasks
 - Strong need for knowledge or high interest in disruptive changes
 - Extraordinary commitment and strong team skills
 - Proficient in English, German nice to have 
 - Confident manner and ability to convince
 - Negotiation skills and assertiveness
 - High willingness to travel
 Please submit your CV in English.

items.desc: Wiener Neudorf, Wien Part-time Working Student What you'll be working on We build our own AI tools at AVILOO, from sales intelligence and translation to expense claims, and we are looking for someone who makes sure colleagues actually use them. This is a part-time position at 20 hours on 3 days a week, on site in our office in Wiener Neudorf or Vienna. AI training: You run a monthly AI workshop and hands-on sessions in German and English, from first steps with AI to building automations. AI onboarding for new joiners: You introduce every new colleague to our AI tools in their first weeks, so they work with AI from day one. Our AI Academy: You help build our own learning app for AI skills, fill it with short courses, AI-made videos and quizzes, and track who completes them. Internal AI news: You run our internal AI news channel like a newsroom: new tools, tutorials, success stories from our teams, and news from the AI world, planned weeks ahead. Launches: You prepare release events and all-hands slots for everything the AI team builds, so colleagues know what exists and start using it. Feedback for the AI team: You find out why some tools get used less than expected and tell the AI team what to change. The AI tool directory: You keep one up-to-date list of every AI tool, skill and workflow at AVILOO, with what it does and who owns it. Events & competitions: You organise challenges such as the best AI-made video and give the winners a stage. What you bring A deep interest in AI and agentic coding. You follow new models and tools as they come out and try them yourself. Daily, hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT: you build your own skills and automate parts of your work. First experience running workshops, tutoring, or training sessions, and making videos or visual content with AI tools. Clear writing: short posts, guides, and tutorials that people read to the end. A talent for explaining technical topics in plain language, since your audience ranges from sales to engineering. Excellent German and English skills, both written and spoken, as you'll train teams in both languages. Strong communication and presence, and a solution-oriented mindset. Independent, precise, and pragmatic work style. A team player who rolls up their sleeves when the situation calls for it. Nice to have's Vibe coding with tools such as Claude Code or Cursor. A big plus. Experience rolling out new software or ways of working in a team or company. Experience with learning platforms or course design. What we offer Ownership of AI training and internal AI communication for the whole company: you see new tools first and shape how they launch. A place in a new AI team that is growing, with room to grow as the team grows. A schedule built around your studies, not the other way round. Working students are welcome. An innovative, performance- and team-oriented work environment where success is celebrated together, even across borders. Creative freedom in a company that is set to grow its revenue significantly in the coming years. A workplace with a true start-up mentality, flat hierarchies, and fast decision-making. AI is at the core of how we work and how we think about the future of our processes. We're looking for people who are genuinely excited about that - not just comfortable using AI tools but interested in what becomes possible when you build around them. Reliable work-life balance – personally guaranteed by the CEO. The minimum salary for this position is €2,420 gross per month for full-time, in accordance with the applicable Austrian collective agreement. Actual compensation is based on qualifications and experience and exceeds the collective agreement minimum. About us AVILOO is the world's leading EV battery data expert and has developed the world's first independent State-of-Health test for electric vehicle batteries. Since its founding in 2018, we have grown into the global market leader in independent EV battery diagnostics. With locations in Europe, Asia, Australia, and the USA, our clients include renowned testing organizations, leasing companies, vehicle dealers, and automobile clubs. We are a fast-growing tech company that values innovation, collaboration, and an entrepreneurial mindset. And that’s exactly why we are looking for you — who thinks ahead, helps shape things and grows with us. If you prefer real conversations, quick decisions and shared breaks, you’ll fit right in. We are not a company of buzzwords or fads. We stand for performance, pragmatism and common sense — with a dash of humour and genuine team energy. What counts here is what you can do and how you contribute. “We take care of our people. While performance is important to us, we also ensure a good work–life balance. As a father of five, I know that parents in particular need flexibility. I guarantee that flexibility to you!” — Dr. Marcus Berger, CEO AVILOO Group Sounds like you? items.desc: About Introw Since early 2023, Introw has become the #1 AI-native, CRM-native partner management platform. We grow 4 to 5x year over year and work with companies like Adyen, Aikido and Factorial. We raised $3M led by Visionaries VC, we serve hundreds of companies worldwide, and we hold a 5.0 rating across 100s of reviews. ShareGate went live with 3,000 partners in under 10 weeks. Ringover took partner activity from 20% to 70%. Why this role matters This is an operations role. You use AI to build the tools and plugins that make all of Introw more efficient, more effective and ready to scale, so everyone can focus on what they are great at: AEs selling, CSMs with customers, marketers telling the story. We grow 4 to 5x a year with a lean team, and you are how that keeps working. You join a team for a few weeks, sit next to them, find the work that eats their time, and replace it with an AI agent, a Claude plugin or a simple tool. Then you move on to the next team. You work across the entire company, side by side with the founders, and you learn from them every day. What you'll own Velocity across every department. You decide where to go next, based on where the biggest time sink is. Today that already covers turning a deal into a quote, answering customers in Slack, and reaching out to customers based on how they use the product. The AI toolbox. Introw Assistant, our AI support agent for customers, and the Claude skills every team works with. Keeping it simple and safe. One assistant and one set of skills, not a pile of side projects, and customer data stays where it belongs. How it works Join a team. Sales, customer success, marketing, product, finance. You work from their desk, in their tools, for a few weeks. Challenge the process. Question how the team works today, fix what is broken, and spot the busywork: the copy-paste, the chasing, the hour of prep before every call. Put agents on the busywork. An AI agent, a Claude plugin or a simple tool they use every day, live in days. No roadmap, no tickets. Hand it over and move on. It keeps working after you leave, and you know how many hours it gives back. Who you are Starting out, and hungry. Ideally you just finished TEW, Handelsingenieur, economics or a Vlerick master, and you would rather build and hustle in a company growing 4 to 5x a year than join a big firm. A builder and a hustler. You have made things on your own initiative, like a side business or a student project people still use. You go find the problem instead of waiting for someone to ask. Hands-on with AI. You use tools like ChatGPT, Claude or n8n to get real work done, and you pick up new ones fast. No coding background needed. Commercial. You understand how sales, customer success and marketing make money, so you fix what matters. An owner. No manager layer. You own the function end to end and decide where to go next, with every resource and all the freedom you need. Careful with data. Customer data only goes where it should. Location Ghent, Belgium, from our office in the city center. Mostly in person, with a day or two of flexibility. Benefits Equity through our ESOP. Everyone at Introw owns a piece of what we build. A MacBook and iPhone, fully set up for you. Fully paid phone subscription. Healthcare plan. Mobility budget. Meal vouchers. Introw merch. Regular team drinks and events, plus travel to industry events. Ready to make a whole company faster? Send us your CV and one thing you built or set up that people actually use: who uses it, and what it saves them. Starters welcome, we hire on what you have built, not on years of experience. We reply to everyone. Contact: Simon Van den Hende, Chief Product Officer, on LinkedIn.

items.desc: T Hub - Machine Learning Scientist / Applied ML Scientist We are looking for a Machine Learning Scientist / Applied ML Scientist with strong hands-on experience in Machine Learning and solid software development skills. The role focuses on designing, developing and validating advanced ML/AI solutions and translating experimental concepts into scalable, reliable and production-ready implementations . You will work across the full Machine Learning lifecycle, from understanding the problem and exploring data, through experimentation and model development, to validation, integration and productionization. Key Responsibilities Design, develop and evaluate Machine Learning and AI solutions for complex real-world problems. Build and optimize models using classical ML, Deep Learning, time-series and Generative AI approaches . Perform data exploration, feature engineering, model selection and systematic experimentation . Design robust model validation and evaluation strategies , including appropriate metrics, benchmarks and experiments. Analyze model behaviour and identify opportunities to improve accuracy, robustness, performance and efficiency . Translate prototypes, research concepts and emerging technologies into practical ML solutions . Write clean, modular, testable and maintainable Python code . Build and integrate ML solutions through APIs and backend services where required. Make informed trade-offs between model quality, complexity, latency, scalability and cost . Apply MLOps practices such as experiment tracking, model versioning, reproducibility, deployment and monitoring . Collaborate with ML Engineers, Data Engineers, Software Engineers, MLOps Engineers and domain experts. Contribute to technical decisions, technology selection and development standards for AI/ML solutions. Stay up to date with new developments in ML/AI and assess their real-world applicability . W realizacji zadań pomoże Ci Strong Machine Learning expertise – practical experience with classical ML and Deep Learning, including regression, classification, clustering, forecasting and model evaluation. Generative AI & LLMs – hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG, embeddings, AI Agents and Foundation Models, with an understanding of when GenAI vs. classical ML is the right approach. Strong Python & software engineering skills – ability to build production-ready ML applications, write clean and maintainable code, use Git, automated testing and REST APIs. Data processing skills – solid experience with Pandas, NumPy and SQL , including working with large and complex datasets and building reproducible data pipelines. MLOps & production ML – understanding of the full ML lifecycle, including experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment, monitoring and drift; experience with tools such as MLflow, Databricks or Azure Machine Learning . Production & cloud technologies – familiarity with Docker, CI/CD and cloud-based ML environments ; experience with model serving and performance optimization. End-to-end ownership – ability to independently translate business problems into ML solutions, make architectural and modelling decisions, evaluate trade-offs and take technical ownership. Typically 3+ years of hands-on ML/AI experience . Nice to Have: Experience with GPU workloads and LLM inference optimization . items.desc: Job ID: 3619930 Machine Learning Scientist / Applied ML Scientist (m/f/d) T Hub Warsaw Professional Application deadline: 29.01.2027 Regular T-Hub Polska Your Task We are looking for a Machine Learning Scientist / Applied ML Scientist with strong hands-on experience in Machine Learning and solid software development skills. The role focuses on designing, developing and validating advanced ML/AI solutions and translating experimental concepts into scalable, reliable and production-ready implementations . You will work across the full Machine Learning lifecycle, from understanding the problem and exploring data, through experimentation and model development, to validation, integration and productionization. Key Responsibilities Design, develop and evaluate Machine Learning and AI solutions for complex real-world problems. Build and optimize models using classical ML, Deep Learning, time-series and Generative AI approaches . Perform data exploration, feature engineering, model selection and systematic experimentation . Design robust model validation and evaluation strategies , including appropriate metrics, benchmarks and experiments. Analyze model behaviour and identify opportunities to improve accuracy, robustness, performance and efficiency . Translate prototypes, research concepts and emerging technologies into practical ML solutions . Write clean, modular, testable and maintainable Python code . Build and integrate ML solutions through APIs and backend services where required. Make informed trade-offs between model quality, complexity, latency, scalability and cost . Apply MLOps practices such as experiment tracking, model versioning, reproducibility, deployment and monitoring . Collaborate with ML Engineers, Data Engineers, Software Engineers, MLOps Engineers and domain experts. Contribute to technical decisions, technology selection and development standards for AI/ML solutions. Stay up to date with new developments in ML/AI and assess their real-world applicability . Your Profile Strong Machine Learning expertise – practical experience with classical ML and Deep Learning, including regression, classification, clustering, forecasting and model evaluation. Generative AI & LLMs – hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG, embeddings, AI Agents and Foundation Models, with an understanding of when GenAI vs. classical ML is the right approach. Strong Python & software engineering skills – ability to build production-ready ML applications, write clean and maintainable code, use Git, automated testing and REST APIs. Data processing skills – solid experience with Pandas, NumPy and SQL , including working with large and complex datasets and building reproducible data pipelines. MLOps & production ML – understanding of the full ML lifecycle, including experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment, monitoring and drift; experience with tools such as MLflow, Databricks or Azure Machine Learning . Production & cloud technologies – familiarity with Docker, CI/CD and cloud-based ML environments ; experience with model serving and performance optimization. End-to-end ownership – ability to independently translate business problems into ML solutions, make architectural and modelling decisions, evaluate trade-offs and take technical ownership. Typically 3+ years of hands-on ML/AI experience . Nice to Have: Experience with GPU workloads and LLM inference optimization . Experience with speech-to-text, text-to-speech, voicebots, streaming or high-volume data . Experience mentoring others and applying AI/ML to complex technical or industrial use cases.

items.desc: We are seeking two full-time Research Assistants to join the BOLD Lab at the Department of Engineering Science (central Oxford). The post is funded by EPSRC and is fixed-term for 12 months. This is an opportunity to join The British Open-ended Learning and Discovery (BOLD) Lab, a major new UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) funded initiative that will establish a world-leading AI research laboratory at the University of Oxford. Bringing together more than 80 researchers from Oxford, UCL and Imperial under one unified vision, BOLD Lab will pursue ambitious, high-risk research to advance the fundamental science of artificial intelligence and address some of the field's most important challenges. BOLD has three initial research pillars: Beyond Backpropagation, Human-Centric Learning & Discovery, and Embodied Learning. You will be responsible for running experiments to test deep learning models at scale, organising the results, and extracting insights in the process. In this highly collaborative role, you will be working with other researchers in the team to support BOLD’s development and research portfolio and in the maintenance and development of the research code base. You should possess a a relevant first degree together with relevant experience and possess sufficient specialist knowledge in the fundamental AI research to work within established research programmes. Informal enquiries may be addressed to boldexec-team@eng.ox.ac.uk For more information about working at the Department, see www.eng.ox.ac.uk/about/work-with-us/ Only online applications received before midday on 29 January 2027 can be considered. You will be required to upload a covering letter/supporting statement, including a brief statement of research interests (describing how past experience and future plans fit with the advertised position), CV and the details of two referees as part of your online application. The Department holds an Athena Swan Bronze award, highlighting its commitment to promoting women in Science, Engineering and Technology. items.desc: AI & Automation Engineer | Malmin Healthcare Group Farringdon, London · £40,000–£50,000 per year, depending on experience Help us make it easier for patients to get answers, book appointments and find the right practice, while giving our dental teams more time to focus on patient care. Malmin Healthcare Group provides NHS and private dentistry, orthodontics and diagnostic services. We’re looking for a hands-on junior engineer to build AI agents, chatbots and automated workflows that our reception, practice management and head office teams can use every day. You’ll work directly with those teams, see where time is being lost and help take projects from the first prototype through to rollout across our practices. What you’ll build Patient-facing chatbots that answer common questions from approved information, guide patients to the right location or booking route, and hand clinical or urgent enquiries to the practice team. Reception and admin automations that organise shared inboxes, draft routine replies for staff to review, flag missed enquiries, track referrals and reduce duplicate data entry. Internal AI assistants that help staff find current policies, prepare standard documents and produce reports without having to search across multiple systems. Marketing tools that help our team draft and test Google Ads, improve landing pages and track which campaigns lead to bookings. You’ll also help improve how patients find accurate information about our practices through Google Search and AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Claude. Reliable integrations with our practice management and other business systems. You’ll help test and monitor the tools you build, and work with our IT and information governance teams wherever workflows involve patient data. We’d start with a patient enquiry chatbot and a reception workflow that reduces manual follow-up . You’ll help measure their impact through response times, enquiries converted to bookings and staff hours saved. What you’ll bring Practical experience building an AI agent, chatbot or automated workflow. Personal, university and commercial projects are all welcome. Some experience with APIs, Python or JavaScript/TypeScript . Familiarity with n8n, Make or Power Automate is useful. An understanding of how to test AI outputs, handle errors and hand a task over to staff when it needs human judgement. items.desc: EngineeringRemote, France/Morocco time zoneFull timeReports to Walid Boulanouar, CTOCompensation: competitive, shared at interview QA Engineer : 200 systems in production, and they have to hold up Past a certain number of systems in production, the constraint is no longer building. It is guaranteeing that it holds. That is this role, and it is new. A useful clarification: this is QA for AI systems, not interface testing. You test non-deterministic outputs, not buttons. / The role What you take on You write an evaluation suite, and it lies You build a test set for a client's support agent. It passes at 95%. Two weeks later a user asks a question phrased unlike anything in your test set, and the system answers nonsense. Your job: maintaining a test set that keeps closing in on real traffic, week after week. You break an n8n workflow for good reasons And check that nothing else breaks with it. A node is changed to fix a bug; a downstream step that depended on a precise output format fails silently. Your regression tests catch that before the client does. You are the last gate before delivery Business test set, the client's edge cases, checking that the outputs are presentable to a leader who will use them to decide. You say yes or no to going live. You verify a number the company repeats everywhere “7 hours a week recovered on average” is a central commercial argument, and a verifiable claim. You build the method to audit it project by project, and you say when it does not hold for a given case. You watch for what degrades without warning Quality dropping over several weeks with no alert, token costs blowing up. You build the signals that make those drifts visible before the client sees them. You write a lot, and to be understood immediately Acceptance reports, non-conformity notes, drift write-ups: readable in thirty seconds by someone who has not followed the project. / Your first 90 days Month 1, you audit what exists and tell us where it breaks most often. Month 2, you put the evaluation foundation in place on a live system. Month 3, no system ships to a client without going through your acceptance. / The profile What we are looking for Evaluation techniques Golden datasets, scoring rubrics, LLM-as-judge calibrated against human annotation, regression testing Tools Solid Python, an eval framework (promptfoo, DeepEval or equivalent), reading and testing n8n workflows, CI/CD Non-determinism Thinks in acceptable quality ranges, tells normal variation from a real regression Writing Clear reports, readable by a non-technical audience Field work 3 to 8 years in QA, test engineering or SDET, part of it on AI systems in production, comfortable saying no under pressure What we are not looking for Someone who executes test plans written by others. items.desc: Department: Department of Biology, Chemistry, Pharmacy contract duration: limited to 3 years Salary / pay grade: E 13 TV-L FU Working hours: 67 % Requisition ID: 931 Application deadline: 14.12.2026 Salary calculator TV-L Salary Student assistant TV Stud III Who We Are The DFG-funded international Research Training Group GRK2662 "Charging into the future: understanding the interaction of polyelectrolytes with biosystems" aims to gain a better understanding of the molecular interactions between polyelectrolytes such as DNA, proteins or heparin with complex biological systems. A special feature of the Research Training Group is the close, complementary cooperation between scientists from Freie Universität Berlin (Germany), McGill University, Montréal, and the University of British Columbia, Vancouver (Canada). The international research training group GRK2662 offers Positions for research assistants with the possibility of a doctorate, structured academic training in an international research environment, including participation in a variety of research-specific and career-enhancing training courses and events, integration into an interdisciplinary international research network and the opportunity for research stays in the laboratories of the Canadian partner institutions. What You Can Expect in Your New Role Position as a Research Assistant (Preadoc) (f/m/d) within the International Research Training Group (IRTG) GRK 2662, in the AG Elter, Project C1 (E13 TV-L, 67%, starting January 1, 2027, for 36 months) Electrostatic interactions between biomacromolecules are essential for numerous biological processes, including blood coagulation. For many surgical procedures, temporary inhibition of the coagulation cascade is required. The anticoagulant heparin is commonly administered for this purpose. Following surgery, its anticoagulant activity should be reversed as rapidly as possible using an appropriate antidote. Heparin exerts its anticoagulant effect through electrostatic interactions with proteins of the coagulation cascade. This activity can be neutralized by positively charged macromolecules that complex heparin selectively. However, naturally occurring macromolecules may trigger immune responses, limiting their suitability for this application. In Project C1, led by Dr. Johanna K. Elter, biocompatible, tailor-made cationic macromolecules will be synthesized using innovative methods such as Iterative Exponential Growth (IEG). Their interactions with heparin will first be investigated in model systems and by theoretical methods. Subsequently, their efficacy in whole blood will be evaluated in collaboration with the Kizhakkedathu Group at the University of British Columbia. Further project information can be found at www.grk2662.de. Key Requirements Completed university degree (M.Sc. in chemistry or polymer science or equivalent, preferably with a focus on synthetic chemistry or related subjects). Desirable Extensive experience in the synthesis, purification, and analysis of organic (macro)molecules Experience in interaction analysis using titration methods (e.g., ITC) and fluorescence-based techniques Experience with theoretical methods for investigating interactions between macromolecules, e.g., using molecular dynamics (MD) simulations Excellent written and spoken English proficiency Strong communication skills and a willingness to work collaboratively in interdisciplinary teams and research collaborations. We look forward to receiving your application, which must include the following documents: A one-page letter of motivation of why you want to work in Project C1, together with details of previous research experience and future goals Your CV (including a list of publications if applicable), Certificates of your academic education including copies of your Bachelor's and Master's degrees, Letter of support (optional) in one PDF document Benefits and Other Advantages Modern workplace in the leafy suburb of Dahlem Salary in line with the collective agreement for the civil service at the state level (TV-L FU), plus additional one-off annual payment Flexible working hours and mobile working by arrangement, where possible The compatibility of work and family life Thirty days of vacation (based on a five-day working week) Office closed on December 24 and December 31 Numerous training and continuing education options for professional and personal development Opportunity to participate in University Sports Center courses and the health promotion program Free parking close to the office and good public transportation connections Discounted “Job Ticket” for public transportation Free use of the Freie Universität library system Employee discount in the cafeteria Exclusive deals for products and services through Corporate Benefits If you are interested in what we have to offer, then you can send your application materials to us directly.
