Doświadczenie w projektowaniu i rozwijaniu platform CI/CD opartych o GitHub Actions, Pipeline as Code, reusable workflows oraz centralne, wersjonowane biblioteki wykorzystywane przez wiele zespołów developerskich; Praktyczne doświadczenie w automatyzacji jakości i bezpieczeństwa oprogramowania w modelu Shift Left, z wykorzystaniem narzędzi takich jak SonarQube, SAST, SCA, secret scanning, container scanning oraz Security & Quality Gates; Dobra znajomość Azure Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes (AKS) oraz automatyzacji wdrożeń, w tym podejść GitOps (Argo CD), Infrastructure as Code, Pipeline as Code i Policy as Code; Doświadczenie w wykorzystaniu rozwiązań AI-SDLC do automatyzacji developmentu, code review, testowania, bezpieczeństwa oraz procesów release management; Dobra znajomość AWS Bedrock oraz Microsoft Foundry i ich wykorzystania do budowy agentów AI oraz autonomicznych procesów wspierających Software Development Lifecycle; Umiejętność łączenia obszarów Software Engineering, Platform Engineering, Security Engineering oraz AI Engineering; Bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego; Nastawienie na rozwiązywanie problemów, ciągłe doskonalenie procesu dostarczania oprogramowania oraz budowanie rozwiązań zgodnie z podejściem Platform as a Product, z uwzględnieniem potrzeb developerów jako użytkowników platformy; Promowanie podejścia automation first, self-service, Shift Left i security by design, połączone z wysokim poczuciem odpowiedzialności za jakość, bezpieczeństwo i niezawodność dostarczanych rozwiązań; Umiejętność budowania standardów i współpracy między zespołami, wspieranie kultury inżynierskiej oraz zainteresowanie nowymi technologiami, w szczególności praktycznym wykorzystaniem AI w Software Engineering. Mile widziane: Doświadczenie w organizacji działającej w modelu Product Operating Model. Wymagania Twoją rolą będzie: Rozwój centralnej Software Delivery Platform wspierającej zespoły produktowe w całym cyklu wytwarzania oprogramowania; Budowa i rozwój wersjonowanych bibliotek CI/CD, reusable GitHub Actions workflows oraz standardowych ścieżek Software Delivery wykorzystywanych przez zespoły produktowe; Automatyzacja procesów build, test, code quality, security scanning, artifact publishing i deployment zgodnie z podejściem Shift Left oraz Secure SDLC; Rozwój platform wdrożeniowych opartych o Azure, AKS, GitOps i Argo CD; Tworzenie i rozwój rozwiązań AI-SDLC, w tym agentów i autonomicznych procesów wspierających development, code review, testowanie, dokumentację, bezpieczeństwo i procesy release management; Wykorzystanie AWS Bedrock oraz Microsoft Foundry do budowy bezpiecznych usług AI zintegrowanych z procesem wytwarzania oprogramowania; Współpraca z zespołami Cybersecurity, Engineering Leadami oraz zespołami produktowymi w obszarze jakości, bezpieczeństwa, Developer Experience i efektywności Software Delivery; Promowanie usług Platform Engineering oraz zwiększanie ich wykorzystania i adopcji w organizacji.

items.desc: We currently have a vacancy for a Document Conversion Specialist fluent in English, to offer his/her services as an expert remotely (within EU) . In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the Development team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team. Tasks: Analyse requirements and assess the feasibility and impact of document-conversion solutions; Design, prototype, implement, test and maintain automated document-conversion pipelines; Convert and transform XML, DOCX and other structured documents into HTML or equivalent formats using XML, XSLT, XPath and related technologies; Use LibreOffice and tools such as Saxon to process and refine documents while preserving structure and formatting; Assess conversion quality, prepare test cases, identify issues and recommend improvements; Automate processing with Java and/or scripting in Windows or Linux environments; Manage technical tasks, releases, documentation, progress reporting and data migrations; Provide technical advice, deliver training, support handovers and participate in project meetings. Requirements Master's degree in IT or relevant discipline, combined with minimum 16 years of relevant working experience; Experience with XML, XSLT, XPath and structured-document processing; At least six months’ hands-on experience developing document-conversion components and processing OOXML/DOCX files with LibreOffice; Strong knowledge of HTML, XHTML, HTML5 and CSS, including complex document structures such as headings, lists, tables, images, formulas and styles; Experience using Saxon or equivalent tools for XSLT-based transformation and post-processing; Experience with Java and/or scripting to automate conversion pipelines, including command-line processing in Windows or Linux; Experience conducting feasibility studies, impact analyses and proofs of concept, and documenting findings and recommendations; Experience designing, implementing and testing conversion solutions, including test case preparation and assessment of output quality and structural fidelity; Knowledge of structured publishing workflows and tools such as Git or Bitbucket, Jira, Oxygen and Microsoft Teams; Excellent command of the English language. Benefits If you are seeking a career in an exciting and dynamic company, where you will offer your services as part of a team of a major European Institution, operating in an international, multilingual and multicultural environment where you can expect real chances to make a difference, please send us your detailed CV in English, quoting reference: (22225/11/2026). We offer a competitive remuneration (either on contract basis or remuneration with full benefits package), based on qualifications and experience. All applications will be treated as confidential. You may also consider all our other open vacancies by visiting the career section of our web site (www.eurodyn.com) and follow us on Twitter (@EURODYN_Careers) and LinkedIn. EUROPEAN DYNAMICS ( www.eurodyn.com ) is a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operating internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc). The company employs over 1000 engineers, IT experts and consultants (around 3% PhD, 36% MSc and 53% BSc or equivalent). We design and develop software applications using state-of-the-art technology. The group generates annual revenues in the range of EURO 40 million, with an EBITDA in the range of 20%. The value of our contract portfolio exceeds EURO 300 million. Fellows join Vertex for a customized post-doctoral
items.desc: Job Description Please submit a CV/resume and required cover letter with your application. Letters of Recommendation will be requested if invited to interview. About the Program The Vertex Fellowship is a unique, one-year training program for outstanding scientists and physicians passionate about solving unmet medical needs and advancing transformative science. Fellows join Vertex for a customized post-doctoral experience, gaining hands-on experience with real-world R&D challenges and benefiting from mentorship by Vertex leaders. This program is designed to provide participants with a broad understanding of the science and business of drug discovery. Program Highlights Project-based Fellowship: Embed for one year within a Vertex project team Work on a project of relevance, based on your skills and our pipeline needs Training & Mentorship Intensive didactic training on the science and business of drug development Scientific mentorship from research leaders Career mentorship from Vertex leaders Exploring Career Fit Upon completion, participants will be able to effectively decide if a career in industry is the right fit, and if so, how they might develop their career. Why be a Vertex Fellow? Contribute to transformative medicines: Help patients by advancing scientific ideas in a team-based environment. Accelerate your career: Learn about drug discovery and build your professional network. Mentorship: Receive guidance from scientific, medical, and business leaders at Vertex. Vertex Fellows Network: Develop connections internally and externally. Program Timeline Applications Accepted: November 23, 2026 – January 8, 2027, by 5:00 PM ET Interview Invitations: February 2027 (Letters of Recommendation requested at this time) Interviews: Early March 2027 Formal Offers: Mid-late March 2027 Program Start: September 2027 Program End: August 2028 Eligibility Requirements PhD, MD, or joint degree attained Demonstrated scientific impact (e.g., peer-reviewed publications, presentations, awards) Evidence of creative thinking, scientific problem solving, and innovation Interest in learning how scientific research leads to the development of therapies Application Instructions Please submit your CV/resume and cove r letter by January 8, 2027, 5:00 PM ET . In your cover letter, consider addressing: Your most significant scientific or research achievement and how you accomplished it An example of how you applied creative thinking to solve a problem What you hope to gain from the Vertex Fellows Program Letters of Recommendation will be requested if invited to interview. At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients. Flex Designation: On-Site Designated Flex Eligibility Status: In this On-Site designated role, you will work five days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility. Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time. #LI-Onsite Company Information Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation. Vertex is committed to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Vertex is an E-Verify Employer in the United States. Vertex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law. Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should make a request to the recruiter or hiring manager, or contact Talent Acquisition at ApplicationAssistance@vrtx.com

items.desc: Description Location: Cambridge, UK – This position offers flexible working options, including predominantly remote work. Applicants should be based (or willing to relocate) within a comfortable commuting distance of our office to attend onsite as required. Do you want to build systems that millions of players depend on every day without necessarily knowing they exist? Our Player Platform organisation is the foundation that powers all things RuneScape. From the moment a player logs in to the moment they complete a purchase, our teams own the technology that makes it work. We're looking for Full Stack Engineers to join our Player Platform team - you'll work across Java backends, React frontends, and AWS infrastructure - building software where reliability isn't optional and your work is felt at scale. What you'll be doing: Owning work from scoping and technical design through to release in production, often across several services Delivering features and improvements in your team's domain with secure-by-design code, code review and documentation Testing your own work with test plans, automated tests (unit, mock, integration) and manual testing where needed Building and maintaining services that are monitored, scalable, robust and highly available, integrating REST APIs and publish-subscribe messaging Working closely with senior engineers and product owners, and growing your skills as you go What we're looking for: A hands-on engineer who wants to build and ship, rather than move towards product or delivery roles Proactive, inquisitive and a clear communicator with both technical and non-technical colleagues Experience delivering web applications or contributing to large established projects, where you took real ownership Java (Spring Boot or similar) and JavaScript/TypeScript with React, Next.js or Node Working knowledge of AWS, CI/CD (Git, Bitbucket Pipelines, Bamboo) and IaC such as Terraform, with familiarity with microservices Nice to have: [Ansible, Helm]; experience in billing, payments or e-commerce What we offer: When you join Jagex you can look forward to a generous Perks & Benefits package including: Private Healthcare, including Dental Plan. Discretionary annual performance bonus. Minimum 6% Pension contributions. Life Insurance. Enhanced family leave policies from day 1. Flexible working hours. 25 days annual leave + Bank holidays & the option to buy/sell holidays + so much more! Right to Work Statement This role is only open to applicants who have the permanent right to work in the UK. We are unable to provide or take over visa sponsorship for this position, either now or in the future. Applicants must therefore be able to demonstrate their ongoing eligibility to work in the UK without the need for employer sponsorship. About Jagex We are Jagex: The RuneScape Company. Home to one of gaming's most enduring success stories. We create deep, community-powered games with worlds that evolve, inspire, and endure. Our flagship MMORPG franchise, RuneScape, has welcomed over 300 million player accounts, inspiring generations of players across PC and mobile for 25 years. As we begin our 26th year, we are accelerating our strategy to expand RuneScape into a broader ecosystem of forever games and connected experiences, grounded in a renewed commitment to integrity and fair play. This includes the reduction of monetisation mechanics, as well as the launch of RuneScape: DragonWilds into Steam Early Access in 2025, representing a major step in building a multi-genre future for the RuneScape universe. We remain focused on building enduring worlds, empowering player-led innovation, and laying the foundations for the boldest era in RuneScape's history. For more information, visit www.jagex.com. Headquartered in Cambridge, United Kingdom, we are home to passionate creators, storytellers, engineers, and even a few dreamers, all united by a single mission to shape the future of online worlds and empower players to make them their own. We're looking for people to join us who share our ambitions and values. We foster an inclusive workplace built on trust, autonomy, and a shared passion for creating experiences that inspire our communities. Our values guide everything we do: We Embrace Fellowship by collaborating and sharing openly. We Hone our Craft by always learning and improving; We Honour our Vows by being honest and transparent; We are our Customers' Heroes by striving to understand our team & player needs, and We Seize The Day by making the most of every opportunity. Join us. The next era of RuneScape and the next chapter of Jagex: The RuneScape Company starts now. Inclusion & Accessibility Statement We are committed to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, and we recruit, develop, and promote based on merit and ability. If you require any reasonable adjustments to support you during the recruitment process, please let …

items.desc: Solution Architect Do you want to shape the architecture behind complex, enterprise-scale solutions and turn ambitious technology strategies into reality? Do you thrive on combining architectural leadership with hands-on solution design to solve complex business and technical challenges? About the team: Digital Business Solutions (DBS) is a global technology team of 400 FTE and 300 partner staff, supporting stakeholders across Elsevier and RELX. DBS forms part of Elsevier’s global Technology function and is the enterprise delivery arm across Elsevier. We provide a wide range of business-critical services across over 250 applications, from Sales and Marketing Technology to eCommerce solutions, from financial system management to Content Publishing Systems. The group includes non-technology functions such as Product Management and a Portfolio Programme Management Office. Within DBS, the Architecture function sets technical direction across our products and platforms, partnering with the business to translate strategy into scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions. About the role: The Architect position provides effective architectural and structural design for the applicable RELX Business Unit. Additional responsibilities include ensuring ongoing development, maintenance, and delivery of technical knowledge and expertise and determining the technical feasibility of development projects. Key responsibilities: Act as a conduit between the Architecture community and the Engineering or Development teams. Work across/with Architects from different organizations. Introduce/train teams with new technology. Lead teams toward problem resolution, identifying, researching, and coordinating the resources necessary to effectively troubleshoot/diagnose complex project issues. Evaluate new technologies and their applicability to the business. Extract/translate findings into alternatives/solutions, identifying risks/impacts and schedule adjustments to facilitate management decision-making. Drive technical direction and architecture evolution via reviews and on-floor leadership. The ability to guide teams into compliance with data privacy and security policies and best practices. Actively monitor the Business Unit system health and design and write proposals to remedy the cause of negative trends. Proactively monitor new development to discover subsystems or components that should be evolved into shared infrastructure. Proactively research, monitor, learn, and assess industry/technology advancements and continually build alliances to explore ways to leverage and advance our technical opportunities. All other duties as assigned Requirements: Required skills- Understanding of cloud architecture fundamentals, ideally AWS: compute, storage, networking, and managed services. Understanding of relational, search, and data lake technologies, and when to use each. Experience with APIs and integration patterns: REST, event-driven and messaging, and batch/ETL. Familiarity with containerised services and API gateways Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD, enough to review designs against standards Familiarity with data formats and standards used in publishing: XML/JSON, JATS or similar, metadata schemas, and identifiers (DOI, ORCID). Working knowledge of a scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, or JavaScript, and the ability to read and review code. Ability to produce architecture diagrams and documentation, ideally the C4 model, plus basic UML, or sequence diagrams. Awareness of security, resilience, and data governance basics (IAM, encryption, GDPR). Desirable Skills - Have experience in publishing and content, and the management and implementation of content systems. Experience of architecting cloud-native solutions with AWS, Azure, or OCI Demonstrate excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including communicating complex technical content to a range of audiences. Enjoy collaborating and leading teams to design a strategy to solve problems and implement innovative solutions. Have a natural ability to engage, influence, and build relationships with stakeholders, teams, and vendors across our business. Experience with monitoring or alerting tooling such as New Relic and OpsGenie. Why join us? Join our team and contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. If you are ready to advance your career and make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. Work in a way that works for you We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals. Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive. Working for you We know that your well-being and …

items.desc: Oxford, United Kingdom ENGINEERING SCIENCE Careers Research Assistant(s) in Fundamental AI Research Salary £36,360 - £48,700 per annum Closing date Jan 29, 2027 12:00PM Share on BlueSky Share on Facebook Share on LinkedIn Description We are seeking two full-time Research Assistants to join the BOLD Lab at the Department of Engineering Science (central Oxford). We're hiring a Data Scientist specialising in Recommender Systems for a fast-growing global gaming technology company. Experience from e-commerce, streaming, media, marketplaces or ad tech counts. Your job title matters less than what you've built. Why you'll like it Real scale: your models reach millions of players worldwide. Real ownership: you own problems from idea to production. Real growth: learn alongside data scientists, ML engineers and data engineers who ship. Modern stack: deep learning, cloud ML and real-time data, with room to test new ideas.

We're a highly motivated team of 40 — ex-MIT, HBS, Bain, and Math/CS/Physics olympiad medalists — and as we prepare for our next stage of growth, we're looking for ambitious, exceptionally talented people to help scale our product and grow with us. What You'll Do At Prosper, we’re pushing the limits of what’s possible with real-time AI. We’re not just making voice agents that “talk”, we’re engineering systems that sound human, reason under strong latency constraints, and adapt instantly to messy, high-stakes healthcare conversations. As a Software Engineer, you’ll be at the center of designing and scaling our platform, the low-latency speech/LLM pipelines, orchestration layers, and reliability systems that make this possible. This is a full-time role in Barcelona office with the possibility to move to the New York office. What We're Looking For 2+ years of experience building products end-to-end, from architecting solutions to deploying production-grade software. Experience managing distributed systems with asynchronous workload orchestration. Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents or other ML models is a plus. We use Pipecat for our voice agents. Founder mindset: ownership + hard work. You see Prosper as a learning step for your future startup. Be ready to handle the challenges of deploying AI voice agents to thousands of daily phone calls. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Maths, Physics or related field (or equivalent experience). Interviewing Process Initial conversation to understand who you are, what you want to do, and where you wanna go (30 minutes) Work on a take-home challenge to discuss in the following interview Review your solution with a couple of engineers from the team (60 minutes) Talk with the co-founder (60 minutes) Offer stage

items.desc: LET’S CUT STRAIGHT TO IT At Severn Trent, we believe everyone deserves more. More care for the environment, more sustainable initiatives, and more support for the communities we serve. That's why we're on a mission to deliver bigger and better things, and we need passionate graduates like you to help us achieve our goals. Our people and culture are the heart of our success. We're proud to be in the top 5% of utility companies worldwide for employee engagement, and we’re equally proud of our strong Glassdoor score - reflecting how much our people love working here. With over 10,000 dedicated colleagues, we're looking for more brilliant people who are eager to turn challenges into opportunities for a better future. If you're excited to learn, and ready to make a real impact, we want you on our team. LET’S TELL YOU MORE Severn Trent is a FTSE 100 company and one of the only ones outside London to have an all-encompassing AI department, where the team focuses on areas like automation and software development. Our Graduate AI Transformation Programme offers the perfect blend of personal and professional development, exposing you to a key part of our business. The 27-month programme consists of placements within the AI team where you will build a well-rounded skillset where you will work on real life challenges and projects that impact our core business functions. Through working in the Capital AI team, you will gain great oversight of an innovative and evolving area of the business. The programme will enable you to build practical AI and software delivery skills. We are looking for 3 graduates who will follow the same programme throughout the first year of their programme and then going onto to chose their specialist route at the start of the second year. We welcome all graduates from diverse backgrounds, as we know diverse minds bring new ideas and a different way of thinking. We are looking for someone who wants to build their career with us and grasp new opportunities, and in return we will support you with varied experiences, training and development to provide a grounding for your future career. HOW WILL THE PROGRAMME WORK? Year 1 — Shared foundation: All graduates will follow the same development programme, covering business problem-solving, user needs, data fundamentals, coding, software development, AI, testing and responsible delivery. This will include practical exposure to both specialist routes so you can make an informed choice. Year 2 onwards — Specialist route: At the start of Year 2, you will choose either Forward Deployed Engineer or Full Stack AI Developer, supported by discussions with their manager and mentor. Your subsequent projects and development should focus on that route for the remainder of the programme, taking you up to the full 27 months. In this exciting programme, you will have the chance to discuss your development and career ambitions in your 1-1 meetings with business leads, mentors, a study buddy, the cohort leader, and the New Talent Team. In Terms Of Development The 2 Specialist Routes Are Forward Deployed Engineer: In this route you will work directly with business teams to understand problems, identify opportunities and build practical AI agents and automated workflows. Within this route you will combine stakeholder engagement with hands-on prototyping, testing, deployment, adoption and measurement of business benefits. Full Stack AI Developer: In this route you will build AI-powered applications across the full technology stack, including user interfaces, back-end services, APIs, data integrations and AI capabilities. Within this route you will develop your skills in secure coding, automated testing, cloud deployment and ongoing improvement. You'll join a caring culture that collaborates to achieve, grow, and develop. Our employee engagement scores are among the highest globally in energy and utilities. That’s why, we value in-person moments to keep our culture alive and why for this role you’ll usually find us in the office during our working hours. What You Will Learn You will expand your knowledge of technical and business skills. During your first year, you will gain hands on experience in internal stakeholder-facing and technical environments. As part of this you will work directly with various business areas to understand challenges and develop technology driven solutions. In the second year, there will be opportunity shape your development where you have the opportunity to specialise in areas such as software development or continue with the forward deployed role. Overall, in the first year you will learn how to: Build strong relationships with business stakeholders and understand real world challenges Apply problem solving techniques to design and deliver practical technology solutions Develop communication and stakeholder management skills alongside technical expertise. items.desc: Data Scientist, Recommender Systems | Remote | Python, PyTorch, Deep Learning Millions of players. Thousands of games. One question: what should they play next? We're hiring a Data Scientist specialising in Recommender Systems for a fast-growing global gaming technology company. You'll build the machine-learning models that decide what millions of players discover, and you'll see your work go live, not sit in a notebook. What you'll actually do Build recommendation models. Candidate generation, retrieval and ranking that make every player's lobby feel personal. Predict what's next. Use sequential behaviour, user and item embeddings and deep learning for next-item prediction. Ship to production. Take models from data and experiments through deployment and monitoring, then keep improving them. Prove it works. Run offline evaluation and A/B testing, and connect model quality to real product results. Try new things. Test transformer-based recommendation, two-tower models and multimodal signals where they genuinely help. What you'll bring Around 3–5 years of hands-on experience in machine learning , with real work on recommender systems, personalisation or ranking Strong Python and SQL Deep-learning experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow or JAX Models you've taken to production on AWS, GCP or Azure The ability to explain what you built, why, and what changed because of it Bonus points (not dealbreakers) Two-tower models, learning to rank, ANN search, cold start, session-based recommendations, MLOps, Spark, Kafka or Flink. Experience from e-commerce, streaming, media, marketplaces or ad tech counts. Your job title matters less than what you've built. Why you'll like it Real scale: your models reach millions of players worldwide. Real ownership: you own problems from idea to production. Real growth: learn alongside data scientists, ML engineers and data engineers who ship. Modern stack: deep learning, cloud ML and real-time data, with room to test new ideas.

Strong knowledge of data storage and query technologies such as SQL, NoSQL, MongoDB, and Hadoop. Experience designing scalable data storage solutions, including Data Lakes, Lake houses, and distributed storage. Experience in data quality checks, data transformation, integration, visualisation, and publication. Experience performing acceptance testing for data-related IT solutions. Education & Experience: Option 1: Master's degree (EQF Level 7) with at least 5 years of IT professional experience. Option 2: Bachelor's degree (EQF Level 6) with at least 7 years of IT professional experience. Minimum 5 years of experience in Data Analysis or Data Science. English proficiency at B2 level or above.

items.title: Jr. Research Software Engineer
items.card: RESPONSIBILITIES , The successful candidate will closely collaborate with research software developers and researchers at the IIASA ECE Program as well as international partners on the following tasks: Lead the conceptual development and implementation of new tools and features for scenario analysis and data visualization to support research and science communication based on requirements elicitation and dialogue
items.desc: The successful candidate will join a team of research software engineers and software developers working with researchers at ECE and collaborating institutions on further developing and continuously improving these tools to support energy- and climate-related research in ECE and in the wider academic community. An interest in the scientific content of the software tools - climate change and energy transition research - will help communication within the multi-disciplinary teams and developing a deeper understanding of the user needs. A key objective is to establish a sustainable framework for collaborative agentic AI development that could eventually be extended across the institute. The job profile will be comprised of two key activities: Supporting modelling teams from around the world in the use of the Scenario Explorer infrastructure and further develop the Python packages for scenario analysis and validation. Maintaining and developing a shared AI skill marketplace that ECE researchers use for agentic AI integration in their research. This combines data-safety and confidentiality rules, agent skills and rules that capture scientific workflows and connectors (MCP servers). This work covers reviewing and merging contributions from researchers, managing the test suite and continuous integration, user support for installation and onboarding, documenting components, and helping researchers turn recurring workflows into reusable tools. Candidates should have strong Python experience in writing maintainable and scalable tools including development of CI/CD pipelines and experience with git version management using platforms like GitHub. They should have worked hands-on with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, developed and evaluated custom agent harness configurations, have familiarity with LLM APIs including their cost and data-retention trade-offs, and show a careful approach to data governance, since the work involves handling embargoed data, manuscripts under review and colleagues' unpublished work. , MAIN TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES , The successful candidate will closely collaborate with research software developers and researchers at the IIASA ECE Program as well as international partners on the following tasks: Lead the conceptual development and implementation of new tools and features for scenario analysis and data visualization to support research and science communication based on requirements elicitation and dialogue with scientific staff and other relevant user groups. Collaborate effectively through established software-development practices (pull requests, code reviews, iterative feedback) and is eager to adapt and improve these workflows for teams working with AI coding agents. Manage a central repository of reusable AI agent skills and tools, specifically defining standards for their development, documentation, testing, and secure deployment, and facilitating their sharing across the team. Serve as contact point for software developers and research software engineers at other institutions that are implementing tools and interfaces based on the ECE infrastructure (e.g., in Horizon Europe projects or activities of the IAMC). Contribute to ongoing research activities by implementing new features in the scientific software packages in close collaboration with scientific staff and with an aim to identify automation opportunities, integrate AI agents with existing scientific software and infrastructure (where possible), and ensure reliable, secure, and scalable solutions. Provide support and guidance on best-practice of scientific software development and the use of tools developed in ECE to researchers at IIASA and collaborators in the wider community. Documentation of the software stack and all modules at high professional standards. , Skills, Qualifications & Experience , Education and Background BS or MS (or equivalent, e.g. DIFH) in a field related to energy systems, environmental sciences or a related field, or has corresponding experience in computer science and software development. They should have a strong interest in scientific software development. Essential skills and competencies: Strong Python experience in writing maintainable and scalable tools. Interest in AI, Machine Learning, Large Language Models, and their application within scientific environments. Good understanding of software development principles, testing, debugging, including development of CI/CD pipelines and experience with git version management using platforms like GitHub. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to work carefully with large and complex scientific datasets. Ability and willingness to understand scientific models and the relationships between model inputs, calculations, and results. Strong ability and willingness to work collaboratively in an interdisciplinary team and communicate with both technical colleagues and scientific domain experts. Excellent written and spoken …

items.desc: About Introw Since early 2023, Introw has become the #1 AI-native, CRM-native partner management platform. We grow 4 to 5x year over year and work with companies like Adyen, Aikido and Factorial. We raised $3M led by Visionaries VC, we serve hundreds of companies worldwide, and we hold a 5.0 rating across 100s of reviews. ShareGate went live with 3,000 partners in under 10 weeks. Ringover took partner activity from 20% to 70%. Why this role matters This is an operations role. You use AI to build the tools and plugins that make all of Introw more efficient, more effective and ready to scale, so everyone can focus on what they are great at: AEs selling, CSMs with customers, marketers telling the story. We grow 4 to 5x a year with a lean team, and you are how that keeps working. You join a team for a few weeks, sit next to them, find the work that eats their time, and replace it with an AI agent, a Claude plugin or a simple tool. Then you move on to the next team. You work across the entire company, side by side with the founders, and you learn from them every day. What you'll own Velocity across every department. You decide where to go next, based on where the biggest time sink is. Today that already covers turning a deal into a quote, answering customers in Slack, and reaching out to customers based on how they use the product. The AI toolbox. Introw Assistant, our AI support agent for customers, and the Claude skills every team works with. Keeping it simple and safe. One assistant and one set of skills, not a pile of side projects, and customer data stays where it belongs. How it works Join a team. Sales, customer success, marketing, product, finance. You work from their desk, in their tools, for a few weeks. Challenge the process. Question how the team works today, fix what is broken, and spot the busywork: the copy-paste, the chasing, the hour of prep before every call. Put agents on the busywork. An AI agent, a Claude plugin or a simple tool they use every day, live in days. No roadmap, no tickets. Hand it over and move on. It keeps working after you leave, and you know how many hours it gives back. Who you are Starting out, and hungry. Ideally you just finished TEW, Handelsingenieur, economics or a Vlerick master, and you would rather build and hustle in a company growing 4 to 5x a year than join a big firm. A builder and a hustler. You have made things on your own initiative, like a side business or a student project people still use. You go find the problem instead of waiting for someone to ask. Hands-on with AI. You use tools like ChatGPT, Claude or n8n to get real work done, and you pick up new ones fast. No coding background needed. Commercial. You understand how sales, customer success and marketing make money, so you fix what matters. An owner. No manager layer. You own the function end to end and decide where to go next, with every resource and all the freedom you need. Careful with data. Customer data only goes where it should. Location Ghent, Belgium, from our office in the city center. Mostly in person, with a day or two of flexibility. Benefits Equity through our ESOP. Everyone at Introw owns a piece of what we build. A MacBook and iPhone, fully set up for you. Fully paid phone subscription. Healthcare plan. Mobility budget. Meal vouchers. Introw merch. Regular team drinks and events, plus travel to industry events. Ready to make a whole company faster? Send us your CV and one thing you built or set up that people actually use: who uses it, and what it saves them. Starters welcome, we hire on what you have built, not on years of experience. We reply to everyone. Contact: Simon Van den Hende, Chief Product Officer, on LinkedIn.

items.desc: Jobbeskrivning Vill du kombinera din erfarenhet som systemutvecklare med generativ AI och nya sätt att bygga, testa och utveckla mjukvara? På Sopra Steria stärker vi vår satsning inom Agentic Engineering och söker nu erfarna systemutvecklare som vill arbeta i skärningspunkten mellan traditionell mjukvaruutveckling och generativ AI. Det här är en roll för dig som är utvecklare i grunden , men som är nyfiken på hur AI kan förändra både utvecklingsprocessen och lösningarna vi bygger. Du behöver inte redan vara expert på alla nya ramverk och tekniker. Däremot tror vi att du har börjat använda AI i ditt arbete och vill fördjupa dig inom området. Hos oss får du arbeta praktiskt med allt från idé och prototyp till lösningar som används i våra kunders verksamheter. I rollen kommer du bland annat att: Utveckla moderna applikationer och tjänster med AI som en naturlig del av utvecklingsprocessen Utforska hur generativ AI och agentbaserade lösningar kan användas för att lösa konkreta verksamhetsbehov Arbeta med API:er, integrationer och moderna utvecklingsplattformar Använda AI-baserade utvecklingsverktyg, exempelvis GitHub Copilot eller Claude Code Bygga lösningar med fokus på kvalitet, säkerhet, testbarhet och långsiktig hållbarhet Tillsammans med kollegor och kunder testa nya arbetssätt och omsätta ny teknik till fungerande lösningar Vem är du? Vi söker dig som har en stabil grund inom system- eller mjukvaruutveckling och som blivit allt mer nyfiken på möjligheterna med AI. Du gillar att bygga och testa nya saker, men har samtidigt erfarenheten som krävs för att förstå vad som behöver fungera när en lösning ska lämna prototypstadiet och användas på riktigt. Du behöver inte kunna varje nytt AI-ramverk som dyker upp. Viktigare är att du har ett genuint intresse för området, redan har börjat använda AI i utvecklingsarbetet och vill fortsätta fördjupa dig. Vi tror att du har: Minst tre-fyra års erfarenhet av professionell system- eller mjukvaruutveckling Erfarenhet av AI-driven utveckling eller AI-baserade lösningar Goda kunskaper inom moderna programmeringsspråk, ramverk, API:er och integrationer Erfarenhet av testning, CI/CD, versionshantering och moderna utvecklingsmiljöer Intresse för nya utvecklingsmetoder, exempelvis spec-driven development och AI-assisterade arbetssätt Förmåga att kommunicera obehindrat på svenska och engelska Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av: Generativ AI, LLM:er eller AI-agenter Molnplattformar som Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud Konsultrollen och att utveckla lösningar tillsammans med kunder Därför Sopra Steria Hos oss får du vara med och utveckla ett område som kommer att påverka hur vi och våra kunder bygger mjukvara framåt. Du får kombinera kunduppdrag hos några av Sveriges ledande organisationer med möjligheten att bidra till vår egen satsning inom Agentic Engineering. Du blir samtidigt en del av ett nätverk av utvecklare, arkitekter och andra tekniska specialister där vi delar kunskap, testar nya idéer och lär oss tillsammans. Vi erbjuder konkurrenskraftiga villkor och attraktiva förmåner, en flexibel arbetsplats och kollektivavtal. Vill du vara med och utforska nästa steg inom AI-driven systemutveckling? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig.

items.desc: We're putting together a talented team to build the #1 training platform for Runners We help everyday runners become outstanding by building an incredible app providing world-class training, coaching and community for everyone, whether you're improving your 5k time or training for your first marathon. Some experience with python (university projects, side projects, internships or similar). Shared ownership of code and outcomes across cross‑functional teams. Experience with deployment, release cycles or CI/CD Experience in a product focussed organisation, building consumer facing applications Benefits We'll be growing our package of benefits over time. We currently offer: £42.5k salary (prorated over your internship) Flexible working (we typically work 3 days a week in the office) 10 days flexible holiday, with the choice to use your bank holiday allowance on days that better suit you Bi-weekly team run and lunch Socials throughout the internship (Team and company wide) AI Engineer Intern Interview Process Our Goal Is To Make The Interview Process As Simple And Enjoyable As Possible. Once the process is finished, we promise to let you know our decision as soon as possible. Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better accommodate you throughout the interview process - this can be from scheduling interviews around childcare commitments to accessibility requirements. We want you to show your best self in the process, so please speak to your Talent Partner. Compensation Range: £42K

items.desc: For our client, an international company operating in the biotechnology and molecular diagnostics industry, we are looking for a Research Scientist. The successful candidate will join a team developing image analysis algorithms and mathematical models used to interpret experimental data and obtain reliable measurements. The role combines a research-oriented approach with the practical application of optimization methods and programming. The Research Scientist will work closely with laboratory scientists and software engineers to find solutions to specific problems — from data analysis and hypothesis testing, through prototype development, to result validation and the implementation of algorithms into existing systems. Key responsibilities Developing and improving classical image analysis algorithms and image-based measurement methods. Building mathematical models and fitting their parameters using non-linear optimization techniques. Formulating hypotheses, designing experiments, and validating results in collaboration with the laboratory team. Analyzing customer-reported issues, identifying root causes, and proposing algorithmic improvements. Developing prototypes, automating data processing, and documenting experiments using Python and Jupyter Notebook. Working with large datasets, including noisy, incomplete, or ambiguous data. Collaborating on the integration of developed solutions into existing C++ codebases. Presenting findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ideal candidate profile Approximately 5 years of experience in a similar role. Proficiency in Python programming, particularly in data analysis, prototyping, and automation of research and development processes. Ability to analyze existing C++ code and understand its structure to effectively collaborate on algorithm implementation and integration. Experience in image analysis and processing ( OpenCV / scikit-image / NumPy / SciPy ). Good understanding of statistics and practical experience with classical machine learning algorithms ( pandas / scikit-learn / statistics / model validation ). Ability to rapidly develop prototypes, document experiments, and communicate effectively with the team ( Jupyter, venv/conda, Git, testing, logging ). Practical knowledge of mathematical modeling and advanced non-linear optimization methods. Ability to present results, draw meaningful conclusions, and clearly communicate the limitations of applied methods and conducted analyses. Nice to have: Experience working with data from laboratory equipment or scientific instrumentation. Experience in customer support, troubleshooting, and resolving technical issues encountered during product use. Conditions Location: hybrid in Wrocław, Poland (Initially 1–2 days/week in the office, with the possibility to reduce later) Contract type: B2B Salary: 140-150 PLN/h + VAT Benefits: Private medical care, life insurance, Multisport card Recruitment steps Phone call with a Recruiter (approx. 20 min.) items.desc: About CommonAI CommonAI CIC is a non-profit organisation built around collaborative engineering and is backed by a mix of UK Government and private funding in order to design, build and deploy innovative AI systems. Our Scaling Inference Lab (SIL) is developing simulation grounded in real measurements to help the UK invest in promising AI infrastructure. We connect proposed hardware designs to realistic workloads, helping investors and engineers understand their potential, their limitations and the next experiment worth doing. The Opportunity Build the workloads and benchmarks that reveal how AI infrastructure performs on useful applications. You will develop reproducible LLM serving workloads, connecting application behaviour and requirements to physical measurements and SIL's simulation platform. The initial focus includes long-context inference and agentic workloads. You will investigate how request patterns, context lengths, caching, repeated model calls and interactions with tools shape the demands placed on a system. Your benchmarks will make performance comparisons meaningful by specifying the work being done and the quality and service requirements it must meet. Working with measurement and simulation engineers and our partners, you will help preserve the workload behaviour that matters when moving between real systems and models. Your work will help engineers and investors understand which infrastructure choices suit particular applications, and how conclusions change when the workload changes. What You Will Do Build and maintain reproducible LLM serving workloads, serving configurations and benchmark tools, including long-context and agentic workloads, using suitable existing software. Characterise relevant behaviour such as request arrivals, prompt and output lengths, caching, batching, tool interactions and dependencies between requests. Define performance measures alongside application-quality and service requirements, so comparisons reflect useful work under stated conditions. Work with measurement engineers to reproduce workloads on physical systems, and with simulator engineers to develop workload representations that preserve the behaviour and dependencies that matter. Investigate how changes in workloads and serving configurations affect conclusions, and keep the benchmark suite relevant as inference technology and workloads evolve. Document datasets, model and software versions, configurations, provenance and permitted use so other engineers can reproduce and extend the work. An example early project would be to build a reproducible agentic workload and work with measurement colleagues to compare its performance across two systems, under agreed application-quality and service requirements. Requirements Experience building or evaluating ML systems, inference services, performance benchmarks or comparable workload-driven systems. Strong practical software skills for constructing reliable benchmark tools, analysing results and debugging interactions between applications and infrastructure. Understanding of LLM inference and an interest in how serving choices affect performance and output quality. Care in designing reproducible comparisons and interpreting results against stated application requirements. Practical experience using AI coding agents, with the judgement to validate generated code, data transformations and evaluations. Experience with vLLM, SGLang or similar serving software, long-context workloads, agentic applications, trace analysis or quality evaluation would be valuable. Depth in a subset is sufficient. The initial remit is LLM serving; other forms of inference are possible later extensions. Why join us Help build UK AI capability and improve how investment and compute serve the public good. Build a network spanning UK hardware SMEs, major technology companies, venture and public investors, and leading universities. Shape a growing team with startup pace and close academic links. Use frontier models and coding agents with a substantial tooling budget. Benefits A collaborative and supportive work environment The opportunity to have a high impact in a growing organisation Competitive salary package, including pension and benefits Professional development opportunities Networking opportunities with influential figures from across the tech sector and academia A vibrant office environment located a few minutes’ walk away from Cambridge train station Salary range: £60,000 - £110,000 per annum Working with us Hybrid, with Cambridge attendance agreed individually around collaboration and the work; applicants across the UK are welcome. We are open to permanent employment, part-time arrangements and consultancy. We would like you to start as soon as practical and can be flexible for the right person. We particularly welcome experienced engineers and can also consider earlier-career candidates with strong evidence of ability. Relevant postgraduate study is useful, but qualifications …

items.card: About The Role Callosum believes that orders of magnitude improvements in AI systems will come through application-aware orchestration across heterogeneous models and hardware. The General Capabilities team is developing the science that makes that possible: a principled, evidence-based method for building agentic systems automatically. items.desc: About Us We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity. Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next. The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve. Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost. Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor. In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence. We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Work with our infrastructure teams to optimise agents for cost and latency on heterogeneous hardware. Deep familiarity with the internals of SGLang, vLLM or comparable inference serving frameworks: scheduler design, memory management and execution pipelines. Depth in multi-agent systems, program synthesis, or evolutionary and LLM-driven search over programs and agents, including systems that run the research loop themselves. Experience with RL or post-training for long-horizon, multi-step or tool-use tasks. Evaluations, benchmarks or agent harnesses you built that other people went on to use. Ability to break defined work into clear, bounded tasks with sufficient context, constraints, and acceptance criteria for both people and AI agents. Ability to review and improve AI-generated designs and implementations rather than treating generated output as authoritative. Working knowledge of testing, CI/CD, observability, security, source control, maintainability, and production operations. Some experience working in cloud environments and integrating with existing systems. Sound problem-solving ability and clear written and verbal communication. items.desc: Organizational Setting The Statistics Division (ESS) develops and advocates for the implementation of methodologies and standards for data collection, validation, processing and analysis, in the food and agriculture statistics domains. In these statistical domains, it also plays a key role in the compilation, processing and dissemination of internationally comparable data, and provides essential capacity building in support of Member Nations. The Division also disseminates publications, working papers and statistical yearbooks, that cover agriculture and food security statistics, including prices, investments, production, trade and agri-environmental statistical data. Finally, as the ESS Director also plays the role of FAO Chief Statistician, the Division supports the various functions of the Chief Statistician, that is to ensure stronger governance of FAO's data and statistical system, foster consistency of FAO's Data and Statistical programme within the Strategic Framework, ensure statistical excellence through the implementation of statistical standards and quality assurance mechanisms, and position FAO's presence in data and statistical discussions at global level. The aim of this Call for Expression of Interest is to populate a roster of consultants and subscribers of Personal Service Agreements (PSAs) for the Data Quality Unit and the Data and Statistics and Coordination Team of ESS at FAO headquarters in Rome, Italy. The Data Quality Unit aims to ensure that the Organization produces and disseminates high-quality data and statistics related to its mandate. The unit develops, updates and implements corporate quality frameworks, policies, standards, procedures and tools to ensure that statistical processes are sound and disseminated data and statistics are of the highest possible quality. It also monitors and assesses the quality of FAO data and statistics and supports FAO technical units in improving their compliance to internal quality policies, standards and procedures. Finally, it provides quality assurance support and tools to FAO technical units and member countries to improve the quality of food and agriculture data and statistics produced at the national level. The Data and Statistics Coordination Team supports the governance and coordination of FAO’s data and statistical activities, both within FAO and within the broader international data and statistical community. It oversees the planning, monitoring and reporting on FAO data and statistical programme of work and more generally supports the monitoring of FAO’s corporate results. It coordinates FAO’s role as custodian agency for 22 Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Indicators. Finally, it acts as focal point for any queries on intellectual property matters concerning FAO databases. Reporting Lines Candidates selected for assignments with the Data Quality Unit (DQU) will work under the general supervision of the Director of ESS and the direct supervision of the DQU Team Leader, and in close collaboration with other members of the Unit. Candidates selected for assignments with the Data and Statistics Coordination (DSCT) Team will work under the general supervision of the Director of ESS, and the direct supervision of the DSC Team Leader, and in close collaboration with other members of the Unit. Technical Focus Candidates selected for assignments with the Data Quality Unit will contribute to the quality assurance efforts of the Division, such as the development and review of statistical standards; the implementation of peer reviews, quality assessments and user consultations; and the provision of support and capacity development activities on statistical and data-quality related matters. Candidates selected for assignments with the Data and Statistics Coordination Team will provide data analysis and programming support to the governance, coordination, planning, monitoring and reporting of data and statistical activities at corporate level, in particular in the area of SDG monitoring, and to the design and monitoring of FAO results framework. Tasks And Responsibilities Candidates selected for assignments with the Data Quality Unit will: Support efforts to ensure the quality of statistical outputs produced and disseminated by FAO, including through the implementation of the Accountability Framework for Statistical Activities. Contribute to the development and review of corporate statistical policies, standards, procedures and tools aimed at improving the quality of FAO statistical production processes and data assets, in line with the Generic Statistical Business Process Model (GSBPM) and the FAO Statistics and Data Quality Assurance Framework. Contribute to the implementation of quality assurance, quality control and assessment mechanisms for FAO statistical processes and data assets, including data and statistics produced using non-traditional data sources, such as Earth observation and other big data sources. items.desc:
Data & AI Intern - Intelligent Operations 
 Description - 
 Before applying please note that, to be eligible for this position, you must be currently enrolled at a university in Spain , remain enrolled until the end of the internship, and be eligible to sign an internship agreement with your university. You must also be available to start the internship in February 2027  and continue participating in the program until  June–July 2027 . 
 We are looking for a motivated student to help us explore how data, analytics and AI can transform the way we run business operations and make decisions . 
 Today, many business reviews still require significant manual effort to collect information from different sources, consolidate data, understand performance and identify the insights that require attention. 
 The objective of this project is to explore a different approach: connecting data, analytics and AI to build the foundations for Intelligent Operations . 
 What you will work on 
 You will work on a real business use case, starting with the automation and augmentation of business reviews. 
 Together with the team, you will: 
 Connect and integrate data from multiple business and operational sources. 
 Structure and prepare data so it can be reliably used for analytics and AI. 
 Develop analytics to understand performance, trends and key business drivers. 
 Explore how AI can automatically identify relevant trends, deviations and areas requiring attention. 
 Use Generative AI to generate insights and help users interact naturally with business data. 
 Prototype automated and AI-assisted business reviews. 
 Explore how these capabilities could evolve towards more proactive Intelligent Operations , where data and AI help identify issues and opportunities and support faster decision-making. 
 The project will combine data engineering, analytics, Generative AI and business understanding , with an emphasis on experimentation and building tangible prototypes. 
 What we are looking for 
 We are looking for a student in Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Engineering, Data Science or a related field , with: 
 Knowledge of Python and SQL. 
 Experience or interest in data analytics and data modelling. 
 Familiarity with Power BI or similar visualization tools. 
 Interest in Generative AI, LLMs and AI agents. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 Curiosity to understand the business context behind the data. 
 An experimental mindset and willingness to turn ideas into working prototypes. 
 Good communication and collaboration skills. 
 What you will learn 
 This internship provides the opportunity to work at the intersection of business, data and AI , applying emerging technologies to real operational challenges. 
 You will gain hands-on experience across the journey from data integration and analytics to AI-generated insights and automation , while exploring how AI can fundamentally change the way business operations are managed. 
 Experience our benefits : 
 Paid internship within a global, technology driven company.  
 Join an international work environment, with opportunities for learning, professional development, and networking across teams.  
 Flexible working schedule, with options for part-time agreements (4 hours/day) or full-time (8 hours/day).  The length of the internship ranges from 4 to 12 months.  
 Access to our intern community, including career development workshops, learning sessions, and social activities that help you grow professionally and connect with other interns.  
 Mentor assigned.

items.desc: The most valuable product development happens where the product meets reality. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you work at that intersection: you turn AI agents into production-ready customer solutions and bring what you learn back into the product. We call this role a Frontier Fellow : part senior engineer, part trusted technical advisor and part bridge between our customers, delivery teams and the HiveAI product team. HiveAI is Fellowmind's agent platform. About the role You belong to the HiveAI product organisation, but you will do much of your work alongside our implementation teams and customers. Building one agent is easy now. Building agents a business can rely on every day is not. That's where you come in: you take on the hardest problems in our customer projects and solve them. The job doesn't end when the solution works. You turn what you learn into HiveAI: when relevant, functionality, patterns and components built for one customer become reusable capabilities that help the next customer and everyone else. What you will do Fix the hard parts. Step in where agents meet real business systems, identity and users, and make them work. When shared components fall short, build your own. Get AI agents into use, fast. Work with our delivery teams from the first customer conversation to go-live. Put a working first version in front of users within days. Be a front runner. Help customers and Fellowmind teams make sound architecture decisions, challenge approaches that won't scale and explain technical trade-offs clearly. Shape HiveAI . Share recurring requirements and architectural insights with the HiveAI development team. Raise the bar for everyone. Share knowledge, patterns and best practices so implementation teams can deliver HiveAI successfully on their own. items.desc: Date: Nov 20, 2026 Location: Rotterdam, ZH, NL, 3011 GA Company: Bunge City : Rotterdam State : Zuid-Holland (NL-ZH) Country : Netherlands (NL) Requisition Number : 48897 Trade Exec ution (Cotton) - Full-time, Rotterdam Position description In this challenging and international role, you are responsible for ensuring proper execution of the trade flows of containerized shipments of raw cotton. In this role you will manage and coordinate logistical activities by executing the Purchase and Sales contracts ensuring that you are accurately reading, checking the contractual obligations, conditions, and details of these contracts. Next to that, you will also be responsible to check the shipment documentation and ensure that payments are made and received on time as well as maintain a correct inventory and administration for our international trades. You will be part of the Operations Cotton team and report directly to the Team lead. Responsibilities You will also coordinate logistics activities, liaising with various parties to ensure that container movements by ship, rail and truck are executed efficiently to ensure that container movements by ship, trains and/or trucks are properly and efficiently loaded and discharged while delivering quality to ensure each shipment is accompanied by a complete and correct set of documentation. Day-to-day duties include: Stock reconciliations and contract allocations and maintenance. Daily liaison with contractual counterparties, local offices, shipping lines and agents. Check L/C’s against contract and UCP 600 rules to make sure they are contractual and compliant, Request amendment if/when necessary, Liaise with suppliers and third parties involved in good fulfilment of contract and follow up payments, nominate surveyors per vessel, resolve operational problems as they arise. Direct contact with suppliers and clients in order to make nominations, send documentary instructions and follow up the contracts Each trade is different, so accurate administration skills and a keen eye for detail are vital. Timely presentation of prepared documentation (such as bill of lading and certificates of origin) are key in completing operations effectively. Good communication skills are crucial in maintaining clear lines of communication with internal departments (such as Trade and Finance), colleagues from our international field offices, as well as external third parties and our customers. Required skills and experience We are looking for candidates who: Have prior industry experience, specifically at least a few years in a similar Operations/Logistics/Trade Execution role, with execution experience in agricultural products or other commodities, and ideally, logistical experience in containers, shipping, train transport or trucks. Possess a high level of accuracy, strong communication skills with cultural sensitivity, and good command of English (spoken and written); additional languages are a plus. Are proficient in working with spreadsheets. Demonstrate a responsible, flexible, and proactive attitude, anticipating issues and finding quick solutions, along with an eagerness to understand and develop within a complex commodity business. Benefits/what we offer The position you are applying for is part of our Operations department. You will work in an informal and diverse team, and be part of an international organization that will help develop your skills and expertise. As well as this, we offer: Competitive Compensation & Benefits: A competitive salary package, an annual bonus scheme based on company results and individual performance, an attractive and fully funded pension scheme, and an additional full month’s salary each year as an annual holiday allowance together with 27 holiday days a year (based on full-time employment). Learning & Development Opportunities: This role offers the opportunity to develop deep expertise in commodity trade execution, international logistics, shipping documentation, contract management, and global supply chain operations. Working closely with traders, logistics providers, suppliers, customers and international colleagues, you will gain valuable exposure to the agricultural commodities industry and build a strong foundation for future growth within Bunge's Operations, Trade Execution or Commercial teams. Modern Workspace & Perks: Our modern, inspiring office in the center of Rotterdam (adjacent to the Markthal and Blaak station) offers complimentary daily lunch service, a business laptop, and reimbursement for public transport travel Engaging Work Environment: Participate in annual company cultural and sport activities, such as the Harbour Run, football tournaments, and team-building events, fostering a strong sense of community and collaboration. items.desc: Are you a hands-on Research Engineer with experience in mammalian cell culture? Would you like to contribute to exciting research and development projects within the Life Science industry? SallyQ is currently looking for a Research Engineer for a consulting assignment in Uppsala. You will join an international R&D environment, working alongside experienced scientists and engineers in a collaborative and innovative setting. About the assignment In this role, you will support research and development activities focused on mammalian cell culture, cell line development and molecular biology. You will work in a laboratory-based environment where you will plan, perform, analyze and document experiments. The position offers a combination of hands-on laboratory work, troubleshooting and collaboration with colleagues across different areas of expertise. Key responsibilities Plan, perform and evaluate laboratory experiments involving mammalian cell culture in different formats and scales. Perform transfection of mammalian cells. Carry out cell sorting and flow cytometry. Perform molecular analysis of cell pools and clones. Support expansion and scale-up of cell cultures for production purposes. Analyze experimental results and troubleshoot laboratory procedures. Maintain accurate laboratory records and documentation according to established guidelines. Present and communicate scientific and technical results within the team. Collaborate with colleagues to achieve project goals and timelines. Your background We are looking for a hands-on, collaborative and solution-oriented person who enjoys laboratory work and has a strong interest in cell culture and molecular biology. Qualifications: Master's degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Biomedicine or a related Life Science field. Hands-on experience in mammalian cell culture is essential . Practical experience with laboratory techniques and analytical methods. Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken. Experience in cell line development, transfection, flow cytometry, PCR/qPCR or molecular cloning is considered an advantage. Experience with cell culture scale-up, protein production or industrial R&D is a plus. You are structured, flexible and enjoy solving practical challenges, both independently and as part of a team. items.desc: Do you want to help make IMBOX smarter and more scalable through better processes, data, AI and automation? At IMBOX, growth means continuously rethinking how we work. We are looking for a curious and analytical AI Automation Specialist who can identify where better processes, data and technology can make a difference and turn opportunities into practical solutions. The role sits at the intersection of business processes and technology. You will improve processes and translate business needs into solutions using AI, automation, data and integrations. You do not need to be a software developer, but you should be able to prototype, configure and test smaller solutions yourself. About the role You will work across IMBOX to understand processes, data and systems and help take solutions from idea to implementation. Your projects will start with a business need or process that could work better. You will explore the problem with the people involved and help shape the right response, whether that means improving the process, connecting data or creating an agent, automation, reporting solution, or small application. You will work closely with the people who know the processes best, ask the right questions, and determine the most pragmatic solution. You will build or configure smaller solutions yourself and coordinate with external specialists when deeper development expertise is needed. Over time, you will take ownership of selected solutions and help ensure they remain useful, secure, and well maintained after launch. What you will be doing Understand and improve business processes across IMBOX Translate stakeholder needs into practical solution designs Identify opportunities within AI, automation, data and digitalization Prototype, configure and test agents, workflows, automations and low-code solutions Work practically with data, reporting, APIs and integrations Coordinate implementation with users and external development specialists Own and continuously improve selected solutions after launch What matters is understanding the problem and finding a pragmatic solution that works. About you Your exact educational background is less important than your combination of business understanding, analytical skills and practical technical capability. You may be a recent graduate or have a few years of experience within Business Intelligence, Business Analytics, Business IT, Digital Business, Information Systems, Applied AI or a similar field. You are curious, analytical and detail oriented. You enjoy understanding how work is done and are willing to dig into a process, system or dataset. You can see the wider business context, but you are also willing to try things yourself and turn ideas into something users can test. We imagine that you: Understand business processes and can translate needs into requirements Have practical experience with AI agents, workflows, low-code or AI-assisted development Can build or configure smaller prototypes and troubleshoot independently Are comfortable working with data, systems, APIs and integrations Can collaborate with both business stakeholders and technical specialists Are pragmatic, curious and willing to experiment and learn It is an advantage, but not a requirement, if you know: Microsoft Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Power Automate or Claude Code Power BI, Power Query or SQL Lovable or similar AI-assisted development tools Application security, governance and release processes An ambassador for smarter ways of working We want someone who looks beyond the tasks they are given. When you see a process that could be easier or discover a useful tool, we expect you to investigate the opportunity, involve the right people and test the idea. We value experimentation and pragmatism, while recognising that solutions used by the business also require testing, security, documentation, maintenance and continuous improvement. What we offer At IMBOX Protection, you will join an international growth company where ideas quickly turn into action and your contribution is visible from day one. A broad, cross-functional role with responsibility from an early stage Close collaboration with leaders, department owners and colleagues across the business The opportunity to work directly with external AI and development specialists Room to experiment with new tools and ways of working An informal culture with short decision-making paths and opportunities to grow Practical information Workplace: HQ in Skødstrup (Aarhus), Denmark Employment: Full-time Starting date: As soon as possible Contact: Director Performance & Execution Lone Jensen at lmj@imboxprotection.com How to apply: Send your application and CV as soon as possible.
