items.desc: Internship / Graduation Project: AI and Emerging Technologies Groenlo, Netherlands 32 - 38 hrs € 325 - € 650 Hybrid What are you going to do? How can AI help healthcare professionals spend less time on repetitive administrative work? In Nedap’s Virtuele Assistent team, we build AI-powered automation and communication tools for Nedap Ons. During your internship or graduation project, you’ll explore how AI can improve these tools or help our team develop them. Start your application Your responsibilities Depending on your interests and study requirements, you’ll focus on one of these directions: Investigate where AI agents can support the team, from exploring ideas and designing solutions to implementing, testing, and maintaining software. Work on voice or text communication for the Ons Suite, with attention to reliability, security, and scalability. Explore how teams can use AI agents in their day-to-day work, which decisions need human oversight, and how teams can manage the risks. Your team You’ll join the Virtuele Assistent team, where colleagues in software development, data science, UX research, and product development work together. We build tools that connect communication to actions within healthcare workflows. You’ll bring your own ideas, test different approaches, and learn from colleagues as you develop your assignment. Our offer What's in it for you? As an intern or graduation student at Nedap, you can work remotely or from our campus in Groenlo. You decide what works best for you in consultation with your team. You’ll have plenty of space to take the lead on your project, make your own decisions, and take responsibility for your work. Along the way, you’ll learn from enthusiastic colleagues who are happy to share their expertise. To thank you for your contribution, we organize a Nedap Student Day twice a year. It’s a chance to get together with other interns, graduation students, and working students across Nedap. We also offer a monthly internship or graduation project allowance of €325–€650. If it’s a good fit on both sides, there may be an opportunity to join Nedap after your project. Many students have stayed on with us! All terms of employment Required Skills You’re curious and enjoy learning by trying out new ideas. You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions, and share what you learn with your team. Depending on your assignment, you’ll focus on building software, conducting technical research, or combining the two. Education: You’re preferably enrolled in a technical degree program. Software development: You enjoy building software, trying out new tools, and testing your solutions. Technical research: You enjoy investigating how a technology works, what it can do, and where its limitations lie. AI: You want to learn how to use AI responsibly, whether in software development, voice or text communication, or collaboration between people and AI agents. We welcome students looking for an internship or a graduation project. Availability for a longer placement is preferred. Get in touch! Hi, I’m Noa, Recruitment Business Partner. Interested? I’d love to hear from you! Apply using the application button and send us your CV, a short note about why you’re interested, or both. If you have any questions, feel free to email me at noa.serradekloet@nedap.com. AI in your work At Nedap, we see AI as a valuable tool to help us work smarter. We are curious about what it makes possible and actively explore how it can help us collaborate better, improve the way we work, and create solutions that truly matter. We expect you to do the same: remain curious, explore how AI can add value in your work, and use it thoughtfully, responsibly, and with sound judgment. We provide the tools, space, and support to do so. About Nedap Nedap is a global leader in Digital Twin Technology, bridging the physical and digital worlds in Retail, Healthcare, Livestock, and Security. Guided by our Technology for Life philosophy, we create smart, sustainable solutions that help people and organizations thrive in a rapidly changing world. With over 1,000 colleagues, we shape the future with meaningful innovations.

Du arbetar nära våra kunder för att identifiera användningsområden, undanröja hinder och etablera effektiva arbetssätt med generativ AI och AI-stöd i mjukvaruutveckling. Du har en bakgrund som mjukvaruutvecklare, exempelvis inom Microsofts teknologier såsom .NET och Azure, eller inom frontendutveckling. Med din tekniska erfarenhet förstår du utvecklingsteamens vardag, tekniska utmaningar och arbetsflöden. items.card: About The Role Imagine a software development environment where AI agents can collaborate, plan complex tasks, write code, run tests, and help engineers turn ideas into working software. That's what we're building. As a Platform Engineer in Signicat's AI Foundations team, you'll help design and build our internal AI Software Factory : a platform that enables teams of autonomous AI agents to work together, interact
items.desc: Signicat is a pan-European digital identity company that makes it easy and safe for organisations to know who they are interacting with online. Using our proprietary technology, we help companies and public organisations securely verify the identities of people and businesses, authenticate users, and enable compliant electronic document signing, so their customers can access services and complete online processes with confidence. Today, Signicat employs over 530 people across 20 offices in 15 European countries. We work with leading banks, fintechs, telcos, public authorities, healthcare providers, and enterprises across retail and mobility to deliver trusted digital identity and onboarding solutions at scale. Joining Signicat means contributing to a mission that has a real impact on how society works and trusting each other in an increasingly digital world. About The Role Imagine a software development environment where AI agents can collaborate, plan complex tasks, write code, run tests, and help engineers turn ideas into working software. That's what we're building. As a Platform Engineer in Signicat's AI Foundations team, you'll help design and build our internal AI Software Factory : a platform that enables teams of autonomous AI agents to work together, interact securely with our systems, and accelerate how we build software. This isn't just about integrating LLM APIs. We're building the foundations for agent-driven software engineering, tackling challenges around orchestration, distributed execution, state management, sandboxing, security, and human-agent collaboration. Our platform runs on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Kubernetes , with Go as our primary programming language . You'll join a team exploring the boundaries of what's possible with AI agents, combining experimentation with solid software engineering principles to turn ambitious ideas into reliable, production-ready systems. How You'll Make An Impact Build the AI Software Factory: Design and develop the core services, APIs, and infrastructure that enable AI agents to plan, execute, and collaborate on complex software engineering tasks. Orchestrate intelligent agents: Build systems that coordinate multiple specialized agents, manage dependencies, schedule work, and support long-running, asynchronous workflows. Design reliable agent runtimes: Develop secure, stateful execution environments that manage agent lifecycles, context, tool invocations, retries, recovery, and execution isolation. Make autonomous execution safe: Implement sandboxing, fine-grained permissions, and security boundaries that allow agents to interact with code, tools, and internal systems without compromising security. Connect agents to the real world: Integrate LLMs, development workflows, internal APIs, and external tools through secure, extensible interfaces and emerging standards such as MCP and A2A. Enable human-agent collaboration: Help create systems where engineers can guide, supervise, and collaborate with autonomous agents, maintaining control over important decisions. Shape the future of AI engineering: Evaluate emerging technologies, challenge existing approaches, experiment with new architectural patterns, and help define how autonomous software engineering evolves at Signicat. Solve interesting engineering problems: Apply your understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, fault tolerance, and software architecture to challenges that don't always have established solutions. Why We'll Love You You have strong software engineering experience, ideally with Go, and enjoy building robust backend services, APIs, and distributed systems. You're comfortable working with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native infrastructure, ideally on Google Cloud Platform. You think beyond individual services and understand how to design systems that handle concurrency, failures, asynchronous execution, and complex state transitions. You care about clean architecture, well-designed APIs, maintainable code, and automated testing. You understand the importance of security, particularly around authentication, authorization, isolation, and executing untrusted workloads. You're curious about LLMs and autonomous agents, including concepts such as tool calling, context management, multi-agent collaboration, and agent orchestration. You enjoy exploring emerging technologies, experimenting with new approaches, and turning promising ideas into practical solutions. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, taking ownership of challenging technical problems, and helping shape architectural decisions. You enjoy sharing knowledge, collaborating with others, and challenging assumptions to find better solutions. Bonus Points You've built systems using agent frameworks such as Google ADK, or worked with protocols like MCP or A2A. You have experience with sandboxing or workload isolation technologies such as gVisor, WebAssembly, or container-based execution environments. You've worked with …

In a world where digital content consumption is skyrocketing and audience expectations evolve daily, traditional production models can no longer keep up - and that’s where we come in. Our creative solutions help media owners and operators monetize inventory more effectively, bridge the creative supply gap for brands and agencies, and deliver faster, smarter, and more personalized experiences. We’re not just keeping up with industry shifts - we’re setting the pace. As we take the next step in our own AI journey, we’re building an agentic operating model that will transform how our teams collaborate, solve problems, and get things done. We’re looking for a curious and proactive Software Agentic Developer Intern to help bring this vision to life. You’ll get hands-on experience exploring the latest AI capabilities, building and testing AI agents, and turning promising ideas into practical solutions that make a real difference across the business. From Sales and Client Services to Product, Marketing, Finance, and Legal, you’ll work with teams across the company to identify opportunities, develop AI-powered solutions, and help bring them into everyday workflows. This is your opportunity to move beyond experimenting with AI tools and start putting AI into practice - transforming your ideas and prototypes into real-world solutions that make an impact across our company. What stack do we use? You'll get hands-on experience with a modern AI and automation stack, including Claude (Claude Code, Cowork, Skills & MCP), Snowflake, Salesforce, Gong, Slack, Jira, and Asana, as well as SQL and Python. Your Responsibilities Run and improve agents for the Celtra Studio department. Build agents for sales reports, account briefs and follow-ups. Write and test the agents use. Check outputs, monitor runs and document agents. Collaborate with colleagues who build their own agents, so they can be shared across Celtra. Develop and maintain the infrastructure for rolling out agents company-wide. Who are you? Working knowledge of at least one programming language, ideally Python or TypeScript, and the ability to read and debug code you didn’t write (including code an AI wrote for you). Solid SQL: joins, aggregations, …, and the habit of checking whether a result is actually correct. Familiarity with serverless or managed ways to run code without maintaining servers (e.g. Heroku, AWS Lambda, Cloud Agents). Understanding of how APIs work: REST, JSON, authentication with API keys. Comfort with Git and the command line. Basic security hygiene: keeping secrets out of code, preferring read-only and least-privilege access, and thinking about what data an agent can see or send. Already building with AI tools. Critical of AI output and clear with non-technical colleagues. Studying or recently graduated in CS, data science or similar. Curious, ambitious and willing to learn. Good verbal and written English. Team player. Nice To Have Browser automation (Playwright, Puppeteer, or Claude in Chrome / computer use). Built a Claude skill or an MCP server. Experience with Snowflake, Salesforce, or the Slack/Jira APIs. Experience evaluating LLM output systematically (test sets, regression checks). What do we offer? items.desc: Vil du være med til at bringe AI i spil hos ALBOA? ALBOA søger en studentermedhjælper på 12 timer om ugen til AI og BI. Du bliver en central del af ALBOAs AI-udrulning, hvor du udvikler AI-løsninger og pilotprojekter, udarbejder rapporter i Power BI og hjælper dine kolleger godt i gang med at bruge AI i hverdagen. Det er et studiejob, hvor dine løsninger bliver brugt i praksis og hvor du er med fra starten, når vi ruller AI ud i organisationen. Om jobbet Du bliver en del af teamet under stabslederen og arbejder tæt sammen med vores data- og analysekonsulent, som også er din daglige sparringspartner. Sammen omsætter I data og ny teknologi til løsninger, der frigør tid og løfter kvaliteten i opgaveløsningen. Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet: Power BI: udvikle og vedligeholde rapporter og dashboards, datamodeller og datakvalitet Power Platform: bygge automatiseringer i Power Automate og apps i Power Apps, der digitaliserer manuelle arbejdsgange AI-udvikling: lave prototyper og pilotprojekter med AI-løsninger, fx agenter i Copilot Studio og fremlægge resultaterne for vores AI-ekspertgruppe Brugerstøtte: hjælpe kollegerne godt i gang med AI gennem sparring, guides og korte oplæg Dokumentation: beskrive løsninger, datakilder og arbejdsgange, så andre kan drive og videreudvikle dem Du får mulighed for at gøre en mærkbar forskel. ALBOA har ambitiøse mål for at udnytte de muligheder, som AI skaber og du bliver en aktiv del af arbejdet med at omsætte dem til konkrete løsninger, der gør en forskel i hverdagen. Om dig Du studerer på en videregående uddannelse med fokus på data, digitalisering eller business intelligence, fx informationsvidenskab, data science, datalogi, it-produktudvikling eller erhvervsøkonomi med BI-profil. Derudover: har du erfaring eller kendskab med Power BI, herunder datamodellering har du interesse for og praktisk erfaring med generativ AI, fx prompting og brug af AI-værktøjer i dit arbejde forstår du datasikkerhed, GDPR og ansvarlig brug af AI kan du forklare tekniske løsninger, så kolleger uden it-baggrund forstår dem er du selvstændig, struktureret og nysgerrig og god til at gøre en idé til en løsning, der virker i praksis Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med et eller flere af følgende: Power Automate, Copilot Studio, SQL, Python eller boligsektorens systemer, fx EG. Vi forventer ikke, at du kan det hele, så har du erfaring med nogle af områderne og lyst til at lære resten, hører vi stadig meget gerne fra dig. Vi tilbyder Et studiejob på 12 timer om ugen med fleksibel arbejdstid, så jobbet passer med dit studie Daglig sparring med vores data- og analysekonsulent Rigtige opgaver i Power BI, Power Platform og Copilot Studio, som du kan bruge på dit CV Indflydelse på, hvordan ALBOA tager AI i brug og løsninger, som dine kolleger bruger i hverdagen Løn efter overenskomsten mellem Dansk Erhverv Arbejdsgiver for medlemmer af BL - Danmarks Almene Boliger og FAOD, Djøf, DM, IDA. Arbejdssted: Vestergårdsvej 15, 8260 Viby J. Der er dog gode muligheder for hjemmearbejde. Ansøgning og praktisk info Søg stillingen senest 31. december via denne annonce. Vedhæft din ansøgning og dit CV. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ønsker tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt - naturligvis med hensyn til din eksamensperiode. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Mads G. Boldt på mgb@alboa.dk. Om ALBOA ALBOA er en almen boligorganisation i Aarhus og vores opgave er at skabe gode, trygge og betalbare boliger og levende boligområder. De fleste af vores boliger ligger i det sydlige Aarhus, i Viby og Højbjerg, men vi har også afdelinger i Vejlby, Galten og Aarhus C. Hos os er beboerne i centrum. Vi går op i et aktivt beboerdemokrati og vi udvikler vores boligområder i tæt samarbejde med beboere og samarbejdspartnere. Det gælder både den daglige drift, store renoveringer og nye digitale løsninger, der gør hverdagen nemmere. Som medarbejder i ALBOA får du 160 engagerede kolleger og en arbejdsplads, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og ordentlighed hænger sammen. Dit arbejde gør en tydelig forskel for de mennesker, der bor i vores 7.300 boliger.

items.desc: Can the lights really go out in a Security Operations Center (SOC)? Automating individual security tasks is one thing. Building a SOC that can operate autonomously, reliably and responsibly is another. What does an organization need before it can take that step? This master’s thesis is part of ‘Project Lights Out: can the lights go out in the SOC?’ . You will explore how a SOC can detect, investigate and respond to cyberattacks with increasing autonomy. What can the system handle on its own, and when should a security professional step in? Your research helps uncover how a SOC can operate reliably and autonomously, and where human expertise remains essential. The vision of a Lights-out SOC involves the autonomous execution of security monitoring, detection, investigation and response with minimal human intervention. Achieving this vision requires more than automating individual SOC tasks or deploying autonomous AI agents. A fully autonomous SOC depends on a coordinated set of technical capabilities, reliable data sources, integrated security systems, operational processes and governance mechanisms. It also requires clear responsibilities, defined boundaries of autonomy, appropriate human oversight and mechanisms for monitoring and controlling autonomous operations. Current approaches often address individual capabilities, such as detection engineering, threat intelligence processing or autonomous incident response, in isolation. Organizations therefore may lack a comprehensive framework for understanding how these capabilities must interact and which technical, organizational and governance prerequisites must be satisfied before increasing SOC autonomy. Without such a framework, organizations may struggle to assess their readiness, identify capability gaps and determine a responsible path towards more autonomous security operations. The Assignment Develop and validate a reference framework that describes the technical, organizational and governance capabilities required for a trustworthy Lights-out SOC. The framework should define the core capabilities, their relationships and dependencies, the prerequisites for autonomous operation and the governance mechanisms needed to manage autonomy responsibly. It should also provide a structured way to assess organizational readiness and identify gaps that must be addressed before increasing the level of autonomy. Validate the framework through expert feedback and representative SOC scenarios. Evaluate its completeness, clarity, practical applicability and usefulness for assessing SOC readiness and planning a transition towards autonomous operations. The objective is to provide an integrated, system-level reference framework for organizations designing or evaluating a trustworthy Lights-out SOC, rather than implementing or testing a complete autonomous agent or a specific decision-verification mechanism. items.desc: ABOUT US: LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers. Help us build better energy-market forecasts! At London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG), we provide financial-market infrastructure, data, analytics, technology and news to customers around the world. Our Power, Natural Gas, Coal and Carbon Research team has analysed energy and commodity markets since 1998. We work across Gdynia, London, Houston, Singapore, Beijing, Oslo, Tokyo, Lund and São Paulo. Gdynia is one of our key research locations. ROLE PROFILE: We are hiring a Research Specialist, Energy and Coal to develop forecasts, data and analysis for global and regional energy markets. Coal markets are changing as energy security, gas prices, power demand, carbon policy, weather and international trade reshape supply, demand and prices. You will investigate these changes, build models and explain what they mean for market participants. You will take ownership of defined areas of market analysis and model development. Your work will support traders, analysts and other customers who use LSEG data and forecasts to make decisions. We welcome candidates from different professional and academic backgrounds. You may already work with energy or commodity markets, or you may be a data scientist or quantitative researcher who wants to apply your skills to real-world energy questions. You do not need prior coal-market experience. We will help you develop market knowledge if you bring strong analytical skills, programming experience and an interest in energy. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: Analyse coal and energy production, consumption, inventories, trade flows, prices and market balances. Build, test and maintain forecasting models, data pipelines and analytical tools. Use Python, statistics, time-series methods, machine learning and AI to improve forecasts and automate analytical work. Evaluate new datasets, challenge assumptions and identify ways to improve our market coverage. Connect developments across coal, natural gas, power, carbon, freight and weather. Present your findings clearly and work with analysts, data scientists, engineers and product teams across LSEG. You will contribute to short-, medium- and long-term forecasts and help decide how we develop our data, models and research. WHAT YOU'LL BRING: You have an MSc or PhD in data science, computer science, mathematics, statistics, physics, engineering, economics, energy systems, meteorology or another relevant quantitative subject. You can demonstrate: Programming skills in Python, R, MATLAB or a similar analytical language. Experience with quantitative methods such as statistics, time-series analysis, predictive modelling, optimisation or machine learning. The ability to organise, analyse and quality-check complex datasets. The ability to explain technical results to different audiences …

Experience and knowledge of delivering data automation, coding and visualisation tools The ability to translate complex technical evidence into clear, engaging insights and practical recommendations for non-technical audiences Strong collaboration, communication and influencing skills with the confidence to work constructively with suppliers and internal stakeholders. Ability to work consistently at pace, to meet corporate delivery deadlines and priorities. Job Description Are you passionate about data and sustainability? Can you find the story hidden in complex datasets and turn it into insight that drives action? We are looking for a Sustainability Data and Insights Technical Specialist to help us use evidence to accelerate delivery of eMission and EA2030. You will work with large and complex sustainability datasets, identifying trends, opportunities and evidence that help colleagues and suppliers make better decisions and deliver measurable sustainability outcomes. A key focus will be improving how we collect, process, analyse and report our Scope 3 carbon emissions, working collaboratively with our supply chain to strengthen data quality and support decarbonisation. You will: Help mature our Scope 3 data, moving towards more accurate supplier-specific evidence that enables us to understand and drive emissions reductions. Analysing and interrogating sustainability data to identify trends, hotspots, risks, and opportunities for action transforming complex data into clear, compelling stories that drive informed decision-making and support delivery of eMission objectives. Develop clear, accessible reporting and visualisations that turn complex evidence into meaningful insights. Understand and support the management, processing and optimisation of large sustainability datasets and data platforms Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective data products and stories. Responding to incidents is a central part of what we do. You will be asked to have an incident role and make yourself available to respond to incidents or provide business continuity support during an incident. This may attract an additional payment, and full training will be available to support you with your incident role . The team The Sustainable Business Team is a welcoming, collaborative team within Strategy, Transformation & Assurance. We help transform how the Environment Agency operates by embedding eMission, our sustainability strategy, and supporting delivery of EA2030. We work across the organisation and with our supply chain to turn ambition into action: supporting nature’s recovery, accelerating the transition to a circular economy, strengthening climate resilience and reducing our Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions towards net zero. Experience/skills Required The generic requirements are set out in the G5 Business Services job profile. The key competences are: Experience of managing and facilitating data reporting delivery within large scale organisations, ideally within the sustainability field. Experience and knowledge of delivering data automation, coding and visualisation tools The ability to translate complex technical evidence into clear, engaging insights and practical recommendations for non-technical audiences Strong collaboration, communication and influencing skills with the confidence to work constructively with suppliers and internal stakeholders. Ability to work consistently at pace, to meet corporate delivery deadlines and priorities. Contact and additional information You’ll have an EA Office base location; as a national role, the working location is flexible / hybrid. Some national travel and overnight stays may be required. If you have any queries about the role, please contact Laxmi Gurung at Laxmi.gurung@environment-agency.gov.uk. We're going to host a candidate information call about this vacancy on Friday 4th December at 10:00 - 10:45 via MS Teams. items.desc: Job Number BU04144 School/Department School of Computer Science & Engineering Grade 7 Salary Information Salary: £38,784 - £46,049 p.a. (Grade 7) Contract Duration 3 years Responsible to Reader Closing Date 11-12-2026 We are looking for an ambitious early-career researcher with a strong quantitative science and/or engineering background, seeking to establish an independent research profile. Applications are invited for this fixed term (3 year), full-time post working in the Nuclear Futures Institute at Bangor University. The successful candidate will have research interest in one or more relevant areas: uncertainty quantification, error propagation, optimisation, or generative design with experience of how to apply them to engineering problems. The Research Officer (PANDA Fellow), will be expected to produce world-class research whilst pursuing external funding opportunities in support of a permanent academic career. This fellowship is in support of PANDA (the Programme for Accelerating Nuclear Development and Applications), a £24M Nuclear Doctoral Focal Award designed to accelerate the translation of research into licensed industrial deployment across the UK's civil and defence nuclear sectors. In addition to building their own research profile, the Research Officer (PANDA Fellow), will develop and deliver bespoke training to the PANDA cohort in uncertainty quantification and optimisation, working with doctoral students across the partnership to embed the theme of accelerated qualification through statistical and computational methods throughout their research projects. As a visible ambassador for PANDA, the post holder will also support student mentoring, represent the programme at recruitment and outreach events, and engage actively with professional and public audiences through social media and similar channels. Candidates should hold a PhD in a relevant discipline (or be near completion) and will typically have postdoctoral research experience in computational and statistical methods or a closely related field. Candidates with experience of applying these methods in the context of numerical modelling or experimental design are encouraged to apply, in addition to those with a strong independent grounding in the methods themselves. Experience of contributing to doctoral or postgraduate training is desirable. This post is subject to a satisfactory enhanced Disclosure & Barring Service and MoD enhanced BPSS check. The successful candidate will be expected to commence as soon as possible, ready to work with the first intake of PANDA doctoral students. This role will be located on campus in Bangor. Due to the collaborative nature of the role in supporting the development and delivery of the PANDA programme, the expectation is that the successful applicant will spend the majority of their time in Bangor. Regular visits to partner universities, project sponsors and UKNNL will be encouraged and supported. Through our Dynamic Working framework, there will also be the option to spend some time working remotely (although remaining in the UK) to support work life balance, which will be discussed further with candidates at interview. Applications will also be considered to carry out this role on a part-time or job share basis. Applications will only be accepted via our on-line recruitment website, jobs.bangor.ac.uk. However, in cases of access issues due to disability, paper application forms are available by telephoning 01248 383865. Informal enquiries can be made by contacting: Dr Tessa Davey (PANDA Co-Director) Professor Michael Rushton (PANDA Director) panda@bangor.ac.uk, tel: 01248 382 818 or 07519 700615. Closing date for applications: 11 December 2026 Committed To Equal Opportunities Overview The College of Science and Engineering at Bangor University is one of the leading centres in the UK for teaching and research in a range of science subjects. With over 2,500 students and 350 academic, technical and administrative staff, the College consists of three academic schools: Environmental and Natural Sciences; Ocean Sciences; and Computer Science & Engineering. The post is based in the Nuclear Futures Institute (NFI) , located in the School of Computer Science and Engineering in Bangor University's Dean Street building. The School of Computer Science and Engineering at Bangor University is a research-led community with approximately 40 academic staff encompassing a wide range of disciplines from Artificial Intelligence and Pattern Recognition to Data Visualisation; Medical Microwave Electronics and Medical Simulation; Optoelectronics, Broadband and Optical Communications; Organic Electronics; Nanotechnology; Nuclear Engineering; Product Design and more. The city of Bangor is located in an area of outstanding natural beauty, close to the mountains of Snowdonia and the beach resorts of the North Wales coast, and offers a quality of life that surpasses that in the most regions of the UK. items.desc:
Every day, expert reviewers at Meta make high-judgment calls that keep people safe across our apps. Their decisions shape the integrity metrics Meta reports to its leadership and the data our AI systems learn from. As AI takes on more of the straightforward work, the decisions people make are the hardest ones, and getting them right has never mattered more.
As an Expert Integrity Enablement Specialist, you'll be on the frontline making our expert reviewers better. You'll become an expert in a specific set of policy areas that may evolve with business priorities, then use that expertise to onboard new experts, coach them when their accuracy slips, and make sure everyone, whether they’re a full-time employee, contingent worker or vendor partner, is working from the same answer. This isn't a classroom trainer role. You'll own learning and quality together, on the ground, every day. Your job is to help people make better decisions every day. A strong candidate for this role also demonstrates an AI-native mindset, approaching work with curiosity and a bias towards experimentation. They instinctively reach for AI tools, adapt quickly to new workflows, and view AI as a lever for better, faster coaching by rethinking how work gets done.
You'll sit within the Global Operations Learning & Quality organization, whose mission is to be the central human performance engine of Global Operations.
Become and stay an expert in your policy area(s): Earn and maintain expertise in a specific set of policies, including meeting ongoing labeling and quality requirements Onboard new experts: Facilitate the onboarding process for new expert reviewers in your violation groups, taking people from new hire to certified expert. Make complex, sensitive policies clear, engaging, and memorable, in person and virtually Monitor quality and coach to close gaps: Review quality data on expert decisions every day, spot patterns early, and design and deliver personalized remediation, from one-to-one coaching to targeted refresher courses for a group Use and maintain AI coaching tools: Use AI-powered coaching in remediation so that experts get feedback faster and practice on the cases they miss. Keep AI coaches and practice content current as policies change and clarifications are issued Escalate what training can't fix: When a gap isn't a skill issue, such as unclear guidance, a tooling problem or a process gap, escalate it into our performance improvement and insights process with clear evidence, and follow it through to resolution Lead calibration: Run calibration sessions with policy authorities and the Content Policy team to keep everyone aligned on the right answer, and make sure the outcomes reach every expert who needs them Extend the model to vendor partners: Partner with trainers and training teams at vendor sites so they follow the same protocols, tools, and calibration you do. Act as a train-the-trainer and a point of contact for your policy areas
3+ years of experience in content moderation, trust and safety, policy enforcement or a related operations role Demonstrated AI fluency: regularly using AI tools in your day-to-day work to work faster items.desc:
We are building the platforms that power machine-speed security incident response across the world's largest cloud provider. Our automation investigates and remediates security events with minimal human intervention, from initial triage through eradication. We need Software Development Engineers to build the systems that make this possible.
Amazon Security's Operational Research and Development team combines Security Engineers and Software Development Engineers in a single mission: reduce time-to-resolution for security incidents through automation at every stage of the response lifecycle. As an SDE, you will build and operate the core platform infrastructure: workflow orchestration engines, enrichment APIs, knowledge graph pipelines, and the operational tooling that keeps them running in production.
As a Software Development Engineer, you will:
 - Build and maintain production services that underpin security automation capabilities (workflow engine, API gateway, data infrastructure)
 - Write clean, well-tested code in Python and TypeScript, shipping features end-to-end from design through deployment
 - Own the operational health of your services: monitoring, alarming, on-call, and incident response for the platforms you build
 - Work daily alongside Security Engineers who define the investigation logic and response playbooks your platforms execute
 - Contribute to architectural decisions that balance rapid delivery with long-term reliability at scale
 - Support the operation of security services deployed in the European Sovereign Cloud
 - Grow into deeper ownership of systems and broader technical influence across the team
This role is based in Paris, France.
About the team
The Operational Research and Development team sits within Amazon Security. We are a mixed team of Security Engineers and Software Development Engineers who share a single mission: make security incident response so fast and accurate that human involvement is reduced to the decisions that genuinely require judgment.
Our engineers own what they build. Each person carries meaningful end-to-end ownership of production systems, from design through deployment and operational excellence. We prototype rapidly, ship iteratively, and treat every manual step in our response pipelines as a problem to solve permanently.
The team values directness, intellectual honesty, and a bias toward building over discussing. We maintain a flexible, distributed working culture and core collaboration hours that respect personal time.
We are intentional about building an inclusive environment where diverse backgrounds and perspectives drive better security outcomes. Whether your path to software engineering was traditional or not, what matters is your ability to ship reliable systems and collaborate effectively across disciplines.
Why Amazon Security
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.
Training and Career growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

items.desc:
Introduction: 
 As an Applied Physicist, you will join the ATLAS Computing Section, which is responsible for the development, operation, maintenance and future upgrades of the Tier-0 and Rucio data processing/management systems for the ATLAS Experiment. You will be in charge of maintaining, operating and evolving the ATLAS Tier-0 system, overseeing all aspects of central data handling and processing for the ATLAS Experiment, and providing ATLAS physicists with high-quality data products for analysis and searches for new discoveries.
 The ATLAS Tier-0 is the central hub of the ATLAS offline computing infrastructure, responsible for the prompt reconstruction, registration and archiving of raw detector data, as well as its distribution to Tier-1 and Tier-2 centres worldwide. It also supports essential data-preparation activities, including detector calibration, alignment and data-quality monitoring.
 Its critical role in the ATLAS data-processing chain demands reliable, continuous operation, rapid problem resolution and flexible support to meet the evolving needs of the Experiment and its clients and users.
 Functions: 
 Take a leading role, as part of a small team of experts, in the operation, maintenance, and evolution of the Tier-0 system to meet the needs of the ATLAS Experiment, with the goal of providing the physics community with data of excellent quality. This includes contributing to all operational aspects of central Tier-0 data handling and processing.
 Engage with a broad and diverse community of stakeholders and clients (including CERN IT and the ATLAS Trigger/DAQ, Software and Computing, Data Preparation, Physics and Detector communities) to understand their data processing requirements and translate them into solutions implemented within the Tier-0 system.
 Contribute to the maintenance and development of the Tier-0 software suite in response to evolving requirements, as well as to the development of applications, tools and interfaces supporting its operation.
 Take a leading role in the preparation and commissioning of the Tier-0 system for the HL-LHC era. This includes activities like the commissioning of calibration and alignment workflows for the new or upgraded detectors; the implementation of new data handling and data management strategies (with CERN IT, Trigger/DAQ, Rucio); the exploration of possible synergies with the ATLAS Grid Production System; and the development and commissioning of innovative workflows for optimising the usage of computing resources (CPU, memory, storage).
Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Large-Scale Computing-System Operations / Physics, Data Processing or a related field.
 Experience: 
 Experience in the development and operation of large-scale data processing systems for scientific experiments or in comparable industrial environments.
 Experience in supporting a diverse community of stakeholders, including prioritising and balancing competing requirements.
 Proven proficiency in Python, SQL-based databases and Git for version control.
 Familiarity with web interface development technologies (HTML, JavaScript and CSS), including backend frameworks.
 Knowledge of calibration requirements and procedures for particle physics experiments would be an advantage.
 Understanding of configuration management and orchestration tools (e.g. Puppet and Kubernetes) is considered an advantage.
 Technical competencies: 
 Architecture and design of ICT systems: in particular of physics data processing and analysis frameworks.
 Verification and optimisation of ICT architectures and designs.
 Simulation, design and development of data processing and analysis workflows.
 Conceptualising, designing and developing user experiences and interfaces.
 Development of application software.
 Behavioural competencies: 
 Achieving Results: having a structured and organised approach towards work; being able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
 Communicating Effectively: demonstrating a pro-active approach to resolving differences; addressing issues of conflict constructively.
 Demonstrating Accountability: working conscientiously and reliably; delivering on promises.
 Solving Problems: addressing complex problems by breaking them down into manageable components.
 Working in Teams: building and maintaining constructive and effective work relationships.
 Language skills: 
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Join CERN's Experimental Area group and contribute to the development of beamlines and facilities for the next generation of fixed-target experiments. The project you will be supporting is called NA60+.
 You will carry out beam studies, simulate proton and ion beams and their associated backgrounds, and perform shielding optimisation calculations. Working closely with beamline experts and service and equipment groups, you will provide technical input to the design of future experimental facilities.
 Your responsibilities: 
 Conduct beam studies for CERN's North Area secondary beamlines.
 Develop detailed simulations of proton and ion beams and associated backgrounds for the future NA60+ experiment.
 Evaluate and optimise shielding for the upcoming NA61-LE beamline through detailed simulations using the FLUKA Monte Carlo code.
 Collaborate with service and equipment groups to inform the design requirements of the NA60+ experiment.
 Contribute to project technical documentation and present findings at technical and project meetings.
 This role includes team supervision responsibilities.
 More information here .

 Experience performing physics simulations.
 Experience writing technical documentation.
 Skills: 
 Knowledge in at least one of the following Monte-Carlo and accelerator optics codes: Geant4, FLUKA, BDSIM, MADx, Xsuite.
 Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and international environment.
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria: 
 You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

 or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

items.desc:
As a superconducting magnet engineer in the Large Magnet Facility (LMF), you will contribute to the development of next-generation high-field accelerator magnets.
 Working in close collaboration with the Superconducting Magnet Technology section and international partners, you will combine numerical modelling, experimental analysis and hands-on engineering to support the design, fabrication and qualification of Nb3Sn magnet prototypes for future accelerators.
 Your responsibilities: 
 Contribute to the design and development of high-field superconducting accelerator magnets, with a particular focus on mid-length Nb3Sn prototypes.
 Perform electromagnetic and mechanical analyses using numerical modelling tools to support magnet design, optimisation and performance assessment.
 Build on experience and know-how from previous Nb3Sn magnet production and apply it to future magnet technologies.
 Follow the fabrication, assembly, instrumentation and testing of magnet prototypes, and contribute to the interpretation of experimental results.
 Participate in R&D activities aimed at improving superconducting magnet technologies through mock-ups, demonstrators and dedicated experimental campaigns.
 Your profile: 
 Finite-element analysis and numerical modelling of complex engineering systems.
 Electromagnetic and/or mechanical design of superconducting magnets or comparable high-performance devices.
 Analysis and interpretation of experimental or instrumentation data.
 Engineering documentation and technical reporting.
 Knowledge of superconductivity and superconducting magnet technologies would be an asset.
 Skills: 
 Knowledge of finite-element and multiphysics simulation tools (e.g. ANSYS, OPERA, ROXIE, COMSOL).
 Knowledge of electromagnetic and mechanical design principles.
 Ability to analyse test data and validate numerical models.
 Scientific communication skills, including technical reporting and presentations.
 Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams.
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria: 
 You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .
 You have a professional background in Mechanical Engineering (or a related field) and have either: a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

items.desc:
TELEFÓNICA EDUCACIÓN DIGITAL, S.L.U. es una empresa del Grupo Telefónica, especializada en ofrecer soluciones integrales de aprendizaje online para la Educación y Formación, con más de 15 años de experiencia en el mercado nacional e internacional, Telefónica Educación Digital desarrolla procesos de aprendizaje de alto impacto en personas y organizaciones. B uscamos personas con inquietudes, ganas de aprender y de desarrollarse en un entorno de trabajo que valora la participación activa de ideas nuevas. La persona seleccionada se incorporará a un equipo profesional, consolidado y pionero en el aprendizaje online. 
 Su sede central está ubicada en España, dentro del Distrito Telefónica en Madrid. 
 PUESTO : Prácticas - Apoyo Gestión Administrativa - Talent Pool 
 Vacante no activa, Cuando estemos en búsqueda activa, valoraremos las candidaturas. 
 Para esta posición buscamos una persona con la posibilidad de realizar un contrato en prácticas. Deberá ser proactiva, con habilidades para trabajar de manera autónoma y en equipo, con una mentalidad de mejora continua y aprendizaje. Además, debe tener un enfoque analítico y orientado a la resolución de problemas.
 FUNCIONES 
 · Gestión y manejo de CRM .
 · Matriculación y verificación de alumnos en plataforma de formación.
 · Elaboración y gestión de documentación administrativa relacionada con los cursos.
 · Seguimiento y coordinación mediante llamadas telefónicas con formadores de las diferentes AAFF. 
 · Coordinación con el equipo docente y técnico.
 · Atención y resolución de consultas de formadores y coordinadores asignados
 FORMACIÓN REQUERIDA 
 FP en Administración y/o Certificado profesional de rama administrativa 
 COMPETENCIAS 
 · Habilidad para identificar y solucionar problemas
 · Correcta Gestión del tiempo
 · Flexibilidad y adaptabilidad
 · Capacidad para colaborar con otros profesionales
 · Habilidad para transmitir información de manera clara y concisa
 CONOCIMIENTOS TÉCNICOS E INFORMÁTICOS 
 · Paquete office
 · Valorable conocimiento de aplicativos de gestión de formación : SFOC, FUNDAE, ó cualquier CRM de gestión
 A la hora de rellenar el formulario, no es necesario completarlo todo, solo los campos obligatorios. Sí necesitamos tu CV y contestación a las preguntas planteadas. ¡Gracias!
 ¿POR QUÉ TELEFÓNICA? 
 Si te unes a Telefónica, te unes a una de las empresas tecnológicas TOP TEN para trabajar en España y a un equipo que no deja de reinventarse cada día para ser líder en su sector. 
 Y es que, en Telefónica, creemos firmemente que son las personas como tú las que dan sentido a la tecnología y no al revés. Queremos hacer nuestro mundo más humano, conectando la vida de las personas. Y por ello, aspiramos a digitalizar a toda la sociedad, sin dejar a nadie atrás. 
 En Telefónica creemos firmemente que promover la diversidad y la inclusión es una gran oportunidad para conectar talento, crecer como compañía y como sociedad. Hay un lugar en Telefónica para todos los tipos de talento, por encima de todo buscamos diversidad de talentos ¿Cuál es el tuyo? 
 Es necesario que conozcas los Principios de Negocio Responsable que apliquen a tu ámbito de responsabilidad. Buscamos profesionales confiables, con integridad, que se comprometan con una gestión ética y transparente, promoviendo un desarrollo social y ambiental más justo y sostenible.

items.desc:
Telefónica Soluciones Outsourcing es una compañía, creada en el año 2003, a la vanguardia de la tecnología en España. Ofrecemos gestión de infraestructuras y servicios TIC, para los clientes del Grupo Telefónica. Destacamos por la reacción inmediata ante las necesidades de los clientes y su flexibilidad ante los frecuentes cambios del mercado actual, así como aportamos #estabilidad laboral a nuestros profesionales. 
 Los proyectos que se realizan son muy variados, pero todos con un indicador común: el objetivo final es ser el asesor técnico de confianza a alto nivel de nuestros clientes y generar un alto impacto con los proyectos en los que nos involucramos. 
 LUGAR DE LA BECA: MADRID 
 HORARIO: PARTIDO
 QUÉ RETOS ENFRENTARÁS EN TU DÍA A DÍA:
 Aprenderás a gestionar los servicios de comunicaciones para los clientes del sector de Empresas de Telefónica mientras desarrollas tus capacidades técnicas ante las tecnologías más innovadoras. 
 Colaboración en algunas de las siguientes actividades: 
 Atención e interlocución con el Cliente. 
 Coordinación y seguimiento actividad del centro técnico que da respuesta a las necesidades de cliente. 
 Desarrollo y coordinación de proyectos de despliegue de tecnología. 
 Apoyo técnico y asesoramiento al Cliente sobre los servicios o nuevas propuestas de soluciones. 
 Análisis de indicadores de calidad, identificación de problemas y propuestas de mejora. 
 Interlocución con las áreas internas de Telefónica para dar respuesta a las necesidades del Cliente. 
 FORMACION: 
 Haber finalizado Ciclo Formativo de Grado Superior / Grado Universitario / Máster o tener previsto finalizarlo en el transcurso de la beca de 9 meses en algún centro docente español reconocido oficialmente. 
 Valorables certificaciones oficiales de Cisco CCNA, CCNP o similares de este sector. 
 Nivel mínimo B2 de inglés. 
 CONOCIMIENTOS: 
 Valorable en redes LAN, WAN, VoIP, SDN 
 EXPERIENCIA: 
 ¡Buenísimas noticias! No se requiere experiencia, solo muchas ganas. 
 IDIOMAS: 
 Nivel mínimo B2 de inglés. 
 HABILIDADES Y COMPETENCIAS QUE DESARROLLARÁS DURANTE LA BECA:
 Trabajo en equipo. 
 Adaptación a los entornos cambiantes. 
 Toma de decisiones. 
 Comunicación efectiva. 
 Proactividad. 
 Pensamiento crítico. 
 Ética profesional 
 ¿QUE ESPERAMOS POR TU PARTE? 
 Pasión por la tecnología. 
 Proactividad. 
 Muchas ganas de asumir retos. 
 Colaboración y trabajo en equipo 
 ¿QUÉ TE OFRECEMOS? 
 En Telefónica Soluciones de Outsourcing, sabemos que el talento joven es el motor del futuro. Por eso, hemos diseñado un programa de becas que no solo te ofrece una oportunidad profesional, sino una experiencia transformadora.... Por ello, estas son algunas de las cosas que te esperan: 
 Flexibilidad Horaria: 35 horas semanales, adaptándonos a tus necesidades y compromisos académicos. 
 Apoyo Económico: Sabemos que estudiar y trabajar puede ser un reto, por eso te ofrecemos una ayuda al estudio de 1.200 euros brutos para que puedas concentrarte en lo que realmente importa: tu desarrollo profesional. 
 Duración y Oportunidades: La beca tiene una duración de 6 meses prorrogable a 9 meses. 
 Modalidad Smart Work: Basada en la confianza y objetivos globales. Contamos con flexibilidad para trabajar en un equipo dinámico y creativo. 
 Proyectos Reales: Participarás en proyectos innovadores que tienen un impacto real en la empresa y en nuestros clientes. ¡Tu trabajo marcará la diferencia! 
 Formación Continua: Acceso a cursos y formaciones para que sigas aprendiendo y mejorando tus habilidades. ¡Siempre apostando por tu desarrollo! 
 Ambiente Colaborativo: Únete a un equipo de profesionales con pasión y talento, donde la colaboración y el intercambio de ideas son la clave del éxito. 
 A TENER EN CUENTA… 
 Los títulos obtenidos fuera de España serán admitidos siempre y cuando estén homologados o cuenten con la declaración de equivalencia otorgada por el Ministerio de Educación y Formación Profesional. 
 Las titulaciones deberán acreditarse mediante exhibición de original o copia legitimada en el momento del proceso. 
 Las personas candidatas que no tengan nacionalidad española deberán aportar: 
 Certificado de inscripción en el Registro Central de Extranjeros. 
 Tarjeta de Identidad de Extranjero (TIE) en vigor o solicitud de prórroga. 
 Visado en vigor y documento que acredite el Número de Identidad de Extranjero (NIE).
 #SomosDiversos 
En Telefónica queremos que tu candidatura sea tratada desde la normalidad y la igualdad de oportunidades. Apostamos por un entorno de trabajo diverso e inclusivo, en el que cada persona sea valorada por su talento y pueda sentirse respetada y libre de ser quien es. Creemos que la diversidad nos hace más innovadores, transformadores y capaces de construir un futuro mejor.
 ¿Te apuntas a esta aventura? 
 ¡Súmate al equipo de Telefónica Soluciones de Outsourcing! ¡Estamos deseando conocerte!

Así, tanto nuestros clientes, como aquellos de otros operadores, podrán disfrutar de la mejor experiencia. Crecemos, nos simplificamos y mejoramos. 
 Postproducción de proyectos de Ficción 
 Contrato: interinidad 
 Grupo profesional: Grupo II 
 Fecha Prevista: a tratar en la entrevista 
 Tu misión 
 Coordinar y supervisar los procesos de postproducción de contenidos audiovisuales, garantizando el cumplimiento de los plazos, requisitos técnicos, estándares de calidad y entregables para su emisión y distribución en plataformas OTT y televisión, actuando como enlace entre productoras, laboratorio digital y equipos internos para asegurar la correcta ejecución de cada proyecto. 
 Funciones y responsabilidades: 
 Planificación y control de proyectos 
 Analizar la viabilidad de los calendarios de postproducción, evaluando los tiempos y necesidades de montaje, etalonaje, sonido, VFX, control de calidad, masterización y verificación interna. 
 Revisar y analizar las partidas de postproducción de las distintas versiones presupuestarias, valorando su adecuación a las necesidades operativas de cada proyecto. 
 Identificar riesgos que puedan comprometer los plazos de entrega para emisión y los diferentes departamentos y proponer alternativas. 
 Participar en las reuniones de arranque y seguimiento de proyectos 
 Supervisar el cumplimiento de todos los hitos de las diferentes fases de postproducción del proyecto. 
 Gestión de materiales y entregables 
 Adaptar, mantener actualizada y compartir la documentación relativa a los requerimientos de postproducción para cada tipo de contenido y asegurar el cumplimiento de los mismos. 
 Realizar el seguimiento de procesos de control de calidad (QC) e incidencias hasta su resolución. 
 Coordinar y supervisar los deliveries destinados a emisión. 
 Coordinar los flujos de trabajo y procesos de postproducción entre productoras, laboratorio digital y departamentos internos, asegurando el cumplimiento de los plazos y requisitos de cada área. 
 Realizar el seguimiento de presupuestos y facturación de todos los trabajos realizados con el laboratorio digital. 
 Gestión de plataformas y herramientas 
 Configurar proyectos, perfiles de usuario y permisos en plataformas de gestión de producción y postproducción. 
 Gestionar incidencias técnicas y modificaciones de usuarios y perfiles. 
 Mantener actualizadas dichas plataformas con la información de postproducción relativa a cada proyecto. 
 Participar en la evaluación y prueba de nuevas funcionalidades para la optimización de herramientas y flujos de trabajo de dichas plataformas. 
 Reporting y mejora continua 
 Elaborar informes periódicos de actividad y estado de proyectos. 
 Identificar oportunidades de optimización operativa y proponer mejoras de proceso. 
 Participar en reuniones periódicas de estatus, planificación y coordinación interdepartamental. 
 Dar soporte técnico y operativo a productoras, proveedores y equipos internos. 
 Experiencia Deseada 
 Experiencia en supervisión, coordinación o gestión de proyectos audiovisuales en la fase de postproducción. 
 Conocimiento sobre flujos de trabajo de series, cine y contenidos a plataformas OTT y televisión.

 Capacidad para trabajar simultáneamente en múltiples proyectos con calendarios, necesidades, requisitos y prioridades diferentes. 
 Nivel avanzado de Excel.

¿QUÉ ES TELEFONICA TECH? 
 Telefónica Tech es la compañía líder en trasformación digital del Grupo Telefónica. Contamos con una amplia oferta de servicios y soluciones tecnológicas integradas de Ciberseguridad, Cloud, IoT, Big Data, Inteligencia Artificial y Blockchain, con la que acompañamos a nuestros clientes en su transformación digital. 
 Somos un grupo de más de 6200 personas valientes que trabajamos a diario desde distintos puntos del mundo para alcanzar la excelencia, a través de un liderazgo basado en la transparencia y en el espírItu de equipo. Si te identificas con nuestros pilares, ¡estamos deseando conocerte! 
 www.telefonicatech.com 
 ¿QUÉ HACEMOS EN EL EQUIPO? 
 En la unidad de CONSULTORÍA CÍBER de Telefónica Cybersecurity & Cloud Tech trabajamos en el desarrollo de proyectos que asesoran a nuestros clientes sobre múltiples aspectos de la Ciberseguridad como, por ejemplo: 
 - la simulación de crisis y retos capture the flag en todas sus categorías; 
 - el desarrollo seguro de software (SDLC); 
 - la evasión de sistemas de Seguridad; 
 - la seguridad en Directorio Activo (AD); 
 - evaluaciones de forensic readiness; 
 - evaluación a CSIRTS y SOCS; 
 - el bastionado de equipos e infraestreucturas; 
 - la seguridad en microservicios (ej. Kubernetes); 
 ¿CÓMO SERÁ TU DÍA A DÍA? 
 Vas a desarrollar funciones de Consultor de Ciberseguridad, tanto en la ejecución de proyectos de Consultoría Ciber, como en el soporte a la preventa de servicios de Consultoría Ciber. 
 En el soporte a la preventa de servicios de consultoría cíber, tu misión será: 
 La participación en defensa de ofertas, incluyendo la elaboración de presentaciones, y la presentación en reuniones con cliente. 
 Debe de tener la capacidad de acudir a eventos con cliente para apoyar a las áreas comerciales del grupo Telefónica. 
 En la ejecución de proyectos de consultoría cíber, tu misión será: 
 Desarrollar proyectos de consultoría en ciberseguridad, con el resto del equipo de consultoría. 
 Gestionar ante el cliente la ejecución de proyectos que le sean asignados. 
 Reportar sobre el estado y ejecución de los proyectos que le sean asignados. 
 Los tipos de proyectos podrán incluir los descritos en “Qué hacemos en el equipo?” y otros nuevos pues el área de Consultoría está en plena evolución y crecimiento. 
 Y PARA ELLO, CREEMOS QUE SERÍA IDEAL QUE CONTARAS CON… 
 Experiencia 
 Todos los candidatos deberán justificar al menos: 
 5 años como consultor de ciberseguridad. 
 Experiencia de al menos 3 años como arquitecto DevSecOp y análisis de código estático. 
 Conocimientos técnicos (valorables) 
 Se valorarán conocimientos en cualquiera de las siguientes disciplinas, como Consultor: 
 Desarrollo seguro del ciclo de vida de software. 
 Modelado de Amenazas. 
 Herramientas de análisis estático de código. 
 Herramientas de análisis dinámico de código. 
 Para desempeñar el rol, las skills que encajarían con el equipo y el proyecto serían : 
 Este perfil Consultor requiere de una persona con carácter, atrevida y proactiva. 
 Se valorarán las siguientes certificaciones en vigor. 
 Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP) 
 Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP)

items.desc:
The Facilities (FCM) Engineer is responsible for monitoring, supervising, and evaluating performance of contractors who provide maintenance, repair, and replacement of FCM equipment and systems; production equipment installation and moves; and construction activities. 
 ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
 Review work completion data and contractor recommendations for changes to PM procedures.
 Review equipment logs to evaluate trends and make recommendations to reduce operating costs and downtime
 Review production downtime data and performs or participates in root cause analysis to reduce downtime due to facilities failures. Ensure lessons learned are shared with all applicable parties.
 Review FCM KPIs. Recognize and act on negative trends and recommend or implement corrective action.
 Review maintenance reports (predictive and preventive) and make recommendations based on data to improve equipment performance and reduce downtime
 Ensure compliance with KPIs to include PM completion, schedule compliance, unscheduled work, and overtime
 Screen new work requests to determine scope of work, urgency, priority, etc., and assign to contractor best suited based on capability, availability, and cost
 Conduct weekly planning and scheduling meetings to include activities by all FCM contractors
 Make recommendations for strategic equipment or system repair or replacement. Obtain budget estimates and update the FCM project backlog files
 Assist FCM Engineers in project planning and scope development
 Provide project support as needed on weekends or holidays
 Participate in department continuous improvement initiatives
 Perform N93 contractor monitoring. Ensure compliance with applicable laws and Bosch policies regarding health, safety, and environment. 
 Ensure work product conforms to Bosch standards and established scope of work. 
 Perform audits of completed work to include work quality, completeness with regard to scope, thoroughness of documentation
 Perform 5S and safety audits of contractor work areas to include office, shop, and storage
 Perform audits of contractor invoices and work output to verify accuracy of cost data.
 Perform work observations and make recommendations to project manager to reduce execution time and cost, or to improve work quality
 Provide direction to contractors as needed to solve problems or clarify issues
 Coordinate with others (production, logistics, HSE, etc.) to obtain downtime, permits, etc.
 Attend meetings as required to coordinate with FCM engineers and project managers to include planning/scheduling and team board meetings
 Enter requisitions to purchase services and materials, approves invoices, and tracks remaining balances to ensure compliance with purchasing policies
 Complete required procedure to document fire alarm impairment and restoration of normal system operation
 KSAs: 
 Familiar with operation and maintenance (preventive and predictive) techniques and procedures related to facilities equipment, buildings, and systems. Ability to evaluate work quality of others performing work on these systems.
 Understands and interprets equipment monitoring and controlling software and data to include HVAC, boiler, chiller, and air compressor systems
 Understands and interprets diagnostic preventive and predictive reports to include vibration analysis, oil and water analysis, infrared analysis, etc.
 Understands fire alarm system operation.
 Knowledgeable of applicable safety laws and procedures for general industry and construction (OSHA, NFPA 70E)
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS 
 BS degree in engineering, engineering technology, industrial engineering, operations management, facilities management, or project management.
 2 years of experience supervising skilled trades workers in an industrial and/or facility maintenance and construction environment.
 Proficient in use of standard office software (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
 Experience using computerized maintenance management software (SAP preferred)
 Preferred in addition to the above: 
 3 or more years of experience supervising skilled trades workers in an industrial and/or facility maintenance and construction environment.
 OSHA 10 or 30 hour construction and/or general industry certificate
 OSHA 510 and/or 511 standards for construction and/or general industry
 Certifications related to this role such as CMRP, CPMM, or similar.

items.title: R&D Engineer – Radar vehicle integration (f/m/div.)
items.card: you will help shape the future of automotive technology, ensuring safety and efficiency in vehicle design. Your key responsibilities: Holistic implementation - You will develop solutions tailored to the specific requirements of vehicle design and automotive radar sensor characteristics. Work closely with antenna developers and signal processing experts within an international team spanning development, manufacturing
items.desc:
Make the future a reality: 
 Join a forward-thinking organization dedicated to revolutionizing the automotive industry through innovative radar sensor integration. As a key player in developing models and algorithms and performing measurement and simulation campaigns for vehicle integration of radar sensors, you will help shape the future of automotive technology, ensuring safety and efficiency in vehicle design.
 Your key responsibilities: 
 Holistic implementation - You will develop solutions tailored to the specific requirements of vehicle design and automotive radar sensor characteristics. Work closely with antenna developers and signal processing experts within an international team spanning development, manufacturing and costumer relations, contributing to significant projects that enhance vehicle performance.
 Structure Analysis - You will perform and analyze CST simulations and anechoic chamber measurements of radar integration scenarios behind customer bumpers and covers, evaluate deviations and anomalies in the integration of radar sensors in the vehicle and work towards solutions.
Your Education & Communication Skills: 
 Academic Background – You have a degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Physics or a related field with a focus on high-frequency technology. Strong Communicator – You will perform extensive measurement and simulation campaigns in collaboration with an international team, where you will present findings and elaborate reports, showcasing your English language skills (German is a plus).
 Your Working Style & Mindset: 
 Key Qualities - We seek a resilient, proactive, and communicative individual who thrives in a structured and analytical working environment.
 Experience - Candidates should have 1-3 years of experience in antenna and high-frequency circuit design, along with competence in the use of simulation tools such as HFSS, CST Microwave Studio, and Matlab. Candidates should also have experience in anechoic chamber RF measurements. Experience with 3D printing and CAD is a plus. Experience in performing RF measurements and simulations with vehicle parts is a plus.
 Hands-on mindset – You are comfortable with working with tools to adapt vehicle parts to the measurement setup.
 Problem-Solving Skills - A strong aptitude for constructive problem-solving and troubleshooting, grounded in a solid understanding of physical relationships, is essential for success in this role.
 Collaboration - You work effectively both independently and as part of a team, communicating clearly and building strong professional relationships.
 Attention to detail – You are motivated to meticulously analyze data and assess issues and opportunities to improve radar integration in the vehicle.
 Curiosity & Practicality - You are eager to learn and enjoy hands-on problem-solving.
 Goal Orientation - You remain focused on achieving targets and delivering high-quality results.
 What You Bring to the Team: 
 Personal Strengths - Your independent, goal-oriented approach will contribute to the team’s success in overcoming challenges.
 Unique Contributions - With your background and expertise, you will enhance team dynamics and foster a collaborative environment that values diversity and inclusion.
 Commitment to Excellence - Your analytical mindset and structured working style will drive continuous improvement in radar sensor integration processes, ultimately benefiting our customers and the industry.

You will help customers to shape their 5G Core Network evolution, turning business and technical needs into robust solution architectures and engaging through implementation to help ensure solutions are delivered successfully. Working closely with customers, DSMs (Domain Sales Managers), account teams, and project delivery
items.desc:
About the role 
 We are looking for a customer-focused Core Network Solution Architect . You will help customers to shape their 5G Core Network evolution, turning business and technical needs into robust solution architectures and engaging through implementation to help ensure solutions are delivered successfully.
 Working closely with customers, DSMs (Domain Sales Managers), account teams, and project delivery colleagues, you will act as a technical design authority throughout the opportunity and project lifecycle. You will combine architectural depth with practical delivery experience, communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, and balance customer value with technical feasibility and operational realities.
 What you’ll do 
 Partner with DSMs and take part of the Presales Core 3 team to lead customer discussions, understand network strategy and service requirements, and identify the right solution scope.
 Build solution proposals and RFI/RFP responses, documenting scope, architecture, capacity assumptions, dependencies, security and resiliency considerations, risks and delivery approach with adherence to CSS and Core Network Service Line WoW .
 Guide customers through technical discussions, helping translate their needs, traffic forecasts, service requirements, network strategy and operational constraints into clear solution requirements.
 Design end-to-end mobile Core Network , develop architectures for cloud-native and virtualized CN functions, considering platform choices, capacity, performance, resilience, geo-redundancy, scalability, security and lifecycle management.
 Define integration points and dependencies with RAN, transport, cloud and OSS/BSS and coordinate stakeholders from Service Lines for Core Network led opportunities.
 Align internal contributors ensuring timely and high-quality delivery of agreed deliverables.
 Translate the agreed solution into clear architecture documentation, design decisions, interface definitions, capacity assumptions, non-functional requirements and acceptance criteria.
 Review detailed designs and implementation plans to ensure alignment with the agreed architecture, product capabilities, security requirements and operational needs.
 Support technical issue resolution, risk management and change assessment, explain impacts and recommend practical options when delivery conditions differ from the original assumptions.
 Contribute to migration, cutover and rollback planning, service validation and handover to operations, with a focus on service continuity and customer readiness.
 Provide technical leadership to delivery teams and act as a point of contact for customer architects and project team.
 Capture lessons learned and customer feedback, and share them with sales, management, product unit and project delivery teams to improve future solutions.
 What you’ll bring 
 Broad technical and business understanding of Core Networks concepts, architectures and Core Network business 
 Hands-on Experience in Core Network solution architecture, pre-sales, technical sales or network engineering in the telecommunications industry.
 Strong understanding of mobile packet core architecture and services, with practical knowledge of 5G Core , cloud-native network functions, virtualization, containers and Kubernetes-based environments. Ability to assess end-to-end architectures across Core Network, IMS, RAN, transport and IT/cloud domains.
 Experience taking technical solutions from customer requirements and pre-sales into implementation and delivery, or a demonstrated ability to work effectively across both phases.
 Ability to lead , align, and motivate a team toward shared objectives
 Commercial awareness and the ability to connect architecture decisions to customer value, operational impact and total cost of ownership.
 Join our Team

To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone.  Are you a recent graduate in electrical engineering or a related field, curious about wireless technology and eager to work hands-on in a lab? Join Ericsson’s Radio Verification organization and help design and verify the test environments used to assess the performance of multi-standard radio products.
 As part of the Test Environment 1 team, you’ll work with RF components, measurement equipment and laboratory setups. items.desc:
Join our Team
 About this opportunity:
 Join Ericsson’s Radio Design Digital & FG team in Kista, where we develop the digital hardware domain for radio products. Our goal is to deliver world-class board performance and quality for Massive MIMO and Remote Radio solutions. As a hardware developer with signal and power integrity expertise, you’ll contribute across the product lifecycle, from architecture and design through verification and volume production.
 You will collaborate with colleagues at our sites in Sweden, China, and Canada, and work with external chipset suppliers to align technology development with Ericsson’s needs. We value perseverance, an open mindset, and a can-do attitude, alongside a shared commitment to learning and continuous improvement.

 Contribute to radio hardware design from early architecture through production.
 Run signal and power integrity simulations for mixed-signal digital and analogue boards, helping ensure robust, high-quality designs.
 Investigate and resolve engineering issues during board verification and integration, working with colleagues across teams and sites.
 Collaborate with external chipset suppliers to support technology choices and development.
 Drive continuous improvements to hardware designs, development processes, and product quality.
 Produce technical documentation in line with radio development processes.
 Troubleshoot hardware and support debugging, including analysis of field-return units.

 Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Mathematics, or a related field.
 Knowledge of signal and power integrity and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) principles.
 Experience with simulation tools such as HyperLynx, Ansys, SiSoft, or ADS, and familiarity with schematic and layout tools such as Cadence or Mentor.
 Hands-on experience using lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analysers, and signal source analysers.
 A quality-focused, analytical, and structured approach, with a sense of ownership and a drive to achieve results and improve.
 A collaborative and communicative approach, with an interest in learning, sharing information, and helping others in a diverse, fast-paced team.
 Telecommunications knowledge, or experience in digital, SerDes, high-speed design, and signal or power integrity analysis, is an advantage.
