items.desc: Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default Founded in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN, Proton was built on the belief that privacy is a fundamental human right . What started as an encrypted email service has grown into an ecosystem of privacy-first products, including Proton Mail, VPN, Drive, Pass, and Calendar, used by millions of people worldwide. We're profitable, independent, and building for the long term. Free from venture capital control and advertising-driven business models, we focus on what matters most: our users. Our work helps protect digital freedom, from everyday privacy to supporting journalists and activists in challenging environments. Today, we're an international team of 700+ people, with offices across 9 countries. We have high standards for the people we hire and the work we do. You'll work alongside talented, driven colleagues who challenge each other, take ownership, and care about getting things right. Explore our open-source projects. Your impact: We’re hiring Mobile Product Engineers across different levels of experience, from junior to staff level engineers. Whether you’re looking to take the next step in your career or already have experience leading complex technical projects, we’d love to hear from you. Your scope and level will reflect your experience and the impact you can bring. As a Mobile Product Engineer, you’ll help shape what we build and own work from understanding the problem through to release and improvement. You’ll speak directly with customers, collaborate with Product and Design, and work across the parts of the stack needed to deliver a complete mobile experience. What you will do: Understand and shape the problem: Work with Product, Design and customers to understand user needs, question assumptions and decide what is worth building. Own complete features: Turn problems into practical solutions across clients, services and data. Take work through testing, release and improvement, paying attention to usability, performance and behaviour in production. Build effectively with agents: Define clear tasks, provide context and evaluate generated code. Investigate failures, challenge suggestions and make changes yourself when needed. Improve how software gets built: Turn recurring problems into better agent instructions, tests, tools and automated safeguards. Share improvements that help the whole team. Build for trust: Make privacy, security, reliability and maintainability part of your decisions. Verify important failure cases, communicate what remains uncertain and make sound trade-offs about release readiness. What you will bring: Experience delivering production software: You can explain the problems you solved, the decisions you made and what you learned from maintaining your work after release. Technical depth and adaptability: You have strong expertise in Mobile Development (Android, iOS or both) and can contribute beyond it. You don’t need equal expertise in every layer, but you understand how your work interacts with the wider system. Practical capability with coding agents: You’ve used agents to deliver working software and can explain how you guide them, improve unsuccessful approaches and verify their output. Code fluency and engineering judgement: You can navigate unfamiliar code, trace behaviour, diagnose problems and make precise changes. You can assess an implementation regardless of who — or what — wrote it. Product judgement: You connect technical choices to user needs, care about the quality of the experience and distinguish a useful reduction in scope from a shortcut that puts users at risk. Ownership and collaboration: You move work forward through uncertainty, explain trade-offs clearly, seek out expertise and take responsibility for the outcome. Technical leadership: You’ve led complex projects through ambiguous requirements, made decisions with lasting consequences and helped other engineers develop their judgement while remaining hands-on. Our mobile teams work with Swift and SwiftUI on iOS, Kotlin and Jetpack Compose on Android, and Rust for cross-platform mobile development. You may bring depth in iOS or Android, or experience across both—there’s no expectation that you know every technology we use. The mix of platform focus and cross-platform work varies by team, and we value strong fundamentals and your ability to learn. What we offer: Work that Matters: Millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments. A Great Team: Diverse, collaborative, and tight-knit, with people from MIT, Harvard, Stanford, Caltech, Cambridge, ETH, and more. Technology: The right hardware and software to do your best work. Learning & Development: We invest in your growth. Proton is one of the fastest ways to accelerate your career — real challenges, real ownership, from day one. Vous menez une veille active sur les évolutions de la data analyse et des innovations technologiques qui lui sont liées. items.desc: About the role Vistex is currently hiring a Cloud Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure Team. The Vistex Cloud Engineer will be primarily responsible for providing automated, highly available cloud infrastructure that will be utilized by internal and external stakeholders. The Cloud Engineer will also be responsible for implementing, monitoring and maintaining Vistex’s cloud-based instances. This is a highly technical, hands-on role with a strong focus on automation, resilient design, and fast deployment of cloud native systems. solutions Enhance and maintain deployment pipelines Understand and implement identity and access management (IAM) for multiple cloud environments Work with cloud-native software-defined networking items.desc: About Rocket Factory Augsburg At Rocket Factory Augsburg (RFA) , we have one clear goal: to create low-cost, flexible, and reliable access to space. We specialize in building small launch vehicles designed to deploy satellites into Low Earth Orbit (LEO) and beyond. Together with you, we aim to revolutionize space services and help improve life on Earth. Sounds interesting? Then join our journey and become part of the team driving the New Space movement in Europe. About the Team Join a team that is shaping the future of European space transportation. In this role, you will take ownership of the electrical infrastructure that powers launch and test operations, from initial concept development through commissioning and operational readiness. You will work on technically challenging projects involving high-reliability power systems, critical infrastructure, and complex industrial environments. Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, operations, and construction, you will play a key role in building and maintaining the facilities that make successful launch campaigns possible. If you are passionate about turning ambitious engineering concepts into safe, reliable, and operational systems, we would love to hear from you. Your Tasks Design, build, and commission electrical control systems for launch and test sites, including control panels, I/O, and field wiring. Contribute to technical requirements for control systems, instrumentation, and electrical interfaces, working with senior engineers and other disciplines. Develop and maintain control system hardware based on Beckhoff PLCs and EtherCAT I/O, from component selection and panel design to integration with sensors, valves, and drives. Create and maintain electrical documentation such as schematics, wiring diagrams, I/O lists, and panel layouts, following team standards. Carry out installation, I/O checks, testing, and commissioning on site, and support troubleshooting and fault investigation during operations. Work with technicians, contractors, and internal teams so systems are built and installed as designed. Report progress, flag technical issues and risks early, and give regular updates to the team lead. Your Qualifications Must-Have Skills Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 3+ years experience designing, building, commissioning, or maintaining industrial control systems. Working knowledge of PLC-based automation, ideally Beckhoff based systems; experience with other platforms is also welcome. Solid understanding of control panel design, including component selection, LV distribution within the panel, protection devices, cable sizing, and earthing/grounding. Familiarity with field instrumentation and actuators (sensors, transmitters, valves, motor drives, VFDs) and their integration into the control system. Ability to develop, review, and maintain electrical documentation such as schematics, wiring diagrams, I/O lists, panel layouts, and technical specifications. Experience supporting systems through the project lifecycle, from design through installation, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting. Ability to work hands-on with hardware, panel wiring, I/O checks, testing activities, and fault investigation. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and multicultural teams. Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken. Nice-to-Have Skills Hands-on experience from university student engineering teams (e.g. rocketry, Formula Student, CubeSat) or research projects involving real hardware, electrical integration, or testing. Substantial involvement can count towards the experience requirement above. Experience with launch, aerospace, energy, process, or other mission-critical industrial environments. Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP). Familiarity with IEC, BS, or comparable international electrical standards (e.g. IEC 60204-1, IEC 61439, BS 7671). Experience with E-CAD tools (e.g. EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical). Experience working with contractors or external engineering partners during installation and commissioning. items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day To support the strategic Germany payroll insourcing initiative under the NEO+ program, Siemens Energy is expanding the Global HR Solutions team to ensure robust, internal control of critical HR systems. To address this business aim, this role focuses on the end-to-end technical configuration, continuous enhancement, and operational support of SAP HCM Payroll (PY) and Time Management (PT) modules nGiven the focus on configuration and compliance, the ideal candidate will have extensive experience in SAP HCM PY/PT, a deep understanding of German payroll and labor regulations, and a proven track record of implementing complex system changes. How You’ll Make an Impact Configure and maintain SAP HCM Payroll (PY) and Time Management (PT) schemas, rules (PCRs), and features according to business specifications. Implement system changes and custom enhancements to support complex German payroll calculations, tax rules, and social security requirements. Design, build, and optimize time evaluation processes, work schedules, and absence quotas within the SAP HCM module. Compliance & Quality Assurance: Analyze legal changes in German tax and labor law to assess system impact and implement mandatory SAP support packages or custom adjustments. Execute comprehensive unit, integration, and regression testing for all payroll and time configuration changes to ensure zero-error payroll cycles. Collaborate with internal auditors and HR payroll teams to validate data accuracy and maintain compliance with statutory reporting requirements. Provide tier-3 technical support for complex payroll and time evaluation errors, resolving system bugs and performance bottlenecks. Translate business requirements from HR department stakeholders into functional and technical specifications for SAP HCM developments. Collaborate with cross-functional IT teams to ensure seamless integration between SAP HCM and external upstream/downstream systems. What You Bring Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience. Hands-on configuration experience in SAP HCM, particularly in the Payroll (PY) and Time Management (PT) modules within Germany, supported by relevant certifications. Strong knowledge of Personnel Calculation Rules (PCR) and Schemas, along with experience in implementing SAP Support Packages and Legal Change Patches (LCP). Fluency in German and English (both written and spoken) is required to effectively manage local legal requirements. HR & Payroll Knowledge: In-depth understanding of German Payroll Legislation, Tax Regulations, Labor Law, Collective Bargaining Agreements, and principles of Time Evaluation and Absence Management. Analytical & Solution Design Skills: Proficient in authoring functional specifications, conducting integration and regression testing, and performing root cause analysis and troubleshooting. items.desc: Job Description: For Airbus Defence & Space in Taufkirchen, we are looking for an IVV Systems Engineer (d/f/m) to join the Systems Engineering MILSATCOM team. The department is developing satellite communication systems for military customers. As an IVV System Engineer (d/f/m), you will work on the IVV & test concept of SBMD, Satellite Communication Systems and the associated Ground- & User Segments, as well as their extensions and modifications. You will be responsible for the IVV and test concept during the implementation phase as well as to be applied after start of routine operations. In the frame of the IVV activities, you will follow the development and acceptance phase from the Request for Proposal (RFP) up to the final acceptance of the ground infrastructure. After acceptance, you will accompany the in-orbit testing of the satellites and the commissioning of the ground- and space segment, i.e. the overall satellite communication system, until it goes live in operations. During the operational phase, you are the technical IVV point-of-contact for any anomalies that might occur and support the technical resolution of the issues. This job combines knowledge of several disciplines with the ability to think outside the box. Your location Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. You are into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options. Your benefits Attractive salary and special payments; 30 days holidays and extra days-off for special occasions; Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects, group wide development prospects; Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, transportation subsidy, employee benefits at cooperating companies; On-site-facilities: Kindergarten close to the site, medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria Compatibility of family & work (job sharing, part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout); Working in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where every voice is heard. Your tasks and responsibilities Requirements engineering with DOORS in the area of IVV for satellite communication systems, theirground segments and lower levels; Conduct and follow-up conceptual IVV activities in the area of satellite communication systems engineering, including but not limited to requirement, interface, user data and management data flow within the ground segment as well as TM/TC interfaces; Establishment of IVV requirement for ground segment items, e.g. ground stations, mission operation center, spacecraft control center, payload control center, networks incl. IT infrastructure as well as data centers; Elaboration of system trade-offs in the area of ground segment IVV engineering and support the overall system architecture IVV definition; Elaboration of verification and validation concept at ground system level and support of relevant testing; Collaborate to and review of the operations concept as well as preparation of operational requirements for the ground segment; Provide technical IVV support to the project managers on planning, contractual changes and risk & opportunities identification. Desired skills and qualifications Diploma/Master degree in Telecommunications, Electronics or other related Engineering disciplines; Profound knowledge of ground segment IVV engineering, i.e. technical interface, data flow (for user and management data) as well as TM/TC engineering (secure and unsecured) Strong knowledge of satellite communication engineering including data flows within the ground segment and between ground and space segment Strong experience in software based systems, networks and IT infrastructure Experience in Ground Station and Satellite Control Center (SCC) IVV engineering; Experience in design, development, integration, verification, and operations of Satellite Communicaton Systems and associated processes and operational procedures Business fluency in English and German. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace. Join us and contribute to digital sovereignty in Europe. With us, you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group. Your Tasks Product vision & strategy: You actively shape the future of several key STACKIT storage products (Object, AI and Cold Object storage) and describe them in a product vision and strategy. Stakeholder Management: You are the central communication point for all relevant stakeholders, such as customers, our sales units and other STACKIT services. You know the needs of our stakeholders and can prioritize them according to their relevance for implementation in order to maximize the added value for our customers as a whole Product development: You are responsible for the development of your STACKIT storage products and their market success. items.card: you will direct end-to-end product assurance across platform assembly, moving seamlessly from component intake through to final deployment validation. Present on the factory floor every day, you will spearhead root-cause defect resolution and architect a high-performing quality management framework designed to drive scalable growth. Responsibilities and Duties Uphold rigorous product standards across assembly,
items.desc: Auterion powers cutting-edge software and hardware platforms for autonomous drones ecosystems. Serving as the QA Production Engineer in our Munich site, you will direct end-to-end product assurance across platform assembly, moving seamlessly from component intake through to final deployment validation. Present on the factory floor every day, you will spearhead root-cause defect resolution and architect a high-performing quality management framework designed to drive scalable growth. Responsibilities and Duties Uphold rigorous product standards across assembly, testing, validation, and sign-off stages for next-generation autonomous platforms. Construct a scalable QA/QC framework aligned with expanding production volumes and rigorous customer or defense audit criteria. Establish and execute comprehensive evaluation routines covering incoming components (airframes, sensors, avionics), assembly stages (workmanship and cabling), and final functional sign-offs. Develop clear inspection standards, manufacturing guidelines, shop-floor check-routines, and robust product tracking mechanisms. Direct root-cause investigations and corrective action initiatives utilizing 8D, 5 Whys, and FMEA frameworks for internal and external issues. Manage supplier quality performance through non-conformance mitigation, corrective measures, and First Article Inspection evaluations. Monitor key production metrics such as FPY, scrap rates, and rework, collaborating cross-functionally with operations, engineering, and supply chain teams. Qualifications and Skills Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, or Industrial Engineering, or equivalent practical background in high-tech fields. Demonstrated experience managing production QA/QC within automotive, robotics, aerospace, or advanced electronics sectors. 3+ years in production quality in aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or electronics. Hands-on inspection of electromechanical assemblies, wiring harnesses, and PCBAs. Fluent with 8D, FMEA, and root-cause tools; can read drawings and schematics. Experience with ISO 9001; aerospace or defense quality standards are a plus. A prevention-over-detection mindset; comfortable working independently in a fast-moving environment. Fluent English; German strongly preferred. Eligible for German security clearance. About Auterion We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems. At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you'll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers' success and to our Winning Culture. Our customers rank among the who's who in the Fortune 50. Ο Ρόλος: Αναζητούμε επαγγελματία μηχανικό ή συναφούς κατεύθυνσης, μ ε τεχνική γνώση και επιχειρησιακή ικανότητα για τον σχεδιασμό, την ανάπτυξη και την επίβλεψη λύσεων σε έργα λιμενικών υποδομών και βιομηχανικού εξοπλισμού. Η θέση εστιάζει στην τεχνική σύνταξη και αξιολόγηση προσφορών για τη διεκδίκηση απαιτητικών διαγωνισμών, στη διαχείριση της εφοδιαστικής αλυσίδας (logistics) και των προμηθειών, καθώς και στην τεχνική υποστήριξη του τμήματος, διασφαλίζοντας την άρτια και στρατηγική υλοποίηση των έργων. Κύριες Αρμοδιότητες: Tendering & Technical Support: Υποστήριξη στη σύνταξη και έλεγχο τεχνικών φακέλων για δημόσιους και ιδιωτικούς διαγωνισμούς, διασφαλίζοντας τη σωστή συγκέντρωση δικαιολογητικών και τη συμμόρφωση με τις προδιαγραφές.Project & On Site Support: Συμμετοχή στην ανάπτυξη, παρακολούθηση και επιτόπια υποστήριξη τεχνικών λύσεων (όπως συστήματα προσκρουστήρων, δέστρες και εξοπλισμός αγκυροβολίας) σε έργα λιμενικών υποδομών και βιομηχανικού εξοπλισμού, από τη μελέτη έως την παράδοση και τοποθέτηση στον χώρο του έργου. Suppliers & Market Research: Υποστήριξη στην επικοινωνία με προμηθευτές και διεθνείς οίκους, καθώς και στην έρευνα αγοράς για εξειδικευμένα υλικά και εξοπλισμό. Team Collaboration & Ownership: Ενεργή συνεργασία με την ομάδα και τα υπόλοιπα τμήματα, αναλαμβάνοντας την ευθύνη (ownership) των ανατιθέμενων εργασιών για την ομαλή ροή των έργων και την τήρηση των χρονοδιαγραμμάτων. Απαραίτητα Προσόντα: Πτυχίο Μηχανικού ή συναφούς πολυτεχνικής ειδικότητας με κατεύθυνση σε λιμενικά, βιομηχανικά ή τεχνικά έργα. Τεχνική Αντίληψη: Ικανότητα ανάγνωσης και ελέγχου σχεδίων (CAD) και τεχνικών προδιαγραφών για λιμενικό και βιομηχανικό εξοπλισμό. Εμπειρία σε Διαγωνισμούς: Εξοικείωση με την ανάγνωση τεχνικών όρων σε δημόσιους και ιδιωτικούς διαγωνισμούς (ΕΣΗΔΗΣ). Υπευθυνότητα & Συνέπεια: Συνεργασία με αίσθηση ownership, προσοχή στη λεπτομέρεια και υπευθυνότητα στην ολοκλήρωση των καθημερινών εργασιών. Επικοινωνία : Καλή γνώση τεχνικής ορολογίας στα Αγγλικά για την επικοινωνία με κατασκευαστικούς οίκους του εξωτερικού.. Παροχές: Σταθερή αμοιβή, πλήρως εναρμονισμένη με την εμπειρία και τις απαιτήσεις της θέσης. Παροχή Ticket Restaurant Ολοκληρωμένη Ιατροφαρμακευτική Περίθαλψη: Ιδιωτικό πρόγραμμα ασφάλισης και παροχές υγείας Ηγετική Παρουσία & Εξωστρέφεια: Εργασία σε μια κορυφαία εταιρεία του κλάδου με έντονη διεθνή δραστηριότητα και συμμετοχή σε εμβληματικά έργα υποδομής. Σημείωση: Παρακαλούμε να υποβάλετε την αίτησή σας μόνο εάν καλύπτετε τα παραπάνω απαιτούμενα προσόντα.

items.desc: EFA GROUP comprises companies in Aerospace, Security, Defense, and Industrial Cooperation with a solid international presence. EFA GROUP currently employs more than 400 people , the majority of whom are engineers and scientists. Headquartered in Greece, the Group maintains a strong international presence across Europe (Cyprus, Belgium, Switzerland, Estonia, and Germany), Asia (Singapore, Indonesia, and South Korea), the Middle East (UAE), and the United States , serving customers in 34 countries worldwide. The GROUP includes EFA VENTURES (Supply Chain Management and integrated services), AEROSPACE VENTURES (Industrial Participation and related services), SCYTALYS (Systems Integration and Software), ES SYSTEMS (MEMs & IoT Integration), EPICOS (Global Defense B2B Information Platform), UCANDRONE (Unmanned Systems), AETHER AERONAUTICS (Target Drones), STHENOS AI (Intelligence Solutions), THYREOS CYBER (cyber security) , SUPERIOR AIR (aviation services and specialized aerial missions), SSMART (defense hardware - software production and services). SCYTALYS is a leading defense software development and systems integration company, founded in Greece in 1993. Serving customers in the Aerospace, Defense, and Security sectors, the company delivers advanced software solutions focused on interoperability, situational awareness, and mission effectiveness. Its expertise spans Tactical Data Links, Command & Control (C2/C4I) Systems, Training, Testing & Simulation, and Surveillance & Reconnaissance solutions. The Role SCYTALYS is looking for a skilled Platform Integration & Verification Engineer to support the installation, integration, verification, and customer acceptance of mission-critical solutions across target platforms and system environments. The successful candidate will work across software, hardware, networks, interfaces, and operational workflows to ensure systems are configured, tested, documented, and ready for acceptance. This hands-on role spans requirements analysis, solution configuration, end-to-end testing, field activities, and customer support. Key Responsibilities Support the analysis of system requirements, design documentation, interface specifications, and customer acceptance criteria Define and evaluate the selection of hardware, software, and other third-party components including supplier quote reviews Plan and perform system installation, integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting on target platforms Coordinate on-site integration and installation activities with subcontractors and project stakeholders Define, maintain, and execute system-level test plans, procedures, test cases, and acceptance scenarios Perform end-to-end verification across software, hardware, networks, interfaces, and external systems Set up and maintain test environments, configurations, test data, and tools for integration, regression, and acceptance testing Capture and analyse test results, report discrepancies, support defect investigation, and verify corrective actions Prepare and support Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and On-Site Acceptance Tests (OSAT) Validate interfaces, connectivity, data flows, operational scenarios, and interoperability across multiple systems and networks Produce and review technical documentation, including Bills of Material, installation manuals, cabling diagrams, maintenance manuals, configuration records, and test evidence Conduct site surveys and prepare related technical reports Requirements 3+ years of experience in system integration, validation, verification, field engineering, or acceptance testing of electronic, software, networked, or mission-critical systems BSc degree in Electronics, Computer, Software, Systems, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience will also be considered Hands-on experience troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and configuration issues Strong understanding of requirements-based verification, test planning, test procedures, test reporting, requirements coverage, and traceability Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, including manuals, datasheets, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), and test specifications Working knowledge of Linux and networking fundamentals Experience using design, documentation, configuration, requirements-management, issue-tracking, or test-management tools Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills Fluency in English, written and spoken Availability to travel to customer and installation sites when required Experience in defense systems, virtualisation, RF fundamentals, test automation, or test and measurement instruments will be considered an asset Familiarity with NATO standards, STANAGs, and airborne, naval, or land-platform environments will be considered an advantage Experience with simulation tools will be considered a strong plus

items.desc: Job ID REF15558I Job Description As Associate, Software Developer (Toll), you will join our engineering team in developing robust, scalable, and mission-critical software for toll collection and transportation management systems. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in backend and/or embedded software development, a good understanding of toll domain concepts or eagerness to learn fast, and a passion for solving complex real-world problems with clean, efficient code. You will work closely with project managers, team leaders, software developers, systems support professionals, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth and timely delivery of our technology solutions. We are seeking a long-term full-time employee for this role to help deliver and support state-of-the-art systems. Responsibilities: Write clean and maintainable code that you and your colleagues will enjoy Obtain and retain product knowledge for the Toll Collection System. Implement solutions to efficiently resolve bugs or issues in the existing product code (especially for the Toll Collection System). Participate in the design, development and delivery of new software products or product functionalities (in priority for the Toll Collection System). Participate in the refinement of the vision. Review existing code as well as code changes to identify and register ‘technical debt’ eligible for refactoring. Assist (when required) software development lead, project managers and other team leaders in scope verification, effort estimations and planning/scheduling for the support of the existing product code’s deployments as well as the implementation of new software products or product functionalities. Follow management meeting outcomes and provide insight, assessment and estimations on software related subjects when needed. Attend technical meetings and follow meeting outcomes. Organize internal team meetings to manage day-to-day operations. Continuously pursue compliance to software principles and quality. Support knowledge sharing meetings to advance team skills. Qualifications University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in software development, preferably with enterprise or distributed systems, or in tolling, intelligent transportation systems (ITS), or similar industries. Good knowledge of .Net/C#. Knowledge of other object-oriented programming languages (e.g. Java, Python) will be valued. Familiarity with C++. Good knowledge of software version control tools (e.g., Git). Adequate experience with database systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL) and ORMs (e.g. Entity Framework). Experience with containerization (e.g., Docker), or cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure). Familiarity with Agile or Scrum development methodologies. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub, Azure DevOps) Familiarity with Asp.Net, web services, REST APIs, and message-based architecture. Familiarity with SOLID principles Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills. Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. Some experience on the following technologies will be considered as an additional asset: Experience with Angular / Ionic technologies Experience working with toll collection protocols (e.g., ISO 18000-6C, DSRC, RFID, ANPR). Knowledge of transaction processing, reconciliation, and financial reporting systems. Understanding of security and privacy requirements in tolling or transportation systems. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We believe that by working together diverse people with different experiences develop the most innovative ideas. Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the heart of how we improve quality of life and we work closely with our people across six ED&I Workstreams: Age, Disability, Faith, Gender, LGBT+ and Race. items.desc: As an Application Test Engineer, you will be a pivotal member of our team, ensuring the reliability and exceptional user experience of our products. Your contributions will directly enhance the performance and satisfaction of our broadband and cloud-based connectivity solutions, making a tangible and positive difference in the lives of our customers. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate with a talented and diverse group of individuals, fostering an environment of innovation and excellence. Develop and execute comprehensive test plans for application QA and verification on broadband CPEs, ensuring optimal performance and an exceptional user experience. Create and implement innovative test plans for service QA and verification on cloud-based home connectivity management solutions, enhancing the reliability and efficiency of our services. Build efficient automation pipelines using industry-standard frameworks like ROBOT and Cucumber, streamlining the testing process and improving overall efficiency. Document and report test results with clarity and precision, providing valuable feedback to stakeholders, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives. Collaborate closely with the development team, offering technical expertise and creative solutions to resolve complex issues, and consistently enhance product quality. Stay abreast of the latest industry trends and technologies, continuously upgrading your skills and knowledge to maintain a competitive edge. Foster a culture of quality and excellence, promoting best practices, and ensuring our products meet the highest industry standards. Must-Have University degree in Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering or relevant field. Experience in developing and executing test plans for application and service QA, with a focus on broadband and cloud-based solutions. Experience in automation frameworks such as ROBOT or Cucumber, demonstrated through a track record of building efficient automation pipelines. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, evidenced by a history of identifying and resolving complex technical issues. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven track record of effective teamwork. Nice-to-Have Prior experience with broadband connectivity CPEs (Optical, 5G and/or WiFi gateway devices) is advantageous. A passion for continuous learning and a commitment to staying updated with the latest technological advancements. A proactive and innovative mindset, always seeking opportunities to improve processes and enhance product quality. Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world. Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world. Learn more about life at Nokia . Our recruitment process We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect. If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity. The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .

items.card: In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful difference by working with a talented technical team to advocate for the needs of developers, architect scalable content solutions, and deliver high-quality technical documentation for Amazon Stores. The ideal candidate has excellent communication skills and a technical background that enables them to collaborate effectively with Software Engineers,
items.desc: DESCRIPTION Amazon Selling Partner Developer Services is seeking a customer-obsessed, detail-oriented technical writer to join a team that is redefining how developer content is created, maintained, and scaled. In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful difference by working with a talented technical team to advocate for the needs of developers, architect scalable content solutions, and deliver high-quality technical documentation for Amazon Stores. The ideal candidate has excellent communication skills and a technical background that enables them to collaborate effectively with Software Engineers, Solutions Architects, Product Managers, and Technical Program Managers. As AI tooling reshapes how API documentation is created, reviewed, and maintained, we are looking for a writer who is curious about this shift and eager to develop skills in AI-augmented content workflows. Key job responsibilities Develop technical documentation through close collaboration with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) across engineering, product, and solutions architecture Flexibly alternate between content creation, planning, and editing tasks across a variety of technical content solutions Author content in accordance with established style guides and identify improvements to those standards based on evolving best practices and AI capabilities Manage a weekly work queue of documentation requests, prioritizing based on business impact and developer experience outcomes Proactively identify and implement process improvements and collaborating with the team on implementation Test and use AI-assisted content workflows to improve documentation efficiency and quality, and suggest tool improvements Advocate for improvements to the customer experience and documentation quality standards Identify and appropriately escalate issues that require leadership or cross-team attention About the team The vision of the Selling Partner Developer Services Documentation team is to externalize quality, global API data products with speed and scale via a self-service experience supported by comprehensive, accessible multi-language documentation to simplify building, migrating to, or integrating with Amazon APIs. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, English, Technical Writing, or a related field Experience designing and delivering developer-oriented documentation Experience using tools to create, manage, and publish documentation Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system Experience designing, planning, and delivering content projects Experience working with engineers and subject matter experts to document complex technical topics PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience working with Agile project management methodologies Experience working with Git or an equivalent distributed version control system Experience planning, managing, and delivering customer-focused documentation across multiple teams Experience as a technical editor or writer of technical documentation working with style guides Experience with programming languages such as Python, Java, C++ Subject-matter expertise in API documentation, developer tools, or related technical domains Familiarity with OpenAPI and Swagger specifications Experience with prompt engineering and generative AI platforms Demonstrated ability to evaluate, adopt, and advocate for AI tooling in a documentation or content workflow context Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

items.card: H-EALTH, divisione dell’ecosistema H-FARM con sede nel Campus di Roncade (Treviso), sviluppa soluzioni avanzate per salute, benessere, longevità e assistenza alle persone fragili. items.desc: H-EALTH, divisione dell’ecosistema H-FARM con sede nel Campus di Roncade (Treviso), sviluppa soluzioni avanzate per salute, benessere, longevità e assistenza alle persone fragili. Operiamo all’intersezione tra medtech, assistive technology, sensoristica, Edge AI e piattaforme digitali, con l’obiettivo di creare tecnologie affidabili, sicure e orientate alla persona per pazienti, caregiver, operatori sanitari, RSA, assisted living e assistenza domiciliare. IL RUOLO Siamo alla ricerca di un Data Engineer per costruire e gestire l’infrastruttura dati che alimenta i nostri prodotti AI in ambito sanitario. Qualità, affidabilità e tempestività delle pipeline hanno impatto diretto su decisioni cliniche e pazienti reali. È un ruolo hands-on di ingegneria dei dati. Lavorerai al confine tra sistemi ospedalieri eterogenei, modelli AI e workflow clinici reali, integrando sorgenti dati diverse in architetture robuste, affidabili e on-premise. DI COSA TI OCCUPERAI Progettare, costruire e operare pipeline ETL production-grade che integrano dati provenienti da sistemi ospedalieri eterogenei (gestionali clinici, SAS, database sorgente) con formati, frequenze di aggiornamento e modalità di accesso diverse (API, DB read-only, export schedulato). Progettazione di un livello semantico con definizioni univoche e versionate (ontologie), su cui si basano interrogazioni in linguaggio naturale (text-to-SQL). Garantire qualità, consistenza e affidabilità dei dati attraverso le sorgenti, implementando protocolli di testing, monitoring e validazione. Collaborare con AI engineer, prodotto e stakeholder clinici per tradurre esigenze di dati in architetture robuste e scalabili. Definire e diffondere best practice in data governance, validazione, discoverability e monitoring delle pipeline nel team e con i team partner. Presidiare performance e affidabilità: identificare bottleneck, rispettare SLA in un contesto sanitario dove la freschezza del dato conta. REQUISITI 3-5 anni di esperienza come Data Engineer o ruolo simile in contesti production. Solida conoscenza di SQL/NoSQL, data modeling e integrazione dati da sorgenti eterogenee. Padronanza di Python, Spark/PySpark e almeno un framework o piattaforma big data moderna. Esperienza comprovata in processi ETL, pipeline dati e orchestrazione con strumenti come Airflow o equivalenti. Familiarità con pattern di integrazione dati: REST API, CDC, pipeline event-based, export schedulati. Esperienza con pipeline su dati non strutturati: OCR, estrazione da documenti, trasformazione in dati strutturati. Forti competenze di coding in Python, con esperienza nello sviluppo di API e integrazione di sistemi. Utilizzo quotidiano di coding agent AI (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex o equivalenti) come strumento nativo nel workflow di sviluppo. Esperienza con deployment e gestione di pipeline sia on-premise che cloud (AWS, Azure o equivalenti). Buon inglese tecnico per documentazione e comunicazione. NICE TO HAVE Conoscenza di architetture AI-data: RAG, vector database, embeddings, knowledge graph (es. Neo4j), modelli visivi per strutturare dati da immagini o PDF. Esperienza con standard dati sanitari (HL7, FHIR, OMOP) o sistemi informativi clinici. Familiarità con deployment on-premise e vincoli di privacy in ambito sanitario (GDPR, MDR). Esperienza con Kafka o architetture near real-time e CDC. Healthtech, medtech o ambienti regolati. COSA OFFRIAMO Inserimento in un venture team ad alta autonomia, orientato a MVP, piloti reali e sviluppo di asset proprietari. Possibilità di costruire da zero l’infrastruttura dati di una piattaforma AI sanitaria in crescita. Contesto multidisciplinare: tecnologia, clinica, software, privacy e regolatorio. Percorso di crescita commisurato al contributo e alla responsabilità assunta nel progetto. Inquadramento, retribuzione e modalità di collaborazione da definire in base a seniority, disponibilità e ruolo.

items.desc: Specialista IT e sistemi informativi Sass Dlacia S.p.A. è una realtà in forte crescita nel settore dell’ospitalità, con strutture inserite in contesti di grande pregio e una forte attenzione alla qualità del servizio, all’accoglienza e all’esperienza dell’ospite. Per rafforzare la nostra organizzazione, cerchiamo un/una Specialista IT e sistemi informativi, con esperienza e solide competenze informatiche, da inserire presso gli uffici di Corvara in Badia. La figura collaborerà con la Direzione nella gestione dei sistemi informatici e supporterà gli uffici centrali e le strutture nelle attività quotidiane e nei progetti di digitalizzazione. Seguirà gli interventi assegnati fino alla loro conclusione, mantenendo un raccordo efficace con i responsabili di reparto e i fornitori tecnici. Principali attività La risorsa si occuperà di: fornire assistenza agli utenti su computer, software, stampanti e periferiche, individuando e risolvendo i problemi operativi; gestire Microsoft 365, caselle di posta, account, licenze e strumenti di collaborazione, predisponendo le dotazioni informatiche per i collaboratori; seguire il funzionamento di reti, Wi-Fi, connessioni Internet e accessi remoti, coordinando con i fornitori gli interventi specialistici; curare attivazioni, modifiche e disattivazioni degli accessi secondo le autorizzazioni aziendali, mantenendo aggiornati permessi e configurazioni di sicurezza; verificare l’esecuzione dei backup, partecipare alle prove di ripristino e seguire gli aggiornamenti dei sistemi e dei dispositivi; mantenere aggiornati inventario informatico, licenze, scadenze e documentazione tecnica, segnalando necessità di sostituzione o adeguamento; supportare l’utilizzo e la configurazione di Factorial, Asana, Dropbox e dei gestionali delle strutture, seguendo le richieste di assistenza con i rispettivi fornitori; contribuire al miglioramento dei flussi informativi tra uffici e strutture, realizzando automazioni semplici e collaborando alle integrazioni tra applicativi; supportare i progetti di introduzione ed evoluzione dei gestionali aziendali, collaborando alla raccolta dei requisiti, alla preparazione dei dati e ai test; contribuire all’introduzione di strumenti di intelligenza artificiale a supporto delle attività aziendali, verificandone i risultati e il corretto trattamento delle informazioni; raccogliere preventivi, seguire gli interventi dei fornitori IT e predisporre istruzioni operative e attività di affiancamento per i colleghi. Profilo ricercato Cerchiamo una persona precisa, affidabile e riservata, capace di individuare i problemi, organizzare gli interventi e seguire le attività con autonomia. Il ruolo richiede una buona preparazione tecnica, capacità di stabilire le priorità e disponibilità a collaborare con persone e reparti diversi. È importante saper distinguere le questioni da risolvere direttamente da quelle che richiedono il coinvolgimento di un fornitore specializzato o una decisione della Direzione. Requisiti Diploma di scuola secondaria superiore a indirizzo informatico o affine, oppure laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria informatica o discipline affini. Il possesso del titolo di studio è obbligatorio. Esperienza in ruoli di assistenza informatica o gestione dei sistemi IT aziendali. Buona conoscenza di Windows, Microsoft 365, reti LAN e Wi-Fi. Conoscenza operativa di gestione degli accessi, autenticazione, aggiornamenti e backup. Capacità di diagnosticare i problemi, documentare gli interventi e seguire le attività fino alla risoluzione. Autonomia nell’organizzazione del lavoro e chiarezza nei rapporti con colleghi e fornitori. Riservatezza nella gestione delle informazioni aziendali e personali. Buona padronanza dell’italiano e capacità di comprendere documentazione tecnica in inglese. Disponibilità al lavoro a tempo pieno in presenza presso gli uffici di Corvara in Badia e a effettuare interventi presso le strutture aziendali. Costituiscono titolo preferenziale Esperienza nel settore dell’ospitalità o in aziende con più sedi. Esperienza con gestionali aziendali, migrazione dati o progetti di digitalizzazione. Esperienza con automazioni, strumenti low-code, semplici script o integrazioni tramite API. Esperienza nell’utilizzo di strumenti di intelligenza artificiale a supporto dei processi aziendali. Cosa offriamo Inserimento full time in presenza presso gli uffici di Corvara in Badia. Collaborazione diretta con la Direzione e con i responsabili delle strutture. Un ruolo che comprende assistenza informatica, gestione dei sistemi e sviluppo degli strumenti digitali aziendali. Responsabilità commisurate all’esperienza e possibilità di contribuire al miglioramento dei processi aziendali. Retribuzione commisurata all’esperienza e alle competenze. Tipologia contrattuale e data di inserimento da concordare.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best. LOEWE MAISON Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques. Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work. Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision. Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House. Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force. At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

items.desc: Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden Groeien kan altijd We doen het samen Goede balans tussen werk en privé Goede werksfeer Veiligheid staat op één Je gaat aan de slag binnen Commercie & Business Development van Cluster Energie van Heijmans Infra. Je vormt een hecht duo met de projectontwikkelaar: die brengt het klantprobleem, de klantwaarde en het commerciële traject in; jij onderbouwt de technische haalbaarheid, systeemkeuzes en benodigde budgetten. Samen ontwikkelen jullie de businesscase. Vanuit jouw technische rol verbind je dit werk met ontwerp, engineering, realisatie, exploitatie en technologiepartners. Door kennis en praktijkervaring samen te brengen, ontwikkelen we betaalbare oplossingen en herbruikbare bouwstenen voor volgende projecten. Formele prijs-, contract- en investeringsbesluiten blijven in de reguliere besluitvormingslijnen. Samen werken we slimmer en bereiken we meer. Zo werk jij aan de toekomst van Nederland Samen met de projectontwikkelaar vertaal je klantproblemen naar technische oplossingsvarianten voor lokale energiesystemen. Je beoordeelt de samenhang tussen onder meer netaansluiting, energieopwekking, opslag, laadinfra, energiesturing, distributie en beveiliging. Je toetst de technische haalbaarheid en raamt en onderbouwt per variant het benodigde budget. Aannames, onzekerheden en technische risico's maak je expliciet. Samen met de projectontwikkelaar vertaal je deze onderbouwing naar een businesscase voor de klant. Je maakt inzichtelijk wat extra prestaties, capaciteit of functionaliteit kosten en wat ze de klant opleveren. Je adviseert wanneer een eenvoudiger oplossing volstaat en wanneer aanvullende techniek daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegt. Veiligheid en geldende eisen blijven randvoorwaarden; daarnaast weeg je robuustheid, maakbaarheid en beheerbaarheid mee. Je vertaalt oplossingen naar modulaire systeemarchitecturen, standaardbouwstenen, ontwerpprincipes, technische eisen, interfaces en toetsingscriteria. Zo kunnen ontwerpers en engineers ermee verder, zijn ontwerpen bij andere klanten herbruikbaar en kunnen systemen waar nodig worden uitgebreid. Je voorkomt onnodig maatwerk. Je verbindt commercie en projectontwikkeling vanaf de eerste ontwikkelfase met ontwerp, engineering, realisatie en exploitatie. Je organiseert technische afstemming en borgt ontwerpuitgangspunten en praktijkervaring in reviews, begeleiding, kennissessies en documentatie. Zo blijft kennis niet bij één specialist en worden oplossingen bij ieder volgend project beter toepasbaar. Je werkt samen met Dick, Senior Business development manager: "De technisch meest uitgebreide oplossing is niet altijd de beste keuze voor de klant. We zoeken iemand die kan uitleggen welke techniek nodig is, wat die kost en wanneer eenvoudiger beter is. Samen met de projectontwikkelaar maak je die afweging zichtbaar in de businesscase. En wat goed werkt, vertaal je naar bouwstenen die we vaker kunnen inzetten. Het kan samen!" Heij technisch adviseur grootzakelijk! items.desc: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. Role summary: This role combines hands-on microscopy expertise, application development, customer training, and technical consultation to enable customers to achieve optimal instrument performance and research outcomes. Working closely with internal teams and external stakeholders, the TEM Applications Scientist supports the adoption of advanced microscopy technologies, addresses complex application challenges, and contributes to continuous product and workflow improvements. This is a fully on-site role in Eindhoven. Final candidate must be located in the area. Responsibilities: Provide expert scientific and technical support for advanced Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) systems and associated analytical techniques in Materials Science applications. Conduct high-quality product demonstrations, technical presentations, and application workshops for prospective and existing customers. Deliver comprehensive pre-sales and post-sales applications support, including instrument optimization, workflow development, and troubleshooting. Train customers on advanced TEM operation, imaging, analytical techniques, and best practices to maximize instrument performance and productivity. Support customers in the operation and optimization of image- and probe-corrected TEM systems, including advanced imaging and analytical workflows. Develop, optimize, and demonstrate innovative TEM applications and methodologies to address emerging scientific and industrial challenges. Collaborate closely with sales teams to understand customer requirements, provide technical expertise during the sales process, and support business opportunities. Work with R&D, product management, marketing, and service teams to communicate customer feedback, identify application needs, and contribute to product and workflow improvements. Troubleshoot complex scientific and technical challenges related to electron microscopy applications and provide effective solutions to customers. Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, research institutions, and internal stakeholders, acting as a trusted scientific and technical advisor. Prepare and deliver technical documentation, application notes, training materials, and scientific presentations to support knowledge sharing and customer engagement. Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at scientific conferences, workshops, customer events, and industry meetings to promote advanced microscopy solutions and applications. Stay current with developments in electron microscopy, materials characterization, and related analytical technologies to continuously enhance technical expertise and customer support. Collaborate effectively with global, cross-functional, and multicultural teams to ensure consistent delivery of high-quality applications support and customer satisfaction. Requirements: Typically requires a PhD in a scientific subject area, preferably Materials Science. Hands-on experience in tuning and using Image and Probe corrected TEMs. Knowledge of sophisticated technology and diagnostics as well as operational optimization experience of analytical equipment; specifically electron/ion microscopes and various energy dispersive spectrometers or other analytical techniques required. Excellent, enthusiastic, clear communication skills, both written and verbal, are crucial to the success of this position. Strong presentation and training capabilities for both technical and non-technical audiences Excellent customer interfacing skills a must Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with internal teams and external customers Proven track record to interact with multi-functional and cross-cultural teams Frequent traveling (up to 50%) and ability to travel both domestically internationally, possession of a valid passport. Fluent English required; additional languages beneficial

items.desc: Helse Sør-øst RHF Patolog Offentlig forvaltning Vil du benytte din kompetanse på et sted hvor det virkelig teller? Vi søker ny kollega i vår seksjon som skal ta fatt på et nytt forskningsprosjekt. Institutt for kreftgenetikk og informatikk (IKI) ved Oslo universitetssykehus arbeider med å utvikle og anvende informatikk og avansert bildeanalyse innen digital patologi for å oppnå ny kunnskap som kan bidra til bedre diagnostikk, prognostisering og behandling av kreftpasienter. Instituttet har et tett samarbeid med nasjonale og internasjonale forskningsmiljøer. Seksjon for interfasegenetikk har flere pågående forskningsprosjekter innen blant annet prostata-, tykk- og endetarmskreft og livmorkreft. Prosjektene omfatter både molekylær karakterisering av kreftsvulster og utvikling og anvendelse av kunstig intelligens for analyse av histologiske vevssnitt. Vi søker nå en patolog i 30 % stilling til det treårige forskningsprosjektet «Pan-cancer analysis of vascular invasion using deep learning», finansiert av Helse Sør-Øst. Prosjektet har som mål å utvikle og validere KI-modeller som automatisk kan identifisere karinnvekst i kreftsvulster og skille mellom innvekst i blodkar og lymfekar. Ved å kombinere digital patologi, immunhistokjemi og kunstig intelligens ønsker vi å utvikle metoder som kan bidra til mer presis og standardisert diagnostikk. Patologen vil få en sentral rolle i den histopatologiske vurderingen av vevsmaterialet og i etableringen av referansedata for utvikling og validering av KI-modellene. Arbeidet vil foregå i tett samarbeid med forskere innen patologi, biologi og informatikk. Stillingen er et ettårig engasjement i 30 %, med mulighet for forlengelse. Det forventes at den som får stillingen har anledning til å jevnlig sitte fysisk på IKI innenfor normal arbeidstid. Oslo universitetssykehus er en arbeidsplass med stort mangfold. Vi mener dette er avgjørende for å løse våre oppgaver på best mulig måte. Vi ønsker at dette mangfoldet skal gjenspeiles blant søkerne til våre stillinger, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater, uavhengig bakgrunn, til å søke! Kvalifikasjoner: For å trives med arbeidsoppgaver hos oss, ser vi etter deg som har følgende kvalifikasjoner: Norsk autorisasjon som lege Spesialistgodkjenning i patologi Erfaring med histopatologisk diagnostikk av kreft God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk Det er en fordel med: Erfaring med vurdering av karinnvekst i kreftsvulster Erfaring med digital patologi og analyse av digitaliserte histologiske snitt Erfaring med immunhistokjemiske metoder og tolkning av immunhistokjemiske farginger Erfaring fra forskningsprosjekter, gjerne innen kreftforskning Interesse for kunstig intelligens og utvikling av nye diagnostiske metoder Vi ber om at relevant dokumentasjon legges ved søknaden. Personlige egenskaper: Personlige egenskaper Strukturert, nøyaktig og kvalitetsbevisst Evne til å arbeide selvstendig og systematisk Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner Faglig engasjert og interessert i forskning og metodeutvikling Trives med å arbeide i et tverrfaglig forskningsmiljø Fleksibel og løsningsorientert Vi tilbyr: Oslo universitetssykehus har et viktig samfunnsoppdrag i det å tilby gode og likeverdige helsetjenester til befolkningen. Som medarbeider ved sykehuset vil du ha en rolle i å innfri dette. Du har betydning for pasientsikkerhet, trivsel på arbeidsplassen og utvikling av en trygg, åpen og inkluderende kultur. Vi er opptatt av at du skal trives og utvikle deg, les under hva vi kan tilby deg: Mulighet til å bidra til et spennende forskningsprosjekt i skjæringspunktet mellom patologi og kunstig intelligens Deltakelse i et tverrfaglig forskningsmiljø med nasjonale og internasjonale samarbeidspartnere Varierte og faglig interessante arbeidsoppgaver Mulighet for medvirkning i vitenskapelige publikasjoner Et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kolleger Vi tar vare på våre nye medarbeidere og støtter deg gjennom oppstartsfasen med vårt sentrale nyansattprogram, les mer: https://www.oslo-universitetssykehus.no/om-oss/jobb-og-utdanning/arbeidsplassen-var/velkommen-med-pa-laget/ Vi har velferdstilbud for våre medarbeidere, f. eks. teaterbilletter, bedriftskor, bedriftsidrettslag m.m. I Oslo universitetssykehus driver vi med avansert pasientbehandling, forskning, utprøvende behandling, undervisning og innovasjon på et høyt internasjonalt nivå. Vi er derfor hele Norges bakvakt! Vi trenger deg med på laget. Høres dette ut som en stilling for deg? Vi gleder oss til å lese din søknad. Vil du vite mer om oss? Szukamy osoby, która nie tylko sprawnie porusza się po obu stronach stacku, ale też bierze odpowiedzialność za kierunek techniczny: projektuje rozwiązania end-to-end (od modelu danych i kontraktu API po komponent w edytorze), prowadzi kluczowe zmiany architektoniczne i podnosi poziom techniczny całego zespołu. Zależy nam na kodzie i decyzjach, które bronią się w perspektywie lat, nie sprintów. ‍ Dlaczego warto z nami pracować? Skala, która robi różnicę - będziesz pracować w jednym z największych europejskich ekosystemów technologii e-commerce – Twoje decyzje architektoniczne będą miały bezpośredni wpływ na działanie tysięcy sklepów internetowych. Kultura dzielenia się wiedzą - tworzymy środowisko, w którym chętnie wymieniamy się doświadczeniami nie tylko wewnątrz zespołów, ale również z naszymi partnerami i całą społecznością technologiczną. Inwestycja w Twój rozwój - zapewniamy budżet i przestrzeń na szkolenia wewnętrzne oraz zewnętrzne – zależy nam, abyś stale poszerzał swoje kompetencje i wdrażał najnowsze rynkowe trendy (np. w obszarze AI). Czym będziesz się zajmować? Projektowaniem i rozwojem funkcjonalności end-to-end: od modelu danych i endpointów w PHP, przez kontrakty API (DTO model formularz), po komponenty w aplikacji React 19+TypeScript (Zustand, Tailwind, react-hook-form, Vite) w architekturze feature-first. Współprowadzeniem wydzielania backendu SVE do samodzielnego serwisu: wyznaczanie granic modułów, projektowanie kontraktów między serwisem a monolitem, wzorce spójności zapisu (outbox, idempotencja), auth service-to-service, strategia migracji bez przestojów. Ownership'em decyzji architektonicznych: przygotowywaniem propozycji rozwiązań, dokumentowaniem ich (plany, rejestry decyzji/ADR), ocena trade-offów i ryzyk. Projektowaniem integracji z modelami AI (tekst i obraz): wybór i routing modeli, odporność na błędy i timeouty, kontrola kosztów, zgodność z AI Act. Kształtowaniem strategii testów w zespole: jednostkowe i integracyjne (Jest), E2E (Playwright), backendowe (Codeception/PHPUnit); dbanie o szybkie i stabilne CI. Odpowiedzialność za bezpieczne wdrożenia: feature flagi, kontrolowany rollout, monitoring zachowania zmian na produkcji i reagowanie na incydenty. Code review i mentoring: wspieraniem rozwoju mid i junior developerów, dzieleniem się wiedzą, ustalaniem standardów jakości kodu. Bliską współpracą z produktem, designem i QA: dekompozycją dużych inicjatyw, estymacje, wskazywaniem długu technicznego i jego wpływu na roadmapę. ‍ Co jest dla nas ważne? Min. 5 lat komercyjnego doświadczenia, w tym realna praca po obu stronach stacku (nie „frontend z okazjonalnym endpointem”). Bardzo dobry TypeScript i React: hooki, zarządzanie stanem, formularze, wydajność renderowania, architektura dużych aplikacji SPA. Bardzo dobry PHP (8.x): swobodna i bezpieczna praca w dużym, istniejącym kodzie (monolit) oraz projektowanie nowego kodu o czystych granicach. Doświadczenie w modularizacji monolitu lub ekstrakcji serwisów (np. outbox, idempotencja, kompatybilność kontraktów między wydaniami, strangler fig). SQL: projektowanie schematów, bezpieczne migracje na produkcji, optymalizacja zapytań. Projektowanie API REST: kontrakty, wersjonowanie, obsługa błędów, kompatybilność wsteczna. Doświadczenie w podejmowaniu i uzasadnianiu decyzji architektonicznych oraz w prowadzeniu zmian technicznych w zespole. Nawyk pisania testów automatycznych i umiejętność budowania sensownej strategii testowej. Git i Docker w codziennej pracy. Doświadczenie w mentoringu i prowadzeniu wartościowego code review. Polski i angielski na poziomie swobodnej pracy z dokumentacją techniczną. Stack technologiczny Frontend: React 19, TypeScript 5.5, Zustand, Tailwind, react-hook-form, Vite (Rolldown), własny design system, Jest, Playwright, Storybook. Backend: PHP (monolit platformy docelowo samodzielny serwis na Symfony), MySQL, memcached, REST, Codeception. Wokół: Docker, GitHub Actions, feature flagi, self-hosted dashboard raportów testowych, integracje z API modeli AI. Mile widziane: Symfony i Doctrine (docelowy stack wydzielanego serwisu). Integracje z modelami LLM/genAI (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), tekst lub obraz. Zustand (lub inne vanilla stores), Tailwind, Vite, Storybook. Playwright: E2E i testy wizualne. Node.js: tooling, skrypty, małe serwisy. Doświadczenie z e-commerce lub SaaS multi-tenant. Mechanizmy cache (memcached, cache HTTP na edge'u) i praca z ruchem produkcyjnym o dużej skali. Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, …

items.desc: Job Title: Supplier Quality Engineer (F/M/D) At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world. : Why you should join: This role offers a great combination of technical expertise, analytical challenges, and close cooperation with suppliers and internal teams. You will have the opportunity to directly influence product quality, develop supplier capabilities, and drive improvements across the supply chain. Your daily tasks: Manage supplier quality performance and build strong relationships with suppliers to ensure the quality of delivered components Participate in supplier selection, qualification, approval, and periodic evaluation in cooperation with the Purchasing Department Conduct supplier system and process audits, identify improvement opportunities, and follow up on agreed actions Manage supplier complaints, including issuing quality notifications, reviewing 8D reports, and ensuring effective implementation of corrective and preventive actions Monitor supplier performance, initiate improvement activities, and drive sustainable solutions to prevent recurring quality issues Support process approvals and internal quality verification of supplier components Coordinate activities related to non-conforming materials and update incoming inspection control plans when required Work closely with Incoming Inspection, Production, Logistics, Engineering, and other Quality teams Promote a proactive and preventive approach to quality management Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen projects Your ideal background: University degree in Engineering or another technical field At least 3 years of experience in Quality Management or a technical role within a manufacturing environment Good knowledge of technical drawings and production processes Practical experience with quality tools and methodologies, such as FMEA, Control Plan, Pareto analysis, 8D, and PPAP Knowledge of measurement techniques, problem-solving methods, and statistical tools Familiarity with quality management standards, particularly ISO 9001, an internal auditor certificate will be an advantage - Knowledge of IPC/WHMA-A-620 or IPC/WHMA-A-610 standards will be an additional asset Good command of English (at least intermediate level), German will be an advantage Proficiency in MS Office, SAP knowledge will be a plus #jobsEMEAAK ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more. Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter). We disclose the full salary range and all pay elements, including how they are calculated, upfront - before any employment decisions are made. At TE, we believe transparency isn’t a checkbox – it’s part of your experience with us. IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity never requests payment or fees from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com . If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities. Biegłej znajomości języka polskiego w mowie i piśmie. Co my możemy zaoferować Tobie: Stabilne zatrudnienie: umowa o pracę z wynagrodzeniem zasadniczym 5 500 zł brutto oraz systemem premiowym. ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future. T&E processes, in line with internal controls and compliance requirements Support internal and external audits by ensuring processes and records are well documented and compliant What we’re looking for Must haves: Good understanding of the Travel and Expense process, including local tax rules and travel policies Experience with travel and expense tools such as Amex, SAP Concur or similar platforms Familiarity with finance systems such as NetSuite, Rillion, SAP/S4HANA or similar platforms, as well as the MS Office Suite (especially Excel) Ability to work independently, with minimal supervision, and a strong sense of ownership over assigned tasks and deadlines Attention to detail, accuracy and good organizational and communication skills Comfortable adapting to shifting priorities, particularly during transitions, migrations and month-end/payment cycles A genuine continuous improvement mindset, with comfort using AI-powered tools and modern finance technology to work smarter and more efficiently Nice to haves: Technical background, to be able to do basic system setup if needed Background in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field is nice to have Working at ICEYE At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. items.desc: Cel roli Odpowiadasz za swój segment polskiego rynku sklepów internetowych: masz zamienić go w klientów, którzy zostają. Wyszukiwanie sklepów, research, pierwszy kontakt i notatki w CRM robią agenci AI. Ty decydujesz, do kogo, kiedy i z czym idziemy, i prowadzisz rozmowy. Za co odpowiadasz Segment: wielkości sklepu i platformy. Kampanie: wybierasz grupę sklepów, powód kontaktu i przekaz; agent robi research, pisze wiadomości i prowadzi kontakt w kilku kanałach. Telefon zostaje, ale dzwonisz wtedy, gdy jest powód. Rozmowy: discovery, demo na żywo w Claude lub ChatGPT, negocjacje, umowa, przekazanie do wdrożenia. Wynik systemu: co tydzień sprawdzasz liczby każdej kampanii, wyłączasz słabe, skalujesz dobre i poprawiasz agentów, podając powód. Co musisz umieć Sprzedaż: discovery, kwalifikacja, negocjacje, rezygnacja ze sklepów bez potencjału. Liczby: czytasz lejek kampanii i nie wyciągasz wniosków z kilku przypadków. Pisanie: krótki, konkretny przekaz i jasne instrukcje dla agenta. Praca z AI: codziennie, bez programowania. Poziomy, targety i wynagrodzenie Wynagrodzenie podstawowe przy przejściu między stanowiskami zostanie utrzymane. Każdy zachowuje dotychczasowy rodzaj umowy o pracę (czas nieokreślony zostaje na czas nieokreślony, okres próbny zostaje okresem próbnym). Targety: Junior: $1100 Regular: $1600 Senior: $2100 Kiedy agenci będą działać i zobaczymy, o ile rośnie liczba rozmów, podnosimy targety. Wchodzimy w tryb konsultacyjny: lepiej kwalifikujemy i skalujemy. Prowizja i bonus Prowizja: bez zmian wobec obecnego modelu. Bonus zespołowy: bez zmian wobec obecnego modelu. Jak mierzymy pracę na co dzień Nowe umowy, które płacą w czwartym miesiącu. Rozmowy kwalifikowane na tydzień. Pokrycie segmentu: udział sklepów, które w ostatnich [90] dniach dostały kontakt z konkretnym powodem. Czas odpowiedzi na zgłoszenie przychodzące. Liczby połączeń nie mierzymy. Pierwsze 90 dni Dni 1 do 30: szkolenie z discovery i z pracy z agentami; praca na kampaniach wspólnych. Dni 31 do 60: własny segment i pierwsze własne kampanie. Dni 61 do 90: pełna odpowiedzialność za segment. Z kim pracujesz Z Team Leaderem GTM w Polsce oraz z osobami budującymi agentów i automatyzacje (Wiktor, Olga). Na zgłoszenia czekamy do czwartku do 12:00. Zadanie rekrutacyjne: kampania na segment Wybierz listę 10 polskich sklepów internetowych z jednego segmentu [platforma / rozmiar / branża]. Wyobraź sobie, że odpowiadasz za ten segment jako GTM Operator w edrone (CRM i marketing automation dla e-commerce). Korzystaj z asystenta AI (Claude), tak jak pracowałbyś na co dzień. Korzystaj tylko z informacji publicznie dostępnych i nie kontaktuj się ze sklepami. Przygotuj: Wybór: 3 sklepy, z którymi warto rozmawiać, i 2, z których rezygnujesz. Przy każdym jedno zdanie dlaczego. Powód kontaktu: dla każdego z 3 wybranych sklepów jedna konkretna rzecz, którą widać na ich stronie i od której zacząłbyś rozmowę. Pierwsza wiadomość do jednego z nich: najwyżej 80 słów. Instrukcja dla agenta AI, który ma napisać podobne wiadomości do kolejnych 200 sklepów z tego segmentu: co ma sprawdzić, co napisać, czego nie pisać. Liczby: jakie 3 liczby sprawdzisz po tygodniu kampanii i przy jakim wyniku ją zatrzymasz. Wyślij jedną stronę z odpowiedziami oraz zapis swojej rozmowy z asystentem AI (poproś Claude o zapis rozmowy w formacie pliku .md). Limit czasu: 90 minut. Nie oceniamy długości. Odpowiedź (plik .md z zapisem oraz odpowiedzi) wyślij na m.serafin@edrone.me lub na Slacku.
