items.desc: Would you like to play a key role in improving 1st Line of Defence (LoD) controls management within Danske Bank? Are you motivated by applying analytical thinking, attention to detail and strong stakeholder engagement to identify improvement opportunities and help the business enhance both control design and operating effectiveness? We are looking for a Risk & Controls Officer to join the Controls Office within Business Controls and Product Management (BCPM) in a key control testing role supporting our Business Units. A significant part of the role is practical control testing and reporting across business areas, working as part of an experienced testing team and contributing to the continuous improvement of controls, testing practices and ways of working. This opportunity is well suited to someone with experience in areas such as control testing, audit, compliance testing, risk assurance or non-financial risk who is looking to further develop their testing expertise within a 1st Line of Defence environment About us – central part in supporting the business The Business Controls and Product Management (BCPM) department plays a central role in supporting the business units in delivering their strategic objectives, with reporting lines to the heads of Large Corporates & Institutions, Business Customers, and Personal Customers. The Controls Office is home to the 1st Line of Defence control testing activities within BCPM. As part of the Operational & Data Risk Testing & Assurance team, you will collaborate across business areas with BCPM colleagues and a broad range of stakeholders in the 1st, 2nd and 3rd Lines of Defence. We focus on improving the control environment by ensuring consistency, transparency and high quality in how non-financial risks are managed through controls. You will be employed and based in either Lithuania or Poland, joining colleagues located across Denmark and other Nordic and European locations. Your focus will be on testing key controls across non-financial risk areas and developing your experience across a range of business processes. The workplace is located in either Lithuania or Poland. Danske Bank supports workplace flexibility through a hybrid work model, where we currently work at least three days a week in the office. Recruitment will take place in either Lithuania or Poland, with no international relocation allowance included. Responsibilities: You will join team members located globally, in Denmark, Lithuania, Sweden, Norway, Finland and Poland. Your focus will be on non-financial risk areas, ensuring effective control management within the 1st Line of Defence. items.desc: Nexio Management to około 550 konsultantów, którzy od ponad 20 lat tworzą zaawansowane rozwiązania IT dla firm w Polsce i za granicą. Jesteśmy zespołem ekspertów, którzy realnie angażują się w projekty swoich klientów. Specjalizujemy się w budowie, rozwoju i utrzymaniu systemów i aplikacji, oraz doradztwie IT. Wierzymy, że najlepsze rozwiązania powstają wtedy, gdy jest przestrzeń na eksperymentowanie - dlatego mamy własne R&D Center na czele z NexioBot naszym mobilnym robotem asystującym, wykorzystującym sztuczną inteligencję do komunikacji. Działamy w takich modelach biznesowych jak managed services, fixed prices oraz wspieramy zespoły naszych klientów w modelach scale up the team. Naszymi klientami są firmy z wielu zróżnicowanych branż, szukające wsparcia najwyższej klasy ekspertów. Opis stanowiska Poszukujemy doświadczonego specjalisty/-ki na stanowisko Mid DevOps Engineer do zespołu rozwijającego projekt z obszaru Internet of Things (IoT). Głównym zadaniem na tej roli będzie projektowanie, automatyzacja oraz utrzymanie skalowalnej infrastruktury chmurowej w środowisku AWS, w oparciu o najlepsze praktyki Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Twój zakres obowiązków Budowa, automatyzacja oraz utrzymanie infrastruktury w AWS z wykorzystaniem Terraform (IaC). Projektowanie i rozwój procesów CI/CD z naciskiem na bezpieczne oraz powtarzalne wdrożenia (Configuration & Release Management). Zapewnienie bezpieczeństwa chmury (zarządzanie IAM, zabezpieczanie pipeline'ów oraz środowisk). Monitorowanie systemów, konfiguracja alertów oraz sprawne reagowanie na incydenty i wyzwania produkcyjne (troubleshooting, optymalizacja wydajności i skalowalności). Ścisła współpraca z backend developerami oraz architektami w ramach zespołu cross-functional. Współpraca z zespołem międzynarodowym. Nasze wymagania Min. 2–3 lata doświadczenia w roli DevOps / Cloud Engineer przy środowiskach produkcyjnych na AWS. Bardzo dobra praktyczna znajomość Terraform oraz podejścia Infrastructure as Code. Doświadczenie w tworzeniu i utrzymaniu pipeline'ów CI/CD (np. GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins). Praktyczna wiedza z zakresu Cloud Security (IAM), monitoringu, logowania oraz dbania o wysoką dostępność (HA) i wydajność systemów. Samodzielność w diagnozowaniu i rozwiązywaniu problemów infrastrukturalnych. Komunikatywna znajomość języka angielskiego (B2/C1). Mile widziane: Doświadczenie z konteneryzacją (Docker, ECS/EKS). Znajomość podejścia Serverless oraz usług zarządzanych (AWS Managed Services). Doświadczenie przy projektach z obszaru IoT. To oferujemy Stabilność zatrudnienia - długofalowe projekty, współpraca z wiodącymi firmami, możliwość rozwoju w różnych obszarach branży IT. Elastyczne formy współpracy - umowa B2B, umowa o pracę lub zlecenie. Benefity: Medicover (rozszerzony o stomatologię), FitProfit, lekcje języka angielskiego. Treningi na siłowni F45 - zlokalizowanej w naszym biurze. Wspólnie ćwiczymy pod okiem profesjonalnych trenerów. Wewnętrzny program poleceń. Możliwość finansowania certyfikatów IT. W zależności od projektu pracujemy w trybie hybrydowym, zdalnym lub stacjonarnym. Wydarzenia okolicznościowe oraz wyjazdy integracyjne - budujemy zgrany zespól również poza biurem. Lubimy pomagać - wspieramy akcje charytatywne, takie jak Szlachetna Paczka, a w ramach #PomagamyNexio angażujemy się tam, gdzie naprawdę możemy coś zmienić. Familiarity with AI/LLM tools and ability to utilise them in your working process. At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference! items.desc: - Las Palmas De Gran Canaria - Alien Technology Transfer empowers top-class innovators to transform visionary product concepts into commercial realities. We do this by helping companies with concrete growth ambitions to secure funding for their product development through our innovation consulting expertise. To date, we have raised more than $700 million for our clients - Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) - across many domains, including agri-tech, artificial intelligence, biotechnology, clean-tech, cyber-security, quantum computing, space, and transport. We are seeking an entrepreneurial and analytical Innovation Consultant to join our hub in Las Palmas to support the operational roll-out and execution of a new, high-growth business line currently in active development. In this role, you will step beyond traditional grant schemes to shape, deliver, and scale our next generation of innovation consulting services. You will combine deep scientific acumen with advanced grant preparation capabilities to structure complex funding and commercialization strategies for international deep-tech clients. Working in close collaboration with leadership, you will lead the end-to-end design and submission of high-value proposals under this new service offering, define delivery frameworks, interface directly with C-level client stakeholders, and help build the methodologies that will define this strategic division. Contract Type: Permanent Hybrid Work Modality: Monday to Thursday at the Office (Las Canteras area) and Friday Work from Home DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Service Delivery & Proposal Architecture: Lead the technical, commercial, and financial drafting of high-impact funding and strategic project proposals tailored to the newly established business unit. Deep-Tech & Commercial Due Diligence: Perform in-depth assessments of emerging technologies, commercial feasibility, IP positioning, regulatory pathways, and market dynamics to build bulletproof business cases. Project Roadmap & Financial Modeling: Engineer comprehensive execution plans, including multi-year GANTT schedules, risk mitigation matrices, work package structures, and detailed project cost/budget models. Strategic Client Management: Serve as the primary strategic interlocutor for client founders, Chief Technology Officers, and Lead Scientists, driving strategic alignment workshops, technical deep-dives, and milestone reviews. Funding Landscape Intelligence & Opportunity Selection: Continuously monitor and analyse the international public and private funding landscape (e.g. EU, US federal, national and regional programmes, and blended or co-investment instruments). Assess emerging schemes against the profiles, technology readiness levels and growth ambitions of our target clients, and recommend which opportunities the company should pursue, with clear rationale on eligibility, competitiveness, funding size and strategic fit. Internal Training & Knowledge Transfer: Design and deliver training for internal teams on newly identified funding opportunities, their evaluation criteria and the best approaches to positioning clients for them. Maintain up-to-date guidance materials so this knowledge is shared and applied consistently across the company. JOB REQUIREMENTS Education: Master's Degree required (PhD preferred) in a STEM field, including: Life Sciences: Bioengineering, Biomedical, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Biology, Botany, Zoology, Neurosciences, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or related disciplines. Engineering: Electronics, Mechanical, Industrial, Medical, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Physics, Materials Science, or related disciplines. Experience (Preferred): Hands-on experience in grant writing and innovation consulting, with a proven track record of securing funding across competitive funding schemes, is a strong plus. Languages: Full professional proficiency in English (both spoken and written). Skills: Exceptional written communication and technical report writing skills. Please note: Due to the high volume of candidates, we are unfortunately unable to provide individual feedback regarding the outcome of every single application.

items.desc: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role 1. Implantación de Plataformas Cloud Participar en la implantación de arquitecturas híbridas y multicloud, integrando servicios cloud con entornos on-premises conforme a los diseños definidos por los Cloud Architects. Implementar Enterprise Landing Zones, redes, identidades y servicios compartidos sobre AWS, Azure o Google Cloud. Desplegar plataformas Cloud AI-Ready, habilitando los servicios de datos, infraestructura y capacidades necesarias para soportar soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial y Machine Learning, de acuerdo con la arquitectura definida. Ejecución Técnica y Soporte a Proyectos Desarrollar las configuraciones técnicas e integraciones necesarias para el despliegue de plataformas y servicios cloud. Participar en revisiones técnicas, validaciones de arquitectura y actividades de integración, aportando conocimiento práctico sobre los servicios del hyperscaler. Proporcionar soporte técnico especializado a los equipos de delivery durante las fases de implantación, migración y puesta en producción. Colaborar en la validación técnica de las soluciones implantadas, asegurando su alineamiento con la arquitectura definida y las mejores prácticas establecidas. Generar la documentación técnica y los entregables del proyecto, colaborando con el Cloud Architect y los equipos técnicos para garantizar la correcta implantación y transferencia de conocimientos. 3. Infraestructura: Conocimientos de redes, VPC/VNet, DNS, VPN, balanceadores, almacenamiento y sistemas Linux/Windows. Infrastructure as Code: Experiencia práctica con Terraform (CloudFormation, ARM o Bicep valorable). Containers: Conocimientos de Kubernetes, OpenShift y plataformas de contenedores. DevOps: Experiencia con Git, CI/CD y herramientas de automatización. Scripting: Python, Bash o PowerShell. Observabilidad: Conocimientos de Logging, Monitoring y herramientas de observabilidad. Conocimientos de plataformas de datos e Inteligencia Artificial en la nube (Azure AI, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI o equivalentes), así como de arquitecturas AI-Ready y servicios gestionados para IA Generativa y Machine Learning. Seguridad: Conocimientos de IAM, controles de seguridad cloud y buenas prácticas de hardening. Habilidades y Mentalidad Clave (Soft Skills): Capacidad para trabajar en equipos multidisciplinares. Orientación a la automatización y mejora continua. Mentalidad analítica y resolución de problemas. Buenas capacidades de comunicación con equipos técnicos. Capacidad para aprender nuevas tecnologías cloud de forma continua. Proactividad y orientación al cliente. Cualificaciones Deseables: Certificaciones Associate o Profesionales de AWS, Azure o Google Cloud. Experiencia en Terraform. Conocimientos de Enterprise Landing Zones. Experiencia en proyectos de migración cloud. Grado en Informática, Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones o experiencia equivalente. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. items.desc: Diseña la Próxima Generación de Plataformas Lakehouse con Databricks Conectamos al mejor talento técnico con los proyectos más desafiantes e innovadores del mercado. No somos una consultora tradicional; somos socios estratégicos que creemos en el impacto real a través de la tecnología. Como Databricks Architect, liderarás la definición, escalabilidad y optimización de plataformas de datos analíticas y de inteligencia artificial sobre arquitectura Lakehouse, uniendo visión de negocio y excelencia técnica de alto rendimiento. Tus desafíos y responsabilidades Diseñar e implementar arquitecturas Lakehouse extremo a extremo mediante el patrón Medallion (Bronze, Silver, Gold), Delta Lake y Databricks Workflows para analítica avanzada e inteligencia artificial. Garantizar una gobernanza empresarial sólida mediante Unity Catalog, definiendo políticas de control de acceso granular (RBAC/ABAC), linaje de datos, auditoría y cumplimiento normativo. Optimizar el rendimiento computacional de cargas Spark, configuración de clústeres, motor Photon y entornos Serverless bajo criterios estrictos de FinOps y SLA. Estandarizar procesos de despliegue continuo mediante Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs), control de versiones e infraestructura como código (Terraform) en entornos corporativos. Definir patrones robustos de ingesta y procesamiento de datos tanto en streaming como por lotes utilizando Auto Loader y Delta Live Tables. ¿Qué buscamos en ti? Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en ingeniería y arquitectura de datos en la nube, con al menos 2 años dedicados al diseño de soluciones en Databricks. Certificación activa Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional o Databricks Certified Solutions Architect (obligatoria). Dominio avanzado de Python (PySpark), SQL, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog y Delta Live Tables. Experiencia contrastada en integración sobre entornos cloud principales (Azure, AWS o GCP), incluyendo gestión de redes, identidades y almacenamiento de objetos. Conocimiento sólido en modelado dimensional moderno y esquemas optimizados para Lakehouse. Nivel de inglés intermedio alto (B2), con capacidad de comunicación fluida técnica y funcional. Valoramos especialmente si además Tienes experiencia con Databricks Mosaic AI, MLflow, Feature Store o Vector Search para canalizaciones de GenAI y Machine Learning. Cuentas con práctica en CI/CD con Terraform, Azure DevOps o GitHub Actions. Has trabajado en integración con herramientas de visualización como Power BI o Tableau. Posees trayectoria en procesos de modernización y migración desde almacenes tradicionales (Oracle, Teradata, Hadoop). Te apasiona aprender, compartir ideas y evolucionar junto al equipo. ¿Cómo mediremos tu impacto? Cumplimiento mensual de objetivos de eficiencia de Proyectos. Alineación y ejecución efectiva del plan estratégico. ¿Qué te ofrecemos? Modalidad de trabajo híbrida en Madrid (3 días semanales en oficinas del cliente ubicadas en la zona de San Blas-Canillejas), con flexibilidad horaria y jornada intensiva los viernes. Integración en iniciativas complejas con alcance global y tecnología cloud de vanguardia. Cultura centrada en la autonomía técnica, la transparencia, la meritocracia y el aprendizaje continuo. Planes continuos de desarrollo profesional y acceso a certificaciones técnicas. En Initium no solo desarrollamos tecnología: creamos un entorno donde las personas pueden evolucionar, aportar valor y dejar huella. Aplica ahora y hablemos.

ISO 20000-1 is a plus Fluent with the methodology: BIA, MTPD, RTO, RPO, recovery order, dependency mapping Has planned and run DR/BC tests and exercises, and prepared evidence for audit Understands how the standard maps onto cloud and SaaS, not just on-prem Deep knowledge of the Microsoft stack: Microsoft 365, Entra ID and Intune (Conditional Access, policies, configuration backup), Dynamics 365 Understands the shared responsibility model with Microsoft: what the vendor covers for backup and availability, and what stays with the client Has worked with backup and DR (11:11 Systems or similar), and knows retention and how to verify restores Networking and perimeter: Meraki, Check Point, ISP failover, HA Integrations (Boomi, EDI, API): what breaks when they go down and whether there’s a manual workaround DNS and domain management, and how credentials, API keys and certificates are stored and accessed during an incident Speaks the same language with the business, with technical teams and with the auditor Self-sufficient and hands-on: from strategy to configuration and live testing Organised: documents carefully, builds the evidence base, keeps scope in check Nice to have Experience in an MSP or IT reseller environment with many SaaS vendors and integrations Familiar with monitoring and management tools: LogicMonitor, NinjaOne, Halo Has worked with distributed office infrastructure and network resilience Responsibilities Review the client’s existing DRP and BCP and the certification requirements, and find the gaps Build a practical testing strategy: what we check (does the plan match reality, does it work in practice, does it hold up against ISO 22301), by which methods (exercises, restore tests), and how we capture evidence for the auditor Tie the tests to the BIA and agree them with the business: MTPD, RTO and RPO for critical services, recovery order, dependency map Run the tests and implement the agreed measures hands-on. Maintain clear operating procedures and playbooks for recurring post-sales activities. Monitor operational queues, recurring failure points and service trends, and fix root causes through better processes, documentation or tooling, reducing operational failures that put retention (GRR) at risk. Keep customer and workflow data reliable in the systems used internally, so decisions and the customer experience stay consistent. Partner with KAM Leadership, RevOps, Data and other internal teams to improve workflows and clarify ownership. Experiment with AI tools and automation to reduce manual work and make operations smoother. What you need to succeed Recent and relevant experience in customer operations, sales operations, implementation, support or a comparable operational role, ideally in a B2B SaaS organization. Strong process discipline, resilience and high attention to detail, with a proven ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Sound judgment and clear communication: you set expectations, know when to escalate risk, and keep stakeholders informed. A practical improvement mindset and comfortable challenging assumptions to find simpler, more reliable ways of working. Curiosity about AI tools and enthusiasm for using them to improve how work gets done. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trusted relationships with Sales, KAMs, RevOps and Data. Passion and empathy for customers, and willingness to pursue opportunities for professional development. Fluent English + at least one other language is a must. Being based in Barcelona. items.desc: Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default Founded in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN, Proton was built on the belief that privacy is a fundamental human right . What started as an encrypted email service has grown into an ecosystem of privacy-first products, including Proton Mail, VPN, Drive, Pass, and Calendar, used by millions of people worldwide. We're profitable, independent, and building for the long term. Free from venture capital control and advertising-driven business models, we focus on what matters most: our users. Our work helps protect digital freedom, from everyday privacy to supporting journalists and activists in challenging environments. Today, we're an international team of 700+ people, with offices across 9 countries. We have high standards for the people we hire and the work we do. You'll work alongside talented, driven colleagues who challenge each other, take ownership, and care about getting things right. Explore our open-source projects. Your impact: We’re hiring Mobile Product Engineers across different levels of experience, from junior to staff level engineers. Whether you’re looking to take the next step in your career or already have experience leading complex technical projects, we’d love to hear from you. Your scope and level will reflect your experience and the impact you can bring. As a Mobile Product Engineer, you’ll help shape what we build and own work from understanding the problem through to release and improvement. You’ll speak directly with customers, collaborate with Product and Design, and work across the parts of the stack needed to deliver a complete mobile experience. What you will do: Understand and shape the problem: Work with Product, Design and customers to understand user needs, question assumptions and decide what is worth building. Own complete features: Turn problems into practical solutions across clients, services and data. Take work through testing, release and improvement, paying attention to usability, performance and behaviour in production. Build effectively with agents: Define clear tasks, provide context and evaluate generated code. Investigate failures, challenge suggestions and make changes yourself when needed. Improve how software gets built: Turn recurring problems into better agent instructions, tests, tools and automated safeguards. Share improvements that help the whole team. Build for trust: Make privacy, security, reliability and maintainability part of your decisions. Verify important failure cases, communicate what remains uncertain and make sound trade-offs about release readiness. What you will bring: Experience delivering production software: You can explain the problems you solved, the decisions you made and what you learned from maintaining your work after release. Technical depth and adaptability: You have strong expertise in Mobile Development (Android, iOS or both) and can contribute beyond it. You don’t need equal expertise in every layer, but you understand how your work interacts with the wider system. Practical capability with coding agents: You’ve used agents to deliver working software and can explain how you guide them, improve unsuccessful approaches and verify their output. Code fluency and engineering judgement: You can navigate unfamiliar code, trace behaviour, diagnose problems and make precise changes. You can assess an implementation regardless of who — or what — wrote it. Product judgement: You connect technical choices to user needs, care about the quality of the experience and distinguish a useful reduction in scope from a shortcut that puts users at risk. Ownership and collaboration: You move work forward through uncertainty, explain trade-offs clearly, seek out expertise and take responsibility for the outcome. Technical leadership: You’ve led complex projects through ambiguous requirements, made decisions with lasting consequences and helped other engineers develop their judgement while remaining hands-on. Our mobile teams work with Swift and SwiftUI on iOS, Kotlin and Jetpack Compose on Android, and Rust for cross-platform mobile development. You may bring depth in iOS or Android, or experience across both—there’s no expectation that you know every technology we use. The mix of platform focus and cross-platform work varies by team, and we value strong fundamentals and your ability to learn. What we offer: Work that Matters: Millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments. A Great Team: Diverse, collaborative, and tight-knit, with people from MIT, Harvard, Stanford, Caltech, Cambridge, ETH, and more. Technology: The right hardware and software to do your best work. Learning & Development: We invest in your growth. Proton is one of the fastest ways to accelerate your career — real challenges, real ownership, from day one. items.desc: Edge AI & Advanced Compute Practice - Inside Solution Engineer Description - The Inside Solution Engineer provides remote technical support to HP's field Solution Engineers, helping them validate solutions, resolve technical issues, and advance customer engagements. This role serves as a technical liaison between the field and the Global Business Unit (GBU), connecting customer requirements and field findings with product management, engineering, and support teams. The engineer performs hands-on lab validation and troubleshooting, coordinates escalations, and maintains technical continuity from issue intake through verified resolution. By turning field experience into reusable guidance and actionable product feedback, this role improves field productivity and solution readiness. Key Responsibilities Field Solution Engineer Support Provide remote technical assistance with solution design, product capabilities, configurations, compatibility, and deployment considerations for Edge AI and Advanced Compute engagements. Support demonstrations, proofs of concept (POCs), pilots, and deployment readiness through lab preparation, configuration reviews, technical validation, and troubleshooting. Develop technical responses, configuration guidance, bills of materials, and supporting documentation in partnership with field Solution Engineers. Field Issue Resolution Triage field issues based on customer impact, urgency, and deployment risk; gather environment details, logs, configurations, reproduction steps, and expected behavior. Reproduce and isolate hardware, firmware, driver, operating system, application, networking, and integration issues in lab environments. Develop and validate workarounds with the appropriate teams, document findings, and confirm fixes with the field before closing issues. Maintain clear issue records, owners, next steps, and status updates so field teams can communicate accurately with customers. GBU Coordination and Escalation Serve as the field technical liaison to GBU product management, engineering, and support teams for product questions, defects, compatibility gaps, and solution limitations. Prepare actionable escalation packages that include business impact, technical evidence, reproduction steps, troubleshooting completed, and the support needed. Track escalations through resolution, coordinate follow-up and fix validation, and communicate confirmed support guidance and timelines to field Solution Engineers. Solution Validation and Field Enablement Maintain representative lab configurations and test new platforms, firmware, drivers, software releases, and ISV integrations against field use cases. Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, known-issue summaries, validated configurations, reference architectures, and reusable demo and POC assets. Share technical updates and lessons learned with the field through training, office hours, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Identify recurring field issues and provide structured feedback to the GBU to improve product quality, documentation, serviceability, and solution readiness. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of experience in solution engineering, technical presales, technical support, systems engineering, AI infrastructure, or a related discipline. Hands-on experience configuring, testing, and troubleshooting enterprise compute solutions across hardware, firmware, operating systems, networking, and software integration. Working knowledge of Edge AI or accelerated computing, including CPUs, GPUs, NPUs, AI inference workloads, containers, and related infrastructure. Ability to reproduce technical issues, analyze logs and diagnostic data, isolate likely causes, and validate corrective actions. items.desc: Job Description: An opportunity for a Functional Architecture Engineer – Ops / FDIR has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space , Getafe (Madrid). The selected candidate will join the Avionics Systems Engineering Team within the Space Systems business line, playing a key role in the PAZ-2 Earth Observation satellite program . The department is responsible for conceiving, developing, and validating the functional architecture and on-board software (OBSW) of satellites—ensuring that spacecraft can be commanded from the ground, process internal data, manage operational modes, and execute mission functions autonomously and reliably in the space environment. Working in a multidisciplinary and multicultural environment, the jobholder will own the end-to-end functional verification of the spacecraft payload and act as a critical bridge between Assembly, Integration & Test (AIT), FDIR, and Flight Operations teams. RESPONSIBILITIES The main tasks of the jobholder will be: Define Test Specifications & Procedures: Translate system and subsystem requirements into logical test sequences, Test Specifications (TS), and step-by-step Test Procedures (TP) in compliance with ECSS standards, while maintaining the Verification Control Document (VCD) for full traceability. Validate FDIR Architecture: Design and verify fault-injection test scenarios to validate autonomous failure detection, safe mode transitions, and recovery logic. Verify Flight Operations Procedures: Review and validate the Flight Operations User Manual (FOUM) and Flight Control Procedures (FCP) against actual spacecraft functional behavior during ground testing. Support Live AIT & Operations Campaigns: Act as functional authority supporting AIT teams during Engineering Model (EM) and Flight Model (FM) test campaigns, as well as Flight Operations during System Validation Tests (SVT), LEOP preparation, and simulation campaigns. Analyze Telemetry & Author Test Reports: Perform off-line analysis of Telemetry and Telecommand (TM/TC) logs, event reports, and operational timelines to verify pass/fail criteria and produce formal Test Reports. Lead Anomaly & NCR Investigations: Diagnose functional or FDIR anomalies, coordinate root-cause investigations across engineering disciplines (OBSW, avionics, power, thermal), and manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCR) through to closure. SKILLS Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to knowing you: Education: Engineering degree in Aerospace, Telecommunications, Electronics, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline. Experience: Proven experience in spacecraft functional verification, satellite AIT, avionics systems engineering, or flight operations. Soft skills: Strong analytical and structured troubleshooting mindset, meticulous attention to detail, autonomy, proactivity, and clear communication skills to coordinate across multidisciplinary teams. Languages: Fluency in spoken and written English (negotiation level). Technical knowledge: Solid understanding of spacecraft functional architectures, operational modes, and TM/TC concepts (CCSDS / PUS standards).Strong knowledge of FDIR concepts (failure modes, recovery trees, safe modes) and operational documentation (FOUM, FCP).Proven ability to analyze telemetry logs, event packets, and timelines, and translate complex requirements into clear test documentation. Valuable / Nice to have: Experience with satellite simulators, spacecraft database (DB) tools, and ECSS verification standards. WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? items.desc: Job Description: An opportunity for a Junior Structural Designer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid) . The selected candidate will join the Combat and UAV Structural Design Team . This multidisciplinary department is responsible for the structural design of key military and unmanned aircraft programs. In the Combat area, the team manages the Eurofighter wing structure—handling design modifications, repairs, non-conformity resolutions, and in-service aircraft support. In the Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) area, the team is actively developing two flagship programs: Eurodrone: The most strategic future UAV defence program for Europe, key to European and national sovereignty, intelligence management, and industrial independence. SIRTAP: A high-performance Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (UAV) being designed, developed, and certified by Airbus Defence and Space Spain for the Spanish Ministry of Defence. Du har arbetat med att designa, bygga, drifta eller vidareutveckla plattformstjänster och har förståelse för hur moderna, skalbara plattformar skapas. Vi ser att du har: Praktisk erfarenhet av Kubernetes och containerplattformar Erfarenhet av plattformstjänster eller andra verksamhetskritiska tekniska tjänster Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code och automatisering, exempelvis Terraform God förståelse för CI/CD och moderna leveransprocesser Kunskap om cloud native-teknik och principer inom plattformsutveckling Goda kunskaper i engelska, både i tal och skrift Relevant utbildning eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av: Internal Developer Platforms, självservice och developer experience Hybrida Kubernetes-miljöer inom cloud och on-premise Observability, monitoring och plattformssäkerhet AWS, Amazon EKS eller Azure Större och komplexa organisationer där plattformar används av flera team Det är meriterande att ha goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift Som person är du nyfiken, initiativtagande och bekväm med att ta ansvar utan detaljerad styrning. Du tycker om att samarbeta, dela kunskap och lösa problem tillsammans med andra. Eftersom plattformen fortfarande utvecklas behöver du också trivas med förändring och vilja vara med och forma lösningar som ännu inte är färdigdefinierade. Tjänsten är säkerhetsklassad och innebär att du behöver bli godkänd i en säkerhetsprövning. I samband med detta kan krav på visst medborgarskap förekomma. Övrigt Lön: Fast månadslön Omfattning: Heltid, tillsvidare Start: Omgående med hänsyn tagen till din eventuella uppsägningstid Placeringsort: Stockholm. Resor till Linköping förekommer några gånger per år Vi behandlar ansökningar löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut, skicka din ansökan redan idag! Om oss Procruitment är Sveriges enda karriärbyrå inom IT, tech och engineering som genom proaktiv rekrytering förenar attraktiva arbetsgivare med människor som delar samma mål och ambitioner. Oavsett om du är en erfaren ledare eller om du ska ta ditt första steg ut i karriären hjälper vi dig att nå dina karriärmål - samtidigt som vi bryr oss om dig, din resa och att du mår bra längs vägen. Procruitment är stolta vinnare av Recruitment Awards och är utsedda till Årets Rekryteringsföretag och Årets Raket samt Gasellföretag 2024 av Dagens Industri .

items.desc: About the Role We build a non-custodial crypto wallet (iOS/Android, React Native), a crypto debit card, IBAN rails, and on-chain trading products (Morpho, HyperLiquid, deBridge). We ship several releases per week. We are looking for a hands-on Senior Mobile QA / SDET (~80% hands-on testing & automation, ~20% technical coordination of 2 QA engineers, with no HR management or 1:1s). Your main goal is to shrink regression time from days to hours by combining AI-assisted mobile/API automation with sharp exploratory testing of money-critical flows. What You Will Do: Automate critical user journeys: Build and maintain fast E2E mobile tests (Maestro / Detox) and API tests (TypeScript / Playwright / Jest) in CI to replace repetitive manual regression. Use AI in code, not just chat: Use Claude Code / Cursor daily to read developer PR diffs, spot edge cases before merge, generate automated tests, and analyze logs. Test high-stakes crypto & Fintech flows hands-on: Verify non-custodial wallets (BIP-39 seeds, Smart Accounts / EIP-7702), cross-chain swaps, perps trading, card top-ups, SEPA IBAN transfers, and KYC/on-ramp flows across iOS, Android, and backend. Coordinate release verification: Act as the technical QA anchor during releases — split testing scope with 2 QA engineers, run risk-based checks, and give fast, evidence-based Go/No-Go sign-offs without bureaucracy. Own production triage: Monitor Sentry, Grafana, and Firebase; reproduce production edge cases and verify hotfixes fast. What We Are Looking For Hands-on automation: Proven experience writing and maintaining mobile E2E (Maestro, Detox, Appium, XCUITest, or Espresso) and API automated tests (TypeScript/JS or Python). Real AI-first workflow: Practical experience using Claude Code, Cursor, or similar coding agents to generate/maintain tests and inspect application code. Crypto / Web3 + Fintech domain: Clear understanding of on-chain mechanics (wallets, signing, gas, RPCs, bridges, DeFi) and/or payment rails (cards, IBAN, KYC/Sumsub, 3DS). Strong mobile & API debugging: Daily fluency with TestFlight, Android Studio, Xcode, Charles/Proxyman, Postman, SQL, and Git. Pragmatic mindset: You focus on release speed and real financial/security risks rather than writing hundreds of manual test cases in Qase. Languages: Russian and English (working proficiency). Tech Stack App & Backend: React Native (TypeScript), Node.js / Java, PostgreSQL. QA & Automation: Maestro, Jest, Playwright, Charles, Postman, Android Studio, Xcode, TestFlight, Qase. AI & Observability: Claude Code, Sentry, Grafana, Firebase. What we offer Fully remote work in an agile, international team. AI-first by default: a team where AI-first engineering is the norm, not an experiment, including AI-assisted testing, test generation, and coverage analysis. Real influence on how the team tests, ships, and thinks about quality, plus a voice in architecture and team processes. A product at real scale: millions of users and thousands of partner platforms. Impact & ownership: work on high-stakes crypto and Fintech flows (transactions, swaps, custody, KYC, on/off-ramps) where accuracy, security, and compliance are essential. Competitive salary based on experience, contribution, and performance. Career progression with opportunities to grow into senior technical, management, or cross-functional roles. Transparent feedback culture that values open dialogue, experimentation, ownership, and visible impact. Recruitment process Apply with your CV. Application review. HR interview. Technical interview. Final interview with the CTO & PM. Offer. Apply if you live in the product, automate what matters, and manually test what machines miss.

items.card: Job Description WHAT YOU’LL DO As a Stylist in the Editorial team, you will play a key role in shaping how H&M expresses fashion through creative storytelling. Working closely with Art Directors, Copywriters and Creative Strategists, you will co-create concepts and lead the styling direction across still image, moving image and social-first content. You will take ownership of styling from early concept development
items.desc: Company Description At H&M Creative Studios, we develop and deliver H&M’s customer-facing brand and content experiences globally. Bringing together strategists, creatives, designers, creators, producers and specialists, we are responsible for H&M’s global campaigns, editorial storytelling, creator marketing, organic social channels, e-commerce content, brand design and physical brand experiences. Together, we shape how millions of customers discover, experience and engage with H&M every day. Job Description WHAT YOU’LL DO As a Stylist in the Editorial team, you will play a key role in shaping how H&M expresses fashion through creative storytelling. Working closely with Art Directors, Copywriters and Creative Strategists, you will co-create concepts and lead the styling direction across still image, moving image and social-first content. You will take ownership of styling from early concept development through to final delivery, creating not only individual looks but complete visual worlds that bring the creative idea to life. You will: Partner with Art Directors, Copywriters and Creative Strategists to develop and shape creative concepts. Lead styling execution across still image, moving image and social-first content. Own the styling journey from concept development and pre-production through shoots and final delivery. Build complete visual narratives around the styling, ensuring product, looks and overall creative expression work together as one concept. Select and curate products for assigned projects, bringing a strong fashion point of view to every execution. Use customer insights, data and performance learnings to make stronger creative and styling decisions. Balance fashion credibility and creative ambition with commercial relevance and effectiveness. Guide and direct Junior Stylists during pre-production and on set. Stay closely connected to emerging fashion, cultural and customer trends. WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH You will be part of a collaborative creative environment, working closely with Art Directors, Copywriters, Creative Strategists and Junior Stylists, as well as partners across creative, commercial and production teams. Together, you will build concepts that combine fashion, storytelling and commercial relevance, creating content that can come to life across different channels and formats. Qualifications WHO YOU ARE We are looking for an experienced Stylist with a strong creative point of view and the ability to turn fashion and cultural insights into compelling visual storytelling. We believe you have: Strong styling experience across still image, moving image and/or social-first content. A strong creative vision and the ability to develop complete fashion narratives, not only individual looks. Deep knowledge of fashion, trends and culture, with a clear point of view on where fashion and the customer are heading. Experience working collaboratively across creative, commercial and production teams. The ability to translate customer insights and performance learnings into stronger creative decisions. Confidence balancing fashion credibility and aesthetic ambition with commercial effectiveness. Strong product selection and curation skills. The ability to communicate a clear styling direction and guide junior creative talent. Additional Information WHO WE ARE H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. 25% staff discount on all our H&M Group brands, both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET) H&M Incentive Program – HIP JOIN US Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things — our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. This is a full-time permanent role based in Stockholm. Please send your CV and Portfolio in English as soon as possible, by the latest Friday 11th December. We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application.

items.desc: Embedded Systemutvecklare erfarenhet av hårdvara Företaget är ett svenskt teknikkonsultbolag. Konsulterna arbetar med utveckling, test, projektledning, design, konfigurationshantering och mjukvaruintegration. De har uppdrag hos ledande företag som utvecklar avancerade tekniska produkter och system. De har kunder inom bland annat telekom, fordon, försvar, medicinteknik, finans, media och gaming. Flera kunder har ramavtal direkt med företaget. Kontoren ligger i Stockholm, Linköping, Göteborg, Malmö, Uppsala och Skövde. Medarbetaren står i centrum. Företaget kombinerar friheten i att driva eget med tryggheten i en fast anställning. Värderingarna är frihet, kunskap och passion. Du blir en del av ett nätverk av specialister inom embedded. Gemenskapen byggs genom after works, aktivitetsveckor, föreläsningar, konferenser och utbildningar. Det här är en rekrytering för en säkerhets klassad kund och kräver svenskt medborgarskap. Ansvarsområde: Utveckla mjukvara i fysiska, tekniska produkter och system där mjukvara och hårdvara samverkar. Ta fram robusta och långsiktigt hållbara lösningar där tillförlitlighet, prestanda och funktion är avgörande. Arbetsuppgifter: Utveckla mjukvara i komplexa styrsystem, kommunikationslösningar och avancerade sensorplattformar. Utveckla andra inbyggda system där mjukvaran är en integrerad del av den fysiska produkten. Arbeta med systemarkitektur, integration och felsökning i komplexa inbyggda system. Arbeta i tekniskt utmanande konsultuppdrag hos ledande produktbolag. Kompetenskrav Minst 6 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling inom embedded/inbyggda system. Erfarenhet från en produktorienterad verksamhet som utvecklar egna fysiska produkter eller tekniska system där mjukvara och hårdvara samverkar. Erfarenhet från generella IT-lösningar eller enbart applikationsutveckling är inte tillräcklig. Goda kunskaper i C och C++ eller andra relevanta programmeringsspråk för embeddedutveckling. Erfarenhet av Embedded Linux och gärna Yocto. Erfarenhet av realtidsoperativsystem (RTOS), exempelvis FreeRTOS, QNX, VxWorks eller Zephyr. Erfarenhet av drivrutinsutveckling och hårdvarunära programmering. Erfarenhet av kommunikationsprotokoll såsom CAN, Ethernet, SPI, I2C och UART. Erfarenhet av felsökning och verifiering med verktyg som JTAG, logikanalysator och oscilloskop. Erfarenhet av säkerhetskritiska eller realtidskritiska system, exempelvis enligt standarder som ISO 26262, IEC 61508, EN 50128 eller DO-178C. Erfarenhet av AUTOSAR är meriterande. Relevant högskole- eller civilingenjörsutbildning inom exempelvis datateknik, elektroteknik, elektronik eller motsvarande kompetens förvärvad genom arbetslivserfarenhet. Flytande svenska, i tal och skrift. Vi kommer inte ta personer vidare i rekryteringsprocessen som inte har flytande svenska. Meriterande: Erfarenhet från fordonsindustrin, försvar, radar- och sensorsystem, marina system, järnväg eller industriell automation. Erfarenhet av hårdvarunära programmering, drivrutiner eller kommunikationsprotokoll. Erfarenhet av systemarkitektur, integration och felsökning i komplexa inbyggda system. Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt som Scrum, Kanban eller SAFe. Personlighet och specifika egenskaper: Genuint tekniskt intresse. Förstår samspelet mellan hårdvara och mjukvara. Vill fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med några av branschens främsta teknikspecialister. Trivs med frihet och eget ansvar för sina uppdrag och sin utveckling. Vilka utvecklingsmöjligheter och förmåner erbjuder vi? Fast anställning Full insyn i uppdragsmöjligheter, timtaxor och karriärvägar. Möjlighet att påverka arbetssätt och kompetensutveckling. Välj mellan fast eller rörlig lön. Du kan själv påverka lön, pension och semester. After works, aktivitetsveckor, föreläsningar, konferenser och utbildningar. Ange ditt löneanspråk i din ansökan. Välkommen med din ansökan! Du blir anställd direkt av företaget. Du får information om vilket företag annonsen avser när du är i kontakt med rekryteraren. Bumbli Group är alltså inte arbetsgivaren utan rekryteringsbolaget. Bumbli Group är en del av House of Recruitment — ett personligt, traditionellt och kvalitetsdrivet rekryteringsbolag i Göteborg.

items.desc: Job Description Summary GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. We are now looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join our Hardware Engineering team in Uppsala, developing PET cyclotron and radiochemistry production systems. You will work with complex, high-precision technical systems with demanding requirements on robustness, reliability, and long operational lifetime. The role includes responsibility for mechanical development in both new product initiatives and improvements to the global installed base. You will be part of a multidisciplinary Hardware Engineering team of approximately 20 engineers, including a growing mechanical design group of eight engineers. The team collaborates closely across mechanical, electrical, and embedded engineering disciplines. The mechanical team has expanded significantly in recent years. As we continue to strengthen our engineering capabilities, you will have the opportunity to contribute to our processes, design standards, and ways of working, while developing your skills alongside experienced colleagues. At GE HealthCare, our machines, our software, our solutions, our services, and our people make a genuine difference to medical professionals and patients all over the world. That’s because we never lose sight of what healthcare really needs—the human touch. Job Description Our Expectations We understand that no candidate will meet every qualification listed below. If you bring mechanical design experience, solid CAD skills, and the motivation to contribute in a complex engineering environment, we encourage you to apply. Key Responsibilities Develop mechanical designs from concept through production as part of a multidisciplinary team. Develop and refine mechanical solutions involving precision structures, vacuum systems, cooling systems, pressure-containing components, and integrated assemblies. Design components for environments influenced by RF fields, magnetic fields, and radiation, working with relevant specialists. Implement engineering changes for products in the installed base, considering robustness, compatibility, and serviceability. Consider performance, reliability, manufacturability, long service life, and Variable Cost Productivity (VCP) in design work. Support structural and thermal analyses and work with specialists on FEA or CFD simulations when applicable. Contribute to risk management activities, such as FMEA, and work according to applicable regulatory and quality requirements, such as ISO 13485. Create and maintain 3D models, drawings, bills of materials (BOMs), and engineering documentation using CAD and product lifecycle management (PLM) systems. Support prototyping, verification testing, root cause investigations, and continuous product improvement. Participate in design reviews and contribute ideas for improving engineering practices. Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience. Approximately five years of experience in mechanical design or a related engineering role. Experience with 3D CAD design. Experience with PTC Creo is an advantage, as it is the primary CAD tool used within the team. Experience creating and maintaining technical drawings, bills of materials, and engineering documentation. Knowledge of materials, manufacturing processes, and design for reliability and service life. Experience with engineering changes, installed base products, or PLM systems such as PTC Windchill or MyWorkshop is an advantage. Experience with vacuum technology, cooling systems, pressure-containing components, or precision assemblies is an advantage. Familiarity with risk management and regulated product development is an advantage. Experience with simulation tools such as ANSYS (FEA and/or CFD) is an advantage. Ability to take ownership of assigned work, collaborate across disciplines, and seek support when needed. Why Join Us Join a growing Hardware Engineering team and work alongside experienced colleagues. Develop your technical skills and contribute to design decisions and ways of working. Work with complex products that have long lifecycles and global impact. If you are interested in learning more we are looking forward to your online-application! Don't meet all the requirements? We are aware that there is almost never a perfect profile. You can learn (almost) anything as long as you are interested and enjoy new topics and challenges. In short: we look forward to receiving your application, even if you do not yet meet the requirements 100%! About us GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator with over 100 years of healthcare industry experience and around 50,000 employees globally. We enable clinicians to make faster, more informed decisions through intelligent devices, data analytics, applications and services, supported by our Edison intelligence …

With technology, we turn spontaneous thoughts into meaningful experiences, helping people travel the world Job Description The setup Job Title: Corporate Affairs Specialist Working model: Hybrid Team: Legal & Corporate Affairs Location: Chiasso, Switzerland Contract: Fixed term (12 months) - full-time (36 hours/week) Budget: up to 55k EUR Travel time required: None / Minimal We are looking for a Corporate Affairs Specialist to join the Legal & Corporate Affairs team at lastminute.com , a dynamic global company powering millions of holiday journeys. You will be a key reference for managing corporate governance across our worldwide subsidiaries, supporting strategic transactions, and ensuring strict compliance with SIX Swiss Exchange requirements. Working closely with Finance, auditors, and external consultants, you will own corporate housekeeping tasks end-to-end—from drafting legal documents and managing board meetings to coordinating compliance workflows with autonomy and precision. If you are thorough, detail-oriented, and thrive in a fast-paced international environment, keep reading! Key Responsibilities Manage board and shareholders' meetings for each subsidiary of the lastminute.com group (including drafting call notices, minutes, and handling statutory filings). Liaise with foreign consultants regarding corporate activities and compliance for subsidiaries based worldwide. Draft powers of attorney, proxies, and confidentiality agreements (NDAs). Assist internal and external auditors and advisors involved in specific corporate transactions (such as M&A, due diligence, new-co incorporations, and share/asset deals). items.desc: Research Technician in Environmental Engineering and Microbiology ( Job Number: 26001523) Department of Biosciences Grade 6: - £31,861 to £32,722 per annum Fixed Term - Full Time Contract Duration: 12 Months Contracted Hours per Week: 35 Closing Date : 08-Dec-2026, 5:59:00 PM Disclosure and Barring Service Requirement: Not Applicable. The University At Durham University we are proud of our people. A globally outstanding centre of educational excellence, a collegiate community of extraordinary people, a unique and historic setting – Durham is a university like no other. Across the University we have a huge variety of roles and career opportunities, which together make us a large and successful community, which is a key hub of activity within our region and nationally. Whether you are at the very start, middle or end of your career, there is a role for you. We believe everyone has their own unique skills to offer. We would be thrilled if you would consider joining our thriving University. The Role and the Department We are looking for a practical, well-organised Research Technician to join CARMA – the Co-selection of Antimicrobial Resistance by Metals Alliance. CARMA is a large, transdisciplinary UKRI-funded research programme investigating how metal pollution in rivers and wastewater co-selects for antimicrobial resistance (AMR), and what this means for human health, environmental regulation and intervention. It brings together Durham University, Imperial College London, the University of Birmingham, the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi and Pondicherry University, with environmental engineers, microbiologists, infection specialists, modellers, economists, genomic experts, patients and practitioners. The post is based in the Department of Biosciences at Durham, in the research group of Professor David Graham. You will carry out the project’s UK field sampling and much of the laboratory work that underpins it, working closely with the project’s Postdoctoral Research Associate in Environmental Engineering and Microbiology (the ‘PDRA’). Together with the PDRA you will collect river water and sediment from sites in North East England (including the North Tyne, South Tyne and Ouseburn) in wet and dry seasons. Back in the laboratory you will: carry out water and sediment physicochemical analyses, including BOD, COD, nitrogen and phosphorus species, organic carbon, and total and bioavailable metals; With the PDRA, culture, isolate and characterise antibiotic- and metal-resistant bacteria, including antimicrobial and metal susceptibility testing that complements whole-genome sequencing; Extract, purify and quality-check DNA from bacterial isolates and from sediment and water samples, and prepare it for the different types of sequencing (short-read and long-read genome sequencing, and metagenomic sequencing), which will be carried out by specialist providers; Prepare, store and ship samples for analysis of pharmaceuticals and antibiotic residues, which will be carried out by our partners in India; Provide analytical support to colleagues in India, and help organise the shipping and processing of samples, isolates and DNA between and among project partners in the UK and India; Give informal tutorials and guidance on laboratory methods to junior members of the laboratory, such as students. Partners in India collect and analyse samples from the Ganges, Yamuna and near Chennai using the same protocols, so careful, consistent and well-documented work is central to the role. With samples, isolates and data moving between several laboratories in two countries, we are looking for someone who is exceptionally well organised. A full list of the analyses and techniques involved is given in the Annex at the end of this document. We do not expect applicants to have experience of all of them – training will be provided – but we ask you to tell us which you have and have not done. The post reports to Professor David Graham and is co-managed by Dr Marcos Quintela-Baluja; day-to-day laboratory and field work will be planned and checked jointly with the PDRA. This is a laboratory- and field-based role, so you will normally work on site in Durham. Fieldwork involves working outdoors beside and in rivers in all weathers, sometimes with early starts, and we will discuss flexible working hours around field campaigns. This post is full time and fixed term for 12 months, starting on 1 March 2027. There is the possibility of extension for up to a further 12 months, subject to the needs of the project, available funding and performance. The post is funded by a UKRI research grant (CARMA) and is tied to that time-limited project. Working at Durham A competitive salary is only one part of the many fantastic benefits you will receive if you join the University: You’ll receive 27 days annual leave per year in addition to 8 public holidays and 4 customary days per year - a total of 39 days. The University closes between Christmas and New Year. …

items.desc: University Hospital Southampton is delighted to offer a fantastic opportunity to work with us Job Title: Laboratory Scientific Technician Contract Type: Permanent Please be advised that this vacancy may close earlier than stated if we receive a large number of applications. This is an exciting opportunity to join our research and development team within microbiology at UHS. As part our team, you will support the Clinical Scientists in manufacturing reagents for a locally developed sample purification and PCR amplification system and ensuring that they meet performance requirements. The department processes over a million samples per year and employs almost 100 staff to delivery all aspects of diagnostic microbiology. As part of our team you will contribute to the delivery of an outstanding service that directly impacts patient care. Please refer to the job description for further information. As one of the largest acute teaching Trusts in England, we offer learning and development opportunities to help you achieve the career you aspire to. UHS is rated ‘Good’ by the CQC and in the latest national NHS Staff Survey, we were in the top 10 acute trusts for staff engagement and for staff recommending the hospital as a place to work or receive care. We support flexible working and will consider requests taking into account the needs of the service. UHS employees are able to access a range of NHS discounts, are entitled to a minimum of 35 days paid holiday (pro rata), and we offer a generous pension scheme. Southampton is an attractive place to live and work situated on the south coast, with an international airport and direct trains to London. The New Forest National Park and beaches of the Jurassic coast are also right on our doorstep. The city offers living costs 30% lower than London and 17 schools rated outstanding by Ofsted. We believe that using technology wisely shows strong time management and commitment to innovation. However, personalising your recruitment application to highlight your unique skills and experiences is crucial. Relying too heavily on generic, AI-generated content instead of drawing from your own strengths and accomplishments may lead to your application being rejected if multiple candidates present identical or similar information. You will work under the supervision of the Clinical Scientists, supporting the R&D team by making reagents, performing quality control to ensure that assays are fit for purpose. You will support the development and validation of new equipment and protocols and to train staff on new or updated methodologies. You will work as part of the laboratory team, providing high quality analysis of samples to provide patients with the highest level of diagnosis and treatment. You will assist the sequencing team to undertake stock-takes and sample collection. You will work core shifts, Monday to Friday, 09:00-17:30. You must be able to work independently, carefully following methods and managing your time. You must be able to maintain concentration and accuracy whilst working in a busy laboratory environment.

LOCATION: Holly Road Head Offices, Skegness, Lincolnshire JOB TITLE: R&D Scientist (Industrial Placement) JOB TYPE: Full Time - 12 month placement - starting in the summer of 2027 HOURS OF WORK: Monday to Friday – 09:00 – 17:00 (with half an hour unpaid lunch break) SALARY RANGE: £26,230 per annum JOB PURPOSE: This role is a year in industry role, starting in the summer of 2027 and would be ideal for a student studying a sandwich degree, year in industry placement or a recently graduated student. You will support the R&D team with the day-to-day functions whilst supporting with a specific project during the placement. Key Responsibilities to include: Take ownership of defined research and product development projects under R&D supervision. Work collaboratively with external technical partners on material and product development. Plan and conduct experiments, testing and technical investigations. Collect, analyse and interpret experimental data. Evaluate new materials, technologies and product opportunities. Support prototype development, product validation and production trials. Maintain accurate technical records and project documentation. Work collaboratively with R&D, Technical, Quality, Production and Commercial teams. Present technical findings, conclusions and recommendations. Support continuous improvement and the development of Micronclean's internal R&D capabilities. Knowledge, Skills and Qualifications required: Essential Analytical and problem-solving ability. Competent IT skills in the use of Microsoft Office products. Methodical approach to practical work Project management and ownership skills. Good written and verbal communication. Desirable On target for at least a 2:1 Degree (or degree equivalent) or above in their related subject. Product Design, Materials Science, Textile Technology, Chemistry or Microbiology based degree advantageous. Character Profile Micronclean’s unique culture is captured within the Micronclean SKIEs. These four principles Stewardship, Knowledge, Innovation and Excellence provide a compass for our strategic direction, help inform the multitude of day-to-day business decisions and keep our customers firmly at the centre of everything we do. A candidate’s character affinity to our culture will be paramount to their suitability for this role. A copy of our vision and values (the Micronclean SKIEs) can be provided as part of the recruitment process. Closing date for application: Friday 11 th December 2026 Interview date: Provisionally December 2026 (exact date TBC) We reserve the right to close this vacancy early, or change the closing date, if we receive sufficient applications for the role. Why Work for Micronclean as a R&D Scientist (Industrial Placement) There are many reasons to join the Micronclean family, but here are just a few more: A generous yearly bonus paid every January, to all staff. Relocation package of £2,000. Homeworking Policy - can request up to 3 WFH days (subject to approval) 30 days’ annual leave (including bank holidays), increasing to 33 days for loyalty service. Company Sick Pay scheme. Company pension contributions of 5% of salary. Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), private counselling and other schemes to support employees with their mental health and wellbeing. A growing, family owned, highly successful business, with a history spanning back to the 1920s. Highly committed to investing in people and training, with a proven history of opportunities and promotions from within for employees who wish to progress. A great culture, represented in our company values known as the SKIEs. The knowledge that you are making a difference, playing a role in key supply chains such as the Covid-19 vaccine. About Micronclean Micronclean is a family-owned business based in Lincolnshire employing over 400 people. The company provides products and services to various industries. Our current focus areas include rental of specialist work wear to cleanroom industries (pharmaceutical, medical devices, aerospace), and of protective workwear to manufacturing industries (engineering, automotive). The company also manufactures and distributes a range of cleanroom products, which it sells in the UK and exports throughout Europe and further afield, including India, Australia, and Canada. The company has an ambitious vision for growth both in the UK where we are investing in all our plants and abroad where our plant in Bangalore, India has recently been commissioned and is supporting the production of Covid-19 vaccines in India. More information about Micronclean can be found on our website, please click here.

items.desc: Ready to Make a Difference Are you an experienced Analytical Chemist looking for the next step in your career? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, working on cutting-edge medical device and pharmaceutical testing? Cormica is seeking an Analytical Scientist to join our dynamic team in Bradford, West Yorkshire. About Us Cormica is a leading provider of analytical research, development and testing services for medical device and pharmaceutical manufacturers, drawing on the expertise and heritage of its world-renowned laboratories. Our mission is to improve patients’ lives by enabling our clients to launch and release their products safely and rapidly across the world. Our business is home to scientists with in-depth experience in their fields, who are enthusiastic about taking on challenges. We are always looking for people who can keep us at the top of our game. What We’re Looking For BSc (or higher degree) in analytical, chemical or related scientific field with demonstrated, relevant experience Practical and theoretical experience with analytical techniques, particularly GC-MS and LC-MS Experience working with medical devices or pharmaceutical products ideally including extractables and leachables studies, for instance according to ISO10993 / ISO18562 Strong statistical and data analysis skills, including data trending and uncertainty calculations Experience within a GMP and / or CRO environment Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work Strong collaborative and problem-solving skills in a team-oriented environment Ability to manage time effectively, work to tight deadlines; a “right first time” approach A professional and proactive approach when engaging with clients and colleagues Strong written and oral communications skills; IT Literate. Role is subject to probation and training on internal processes. The Role This role presents an exciting opportunity to an individual with a strong chromatography background obtained within a pharmaceutical or medical device focused environment. As an Analytical Scientist, you will play a crucial role in the development, validation, and execution of analytical methods to support laboratory projects, particularly those with an Extractables and Leachables focus. You will work closely with our technical experts, ensuring the efficient and high-quality execution of projects while mentoring analysts and maintaining compliance with industry standards. Key Responsibilities Design and lead challenging laboratory-based analytical project work, this may include; discussions with clients, preparation of protocols, technical oversight of analytical work, conducting complex analysis, processing and review of analytical data, preparation of technical reports, and presentations to clients. Develop, optimize, and validate robust analytical methods within project timelines. Support client enquiries, providing clear and professional technical insights. Mentor and train team members, fostering technical growth and high-quality work. Retain and develop technical skills and knowledge by maintaining awareness of scientific literature to assist work progression and contribute to scientific strategic service offerings. Working Hours Full time (37.5hrs per week). Company Benefits We offer a range of learning and development opportunities depending on the role, with all employees having access to a range of internally delivered training modules as standard. In our science-based roles we offer structured career progression, more details of which can be discussed during the recruitment process. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer as a minimum: Pension scheme, Healthcare Cash Plan, Cycle to Work scheme, Childcare Vouchers and local Reward & Recognition schemes. Please submit your application via the Cormica Careers Page using the following link: https://cormica.careers.hibob.com/jobs/5b2508c9-48f4-4ab3-a8b4-7329fd945450 Pay: £32,000.00-£36,000.00 per year Benefits: Casual dress Company pension Cycle to work scheme Free parking Health & wellbeing programme On-site parking Sick pay Work Location: In person

items.desc: About the role Join the team behind Price Service —a mission-critical HTTP API powering pricing and promotions across all of Tesco’s channels. From tills to websites and everything in between, our work touches the lives of over 28 million UK shoppers every week , with global reach on the horizon. We’re building a robust, internet-facing API that runs both in stores and in the cloud, designed to support future innovation at scale. This means solving complex distributed systems challenges, ensuring high availability, and optimizing performance. Concepts like the CAP theorem aren’t just theory here—they’re part of our daily engineering conversations. Our stack includes Java, Vert.x, RxJava, Groovy, Couchbase, and Kafka , built using Terraform , running in Kubernetes on Azure utilising GitHub Actions pipelines. We follow Agile principles, adapting Kanban and other methodologies to fit the team’s needs. Collaboration is at the heart of our culture—pair programming is common, and all code is reviewed via GitHub. You will be responsible for Design and implement end-to-end systems using your deep JVM and java ecosystem expertise. Translate product requirements into well-structured, maintainable code. Write test-driven features and follow the TDD and BDD cycle. Apply SOLID principles and cohesive design to build scalable software. Design, build, deploy and maintain the required infrastructure. Collaborate with product stakeholders to shape and refine features. Support production systems, resolve incidents, and conduct root cause analysis. Mentor and support fellow engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning. Share knowledge across the wider engineering community. Prototype and evaluate new tools and technologies. You will need Strong experience with Java 8+ . Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, etc.). Proficiency with both SQL and NoSQL databases. Proven ability to scale systems effectively. Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall). Exposure to reactive programming paradigms. Bonus: Experience with eCommerce or search systems . Whats in it for you? We’re all about the little helps. That’s why we make sure our Tesco colleague benefits package takes care of you – both in and out of work. Click Here to find out more! Annual bonus scheme of up to 20% of base salary. Holiday starting at 25 days plus a personal day (plus Bank holidays). Private medical insurance. 26 weeks maternity and adoption leave (12 months service required at the qualifying date) at full pay, followed by 13 weeks of Statutory Maternity Pay or Statutory Adoption Pay, we also offer 6 weeks fully paid paternity leave. Free 24/7 virtual GP service, Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and your family, free access to a range of experts to support your mental wellbeing. The above information is a shortened summary, refer to our policies for full details About Us You might know us as a supermarket, technology company or even for our award-winning mobile network. Truth is, we’re all of those things, and much more. Our colleagues work with one goal in mind, helping to make every day a little better for our customers, colleagues and communities all over the world. No two customers are the same, neither are our colleagues. At Tesco, we champion a balance that lets you thrive both in and out of work. Spend 60% of your week collaborating with colleagues at our office locations or local sites and the rest remotely. Whether you're just kicking off your career, juggling passions, or navigating big life events, we're here to support you. We always welcome a conversation about flexible working, so talk to us throughout your application about how we can support. We're proud to be an accredited Disability Confident Leader, where everyone’s welcome. That’s why we commit to providing a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you need support with your application, click here for more information. And if you're interested in joining our team but don't tick every box, don't let that hold you back from applying. When you join us in this role, you'll be employed by Tesco Stores Limited, the Tesco legal entity responsible for your employment.
