You’ll work closely
items.desc: About the role and team As a Data Engineer, you’ll join a collaborative technology team responsible for developing and supporting the data capabilities that underpin our business. You’ll play a hands-on role in designing and building data pipelines, integrations, governed datasets and data products, working across platforms including Snowflake, Microsoft Azure Data Factory and Microsoft Power BI. You’ll work closely with technical colleagues, data governance teams and business stakeholders to understand what they need and translate those requirements into reliable, well-designed solutions. The role goes beyond traditional data engineering. You’ll also have the opportunity to contribute to our growing use of AI, helping us build the data foundations required for AI solutions as well as using AI tools to improve the way we engineer, automate and solve problems. We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, can communicate confidently with both technical and non-technical colleagues, and wants to help shape how data and AI capabilities evolve across the firm. What you'll be doing Designing, building and supporting scalable data pipelines and integrations using SQL, Python and modern data engineering approaches. Developing end-to-end data solutions that support reporting, analytics and AI use cases across the firm. Building and maintaining governed datasets and reusable data products, ensuring data is reliable, accessible and fit for purpose. Integrating enterprise and cloud platforms, including Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Power BI, Salesforce and other business applications. Working with business stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions. Applying strong data management and governance practices, including data quality, lineage, metadata, glossary and appropriate controls. Working with data governance colleagues to ensure solutions follow agreed enterprise data standards and procedures. Monitoring, troubleshooting and optimising data pipelines to ensure performance, scalability and operational reliability, including acting as a point of escalation for more complex issues. Applying software engineering disciplines including Git, automated testing, CI/CD and automation to improve the quality and consistency of delivery. Supporting the responsible adoption of AI, including developing AI-enabled solutions and using AI tools to improve engineering workflows and operational efficiency. Considering security, compliance and responsible AI throughout the design and delivery of solutions. Creating and maintaining clear technical documentation and sharing knowledge across the team. Identifying opportunities to simplify processes, reduce manual effort and improve the way data is managed and used across Walter Scott. Skills and experience We're interested in someone who combines strong technical skills with curiosity, sound judgement and an ability to work collaboratively. items.desc: Vulnerability Management Engineer “Help us find, prioritise and remediate security vulnerabilities across our technology estate” At Castle Trust Bank, we pride ourselves in being a fintech challenger bank, providing specialist property mortgages, retail finance lending and savings accounts to a variety of customers. We are looking for a hands-on Vulnerability Management Engineer to join our Technology team at Castle Trust Bank. Working closely with our Vulnerability Management Lead, you will help identify, assess and drive the remediation of security vulnerabilities across a diverse technology estate. This includes servers, applications, networks, cloud platforms, end-user computing, data environments, security devices, hardware and firmware. You will run and optimise vulnerability scanning tools, validate findings, assess risk and provide practical remediation guidance to technical teams. Just as importantly, you will follow actions through to verified closure, helping us maintain a secure, resilient and well-controlled environment for our customers and colleagues. This role is based in Basingstoke on a hybrid basis working 3 days office and 2 days at home. The role and what you’ll deliver: You will be: Running, configuring and tuning vulnerability scans and discovery activities using tools such as Qualys and Microsoft Defender Ensuring assets are within scope, scans complete successfully and any coverage gaps are identified Triaging and validating findings, removing false positives and grouping issues to support effective remediation Assessing vulnerabilities using CVEs, CVSS scoring, exploitability and the wider business context Maintaining our security improvement register, including owners, actions, target dates, status and supporting evidence Mapping findings against the NIST Cyber Security Framework Working with Platform, Network, Data, Application Support and IT Service Desk teams to agree practical remediation actions Providing technical guidance on patching, configuration changes, upgrades and compensating controls Verifying remediation through rescanning and evidence checks before closing findings Monitoring vendor advisories and threat intelligence to identify newly disclosed risks relevant to our estate Tracking end-of-support dates and highlighting upcoming technology obsolescence Maintaining an inventory and patching status for hardware and firmware that may not be covered by routine scanning Producing dashboards and management information covering remediation performance, trends and overdue actions Translating penetration testing and audit findings into clear, owned actions Automating repetitive processes using PowerShell , Python or similar tools Maintaining clear procedures, runbooks and exception records to support an auditable process Supporting incident and problem management where vulnerabilities are being exploited or affecting services Participating in the Technology on-call rota, providing 24/7/365 cover What you’ll bring: You will be naturally curious, analytical and committed to keeping your technical knowledge current. You will take a pragmatic approach to security, balancing technical risk with business priorities and service requirements. In addition, you will have: Essential Hands-on experience using vulnerability scanning and management tools such as Qualys Experience running scans, interpreting results and prioritising remediation activity Good working knowledge of Windows Server and Linux, including patching and secure configuration A solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP and firewalls Knowledge of virtualisation, ideally Hyper-V An understanding of public cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure, AWS or GCP Working knowledge of endpoint management and security tools, including Microsoft Intune and Defender A good understanding of CVEs, CVSS scoring and exploitability Experience applying business context when assessing and prioritising technical vulnerabilities Scripting or automation experience using PowerShell, Python or a similar language An understanding of patch, vulnerability and change management within a controlled or regulated environment Awareness of security frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001 or CIS Controls Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to different audiences Desirable Experience working within financial services or another regulated sector Knowledge of network and security technologies such as Palo Alto, Cisco Meraki or HPE Aruba Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform Familiarity with Active Directory security assessment tools, including BloodHound or Purple Knight Experience using an IT service management tool to manage tickets and changes A relevant certification such as CompTIA Security+, Microsoft AZ-500, Microsoft SC-200 or a Qualys certification ITIL Foundation or a degree in Computer Science, cybersecurity or a related subject …

items.desc: Description About the role Bloomsbury Football Foundation is on a mission to transform the lives of young people through the magic of football, ensuring everyone has the opportunity to play regardless of ability to pay. Our programmes reach over 7,000 young people every week, and we are now launching our first Community outside of London, in Leicester. As Lead Football Coach, you will plan and lead high-quality, inclusive coaching sessions across our Leicester Communities programme, working in schools, community venues and holiday camps. Every session you deliver will intentionally support our impact goals, helping young people develop physically, socially and emotionally while giving them a place to play, a community to belong to, and the tools to move forward in life. You will be one of the first faces of BFF in Leicester. Working closely with the Communities Programme Lead and with support from our London-based coaching team, you will build strong relationships with young people, parents, partners and venue staff, and help shape what Bloomsbury looks like in a new city. To succeed in this role, you'll bring energy, creativity and care to every session, a commitment to safeguarding, and a drive to keep improving your coaching practice and the programme around you. Our commitment to inclusion At Bloomsbury, belonging isn't just something we create for the young people we serve it's something we live as an organisation and is embedded into core values. We are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we work in, and we actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, and identities. We particularly welcome applications from women and people from underrepresented groups, who remain underrepresented in both the sport and charity sectors. We know that the best idea wins regardless of who it comes from, and we are proud to be building an organisation where everyone has a place to play, belong, and progress. Key Responsibilities Session Planning & Delivery: Plan and lead the delivery of regular coaching sessions across Communities and Special Projects programmes that intentionally support Bloomsbury Football’s impact goals and youth development outcomes. Create engaging, age-appropriate and inclusive session plans that cater to a wide range of abilities, promoting physical, social and emotional development. Deliver high-quality coaching that reflects Bloomsbury's dedication to purpose, belonging and progression on and off the pitch. Relationship Building & Communication: Create and maintain positive relationships with multiple stakeholders including young people, parents, partners and venue staff Communicate effectively and confidently with young children, parents and other stakeholders Represent Bloomsbury Football Foundation professionally at all times, embodying our mission to transform lives through the magic of football. items.desc: We are looking for motivated, passionate self-starters who want to kickstart a career in Addictions . This position is a fantastic opportunity to make a real difference and use your own lived experience of substance use and recovery to support those who are currently accessing drug and alcohol services. As an IPS Peer Employment Specialist in BLMK, you will play a vital role in helping people find meaningful and fulfilling employment. You’ll receive training and support , develop your skills, and have access to a broad range of opportunities. Joining a passionate and driven team, you’ll be working towards creating a fairer and more inclusive society for people. We welcome applications from all experience levels and backgrounds . What you will need is the ability to motivate and build relationships with service users, strong organisational skills, the confidence to communicate and engage with a range of employers, multi-agency partners, and a fundamental belief that anyone can work. Please note we will measure the quality of the application you submit as an assessment method towards your suitability for the Employment Specialist Role. Before submitting your application please proofread your application to ensure all areas are fully completed and check that spelling and grammar is correct.* What is an IPS Employment Specialist? This is a rewarding and dynamic role where no day is the same and you’ll be making a genuine difference to people’s lives. Using the Individual Placement and Support (IPS) model you’ll be: Supporting and motivating individuals who have received support for their addiction to access and sustain paid employment. Regularly meeting with clients to listen, offer support and help them identify their best job match, reflecting their skills and aspirations. Supporting the clients through CV production, interview techniques and managing their health at work. Advocating for your clients by educating and engaging with employers regarding the IPS service. Sourcing job opportunities for your clients through regular contact with local employers within the community. Promoting employment and raising expectations around the ability of service users to access paid employment, breaking down the barriers for them. Delivering employment-focused groups and workshops to clients. Working for Central North West London NHS Trust You will also be part of the Trustwide Employment Services Team and Addictions Directorate. You will receive a number of staff benefits working for CNWL Trust, this includes an attractive pension scheme, a range of staff networks, travel discounts, employee assistance programme and discounts at hundreds of retailers nationwide. This role is an excellent opportunity to start a long-term career within the addictions sector, develop your skills and a gateway to the vast number of opportunities within CNWL. Apply today to become an IPS Peer Employment Specialist and make a real difference! The successful applicant may have contact with patients or service users. As an NHS Trust we strongly encourage and support vaccination as this remains the best way to protect yourself, your family, your colleagues and of course patients and service users when working on our healthcare settings. For further info please visit: Skilled Worker visa: Overview - GOV.UK Who are we looking for? Firstly, you will need to have your own personal lived experience of substance use and accessing services. You will also need either a degree-level education or relevant work experience, such as in the health and social care or employment sectors. Alongside having strong and persuasive communication skills, excellent time management and exceptional organisational skills. Also, the ability to initiate and develop relationships with a variety of individuals and be able to engage employers using a variety of methods such as via the telephone or face-to-face in the community. It would also be helpful, but NOT essential, if you have experience of working with people with addiction support needs (or similar groups) OR have experience working in employment support services (or equivalent), this can include working with people on a one-to-one basis, offering motivation and support, or engaging with a range of stakeholders. We are actively interested in individuals who have experience using a persuasive communication style or promoting a service to a variety of audiences, this can include marketing, recruitment, or sales roles. items.desc: Join our dedicated Wound Centre Service, delivering high-quality, patient-centred care to housebound patients with complex wounds across East Kent. Working within a supportive multidisciplinary team aligned to Primary Care Networks, you will provide specialist wound care in clinic settings, supported by Patient Transport, and in patients' own homes where required. You will deliver evidence-based interventions and holistic assessments that promote healing, independence and improved quality of life. The service works closely with Community Nursing teams to provide integrated care and ensure patients receive the right treatment at the right time. This role offers excellent opportunities for professional development, enabling you to build advanced clinical skills through training and specialist support. Interventions commonly include wound management for leg ulcers and post-operative wounds, lower limb and Doppler assessments, VAC therapy, maggot therapy, and health promotion for patients living with long-term conditions. As a Wound Clinic Practitioner, no two days are the same. You will manage a varied caseload, providing assessment, planning, implementation and evaluation of personalised care for patients with complex wound care needs. Your responsibilities will include changing wound dressings, catheter care, undertaking holistic assessments and delivering clinical interventions within your scope of practice. You will work in partnership with patients to develop integrated care plans that support their health goals and promote self-management wherever possible. The role also includes supporting the supervision and development of junior colleagues, Healthcare Assistants and students, helping to maintain high standards of care across the service. Working collaboratively with community and primary care teams, you will contribute to safe, effective and compassionate care that makes a real difference to patients across East Kent. items.desc: Global Operations TikTok Shop - Europe LIVE Country Business Partner (Chinese Speaker) Location : London Employment Type : Regular Job Code : A171702 Responsibilities The TikTok commerce team builds the solutions that help businesses engage audiences, inspire product discovery, and create commercial experiences on a platform where brands and merchants connect meaningfully with creators and communities. items.desc: Pennine Care NHS Foundation Trust CONSULTANT in Crisis Resolution Home Treatment Team Stockport - 10PAs Pennine Care NHS Foundation Trust is looking to recruit a full-time substantive Consultant Psychiatrist for the Crisis Resolution Home Treatment Team based in stepping Hill Hospital. The post - holder will provide providing medical leadership and management of patients presenting with mental health crises treated at home or supporting discharge from inpatient services. This is an exciting time to join the Trust and there are many opportunities to contribute to the organisations’ development and to look at service redesign models. Stockport has a very strong teaching commitment and candidates will be expected to contribute to the teaching of medical and nursing staff. There are close links with ongoing research projects. The Consultants contribute to local service user & carer groups. To provide high-quality Mental Health Care for adults presenting with mental health crises treated at home or supporting discharge from inpatient services. To work closely with other teams and Consultants to ensure coherent and high-quality mental health care for adults with severe and enduring mental health problems within the Stockport area. To work with the other Consultants to support the development of the service, and to attend local and divisional service development meetings. Applicants must be on the GMC’s Specialist Register or eligible for inclusion or be within six months’ of the anticipated award of a Certificate of Completion of Training (CCT) in General Adult Psychiatry at the time of interview for the post. On Call frequency is 1 in 27 We offer ample opportunities for our consultants’ professional development and opportunities for additional work for additional PAs (require negotiation) . We are proud to provide high quality mental health and learning disability services, both inpatient and in the community across five boroughs of Greater Manchester - Bury, Oldham, Rochdale, Stockport and Tameside and Glossop. Our vision is for a happier and more hopeful life for everyone in our communities and our staff work hard to deliver the very best care for the people who use our services. We’re really proud of our #PennineCarePeople and do everything we can to make sure we’re a great place to work. All individuals regardless of race, age, disability, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marriage and civil partnership are encouraged to apply for this post. We would also encourage applications from individuals with a lived experience of mental illness, either individually or as a carer. Please see attached job description and person specification to support your application for this post. Quanta Group provides a full wealth management service through three core businesses - an investment platform, financial planning and advice business, and discretionary fund manager. Each business operates independently of each other yet gives financial planners the flexibility to deliver advice using any combination of our products, investments, and services: Wealthtime – an award-winning investment platform that helps advisers deliver the best outcomes for their clients, bringing together smart technology and expert support. Copia Capital Management – a leading discretionary fund manager that works exclusively with advisers to provide a range of managed portfolio services. About the Role The Financial Crime Analyst is responsible for assisting the Financial Crime Manager to manage and oversee Wealthtime and Copia Capital Management’s efforts to prevent and detect financial crimes, such as money laundering, fraud, terrorist financing, and bribery. They will maintain policies, procedures, and controls to ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations. The Financial Crime Analyst will also provide support to 1st line business units, assist with investigations as required, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to mitigate financial crime risks. The role holder will support the Money Laundering Reporting Officer and wider team to maintain a financial crime framework appropriate to Wealthtime and Copia Capital Management. Key Responsibilities: Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of relevant laws, regulations, and industry best practices related to financial crime prevention. Maintain policies, procedures, and controls to prevent and detect financial crimes, such as money laundering, fraud, terrorist financing, and bribery. Provide guidance and support to business units on financial crime prevention matters, including reviewing and approving high-risk transactions and customer relationships. Conduct risk assessments to identify potential financial crime risks and develop strategies to mitigate them. Monitor and analyse transactions and customer activities for suspicious patterns or behaviors that may indicate financial crime. Assisting the Financial Crime Manager to investigate and respond to suspected financial crime incidents, including conducting internal investigations, gathering evidence, and reporting findings to management and relevant authorities. Collaborate with internal stakeholders, such as legal, risk management, and compliance, to ensure a coordinated approach to financial crime prevention. Stay up to date on industry trends and changes in regulations related to financial crime prevention. Deliver training programs to educate employees on financial crime prevention measures and their compliance obligations. Assist the Financial Crime Manager to collaborate with external stakeholders, such as law enforcement agencies and regulatory bodies, to share information and best practices in financial crime prevention. Assist the Financial Crime Manager to prepare regulatory reports and filings related to financial crime prevention as required. Maintain internal communications pages and other communication channels regarding financial crime and support financial crime training. Keep the Financial Crime Manager informed of significant financial crime issues and developments. Conduct periodic reviews and audits to assess the effectiveness of financial crime prevention controls and make recommendations for improvements. Ensure the Wealthtime Group’s compliance with data privacy and security requirements related to financial crime prevention. Create and comment on Financial Crime MI which feeds into the MLRO’s and Compliance Officer’s Board Reports. Respond to queries in the financial crime mailbox. Update and have oversight of financial crime risk events on OMIA. About You Specialist Skills, Qualifications and Experience: Experience in Financial Crime Prevention within the financial services industry in a 2nd line compliance role. Relevant business qualification (e.g., Certified Anti Money Laundering Specialist) Strong knowledge of relevant laws, regulations, and industry best practices related to financial crime prevention. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and mitigate financial crime risks. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the …

Whether it's data strategy, governance, engineering, analytics, or AI, we work with our clients to turn data into real, impactful results. Data Licensing Specialist London | Hybrid Model - working from home up to 40% | Reference 8437 Data Licensing Management Specialist – London About the Role We are seeking an experienced Data Licensing Management Specialist to join the Data Licensing Management team in London. You will manage third-party data supplier licensing, commercial governance, entitlement controls and supplier reporting, and implement data products across the organisation. As a subject matter expert, you will work independently to translate supplier contractual requirements into effective operational processes, product configurations, accurate customer communications, compliance controls and reporting procedures. You will take ownership of operational processes, use evidence to resolve complex licensing issues and inform decisions, and coordinate action across stakeholders. You will drive improvements in service quality, accuracy, efficiency and control, maintaining a strong focus on governance, compliance and operational excellence. What You Will Do Key Responsibilities Manage the supplier data lifecycle from acquisition to delivery and ongoing compliance. Interpret contracts, assess supplier changes and implement licensing restrictions and commercial controls. Provide expertise on market data, reference data, news licensing and supplier policies. Coordinate implementation of supplier agreements and changes, maintain auditable records and operational procedures, and drive improvements in controls, consistency, quality, and efficiency. Maintain accurate product assortments and entitlements for customers, internal users, applications and suppliers. Conduct reviews, remediation and data clean-up, coordinating implementation with Product Management, Customer Operations, Technology and Sales. Produce and validate accurate supplier usage and operational reports, and support internal, external, and supplier audits. Maintain operational supplier relationships and advise internal stakeholders on licensing requirements and restrictions. Support business and customer data projects and act as the escalation point for supplier-related operational issues. Strong understanding of commercial contracts and data licensing principles. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including proficiency in Excel formulas, lookups, PivotTables and data validation for reconciliation and reporting. Ability to identify discrepancies and explain findings and corrective actions. Effective stakeholder management and communication skills. Familiarity with data management and experience using entitlement, workflow and reporting platforms. Experience with Power BI, automation or approved AI-enabled tools is desirable but not essential; programming and advanced dashboard development are not required. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Information Management, Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Typically five or more years of relevant experience in market data, licensing, reference data, entitlements, operations, or a related financial services environment. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. Personal Development You will benefit from a culture of continuous learning and feedback. Your personal growth is supported through an extensive learning offering. items.desc: DESCRIPTION The Retail Supply Chain Initiatives (RSI) team is looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer who thrives in a collaborative, creative, and fast-paced environment where ambiguity is the norm and analytical thinking drives impact. In this role, you will develop, enhance, automate, and manage analytical models that power decision-making across EU supply chain operations. **What you'll do:** Design and maintain data pipelines, models, and dashboards that serve multiple stakeholders across the organization Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences Use data to constructively challenge assumptions and inform better decisions Identify opportunities to simplify and automate, building sustainable long-term solutions **What we're looking for:** Solid foundation in data mining, modelling, and quantitative analysis Experience working with large-scale datasets (professional or academic) Clear written and verbal communication skills — able to tell the story behind the data Comfort navigating ambiguity and a willingness to ask questions to define problems A collaborative mindset with curiosity and eagerness to learn from experienced team members Key job responsibilities Key Job Responsibilities: Build and maintain ETL pipelines and data models supporting EU supply chain analytics Develop dashboards and reporting solutions for retail stakeholders, ensuring data accuracy and timely delivery Perform deep-dive analyses on supply chain metrics, surfacing root causes and actionable recommendations Automate recurring reporting and data quality checks to reduce manual effort Partner with senior BIEs and product managers to translate business questions into analytical solutions Document data sources and methodology to enable self-service for business users Help shape the future of our analytics practice — contributing to the team's transition toward AI-powered, conversational data experiences that are replacing traditional dashboards A day in the life Your morning might start with reviewing overnight pipeline outputs and catching data quality issues before they reach downstream users. You then move into analytical work, such as building or refining a data model behind a dashboard used across EU retail. You will meet regularly with product managers and operations leads to plan upcoming analytical needs, with focused time in between for SQL development, root cause analysis, and documentation. You will also take part in design reviews and share findings with business partners to guide their next steps. About the team The Retail Supply Chain Initiatives (RSI) team's vision is to evolve EU Retail inbound into the most cost-efficient and selling partner-friendly integrated supply chain. The BI team within RSI is the analytical backbone of this mission. It delivers insights through dashboards, financial reporting, and data products used by 3,000+ people across the EU stores organization. We value collaboration, curiosity, and practical problem-solving, and we keep looking for better ways for data to serve the business. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared) Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R) Experience with SQL Experience in the data/BI space PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. You also know what belongs in Fuse’s world and what doesn’t, so the ideas you bring could only have come from us. Organisation. Your briefs make other people’s work better. items.desc: Responsibilities The role of a Database Engineer at Jacobs Enforcement, combines database engineering, development, BI reporting and database administration. You'll work closely with the operational and financial teams to build SQL reports, database objects (views, stored procedures, functions and triggers) and MariaDB Event Scheduler automations. These automations find records matching specific criteria and update them, ranging from simple to complex, and run at intervals from every 15 minutes to once a day. You'll also bring data in from a third-party system, clean and validate it, and load it into our own schema, and you'll help design and extend that schema. You'll need to balance delivery speed with the safety of a live production system. Responsibilities Write SQL (MariaDB/MySQL) to support operational and financial reporting. Build and maintain MariaDB Event Scheduler automations that identify and update records. Develop and maintain database objects, including views, stored procedures, functions and triggers. Build and maintain ETL processes that take data from our third-party system, clean and standardise it, and load it into our own schema. Manage file-based imports and exports, including bulk loads and extracts, with validation and error handling. Contribute to database architecture, including amending the existing schema and designing new tables, relationships and indexes as operational needs evolve. Plan and apply schema changes safely, using scripted migrations with rollback plans to minimise risk to live data. Assess and mitigate the impact of queries and changes on production, especially during working hours. Optimise queries to deliver results within finite time windows. Review colleagues' SQL constructively, suggesting improvements rather than rewriting their work. Write clear documentation so both technical and non-technical colleagues can understand your work. Use Git for version control, peer review and approval before deployment. Maintain database replication, monitoring lag and resolving breaks, and ensure automations and schema changes work alongside replicated data. Support the move of our databases to managed cloud hosting, including testing schema, data and automation compatibility. Maintain database health and access, including backups and restore testing, performance monitoring, and managing user permissions and least-privilege access. Essential Experience 3+ years writing SQL in MariaDB or MySQL, supporting a range of operational and financial functions. Proven experience building views, stored procedures and functions. Experience handling data imports and exports. Knowledge and understanding of transactions, locking and concurrency. Experience of relational database design, including normalisation, indexing and making schema changes to live systems. A deep understanding of how SQL affects production systems, and how to mitigate that impact. Proven experience optimising queries for speed and low load. Essential behaviours and skills Looks beyond conventional solutions, identifying non-obvious approaches that deliver order-of-magnitude improvements. Reviews others' code helpfully and accepts feedback on their own work with good grace. Writes meaningful names and clear comments, and values documentation. A strong team player who communicates well with non-technical stakeholders. Works well under pressure. Works independently, with the autonomy and initiative to manage tasks and deadlines effectively. Makes positive contributions and suggestions within the team. A creative, problem-solving and proactive mindset. High attention to detail, checks their own work before asking others to review it. Desirable Background in database-related workflows or finance. Experience with ETL or data integration tools (e.g. SSIS, Airflow, Python-based pipelines). Experience applying AI interfaces to data or operational processes. Experience with Power BI. Working knowledge of Git and peer review workflows. Experience with cloud-hosted databases. items.desc: Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported. Your role at a glance The IT Transformation Specialist (m/f/d), supports the execution of the global IT Transformation agenda across NTT Global Data Centers. Working closely with the Senior Manager, IT Transformation, the role helps translate strategic priorities into structured activities, coordinates inputs and follow-through across stakeholders, and creates transparency on progress, milestones, dependencies, risks and decisions. The role provides hands-on support for cross-functional transformation initiatives, governance activities, executive reporting and priority assignments. A key responsibility is owning the operational maintenance of the Business Transformation Architecture Roadmap, including data collection, validation, consolidation and the preparation of integrated insights for transformation steering and leadership decision-making. The Specialist coordinates and enables execution, while strategic prioritization, leadership alignment and overall accountability for the IT Transformation agenda remain with the Senior Manager, IT Transformation. What we are looking for KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Support the execution and coordination of the global IT Transformation agenda and selected cross-functional initiatives. Translate priorities into structured activities, deliverables, milestones and follow-up actions. Coordinate stakeholders and inputs across business functions, IT domains, regions and delivery teams. Maintain transparency across transformation activities, including progress, dependencies, risks, decisions and expected outcomes. Prepare concise management updates, decision materials, workshops and governance sessions. Support priority and special assignments requiring additional structure, coordination or management attention. Own the operational maintenance and recurring update cycle of the Business Transformation Architecture Roadmap. Coordinate roadmap data collection and challenge submissions for completeness, consistency and quality. Consolidate milestones, dependencies, decisions and ownership into an integrated roadmap view. Identify information gaps, timing conflicts and decision requirements and escalate them appropriately. Maintain agreed transformation and roadmap templates, guidance, definitions and operating procedures. Track agreed decisions and actions through to completion. KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in Information Technology, Business Administration, Transformation or a related field. Master's degree or relevant professional certification is advantageous. Multiple years of relevant experience in IT transformation, transformation consulting, programme or portfolio coordination, business analysis, or a comparable field. Experience coordinating activities across multiple initiatives and stakeholder groups. Experience preparing structured management reporting, presentations and decision-support materials. Experience working in an international or geographically distributed organization is advantageous. Strong analytical, organizational and stakeholder management skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Teams and SharePoint. Knowledge of transformation, portfolio, programme or project governance practices. Consulting experience is preferred. Experience with ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management or comparable portfolio tools is advantageous. Who we are As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

items.desc: As an Applied AI Engineer in Morningstar Sustainalytics, you will build and ship the AI-powered solutions that bring our products to life. These solutions assess the Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) performance of public and private companies globally. The work ranges from LLM and agentic applications, extraction and inference pipelines, and evaluation frameworks to scaling and improving our existing AI systems. It also covers any other area you see fit to expand the capabilities of our products and analysts. You will combine data science rigor with modern AI engineering, so that what we build is accurate, measurable, and reliable in production. Your work helps investors define their strategies with ESG insights. It also pushes companies to improve how they treat the environment, their social spheres (workforce, stakeholders, consumers, nearby communities), and their governance. As more companies move in this direction, we aim to have a far-reaching impact by promoting a healthy ESG mentality through novel AI technologies. Job Responsibilities You will collaborate with talented software engineers, AI research engineers, and ML Ops engineers. Your key focus is to turn AI capabilities into dependable, high-quality products: Design, build, and scale applied AI systems (LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows, NLP pipelines) to improve Morningstar | Sustainalytics products. Apply data science methods end to end: data exploration, feature and prompt design, modelling, experimentation, and evaluation. Build evaluation frameworks and quality gates for AI systems, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, and human review. Measure accuracy, faithfulness, cost, and latency. Develop and deploy human-in-the-loop systems, including simple annotation and feedback tools, to continuously improve model quality. Fine-tune, adapt, and optimise open-source models, including Large Language Models, where they outperform off-the-shelf solutions. Build and maintain scalable ML/AI APIs and services, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines for training, evaluation, and deployment. Collaborate with AI Research and Software Engineering teams to turn PoCs into scalable production versions. Collaborate with analysts and QA teams to ensure our products exceed the expectations of our stakeholders. Monitor deployed models and AI systems for data quality, drift, and performance regressions, and act on what you find. Take initiative and own technical solutions to data quality and workflow challenges. Qualifications 3+ years of relevant experience developing and deploying Machine Learning or AI systems in production. Strong Python skills and the data science stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn), plus experience with a deep learning framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow). Hands-on experience building LLM-based applications (prompt engineering, RAG, tool use, or agent frameworks). Solid data science foundations: statistics, experiment design, feature engineering, and model evaluation across tabular and unstructured text data. Experience developing scalable Machine Learning APIs. Experience developing CI/CD pipelines for training and deploying ML models. Basic experience with microservices architectures. Basic experience developing simple UIs (for data annotation or model feedback). Effective communication skills, including explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. Nice to Have (any of the below) Experience training, fine-tuning, and deploying large deep learning systems (e.g., BERT, T5, GPT-style models, or large CV models), including parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA/QLoRA. Experience monitoring deployed ML models (data quality, data drift, target drift, model quality). Experience with AWS (e.g., SageMaker, AWS Pipelines, Bedrock). Experience with MLOps and experiment-tracking frameworks such as Kubeflow, MLflow, or Weights & Biases. Experience with ML software packages such as PyTorch Lightning, Ignite, or Ray. Experience implementing and scaling Docker container-based solutions. Experience with vector databases and retrieval techniques (embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking). Experience with NLP tasks such as information extraction, NER, and entity disambiguation. Domain interest or experience in ESG, sustainable investing, or financial services. items.desc: In YouGov Shopper , we believe that constant innovation is the key to improve the pertinence and quality of the data that we receive from our consumer panel members and app users. To achieve this goal, we have developed a coding framework that automatically enriches shop receipts and consequently reduces work for our panelists. As a Data Scientist, you'll be part of a cross-functional team of machine learning engineers, developers, and fellow data scientists. Together, you'll help design and build new components of our coding framework, enabling richer insights by enhancing consumer panel purchase data. You'll take the lead on a workstream within the team — owning its technical direction, coordinating the work of others contributing to it, and making sure it delivers against the team's broader goals.\ Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do: Develop, implement, and standardize NLP and ML solutions for tasks such as text classification, clustering, entity recognition, and semantic search, from proof-of-concept to production. Conduct exploratory data analysis and create clear visualizations to communicate patterns and trends to the team and stakeholders. Be an active and influential member of our Agile Team, drive the definition of tasks within your workstream, share findings, raise risks and uncertainty, and challenge priorities during plannings. Present to the team and broader audience during agile ceremonies (sprint reviews, system demos). Screen the market for potential new and innovative Data Science approaches relevant to your workstream, and stay up to date with advancements in machine learning and NLP. Create and improve methods and tools, and contribute to and help define best practices around Data Science. Share Data Science knowledge within the team, mentor less experienced colleagues contributing to your workstream, and support their growth. Work across teams and projects to broaden your understanding of the various areas within YouGov Shopper. These are the essentials for having an interview: Typically 2+ years of professional experience in data science, applied ML, or a related field. Knowledge of statistics, probability, and machine learning techniques, including statistical and predictive modeling. Proficiency in Python and its data science ecosystem (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels), with good working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL. First experience with NLP techniques and libraries (tokenization, embeddings, transformers, Hugging Face Transformers, spaCy, or NLTK) and exposure to deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow). Good understanding of cloud environments and architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure) for data and ML workloads. Ability to translate and clearly communicate sophisticated analytical information to both technical and non-expert audiences. Tools & Technology: Jupyter, Python, and Python best practices and coding standards (PyCharm, R-Studio Server, Zeppelin). Python frameworks such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels. Git, GitLab, CI/CD awareness. Collaboration & documentation: JIRA, Confluence, Teams, Miro. About YOU: Think beyond the obvious, approaching problems with creativity and innovative solutions. Take ownership: proactive in driving your workstream forward, unblocking teammates, and making sure things get delivered. You're eager to learn and share, mentoring colleagues on your workstream and supporting them with debugging, tooling, or best practices. Communicate clearly and confidently in English within a business and technical context.

items.desc: INVT doo Novi Sad traži motivisanog AI inženjera koji želi da gradi agentske sisteme koji zaista rade u produkciji. O nama INVT je AI kompanija iz Novog Sada. Gradimo i skaliramo AI agente koji obavljaju stvaran posao, od ideje do produkcije, za kompanije srednje veličine iz SAD, Velike Britanije i Evrope. Ne pravimo još jedan alat. Pravimo sloj inteligencije oko podataka i procesa klijenta: agente povezane sa sistemima u kojima njihov tim već radi. Verujemo da agent radi onoliko dobro koliko je dobar kontekst koji ima, i da se autonomija zaslužuje. Počinjemo uz punu ljudsku kontrolu, a agentima dajemo više samostalnosti kako raste poverenje. Zato nam je najvažnije ono što stoji oko modela: harness i evaluacije koje pokazuju da sistem zaista radi. Šta ćeš raditi Graditi i unapređivati harness agenata: dizajn alata, upravljanje kontekstom, memorija, guardrailovi, human-in-the-loop odobravanja i sandboxovi za izvršavanje koda Postavljati evaluacije: eval skupove iz stvarnih slučajeva, LLM-as-judge, regresione testove i tracing, tako da svaka promena prompta, modela ili alata ima merljiv rezultat Graditi agentske tokove u LangGraph-u i LangChain-u i servise u FastAPI-ju Raditi retrieval nad PostgreSQL/pgvector, uključujući hibridnu pretragu i citate Raditi direktno sa klijentima i pretvarati njihove procese u pouzdane agentske funkcionalnosti Šta tražimo 2-4 godine profesionalnog iskustva u razvoju softvera, pretežno u Python-u Bar jednog agenta ili LLM funkcionalnost koje su koristili stvarni korisnici Iskustvo sa evaluacijom LLM sistema: znaš kako da izmeriš da li je promena popravila ili pokvarila stvar Svakodnevni rad sa Claude Code-om, Codex-om, Cursor-om ili sličnim alatima Dobro poznavanje API-ja, SQL-a i async koda, kao i testiranja, Git-a, CI/CD-a, Docker-a i principa sigurnog razvoja Engleski dovoljan za rad sa klijentima iz SAD, uz delimično preklapanje sa njihovim radnim vremenom popodne Inicijativu, samostalnost i dobru komunikaciju u timu Prednost imaju kandidati sa Poznavanjem agentskih harness-a i alata kao što su Hermes, OpenCode ili Claude Agent SDK, ili sa sopstvenim harness-om Iskustvom sa LangSmith-om, Langfuse-om ili sličnim alatima za tracing i evaluaciju, kao i sa DSPy-jem Iskustvom sa više LLM provajdera (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight preko vLLM-a) i sa MCP-om Iskustvom sa nekom cloud platformom (GCP, AWS, Azure), frontendom ili DevOps-om Fakultetskim obrazovanjem iz računarstva, elektrotehnike, matematike ili srodnih oblasti Šta nudimo Neto zaradu od 1.600 do 2.000 EUR mesečno Hibridni rad, uz mogućnost rada od kuće Fleksibilno radno vreme Privatno zdravstveno osiguranje Rad na produkcionim sistemima sa stvarnim korisnicima, uz seniore koji su ovakve sisteme isporučili od početka do kraja Jasan okvir za napredovanje kroz inženjerske nivoe Prijava Pošalji CV i nekoliko rečenica o agentu koji si napravio, kako si merio da li radi i šta si naučio usput, na info@invt.tech. Prijave primamo zaključno sa 13.12.2026. Radujemo se tvojoj prijavi!

items.desc: Who We Are Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a leading Data & AI services company helping large organisations turn data and AI into measurable business value. We work with major enterprises across industries including pharma, chemicals, manufacturing, financial services and automotive, solving complex problems across operations, R&D, customer experience and core business processes. Today, Unit8 brings together 170+ engineers, data scientists and consultants across Europe and North America, with a growing presence in the Middle East. We have delivered more than 350 Data & AI projects, spanning GenAI and AI engineering, data platforms, cloud, machine learning and advanced analytics. Our Mission Our mission is to help organisations make Data & AI work in the real world. We combine strong engineering, technical expertise and business understanding to take ideas from problem definition and architecture through implementation, deployment and adoption. Requirements About You As a Data & AI engineer, you build the technical side of client projects, going from a business problem to a solution running in production. You help work out what the client actually needs, design the parts you own and write most of the code yourself. You work in a small project team with a technical lead, and you talk directly with the client's engineers and users. This role is for engineers who want to own real pieces of client work end to end and grow their impact, while staying hands-on. What You'll Do Build the solution: design and write tested, maintainable production code for GenAI applications (agents, RAG, LLM apps) or data platforms and pipelines, and get it running for real users Own your part: take responsibility for a component or workstream, from design to deployment, and deliver it with limited supervision Work with the client: understand their business problem, help turn it into clear requirements, and explain your technical choices and trade-offs to stakeholders Own the quality: be accountable for what you ship, backed by testing, documentation and code reviews with your team Learn and share: grow quickly alongside senior engineers, and share what you learn with the rest of the team. Why You'll Love It Solve problems that matter: work directly with clients on complex challenges where Data & AI materially improves how their business runs Build, not just advise: you ship code that runs for real users, not slide decks Work at the edge of Data & AI: GenAI and agents, AI engineering, modern data platforms Work with people who raise the bar: deeply technical engineers and data scientists who care about solving hard problems and will help you grow Grow with us: take on more ownership, more complex projects and, if you want it, a path towards technical leadership as you prove yourself. Who You Are 2 to 4 years of experience building software, data or AI systems, and you are hands-on: you have written production code in Python in the last 3 months Solid experience in GenAI / AI Engineering or ML / Data Science that you have helped take to production Solid software engineering fundamentals: testing, version control, CI/CD and clean, readable code Good at problem decomposition and software design: you can turn requirements into a well-structured solution and explain the trade-offs You have owned technical work end to end: a feature, a component or a pipeline you were responsible for You learn fast and look for feedback: you want to improve your code and your craft You enjoy working with clients and can explain technical choices clearly. Experience in consulting or another client-facing environment is a plus Experience with Data Platforms & Cloud (Azure, AWS) is a plus. How We Hire Our hiring process includes a live coding interview without AI assistance, a technical design discussion and a client case study. Benefits What we offer Work on client projects that have a concrete impact on their business Exposure to a wide variety of projects, industries, and technologies. Each client is different Ability to contribute to internal open-source projects like Darts (https://github.com/unit8co/darts) or building our own MLOps platform Tailor-made mentorship programme Learning activities such as ML and Engineering Knowledge Sharing Groups. Up to 10% of paid time for self-development Opportunity to join a fast-growing service company with a start-up atmosphere Work with an international team made of more than 15 nationalities. Cross offices/company-wide frequent events (off-site or on-line). Fun Fund to spend with the team on after-work activities. Compensation package including base salary and profit sharing based on the performance of the company Extended parental leave conditions Why Unit8? At Unit8, we don't just turn data into value - we empower the people who make it possible. If you are looking for a place where you can take ownership, your next chapter starts here. Trust from Day One: We rely on your expertise. Trust is the core of our culture …

items.desc: Chi siamo E80 Group è una multinazionale specializzata in soluzioni intralogistiche automatizzate per imprese operanti nei settori food, beverage e tissue. Oltre a LGV e AGV, magazzini automatici ad alta densità ed etichettatrici, fasciatori e pallettizzatori robotizzati, il Gruppo ha sviluppato la piattaforma software SM.I.LE80 (Smart Integrated Logistics ) per garantire l'integrazione tra sistemi e flussi produttivi e la massima tracciabilità dall'ingresso delle materie prime alla spedizione. Con le sue 15 filiali world-wide, il Gruppo si riconosce nei valori Etica, Coraggio, Umiltà, Sicurezza (ECUS). Questi sono i fondamenti della nostra cultura aziendale sempre al servizio delle persone, dei clienti e del territorio. Chi cerchiamo Saranno le nostre paure a limitare il nostro successo, non i nostri errori. Il segreto per assumere talenti di successo sta nel cercare persone che non abbiano paura di fallire, ma vogliano cambiare il mondo – Enrico Grassi, CEO e fondatore di E80 Group Stiamo parlando di te? Ecco cosa E80 Group può offrirti. Stiamo cercando una risorsa R&D Localization & Perception Engineer da inserire nel reparto ART Lab (Advanced Research and Technology Lab), il cuore della ricerca e sviluppo di E80 Group, dove lavoriamo per mantenere — e ridefinire — la nostra competitività sul mercato. Il nostro obiettivo è studiare soluzioni tecnologiche dalle primissime fasi esplorative fino alla realizzazione di prodotti stand-alone o integrati con l'attuale flotta di veicoli autonomi. Parte dei progetti seguono una logica market-driven e customer-driven, spinta dalle esigenze di mercato e clienti, mentre altri scaturiscono da iniziative interne technology-driven, in cui vi è una spinta esplorativa verso tecnologie promettenti. La persona selezionata entrerà nel team di Localization & Perception, che si occupa dello sviluppo di sistemi di localizzazione e percezione per robot mobili basati su sensori LiDAR 2D/3D, algoritmi di sensor fusion e tecniche avanzate di mapping e navigazione. Tematiche come SLAM, scan matching, occupancy grid mapping, obstacle detection, point cloud processing e sensor fusion sono affrontate nel dominio di E80 Group, focalizzandosi sulla robustezza industriale delle soluzioni adottate in ambienti reali e altamente dinamici. Il team lavora in un contesto dove innovazione e pragmatismo si incontrano: forte esposizione alle tecnologie più avanzate, ritmo serrato e un obiettivo chiaro — portare lo stato dell'arte dalla ricerca al campo, dove conta davvero. Responsabilità Alla risorsa saranno affidati progetti di durata variabile, sia di pochi mesi sia pluriennali. I progetti potranno toccare diverse tematiche legate a localizzazione, percezione e navigazione autonoma. Alcuni esempi di attività: Progettare e sviluppare algoritmi di localizzazione e percezione basati su dati LiDAR 2D/3D e point cloud; Sviluppare e manutenere stack software in C++, anche all'interno di architetture ROS2/Docker; Configurare, gestire e ottimizzare build system basati su CMake e ambienti di sviluppo su Linux; Sviluppare tool di supporto, scripting e prototipazione rapida in Python; Partecipare a raccolta dati sul campo e in simulazione per validare e migliorare gli algoritmi; Definire ed eseguire test estensivi per validare robustezza, performance e affidabilità delle soluzioni sviluppate sia in ambiente R&D che in campo; Collaborare con altri team per l'integrazione di sensori complementari (telecamere, IMU, encoder); Valutare nuovo hardware sensoristico o di elaborazione. Requisiti Coinvolgimento e collaborazione con il team saranno alla base della riuscita dei progetti. I progetti verranno affrontati dallo studio di fattibilità fino alla prima installazione presso i clienti. Cerchiamo profili Mid/Senior con almeno 3–5 anni di esperienza rilevante in ambito localizzazione, percezione, navigazione per robotica mobile o similari. Requisiti essenziali: Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria Informatica, Robotica, Automazione o affini; Solida conoscenza di C++ (C++17 o successivo); Esperienza pratica con ROS2; Esperienza con sistemi operativi Linux; Conoscenza di algoritmi di localizzazione e mapping; Esperienza nel processing di dati LiDAR 2D/3D e point cloud; Capacità di lavoro in team e spiccata attitudine al Pair Programming / Team Programming; Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese; Capacità di analisi e problem solving, con attenzione alla qualità; Disponibilità a trasferte internazionali (:10%) per raccolta dati e attività di piloting. Requisiti preferenziali: Esperienza con Visual Studio e sviluppo cross-platform (Linux/Windows); Esperienza nell'uso di Docker per ambienti di sviluppo e deployment; Familiarità con CMake e toolchain di build per progetti C++ complessi; Conoscenza di tecniche di sensor fusion multi-modale (LiDAR + IMU + odometria); Buona conoscenza di Python per scripting, analisi dati e prototipazione; Esperienza su sistemi embedded Linux-based per robotica; Familiarità con strumenti di …

items.desc: Why This Role Matters AI is rapidly changing how users interact with data, but most products still rely on manual workflows, fragmented tools, and steep learning curves. In this role, you’ll redefine how marketers explore, understand, and act on their data by building AI-powered product experiences. The AI domain is at the center of how we bring AI to our customers-owning the full multi agent infrastructure end-to-end. Your work will directly shape how thousands of users move from raw data to insight faster, more naturally, and with greater confidence. Our Ways of Working We organize our work around domains and workstreams with clear areas of ownership. We work in small, iterative cycles-experimenting, learning, and deploying to production multiple times a day with high autonomy and close cross-functional collaboration. What You Will Do Design and implement user-facing AI features, such as natural language querying, AI-assisted workflows, and intelligent insights. Own features end-to-end from early exploration and prototyping through system architecture, implementation, production deployment, and followup. Partner closely with product managers and designers to define interaction patterns for AI-driven user experiences. Evaluate and optimize the reliability, latency, cost, accuracy, and usability of AI features in production. Contribute to shaping Funnel’s approach to AI in the product, including tooling, design patterns, and best practices. Drive technical initiatives from idea to production. Make sure best practices are followed, e.g., testing, relevant code reviews, dry principles. Skills & Experience We’re Looking For 5+ years of experience building product-facing software as a fullstack and/or backend engineer. Product mindset with comfort navigating ambiguous problem spaces, driving technical direction, and collaborating closely with stakeholders. Forward leaning, you are a curious engineer, not afraid to try new things, learn from mistakes and move forward. AI native mindset treats AI as a fundamental part of your workflow, embedded into your ways of working, but you also know when not to use AI. Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications in production, including system performance evaluations and cost monitoring. Strong engineering skills with a track record of crafting high quality code that is maintainable over time and maintaining distributed systems that are fault tolerant. Cloud & Infrastructure operations experience designing and operating scalable cloud infrastructure (AWS), APIs, data pipelines, and observability. Experience working with data-heavy products and/or analytics tools would be an advantage. Familiarity with Amazon Bedrock or similar LLM foundation model platforms would also be beneficial. Why You Should Join Us Build meaningful tech that powers millions of daily jobs for customers around the world. Help shape our next-gen platform as we grow and move toward an AI-first future. Enjoy real ownership with the freedom to design, build, and ship every day. Work with friendly, collaborative teams who care about quality and each other. Grow with us in a company that invests in learning, innovation, and people. Location & Eligibility At This Time, We Can Only Consider Applicants Currently Residing In Stockholm, Sweden, Who Meet At Least One Of The Following Criteria Hold Swedish citizenship Hold EU/EEA citizenship and reside in Stockholm Hold a valid Swedish work permit Office-first At Funnel, we have an office-first approach, and we work from the office a minimum of four days a week. items.desc: Job Details Job Description: Job Description Contribute to Intel XeSS and related AI-based graphics technologies for Client Graphics, including XeSS Super Resolution, XeSS Frame Generation, neural rendering, and next-generation AI rendering capabilities. You will develop game engine instrumentation and capture technologies that enable high-quality AI training and evaluation datasets. This is a hands-on technical role spanning rendering pipeline analysis, game engine integration, graphics instrumentation, data capture, reference generation, and visual quality validation. You will work with research, SW, validation, infrastructure, and ecosystem teams to implement and integrate the graphics technologies and workflows required for AI model development. Key Responsibilities Develop game engine instrumentation and capture technologies for XeSS and related neural graphics capabilities. Design and implement engine integrations, rendering plugins, and graphics tools for capturing frames, rendering buffers, metadata, and temporal inputs. Analyze and modify game engine rendering pipelines to support deterministic capture, reference generation, and synchronized export of model inputs and ground-truth data. Implement capture and instrumentation solutions using C++, modern graphics APIs such as DirectX 12 or Vulkan, and shader languages such as HLSL or GLSL. Work with AI model developers to understand requirements for rendering inputs, reference data, content coverage, and dataset validation. Develop tools and workflows for validating captured data, identifying rendering and synchronization issues, and investigating visual quality problems. Debug interactions across game engines, applications, graphics APIs, GPU drivers, and hardware to resolve capture and integration issues. Contribute to the integration of capture technologies into scalable dataset generation and AI graphics development workflows. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. 6+ years of relevant industry experience developing real-time graphics, game engine, GPU, or graphics tooling technologies, including experience contributing to production-quality software. Strong C++ programming skills and hands-on experience developing or modifying real-time rendering pipelines, game engines, graphics middleware, or GPU-oriented tools. Strong understanding of modern graphics APIs, such as DirectX 12 or Vulkan, and shader programming using HLSL or GLSL. Experience developing game engine integrations, rendering plugins, capture systems, graphics instrumentation, or debugging tools. Strong systems programming and debugging skills, including experience working with unfamiliar codebases and complex interactions across applications, graphics APIs, and GPU drivers. Experience with graphics API interception, runtime instrumentation, or frame capture and analysis technologies. Preferred Qualifications Experience with AI upscaling, frame generation, neural rendering, or adjacent AI-based graphics technologies. Experience with Unreal Engine rendering internals, custom rendering engines, or graphics technology integration in commercial games. Good understanding of temporal rendering techniques, including antialiasing, super resolution, frame generation, motion vectors, jitter, disocclusions, and rendering history. Experience with dataset capture, reference image generation, deterministic playback, or synchronized export of rendering buffers and metadata. Experience using Python for capture automation, data processing, workflow integration, or visual quality validation. Experience with GPU debugging and profiling tools such as RenderDoc, PIX, or Nsight Graphics. Understanding of GPU architecture, performance, memory systems, synchronization, and hardware-aware optimization. items.desc: En ARAG buscamos personas con vocación, ganas de crecer y pasión por ayudar a mejorar la vida de los demás. Somos una compañía internacional con sede en Düsseldorf, formada por más de 4.000 profesionales en 19 países, y líder en España en seguros de Defensa Jurídica y Asistencia en Viaje, con la confianza de más de 20 millones de clientes. Si te motiva trabajar en un entorno que prioriza a las personas, la conciliación, el bienestar y el desarrollo profesional, ARAG es el lugar donde puedes construir tu futuro. Buscamos incorporar un/a Senior Software Engineer con perfil tecnológico transversal, capaz de diseñar, desarrollar e integrar soluciones utilizando diferentes tecnologías, frameworks y plataformas, con especial foco en Inteligencia Artificial y nuevas tecnologías. No buscamos un especialista en una tecnología concreta, sino una persona con sólidos fundamentos de ingeniería de software, experiencia trabajando con diferentes stacks y, sobre todo, capacidad para aprender rápidamente, experimentar y desenvolverse en entornos tecnológicos cambiantes. Participar en iniciativas relacionadas con IA generativa, agentes, LLMs y automatización inteligente . Evaluar nuevas tecnologías, frameworks y servicios y determinar su aplicabilidad en casos reales de negocio. Integrar soluciones mediante APIs, servicios cloud, bases de datos y sistemas corporativos . Trabajar tanto en backend como, cuando sea necesario, en frontend o componentes de integración. Convertir pruebas de concepto en soluciones técnicamente robustas y mantenibles. Colaborar en decisiones de arquitectura y definición de estándares técnicos. Trabajar con equipos internos y proveedores en iniciativas de innovación y transformación digital. Requisitos Imprescindible: Residencia y empadronamiento dentro de un radio máximo de 80 km de Barcelona. Experiencia sólida en desarrollo de software y participación en proyectos con diferentes stacks tecnológicos. Buen dominio de uno o varios lenguajes como Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C# o Java. Experiencia trabajando con APIs REST, servicios web, bases de datos y arquitecturas cloud. Experiencia con frameworks modernos de desarrollo. Conocimientos o experiencia en IA generativa, LLMs, RAG, agentes o frameworks de IA. Experiencia con plataformas cloud, preferentemente Azure. Conocimientos de Git, CI/CD, contenedores y prácticas modernas de desarrollo. Capacidad para enfrentarse a tecnologías desconocidas, entenderlas rápidamente y construir soluciones con ellas. Deseable: Experiencia en Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft 365 Copilot o Microsoft Agent Framework. Experiencia con arquitecturas basadas en microservicios, eventos y APIs. Experiencia realizando PoCs y evolucionándolas posteriormente hacia soluciones productivas. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Contrato indefinido. Convenio Colectivo General de ámbito Estatal para las entidades de Seguros, Reaseguros y Mutuas colaboradoras con la Seguridad Social. Formar parte de una empresa líder en el sector, consolidada y en fase de expansión. Reuniones de seguimiento para ver y analizar la consecución de objetivos. Formación continua en un ambiente de trabajo agradable con fuerte implicación y motivación personal. Modalidad de trabajo: durante el periodo de formación y adaptación será 100% presencial. Superado este periodo, la persona podrá solicitar adherirse al acuerdo híbrido de teletrabajo al 50%. Durante los periodos de verano, Navidad y Semana Santa, se puede adherir al acuerdo de teletrabajo del 100%. Retribución flexible (seguro médico, seguro voluntario de jubilación, ticket guardería, ticket transporte y formación). Por ello, garantizamos la igualdad de oportunidades en todos nuestros procesos de selección y desarrollo profesional, evaluando a las personas exclusivamente en función de sus competencias, experiencia, potencial y adecuación al puesto. items.desc: Riksantikvaren er pådriver for en kulturmiljøforvaltning som i større grad skal utvikle og ta i bruk gode digitale tjenester i forvaltningen av Norges kulturminner. I tråd med nasjonal digital strategi og økende forventninger til innovasjon og digitalisering jobber vi aktivt med å utforske og etablere moderne teknologi, arkitekturer og plattformer for innsikt. Vi søker en erfaren arkitekt som kan inngå i teamet for Innsikt, KI og Dataplattform. Personen skal ha en sentral rolle i utvikling og forvaltning av løsninger for søk, analyse, innsikt og KI-baserte tjenester. Teamet skal etablere og videreutvikle en arkitektur som gjør kulturmiljødata og digitalisert arkivmateriale enklere tilgjengelig for søk, analyse, innsikt og KI-baserte tjenester. Målet er forbedrede interne arbeidsprosesser og nye digitale tjenester for forvaltningen. Arkitekten skal bidra til at løsningene får en robust, skalerbar og fremtidsrettet arkitektur i et moderne skymiljø. Rollen innebærer også å fungere som mentor og faglig sparringspartner for et ungt team, samtidig som personen selv tar et aktivt ansvar i utviklingen av løsningene. Rollen krever svært god teknisk kompetanse og betydelig erfaring med utvikling og arkitektur av datadrevne løsninger. OpenSearch vil være et viktig fundament i dette arbeidet. Vi ønsker å videreutvikle bruken av OpenSearch som søke- og datatilgjengelighetsplattform. OpenSearch benyttes i dag i tjenesten Spor, som gjør tilgjengelig digitalisert arkivmateriale. Rollen vil derfor ligge i skjæringspunktet mellom systemarkitektur, søk, informasjonsforvaltning og praktisk bruk av KI. Arkitekturen skal ses i sammenheng med Riksantikvarens øvrige arbeid med dataplattform i Azure. Denne skal legge til rette for at data fra ulike kilder kan gjøres tilgjengelige, sammenstilles og brukes til innsikt og nye digitale tjenester. Databricks inngår som en viktig del av denne plattformen, mens OpenSearch skal bidra til effektiv søking, utforsking og tilgjengeliggjøring av både strukturert og ustrukturert innhold. Samlet skal dette gi et godt grunnlag for videre utvikling av KI-baserte løsninger og mer sammenhengende tilgang til kulturmiljødata. Vi arbeider etter moderne og pragmatiske prinsipper for utvikling og arkitektur. Det innebærer blant annet bruk av skybaserte tjenester, automatisering, infrastruktur som kode og løsninger som kan utvikles iterativt og tas i bruk fortløpende. Vi ønsker å etablere en arkitektur som er robust nok til å understøtte langsiktig forvaltning, men samtidig fleksibel nok til at teamet raskt kan teste hypoteser, evaluere ny teknologi og realisere løsninger med verdi for forvaltningen. Rollen vil kreve både helhetlig arkitekturfaglig blikk og vilje til å bidra praktisk i teamets arbeid. Det er viktig å kunne se sammenhengen mellom behov, data, teknologi og brukeropplevelse, og å kunne omsette dette til konkrete arkitekturvalg og fungerende løsninger. Samtidig vil personen få en viktig oppgave i å styrke teamets kompetanse, etablere gode arbeidsmåter og bidra til faglig utvikling gjennom veiledning og samarbeid. Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt. Arbeidsoppgaver Ta en sentral arkitektrolle i (videre-)utviklingen og forvaltningen av Riksantikvarens prosjekter for datadreven innsikt, og bidra til en robust, skalerbar og sikker systemarkitektur i Azure. Videreutvikle og forvalte OpenSearch som søke- og datatilgjengelighetsplattform, med ansvar for blant annet indeksering, søkemodeller, relevans, ytelse og skalerbarhet. Utforme og realisere samspill og arkitektur mellom OpenSearch, Databricks og andre relevante tjenester, inkludert robuste integrasjoner og dataflyter for strukturert og ustrukturert innhold. Bidra til at OpenSearch og dataplattformen kan understøtte semantisk søk, KI-baserte tjenester, innholdsforståelse og nye former for tilgang til Riksantikvarens data. Etablere og videreutvikle beste praksis for utvikling, test, automatisering, deployment, overvåking, feilhåndtering og optimalisering i løsningen. Være en aktiv faglig sparringspartner og mentor for teamet, og bidra både strategisk og praktisk til arkitekturvalg, teknisk utvikling, dokumentasjon og kompetansebygging innen OpenSearch, dataplattform og KI. Krav til kvalifikasjoner Relevant høyere utdanning innen IT, teknologi eller tilsvarende. Mastergrad er en fordel, men relevant erfaring og dokumentert sterk teknisk forståelse kan kompensere for formell utdanning. Solid erfaring med system- og løsningsarkitektur i skybaserte miljøer, gjerne Azure, og evne til å utforme robuste, skalerbare og sikre løsninger som balanserer langsiktige behov med iterativ utvikling. Dokumentert erfaring med OpenSearch eller tilsvarende søke- og dataplattformer, inkludert indeksering, søkemodeller, relevans, ytelse, skalerbarhet og forvaltning Erfaring med automatisering og best practice utviklings- og leveranseprosesser, for eksempel infrastruktur som kode med Terraform, CI/CD, versjonskontroll, testing og automatisert deployment. items.desc: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Ready to use AI to make healthcare data sharing faster, safer and smarter? Our Data Access and Sharing Squad is part of the Real World and Clinical Data Strategy function within PD Data Science and Analytics at Roche. Our purpose is to make clinical and healthcare data available to researchers and partners in a compliant manner while protecting the privacy of every patient behind it. When data is shared securely and efficiently, science moves faster and new medicines reach patients sooner. We are now automating and simplifying our ways of working, and we are looking for someone to help us shape what comes next. At Roche, you will have the opportunity to join an established early careers community, with a dedicated Early Careers Forum to share experiences, network and develop a broader understanding of the diverse functions in this pioneering healthcare company. You will work closely with experienced data sharing and privacy experts and turn new ideas into working solutions with real impact.
