items.desc: Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) Remote-first Portugal (Porto & Lisbon offices) · Full-time or B2B · Total package €55,000–€66,000 I'm hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who want to take shaped but still ambiguous problems and turn them into working systems that people actually use. You will work directly with users and client engineers across multiple workstreams, alongside an AI Engagement Lead. You take ownership from workflow discovery through a useful prototype, production or regular operational use, and the iteration loop that keeps it working. This is not a demo, support, or ticket-delivery role. What you will own The working system, the smallest useful version that runs the whole workflow, then harden what earns the right to stay (across application code, APIs, data, automation, and agentic workflows) Technical discovery: sit with users, uncover real constraints, and turn them into a technical plan and fast learning sequence AI quality: evaluations, tests, observability, fallbacks, and human controls. Treat fluent output as unverified output Integration and production: work inside the client’s identity, security, data, and infrastructure constraints with deliberate trade-offs Adoption and handoff: train the team, write the runbook, and make the client progressively less dependent on you Reusable patterns: turn useful field learning into shared skills, evaluation sets, and building blocks You may be a fit if You have shipped production software to real users and can explain your contribution from architecture through operation You are strong in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript (or a comparable stack) and comfortable across APIs, data, authentication, cloud systems, and debugging You have built useful systems with LLMs or agents and understand prompting/context, tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and common failure modes You can move from an unfamiliar business workflow to a working vertical slice without waiting for a perfect specification You use AI deeply in your own engineering work and can show where it accelerated you, where it failed, and how you verified the result You communicate clearly with users, engineers, and leaders, and can say “this will not work as proposed” while bringing a better path Work model & compensation Primarily remote / working from home, with offices in Porto and Lisbon available. Occasional client travel for discovery, building sessions, and rollouts. Full-time employment or B2B contractor arrangements possible. Total package €55,000–€66,000 (salary + benefits), plus profit sharing. Please send your CV if you believe this is a good fit.

items.desc: Arbeitsumfeld In der Funktionsauslegung Karosseriestruktur entwickeln und bewerten wir Fahrzeugstrukturen mit modernen Simulationsmethoden und gestalten damit die passive Sicherheit zukünftiger Fahrzeuggenerationen. Während deines Praktikums arbeitest du an der spannenden Schnittstelle von Crashsimulation, Künstlicher Intelligenz, Optimierung und Automatisierung. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt auf dem zukunftsweisenden Bereich des Surrogate Modelling, bei dem Machine-Learning-Modelle auf Basis von Simulationsergebnissen entwickelt werden, um das Verhalten unterschiedlicher Strukturvarianten schnell vorherzusagen und für die virtuelle Fahrzeugentwicklung nutzbar zu machen. Du erhältst dabei tiefgehende Einblicke in aktuelle Methoden der simulationsbasierten Fahrzeugentwicklung, bringst aktiv deine eigenen Ideen ein und arbeitest unmittelbar an der Entwicklung und Bewertung innovativer datengetriebener Ansätze für die Crashsimulation bei der AUDI AG mit. Aufgaben Du wirkst aktiv an der Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Surrogate-Modelling-Methoden für die virtuelle Crashentwicklung mit Du modellierst und analysierst parametrische Varianten von Fahrzeugstrukturen hinsichtlich Geometrie, Wandstärke und Werkstoff Du bereitest Simulationsdaten sorgfältig auf und nutzt diese für das Training sowie die Validierung Machine-Learning-basierter Surrogate Models Du bewertest die Prognosegüte der Modelle für unterschiedliche Zielgrößen und Lastfälle präzise Du erprobst den Einsatz von Surrogate Models zur schnellen Bewertung und Optimierung von Strukturkonzepten Du optimierst bestehende Python-Skripte für Datenaufbereitung, Automatisierung und Auswertung Du vergleichst verschiedene Modellierungsansätze und identifizierst daraus Verbesserungspotenziale Du dokumentierst deine Arbeitsergebnisse transparent und unterstützt den Wissenstransfer in der Fachabteilung Qualifikation Du studierst Fahrzeugtechnik, Maschinenbau, Computational Engineering, Physik oder einen vergleichbaren technischen Studiengang Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und Englisch Du besitzt fundierte Kenntnisse in Python Du bringst ein großes Interesse an Crashsimulation, Machine Learning und Optimierungsmethoden mit Du hast idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit der Finite-Elemente-Methode, CAE-Simulation oder Machine Learning sowie mit entsprechenden Simulationswerkzeugen Du zeichnest dich durch ein ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen aus und arbeitest strukturiert sowie selbstständig Du bringst Freude am Experimentieren mit neuen Methoden und der eigenständigen Bearbeitung komplexer technischer Fragestellungen mit Den finalen Praktikumszeitraum vereinbarst du im Gespräch mit der Fachabteilung. Wir leben Begeisterung, Vertrauen, Mut und Verantwortung, setzen uns aktiv für Inklusion ein und schaffen dadurch ein Umfeld, das die Individualität jedes Menschen im Unternehmensinteresse fördert. Les analyses de risques sont généralement réalisées à un instant donné alors que l'exposition réelle des systèmes évolue en permanence au gré des vulnérabilités découvertes, des évolutions d'architecture, des projets de transformation et des mesures de remédiation mises en œuvre. L'objectif de ce stage est d'étudier comment l'Intelligence Artificielle peut contribuer à une approche de Continuous Risk Assessment , en exploitant différentes sources d'informations afin d'évaluer dynamiquement l'évolution du niveau de risque et d'assister les équipes GRC dans leurs décisions. Vos Missions Principales Seront Les Suivantes Réaliser un état de l'art des approches de Continuous Risk Management et Continuous Control Monitoring, Identifier les données exploitables pour la mise à jour continue de l'exposition aux risques, Définir un modèle permettant de relier événements cybersécurité, contrôles de sécurité et scénarios de risques, Étudier l'utilisation de l'IA pour : réévaluer automatiquement les scénarios de risques ; identifier les impacts potentiels d'un changement ; proposer des scénarios de menaces ou de risques complémentaires ; suggérer des priorités de traitement. Développer un prototype ou une preuve de concept, Évaluer la pertinence et l'explicabilité des résultats obtenus. Votre profil Vous préparez une formation de niveau BAC+5 à dominante Cybersécurité, Intelligence Artificielle et/ou Data Science et vous recherchez un stage pour une durée de 6 mois ? Vous possédez un intérêt marqué pour la gestion des risques et la gouvernance cybersécurité ? Vous maîtrisez Python, l'analyse de données ou les outils de traitement de l'information ? Vous êtes capable de modéliser des scénarios de risques et d'analyser des données complexes ? Vous connaissez les référentiels de gestion des risques (EBIOS RM, ISO 27005, NIST RMF, FAIR) ? Vous avez des connaissances en IA générative, Machine Learning ou Data Science ? Vous vous intéressez aux Knowledge Graphs, à MITRE ATT&CK ou à la Cyber Risk Quantification ? Esprit analytique, curiosité, créativité et autonomie sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! Le mot de l’équipe Rejoignez …

Vos missions seront les suivantes : La compréhension du modèle actuel de recommandation et l’analyses de ses performances et ses limites. La préparation d’une base de données avec les caractéristiques des clients, la formule recommandée et la formule sélectionnée. La mise en place d’un nouvel algorithme de recommandation basé sur une approche de Machine Learning en respectant des règles techniques. items.desc: Wat ga je doen? Met jouw energie kan het Je bouwt AI-oplossingen die verder gaan dan prototypes. Jij ontwikkelt toepassingen die daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt binnen de organisatie. Je werkt aan actuele AI-vraagstukken zoals LiveAssist en combineert software engineering met de nieuwste ontwikkelingen rondom LLM's. Je kunt daarbij rekenen op uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden, hybride werken en volop ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Zo ga jij deze uitdaging aan Binnen Smart IT & AI Solutions werk je aan AI-toepassingen voor concrete behoeften in de organisatie. Je bouwt met Python, past LLM- en RAG-technieken toe en hebt ervaring met het realiseren van oplossingen in Azure of AWS. Je werkt samen met collega's uit engineering, de business en softwareteams achter bedrijfskritische applicaties, zoals klant- en SAP-omgevingen. Je vertaalt gebruikersbehoeften naar software en zorgt dat AI-oplossingen naadloos aansluiten op bestaande systemen De precieze usecases kunnen veranderen en zich binnen de hele organisatie van Enexis bevinden. Je start met actuele vraagstukken, zoals LiveAssist, en werkt later mogelijk aan andere toepassingen waarin AI-waarde kan toevoegen Dit zijn jouw verantwoordelijkheden: Bouwen en verbeteren van AI-toepassingen met Python in een Azure- of AWS-omgeving. LLM- en RAG-technieken toepassen in oplossingen voor concrete werkprocessen. Services en API’s ontwikkelen en integreren die nodig zijn voor de toepassing. AI-uitkomsten toetsen op kwaliteit en bruikbaarheid, en gebruikersfeedback vertalen naar verbeteringen. Samenwerken met het platformteam en collega’s uit verschillende disciplines, en technische keuzes helder bespreken. Functie-eisen Zo pak jij het aan Je bent een praktische bouwer: je vindt het leuk om technologie om te zetten in iets waar mensen mee kunnen werken. Je onderzoekt wat een gebruiker nodig heeft, probeert ideeën uit en verbetert je oplossing op basis van wat je leert. Je werkt graag samen, staat open voor feedback en deelt je kennis met collega’s. Je hoeft niet alle onderdelen van het AI-platform zelf te beheersen. Wel heb je al ervaring opgedaan met LLM’s en RAG en heb je oplossingen gebouwd in een cloudomgeving. Verder heb je: Hbo-werk- en -denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld in software engineering, informatica, artificial intelligence of een vergelijkbare richting. Ervaring met softwareontwikkeling in Python en met het bouwen van oplossingen in Azure of AWS. Je hebt een goede basis in software engineering en schrijft graag begrijpelijke en onderhoudbare code. Je werkt graag samen met collega’s uit techniek, productteams en de business en krijgt energie van het verbinden van verschillende perspectieven. Ervaring met monitoring, logging of het beheren van toepassingen is mooi meegenomen. Ook ervaring met het evalueren van AI-uitkomsten of het verbeteren van retrievalkwaliteit komt van pas. Team & cultuur Je zet je schouders eronder met Je komt terecht in een jong en compact team van 8 AI- en engineeringcollega’s binnen Smart IT & AI Solutions. Samen met collega’s uit product en de business werk je aan de hele keten: van het signaleren van een vraagstuk en het bedenken van een oplossing tot het bouwen, testen en gebruiken ervan. We volgen de nieuwste ontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI en zoeken graag naar sterke, praktische oplossingen voor complexe vraagstukken. De sfeer is energiek en ondernemend, met ruimte om ideeën uit te proberen, kennis te delen en samen te leren. We vinden het belangrijk dat je je bij ons thuis voelt. We zijn allemaal anders en het mooie daarvan is dat we elkaar vanuit die verschillen aanvullen. We hebben elkaars perspectieven en meningen nodig voor een succesvolle energietransitie! Lees hier mee over ons beleid op diversiteit en inclusie. Wat krijg je van ons? En wij steken natuurlijk ook energie in jou Bij Enexis werk je in de voorhoede van een van de grootste uitdagingen van onze tijd: de energietransitie. Daarbij zorgen we goed voor je. Dat begint met een uitgebreid welkomstpakket en -programma om je collega’s te leren kennen. En met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden: Salaris tussen € 4.223,- en € 6.033,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). Inclusief de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden kan je salaris oplopen tot € 7.764,- bruto per maand. Je ontvangt namelijk 28,7% bovenop je salaris (8% vakantiegeld, een 13e maand van 10,7% en een persoonlijk budget van 10%). Dit kun je laten uitbetalen wanneer je wilt, of je kunt hier extra verlofdagen van kopen. 24,5 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband. Meer oplaadtijd nodig? Met je persoonlijke budget en 13e maand kun je tot wel 35,5 extra verlofdagen per jaar kopen. Mogelijkheden om hybride te werken, inclusief een door ons ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,45 netto per dag. Bijdrage van 70% aan je ABP Keuzepensioen: Enexis betaalt twee derde van de premie, jij draagt een derde bij. Een vitaliteitsbudget van € 700,- bruto per jaar, dat je bijvoorbeeld kunt inzetten voor je …

items.card: You will work on site alongside the retailer’s data scientists and data architects, in an agile team. We are most interested in engineers who combine deep BigQuery experience with a track record of taking ML models into production. BigQuery experience without hands-on modelling work will not be enough. Retail experience helps but is not required. Data & Google Cloud BigQuery: using BigQuery as the foundation for ML
items.desc: Axiologik is looking to bring in 1 to 3 ML / AI Engineers to join them with on a fantastic new piece of work! £700 inside IR35 Hybrid - 3 days a week onsite minimum in Bradford You will work on site alongside the retailer’s data scientists and data architects, in an agile team. We are most interested in engineers who combine deep BigQuery experience with a track record of taking ML models into production. BigQuery experience without hands-on modelling work will not be enough. Retail experience helps but is not required. Data & Google Cloud BigQuery: using BigQuery as the foundation for ML work, including complex SQL over large datasets, building features and training data in the warehouse, and keeping query cost and performance under control. Experience of BigQuery ML (training models in SQL inside BigQuery) is a bonus. Vertex AI: pipelines, training and model registry. Experience of another ML platform (SageMaker, Azure ML, Databricks) transfers where BigQuery experience is strong. Machine Learning Maths & Statistics: linear algebra, calculus, probability, and statistical time series modelling with tools such as Prophet. Modelling & Forecasting: supervised and unsupervised algorithms, tree-based models (such as LightGBM or XGBoost), and neural networks with frameworks such as TensorFlow. Experience of demand forecasting, promotional uplift or price elasticity is desirable. LLM & Generative AI (desirable) AI Agents & Workflows: designing and building multi-step reasoning agents and memory-managed orchestration pipelines. Prompt Engineering & Fine-Tuning: crafting effective prompts, parameter tuning, and adapting base models. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): connecting LLMs to data sources, working with vector databases, and managing document chunking and retrieval accuracy. Software Engineering / ML / DevOps: Models in production: a track record of taking ML models from prototype into live use, working alongside data scientists to turn their work into deployable services. Production grade Python: writing clean, maintainable, resilient, idempotent code with logging, error handling and alerting, unit test coverage and version control, ready for production release and supportability. Containerisation & Infrastructure: working knowledge of Docker and GCP infrastructure as code with Terraform. CI/CD & Monitoring: automating pipelines (Jenkins or similar), logging telemetry, tracking experiments (MLflow or Vertex AI Experiments), and monitoring for model and data drift in production. Resourcing Process All screening calls and virtual interviews will be recorded as part of our processes. If successful in application, you will be asked to confirm pronouns and make us aware of any reasonable adjustments you have, so we can ensure you are set up for success. There will be a screening call with our Talent Partner. This phone call will be recorded and data stored in Google Cloud which may be in US regions. This data is not used for marketing, advertising or training AI models and will be deleted after 30 days. You will interview with both Axiologik and the client. GDPR Statement At Axiologik, we take pride in being 100% GDPR compliant. All your data is handled in strict compliance with EU data protection laws. We store your data for up to 12 months. For additional information on how we handled your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy on our website.

Meta is seeking an experienced software engineer to join the Media Foundation Creator Tools team. Media Foundation builds client and server SDKs for video, audio, and images across all surfaces (web and mobile). We are looking for candidates who share a passion for driving new standards and AI-assisted creation features, develop innovative audio and video creation technology, tackle efficiency and reliability challenges in order to make our creation features available to billions of users.

The Find My team is dedicated to building a seamless, private, and secure experience for users to locate their devices, personal items, and share location with friends and family. We're a group of highly motivated engineers, designers, and product managers who are passionate about creating a simple and reliable experience for hundreds of millions of users worldwide. We thrive in a fast paced environment where team members are often encouraged to wear multiple hats and contribute to various aspects of the product lifecycle. Innovation and creative problem-solving are at the heart of our team, and we constantly explore new approaches to deliver groundbreaking solutions while collaborating with diverse disciplines across the company, including hardware, software, and privacy, to deliver an exceptional user experience.
As an engineer on our team, you'll thrive in a fast-paced, startup-like environment, collaborating closely with a passionate team to achieve a shared mission. items.desc:
Wer wir sind
 Helsing ist ein Unternehmen für KI im Verteidigungsbereich. Unsere Mission ist es, unsere Demokratien zu schützen. Unser Ziel ist technologische Führungsfähigkeit, damit offene Gesellschaften auch in Zukunft souveräne Entscheidungen treffen und ihre ethischen Standards selbst bestimmen können.
 Als Demokratien tragen wir aus unserer Sicht eine besondere Verantwortung für die umsichtige Entwicklung und den verantwortungsvollen Einsatz leistungsfähiger Technologien wie künstlicher Intelligenz. Diese Verantwortung nehmen wir sehr ernst.
 Wir sind ein ambitioniertes und engagiertes Team aus Ingenieur:innen, KI-Spezialist:innen und kundennahen Programmmanager:innen. Für unsere europäischen Teams suchen wir Menschen, die sich mit unserer Mission identifizieren und ihre Fähigkeiten einsetzen möchten, um einige der komplexesten und wirkungsvollsten Herausforderungen unserer Zeit zu lösen.
 Wir leben eine offene und transparente Unternehmenskultur, in der wir eine konstruktive Auseinandersetzung über den Einsatz von Technologie im Verteidigungsbereich, ihren Nutzen und ihre ethischen Implikationen ausdrücklich begrüßen.
 Die Rolle 
 Als Controller/in mit Schwerpunkt öffentliches Preisrecht verantwortest du die Preisermittlung und Kalkulation unserer öffentlichen Aufträge. Du stellst sicher, dass sie der VO PR Nr. 30/53 und den Leitsätzen für die Preisermittlung auf Grund von Selbstkosten (LSP) entsprechen. Preisprüfungen durch die Preisüberwachungsbehörden bereitest du vor und begleitest sie. Du prüfst Angebote, Kalkulationen und Verträge und wirkst bei Preisverhandlungen mit öffentlichen Auftraggebern mit. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Forschung & Entwicklung, Projektmanagement und Finance zusammen und berätst sie zu preisrechtlichen Anforderungen. Außerdem unterstützt du das Controlling von Entwicklungsprojekten und die Aktivierung von Entwicklungskosten nach IAS 38. Die Prozesse und Tools zur Preisermittlung entwickelst du standortübergreifend weiter. 
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Du ermittelst und überwachst die Gemeinkostenzuschlagssätze nach VO PR Nr. 30/53 und erstellst die zentralen Unterlagen für die Periodenkalkulation. 
 Du bereitest Grundsatz-, Plankosten- und Einzelauftragsprüfungen vor und begleitest sie. Das gilt für Marktpreise ebenso wie für die verschiedenen Selbstkostenpreistypen (Selbstkostenfest-, Selbstkostenricht- und Selbstkostenerstattungspreise). 
 Du prüfst und korrigierst Angebote, Kalkulationen und Verträge nach VO PR Nr. 30/53, LSP und unseren internen Kalkulationsrichtlinien. 
 Du unterstützt Preisverhandlungen vor und nach Vertragsabschluss und berätst F&E, Projektleitungen und Management zu Fragen des öffentlichen Preisrechts. 
 Du wirkst bei der Kapazitäts- und Einzelkostenplanung, beim Controlling von Entwicklungsprojekten und bei der Aktivierung von Entwicklungskosten nach IAS 38 mit. 
 Du solltest dich bewerben, wenn du 
 ein Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mitbringst und praktische Controlling-Erfahrung in einem produzierenden Unternehmen oder in der Wirtschaftsprüfung hast, 
 fundierte Kenntnisse im öffentlichen Preisrecht hast, insbesondere in der VO PR Nr. 30/53 und den LSP, 
 bereits Kalkulationen, Angebote und Verträge erstellt und geprüft sowie prüfungssichere Zuschlagssätze ermittelt hast, 
 SAP FI, CO und PS sicher im Controlling und in der Preisermittlung einsetzt, 
 verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift mitbringst und auch gegenüber Prüfern und Kunden klar kommunizierst. 
 Hinweis: Wir arbeiten in einer Branche, in der Frauen und andere unterrepräsentierte Gruppen nach wie vor deutlich unterrepräsentiert sind. Wir möchten dich ausdrücklich ermutigen, dich auch dann zu bewerben, wenn du nicht alle genannten Anforderungen erfüllst. 
 Von Vorteil aber kein muss wäre, wenn du folgendes mitbringst 
 Du warst bereits direkt an einer Grundsatz- oder Einzelauftragsprüfung oder an Preisverhandlungen mit öffentlichen Auftraggebern beteiligt. 
 Du hast Erfahrung im Controlling von F&E-Projekten, in der Aktivierung von Entwicklungskosten oder in der Abwicklung öffentlicher Aufträge. 
 Werde Teil von Helsing und unserer wichtigen Mission
 Unsere Arbeit hat Bedeutung. Bei Helsing leistest du einen direkten Beitrag zum Schutz demokratischer Staaten – in einem Umfeld, in dem ethische und geopolitische Fragen gleichermaßen eine wichtige Rolle spielen.
 Unsere Arbeit ist einzigartig. Wir arbeiten in einem Bereich mit außergewöhnlichen technischen Anforderungen und Rahmenbedingungen, in dem Robustheit, Sicherheit und verantwortungsvolles Handeln entscheidend sind. Dich erwarten besondere Herausforderungen in den Bereichen Engineering und KI, deren Lösungen einen spürbaren Unterschied machen.

You will prepare for and support government audits, review contract calculations and offers, and contribute to price negotiations with public customers. Working with colleagues across R&D, project
items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role 
 As Cost Controller, Public Contracts, you will oversee pricing and cost calculations for public contracts, ensuring they comply with German public procurement pricing law, including VO PR Nr. 30/53 and LSP. You will prepare for and support government audits, review contract calculations and offers, and contribute to price negotiations with public customers. Working with colleagues across R&D, project management and finance, you will provide guidance on pricing requirements, support development project controlling and the capitalisation of development costs under IAS 38, and improve pricing processes and tools across our sites. This is a full-time, permanent role with a hybrid working arrangement.
 The day-to-day 
 Calculate and monitor overhead rates in line with VO PR Nr. 30/53, and prepare core documents for period calculations
 Prepare for and support fundamental, planned-cost and individual contract audits, covering market prices and the different cost-based price types
 Review and correct offers, calculations and contracts against VO PR Nr. 30/53, LSP and internal costing guidelines
 Support pre- and post-contract price negotiations, and advise R&D, project managers and management on public pricing requirements
 Contribute to capacity and direct-cost planning, development project controlling and IAS 38 cost capitalisation, while improving pricing processes and tools across sites
 You should apply if you 
 Have a grounding in business administration, industrial engineering or a related field, and practical controlling experience in manufacturing or audit
 Apply working knowledge of German public pricing law, particularly VO PR Nr. 30/53 and LSP
 Have prepared and reviewed calculations, offers, contracts and audit-ready overhead rates
 Use SAP FI, CO and PS to support controlling and pricing work
 Communicate clearly in fluent German and very good written and spoken English, including with auditors and customers
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Nice to Have 
 Have taken part directly in a fundamental or individual contract audit, or a public-sector price negotiation
 Have supported R&D project controlling, the capitalisation of development costs or public contracts
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward 
 In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts 
 We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about 
 What we offer 
 Competitive salary and VSOP options

 Highly data-driven with an advanced analytical aptitude that can draw critical insights through synthesizing market, competitive, usage, pipeline and other data sources.

It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram , LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

items.card: ABOUT THE ROLE The Inference team builds and runs the systems that serve Mistral's models to the world. We own the path from a trained model to a response on someone's screen. That includes the APIs and gateway that requests come through, routing and scheduling across our GPU fleet, and the capacity, deployment and operations work that keeps it all running. Our work serves two groups. Customers need fast, reliable
items.desc:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Inference team builds and runs the systems that serve Mistral's models to the world.

We own the path from a trained model to a response on someone's screen. That includes the APIs and gateway that requests come through, routing and scheduling across our GPU fleet, and the capacity, deployment and operations work that keeps it all running.

Our work serves two groups. Customers need fast, reliable and cost-efficient inference as usage keeps growing. Our researchers rely on the same systems for evaluation, data generation and reinforcement learning, so what we build feeds directly into the next generation of models.

 




WHAT YOU WILL DO

As an Engineer on Inference, you'll build and run the services that sit between our users and our models. The work is close to the product and to the hardware, and the improvements you make show up quickly in latency, reliability, cost and how fast we can ship new models.

Experience with LLM inference is a plus, but it isn't a requirement. We're just as interested in strong Systems Engineers from other backgrounds who are keen to go deep on serving.



A few of the problems our teams work on:

 - Designing and evolving our inference APIs, so model capabilities like tool calling, structured outputs and new modalities are available to developers on launch day.

 - The backend services and gateway every request passes through, from authentication, streaming and rate limiting to usage metering, observability and end-to-end reliability.

 - Routing, load balancing and autoscaling across our clusters, so we absorb traffic spikes without wasting GPUs.

 - Faster, safer rollouts of new models and serving releases.







WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Have several years of experience shipping and running backend or distributed systems that serve real production traffic.

 - Write high-quality production code, and are comfortable using AI coding tools without compromising on it.

 - Care about performance and reliability, and enjoy making systems faster, cheaper and more robust.

 - Have led the design of significant systems, making the right trade-offs and seeing them through to production.

 - Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code review, design discussions and mentoring.

 - It’s a plus if you’ve shipped production backend services in Python or Go, or operated Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure at scale

 - Experience with LLM serving engines such as vLLM is a strong plus.




WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.




PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.card: About the Job This role involves intense business travel, mostly in the Oxford–London corridor. When not traveling, the work can be performed from the Oxford area. Our Rooftop Autonomous Control Kit (RACK) integrates sensing, compute, communication, and networking into a manufacturer-agnostic solution deployable across a wide
items.desc:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 
Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 
Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.


About the Job 
This role involves intense business travel, mostly in the Oxford–London corridor. When not traveling, the work can be performed from the Oxford area.
At Gravis, we operate at the intersection of hardware, software, and real-world deployment. Our Rooftop Autonomous Control Kit (RACK) integrates sensing, compute, communication, and networking into a manufacturer-agnostic solution deployable across a wide range of construction machines.
As a Field Robotics Engineer, you will play a central role in delivering customer projects and ensuring our systems meet the highest standards of reliability and performance. This hybrid position combines hands-on technical execution with ownership of customer deployment projects from planning through delivery.
You will work closely with R&D and Operations to coordinate end-to-end deployments, continuously improving how we plan, test, and deliver our solutions. You will lead on-site setup and commissioning, engage directly with customers throughout project execution, and help translate complex robotic system behavior into reliable real-world performance. Your ability to understand and troubleshoot integrated robotic systems will be essential to maintaining and advancing the robustness of our field operations.

What you will do:
Lead the technical execution of customer deployment projects from start to finish. 
 Own end-to-end technical planning, coordination, and follow-up in close collaboration with Operations. 
 Serve as a trusted technical point of contact for customers throughout the deployment lifecycle. 
 Provide hands-on technical support and guidance to customers and end users. 
 Perform regular system testing to ensure reliability, robustness, and performance. 
 Generate performance reports and work with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve issues quickly. 
 Contribute to continuous improvement of deployment processes, tooling, and best practices.
What we’re looking for:
University degree (including degrees from universities of applied sciences) in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. 
 Strong experience deploying, integrating, and debugging robotic software systems. 
 Experience with the ROS ecosystem. 
 Solid Linux proficiency. 
 Fluency with Git or other version control systems. 
 Good programming skills in C++ and Python. 
 Willingness to travel to customer sites (including internationally, depending on project needs). 
 Valid Category B driving license.
Beneficial::
Hands-on mechanical or electronics experience (hardware assembly, basic soldering)
 Experience with communication protocols such as CAN
 Previous customer project or technical project management experience
 Practical experience repairing vehicles, machinery, bicycles, or electronics
 Experience operating or working with construction or agricultural machinery
Don't meet every requirement? If you're enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn't match every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect candidate for this or other positions.
 
This is an opportunity to join a dynamic and versatile team, and to be part of a young startup that will revolutionize heavy construction. As a forward-facing startup, we understand that work-life balance and flexibility are important considerations for many professionals: If you are a highly qualified candidate with the requisite skills and experience, we encourage you to apply and discuss your preferred working arrangement during the interview process.
Gravis is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.
 
 
We are an international team that is working to solve problems with a global impact: to facilitate efficient communication and collaboration, proficiency in English is a requirement for all roles.

The Opportunity:
As ANYbotics continues to scale globally, so does the importance of keeping our internal systems, infrastructure and people secure. We are expanding our Information Security & Technology team and looking for a hands-on IT Security & Systems Specialist to help shape how we operate, secure and improve our technology environment. 
 As an early member of our growing security team, you will take ownership of the operational security of our internal systems, covering endpoint security, identity and access management, network security and compliance. Your responsibilities will go beyond maintaining existing systems. You will identify opportunities to automate, modernise and improve our technology landscape, helping us move towards a more secure, scalable and cloud-native environment. 
 You will report to our VP of Strategy & Operations, work closely with our Head of Information Security & Technology and partner with our IT Manager. Based in Barcelona, you will have the autonomy to drive improvements while benefiting from experienced technical guidance within the wider team.
Your Impact:
Endpoint Security & Patching: Own endpoint security configuration, hardening standards, patching policies and compliance across our Linux, macOS and Windows environment, working closely with our IT Manager on implementation. 
 Identity & Access Management: Develop and maintain secure access models across our business systems, including Google Workspace, GitLab, Notion and Wrike, ensuring appropriate permissions and effective access controls. 
 Network Security: Design and improve security across our Zurich and Barcelona office networks, including network segmentation, authentication and zero-trust access. 
 Systems & Automation: Maintain and improve internal services, automate recurring administrative and security tasks, and support our transition towards cloud-native solutions. 
 Information Security & Compliance: Maintain security controls and documentation, support ISO 27001 audits, coordinate security training activities and implement data protection measures. 
 Incident Response: Support the identification, investigation and resolution of endpoint and account security incidents, ensuring appropriate documentation and escalation. 
 Technology Evaluation & Integration: Evaluate new technologies, collaborate with internal stakeholders and ensure new solutions are securely integrated into our existing systems. 
 Local IT Security Presence: Act as a local point of contact for IT and security matters within our growing Barcelona office.
Your Profile:
Endpoint Management: Hands-on experience administering and securing mixed Linux, macOS and Windows environments using remote monitoring and management (RMM) and endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools. 
 Security Operations: Practical experience with patch management, vulnerability remediation and endpoint hardening. 
 Identity & Access Management: Experience with SSO, MFA, directory services and role-based access management across SaaS applications. 
 Networking: Solid understanding of DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Wi-Fi, firewalls and network security principles. 
 Scripting & Automation: Experience using Python, shell scripting or similar tools to automate administrative tasks and improve system reliability. 
 Ownership & Initiative: You are comfortable working independently, identifying opportunities for improvement and taking responsibility for delivering solutions. 
 Documentation & Communication: Ability to produce clear technical documentation and runbooks, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical colleagues. 
 Location & Language: Based in or able to work from Barcelona, with fluent English.
Bonus Points:
Experience with NinjaOne, SentinelOne, UniFi or Google Workspace administration. 
 Experience with infrastructure as code, configuration management or cloud-native services. 
 Familiarity with zero-trust network access, MDM, device certificates or 802.1X authentication. 
 Experience supporting ISO 27001 or SOC 2 compliance and audits. 
 Experience with Linux and/or Windows workstation hardening. 
 Experience securely leveraging AI-assisted coding and automation tools. 
 Experience working in a fast-growing technology, hardware or robotics company. 
 Additional language skills in Spanish or German.
What we offer:
The opportunity to be an early member of a growing Information Security & Technology team and directly shape our security standards and practices. 
 Broad technical ownership across a diverse technology landscape spanning Linux, macOS, Windows, cloud services and modern networking infrastructure.

items.desc:
As a Detector Integration Engineer, you will support the construction and testing of the CMS Phase-2 Outer Tracker, focusing on its mechanical and cooling systems at the Tracker Integration Facility (TIF), where detector components are assembled, integrated and tested. You will contribute to the operation of the detector's evaporative CO₂ cooling system, support testing and commissioning activities, and work alongside experienced specialists on its operation and maintenance.
 Your responsibilities 
 Planning and operation of the TIF CO2 cooling plant according to the different users' needs.
 Coordination of the connections/disconnections of the different users.
 Assistance to the users for the connections/disconnections including leak testing.
 Operation of the automatic/cyclic pressure test setup in TIF for pressure tests of the detector's piping assemblies.
 Supervise capillaries brazing and pressure/leak tests.
 Your profile 
 Experience in manufacture of pipework, including pipe-joining techniques (welding, brazing) would be an advantage.
 Knowledge in maintenance and operation of cooling system would be an advantage.
 Experience in using CAD systems such as CATIA would be an advantage.
 Experience in manufacture of mechanical parts and assemblies would be an advantage.
 Skills 
 Teamwork - communicating well with others working on the same projects.
 Interest in mechanics and manufacturing of mechanical assemblies.
 Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.
 Eligibility criteria: 
 By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Mechanical Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

items.desc:
Within the HSE Unit, we have the QARE Service. Quality and Aging Research for Cable (QARE) service is a quality control service for cables and a research program on cable ageing assessment at CERN accelerators.
 The activity involves the development of the most appropriate cable testing techniques to perform quality control on cables procured for CERN, and establish aging requirements on cables operating in the CERN accelerators environment.
 QARE service needs to perform and develop electrical tests for low-voltage cables, including insulation resistance, dielectric spectroscopy, and voltage-withstand testing. You will contribute to cable qualification, condition assessment, and quality control.
 Your responsibilities: 
 Perform electrical tests on radiation-resistant cables and insulation materials.
 Prepare samples, test setups and measuring equipment.
 Develop and validate test procedures and acceptance criteria for radiation-resistant cables.
 Analyse the effects of ageing, temperature, humidity and radiation.
 Process measurement data and identify abnormal behaviour.
 Ensure calibration, traceability and safe operation of test equipment.
 Write test procedures, technical notes and qualification reports.
 Present results and recommendations to technical teams.
 Your profile: 
 Experience with electrical measurements or laboratory testing.
 Knowledge of resistance, capacitance, impedance, leakage current, and dielectric breakdown.
 Familiarity with insulation testers, high-voltage equipment, LCR meters, or impedance analysers.
 Experience analysing data using Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, or similar tools.
 Ability to write clear procedures and technical reports.
 A careful, analytical and safety-conscious approach.
 Knowledge of cable testing techniques, dielectric materials, measurement uncertainty, and relevant IEC/EN standards would be an advantage.
 Skills: 
 Quality control, cable qualification, and acceptance criteria.
 Laboratory instrumentation and data acquisition.
 Python for data processing, analysis, and visualisation.
 Microsoft Excel for data analysis and reporting.
 Microsoft Word and PowerPoint for technical documentation and presentations.
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria: 
 You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .
 By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Electrical Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .
 You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
 Applicants without a university degree are not eligible.
 Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

items.card: You will feel the support of being part of a strong and stable company committed to employee development, collaboration and long-term career growth. In this role, you will assess complex construction and liability risks and act as a trusted advisor to customers,
items.desc:
About Us: 
 In today’s complex world, tackling risk is fast-paced, unpredictable and rewarding. Challenge yourself to find ways to protect the things people value from all kinds of risks, big and small. If you want to love what you do, work with us.
With about 55,000 employees serving customers in more than 170 countries, Zurich is one of the world's leading insurers. Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) is Zurich's global risk engineering and advisory business, bringing together approximately 1,000 risk professionals around the world who help customers understand, manage and build resilience against a wide range of risks. The success of our business is built on the contributions of our highly talented employees. You will feel the support of being part of a strong and stable company committed to employee development, collaboration and long-term career growth.
 Role Overview: 
 This is an exciting opportunity to join Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) Benelux as a Risk Engineer / Consultant Construction & Liability .
In this role, you will assess complex construction and liability risks and act as a trusted advisor to customers, Underwriting and other key stakeholders. You will help customers identify, evaluate and manage risks across construction projects, operations, products and services, supporting both resilience and informed underwriting decisions. Drawing on your technical expertise and practical experience, you will provide risk consulting services, conduct site surveys and assessments, and deliver pragmatic recommendations that help customers manage risk effectively. As part of Zurich Resilience Solutions, a global network of approximately 1,000 risk professionals, you will collaborate with experts across disciplines including Property, Marine, Energy, Natural Hazards & Climate, Cyber and Business Continuity to deliver holistic risk solutions.
This is a full-time or part-time role with occasional travel in Benelux and internationally.
Key Responsibilities: 
 Deliver construction, product liability and general liability risk consulting services to customers across a range of industries.
 Act as a trusted advisor to customers, Underwriting and other stakeholders on construction and liability risk matters.
 Conduct desk-based reviews and on-site surveys, providing clear risk assessments and practical recommendations.
 Evaluate construction projects, operational activities and liability exposures to support underwriting and risk management decisions.
 Review project execution, quality and safety standards, and identify opportunities for risk improvement.
 Support claims investigations and provide expertise on losses and emerging risks.
 Collaborate with other ZRS risk disciplines to deliver integrated risk solutions.
 Contribute to knowledge sharing, business development and the continuous enhancement of Zurich's risk consulting capabilities.
Qualifications: 
 Degree in Engineering, Construction, or another relevant technical discipline.
 Experience in construction, liability, risk engineering or a related field.
 Strong understanding of construction risks, project execution, quality and safety standards, and risk management principles.
 Experience with complex commercial and/or industrial construction projects is preferred.
 Ability to analyse complex risks and translate findings into practical recommendations.
 Strong communication, relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
 Collaborative mindset with an interest in working across multiple risk disciplines.
 Professional accreditation, international experience and additional language skills are an advantage.
What You Can Expect From Us: 
 Flexible working options include part-time, job-share and full-time opportunities. 
 A varied, challenging and rewarding role with significant autonomy. 
 Collaboration with an experienced and high-performing international team. 
 Exposure to a broad range of industries, construction projects and liability challenges.
 Access to innovative risk engineering tools, technologies and global expertise.
 Opportunities to work alongside specialists from multiple risk disciplines.
 Ongoing professional development and career growth opportunities within a leading global insurer.
How to Apply: 
 Please submit your resume and any supporting information demonstrating your experience and suitability for the role. We look forward to hearing from talented professionals who are passionate about risk consulting and helping customers thrive. 
Join Zurich Benelux and take the next step in your career. We can create a brighter future together!

 Le service d'Exploitation gère et exploite les infrastructures du patrimoine immobilier et les services aux utilisateurs de l'EPFL. Il est composé d'environ 75 collaborateurs actifs dans les techniques CVSE-MCR-Supervisions, Entretien Bâtiments et Intendance.

items.desc:
Mission 
 The Chair of Operations, Economics and Strategy (OES) at the College of Management of Technology at EPFL invites applications for a full-time PhD student position within the EPFL doctoral school program in Management of Technology (EDMT).
 We are offering a challenging full-time PhD student position at the Chair of Operations, Economics and Strategy (OES) at EPFL.
 The mission of OES is to conduct world-class research and teaching at the intersection of operations, economics, and strategy, with a focus on organizations and their interactions.
 At OES, you will have the opportunity to work on the design, analysis, and implementation of innovative models for decision-making, economics, and operations. Research topics may include optimization, decision-making under uncertainty, market design and pricing, operations research, dynamic systems, and strategy-relevant applications.
 Main duties and responsibilities 
 Develop and complete an original doctoral dissertation
 Conduct independent research in close interaction with the Chair and, where appropriate, with external or industry partners
 Contribute to teaching activities, including co-supervision of student projects
 Provide limited support for academic and administrative activities of the Chair
 Profile 
 An excellent Master’s-level degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field
 A strong mathematical background, including familiarity with optimization, probability, and the analysis of mathematical models
 A sincere interest in business-related, economic, and operational problems
 Proficiency in English
 Strong motivation for academic research, critical thinking, independence, good self-management skills, and team spirit
 Interest in a career involving research and teaching is an asset
 We offer 
 Excellent working conditions in an international research environment
 Individual and intensive supervision of your PhD project
 Financial support in accordance with EPFL doctoral student conditions
 The opportunity to work on rigorous, practically relevant research at the interface of operations, economics, and strategy
 Informations 
 Your application should include:
 CV
 Motivation letter
 Diplomas
 Transcripts/grades from Bachelor’s and Master’s studies
 To be eligible for a PhD at EPFL, candidates must be admitted to an EPFL doctoral school program. For this position, candidates should also apply to the EPFL EDMT Doctoral School :
 https://www.epfl.ch/education/phd/edmt-management-of-technology/edmt-how-to-apply/ 
 Application deadlines: January 15, 2027 and April 15, 2027. Applications to OES may be reviewed on a rolling basis; formal admission to EDMT requires a complete application by one of these deadlines.
 Expected start date: September 1st, 2027. An alternative start date may exceptionally be agreed upon by mutual agreement.
 Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

items.desc:
Conectamos el presente. Transformamos el futuro. 
 ¿Alguna vez te has preguntado qué hace posible que millones de personas estén conectadas al mismo tiempo, desde cualquier lugar del mundo, sin que nada falle? 
 En Telefónica, hacemos que sea posible. 
 Somos una compañía global de telecomunicaciones y tecnología que conecta a personas, empresas y comunidades a través de redes de última generación y soluciones digitales avanzadas como cloud, inteligencia artificial, IoT o ciberseguridad. 
 Con una trayectoria de más de 100 años, trabajamos cada día para que la innovación esté al servicio de la sociedad, impulsando una transformación digital responsable, sostenible y con impacto real. 
 Aquí no solo diseñamos infraestructuras, diseñamos el futuro . Buscamos personas que tengan inquietudes, entusiasmo y pasión por lo que hacen, que no se conformen y que quieran crear la Telefónica del mañana. 
 Si te apasiona la tecnología que transforma vidas, este es tu lugar. 
 ¿Cuál será tu misión? 🎯 
 Te integrarás en el núcleo de la Ciberinteligencia, dentro de la Dirección de Ciberdefensa Global de la Dirección de Seguridad Digital. Tu misión no será solo detectar amenazas, sino interpretar el tablero global . 
 Buscarás identificar, analizar y difundir inteligencia que permita anticipar movimientos de actores adversarios, comprendiendo la intersección entre la técnica y el contexto geopolítico para fortalecer la postura defensiva de Telefónica y blindar la toma de decisiones estratégicas. 
 Serás una pieza clave en la evolución de nuestras capacidades de Ciberinteligencia (CTI), actuando como el puente entre la realidad técnica (SOC, CSIRT, Red Team) y la visión de riesgo global, transformando datos complejos en resiliencia organizativa frente a un panorama de amenazas en constante cambio. 
 ¿Qué capacidades buscamos en ti? 🔎 
 Mentalidad de analista: Curiosidad insaciable por entender cómo funciona el mundo, las dinámicas de poder global y cómo estas se traducen en vectores de ataque digitales. 
 Arsenal técnico: Dominio avanzado de herramientas de análisis de datos y plataformas de inteligencia, con capacidad para navegar en la superficie y profundidad de la red. 
 Pensamiento crítico: Conocimiento de técnicas de hacking, forense digital, ingeniería de detección y análisis de código malicioso 
 Comunicación estratégica: Capacidad para sintetizar complejidad técnica en briefings ejecutivos y narrativas claras que permitan tomar decisiones rápidas y precisas. 
 Autonomía y rigor: Capacidad comprobada para gestionar proyectos complejos de forma independiente en entornos de alta presión y plazos ajustados. 
 Ética profesional: Integridad absoluta y discreción en el manejo de información sensible y clasificada. 
 Idiomas: Español nativo/fluido y un nivel de inglés avanzado capaz de redactar informes técnicos y estratégicos con precisión. Se valorarán conocimientos de portugués y alemán. 
 ¿Cómo contribuirás con tus capacidades al propósito del rol? 💼 
 Programa de inteligencia: Ayudaras en el diseño de los procesos de ciberinteligencia, detectando gaps de visibilidad y expandiendo capacidades que mantengan a Telefónica un paso por delante de los adversarios. 
 Análisis de fuentes complejas: Liderarás la recolección y el procesamiento de inteligencia mediante diferentes dominios como OSINT aplicando metodologías de análisis estructurado para convertir el ruido de múltiples fuentes en inteligencia accionable. 
 Respuesta ágil y discreta: Proveerás inteligencia táctica y operativa en tiempo real para neutralizar amenazas emergentes, entendiendo si el ataque es un evento genérico o una operación dirigida con objetivos específicos. 
 Ingeniería de detección: Optimizarás y automatizarás casos de uso, integrando la inteligencia generada directamente en las herramientas de seguridad para transformar el conocimiento en defensa automática. 
 Vigilancia del panorama global: Mantendrás un radar activo sobre TTPs, actores de amenazas (APTs), campañas y vulnerabilidades críticas, evaluando el impacto potencial basándote en la coyuntura global actual. 
 Producción de inteligencia: Generarás productos de inteligencia en los tres niveles (estratégico, operativo y táctico), definiendo el ciclo de vida de los IOCs y asegurando que la información llegue al decisor adecuado en el momento preciso. 
 Soporte en crisis: Actuarás como el referente de inteligencia para el CSIRT y el Red Team durante incidentes críticos, aportando el contexto necesario para priorizar riesgos y acelerar la remediación. 
 Sinergia multifuncional: Coordinarás esfuerzos con SOC, Arquitectura y otros departamentos para alinear la defensa técnica con los objetivos de negocio y la seguridad global. 
 Medición de Impacto: Definirás y reportarás métricas de madurez y desempeño del programa de CTI, trazando roadmaps de mejora continua basados en datos. 
 Mentoría Técnica: Actuarás como referente y mentor para analistas junior, fomentando una cultura de aprendizaje …

items.desc:
Fedezd fel a benned rejlő lehetőségeket a KUKA-val 
 A KUKA számos lehetőséget kínál, melyek által előremozdíthatod karriered, átélheted álmaidat és kibontakozhat a benned rejlő potenciál. A világ egyik vezető automatizálási szakértői vagyunk, globális lehetőségeket kínálunk a robotika, automatizálás, logisztika, szoftvermegoldások és az elektronika területén. Ha motivált vagy, merész ambíciókkal és elképzelésekkel, aki hisz az együttműködésben és a kölcsönös tiszteletben, akkor a KUKA-nál biztos lehetsz a sikerben!
 Feladatok 
 Nyomtatott áramköri lapokon végzett hibaanalízis.
 Új hibaképek felismerése, megoldási javaslatok tétele.
 Nyomtatott áramkörök javítása műszaki dokumentációk szerint.
 Javított termékek ellenőrzése, tesztelése és minőségi megfelelőségeknek való megfelelés.
 A munkafolyamatokhoz kapcsolódó dokumentumok elkészítése és egyéb adminisztratív feladatok ellátása.
 Munkaeszközök, berendezések karbantartása.
 Elvárások 
 Villamos vagy elektrotechnikai szakirányú végzettség
 Gyártóterületen szerzett tapasztalat
 Kiemelt finommotorikai képesség
 Rajzok és munkautasítások olvasásának képessége
 Problémamegoldó képesség
 MES rendszer használata
 Amit mi ígérünk 
 Kultúránk gyökere a robotika és a könnyű, felhasználóbarét automatizálási megoldások iránti szenvedélyünkben rejlik. Az eredmény? Világszerte egyszerűbbé és biztonságosabbá tesszük az emberek életét. Vállalatunk lelke a sokszínűség – nagyra értékelünk minden egyes ragyogó és merész ötletet. Mindenkit arra bíztatunk, hogy munkája során legyen teljesen önmaga, ezáltal egy olyan környezet tud létrejönni, ahol az inspiráció, a szakértelem és a személyes fejlődés kibontakozhat. Közös célunk? A nagyszerűség és az innovatív, pozitív változások beindítása és elérése – nem csak az automatizálási iparágon belül, hanem annak határain túl is.
 Juttatások és támogatások 
 Elkötelezettek vagyunk munkatársaink jóléte iránt, ezért juttatások széles skáláját biztosítjuk, a versenyképes juttatási csomagoktól a rugalmas munkarenden át a szakmai fejlődési lehetőségekig. Mindezzel célunk, hogy munkavállalóink elégedettek legyenek. Hiszünk abban, hogy munkatársaink elkötelezettségét és kemény munkáját elismerés illeti, és juttatásaink tükrözik ezt a hozzáállásunkat. Célunk, hogy olyan munkahelyet hozzunk létre, ahol az alkalmazottak értékesnek érzik magukat, inspiráltak és motiváltak, hogy a legjobbat hozzák ki magukból. Csatlakozz hozzánk, és élvezd az előnyeit egy olyan vállalatnak, amely a csapatának a jóllétét és fejlődését helyezi előtérbe!
 Sokszínűség, méltányosság és elfogadás 
 Alapvető meggyőződésünk, hogy kedvesen, nyitottan és kölcsönös tisztelettel egymás iránt egy olyan környezetet teremthetünk, ahol mindenki önmaga lehet a munkája során. 
 A KUKA az esélyegyenlőség iránt elkötelezett vállalat. Minden jelentkezést aprólékos gondossággal és odafigyeléssel kezelünk – olyan döntéshozatali folyamattal, amelyet nem befolyásol a származás, az iskolai végzettség, az életkor, a nem, a szexuális irányultság, továbbá a vallási vagy a politikai meggyőződés sem. Ha csatlakozol a KUKA-hoz, rengeteg lehetőséged lesz arra, hogy megoszd, mi motivál téged, és mi határozza meg egyéniségedet, ha szeretnéd.
 Csatlakozz az utazáshoz! 
 Ha úgy gondolod, hogy a KUKA által kínált karrier az, amit keresel, szívesen hallanánk felőled.
 Várjuk jelentkezésedet!

items.desc:
Chez STMicroelectronics, nous sommes convaincus que la technologie est un moteur d’innovation et a un impact positif pour les entreprises, les personnes et la société.
 En tant qu’acteur mondial des semiconducteurs, nos technologies de pointe et nos composants électroniques sont invisibles mais au cœur du monde d’aujourd’hui.
 Rejoindre ST, c’est intégrer une entreprise internationale riche de plus de 115 nationalités, présente dans 40 pays, et rassemblant plus de 50 000 talents passionnés et engagés, tous unis par la volonté de créer et d’inventer la technologie de demain.
 Innover demande bien plus que des compétences techniques : cela nécessite des personnes inspirantes, qui savent collaborer avec respect et enthousiasme. Des collaborateurs animés par la passion, prêts à remettre en question le statu quo, à faire avancer l’innovation et à révéler leur plein potentiel.
 Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous et contribuez à construire un futur plus intelligent et plus durable, en alliant responsabilité et innovation. 
 Notre technologie commence avec vous.
 Version française: 
 VOTRE RÔLE 
 Vous intégrerez notre organisation Supply Chain en tant que jeune diplômé dans le cadre d’une mission VIE et contribuerez à la collaboration entre la Supply Chain, la Production et les Groupes Produits. Vous participerez au processus Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) ainsi qu’à la planification à moyen et long terme pour un périmètre de produits défini. Aux côtés de collègues expérimentés, vous apprendrez à tenir à jour un plan coordonné entre les différentes fonctions, à analyser la demande, les capacités et les stocks, et à préparer des scénarios pour éclairer les décisions d’approvisionnement et de capacité. Votre participation concrète à ces activités vous permettra de développer progressivement vos compétences en planification et votre autonomie.
 VOS MISSIONS 
 Participer à l’élaboration et à la mise à jour du plan S&OP sur un horizon de deux ans pour votre périmètre, en contribuant au plan consolidé de l’entreprise
 Contribuer à la mise à jour des modèles de chaîne logistique de bout en bout dans des systèmes de planification tels que SAP IBP, avec l’accompagnement de l’équipe et les contributions des Groupes Produits et de la Production, en intégrant la montée en cadence des nouveaux produits, les transferts de produits, les jalons de qualification et les plans de charge des nouvelles sources de production
 Analyser les données de demande et de capacité avec l’appui de collègues expérimentés afin d’identifier les contraintes, les risques et les opportunités
 Contribuer à l’élaboration et à la comparaison de scénarios S&OP, à l’évaluation de leurs impacts et au suivi des actions d’amélioration convenues
 Participer à l’analyse des stocks et à la préparation de propositions concernant les niveaux cibles, les stocks tampons et le positionnement des stocks, en apprenant à concilier niveaux de service, capacités et objectifs financiers
 Contribuer à la préparation de rapports dédiés au suivi du respect des objectifs et des jalons des projets stratégiques, notamment Ocean, et mettre en évidence les écarts afin de les examiner avec l’équipe
 Contribuer à l’élaboration du plan à long terme sur cinq ans en consolidant les données et les hypothèses pour appuyer la planification stratégique de votre périmètre
 VOS COMPÉTENCES ET EXPÉRIENCES 
 Diplôme récemment obtenu en gestion de la chaîne logistique, en gestion industrielle, en ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe.
 Aucune expérience professionnelle préalable à temps plein n’est requise. Un stage, un projet universitaire ou des enseignements en Supply Chain, en planification, en S&OP ou en planification des capacités constitueraient un atout.
 Bonnes capacités d’analyse, souci du détail et volonté d’apprendre à :
- Interpréter les signaux de demande, les contraintes de capacité et la dynamique des stocks
- Élaborer et comparer des scénarios de simulation et en évaluer les impacts
- Transformer les données en conclusions claires pour éclairer les décisions de planification
 Bonne maîtrise pratique d’Excel pour l’analyse de données et volonté de se familiariser avec les outils et les processus de planification de la chaîne logistique.
 Bonnes aptitudes à la communication et au travail en équipe, curiosité et volonté de poser des questions et de collaborer avec la Supply Chain, la Production, les Opérations et les Groupes Produits.
 Esprit d’initiative, volonté d’apprendre auprès de collègues expérimentés et motivation pour évoluer dans un environnement international et transverse dans le cadre d’une mission VIE.
 Maîtrise courante de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit ; la connaissance d’autres langues européennes est un atout.
 LES ATOUTS SUPPLÉMENTAIRES 
 Connaissance acquise durant les études des concepts de chaîne logistique couverts par la certification APICS CPIM ou des certifications similaires ; aucune certification n’est requise.

items.desc:
Opportunités à temps plein | Paris et IDF 
 En postulant, vous intégrerez notre vivier de talents pour de futures opportunités au sein de la force de vente d’EssilorLuxottica en France, une organisation en forte croissance qui façonne l’avenir de l’optique et de l’innovation. 
 Alors, comment se déroule notre processus de recrutement exploratoire ? 
 1°/ Postulez à l’offre en soumettant votre CV. 
 2°/ Si votre profil correspond, vous serez invité(e) à un entretien exploratoire avec un recruteur afin de mieux comprendre votre parcours et vos aspirations. 
 3°/ Enfin, si cet entretien exploratoire est concluant, vous aurez un entretien avec un(e) Responsable RH. En cas de succès, vous serez ensuite convié(e) à un entretien avec l’équipe Commerciale. 
 Presentation d'EssilorLuxottica 
 Si vous avez déjà porté des lunettes, nous nous sommes déjà rencontrés. 
 Nous sommes un leader mondial dans la conception, la fabrication et la distribution de verres ophtalmiques, de montures et de lunettes de soleil. Nous offrons à nos partenaires de l’industrie dans plus de 150 pays l’accès à une plateforme mondiale de produits de soins de la vue de haute qualité (tels que la marque Essilor, avec Varilux, Crizal, Eyezen, Stellest et Transitions), des marques emblématiques que les consommateurs adorent (telles que Ray-Ban, Oakley, Persol, Oliver Peoples, Vogue Eyewear et Costa), ainsi qu’un réseau qui offre aux consommateurs des soins de la vue de haute qualité et des expériences d’achat de premier ordre (tels que Sunglass Hut, LensCrafters, Salmoiraghi & Viganò et le réseau GrandVision), et des plateformes de e-commerce de premier plan. 
 Rejoignez notre communauté mondiale de plus de 200 000 employés dévoués à travers le monde pour conduire la transformation de l’industrie des lunettes et des soins de la vue. Découvrez-en plus en nous suivant sur LinkedIn ! 
 Votre #FutureInSight avec EssilorLuxottica 
 Êtes-vous prêt à explorer de nouveaux horizons, à favoriser l’inclusivité et la collaboration, l’agilité, à éveiller la passion et à avoir un impact positif sur le monde ? 
 Rejoignez-nous pour redéfinir les limites de ce qui est possible ! 
 Principales missions: 
 · Visiter la clientèle existante sur la zone définie par la société LUXOTTICA France ; 
 · Présenter et vendre les produits commercialisés par la société et qui lui sont désignés comme tel; 
 · Avoir une forte présence sur le terrain pour augmenter la fréquence de visite et la couverture de la zone ; 
 · Développer le chiffre d’affaires de sa zone en respectant les KPI’s ; 
 · Assurer le suivi de sa mission sur le plan administratif et commercial ; 
 · Gagner des parts de linéaires chez nos clients partenaires et assurer une mission de Merchandising et de balisage régulière ; 
 · Accompagner les clients dans la mise en place et le développement de l’EDI via les logiciels Konvergence et Cosium ; 
 · Communiquer de façon régulière en interne (TAM/ATC/BSM) pour partager ses best practices et informations obtenues sur les clients et sur la concurrence ; 
 · Contribuer au développement de l’image de marque de la société par sa rigueur et son efficacité. 
 Profil recherché: 
 · Excellente capacité organisationnelle 
 · Sensibilité Mode & Passion du produit et de la marque 
 · Aptitudes pédagogiques & Force de proposition 
 · Maitrise de la démarche de vente Luxottica 
 · Forte affinité avec la culture sell-out et les outils digitaux 
 · Une très bonne connaissance de la zone d’affectation 
 · Mobilité dans le cadre des fonctions à prévoir pour assurer une couverture qualitative de la zone 
 · Maîtrise des outils informatiques

Job Description
 As a PLC Controls Technician, you will design, program, troubleshoot, and maintain PLC-controlled systems using Siemens S7 and TIA Portal, while supporting manufacturing operations through advanced diagnostics, system improvements, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure equipment reliability and efficiency. This is a direct-hire opportunity.

 401k

2nd shift: Mon-Fri 2pm-10pm
3rd shift: Mon-Fri 10pm-6am
C Shift: Sat-Mon 5am-5pm
D Shift: Sat-Mon 5pm-5am

 Principal Responsibilities: 
 Design, program, and maintain PLC systems in accordance with corporate standards
 Develop and support HMI applications for manufacturing equipment
 Troubleshoot complex equipment and automation issues to determine root causes and implement corrective actions
 Modify PLC programs and interface communications with industrial devices
 Diagnose and resolve issues with vision systems, including Cognex and Keyence
 Troubleshoot and maintain servo drive systems, particularly Rexroth and Siemens platforms

 Proficient in basic programming, manipulating, maintaining and troubleshooting robotics, with emphasis on FANUC robots.
Required Qualifications: 
 Associate degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience)
 3+ years of experience in industrial automation and maintenance
 Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify root causes and implement effective solutions
 Working knowledge of PLC programming languages (IEC 61131-3), including Ladder Logic (LAD), Function Block Diagram (FBD), Structured Control Language (SCL), Statement List (STL), and GRAPH
 Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and blueprints
 Strong mechanical aptitude and experience with electrical servicing and installations
 Effective communication and teamwork skills
 Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and manage multiple priorities
 Experience troubleshooting vision systems (Cognex, Keyence)
 Experience with servo drive systems, including Rexroth and Siemens platforms
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience with Siemens Step 7 and TIA Portal
 PLC and Robotics experience. FANUC and ABB robots is a plus.

 At Ericsson, we are shaping the future of connectivity. Through our NextGen Program, we are looking for curious, ambitious, and innovative engineers who want to begin their careers by working on technologies that connect billions of people worldwide.
 As a Software Developer in our organization, you will be part of a global team developing the software platforms and capabilities that power Ericsson's Purpose-built and Cloud RAN solutions. You will gain hands-on experience with modern software engineering practices, cloud-native technologies, automation, AI-assisted development, and large-scale distributed systems.
 About our organisation 
 Product Engineering Group 3 (PEG 3) is part of Product Engineering Unit RAN Performance (PEU RP), which develops Ericsson's Baseband software for the Purpose-built and Cloud RAN portfolio. We create software solutions that enable high-performance, scalable, secure, and energy-efficient mobile networks used by communication service providers around the world.
 As the industry continues its transformation toward cloud-native architectures, our teams are driving the evolution of Cloud RAN solutions and preparing the foundations for future networks. In addition to advancing today's 5G capabilities, we are actively developing technologies that will contribute to 6G, the next generation of mobile communications.
 By joining us, you will have the opportunity to work on technologies that will shape the future of connectivity for years to come.

 Develop and maintain software for Ericsson's Baseband and Cloud RAN solutions

 Contribute to software architectural improvement
 Work with automation, continuous integration, and continuous delivery practices

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Ericsson's global R&D organization
 Learn and apply modern software engineering methodologies and AI-enabled development tools
 Contribute to innovations supporting the evolution from 5G Advanced toward future 6G networks

 We recruit for potential and believe that curiosity, learning ability, and collaboration are key ingredients for success.
 You may be a recent graduate or have a few years of professional experience and possess:
 MSc or BSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Telecommunications, or another relevant field

 Interest in software development, AI, machine learning, and telecommunications
 Familiarity with AI-assisted software development and coding assistants (Coding Buddy, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools) is an advantage
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 A growth mindset and willingness to continuously learn
 Ability to collaborate effectively in diverse and international teams
