items.desc:
Join our Team
 About this opportunity 
We are looking for an engineer to work with verification, validation, qualification and certification of optical pluggable modules used in our Transport hardware products.
 The role is hands-on and combines optical and electrical measurements, lab work, test automation, result analysis and troubleshooting. You will work with SFP modules and related optical interfaces throughout the product development and maintenance lifecycle.
 Our verification environment is increasingly automated, and you will also contribute to improving how we perform verification. Python and modern AI tools are used to simplify repetitive tasks, improve analysis and documentation, and make our verification environment more efficient and user-friendly.
 What you will do 
• Execute verification, validation, qualification and certification activities for optical pluggable modules and Transport hardware products
• Perform optical and electrical measurements according to product requirements and relevant test specifications
• Set up, operate and maintain optical and electrical test benches
• Perform measurements, collect and analyze test data and identify deviations from expected performance
• Work with automated verification environments, including execution and improvement of existing test solutions
• Support troubleshooting and failure analysis together with HW designers and senior verification engineers
• Document test results and produce structured verification and certification reports
• Contribute to qualification and certification activities to ensure that products and pluggable modules meet defined requirements
• Use Python where appropriate for measurement automation, data handling and analysis
• Explore and use AI tools to improve efficiency in test preparation, result analysis, troubleshooting and documentation
• Improve verification methods and ways of working to make testing efficient, repeatable and easy to use
• Contribute to structured, safe and efficient lab operations
 The skills you bring 
• Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Photonics, Optical Engineering, Physics or a similar technical field
• Knowledge and interest in optical communication and optical transceiver technology
• Experience with optical pluggable modules such as SFP, SFP+, SFP28 or similar
• Hands-on experience with optical and electrical lab equipment, test benches and measurement procedures
• Understanding of optical measurements and parameters relevant to optical transmitters and receivers
• Experience from hardware verification, validation, qualification or certification
• Basic understanding of Transport hardware, high-speed interfaces and electrical principles
• Basic knowledge of Python, or an interest in using scripting and automation to improve verification activities
• Interest in using AI-assisted tools as part of modern engineering and verification workflows
• Ability to work according to defined processes with high attention to quality and detail
• Good analytical and troubleshooting skills
• Good communication and collaboration skills and an ability to work effectively across different engineering disciplines
• Positive attitude, curiosity, willingness to learn and openness to new technology and ways of working
 Who you are 
You enjoy combining hands-on lab work with analytical problem solving. You are curious about optical technology and like understanding how products behave through measurements and testing.
 You are comfortable working in a structured verification environment, but you also look for opportunities to improve how things are done. You see automation, Python and AI as useful engineering tools, rather than the purpose of the job itself.
 You enjoy collaborating with others, troubleshooting complex HW problems and contributing to products that meet demanding requirements for performance, quality and reliability.

items.desc:
Grow with us
 About this opportunity:
We are looking for a Cloud DevOps Engineer to help operate, automate, and continuously improve our AWS cloud environments. You will work hands-on with cloud infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code, access controls, monitoring, and deployment workflows—helping make AWS services secure, reliable, and straightforward for development and analytics teams to use.Working as part of the cloud platform team, you will partner closely with the Cloud Platform Lead and specialist operations, security, data, and engineering teams. The lead owns the platform direction and architectural governance; you will turn agreed standards and designs into reliable implementations, support day-to-day operations, and contribute practical improvements based on what you observe in the environments.
What you will do:
• Provision, configure, and maintain AWS environments in line with team standards.
• Build, update, and support Infrastructure as Code, primarily with Terraform, and help improve reusable modules and automation.
• Handle operational changes and service requests, investigate incidents, and help resolve cloud platform issues in collaboration with support teams.
• Implement and maintain cloud access controls, including Azure AD / Microsoft Entra ID integrations and role-based access patterns.
• Support cloud security, compliance, and configuration controls; identify deviations and help remediate them.
• Configure and maintain monitoring, logging, auditing, and alerts using AWS CloudWatch and AWS CloudTrail.
• Support cloud networking and connectivity, including AWS PrivateLink, following approved designs and security requirements.
• Work with S3 and other AWS cloud storage services.
• Support database deployment and change processes, including SQL and Database Change Management (DCM) practices.
• Collaborate with development, data, analytics, and platform teams to understand their needs and deliver practical cloud solutions.
• Document configurations, operating procedures, and troubleshooting steps so services are consistent and supportable.
• Identify opportunities to improve automation, reliability, security, cost awareness, and the developer experience.
The skills you bring:
• Hands-on experience operating AWS environments and cloud services.
• Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
• Understanding of cloud security, identity, access management, and governance fundamentals.
• Experience with Azure AD / Microsoft Entra ID or another enterprise identity integration, and familiarity with RBAC. Knowledge of PBAC is an advantage.
• Experience with cloud monitoring, logging, and auditing; AWS CloudWatch and CloudTrail are an advantage.
• Understanding of cloud networking and connectivity concepts; experience with AWS PrivateLink is an advantage.
• Experience with S3 or similar cloud storage services.
• Good SQL skills and familiarity with database deployment or Database Change Management practices.
• An automation mindset, attention to operational detail, and a focus on repeatable, well-documented solutions.
• A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with engineering, analytics, security, and operations stakeholders.
Nice to have
• Experience with Prisma Cloud or a similar cloud security platform.
• Familiarity with FinOps principles, cloud cost monitoring, or cost optimization.
• Experience supporting enterprise-scale cloud environments.
• Familiarity with Snowflake or another cloud-based data platform.
• Familiarity with data and analytics platforms or AI/data-intensive workloads.
• Scripting experience, for example Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

 Stellenbeschreibung
 Ihr Arbeitsort ist die Baubibliothek auf dem Campus Hönggerberg eine der weltweit renommiertesten Spezialbibliotheken für die Fachbereiche Architektur, Städtebau, Raumplanung und Bauingenieurwesen.
 Die Bibliothek bietet vielfältige Kurse und Beratungen für Studierende, Dozierende und Forschende an. Wir unterstützen Lehre und Forschung mit einem breiten Angebot an physischen Medien und digitalen Ressourcen, bringen unsere Expertise in gemeinsame Projekte ein und schaffen eine inspirierende Umgebung zum Arbeiten und Lernen.
 Bibliothek mitgestalten: Fachgebiete Architektur, Städtebau und Raumplanung 
 Wie finden Studierende die passende Literatur für ihren Entwurf? Welche Informationen brauchen Forscher:innen für ihr nächstes Projekt? Und wie können digitale Werkzeuge die Recherche erleichtern?
 Du bringst Menschen, Fachwissen und Informationen zusammen. Gemeinsam mit uns gestaltest du unser Literatur- und Informationsangebot für Architektur, Städtebau und Raumplanung, berätst unsere Bibliothekskundschaft und entwickelst neue Services. Deine Ideen geben dabei wichtige Impulse für die tägliche Bibliotheksarbeit als auch für den Einsatz digitaler Technologien.
 Das erwartet dich: 
 Ein vielseitiges Fachgebiet: Du wählst Literatur aus, entwickelst unsere Bestände weiter und erschliesst Inhalte so, dass sie gut gefunden und genutzt werden können
 Austausch mit Stundent:innen und Forscher:innen: Du unterstützt bei Literaturrecherchen und Fragen zu unserem Informationsangebot und im Gespräch erfährst du, was unsere Student:innen brauchen und bringst diese Impulse in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Services ein
 Bibliotheksarbeit im Team: Du wirkst im täglichen Bibliotheksbetrieb mit und gestaltest gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen verständliche, zugängliche und hilfreiche Angebote
 Kontakte innerhalb und ausserhalb der ETH: Du pflegst den Austausch mit Departementen und Fachcommunities und machst unsere Bibliotheksangebote dort bekannt, wo sie Forschung und Lehre unterstützen
 Raum zum Ausprobieren: In Projekten erkundest du, wie digitale Werkzeuge und Künstliche Intelligenz die bibliothekarische Arbeit unterstützen können, etwa bei der Sacherschliessung, Recherche oder Vermittlung von Wissen

 Masterabschluss in Architektur, Städtebau, Raumplanung oder einer verwandten Disziplin
 Eine bibliothekarische oder informationswissenschaftliche Zusatzqualifikation, idealerweise einen MAS in Bibliotheks- und Informationswissenschaft, oder einschlägige Berufserfahrung in einer Bibliothek oder einer vergleichbaren Informationseinrichtung
 Kenntnisse in der Auswahl, Erschliessung und Vermittlung von Literatur und Informationen sowie Interesse an der Weiterentwicklung wissenschaftlicher Bibliotheksangebote
 Freude daran, Menschen zu beraten, Fragen aufzugreifen und gemeinsam passende Lösungen zu finden
 Neugier auf digitale Technologien und die Bereitschaft, neue Werkzeuge auszuprobieren und ihren Nutzen für die Bibliotheksarbeit kritisch zu prüfen

items.desc:
DISCOVER PIRELLI 
 We are a global leader in the tire industry, specialized in designing, developing, manufacturing, and marketing high-performance tires for cars, motorcycles, and bicycles. With a presence in over 160 countries and around 18 production facilities, we pride ourselves on our cutting-edge technology and commitment to sustainability. Innovation is at the heart of everything we do, and it is fueled by our commitment to the inclusion of unique perspectives and different experiences. Because power is nothing without our people! 
 WHY JOIN US 
 We are offering a rewarding role with scope for career progression along with:
 International, engaging, and supportive working environment
 Personal and professional development
 A highly technological and constantly evolving production environment
 Continuous technical training and opportunities for professional growth
 YOUR CORE ACTIVITIES 
 We are looking for a Production Assistant to join our team. This role is responsible for the operational and managerial coordination of production and maintenance activities in a high-automation department, ensuring the continuity and efficiency of production and automation systems, product quality, and compliance with safety regulations.
 Key responsibilities include:
 Coordinate daily production and automation activities, ensuring alignment with production plans and quality standards
 Organize preventive and corrective maintenance in collaboration with the technical team to minimize machine downtime
 Deal with suppliers and engineering department (at Plant and HQ level) in order to implement new procedures on automated systems, analyze problems and facilitate the conduction of machines
 Manage attendance, leave, overtime, and shift planning to ensure operational continuity
 Track and analyze production data and automatic systems, activating escalation procedures for complex technical issues
 Ensure adherence to operational procedures and workplace safety regulations
 Supervise, motivate, and support the growth of production and maintenance staff, including training and upskilling initiatives.Facilitate interdepartmental communication and collaborate with HR to manage disciplinary actions and resolve operational conflicts
 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electronic, Automation, Management)
 1-3 years of experience in industrial production/maintenance with leadership roles
 Deep knowledge of production processes
 Proficiency in management software and reporting tools
 WHAT PUTS YOU IN POLE POSITION 
 Excellent organizational and planning abilities
 Strong leadership, team management, and problem-solving skills
 COMPENSATION PACKAGE 
 The employment contract will be regulated by “Gomma Plastica” National Collective Bargaining Agreement
 The gross annual base salary (RAL) offered will be no less than € 32.000
 The Company is committed to offering a competitive compensation package and, following the selection process, may propose a final gross annual base salary above the stated level, commensurate with the candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications
 The position’s compensation package also includes a variable component and a competitive welfare and benefits offer. Further details will be provided at a later stage and will be subject to the applicable Company policies
 APPLY NOW, DRIVE YOUR FUTURE! 
 #WePirelli 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and this search is open to all individuals, in compliance with the principles of equal opportunity and non-discrimination, pursuant to applicable laws and regulations

 Overview 
 Entrerai a far parte della struttura Digital and Physical Branch & Conversational AI, responsabile dell'evoluzione delle piattaforme e delle soluzioni applicative che supportano la filiale digitale e la rete delle filiali fisiche del Gruppo. Lavorerai in un contesto dove convergono canali digitali, strumenti di collaborazione evoluta e tecnologie di Intelligenza Artificiale, con particolare focus su nuova piattaforma unica di Filiale e su assistenti virtuali conversazionali basati su tecnologie AI a supporto della clientela e dei colleghi del Gruppo. 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Gestire programmi e progetti IT complessi lungo l'intero ciclo di vita, raccogliere i requisiti fino al rilascio in produzione e monitorare i risultati. 
 Coordinare team multidisciplinari composti da stakeholder di business, architetti IT, fornitori esterni e strutture specialistiche del Gruppo. 
 Definire roadmap evolutive, piani progettuali, milestone, budget, rischi e dipendenze progettuali. 
 Garantire l'allineamento tra obiettivi di business, strategia digitale e soluzioni tecnologiche implementate. 
 Contribuire l'evoluzione delle soluzioni dedicate alla filiale digitale e alle filiali fisiche, con particolare attenzione all'esperienza di clienti e colleghi. 
 Monitorare avanzamento, qualità, costi e benefici dei programmi assegnati, producendo reportistica direzionale e supportando i processi decisionali. 
 Chi stiamo cercando 
 Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: 
 Esperienza di 3-5 anni nel ruolo 
 Hai maturato una significativa esperienza nella gestione di progetti e programmi IT di media o elevata complessità. 
 Hai esperienza nel coordinamento di stakeholder con esigenze differenti e nella gestione di contesti organizzativi articolati. 
 Conosci i principali modelli di project e program management, sia tradizionali sia Agile. 
 Hai esperienza nelle tecnologie digitali innovative, in particolare nei domini della collaborazione digitale, dell'automazione e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale. 
 Rappresentano un plus: 
 Esperienza nel settore bancario o dei servizi finanziari. 
 Familiarità con ecosistemi cloud e architetture a microservizi. 
 Aver svolto percorsi di studio e/o lavoro in ambito internazionale 
 Cosa ti offriamo 
 Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da 40.000 € 
 Il Gruppo prevede una componente variabile della remunerazione così come disciplinata dalle Politiche di Remunerazione consultabili sul sito di Gruppo 
 Elementi complementari disciplinati dal Contratto Collettivo Nazionale Credito e accordi aziendali di secondo livello 
 Iniziative di sviluppo professionale a supporto della crescita delle nostre persone 
 Ampia offerta formativa tramite la Corporate Academy dedicata allo sviluppo continuo delle competenze professionali, manageriali e trasversali a tutti i livelli 
 Possibilità di aderire al lavoro flessibile e alla settimana corta 4x9 
 Sistema moderno e integrato di welfare aziendale ( link ) 
 Copertura sanitaria e previdenza complementare a decorrere dall’assunzione 
 Vantaggi sui prodotti e servizi bancari del Gruppo 
 Chi siamo 
 Siamo leader in Italia e uno dei principali gruppi bancari in Europa. Unisciti a noi e fai parte della nostra storia di successo! Con oltre 20 milioni di clienti in Italia e all'estero siamo un vero e proprio motore di crescita sostenibile con un forte impegno per l'ambiente e un impatto tangibile sulla società. 
 Le persone sono al centro, ce ne prendiamo cura impegnandoci nel creare una cultura inclusiva all'interno del Gruppo in cui tutti si sentano protagonisti e valorizzati. 
 L’Area Chief Data, A.I. & Technology Officer è la realtà IT del Gruppo che coniuga l’agilità di una fintech con la solidità di un grande gruppo; avrai l'opportunità di lavorare in un contesto innovativo con tecnologie all’avanguardia e con forte spinta alla trasformazione digitale. 
 Unisciti alla nostra realtà internazionale. Il futuro non si aspetta, si sceglie! 
 #sharingfuture 
 Garantiamo un ambiente inclusivo e di pari opportunità. Considereremo tutte le candidature a prescindere da razza, religione, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, stato civile, età, disabilità o qualsiasi altra categoria protetta nel rispetto dei D.lgs. 198/2006, 215/03 e 216/03. 
 Per la valutazione delle candidature, i dati saranno utilizzati da Intesa Sanpaolo S.p.A. come Data Controller. Ti invitiamo a prendere visione dell’ Informativa Privacy dedicata.

Bankunk az olasz Intesa Sanpaolo Csoport leányvállalata. Univerzális hitelintézetként a hazai pénzpiac egyik meghatározó szereplőjeként több mint 45 éves tapasztalattal rendelkezünk.  Szakmai segítségnyújtásban a fiókba érkező lakossági ügyfelek számára. 
 Pénzügyi tanácsadásban számlák, megtakarítások és fedezetlen hitelek kapcsán. 
 Digitális banki csatornák (mobilalkalmazás és internetbank) ismertetésében és használatuk támogatásában. 
 Az ügyfelek igényeinek megismerésében és az azokhoz illeszkedő termékek ajánlásában . 
 Az értékesítési és az ügyfélkiszolgálási folyamatokhoz kapcsolódó adminisztratív feladatok ellátásában. 
 Szükség esetén a valuta- és forintpénztáros kolléga helyettesítésében . 
 Neked való mindez, ha: 
 Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel. 
 Az elmúlt 5 évben foglalkoztál ügyfélkezeléssel és értékesítéssel . 
 Kifejezetten a bankszektorban szeretnéd építeni a karriered. 
 Igényled a folyamatos tanulást és fejlődést . 
 Szívesen foglalkoznál korszerű pénzügyi termékekkel és digitális megoldásokkal . 
 Kiemelkedő kommunikációs készséggel rendelkezel és könnyedén teremtesz kapcsolatot különböző típusú ügyfelekkel. 
 Saját sikereiden túl, szem előtt tartod a csapatod céljait is. 
 Előnyök: 
 Banki termékek értékesítésében szerzett tapasztalat. 
 Valuta- és forintpénztárosi végzettség. 
 Pénzkezelési tapasztalat. 
 Értékeljük a tehetséged: 
 Éves bruttó 500 000 Ft-os cafeteria keretet biztosítunk, melyet gyakorlatilag minden jól ismert elemre felhasználhatsz. 
 Próbaidő után kamatmentes lakáscélú hitelfelvétel lehetősége is adott lesz. 
 Beilleszkedési bónusszal ismerjük el a kezdeti időszak kihívásaiban tanúsított kitartásodat: fél éves és egy éves munkaviszonyodat egyaránt bruttó 150 000 - 150 000 Ft-tal jutalmazzuk a szabályzatban megadott feltételek teljesítése esetén. 
 Teljesítményed alapján negyedévente bónusz kifizetésben részesülhetsz . 
 Támogatjuk testi és lelki jól-léted: 
 Egészségbiztosítási szolgáltatást nyújtunk. 
 Anyabankunknak köszönhetően, súlyos betegségek esetén térítésmentes második orvosi szakvélemény és kezelés nemzetközi orvos szakemberek által . 
 Pszichológiai tanácsadás a Szakértő Segítség Program keretén belül. 
 Nyári szünetekre táborok támogatása. 
 Banki, partneri kedvezmények vásárlásokra és egyéb szolgáltatásokra . 
 Csatlakozz hozzánk, mert: 
 Egy nemzetközi bankcsoport magyar leányánál biztos munkahelyed lesz . 
 A munkatársaiddal minden problémára megoldást találtok majd, hiszen a támogató közösség nálunk alap. 
 Számunkra fontos a szakmai fejlődésed, ezért széleskörű képzés palettát nyújtunk minden munkavállalónak. 
 Online és személyes programokkal színesítjük a hétköznapokat. 
 Szeretnél többet megtudni arról, hogy milyen nálunk tanácsadóként dolgozni a mindennapokban? Látogass el a Karrier a fiókhálózatban oldalunkra is!

Mi smo tim od gotovo 3000 koleginica i kolega širom Srbije. Slavimo jedinstvenost i negujemo kulturu otvorenog feedback-a, jer samo tako možemo rasti i razvijati se zajedno. Deo smo Intesa Sanpaolo, jedne od vodećih bankarskih grupa u Evropi, na tržištu Srbije smo 20 godina i poslujemo u više od 90 gradova naše zemlje. Verujemo da bez snažnih pojedinaca nema ni snažnih timova, ali i da samo jaki timovi mogu biti pravi oslonac i temelj za svaki individualni uspeh. Zajedno, svakodnevno brinemo o potrebama više od 1,3 miliona klijenata, gradeći čvrste odnose poverenja zasnovanih na ekspertizi i znanju. 
 TI SI ODLIČAN KANDIDAT ZA OVU POZICIJU AKO POSEDUJEŠ:
 Minimum IV stepen stručne spreme
 Dobre komunikacione i organizacione veštine
 Aktivno znanje engleskog jezika
 Interesovanje za rešavanje tehničkih problema i pronalaženje njihovog uzroka
 Želju za razvojem znanja iz oblasti endpoint managementa i modernih Microsoft tehnologija
 Sposobnost za samostalan rad, kao i efikasnu saradnju u timu
 TVOJE PREDNOSTI BI MOGLE DA BUDU:
 Iskustvo u radu sa Microsoft Windows Enterprise i co-managed okruženjima
 Poznavanje Microsoft Intune i Microsoft MECM/SCCM platformi
 Iskustvo u radu sa Microsoft Azure i Microsoft 365 servisima
 Iskustvo u upravljanju Android i iOS uređajima
 Iskustvo u pružanju podrške krajnjim korisnicima u velikim ICT sistemima
 Poznavanje PowerShell-a, automatizacije i rešavanja problema u Windows okruženju
 Iskustvo ili interesovanje za korišćenje AI alata i Microsoft Copilot tehnologija u svakodnevnom radu
 Razumevanje mogućnosti primene AI rešenja u modernom ICT i endpoint management okruženju
 ŠTA OVA ULOGA PODRAZUMEVA:
 Učestvovanje u upravljanju kompletnim životnim ciklusom Windows klijentskih uređaja
 Konfigurisanje, instalaciju i održavanje operativnih sistema, poslovnih aplikacija i periferne opreme
 Upravljanje uređajima korišćenjem Microsoft Intune i MECM/SCCM platformi
 Učešće u implementaciji Windows funkcionalnih i bezbednosnih ažuriranja
 Administraciju i podršku za Android i iOS mobilne uređaje
 Dijagnostikovanje i rešavanje hardverskih i softverskih problema
 Pružanje korisničke podrške udaljeno i na lokaciji korisnika
 Saradnju sa drugim ICT timovima na implementaciji novih tehnologija i unapređenju postojećih servisa
 Korišćenje AI i automation alata za efikasnije rešavanje incidenata, analizu problema, dokumentovanje rešenja i optimizaciju procesa
 Učešće u unapređenju načina rada tima kroz primenu Microsoft Copilot-a, PowerShell automatizacije i drugih savremenih tehnologija
 Zašto baš Banca Intesa? 
 Svojim kolegama smo omogućili fleksibilno radno vreme i rad od kuće, kao i odlične prilike za razvoj kroz eksterne obuke, interne radionice i talent programe. Talentovanim kolegama pružamo priliku za internacionalnu karijeru. Brinemo o balansu, podstičemo zdrave životne navike i gradimo atmosferu dobre timske saradnje i podrške. Učestvujemo na brojnim sportskim aktivnostima i takmičenjima, kao i volonterskim aktivnostima u okviru programa „Intesa od srca“. Deci naših zaposlenih pružamo priliku da steknu dragocena međunarodna iskustva i razviju svoje veštine i talente, kroz učešće u sportskim takmičenjima i letnjim kampovima za decu.
 Ako želiš da napraviš sledeći korak u svojoj karijeri i pridružiš se timu u kojem se tvoje ideje, stručnost i doprinos istinski cene, voleli bismo da te upoznamo. Prijavi se danas i zajedno sa nama oblikuj budućnost.

 Team Description: 
The Identity Kubernetes Platform team builds the software systems, automation services, and platform capabilities that enable Microsoft Identity services to operate securely and reliably on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Our engineers develop fleet management solutions, buildout and recovery orchestration systems, and platform automation that help service teams safely manage infrastructure changes across a rapidly growing global platform. We partner closely with Azure, Microsoft Defender, and Identity engineering teams to solve complex distributed systems challenges, improve platform security and reliability, and create software that enables large-scale service evolution with little to no customer impact. Overview 
 Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world.

Attackers also run International Revenue Share Fraud (IRSF) against any public voice/SMS services. Our team builds both detections and blocking mechanisms against all the above attacks, in particular, focusing on fighting fraud. We develop detections through training machine learning models, using threat intelligence signals as input, aggregated across entire Internet. We build state of the art machine learning platform for both training, deployment and monitoring. Our machine learning models protect billions of Microsoft users in real-time. With this team, you get a chance to learn new technology in AI, security, and distributed system design. We have experts in all these 3 areas to help you grow.  Job Title: Medical Science Liaison Immunology - Respiratory 
 Location: Reading, UK 
 Working Pattern: Field Based 
 About The Job 
 As Medical Science Liaison (Dual role) within our Immunology Medical team, you'll build and nurture trusted, peer-to-peer partnerships with healthcare professionals, institutions and payers in a non-commercial, scientific capacity. You'll use your scientific expertise to understand their needs, share balanced and accurate scientific information, and capture actionable insights that help shape our medical strategy. You'll work independently and remotely, using digital and omnichannel tools to engage your network. You'll also collaborate closely with internal colleagues across medical, commercial, market access, regulatory and R&D, and support clinical trials and real-world evidence generation, all while upholding the highest standards of ethics and compliance. Your work will help improve patient pathways and outcomes. Ready to get started? 
 Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.  
 About Sanofi 
 We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. 
 Main Responsibilities 
 Build and maintain trusted, two-way relationships with healthcare professionals, hospitals and healthcare organisations, taking time to understand what matters most to them. 
 Share clear, accurate and balanced scientific information, and respond to questions in a way that is easy to follow, whether in person or online. 
 Gather insights from the people you meet and turn them into practical ideas and recommendations that help shape our medical plans. 
 Work closely with colleagues across medical, commercial, access, regulatory and research teams, offering scientific guidance and training where it's needed. 
 Support clinical studies and help identify opportunities to learn from real-world patient data. 
 Use video calls and other digital tools to connect with your network, managing your own schedule and working independently from home. 
 Keep up to date with the science in your area, and follow all ethical, safety and compliance requirements, including reporting any safety information you hear about promptly. 
 About You 
 Practical experience in a healthcare, clinical, scientific or life sciences setting, such as clinical practice, research, or working with healthcare professionals. Any relevant experience is welcome, and we value what you can bring from different backgrounds. 
 Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex scientific topics clearly to people from different backgrounds. You're comfortable building relationships, working independently, and using your judgement. 
 A good understanding of clinical research and how studies are designed and reported, with the ability to read and assess scientific papers critically. Comfort using digital tools and video platforms to engage remotely. 
 A degree in a scientific or life sciences subject, or a qualification as a UK-registered healthcare professional. 
 An interest in learning the regulatory and ethical framework for medical communications in the UK, which we'll support you to build on. Experience of the NHS and UK healthcare environment is a plus. 
 Fluent English (written and spoken). 
 Why Choose Us 
 Make a real difference for patients: Work in specialty care, where your scientific expertise helps people living with complex, long-term conditions and supports better care and outcomes. 
 Be at the forefront of science: Join a team working on innovative treatments and a growing pipeline, and keep building your knowledge alongside leading experts in the field. 
 Grow your career your way: Shape your own development plan, with training, mentoring and opportunities to move across teams, roles and countries as your interests evolve. 
 Work flexibly: This is a remote role, so you can manage your own schedule and plan your work in a way that fits your life.

items.desc: ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. THE ROLE You will be joining the Platform Firmware Quality Verification (PFQV) team. You will be a hands‑on Technical Engineer within the platform firmware organization, responsible for end‑to‑end ownership and delivery of critical firmware verification work. This role is designed for an experienced developer who brings technical depth and strong execution, while remaining a strong individual contributor. Working closely with cross‑functional firmware engineering teams and program partners, you will engage in all aspects of verification, with a focus on developing methodologies that drive improvements during the pre‑silicon phase of SoC development. The ideal candidate brings a strong verification engineering background and a passion for quality assurance, with clear ownership for outcomes—including quality, schedule, and technical direction for assigned tasks and deliverables. Effective communication and seamless integration within the team—both internally and with cross‑functional partners—will be essential for success. THE PERSON You are a technically strong, self‑driven engineer who takes ownership when ambiguity arises. You excel at solving complex problems, working effectively across teams, and enabling solid execution. You contribute through high‑quality design, clean and maintainable code, clear communication, and consistent follow‑through. You are comfortable collaborating across functions, balancing deep technical understanding with practical decision‑making, and holding yourself accountable for results. Passionate about software quality, you bring creative, effective problem‑solving skills and thrive both independently and collaboratively in fast‑paced environments. You proactively take initiative and work effectively with cross‑functional teams. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Own the end‑to‑end delivery of firmware verification work for features or projects, from scoping and design through implementation, validation, and release, ensuring correctness, robustness, and long‑term maintainability. Drive implementation and validation tasks, and contribute to design specifications and technical proposals, while collaborating closely with cross‑functional teams including firmware teams, simulation/virtual team, design verification team, and driver teams. Debug and resolve complex, cross‑component issues in pre‑silicon and post‑silicon environments to unblock execution and ensure high‑quality delivery. Partner with program managers, architects, validation, and other firmware teams to identify dependencies, risks, and execution gaps, and proactively track progress to ensure alignment across stakeholders. Surface issues early and drive them to closure, while balancing short‑term delivery needs with long‑term technical health. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Experience in firmware verification with solid pre‑silicon and post‑silicon functional verification understanding, with clear ownership and accountability for assigned deliverables. Extensive full verification lifecycle experience (design, implementation, debugging, validation, sustainment) with excellent analytical/troubleshooting skills, strong debug capability, and effective issue management. Outstanding communication and collaboration (written/verbal/interpersonal) and ability to work closely with cross‑functional teams including firmware, simulation/virtual, design verification, and driver teams. Expert in firmware QA concepts, best practices, and procedures; maintains vigilance for improving validation processes, applications, and methodologies. Develop verification requirements, test plans, and test cases with firmware engineering and verification teams; experienced in creating and reviewing requirements and test plans. Conduct functional, regression, and performance testing to validate firmware functionality and stability. Comfortable with scripting (e.g., Python, Windows PowerShell, Java) and experienced with Jenkins server operation and pipeline scripting. Experience in VM management and simulation/emulation environments; proficient with Jama, GitHub, and Jira.  Description and Requirements
 Descripción y requisitos 
 ¡Si quieres transformar el futuro de la energía, buscamos Profesional Operación para incluir en nuestro equipo de Operations en Spain-Arrecife-Carretera Los Mármoles s/n ! 
 Con quién trabajarás 
 La Central Térmica de Punta Grande es la principal instalación de generación eléctrica de la isla de Lanzarote. Es una instalación estratégica dentro del sistema eléctrico insular canario, que se caracteriza por ser aislado y no interconectado con el sistema peninsular. La central es propiedad y está operada por Unión Eléctrica de Canarias Generación. Tiene una potencia instalada aproximada de 174,5 MW, compuesta por: 11 Grupos diésel (fuel oil y gasóleo), 2 Turbinas de gas (gasóleo) y Equipos Auxiliares. 
 El objeto de la CT de Punta Grande es: 
 1. Garantizar el suministro eléctrico en la isla de Lanzarote (Datos de demanda/ producción cierre año 2025) especialmente relevante en un sistema eléctrico aislado. 
 2. Aporta estabilidad al sistema eléctrico realizando regulaciones de frecuencia, tensión. La composición de sus grupos (Diesel y gas) permite reaccionar con ajustes rápidos ante variaciones de demanda. 
 3. Apoyo a la integración de las energías renovables en el sistema eléctrico insular, cuya penetración es variable e intermitente. La generación térmica producida en la central permite compensar caídas bruscas de la generación renovable, manteniendo la seguridad del sistema y garantizando el suministro eléctrico. Concretamente en el área de Mantenimiento, en la central se realizan una intensa actividad de mantenimiento preventivo, correctivo y revisiones planificadas. Siendo el mantenimiento una actividad necesaria y de especial relevancia en esta central debido a la antigüedad de los grupos instalados. 
 La contribución de la CT de Punta Grande a la compañía se puede detallar desde varias perspectivas: 
 1. La Central Térmica de Punta Grande es la principal instalación de generación eléctrica de la isla de Lanzarote. Tiene una potencia instalada aproximada de 174,5 MW, compuesta por: 11 Grupos diésel (fuel oil y gasóleo), 2 Turbinas de gas (gasóleo) y Equipos Auxiliares . 
 Lo que harás 
 En el puesto de Profesional Operación , apoyarás al equipo en las siguientes actividades : 
 Realizar en planta las maniobras de Operación dentro de la Central de acuerdo con las instrucciones de trabajo recibidas, así como el mantenimiento elemental. 
 Realizar todo tipo de maniobras dentro de la Central, incluyendo operación química, de acuerdo con las instrucciones y rutinas de trabajo 
 Realizar las maniobras necesarias para la realización de descargos y reposiciones, responsabilizándose de la operativa de su propia actividad. 
 Realizar los mantenimientos y limpieza industrial de los motores o máquinas, según las instrucciones recibidas. 
 Realizar las rutas de datos de la instalación. 
 Integrar equipos de intervención en extinción de incendios o emergencias 
 Participar en la aplicación de la prevención de riesgos laborales, gestión de residuos tóxicos y planes de emergencia de la Central. 
 Participar activamente en el cumplimiento de toda la normativa establecida en materia Medioambiental y de Prevención de Riesgos Laborales. 
 Colaborar en la formación práctica de otros trabajadores. 
 Realizar cualquier otro cometido que, dentro del ámbito de sus aptitudes profesionales, especialidades y Puesto de Trabajo y de acuerdo con la normativa de aplicación, le sea indicado por sus superiores por necesidades del servicio 
 ¿Qué se requiere? Los requisitos mínimos para este puesto son:

 Conocimientos:

 Job Overview
 As an SoC Architect specializing in DDR, you will shape memory controller and DDR PHY integration for high-volume system-on-chip (SoC) platforms. Working with Arm teams and partners, you will help develop production-quality silicon for markets including mobile, automotive, datacenter, networking and IoT.
 Responsibilities
 Lead the architecture for SoC memory controller and DDR PHY IP integration, working with internal and third-party IP teams.
 Develop expertise in IP microarchitecture and guide optimizations for performance, efficiency and scalability.
 Work with architecture and core technology teams to shape the memory controller feature and technology roadmap for future SoCs.
 Collaborate with SoC architects, core technology and software teams to optimize platform solutions and support multiple partner engagements.
 Help identify use cases and workloads that showcase Arm IP and platforms.
 Coordinate with engineering teams on timely IP delivery into SoCs and use development insights to inform future IP.
 Lead partner and customer architecture discussions, developing specifications to a stage where design and implementation teams can engage.
 Follow industry trends and technologies to support innovation and continuous improvement in SoC architecture.
 Required Skills and Experience
 Experience architecting scalable SoCs on advanced process nodes across multiple market segments.
 Expertise in multiple relevant areas, such as heterogeneous compute, power management, clocking, interconnects, caching, security, virtualization, memory hierarchies, DRAM technologies, packaging or performance and power modelling.
 Ability to communicate and present to executive audiences and influence engineering and business stakeholders inside and outside Arm.
 A bachelor's or master's degree in electrical or computer engineering, or equivalent practical experience, together with senior development or leadership experience in the semiconductor industry.
 Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience
 Ability to work with changing priorities and requirements.
 Ability to challenge established approaches constructively at senior level.
 Experience delivering multiple complex projects in parallel, on time and to specification.
 In Return
 You will have the opportunity to deepen your IP microarchitecture expertise, influence future memory controller technology and work with Arm teams and partners on SoCs across several markets.
 Additional Information
 Please note that no relocation package is available for this role.

Нашата цел е да бъдем банката за бъдещето на Европа и търсим хора, които имат желание да поемат с нас в тази посока. Ключово за отношенията и процесите, които градим, е те да са най-добър пример в прилагането на принципите за многообразие и равнопоставеност и в утвърждаването на приобщаваща среда за всички.
 Бизнесът ни създава инвестиции, ресурси и нови възможности, които стимулират развитието на нашите служители, като им предоставят уникално и динамично професионално преживяване. Ще се радваме да допълните екипа ни с вашите таланти и силни страни и да изградите кариера, в която ще бъдете възнаградени подобаващо за постиженията ви.
 Ние ще ти дадем възможност да
 ● Предлагаш пълната гама от банкови продукти и услуги за физически лица;
 ● Участваш активно в кампании за продажба на продукти и услуги и използваш най-успешните търговски техники;
 ● Извършваш касови и безкасови операции при стриктно спазване на действащите вътрешно-банкови нормативни актове;

 В теб търсим

 ● Познания по английски език (ще се считат като предимство);
 ● Компютърна грамотност;
 ● Икономическо образование (ще се счита за предимство);
 ● Сходен опит в банковата сфера или опит на търговска позиция (ще се счита за предимство).

Ключово за отношенията и процесите, които градим, е те да са най-добър пример в прилагането на принципите за многообразие и равнопоставеност и в утвърждаването на приобщаваща среда за всички.

 Postanite del inovativnega delovnega okolja in vključujoče družbe, ki pozdravlja ter krepi raznolikost misli, pogledov in idej ter zaposlenim omogoča, da v celoti sprostijo svoj potencial in talent.
 Kaj boste počeli
 Na področju poslovanja z malimi in srednjimi podjetji za zahodno in vzhodno regijo iščemo novega sodelavca ali sodelavko za področja: 
 pridobivanje novih strank in skrb za obstoječi segment strank,
 finančno in investicijsko svetovanje strank,
 učinkovita navzkrižna prodaja,
 skrb za konstantno izboljšavo storitev ter optimizacijo procesov,
 izdelava predlogov, prodajnih poročil in analiz. 
 Kaj boste potrebovali za uspeh
 K prijavi vabimo kandidate, ki: 
 imate najmanj VI. stopnjo izobrazbe ekonomske ali druge ustrezne smeri, 
 se lahko pohvalite z vsaj 2. letoma ustreznih ali primerljivih delovnih izkušenj, 
 poznate bančno poslovanje in finančne produkte,
 se zanimate za gospodarske razmere in imate izkušnje s področja finančnih analiz podjetij oz. s področja poznavanja finančnih izkazov podjetij,
 imate odlične komunikacijske verbalne in pisne veščine, se radi pogajate in vas iskreno veseli delo v prodaji,
 ste samostojni, proaktivni in radi dosegate zastavljene cilje, a hkrati dobro delujete v timu,
 aktivno uporabljate slovenski in angleški jezik ter imate vozniško dovoljenje B kategorije.
 Kaj boste dobili v zameno
 Če ste se našli v naštetih opisih in si želite veliko izzivov pri svojem delu, vas vabimo, da se nam pridružite. V naši mednarodni Skupini boste našli veliko priložnosti za strokovno in osebnostno rast. Delovno mesto se nahaja v Novem mestu. 
 Prijave z življenjepisom in s spremnim pismom sprejemamo do 06. decembra 2026. 
 Pridružite se Banki za prihodnost Evrope.

 Co budete dělat
 Máte už nějakou zkušenost ze světa financí a chcete se dále posouvat? Staňte se tváří naší banky na naši nově zrekonstruované pobočce v Karlíně. Hledáme PRIME bankéře/ku pro exkluzivní péči o naše klienty.
 Zní to, jako by tato pozice byla ideální pro Vás? Tak čtěte dál! 
 PRIME by UniCredit je prémiové bankovnictví nové generace pro bonitní klienty. Kombinuje špičkové digitální služby s osobním přístupem dedikovaného bankéře. 
 Co Vás čeká? 
 Péče o svěřené portfolio klientů a jeho aktivní rozšiřování 
 Budování a rozvíjení dlouhodobých vztahů s klienty a obchodními partnery 
 Poskytování kvalitního a profesionálního poradenství 
 Navrhování individuálního řešení pro naše klienty 
 Pomoc klientům při financování jejich plánů a hledání optimálních úvěrových řešení.
 Plnění stanoveného obchodního plánu a aktivní podílení se na úspěchu pobočky 
 Co budete potřebovat k úspěchu
 Co k tomu potřebujete? 
 Maturitu – středoškolské vzdělání ukončené maturitní zkouškou je základ. 
 Komunikaci a proaktivitu – mimo péči o stávající klienty vás čeká i akvizice nových klientů. 
 Znalost češtiny – komunikace s klienty vyžaduje perfektní jazyk, další jazyk je výhodou, ale ne nutností. 
 Touhu na sobě dále pracovat a dosahovat výsledků – to je klíčem k úspěchu. 
 Zkušenosti z oblasti financí – hledáme někoho, kdo už se stihl v této oblasti rozkoukat. 
 Osvojené prodejní dovednosti – umět identifikovat potřeby klientů, najít vhodné řešení a dotáhnout obchodní příležitosti do úspěšného konce. 
 Splněné certifikace od ČBA výhodou – naše práce je podmíněná splněním certifikační zkoušek. Pokud některou z nich nemáte nevadí, projdete si jimi v průběhu adaptačního procesu. Hradíme je my. 
 Co za to dostanete
 Co Vám nabídneme:
 ✔️ Odměňování podle výsledků – vaše práce má přímý vliv na vaše finanční ohodnocení. ✔️ Prostor pro vlastní iniciativ u – s rostoucími zkušenostmi získáte větší zodpovědnost a samostatnost. ✔️ Kariérní růst

 In Deinem 12-monatigen rotationsbasierten Traineeprogramm lernst Du das Unternehmen ganzheitlich kennen. Du arbeitest in einem zukunftsorientierten und internationalen Umfeld, in dem Du lernen, Dich entfalten und gleichzeitig mit Deinen Ideen etwas bewirken kannst - getreu unserem gemeinsamen Ziel "Empowering Communities to Progress".
 Im Bereich Real Estate innerhalb der Division Digital & Operations (CDOO) gestalten wir die Arbeitswelt von morgen. Wir verantworten die Entwicklung, Modernisierung und den Betrieb unserer Verwaltungs- und Bankimmobilien und schaffen die Grundlage für modernes, nachhaltiges und effizientes Arbeiten. Dabei steuern wir anspruchsvolle Bau- und Infrastrukturprojekte, entwickeln innovative Arbeitsplatzkonzepte und stellen den langfristig wirtschaftlichen Betrieb unserer Immobilien sicher.
 Das erwartet Dich bei uns
 Im Rahmen unseres Traineeprogramms lernst Du das Bauprojektmanagement und den Immobilienbetrieb einer internationalen Bank aus unterschiedlichen Perspektiven kennen. Du arbeitest an spannenden Bau-, Modernisierungs- und Transformationsprojekten mit und erhältst tiefe Einblicke in die Steuerung komplexer Immobilienvorhaben.
 Dabei erwarten Dich unter anderem folgende Aufgaben:
 Du unterstützt bei der Planung, Steuerung und Umsetzung von Bau-, Umbau- und Instandsetzungsprojekten in unseren Gebäuden.
 Du wirkst bei der Projektleitung hinsichtlich Terminen, Kosten, Qualitäten und Risiken mit.
 Du begleitest alle Projektphasen von der Bedarfsanalyse über die Planung und Ausschreibung bis hin zur Umsetzung und Übergabe.
 Du arbeitest bei der Koordination und Steuerung externer Dienstleister und Fachfirmen mit. 
 Du wirkst an Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung moderner Arbeitsplatz- und Nutzungskonzepte mit.
 Du unterstützt bei der Sicherstellung eines wirtschaftlichen und nachhaltigen Immobilienbetriebs nach Abschluss der Projekte.
 Du analysierst Betriebs- und Projektdaten und leitest Optimierungspotenziale für unsere Gebäude und Prozesse ab.
 Du arbeitest mit digitalen Lösungen und Systemen für Projekt- und Immobilienmanagement.
 Das bringst Du mit
 Du passt perfekt zu uns und unserer Kultur, wenn Du Dich mit den Werten Integrity, Ownership und Caring identifizierst und zugleich über ein agiles Mindset, Neugierde und proaktives unternehmerisches Denken verfügst.

items.desc:
Als UX Designer bij Framna maak je complexe vraagstukken helder: in flows, in ontwerpen en aan tafel met partners. Je werkt vanuit onze studio in Amsterdam of Zwolle, samen met een groot designteam, aan digitale producten die dagelijks gebruikt worden.
 Word onderdeel van ons team 
 Je komt in het designteam van Framna, met collega's in onze studio's in Amsterdam en Zwolle. Vanuit een van beide studio's werk je met designers, developers en partners aan digitale producten zoals apps, websites, webapps en portals.
 Ons designteam staat bekend om een scherpe strategische blik, uitvoeringskracht, creativiteit en open samenwerking waarin ze complexe vraagstukken vertalen naar digitale ervaringen die écht het verschil maken. Ideeën worden hier snel werkelijkheid zonder in te leveren op kwaliteit en je kunt vanaf dag één impact maken.
 Wat je gaat doen 
 Je pakt complexe vraagstukken van partners zelfstandig op. Je maakt ze concreet in requirements, flows en ontwerpen, en toetst je oplossing bij gebruikers en stakeholders. Je presenteert je werk, doet pitches en adviseert partners over de keuzes die het product beter maken.
 Jouw belangrijkste taken zijn:
 Abstracte vraagstukken samen met partners doorgronden en omzetten in heldere requirements
 Informatiearchitectuur, user flows, wireframes, interaction design en UI-design uitwerken
 Prototypes maken en ontwerpen valideren bij gebruikers
 Bijdragen aan het design system en toegankelijke ontwerpen opleveren, in nauwe samenwerking met developers
 Ontwerpkeuzes presenteren, pitchen en partners adviseren
 Stakeholders actief betrekken, verwachtingen managen en verschillende belangen samenbrengen in het ontwerpproces
 Junioren begeleiden en je ervaring delen in het designteam
 AI in je werk 
 AI is bij Framna onderdeel van hoe we digitale producten ontwikkelen, waarbij de menselijke afweging altijd leidend blijft. Als designer zet je het in bij research, het schrijven van requirements, het genereren en opschonen van designs in Figma en prototyping. Wat AI oplevert, beoordeel je zelf kritisch.
 Omdat AI zich razendsnel ontwikkelt, blijft ook ons ontwerpproces continu in beweging. Je volgt deze ontwikkelingen actief, experimenteert met nieuwe mogelijkheden en vormt je eigen visie op de rol van AI binnen design. Je neemt initiatief, deelt inzichten en draagt bij aan het continu verbeteren van onze manier van werken.
 Het designteam omschrijft het zo: "AI speelt een cruciale rol in ons ontwerpproces. Het helpt ons met research, het structureren van input sneller te prototypen. Waar het werkzaamheden versnelt en de kwaliteit verhoogt, zetten we het in. De ontwerper speelt hierin een cruciale rol waarbij beoordelingsvermogen cruciaal is."
 Wie jij bent 
 Klaar om deze rol helemaal eigen te maken? Wij denken dat je goed bij ons past als je:
 Complexe vraagstukken zelfstandig oppakt, ook als het probleem nog niet helder is.
 Sterk bent in de kern van UX: flows, informatiearchitectuur, wireframes en interaction design.
 Overtuigende, gebruiksvriendelijke en esthetische UI ontwerpt.
 Zelf ervaring hebt met gebruikersonderzoek en het valideren van ontwerpen bij gebruikers.
 Zelfstandig presenteert en adviseert richting partners en je visie overtuigend uitdraagt.
 Over Framna 
 Framna betekent vooruitbrengen. En dat is precies wat we doen. We werken samen met marktleiders en met organisaties die dat willen worden om digitale producten te creëren die markten definiëren, industrieën vernieuwen en betekenisvolle groei realiseren.
 Vanuit een sterke productgedreven cultuur bouwen we met honderden collega’s aan de toekomst, verspreid over meerdere studio's in Europa en daarbuiten. Dagelijks vertrouwen miljoenen gebruikers wereldwijd op de producten die wij maken. Van soepele betaalervaringen tot dagelijkse mobiliteit, en van gezondheidsbeheer tot slimmer winkelen.
 Samen met ambitieuze partners bouwen we digitale producten die markten leiden en grenzen verleggen. Want wanneer producten winnen, winnen bedrijven ook. Wij noemen dat: win by product.
 Wat je krijgt 
 Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €4.000 - €5.500 afhankelijk van je ervaring.
 Pensioenbijdrage van 67% vanuit Framna.
 27 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen.
 Vergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en thuiswerken.
 Een MacBook en telefoon in bruikleen.
 Dagelijkse lunch in de studio.
 Goed om te weten 
 In overleg werk je ook op locatie bij partners.
 Voor deze functie zoeken we een collega die vloeiend Nederlands spreekt.
 Framna biedt geen visa sponsorship.
 We ontvangen je sollicitatie graag inclusief portfolio. Laat daarin niet alleen het eindresultaat zien, maar ook het waarom erachter: van briefing tot oplevering.
 Het sollicitatieproces 
 Wil jij meebouwen aan digitale producten die de wereld vooruit helpen? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog. Binnen zeven werkdagen neemt Léon van ons recruitmentteam contact met je op.
 Klikt het? Dan starten we met een korte online kennismaking. Zijn we daarna …

items.desc:
Role highlights 
 Quality Assurance Technician - Assembly, Integration & Final Inspection 
 Location: Valencia, Spain
 Department: Product & Mission Assurance
 Reports to: Reliability Engineer Manager
 Employment type: Permanent
 Workplace model: Production floor/Cleanroom
 Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)
 Why this role matters: 
 As a Quality Assurance Technician you are the independent set of eyes between our production line and orbit. You will perform in-process and final inspections of electronic and mechanical assemblies, verify that every integration step is carried out to procedure, and carry out the final inspection of completed satellites before they leave for environmental testing and launch.
 You will witness mandatory inspection points (MIPs), confirm workmanship against IPC and ECSS requirements, check torque, bonding, harness routing, connector mating and cleanliness, and make sure the build record is complete and audit-ready.
 Embedded within the production and AIT (Assembly, Integration and Test) environment, you will work in cleanrooms with ESD-sensitive flight hardware. Working closely with Production, AIT Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Mission Assurance and Supply Chain, you will catch defects before they move downstream, prevent quality escapes, and help every satellite we ship meet space-grade standards.
 Who We Are 
 ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.
 ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.
 ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.
 Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
 Your day-to-day responsibilities 
 Perform in-process inspections of electronic assemblies (PCBAs, harnesses, cable assemblies, units, etc.)

items.desc: Summary Andersen is looking for a Data Scientist / AI Agentic Engineer in the EU for a project developing an AI-powered fraud investigation solution to analyze alerts, reduce false positives, and improve efficiency. The customer is a large international technology organization operating in the digital infrastructure domain. It develops and maintains high-load platforms that process and manage significant volumes of data across multiple regions. The engineering landscape includes distributed systems, cloud-based environments, system integrations, and advanced security practices, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and continuous platform evolution. The project is focused on developing an AI-powered fraud investigation solution integrated with an existing fraud detection platform. It leverages agentic AI and generative AI to analyze alerts, identify false positives, enrich fraud cases with additional data, and provide actionable recommendations to investigators, improving investigation efficiency and supporting informed decision-making. Responsibilities Supporting the build of an AI agent that assists fraud investigators in assessing ARIC alerts. Selecting the appropriate AI / model approach for the use case. Designing agent skills and prompts, applying knowledge of how fraud cases are handled by investigators. Incorporating additional information such as beneficiary and mule data into the agent's analysis. Identifying false positives and reducing alert noise. Creating an evaluation framework and measuring agent performance through accuracy, precision and recall. Bringing the agent as close as possible to the decisions of experienced human investigators. Taking proof-of-concept life and providing a single clear recommendation to support human investigators. Bringing specialist fraud and financial crime expertise to complement the client's internal team. Requirements Experience in data science or AI / ML engineering applied to fraud detection or financial crime in financial services for 3-5 years. Hands-on fraud / financial crime investigation expertise: alert logic, false positive analysis, mule networks. Practical experience implementing GenAI / LLM-based agentic solutions, including agent design, skills and prompt engineering. Experience building evaluation frameworks and measuring performance with accuracy, precision and recall. Ability to select the appropriate AI / model approach for a given use case. Level of English – from Upper-Intermediate and above. Desired skills Hands-on experience with Featurespace ARIC. Experience taking an AI / agentic proof of concept into production. Reasons to join us Experience in teamwork with leaders in FinTech, Healthcare, Retail, Telecom, and others. Andersen cooperates with such businesses as Samsung, Siemens, Johnson & Johnson, BNP Paribas, Ryanair, Mercedes, TUI, Verivox, Allianz, T-Systems, etc.. Guarantee of professional, financial, and career growth! The company has introduced systems of mentoring and adaptation for each new employee. The opportunity to earn up to an additional 1,000 EUR per month, depending on the level of expertise, which will be included in the annual bonus, by participating in the company's activities. Access to the corporate training portal, where the entire knowledge base of the company is collected and which is constantly updated. Bright corporate life (parties / pizza days / PlayStation / fruits / coffee / snacks / movies). Certification compensation (AWS, PMP, etc). Referral program. Private health insurance and sports compensation, depending on the type of employment. Join us! items.desc: Als AI Engineer bij Social Deal breng jij AI van prototype naar productie, op een platform dat door meer dan 10 miljoen gebruikers wordt gebruikt! Je bouwt aan onze eigen AI-tools waarmee collega's van Marketing, Support en Sales in gewone mensentaal vragen kunnen stellen aan onze data. Daarnaast werk je aan Deal Monitor: een systeem dat deals en campagnes volgt, analyseert en voorspelt. Je werkt dagelijks met Python, SQL en Large Language Models (LLM's) en zorgt ervoor dat jouw oplossingen betrouwbaar en veilig binnen onze omgeving draaien. Je krijgt volop ruimte om mee te denken, nieuwe technologieën te ontdekken en jouw ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. Bijvoorbeeld tijdens onze wekelijkse hackathons! Waar houd je je zoal mee bezig als AI Engineer? Je werkt aan onze eigen MCP-server (Social Deal Data). Je verbetert en ontwikkelt deze verder om onze interne bedrijfsprocessen te optimaliseren, inclusief deployment, CI en monitoring. Je ontwikkelt samen met afdelingen als Marketing, Support en Sales slimme AI-tools, waarmee collega's snel en betrouwbaar antwoorden krijgen op basis van onze data. Je ontwerpt en bouwt AI-agents die via MCP zelfstandig taken uitvoeren met onze tools en data. Denk aan het monitoren van deals, signaleren van kansen en automatiseren van terugkerende werkzaamheden. Je zorgt ervoor dat onze AI-oplossingen veilig en betrouwbaar werken. Denk aan toegangsrechten per afdeling, controle op queries, audit logging en het beschermen van persoonsgegevens. Je ontwikkelt slimme automatiseringsoplossingen die processen efficiënter, schaalbaarder en minder foutgevoelig maken. Je bouwt recommender systems die klantgedrag voorspellen en bijdragen aan een hogere conversie. Je ontwikkelt machinelearningmodellen voor forecasting, clustering en classificatie, bijvoorbeeld om de prestaties van deals en campagnes beter te voorspellen. Je werkt nauw samen met Software Developers, Product Owners en Testers en presenteert jouw ideeën en resultaten tijdens demo's aan stakeholders, waaronder de directie en andere afdelingen. Met wie ga je dat doen? Je werkt nauw samen met Rami Alkadi, onze AI-specialist, en komt terecht in een team van meer dan 65 collega's binnen Development. Denk aan Software Developers, Product Owners, Quality Assurance Testers en UX/UI Designers. Samen werken jullie aan innovatieve oplossingen die direct impact hebben op onze organisatie en miljoenen gebruikers. Er wordt serieus en geconcentreerd gewerkt, maar er is ook ruimte voor een geintje en ontspanning. Van een potje tafeltennis tot gezellig samen lunchen of borrelen: bij Social Deal werk je hard, maar is er ook ruimte voor plezier! Wat vinden wij belangrijk? Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring als AI Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Data Engineer of in een vergelijkbare functie. Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen van AI-agents en weet hoe je deze inzet om processen en werkzaamheden te automatiseren. Je hebt kennis van machine learning en ervaring met het ontwikkelen en toepassen van machinelearningmodellen. Je hebt ervaring met data engineering , zoals ETL/ELT-pipelines, datamodellering en datawarehouses (Google Cloud BigQuery). Je hebt sterke programmeervaardigheden in Python, bent goed thuis in SQL en kunt werken met databases zoals MySQL/MariaDB. Je bent bekend met Large Language Models (LLM's), zoals Claude en ChatGPT, en weet hoe je deze kunt toepassen in slimme AI-oplossingen. Je hebt ervaring met het bouwen en testen van API's en werkt met Git om duidelijke, onderhoudbare code te schrijven. Je hebt oog voor security en privacy en begrijpt hoe belangrijk het is om AI-oplossingen veilig en betrouwbaar te ontwikkelen. Je kunt complexe technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk uitleggen aan niet-technische collega's en weet hun ideeën en vraagstukken te vertalen naar werkende oplossingen. Je gaat probleemoplossend te werk, neemt initiatief en werkt graag samen met anderen. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologieën en vindt het leuk om te blijven experimenteren en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Bijvoorbeeld tijdens onze wekelijkse hackathons op vrijdagmiddag! Kennis van securitystandaarden zoals least privilege en OAuth/OIDC. Herken jij jezelf in dit profiel? Dan maken we graag kennis met je! Wat krijg je van ons? items.desc: Company Description SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. We operate a network of over 2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries , supported by a team of over 100,000 dedicated professionals . With more than 145 years of service excellence , we combine the precision and accuracy that define Swiss companies to help organizations achieve t he highest standards of quality, compliance and sustainability. Our brand promise – “when you need to be sure” – underscores our commitment to trust, integrity and reliability , enabling businesses to thrive with confidence . We proudly deliver our expert services through the SGS name and a portfolio of trusted specialized brands , including Applied Technical Services , Brightsight , Bluesign and Nutrasource . Job Description Main Purpose of Role Act as the One NoBo technical reference for the Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (focusing on cyber resilience and AI), owning interpretations, procedures and templates applied consistently across all SGS notifications and executing affiliates. Qualify, authorise and monitor certification personnel under the One NoBo competence scheme, enabling EU-bound certification to be delivered locally under EU notifications. Lead the adoption of digital and AI tools in the certification process, keeping every conformity-assessment decision under qualified human control. Bridge One NoBo with SGS notified capacity in Spain, including the Rail Notified Body. Key Accountabilities AI-enabled machinery – Build SGS assessment capability for machinery and safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning (Annex I Part A), and for the AI-related health and safety requirements being added to the Regulation through Regulation (EU) 2026/1744. Cybersecurity of machinery – Build SGS assessment capability for protection against corruption and for the safety and reliability of control systems (Annex III, sections 1.1.9 and 1.2.1), including the interface with the Cyber Resilience Act and the IEC 62443 series. Technical review and decision – Perform technical file reviews and, once qualified, take certification decisions for machinery files routed under the selected SGS notification, in line with ISO/IEC 17065. Technical advisory – Develop and deliver technical advisory services on the Machinery Regulation, including AI and cyber requirements, for SGS affiliates and clients, kept strictly separate from the certification of the same clients in line with ISO/IEC 17065 impartiality requirements. SGS NoBos network – Develop, release and maintain One NoBo procedures, checklists and certificate templates, harmonising practice across SGS Notified Bodies and supporting their international collaboration. Competence and qualification – Own the One NoBo competence matrix (person × scope × authorisation) in ProCert; define qualification criteria, perform witness assessments and monitor evaluators in executing affiliates, including SGS China. Accreditation and notification – Support accreditation assessments and notifying-authority applications for machinery scope; represent SGS in the European coordination group of Notified Bodies for machinery (NB-M) and apply its Recommendations for Use. Authorised affiliates – Plan and perform One NoBo process assessments of authorised affiliates against the One NoBo Policy, follow up findings and report results to the One NoBo Committee. AI in certification – Act as product owner for AI-assisted certification workflows (AI Bot portfolio, ProCert integrations): define requirements, validate outputs, manage data governance and ensure AI never issues deliverables or takes conformity decisions. Platform and KPIs – Act as ProCert key user for machinery workflows; monitor turnaround time, certificates issued and resource utilisation through Power BI and drive corrective actions. Collaboration with SGS Spain – Work with SGS Spain, including the Rail Notified Body, to share experience and qualified resources and to align processes within the One NoBo framework. At all times, comply with SGS Code of Integrity and Professional Conduct and with the impartiality requirements of the Notified Body. Il accompagne le réseau des digitaliseurs de la Branche (représentants en région et directions de spécialités) dans la modernisation et l'outillage de leurs processus métiers. Dans le cadre de sa feuille de route, le pôle explore les opportunités offertes par le développement assisté par IA (vibe-coding, agents de code, IA générative) pour permettre aux équipes de prototyper rapidement des outils internes tout en garantissant la qualité et la pérennité du code. Rattaché au responsable du pôle Solutions Digitales Métiers et accompagné au quotidien par une équipe pluridisciplinaire, vous participez au cadrage et à l'expérimentation des pratiques de vibe-coding au sein d'un environnement sécurisé. Encadré et guidé tout au long de votre PFE, vos principales missions consistent à : Expérimenter et structurer les bonnes pratiques : Tester les outils de vibe-coding et d'IA agentique sur la plateforme IA fournie par la DSI du Groupe. Définir des modèles d'architecture simples et propres (en Python ou TypeScript) permettant d'assurer la transition fluide entre un PoC/maquette rapide et un projet industrialisé. Contribuer à la gouvernance et au workflow d'arbitrage : Participer à la définition des critères et du workflow décisionnel permettant de déterminer quand une application métier peut être développée en vibe-coding directement par les digitaliseurs via la plateforme DSI, et à partir de quel seuil (complexité, criticité, volume de données, sécurité) il convient de basculer vers un projet de développement classique assisté par IA. Créer des assistants IA sur-mesure (skills & plugins) : Développer et tester de petits modules réutilisables qui guident les IA pour générer du code conforme aux bonnes pratiques Eiffage (sécurité, gestion des API, structure de projet). Contribuer à l'environnement de travail (sandbox) : Participer, avec l'appui de notre profil DevOps, à la mise en place d'un espace d'expérimentation simple et sécurisé pour l'équipe et le réseau.

items.desc: Présentation de la société Et si votre futur métier contribuait concrètement à la transition climatique et environnementale ? Chez Naldeo, nous sommes convaincus que les grands défis liés au climat, à l'eau, à l'énergie, aux déchets et à l'environnement nécessitent des solutions ambitieuses et des talents engagés. Acteur indépendant de référence dans l'ingénierie et le conseil, nous accompagnons les collectivités, les industriels et les opérateurs privés dans la conception et la réalisation de projets à impact environnemental positif. Avec 13 implantations en France, nos équipes interviennent sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des projets, de la stratégie jusqu'à la mise en oeuvre opérationnelle. Rejoindre Naldeo, c'est intégrer un groupe qui place l'engagement, l'expertise technique et l'esprit d'équipe au coeur de son développement. Naldeo Stratégies Publiques s'engage quotidiennement auprès de tous les clients publics pour réaliser des missions de conseil et d'expertise relatives à la gestion des services et des projets publics. Naldeo Stratégies Publiques dispose d'un pool unique d'ingénierie sectorielle à fortes compétences techniques (eau-assainissement, chauffage urbain, gestion et traitement des déchets, électricité-gaz, transition énergétique) complété par des compétences fonctionnelles (finance, juridique, organisation et digital). Mission Stage Paris (12e) Intégré(e) à l'équipe déchets et économie circulaire, vous partirez d'un irritant métier concret : une analyse longue à produire, des connaissances hétérogènes et dispersées, des données difficiles à exploiter, une tâche répétitive ou l'obsolescence d'outils d'aide à la décision. Avec l'appui des experts métier et du dispositif IA de Naldeo, vous transformerez ce besoin en un outil utile, testé et réutilisable, et réitérerez ce processus sur plusieurs sujets. Basé(e) à Paris ou à Lyon, vous rejoindrez pleinement l'équipe de consultants. Aux côtés de ces experts, vous approfondirez les connaissances acquises au cours de votre formation et les mettrez en pratique sur plusieurs thématiques métier. Vous contribuerez directement aux missions de l'équipe en mobilisant l'intelligence artificielle pour concevoir des outils efficaces, explorer de nouvelles approches et apporter des perspectives complémentaires, notamment dans les domaines suivants : Accompagnement des collectivités dans la mise en oeuvre des nouvelles réglementations ; Exploitation « augmentée » des données ouvertes et des données de NSP ; Expérimentation de nouveaux modèles de langage (LLM) open source ; Conception d'outils d'extraction documentaire et valorisation des informations collectées. À l'issue du stage, vous saurez analyser un besoin métier et mobiliser les données et l'intelligence artificielle pour concevoir une solution utile, fiable et adaptée aux utilisateurs. Profil Vous terminez une formation d'ingénieur ou un Master 2 dans le domaine de l'environnement ou de l'énergie avec une appétence sur les sujets d'économie circulaire, de gestion et de traitement des déchets et souhaitez mettre vos compétences au service de projets concrets. Vous avez compris que votre expertise métier gagnera encore en impact lorsqu'elle sera associée à une utilisation pertinente de l'intelligence artificielle. Ce stage vous offre l'occasion de développer cette double compétence. Au sein de Naldeo Stratégies Publiques, vous approfondirez les enjeux de votre secteur tout en expérimentant l'IA générative, l'automatisation et l'analyse de données pour répondre à des besoins réels. Aucune expertise préalable en IA n'est indispensable : nous recherchons avant tout un socle technique solide, de la curiosité, une capacité d'apprentissage et l'envie de transformer des problématiques métier en solutions utiles. Compétences appréciées : Expérience antérieure sur des projets impliquant de l'IA ; Connaissances en traitements de données Métiers ; Notion de programmation. Profil attendu : Intérêt marqué pour les évolutions technologiques du secteur de l'IA ; Force de proposition et capacité à expérimenter de nouvelles approches dans la résolution de problématiques ; Engagement et sérieux dans la réalisation des missions confiées.

Concevoir et intégrer de nouvelles fonctionnalités en fonction des besoins identifiés. Réaliser des tests fonctionnels et contribuer à l’amélioration de l’expérience utilisateur (UX/UI). 4. Collaborer avec différents services et accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’adoption des nouveaux outils. Profil recherché : Étudiant(e) en dernière année de Bac+5 (Master 2 ou école d’ingénieurs), spécialisé(e) en informatique, intelligence artificielle, systèmes d’information ou transformation digitale. Bonne connaissance de l'environnement Microsoft Power Platform, notamment Power Apps et Power Automate. Intérêt marqué pour l’intelligence artificielle générative et ses applications en entreprise. Connaissances en développement informatique et web (HTML, CSS, JavaScript). Compréhension des principes d’automatisation des processus et d’intégration de données. Capacité à manipuler et analyser des données. Compétences appréciées : Connaissance de Microsoft Copilot Studio. Notions de Power BI. Première expérience dans la conception d’applications ou de workflows automatisés. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Participer à des projets concrets d’intelligence artificielle et d’automatisation. Développer vos compétences techniques dans un environnement professionnel. Bénéficier d’un accompagnement de proximité. Collaborer avec différents métiers et contribuer à des initiatives innovantes. Informations pratiques : Durée du stage : 6 mois Début du stage : idéalement janvier 2027 Gratification : 5,20 € / heure Lieu : Villabé Type d'emploi : Stage Rémunération : 5,20€ par heure Lieu du poste : En présentiel
