items.desc: Your mission What the job is Ceph is an open source distributed storage system. It runs block, file and object storage for clouds, research labs and companies around the world. RGW is its object storage gateway. It speaks the S3 and Swift APIs and stores data in RADOS, the replicated object store at the core of Ceph. CLYSO supports, develops, and ships its own distribution (CES) of Ceph. We work upstream. Most of the code you write lands in Ceph under your name, and goes through public review with the Ceph community. This job is on our RGW team. You work on RGW and on the parts of Ceph below it when a problem goes there. The work is systems software: concurrency, partial failure, protocol semantics, on-disk state and performance under load. You write C++ in a large, old and active codebase. You will read much more code than you write. Your profile What you work on Our current work includes: Performance of RGW on librados, also during partial failures and slowdowns of the storage backend. Detection and handling of fail-slow components, which still work but are much slower than normal. Quality of service for clusters that mix HDDs and SSDs. Cluster dashboards that help operators understand what the cluster does. Swift API maintenance and conformance with the S3 and Swift protocols. Quota and identity integration with OpenStack Keystone. Features and fixes that help large installations integrate Ceph, scale and grow. Who you work with You join a small RGW team inside a larger Ceph engineering group. Colleagues work on CephFS, BlueStore, the OSD, the test infrastructure and Rook. A staff engineer works with you on design, review and upstream work. You also work next to people who shape Ceph upstream. Our CTO is one of the three elected co-chairs of the Ceph Executive Council. Several colleagues sit on the Ceph Steering Committee. Three colleagues are Ceph Ambassadors, who represent the community in their regions. CLYSO is a Diamond member of the Ceph Foundation. What we look for We look for people who work on infrastructure and systems software, or who want to grow into it. We do not filter by years of experience. We filter by field and by evidence. You must: Write C++ and read a large C++ codebase with confidence. Bring experience below the application layer, or a strong interest to get there. Read and write English at C1 level or better. Fields that transfer well to this job: Storage engines, write-ahead logs, replication or transactions in databases. File systems: on-disk formats, caching, metadata services, FUSE or kernel file systems, parallel file systems. Kernel subsystems: block layer, network stack, memory management, drivers, eBPF. Network data plane: proxies, load balancers, packet processing, RPC frameworks. Firmware for storage or network devices. Internals of message queues, streaming systems, object stores or caches. Kubernetes controllers for stateful systems, CSI drivers or other Kubernetes internals. HPC and research computing: parallel file systems, burst buffers, MPI-IO or data pipelines for large instruments and simulations. If your main systems work is in Go or Rust, that counts too, as long as you also read and write C++. Python helps. Ceph uses it for tests, tooling and manager modules. Upstream review takes patience. Reviewers are busy, and good work can wait. We value people who keep a pull request alive: they rebase it, answer review and get the attention of maintainers. Evidence we like to see The job fits a strong junior, a mid-level and a senior engineer. We decide the level from what you show us. Junior: you built a part of a database, file system or kernel. Examples are a buffer manager, a B+ tree, a scheduler or a small operating system. You can explain how it fails. Maybe you have a few merged patches in a systems project. Mid-level: you shipped a component in a systems project. You chased a bug across a layer boundary and can explain the symptom, the tools and the root cause. You got non-trivial work merged in a public project with demanding review. Senior: you owned a component in production. You have a long record in an open source systems project. Others built on your design proposals. Upstream review takes patience. Reviewers are busy, and good work can wait. We value people who keep a pull request alive: they rebase it, answer review and get the attention of maintainers. Where you work The team works remotely across Europe, with a center of gravity in Germany. The Ceph community is worldwide. We have an office in Munich Schwabing. How to apply Send us your CV. Links to merged patches and other open source contributions are welcome, and they tell us more than a list of skills. In the interview, you read and review C++ code with us. It has bugs on purpose. We talk about what you find, how it can fail and how you would test it. You do not need to know Ceph before. About us CLYSO was founded in 2010 with headquarters in Munich and solves the biggest challenges companies face …

items.desc: The European Southern Observatory (ESO) enables scientists worldwide to discover the secrets of the Universe for the benefit of all. We design, build and operate world-class observatories on the ground - which astronomers use to tackle exciting questions and spread the fascination of astronomy - and promote international collaboration for astronomy. Established as an intergovernmental organisation in 1962, today ESO is supported by 16 Member States (Austria, Belgium, Czechia, Denmark, France, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland and the United Kingdom), along with the host state of Chile and with Australia as a Strategic Partner. ESO's headquarters and its visitor centre and planetarium, the ESO Supernova, are located close to Munich in Germany, while the Chilean Atacama Desert, a marvellous place with unique conditions to observe the sky, hosts our telescopes. ESO operates three observing sites: La Silla, Paranal and Chajnantor. At Paranal, ESO operates the Very Large Telescope and its Very Large Telescope Interferometer, as well as survey telescopes such as VISTA. Also at Paranal, ESO will host and operate the south array of the Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory, the world's largest and most sensitive gamma-ray observatory. Together with international partners, ESO operates ALMA on Chajnantor, a facility that observes the skies in the millimetre and submillimetre range. At Cerro Armazones, near Paranal, we are building "the world's biggest eye on the sky" - ESO's Extremely Large Telescope. From our offices in Santiago, Chile we support our operations in the country and engage with Chilean partners and society. Due to the need for additional resources associated with the ELT and Instrumentation Programmes, for its Mechanical Engineering Department (MEC), within the Directorate of Engineering at its Headquarters in Garching near Munich, Germany, ESO is advertising the position of Mechanical Engineer Garching Deadline 13/12/2026 This is an excellent opportunity for engineers with relevant work experience, whether they are in the early stages of their career or have reached a certain level of seniority. ESO is looking for a Mechanical Engineer to work in MEC's Instruments and Cryogenic Systems group in the Directorate of Engineering. The department comprises about 30 engineers and technicians, who work closely with other departments at ESO as well as many national and international institutes and industrial consortia to define and develop state-of-the-art research facilities for ESO's observatories in Chile, especially for the ELT and VLT. The successful candidate will work in the ESO matrix structure serving various projects and fulfilling tasks received from supervisor and project managers. This includes involvement in many project phases typically consisting of design, Assembly-Integration-Verification (AIV) and commissioning. The Mechanical Engineer will be involved in collaborations with mainly European companies and/or consortia for the design, construction testing and installation of scientific instruments and sub-units for ELT and VLT. They will support the design and laboratory test activities of ESO developments and deliverables. Visits to contractors' premises and duty trips to ESO's observatories in Chile are required to support contracts follow-up, installation and commissioning activities. Main Duties and Responsibilities: Support the ELT and Instrumentation Programmes with mechanical engineering and design; Use CAD software for the mechanical design of telescope infrastructure, scientific instruments and their sub-units, mechanisms and handling systems; Supervision of manufacturing, assembly, integration and commissioning of instruments, their sub-units and infrastructure, including on-site installation at the observatories; As member of an ESO follow-up team, covering the mechanical aspects, supporting and reviewing the work of external partners in the development of astronomical instrumentation for the ESO observatories; Laboratory testing of mechanical components, opto-mechanical systems and instrument subsystems; Reports to: Head of the Instruments and Cryogenic Systems Group of the Mechanical Engineering Department. By enabling customers to order from a curated selection of over 3,000 groceries and household essentials through our user-centric app, we deliver what people need in minutes. We have fundamentally shifted the retail landscape across Germany and the Netherlands, while embedding sustainability into our core through an all-electric delivery fleet, recyclable packaging, and a focus on reducing food waste. With a network of more than 160 hubs, we now bring the Flink experience to more than 22 million people, making us an integral part of the urban infrastructure. items.desc: What to Expect Tesla was founded in 2003 with the goal of accelerating the transition to sustainable energy and protecting the planet Earth. Through solar energy, batteries, and electric vehicles, we are building a world of amazing abundance. At Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg, we manufacture the Model Y, and starting in 2027, we’ll produce everything from battery cells to electric vehicles. This is unique in Europe. Our international team consists of over 12,000 employees from 130 countries. We hire talent at all skill levels - prior experience in the automotive industry is not required. Would you like to help write the next chapter in Tesla’s success story and work at one of Germany’s most modern workplaces? Then this is the right place for you! The Factory Layout Engineering Team at Tesla’s Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg is seeking a Factory Layout Engineer to contribute to the design and optimization of factory layouts for all Tesla products. The team holds primary responsibility for all layout activities at Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg while also providing expert support to Tesla factories across the global manufacturing network. The role requires a solid foundation in industrial engineering principles, combined with proficiency in 2D/3D CAD software, to deliver layouts that support high-density and efficient factory operations. The position involves close collaboration with all factory stakeholders, including manufacturing, material flow, construction, and facilities engineering teams. A hands-on approach is essential, as is the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, demanding environment. The team is characterized by exceptional flexibility and high motivation. Successful candidates will demonstrate comparable attributes of adaptability, analytical precision, organizational excellence, and a strong team-oriented mindset. The role is based at Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg. What You'll Do Audit manufacturing shops and conduct layout updates across the entire Gigafactory to ensure as-built status is accurately reflected in the factory layouts Update and maintain layouts in AutoCAD and develop models in visTABLE (training provided) Manage and coordinate spaces inside and outside the factory Support structured problem-solving and continuous improvement initiatives Develop concept models and generate factory layout KPIs to enable data-driven decisions Automate factory layout engineering methods and develop internal optimization tools What You'll Bring Please note: We hire rockstar engineers. Submit your CV highlighting at least one achievement demonstrating excellence. MS in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field, or evidence of exceptional ability Understanding of Factory Planning principles according to VDI 5200 Proven skills in Lean Manufacturing Design, factory optimization, first-principles thinking, and Digital Twin modeling Basic experience with AutoCAD and visTABLE, or a willingness to learn (training available) Fluency in English Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. At Aircraft & Systems Security we protect Airbus Defence and Space products against deliberate malicious acts during the whole product lifecycle. Our team is responsible for Product Security governance and performs technical activities such as compiling security concepts and architecture, performing risk assessments, defining appropriate requirements and supporting their implementation. You will join a growing team that is working in a new and challenging international environment when information security is becoming a revolution for the aeronautical industry and a key competence for the company, as well as for the airworthiness authorities and end users. Our field of activities ranges from proven combat platforms such as Tornado or Eurofighter up to the A400M transport aircraft, and covers also new unmanned developments such as the Eurodrone and UCCA programs, in air and on ground. In your upcoming position you will contribute to security aspects for unmanned platforms. You will be a key person in ensuring that the Airbus Defence and Space products and supporting services are protected against cybersecurity threats throughout their entire lifecycle and comply with regulations and requirements. As a Product Security Architect you are fully embedded in the system engineering process and will contribute to aircraft and system security architectures and design in accordance to the security scope. You will act as a Product Security architect in your domain and work closely together in an international environment with design offices and suppliers in designing the systems security architectures while ensuring that the security requirements are implemented. Make it fly with us! This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks. items.card: In this role, you will be responsible for turning advanced optical concepts into robust, manufacturable, and operable experimental and production laser systems. Your work will directly enable the performance, stability, and scalability of our fusion laser infrastructure — ensuring that optical designs meet extreme power, precision, and reliability requirements while remaining practical to build, integrate, and
items.desc: Focused Energy is a fusion energy startup with the goal of generating unlimited clean energy to responsibly meet future global demand. With the use and commercialization of laser-induced inertial fusion, a clean and highly efficient power generation technology is coming within reach, suitable to ensure a secure and scalable future energy supply. We are seeking a skilled and driven Optical Engineer to design, analyze, and help realize the next generation of high-energy and high-average-power laser systems that underpin Focused Energy’s fusion program. In this role, you will be responsible for turning advanced optical concepts into robust, manufacturable, and operable experimental and production laser systems. Your work will directly enable the performance, stability, and scalability of our fusion laser infrastructure — ensuring that optical designs meet extreme power, precision, and reliability requirements while remaining practical to build, integrate, and operate. What you’ll do Optical System Design: Design, model, and optimize complex optical systems for high-energy and high-average-power laser applications, balancing performance, robustness, and manufacturability. Simulation & Analysis: Use advanced optical modeling tools (e.g., Zemax / OpticStudio) to perform ray tracing, tolerance analysis, stray light analysis, and wavefront propagation to predict and validate system behavior. Performance Specification: Define detailed optical specifications including component selection, materials, coatings, and tolerances to meet demanding power, fluence, and stability requirements. Integration & Commissioning: Partner closely with technicians, laser engineers, and mechanical and electrical teams during assembly, alignment, testing, and commissioning of optical systems, troubleshooting issues as they arise. System Optimization: Identify and resolve performance limitations related to aberrations, thermal effects, alignment sensitivity, and stray light to ensure stable, repeatable operation at high power. Documentation & Communication: Produce high-quality technical documentation, analyses, and design reviews to support internal development, knowledge sharing, and external collaboration. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work across disciplines to ensure optical designs integrate cleanly into larger laser, mechanical, electrical, vacuum, and control system architectures. Who you are A degree in Optical Engineering, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with professional experience designing and analyzing optical systems for laser or photonics applications. Deep hands-on experience with Zemax (OpticStudio) or comparable optical design and simulation tools, including tolerance and stray light analysis. Strong understanding of classical optics, Gaussian beam propagation, laser physics, and material behavior under high-intensity or high-fluence conditions. Comfortable moving between modeling and the lab — supporting alignment, testing, debugging, and iteration of real optical hardware. You bring rigor to your designs, anticipate failure modes, and care deeply about accuracy, documentation, and long-term reliability. You can work effectively with scientists, engineers, and technicians and communicate complex optical concepts clearly across disciplines. Preferred: Experience with MATLAB, Python, or similar tools for analysis, modeling, or automation of design workflows. Preferred: Familiarity with cleanroom practices, vacuum-compatible optical design, large-aperture optics, or advanced components such as adaptive or deformable optics. Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

items.desc: Company Description We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business. Job Description About the role Sportradar supplies betting operators around the world with odds and trading services. Our clients share a portion of the revenue generated from bets placed through our services and, as part of their contract with Sportradar, are required to report all relevant betting activity to us. Revenue Protection Team makes sure this activity is reported accurately and in line with those contractual obligations. You will work with large sets of client betting data to identify gaps, discrepancies or unusual patterns and investigate their cause. You will determine what the contract requires, gather the supporting evidence and estimate the potential commercial impact. You will build a clear case for Sales and Legal to take forward with the client, then follow each case through to resolution and measure the outcome. This is not a trading role. You will not be pricing markets or managing betting liabilities. The focus is on data investigation, building evidence and revenue recovery . THE CHALLENGE Analyse client betting data to spot anomalies and changes in behaviour. Compare clients against their peers and against their own history to tell a real problem from a seasonal or market effect. Build the evidence behind each finding so that it stands up to challenge. Estimate the revenue impact of an infringement using a clear and defensible method. Write short, precise findings for non-technical stakeholders in Sales, Legal and management. Build and improve the tools the team uses for recurring checks, including AI assisted ones. Follow a case through to resolution and measure the uplift afterwards. ABOUT YOU 2+ years of experience in a data-led investigative role. Experience in betting or sports data is preferred, but we also welcome strong backgrounds in fraud, risk, financial crime, payments, revenue assurance, trading risk, integrity or similar areas. Proven ability to uncover wrongdoing, non-compliance or revenue leakage through data analysis, from the first signal to an evidenced and quantified conclusion. Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, cleaning and reconciling large datasets, and building calculations that others can review and validate. Your Excel skills will be assessed as part of the interview process. Working knowledge of SQL, with the ability to pull, filter and aggregate data from large tables independently. Clear and concise writing skills, with the ability to explain complex findings to people who may not know the underlying data. Curiosity and persistence, with the drive to keep digging until the explanation holds. An interest in using and building tools, including AI, to work more effectively, applying them alongside your own knowledge, skills and informed judgement rather than as a substitute for them. Nice to have Python for data analysis. Power BI or a similar tool. Experience writing to or dealing with external clients on contractual matters. OUR OFFER: A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding. Flexibility to manage your workday and tasks with autonomy. A balance of structure and autonomy to tackle your daily tasks. Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants. Global Employee Assistance Programme. Calm and Reulay app (leading well-being apps designed to support focus, quality rest, mindfulness, and long-term mental resilience). Online training videos. Flexible working hours. While we appreciate the flexibility and benefits of working from home, we strongly believe that coming together in person fosters stronger connections, encourages collaboration, and drives innovation—both as individuals and as a company. The energy, shared ideas, and team support we experience in the office strengthen the foundation of our success and culture. For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a fully on-site model, with team members working in the office five days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together. OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS: Initial Screening : A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. Team interview: with the Revenue Protection manager and senior members of the wider team about your experience, how you investigate, and how you would fit in the team. Final interview onsite: technical exercise completed live with the team in our office, using a realistic dataset. No AI tools for this stage, we want to see how you work through the data and reach your conclusions. Final Steps : Receive feedback and, if …

items.desc: Junior Foreperson (Parks) HG Job Specification Junior Foreperson (Parks) Cork City Council Closing Date: 4pm, Friday 27th November 2026 44 To be read in conjunction with Our Candidate Information Booklet Junior Foreperson (Parks) BACKGROUND Located on Ireland’s scenic south coast, Cork City is the country’s second-largest urban centre and home to over 224,000 people. Since the 2019 boundary extension, Cork has entered a new phase of ambitious growth and development, with its population projected to reach 335,000 by 2040. Backed by over €2.5 billion in investment, this expansion is focused on sustainable, infrastructure-led growth-enhancing housing, transport, public amenities and cultural services across the city. Cork City Council is a large urban local authority with 1,675 employees operating across more than 40 locations. The Council is made up of 31 elected members who represent five wards across the city and play a vital role in shaping local policy, decision-making and strategic priorities. The Council has an annual revenue budget of approximately €362 million for 2026 and delivers a broad range of public services including housing, planning, transport, libraries, parks and recreation, community development, culture and placemaking. Internal services include Finance, ICT, Human Resources, Legal Affairs, and Corporate Affairs. Our work is guided by the Corporate Plan 2024 – 2029, which sets out a clear vision and values for Cork’s future – placing sustainability, innovation, service excellence, and community wellbeing at the heart of everything we do. Cork’s international recognition as a UNESCO Learning City, a WHO Healthy City and one of the EU’s Climate-Neutral and Smart Cities reflects the city’s ambition and global outlook. Cork City Council is committed to delivering high-quality public services by working collaboratively with strategic partners, businesses, communities and neighbourhoods. Together, we are shaping a city that continues to thrive as a vibrant place to live, study, visit, and work. We are now seeking applications from individuals who are passionate about public service and eager to contribute to Cork’s ongoing transformation. If you bring relevant experience, a commitment to service excellence, and a forward-thinking approach to innovation and customer focus – we want to hear from you. Our people are committed to our values of public service, integrity, respect, a people centred approach, responsibility, and ambition. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to play a meaningful role in shaping the city’s future, driving impact and supporting Cork’s continued growth and success. The Corporate Plan can be viewed here: Cork City Council Corporate Plan 2024–2029 Junior Foreperson (Parks) Vision, Mission, & Values Our Vision Make Cork City Better Our Values Public Service Integrity Respect People Centred Responsible Ambitious Provide high quality services and address peoples’ needs in a manner that is both inclusive and equitable. We act honestly, openly and fairly in all our dealings. We treat all people with respect We engage with people in a fair, courteous and timely manner. We strive for continous improvement. We are accountable and transparent and act responsibly in our dealings and decision making. We work to attract investment to the City Our Mission People – A City of Welcomes where a Public Service ethos is at the core of how we do business. Place – An Ambitious, Vibrant, and Sustainable City ready for the future while continuing to deliver high quality services every day. Prosperity – A Vibrant City of Neighbourhoods, Communities and Businesses working together to deliver on our economic and cultural potential. Junior Foreperson (Parks) THE ROLE Cork City Council invites applications, on the official application form, from suitably qualified persons who wish to be considered for inclusion on a panel from which temporary and permanent vacancies for the post of Junior Foreperson – Parks Department may be filled. Cork City Council reserves the right to assign the post holder to any depot operated by the Parks Department, either currently or in the future, subject to reasonable notice. Reporting to the Assistant General Foreperson, General Foreperson, Executive Horticulturist, Senior Parks and Landscape Officer or other appropriate officer, the post holder will be responsible for carrying out Parks Department operations and supervising allocated staff within their designated area. The post holder will work in a supervisory capacity, assisting in the effective delivery, management and maintenance of parks, gardens and open spaces, while also participating in operational activities as required. The overall purpose of this role is to answer internal and external calls using professional telephone etiquette. To answer questions providing general information with the aim of a first time resolution. Take payments, calculate charges, and process bills Update patient accounts in a timely manner with clear and precise information Identify and escalate priority issues referring to a more experienced employees if necessary Processing requests for ordering Radiology images Identify and escalate priority issues This job description is not exhaustive and may be adjusted periodically after review and consultation. You will also be expected to carry out any reasonable duties, which may be requested from time-to-time Personal and Professional Responsibilities The post holder is expected to: Adhere to the Hospital's mission and Vision Maintain patient confidentiality including authorisation of the release of medical information Abide by Hospital policies and all regulatory requirements including mandatory training Have excellent customer care and communication skills, both written and verbal Have excellent knowledge of computers and Microsoft Windows software and keyboard skills Have excellent time management skills and ability to multi-task and prioritize work Build collaborative relationships through strong teamwork across the organization Be flexible, reliable and detail orientated. Hours of work will on occasion be subject to change A willingness to change with the hospital requirements Person Specification Qualifications Leaving Certificate or equivalent. Administration and or computer skills qualification. Experience 2 years Customer Service experience Previous Medical Admin experience desired Experience using IT systems, including MS Excel & Word Job Specific Competencies and Knowledge Exhibits high level of customer / patient relation skills. Complies with processes and procedures Exhibits ability to work as a member of a team in daily performance of duties. Have a high capacity for responsibility and individual initiative, and an ability to write clear and concise English. Have excellent organisational skills Personal Competencies All posts in Beacon Hospital require a high level of flexibility to ensure the delivery of an effective and efficient service. Therefore, the post holder will be required to demonstrate flexibility as and when required by their manager of hospital management. This job description is intended to be an outline of the areas of responsibility and deliverables at the time of its writing. As the Hospital and the post holder develop, this job description may be subject to review in light of the changing needs of the Hospital.

items.desc: hi Siamo La storia del Gruppo Dallara inizia nel 1972, quando l’Ingegner Giampaolo Dallara, dopo importanti esperienze lavorative in Ferrari, Maserati, Lamborghini e De Tomaso, fonda la "Dallara Automobili da Competizione" a Varano de' Melegari, un piccolo paese vicino a Parma. Oggi, il Gruppo Dallara è composto da oltre 900 Persone Dallara ed è una delle più importanti realtà nel settore della progettazione, sviluppo e produzione di vetture da competizione ad alte prestazioni. Dallara è l’unico fornitore dei campionati: IndyCar, IndyNXT, Formula 2, Formula 3, EuroFormula, Formula E e Super Formula. Inoltre, sviluppa e produce alcune delle vetture che si sfidano nei campionati WEC e IMSA ed offre consulenza in altri campionati, incluso il mondo NASCAR. Dall'inizio degli anni 2000, Il Gruppo Dallara fornisce consulenze specialistiche e assistenza professionale a costruttori e squadre corse per sviluppare vetture sia da competizione che stradali. Il 16 novembre 2016 è stata svelata la Dallara Stradale, la prima vettura stradale a marchio Dallara, che incarna il sogno dell'Ingegner Dallara e sintetizza quasi 50 anni di innovazioni. In seguito, è stata sviluppata la Dallara EXP, una versione da pista della Stradale, che rappresenta l'essenza dello spirito sportivo con prestazioni estreme e standard di sicurezza FIA. Infine, negli ultimi anni, il Gruppo Dallara ha iniziato a collaborare allo sviluppo di soluzioni per il settore aerospaziale. Il ruolo Nel ruolo di Bodywork & Interiors Designer entrerai a far parte del team di Bodywork & Interiors Design nel dipartimento di Design & Research di Dallara Automobili, azienda del Gruppo Dallara specializzata nella progettazione, realizzazione di pre-serie e test per le 3 Business Unit aziendali ( Racing , Automotive e Aerospace ). In questa posizione sarai responsabile della progettazione dei componenti in composito per vetture racing e automotive ad altre prestazioni. In particolare, seguirai l’intero processo di design: dal concept del componente fino alla sua delibera garantendo che esso rispetti gli standard del Gruppo Dallara. Infine, questo ruolo ti darà l’opportunità di confrontarti e collaborare con tutti i gruppi del dipartimento Design & Research e con il dipartimento di Aerodynamics e di entrare a far parte di un ambiente dinamico e innovativo. Cosa stiamo cercando Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica o affini; Esperienza nella progettazione di componenti in composito e nell’utilizzo di software CAD (è preferibile la conoscenza di Catia); Ottima conoscenza dei materiali compositi e dei relativi processi produttivi; Spiccata predilezione al lavoro in team. I nostri valori Umiltà Vogliamo fare bene il nostro lavoro con passione, determinazione e competenza, valorizzando gli errori, condividendo la conoscenza e superando con resilienza le difficoltà, consapevoli che il più grande pericolo è credere di sapere. Lealtà Crediamo nella parola data, nel rispetto tra le persone e degli impegni presi; vogliamo sviluppare legami fondati sull’onestà, la fiducia e la serietà dei rapporti umani. Curiosità Vogliamo fare meglio ciò che abbiamo sempre fatto con prontezza, entusiasmo e amore del sapere, sfidando ciò che esiste in modo nuovo e flessibile con la continua disponibilità ad imparare. Cosa offriamo Programma di welfare olistico – Comunità Dallara; La retribuzione annua lorda sarà commisurata all'esperienza e al livello di seniority, con una base di partenza di €30.000-€33.000 per profili Junior e €35.000-€40.000 per profili con comprovata esperienza nel settore Accesso a percorsi formativi qualificati; Internal Job Posting; Policy Smart-Working; Flessibilità oraria.

Contribute to the continuous improvement of field production processes and operational efficiency. Your Profile Residence in the Padua, Vicenza, or Rovigo area, or willingness to relocate to the region. Technical diploma or certification in Agriculture, Agronomy, or a related field. items.desc: Role Overview MDOTM, a leading provider of AI-driven investment solutions, is looking for an Intermediate DevOps Engineer to join our Platform Team. Work at the leading edge of technology, leveraging our decade of experience in proprietary AI to power a platform trusted by top-tier institutional clients. Truly flexible work environment — we care about output, not hours logged. Collaborate daily with an ultra-international team (18+ nationalities) across our Milan, London, and New York offices. Annual company retreat at a stunning location, because we invest in our people beyond the day job. Real, fast-track career progression, with outsized growth opportunities for early team members.

items.desc: The Challenge Talk360 connects more than 6 million people worldwide every year, and we rely on data we can trust. We have built the foundations of a modern data platform, and now we are looking for an Analytics Engineer to carry the build forward and make that data work for every team. You will be a driving force in how Talk360 works with data, spotting where the numbers disagree, helping decide what the right definition is, and building the models that settle it. As the foundations mature, the role might lean further towards analytics, and we will shape that together. Our current tech includes: Data warehouse: BigQuery Ingestion: Stitch Transformation: dbt Cloud Visualisation: Omni, replacing Tableau and QuickSight What you’ll do Data Modelling & Pipelines: Build and maintain scalable, reliable data models that expose high-quality data for analysis and reporting. Decide what each new data source needs and model it for the warehouse, working with Tech, who own our infrastructure and ingestion. Source of Truth: Grow our dbt project with new, tested and documented models, keeping one agreed definition for every metric. You will be extending and improving a codebase with its own conventions, not starting from a blank page. Automation: Replace manual routines and hand-built reports with reliable, automatic reporting that teams can check and trust. Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with teams across the business to understand what they need, challenge it where it helps, and translate it into technical solutions that enable reliable self-serve data for decision making. Quality & Governance: Set the standards and conventions that keep the warehouse maintainable as we grow, and build the monitoring and alerting that catches data quality issues before they reach the business. AI-Ready Data: Name, describe and define our data clearly and consistently, so that colleagues and AI tools can ask questions of it and get the right answer. Champion Data Culture: Champion the use of data to optimise business performance, coach colleagues to explore it themselves in Omni, and bring fresh analytical ideas to the table. Working with AI AI is part of how we work every day, and it will be part of your role. We expect you to use AI tools to write and review SQL and dbt code, draft tests and documentation, and speed up investigation, and to check what they produce with a critical eye. You are accountable for the quality of what you ship, however it was written. The Team You will report to Rianna, our Head of Data, and work with Max (Data Insights) as part of our small Data team of three on day-to-day modelling priorities. You will work with the Tech team, who own our data infrastructure and ingestion, and partner directly with stakeholders across the business. Who you are You have owned analytics engineering work end to end. You have solid SQL and dbt experience, including extending and maintaining an existing dbt project as well as building new models (Cloud or Core). You are comfortable designing data models from ambiguous or undocumented business logic, not just working from an existing spec. You see yourself as a strategic partner to the business who wants to understand the underlying question, and you can clearly communicate the impact of your technical work in plain language. You use AI tools in your analytics work and you have good habits for checking what they produce. You write tests and documentation with every model, and you keep an eye on warehouse cost and on how sensitive data is handled. You are familiar with Git fundamentals. We use dbt Cloud for orchestration and deployment, so we do not require deep pipeline engineering. How we hire There are four stages: 30-minute call with our recruiter. 60-minute conversation with the hiring manager. 75-minute case study, done in our office with colleagues from across the business. There is nothing to prepare and no take-home task. 30-minute conversation with a senior leader. What we have for you Competitive compensation 80,000 - 90,000 euros per year all-in gross Learning and growth €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving. Time to recharge 25 vacation days Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we’ll tell you more during the interview) Work from anywhere As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas. A team you’ll actually want to be part of Weekly team lunch every Thursday Regular team moments and outings An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond Set up for success Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work Monthly phone allowance and commuting …

items.desc: Job Description Ramboll is looking for a Consultant Soil and Groundwater to join its Site Solutions team in Rotterdam. You will work on soil and groundwater investigations, remediation and site redevelopment projects in the Netherlands. The role combines technical assessment with project management and client advice, including support for environmental due diligence and property transactions. Your new role As our new Consultant Soil and Groundwater, you will manage investigation and remediation projects, providing technical advice and practical recommendations to clients. You will be part of the Site Solutions team within Ramboll's Environment & Health department in Rotterdam, working with colleagues across the Benelux region, Europe and the US. You will work on a varied portfolio of projects involving contaminated land, groundwater investigations, remediation and site redevelopment. From planning investigations and supervising fieldwork to interpreting data and advising clients, you will take responsibility for projects throughout their lifecycle. You will also contribute to environmental due diligence and property transactions, helping clients make informed decisions about their sites. Working closely with colleagues and external stakeholders, you will combine technical expertise with project management and client engagement. This is an opportunity to develop your expertise while contributing to projects with a tangible environmental impact. Your key responsibilities will be: Manage soil and groundwater investigation and remediation projects, ensuring delivery within agreed budgets, timelines and quality standards. Develop investigation strategies and conceptual site models to assess contamination, identify data gaps and guide further investigation and remediation. Coordinate subcontractors and supervise fieldwork, ensuring compliance with agreed investigation plans and relevant health, safety and quality requirements. Interpret technical and spatial data and prepare clear reports, remediation plans and practical recommendations in Dutch and English. Build client relationships, coordinate with authorities and stakeholders, and provide technical advice for property transactions and redevelopment projects. About you You are a proactive and organised consultant who can independently manage projects, make sound technical assessments and communicate your findings clearly. You enjoy working with clients and colleagues and can balance technical detail with a practical understanding of project objectives. For this role, you will bring: A BSc or MSc in Environmental Science, Earth Sciences, Land and Water Management, Physical Geography or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. Relevant consultancy experience in soil and groundwater investigations and remediation in the Netherlands. Experience managing projects, including budgets, deadlines, subcontractors and client communication. Practical experience with GIS software such as QGIS and/or ArcGIS, as well as TerraIndex. Excellent spoken and written Dutch and English, with the ability to lead stakeholder discussions in Dutch and prepare technical reports in both languages. What we can offer you Flexible work environment and working arrangements. Commitment to your professional development, including access to internal training programmes. Leaders guided by our Leadership Principles. A culture that welcomes you as the unique person you are. Inspiration from colleagues, clients and projects. Collaboration with soil and groundwater specialists across the Benelux, Europe and the US. 30 days of annual leave. Pension contributions. How to apply Please submit your application and CV online. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every requirement. Deadline: February 5, 2027 About Ramboll Ramboll is a foundation-owned architecture, engineering and consultancy company founded in Denmark. Its services span Buildings, Transport, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, Management Consulting, and Architecture & Landscape. Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion Ramboll is committed to an inclusive and supportive working environment and offers flexible working arrangements. If you need any adjustments to the application process, please contact job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com.

Dan zijn wij op zoek aan jou! Voor de uitbreiding van Analytische Chemie zijn wij op zoek naar een Chemisch Analist Afdeling: De afdeling Chemie bestaat uit ongeveer 150 medewerkers verdeeld over de eenheden Analytische en Fysische Chemie, environmental fate, Bioanalyse en Test Item Receipt and Formulation. In de laboratoria wordt gewerkt met de modernste technieken zoals UPLC-UV, LC-(MS)MS, GC-FID, GC-(MS)MS en ICP-(MS)MS en andere specifieke technieken. Team: In ons team heerst een plezierige en informele sfeer. Als analist werk je binnen een dynamisch en divers team van zowel jonge als ervaren professionals aan diverse analytisch chemische uitdagingen om ontwikkeling van onder andere nieuwe medicijnen mogelijk te maken. Je rol: Als chemisch analist werk je aan je eigen studies om de methode te ontwikkelen, te valideren en de monsters te meten. Je hebt hierbij regelmatig contact met de studieleider. Als analist werk je zelfstandig aan je eigen studies en rapporteer je de experimentele resultaten. Je profiel: Je wordt enthousiast van technische uitdagingen en je zoekt hiervoor graag oplossingen; Je bent een teamspeler die graag met je collega’s meedenkt en het teamresultaat net zo belangrijk vindt als je eigen doelen; Je hebt analytisch chemische kennis op HBO niveau; Je hebt een kritische werkhouding, je bent klantgericht en je neemt graag het initiatief. Primaire verantwoordelijkheden: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het zelfstandig voorbereiden en uitvoeren van niet-routinematige analyses; Beoordelen, verwerken en rapporteren van data conform geldende procedures; bespreken van resultaten en eventuele afwijkingen; Nauw samenwerken met het team om de werkzaamheden te optimaliseren. Je hebt neventaken naast je hoofdtaak als analist. Deze neventaken zijn gerelateerd aan bijvoorbeeld onderhoud en kalibratie van instrumenten en hulpmiddelen of verantwoordelijkheid voor SOPs, analytische software en templates. Wat is fijn: Ervaring met GLPen/of GMP; Ervaring met LC en/of LCMSMS. items.desc: Vil du benytte din kompetanse på et sted hvor det virkelig teller? Vi søker ny kollega i vår seksjon som skal ta fatt på et nytt forskningsprosjekt. Institutt for kreftgenetikk og informatikk (IKI) ved Oslo universitetssykehus arbeider med å utvikle og anvende informatikk og avansert bildeanalyse innen digital patologi for å oppnå ny kunnskap som kan bidra til bedre diagnostikk, prognostisering og behandling av kreftpasienter. Instituttet har et tett samarbeid med nasjonale og internasjonale forskningsmiljøer. Seksjon for interfasegenetikk har flere pågående forskningsprosjekter innen blant annet prostata-, tykk- og endetarmskreft og livmorkreft. Prosjektene omfatter både molekylær karakterisering av kreftsvulster og utvikling og anvendelse av kunstig intelligens for analyse av histologiske vevssnitt. Vi søker nå en patolog i 30 % stilling til det treårige forskningsprosjektet «Pan-cancer analysis of vascular invasion using deep learning», finansiert av Helse Sør-Øst. Prosjektet har som mål å utvikle og validere KI-modeller som automatisk kan identifisere karinnvekst i kreftsvulster og skille mellom innvekst i blodkar og lymfekar. Ved å kombinere digital patologi, immunhistokjemi og kunstig intelligens ønsker vi å utvikle metoder som kan bidra til mer presis og standardisert diagnostikk. Patologen vil få en sentral rolle i den histopatologiske vurderingen av vevsmaterialet og i etableringen av referansedata for utvikling og validering av KI-modellene. Arbeidet vil foregå i tett samarbeid med forskere innen patologi, biologi og informatikk. Stillingen er et ettårig engasjement i 30 %, med mulighet for forlengelse. Det forventes at den som får stillingen har anledning til å jevnlig sitte fysisk på IKI innenfor normal arbeidstid. Oslo universitetssykehus er en arbeidsplass med stort mangfold. Vi mener dette er avgjørende for å løse våre oppgaver på best mulig måte. Vi ønsker at dette mangfoldet skal gjenspeiles blant søkerne til våre stillinger, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater, uavhengig bakgrunn, til å søke! Oferujemy umowa o pracę na okres 6-ciu miesięcy z możliwością przedłużenia na czas nieokreślony, elastyczne godziny rozpoczęcia pracy (od 7.00 do 9.00). Po około trzymiesięcznym okresie wdrożenia możliwość pracy w systemie hybrydowym, od samego początku możesz liczyć na wsaparcie buddyego, który wdroży Cię w codzienną pracę. Dzięki temu masz realny wpływ na swoją ścieżkę kariery, a także możliwość zdobywania nowych umiejętności i doświadczeń w różnych obszarach firmy, dojedziesz do nas różnymi środkami komunikacji: z Gdyni: SKM do Sopot Wyścigi, trolejbus 21, z Gdańska: tramwaj 2,8, 6, autobus 227, 143, 148, SKM Gdańsk Żabianka, pracę w wyjątkowej lokalizacji – tuż przy plaży, nad morzem. Piękne widoki i świeże powietrze to nasza codzienność, która umila dzień! pracę w firmie będącej jednym z liderów rynku ubezpieczeń w Polsce, która od ponad 30 lat pozostaje wiarygodnym i niezawodnym partnerem oferującym najwyższej jakości produkty i usługi, przestrzeń bez barier architektonicznych i możliwość dostosowanie stanowiska pracy do różnych niepełnosprawności.

items.desc: At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us. Boeing Poland is seeking a highly skilled Flight Controls Systems Engineer to support the design, integration, verification, and safety assessment of aircraft Flight Control and Autoflight systems. This role offers the opportunity to work on complex aerospace systems across the full product lifecycle, from early concept development through integration, test, certification support, and in-service issue resolution. The ideal candidate brings strong systems engineering fundamentals, hands-on experience in Flight Controls or Autoflight systems, and the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering disciplines to deliver safe, reliable, and high-performing aircraft systems. Position Responsibilities: Develop, analyze, and manage system requirements to support robust system design, traceability, and compliance in DOORS. Lead or support verification and validation activities, including test planning, test execution, issue resolution, and documentation of results. Work closely with cross-functional teams to define, document, and manage system interfaces across hardware, software, safety, integration, and test functions. Create and maintain high-quality system design documentation, including specifications, interface definitions, and technical reports. Perform root cause analysis and support disposition development for complex design nonconformances and technical findings. Investigate technical, operational, and quality issues identified in service and drive resolution through engineering analysis. Support the development of complex systems from conceptual design through product introduction and lifecycle sustainment. Evaluate potential safety implications associated with Autoflight and Flight Control system functions. Contribute to continuous improvement in systems engineering processes, methods, and technical rigor. Basic Qualifications: Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited course of study in engineering, engineering technology (includes manufacturing engineering technology), chemistry, physics, mathematics, data science, or computer science. Experience in systems engineering and technical disciplines related to aircraft Flight Control systems. Strong understanding of systems engineering principles, including requirements development, interface management, and verification. Upper-intermediate English proficiency in both written and verbal communication. Preferred Qualifications: Direct design or integration experience with aircraft Flight Controls or Autoflight systems. Experience performing engineering analysis of Fight Control or Autoflight systems using guidance, navigation, and control theory and related analytical methods. Familiarity with system safety practices and product safety assessment processes. Working knowledge of relevant government regulations and certification requirements impacting aerospace systems. Experience with MATLAB/Simulink. Experience with DOORS and model-based or requirements-driven development environments. Ability to influence technical decisions in a collaborative, cross-functional environment. Join us if you want to: Market competitive salary and performance-based incentive program. Have flexible working hours. Enjoy additional paid days off for Christmas break (December 24th-January 1st). Develop professional skills with our virtual learning tools and platforms. Benefit from Learning Together Program and MyBenefit program. Benefit from Employee Recognition Program. Get Medical Plan (Medicover/LuxMed) and life insurance (Warta S.A.) for you and your Family. Participate in Employee Pension Scheme (PPE). Enjoy and create with us friendly and inclusive atmosphere in workplace. Cooperate and exchange knowledge with world class global engineering team. Conflict of Interest: Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company’s Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process. items.desc: Join our team as a Junior Software Specialist! Are you starting your career in software development and looking for a place where you can grow as a Full-Stack Developer working with Java and Angular? For us, your curiosity, motivation, and willingness to develop are just as important as your current technical knowledge. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, collaborating with others, and continuously improving their skills. Good knowledge of Java, Angular, or web development will help you get started. Experience with AI-powered development tools, such as GitHub Copilot or similar solutions, is an additional advantage. In this role you will contribute to the development and continuous improvement of our applications. You will translate business requirements into working software solutions and participate in the development lifecycle. Working closely with experienced developers and other team members, you will have the opportunity to strengthen your technical skills, learn our systems and development practices, and gradually take on more responsibility as your experience grows. items.desc: Veritas Group to nie tylko branża opiekuńcza - to organizacja, w której codziennie koordynujemy setki procesów związanych z zatrudnieniem i obsługą opiekunów pracujących w Niemczech. Nasz dział rekrutacji odpowiada za prowadzenie procesów, dopasowanie kandydatów do ofert oraz bieżący kontakt z kandydatami. To praca oparta na komunikacji, podejmowaniu decyzji i szybkim reagowaniu na zmieniające się potrzeby. Równolegle działają u nas zespoły m.in. administracyjne, kadrowe, finansowe, IT, a także obszary operacyjne takie jak transport, dokumentacja, Biuro Obsługi Klienta czy call center. Każdy z nich współtworzy rozwiązania, które pozwalają firmie działać sprawnie i na dużą skalę. Od 2011 roku zatrudniliśmy ponad 45 000 opiekunek. Działamy w skali całej Polski, współpracując z kandydatami i pracownikami z różnych regionów. Jesteśmy środowiskiem dla osób, które lubią pracować w dynamicznym tempie, cenią współpracę z innymi i chcą mieć realny wpływ na to, jak działamy każdego dnia. Cześć! Ogłaszamy nową rekrutację! Poszukujemy osoby do zespołu Fundacji Veritas , która pomoże nam organizować i realizować nasze projekty – od wydarzeń kulturalnych i festiwali, przez warsztaty i inicjatywy społeczne, po projekty edukacyjne i ekologiczne. Zależy nam na kimś, kto lubi organizować, potrafi dobrze planować i przede wszystkim jest samodzielny w działaniu. Szukamy osoby, której będziemy mogli powierzyć projekt, wiedząc, że zadba o jego przygotowanie, realizację i wszystkie szczegóły po drodze. Nie oznacza to oczywiście pracy w pojedynkę. Działamy zespołowo, wspieramy się i wspólnie szukamy najlepszych rozwiązań. Ważne jest jednak dla nas, żebyś potrafił/a przejąć inicjatywę, podejmować decyzje i doprowadzać rozpoczęte działania do końca. Twoje codzienne obowiązki: Samodzielne prowadzenie projektów Fundacji – od pomysłu i planowania po realizację i podsumowanie. Organizacja wydarzeń, warsztatów, spotkań i większych eventów, również od strony logistycznej i technicznej. Przygotowywanie harmonogramów, budżetów oraz czuwanie nad terminami. Współpraca z naszymi partnerami, podwykonawcami, artystami i instytucjami, z którymi razem działamy. Koordynowanie pracy osób zaangażowanych w poszczególne projekty. Bieżące prace organizacyjne – przygotowywanie ofert, zestawień, dokumentów i podsumowań. Dołącz do nas, jeśli: Posiadasz doświadczenie w samodzielnym prowadzeniu projektów i organizacji wydarzeń. Jesteś osobą samodzielną i odpowiedzialną. Potrafisz planować, ustalać priorytety i pilnować szczegółów, nie tracąc przy tym z oczu całego projektu. Dobrze komunikujesz się z ludźmi. Ważna jest dla nas zarówno współpraca wewnątrz zespołu, jak i umiejętność budowania dobrych relacji z partnerami Fundacji. Umiesz odnaleźć się w dynamicznych sytuacjach, reagować na zmiany i samodzielnie szukać rozwiązań. Swobodnie korzystasz z narzędzi AI, takich jak ChatGPT czy Claude. Zależy nam na osobie, która potrafi wykorzystywać nowe technologie w codziennej pracy, oszczędzać dzięki nim czas i pracować efektywniej. Posiadasz prawo jazdy kat. B i jesteś gotowy/a na wyjazdy związane z realizacją projektów. Dodatkowym atutem dla nas będzie: Doświadczenie w organizacji festiwali, koncertów. Doświadczenie we współpracy z organizacjami pozarządowymi, instytucjami publicznymi lub partnerami biznesowymi. Znajomość narzędzi do zarządzania projektami, np. Asana, Trello, Notion. Umiejętność przygotowywania i kontrolowania budżetów wydarzeń. Znajomość języka angielskiego umożliwiająca swobodną komunikację z partnerami. Co możemy zaoferować? Umowę o pracę od początku współpracy lub – jeśli preferujesz – inną formę zatrudnienia. W zależność od Twojego doświadczenia miesięczne wynagrodzenie 5000-5500 zł netto. Pracę przy ciekawych i bardzo różnorodnych projektach. Dużą samodzielność i wpływ na to, jak realizowane są poszczególne działania. Możliwość realizowania własnych pomysłów i proponowania nowych rozwiązań. Współpracę z ludźmi, którym zależy na tym, co robią. Przestrzeń do rozwoju, zdobywania nowych doświadczeń i współtworzenia inicjatyw, które mają znaczenie. W Veritas wierzymy, że praca to coś więcej niż obowiązki, dlatego stawiamy na Twój rozwój i codzienny komfort. Zdrowie i Balans : Prywatna opieka medyczna (LuxMed), karta Medicover Sport, PetHelp, firmowa sauna oraz dostęp do platformy Hedepy. Czas dla Ciebie : Dodatkowe 3 dni wolnego w roku oraz dzień wolny na urodziny. Aktywność w biurze : Joga, treningi funkcjonalne oraz świeże owoce i warzywa raz w tygodniu. Rozwój : Kursy językowe w biurze (angielski, niemiecki, hiszpański), warsztaty kreatywno-rozwojowe oraz wolontariat pracowniczy. Atmosfera : Chill room (piłkarzyki, ping-pong, planszówki) i spotkania integracyjne. Szanujemy Twój czas, dlatego nasz proces rekrutacji jest krótki i przejrzysty. Po przesłaniu przez Ciebie CV, odezwiemy się telefonicznie, a kolejnym krokiem będzie spotkanie w naszym biurze. Po nim podejmiemy decyzję i wrócimy do Ciebie z odpowiedzią.

Doświadczenie w projektowaniu rozwiązań raportowych równolegle z powstawaniem procesów biznesowych. Dobra znajomość Power BI Service, w tym publikowania raportów, zarządzania workspace'ami, konfiguracji odświeżania danych, Row Level Security (RLS) oraz zarządzania uprawnieniami użytkowników. Dobra znajomość SQL. Dobra znajomość Power Automate, SharePoint, Microsoft Copilot oraz Microsoft Excel. Umiejętność analitycznego myślenia oraz samodzielnego projektowania rozwiązań raportowych. Umiejętność współpracy z użytkownikami biznesowymi i zbierania wymagań. Bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie min. B2. Mile widziane: Znajomość Git i/lub Azure DevOps. Znajomość Microsoft Fabric. Znajomość Databricks. Znajomość MS Access. Doświadczenie w optymalizacji modeli danych, zapytań SQL oraz kodu DAX. Znajomość zagadnień związanych z wydajnością raportów Power BI. Ciekawość AI, automatyzacji i praktycznego wykorzystania technologii w biznesie. Znajomość podstaw Pythona. items.desc: Company Description Company Description NielsenIQ is a global measurement and data analytics company that provides the most complete and trusted view available of consumers and markets worldwide. We provide consumer packaged goods manufacturers/fast-moving consumer goods and retailers with accurate, actionable information and insights and a complete picture of the complex and changing marketplace that companies need to innovate and grow. Our approach marries proprietary NielsenIQ data with other data sources to help clients around the world understand what’s happening now, what’s happening next, and how to best act on this knowledge. Job Description Job Purpose This role covers the activities post inputs are received from the source - retailers/vendors. Primary focus is to be the bridge between the Supplier Engagement team and other Ops pillars. System change surveys, BAU query resolution, MSD tickets tracking and closure, KPIs reporting, productivity initiatives, RCAs are the key areas of work for this team. Apart from this, the team is also responsible to analyze, classify and management of the data. This role is accountable for handling data queries arising from BAU quality checks (RAP & DQI scoring). Job Responsibilities Retailer Onboarding and Engagement: Collaborate with the Supplier Engagement Lead on retailer onboarding. Ensure compliance for received data by working closely with retailers and NielsenIQ teams. Track retailer or vendor data quality and conduct regular reviews with internal stakeholders and retailers. Drive specific quality improvement goals for retailers, including change management related to data receipt. Handle large data sets with exposure to multiple formats and TLog data. Understanding of SAP, transactional data handling, FTP, and MFT setup and maintenance. Ability to extract, transform, load, and clean large data sets from multiple sources. Familiarity with managing, querying, and aggregating large data sets. System Change and Data Corrections: Plan and follow up on operational activities. Address data corrections due to MSD or other data errors through retailer discussions and planning with Ops. Track and resolve MSD tickets. Collaborate with INS team on results of eDive for System change. Stakeholder Management & BAU Collaboration and Communication: Act as the internal SPOC for Ops and regional leadership teams. Provide updates on KPIs, market progress on retailer onboarding, BAU KPIs, and productivity initiatives. (internal SPOC for Ops) Communicate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve data issues. Provide timely updates and visibility to stakeholders. Contact data providers via email if data has not been received as per SLAs. Communicate with data providers on any discrepancies found in initial data checks, FoVa reports, shop usability, or other factory processes. Handle new store information and confirmation on store closures. Address new stores and closed store queries. Coordinate with Input Ops and Output for processing reissued data. Send relevant IO communications (internal) regarding new/closed stores, missing retailer data, estimation of retailer data, reissue of retailer data, store name changes, store mapping corrections, retailer expansion, and retailer data changes during BAU. Quality Assurance: Conduct quality checks, including eDive primary testing of data, and RAP scoring, eDive. Address data queries arising from quality checks. Opportunity Identification: Identify new operational efficient opportunities within existing retailers. Ops teams (NOC), and DA Analysts to realize these opportunities, consulting closely with the commercial or RV team as applicable. Role Requirements/Skills Qualifications - Technical: Experience with Python, FoxPro, and Cloud Platforms. Large data handling skills with exposure to multiple formats and TLog data. Understanding of SAP and transactional data handling. FTP and MFT setup and maintenance. Ability to extract, transform, load, and clean large data sets from multiple sources. Familiarity with managing, querying, and aggregating large data sets. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Proficient in complex business process modeling and data modeling concepts. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Access, Outlook, PowerPoint). Extensive knowledge in Retail, specifically in POS and supply chain. Understanding of factory processes. Extensive knowledge in Retail, specifically in POS and supply chain. Proficiency in developing Unix/Python queries. Qualifications - Skills: Master's Degree or technical institute degree/certificate in statistics or data analytics, or equivalent work experience. 3+ years of relevant professional work experience. Understanding of various data and file formats. Ability to interpret different data structures and mapping. We operate in nearly 30 countries in the world, hiring more than 55,000 employees.The Polish branch, as the Global Center of Excellence, operates in Katowice since 2007 and has been growing ever since. Currently, our team consists of around 1,000 specialists. Within the Digital Platform Services department, our teams specialize in areas such as cloud, operating systems, virtualization, databases, backup or storage, as well as networking and security. We also have 1st line support consultants who speak French and English, but also Italian, Spanish, Portuguese and German. The Application Services department is responsible for areas such as software development, data engineering, testing services, CRM, ITSM and ERP platform integrations, as well as application management for customers in Scandinavia, Benelux, France, Germany, Switzerland and the UK. Note that we can only offer cooperation to people who has EU citizenship, are located in Poland and are willing to commute to our office in Katowice, Poland Job Description We are looking for Infrastructure Engineer (Linux + VTOM) with French to join Sopra Steria Polska and become part of a team supporting the telecommunications sector. Responsibilities: Administration and maintenance of business applications for a French-speaking client, ensuring their stability, availability, and optimal performance. Monitoring application performance and proactively identifying issues to maintain high availability and reliability. Incident and problem management (2nd line support) , including troubleshooting and root cause analysis, with readiness to participate in an on-call rotation. Conducting application-level validation and verification activities related to client-requested changes and releases, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations. Client communication and coordination , providing timely updates and maintaining strong working relationships. Collaboration with cross-functional teams to support business needs and drive system improvements. Administration of environments based on Linux, and VTOM , leveraging hands-on technical experience. Providing support within a shift-based working model and participating in a rotating on-call schedule , including both weekday and weekend coverage. Qualifications Must have requirements: Knowledge of operating systems ( Linux ). Good knowledge of VTOM . Very good command of French (min. B1/B2) – daily communication with the client. Experience in application administration / application support. Hands-on experience in application monitoring and incident analysis. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Availability to work in a rotating shift pattern and participate in an on-call support schedule, including weekday and weekend coverage on a rotational basis. Availability to attend the office on a regular basis as part of a hybrid working arrangement. Additional Information What we offer: BENEFITS (UoP): Luxmed, Medicover Sport, Worksmile, educational platforms, languages learning platform, referral bonus, copyrights, life insurance, certifications (paid by the company), conferences, Tech Lunches, possibility to join our Communities (Project Management, Architecture, Security, Process Management, Leadership, AI and Cloud), local kindergarten. ADDITION: free parking, fresh fruits, workation. In case of questions, please contact the HR team. The recruitment process for this position consists of two stages: a short phone call with a recruiter (30 min max) one-hour long interview on Teams (with both general and technical questions) All information about salary range and its additional components will be provided during the 1st stage of recruitment process. Działa w nim dobrze znana Szkoła Tańca No Limits (jeśli nie znasz, czas nadrobić towarzyskie zaległości xD), Pixel - interaktywna podłoga led oraz całe spektrum aktywności, w których ludzie się ruszają, uczą, bawią i poznają. Szukamy specjalisty ds. klientów, atmosfery i organizacji No Limits Dla osoby, która kocha ludzi, ruch i działanie oraz nie boi się przyznać rodzinie, że jej stałą pracą jest branża rozrywkowa. Jeśli humor zawsze Ci dopisuje i szukasz pracy innej niż wszystkie – zapraszamy! Szukamy kogoś, kto będzie sercem tego miejsca. Kto wita ludzi z uśmiechem, zna ich imiona, wciąga nowe osoby do towarzystwa i sprawia, że każdy czuje się tu jak u siebie. Cytując klasyka (AI): “To nie jest recepcja, to nie jest obsługa klienta. To gospodarz całego miejsca”. Od razu uczciwie: tak, będziesz też za ladą, ale to nie jest typowa recepcja. Jeśli szukasz spokojnej pracy przy biurku z kawą i Excelem, to nie tutaj. U nas jest głośno, tłoczno i dużo się dzieje. I właśnie to kochamy Odnajdziesz się, jeśli: najlepiej się czujesz, gdy wokół są ludzie i coś się dzieje, zagadujesz pierwszy/a i lubisz rozkręcać towarzystwo, widzisz, co trzeba zrobić, i po prostu to robisz, bez czekania na polecenie, uwielbiasz działać, ruszać się i żartować, z lekkością polecasz rzeczy, które sam/a uważasz za fajne, umiesz wysłuchać i ogarnąć emocje, swoje i cudze, nie boisz się przemówić do grupy kilkunastu osób, ogarniasz komputer i internet, potrafisz podłączyć urządzenie i naprawić drobnostki, a jak czegoś nie wiesz, to się dowiadujesz, żarty żartami, ale zadania wykonasz sumiennie i do końca dbasz o miejsce jak o własny dom: światła, krzesła, dekoracje, porządek, dobrze czujesz się w zmianach i nie potrzebujesz, żeby wszystko było zawsze poukładane. Czym się zajmiesz: budowaniem atmosfery: zagadniesz kogoś na holu, wpadniesz zagrać z dziećmi w Pixela, zrobisz coś miłego dla kumpeli z pracy kompleksową obsługą kursantek i kursantów – sprzedaż karnetów, obsługa czytników kart sportowych i szybką wymianą najnowszych plotek ze świata tańca, graniem w nowe gry na Pixelu i tworzeniem easter eggs, doradzaniem i polecaniem zajęć, wydarzeń i usług, przygotowaniem przestrzeni do zajęć i eventów - np. światła do nagrywki Twerku, dekoracje urodzinowe lub krzesła dla słuchaczy poezji, obsługą naszych systemów i prostych spraw technicznych, Oferujemy: umowę zlecenie, na start 120h miesięcznie, stawkę 3960-4300 zł brutto(120h), 5200-5700zł brutto (160h) - mocno zależne od doświadczenia, pracę w miejscu pełnym energii i ludzi z pasją, realny wpływ na to, jak wygląda No Limits, karnety na zajęcia taneczne, pole dance i warsztaty, darmowa sala na wynajem, ta z Pixelem też, kawę. po prostu elastyczny grafik (pracujemy popołudniami w tygodniu i całe weekendy, min. 2 weekendy to warunek konieczny) rozwój, rozwój, rozwój - szkolimy się często, na bieżąco feedbackujemy, a zadania dobieramy wg talentów gallupa. Robimy też wyjazdy szkoleniowo-rekreacyjne (if you know what i mean) Jedno jeszcze: pracujemy sprawnie i stawiamy na rozwiązania. W szukaniu dziury w całym mamy już wprawę, więcej osób do tego nie potrzebujemy. Szukamy kogoś, kto zamiast „to nie działa” powie „ogarnę to”. Wybierzemy osoby chcące na dłużej zaangażować się w rozwój firmy i tworzenie zespołu. Polubimy się, a nasz styl pracy będzie spójny - dostaniesz awans, podwyżkę i przedłużenie umowy. Jak aplikować : Wyślij CV na praca(a)nolimits.art.pl i dopisz 2–3 zdania: kiedy ostatnio wciągnąłeś/wciągnęłaś kogoś do zabawy albo rozkręciłeś/rozkręciłaś towarzystwo? Ta odpowiedź powie nam więcej niż CV. Wynagrodzenie: 3 900,00zł - 5 700,00zł miesięcznie (brutto) Świadczenia dodatkowe: Bony i paczki świąteczne Elastyczne godziny pracy Elastyczne godziny pracy Imprezy firmowe Program rozwoju zawodowego Zniżki pracownicze Miejsce pracy: Stacjonarna

Rolls-Royce is one of the most enduring and iconic brands in the world and has been at the forefront of innovation for over a century. We are proud to be a force for progress, powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere. This position will support, certify, and document storage and backup infrastructure, as well as serve as a Level 2 escalation point for existing infrastructure. This role must have strong communication and analytical skills. Responsible for automation of infrastructure tasks to reduce repetitive or time-consuming processes, utilizing SRE principles and practices and an infrastructure as code methodology. Demonstrate a high level of technical expertise to support complex Storage & Backup devices, including SAN, NAS and Backup solutions across all tiers, under minimal supervision. Be scheduled On-Call to support the infrastructure and our systems. Willingness to work on shift days (Sunday to Thursday or Tuesday to Saturday from 9:00AM to 6:00PM local time). Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering or related field is preferred. Preferred Qualifications: A keen interest in learning storage technologies and working in an infrastructure support role. Experience with UNIX (Linux, AIX, Solaris), VMware or other hypervisors, and Windows operating environments. Excellent oral and written communication skills and strong inter-personal skills. Strong ability to self-learn new storage technologies. Monitoring, Tuning, Troubleshooting, and root cause analysis. Strong organization and analysis skills. Strong focus on quality and customer service. Must be able to multitask and prioritize work. Strong analytical and practical problem solving skills. Experience of working in an infrastructure support role and/or a keen interest in learning the role of an infrastructure support engineer in the storage realm. An interest in scripting / coding for infrastructure automation. Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.
