In this role, you will work primarily with linear TV audience data to help stakeholders understand how channels and content are performing, and you will proactively identify opportunities to grow engagement. You will produce and analyse regular audience reports for The Walt Disney Company channels broadcast in Portugal, but the role goes beyond reporting: you will investigate trends and notable changes in the data, respond to ad hoc analysis requests and turn data into audience insights, tracking the performance KPIs that are instrumental to the success of the channels and the company. This position is part of the Programming department, which includes five key areas related to Channel Management: Content Production, Content Acquisition, Programming, Scheduling and Research. You will join the Research team. You’ll join a team grounded in our Disney values — acting with Integrity, welcoming everyone through Inclusion, embracing boundless Creativity, working together through Collaboration and caring deeply for our Community. These values shape how we work and how we support one another every day. This role will be based in our Lisbon office, 4 days a week, with either a Monday or Friday working from home. This is a 6 month fixed term contract. What You Will Do Produce, update and analyse detailed audience reports (local overnight, weekly and monthly) for linear channels, tracking key performance indicators and trends across programs and dayparts Lead ad hoc analyses and respond to internal requests on channel and program performance, proactively investigating trends and notable changes in the data to identify key result drivers, generate audience insights and help define new content and channel strategies for ongoing improvement Collaborate with Programming, Marketing, Creative, Ad Sales, Finance, and other stakeholders to translate audience data into clear insights and recommendations Drive the automation and optimization of reporting, analysis and research workflows by identifying and implementing opportunities to leverage data tools, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automation technologies, and dashboarding or business intelligence platforms, increasing efficiency, improving data accessibility and enhancing the team’s analytical capabilities Ensure high data quality and attention to detail in all reports and analyses, including consistency checks and timely delivery to internal partners Required Qualifications & Skills Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Statistics, Mathematics, Management or a related quantitative, business or media field, or equivalent professional experience Proven experience in a role where data analysis or media research is a core responsibility, ideally with linear TV or audience measurement data; experience producing insights rather than only reports, and handling ad hoc analytical requests, is a strong advantage Professional communication level in Portuguese and English. Spanish is a plus Expert-level Excel skills, plus strong proficiency in MS Office for data manipulation, reporting and presentation building Experience with Power BI and knowledge of or a clear interest in AI-based tools and data automation to make our ways of working more efficient Strong analytical skills and a high affinity for numbers, with genuine passion for TV, Media and Entertainment and the curiosity to identify meaningful patterns and insights in audience metrics Proactive, versatile and a true team player who can work independently with a high level of individual responsibility, manage multiple tasks and deadlines with strong attention to detail, and explain complex findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders The Walt Disney Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. items.desc: proSapient is a global Expert Network firm. We provide clients with rapid access to high-quality, relevant expert insights, through a combination of world-class client services and innovative AI technology. Whether it’s a private equity firm evaluating an investment or a consultancy business charting a new strategy, we connect these clients with industry experts who deliver the insights needed to make impactful, informed decisions. We are a venture capital-backed scale-up headquartered in London with a diverse, international presence across our offices in Lisbon, Toronto, and Raleigh. With a team of over 330 employees, we are one of the UK's fastest growing and most successful female co-founded businesses. You’ll receive a 25,000€ base salary , with 9,000€ in on-target commission , bringing your total on-target earnings to 34,000€ per year . And the best part? Commission is uncapped , so the more you achieve, the more you can earn. Please submit all applications in English. What is an Associate? As an Associate, your primary responsibility is to rapidly connect our clients (Private Equity & Consultancy firms) with top industry experts from around the globe. Our clients have high expectations, so if you excel in a fast-paced target-driven environment, proSapient could be the ideal place for you. After an intensive training period, you'll be honing and applying a variety of skills, including communication, sales, project management, and negotiation. You won't find a typical 9-to-5 here – we work with some of the world’s most respected investment and professional services firms, and sometimes the role will require going the extra mile and putting in extra hours. However, the rewards, uncapped commission and growth opportunities make it all worth it! The key duties of this role will include: Understand Client Briefs: Receive and understand various client briefs, conducting initial research into new industries, companies and business topics to ensure a good base level of understanding of your client’s needs. Your business and commercial understanding will grow exponentially. Expert Sourcing : Having understood the client brief, a large part of your day will be spent sourcing experts on a global scale by: 1) Utilising our AI-driven Platform as a key source to find potential matches from within our existing network and 2) Utilising professional networking sites and other online resources to source new experts to join our network. Expert Communication : Employing a mix (Calls, Emails, Messaging, etc...) of outbound methods to reach experts, you’ll then engage with and vet to evaluate their suitability for the brief. These interactions are fantastic opportunities to learn more about an industry, build your professional network and hone your negotiation skills. Project Management: Work closely with your team to meet project deadlines and exceed clients’ expectations. Requirements The drive to meet and exceed personal targets. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and taking ownership of your own success. A client-focused mindset, committed to surpassing client expectations and delivering true value through speed, quality and excellent service. A curious nature, enjoying the opportunity to learn about various industries and develop new skills. Enjoy working in a team and collaborating with others to achieve success. MUST be fluent in English and German (the ability to speak other languages is a plus). Benefits Generous uncapped commission scheme that is designed to encourage and reward over performance - the sky is the limit! Hybrid working (a minimum of 3 days in the office) On top of the hybrid working policy, you can enjoy the flexibility of working remotely for up to 20 days extra each year, allowing you to tailor your work environment to your needs and embrace a change of scenery. Growth Opportunities- At proSapient, your career growth is as dynamic as the role itself! We offer multiple paths for career development, allowing you to tailor your journey based on your skills and interests. Full health insurance through AdvanceCare (Once passed probationary period) Up to €9.60 meal voucher per day Enhanced Maternity & Paternity pay Enhanced sick pay (up to 10 days per year) Team outings - From quarterly gatherings to our annual Winter & Summer parties, we love to celebrate, collaborate and have fun together! Want to hear more? Look at our careers Notion page - https://prosapient.notion.site/Careers-at-proSapient-bfb1f316031b4dabbd9d40943cc4cc6f Next Steps... In the first stage, you’ll have an interview with a member of the Talent Team to discuss your background and how it aligns with the key skills required …

items.desc: FieldCore is looking for engaged and driven individuals with a passion for engineering to join our Field Engineering Program and Technical Field team based in Spain. GE Vernova is a planned, purpose-built global energy company that includes Power, Wind, and Electrification businesses and is supported by its accelerator businesses of Advanced Research, Consulting Services, and Financial Services. Building on over 130 years of experience tackling the world’s challenges, GE Vernova is uniquely positioned to help lead the energy transition by continuing to electrify the world while simultaneously working to decarbonize it. GE Vernova helps customers power economies and deliver electricity that is vital to health, safety, security, and improved quality of life. GE Vernova is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, U.S., with more than 80,000 employees across 100+ countries around the world. GE Vernova’s Gas Power business engineers advanced, efficient natural gas-powered technologies and services, along with decarbonization solutions that aim to help electrify a lower carbon future. You will gain hands on experience and grow your career whilst traveling the world to provide power to communities. Upon successful graduation from the Field Engineering Program , you will be eligible for a Technical Field Advisor position working on Steam Turbines . As a Technical Field Advisor for Steam Turbines , you will contribute to the management of site activities including planning, organizing, integrating, and monitoring of resources such as labour, tools and technical assist. You will make decisions, apply concepts to issues of great complexity, and resolve issues through immediate action or short-term planning at customer power generating facilities. Furthermore, you will perform hands on work and be responsible for the maintenance of Steam Turbines and some Gas Turbines. How You Will Make a Difference: Maintain strong safety mindset to assure the executed work reflects the technical requirements within GE safety standards. Manage, coordinate, and/or monitor Steam site activities Lead and manage on-site systems and equipment and ongoing preventive maintenance, repair, and calibration after installation. Respond to requests for emergency repairs and services to troublesome equipment. Provide technical instruction and work to company standards regarding operation, calibration, repair, and maintenance at customer's sites. Responsible for writing technical reports, preparing job status reports, reports to customers, time sheet and expense sheets on a complete timely and thorough basis. Drive customer satisfaction through commitment to quality. Prepare timely and accurate technical reports for customer records and a reference for future outages. Perform walk-downs to verify that contractors and craft personnel are working to company standards. Direct and manage aftermarket upgrades that need to be performed at the site level. Special Role Requirements: Able to travel extensively overseas to and from projects and various field assignments. Willing to work holidays, weekends and overtime as required by field assignments. Ability to spend considerable time away from home for training and field assignments Skills for Success You should be fluent in English, with strong technical competence and passion for engineering. You will also have: A strong ownership and work ethic. A desire to learn and problem solve. A positive can-do attitude with the ability to communicate with internal and external customers. A formal education and subsequent University Bachelor or Master’s degree in Engineering are nice to have, but we are most interested in your total experience and professional achievements. As Client Advisor , you will ensure that our client service expectations are exceeded in a personable, playful, and engaging way, enabling you to deliver your individual and team goals. Master and transmit our brand history and heritage. Highlight our product categories through your product knowledge and storytelling. Develop and grow your client book, updating client information on the relevant company tools. Profile What is important for the role: Proven experience in achieving individual goals and contributing to team results. Experience within a similar customer centric role. Deep interest in Fashion, Art, and Culture. Be naturally inclusive and open minded. Confident, service orientated, adaptable and empathetic in style and approach. Effective communication skills with the sensitivities to build and maintain a client portfolio. Results driven with a commercial mindset without compromising on the Team Player attitude. Fluent in Spanish and English; any other language will be considered a plus. Additional information About LOEWE Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise. At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best. LOEWE MAISON Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques. Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work. Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision. Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House. Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force. At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

items.desc: DESCRIPTION The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle. Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. What started as an encrypted email service has grown into an ecosystem of privacy-first products, including Proton Mail, VPN, Drive, Pass, and Calendar, used by millions of people worldwide. We're profitable, independent, and building for the long term. Free from venture capital control and advertising-driven business models, we focus on what matters most: our users. You'll work alongside talented, driven colleagues who challenge each other, take ownership, and care about getting things right. Explore our open-source projects. Whether you’re looking to take the next step in your career or already have experience leading complex technical projects, we’d love to hear from you. Take work through testing, release and improvement, paying attention to usability, performance and behaviour in production. Build effectively with agents: Define clear tasks, provide context and evaluate generated code. Investigate failures, challenge suggestions and make changes yourself when needed. Improve how software gets built: Turn recurring problems into better agent instructions, tests, tools and automated safeguards. Share improvements that help the whole team. Build for trust: Make privacy, security, reliability and maintainability part of your decisions. Verify important failure cases, communicate what remains uncertain and make sound trade-offs about release readiness. What you will bring: Experience delivering production software: You can explain the problems you solved, the decisions you made and what you learned from maintaining your work after release. Technical depth and adaptability: You have strong expertise in [discipline / relevant technologies] and can contribute beyond it. You don’t need equal expertise in every layer, but you understand how your work interacts with the wider system. Practical capability with coding agents: You’ve used agents to deliver working software and can explain how you guide them, improve unsuccessful approaches and verify their output. Code fluency and engineering judgement: You can navigate unfamiliar code, trace behaviour, diagnose problems and make precise changes. You can assess an implementation regardless of who — or what — wrote it. Product judgement: You connect technical choices to user needs, care about the quality of the experience and distinguish a useful reduction in scope from a shortcut that puts users at risk. Ownership and collaboration: You move work forward through uncertainty, explain trade-offs clearly, seek out expertise and take responsibility for the outcome. Technical leadership: You’ve led complex projects through ambiguous requirements, made decisions with lasting consequences and helped other engineers develop their judgement while remaining hands-on. A Great Team: Diverse, collaborative, and tight-knit, with people from MIT, Harvard, Stanford, Caltech, Cambridge, ETH, and more. Technology: The right hardware and software to do your best work. Learning & Development: We invest in your growth. Proton is one of the fastest ways to accelerate your career — real challenges, real ownership, from day one. The purpose of the role is twofold: to give the team greater access to data, whether through dashboards or KPI tracking, and to make day-to-day work easier through data-driven automation. What responsibilities and objectives will you have? Design, build and maintain automations that reduce manual work for the Customer Care team and its agents, and improve them continuously. Automate the processing of recurring, business-critical files such as claims files, leaving them ready for review. Handle ad-hoc data requests: pulling lists, cross-referencing sources and running one-off validations. Design, develop and maintain internal dashboards in Power BI. Contribute to Customer Care data tables and models, following the standards set by the international team. Represent Customer Care Iberia in cross-functional company projects, bringing the data perspective of the area. Well, what will the requirements be? Junior profile. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything, but for someone with a solid technical foundation and good judgement: when faced with a new problem, they come up with an approach, put it forward and see it through. Solid SQL and Python (PySpark). Microsoft environment, particularly Excel, SharePoint and Power Automate. Power BI for reporting and dashboards. Autonomy: the ability to take a loosely defined problem, find a way forward and propose a solution. Genuine interest in the business, not just the data: why something is being asked for and what it will be used for. Working level of English for day-to-day collaboration within an international team, and Spanish for working with the local Customer Care team. Nice to have: n8n or other workflow automation tools. What do we offer? Wellbeing programme Flexible working hours Online platform for lifelong learning Competitive salary Flexible remuneration services can be contracted Why join us? At InPost, you will play a key role in shaping how millions of customers interact with last-mile delivery solutions. You will work in a fast-growing, innovative environment where your contributions directly support the company’s expansion and market presence. Our culture is built around five key behaviours, driven by a strong “Go Go Go” mindset focused on speed and determination. CHAMPION THE CUSTOMER: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and strive to exceed expectations. OWN IT: We take responsibility, act with initiative, and proactively drive solutions. DARE TO DISRUPT: We embrace innovation, ambition, and continuous learning to grow and improve together. MAKE IT HAPPEN: We adapt quickly, learn constantly, and move forward with Smart execution. WIN TOGETHER: We achieve great results through collaboration, recognition, and a shared winning mindset. Inclusive Culture InPost has an Equal Opportunities Plan that promotes equality at all levels. We aim for equality in the company's workplaces, focused on promotion, as well as gender equality, diversity, equity and inclusion of people regardless of their abilities and conditions.

items.desc: Job Description: An opportunity for a Maintenance Program System Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid). At Airbus Defence and Space, we ensure the safety and reliability of the world’s most advanced military aircraft. The Maintenance Programs Department is responsible for securing Airworthiness Authority approval for the scheduled maintenance requirements of the A400M, A330 MRTT and C-295 fleets. Using the industry-leading MSG-3 methodology and the MRB process , we bridge the gap between aircraft design and operational safety. We act as a key technical link, collaborating directly with Operators and Airworthiness Authorities (such as EASA and INTA/CQC) through Maintenance Working Groups to define the Instruction for Continued Airworthiness (ICA). RESPONSIBILITIES As a Maintenance Program System Engineer, you will be at the heart of aircraft maintenance program development. Your mission will include: MSG-3 Analysis: Perform complex Systems MSG-3 analyses to define Scheduled Maintenance Requirements for our flagship aircraft (A400M, A330 MRTT/FSTA, C-295, and more). items.desc: At Locus Robotics, we build AI-powered systems and intelligent robots that keep global supply chains running. Our platform combines advanced AI, real-time decision-making, and autonomous robotics to help leading companies improve efficiency, scale operations, and adapt to constant change. Locus Robotics is a place to do meaningful work with real-world impact, where your ideas move quickly from concept to deployment. We invest in our people, encourage continuous learning, and give you the opportunity to grow your career while building technology that is used every day at global scale. As a Field Service Technician , you'll be on the front line of our robotics operations across Europe, keeping our technology performing at its best where it matters most: in our customers' warehouses.. Based in Spain, you'll travel throughout Spain and Europe to troubleshoot, repair, maintain, and optimize our robotic systems while building strong relationships with the customers who rely on them every day. This is a highly hands-on, customer-facing role with extensive regional travel throughout Spain and Europe, including overnight stays. Due to the field-based nature of the position, you'll need a valid driver's license and access to your own reliable vehicle for travel to customer locations. Depending on the destination, travel may also include trains, air travel, and other appropriate forms of transportation. Approved business travel expenses, including mileage and transportation costs, will be reimbursed in accordance with company policy. If you enjoy solving technical challenges, working directly with cutting-edge robotics, and want a role where no two days are the same, this is an opportunity to make a visible impact across our growing European customer network. Responsibilities Diagnostics and troubleshooting: Diagnose robot issues and proactively identify potential problems using Locus system applications. Perform on-site preventive maintenance for robots and charging stations. Troubleshoot and execute on-site repairs, including preparation and necessary equipment management. Conduct onsite testing and physical inspections of robots to diagnose root causes and perform necessary repairs and validation. Parts inventory management: Carry and maintain an appropriate inventory of robot spare parts, conduct regular inventory audits, and ensure accurate parts tracking. Manage and nurture on-site customer relationships, ensuring smooth and efficient robotic operations. Assist customers with handling non-hardware-related escalations on-site. Analyze robot data to identify early signs of component degradation. Maintain detailed records of work performed and ensure accuracy in documentation. Complete service reports and manage support tickets in Salesforce. Provide additional remote technical support and Return Material Authorization (RMA) activities as required. Qualifications Minimum of 1+ year of experience in a similar hands-on technical role or demonstrable technical aptitude. Robot-specific training will be provided. A valid driver's license. Proficient with mechanical hand tools and multimeters. Prior experience in electrical and/or mechanical troubleshooting. Basic understanding of Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and Outlook. Ability to lift, pull, and push up to 23 kg. Must have the ability to frequently bend, stoop, lift, walk, and reach as part of the job requirements. Maintains a strong work ethic and a consistent attendance record. Must be adaptable to working in warehouses that may or may not be climate controlled. Self-motivated, with a strong problem-solving ability in both independent and customer-facing scenarios. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with internal and external stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Must be authorized to work in Spain without sponsor today or in the future. Must be available to meet the travel requirement of up to 90%. The expected annual base salary range for this role is EUR 25,000 - 40,000 (based on external market data) plus bonus and equity. Actual offers will depend on factors such as the candidate's experience, education, training, key or critical skills, geographic location, and current market and business conditions Additional Information Locus Robotics is an equal opportunity employer. Application Fraud Detection Notice: To help maintain a fair and secure hiring process, Locus Robotics may use AI-assisted and other automated tools to detect suspected fraud, misrepresentation, or misuse of the application process. Hiring decisions are not made solely by automated means unless otherwise disclosed where required by law. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

items.desc: European Union Work type: Office/Remote Technical Level: Middle Job Category: Quality Control We are looking for a Middle QA Engineer to join our team! Our client is a large US-based provider of marketing, packaging, printing, and supply chain services, working with Fortune-level companies and employing tens of thousands of people worldwide. You will own establishing a reliable regression testing approach for an existing enterprise web application that is about to undergo a framework modernization. The role focuses on understanding business workflows, identifying critical functionality, designing comprehensive test scenarios, and ensuring existing system behaviour is preserved throughout the migration. You don't need to have prior test automation experience. However, you should be open to using AI-assisted tools to help introduce a basic level of automated testing, with support from the engineering team. Responsibilities: Take ownership of building and maintaining the regression testing approach for the existing application. Collaborate with the customer's team to reverse-engineer, analyze, and document critical business workflows and user scenarios. Explore the existing application, identify key functionality, edge cases, and undocumented business rules. Design and document regression, characterization (golden master), and exploratory test scenarios before major system changes are introduced. Perform manual API/HTTP testing and validate critical application functionality. With support from engineers and AI-assisted tools, introduce basic automated checks for selected critical workflows and APIs. Help integrate automated checks into Azure DevOps pipelines. Perform functional, regression, smoke, and security-related checks during release cycles. Support the customer's User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities. Analyze test failures, application logs, and stack traces to help identify and communicate potential issues. Work closely with developers and the Product Owner to clarify requirements and investigate unexpected behaviour. Maintain clear and structured QA documentation. Requirements: 4+ years of experience in Manual QA / Software Testing, primarily with web applications or backend systems. Strong understanding of software testing fundamentals and test design techniques. Practical experience designing and maintaining regression test suites, smoke tests, sanity checks, and release validation criteria. Ability to independently analyze business workflows, identify potential risks, and translate requirements into clear test cases and scenarios. Experience with exploratory testing and API testing. Good understanding of HTTP fundamentals, cookies, sessions, and typical web application architecture. Hands-on experience with API testing tools such as Postman, Insomnia, or curl. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and Azure DevOps (ADO), including running existing jobs, reviewing pipeline results, and investigating failures. Basic familiarity with application logs, stack traces, and build tools. Good communication and documentation skills. Upper-Intermediate+ level of English. Nice to Have: Basic experience with test automation or willingness to learn and introduce simple automated checks with the help of AI-assisted tools. Familiarity with Java-based testing tools and frameworks (JUnit / TestNG, Selenium / Selenide, REST Assured). Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot to generate basic test scripts or test skeletons, with the ability to review and validate the generated output. Experience testing applications during framework upgrades, platform modernization, or backend migrations. Familiarity with characterization testing, golden master testing, or other approaches to comparing application behaviour before and after changes. Experience working with legacy Java applications, Apache Tomcat, or servlet-based systems. Familiarity with XML, XSLT, or server-side rendering technologies. Basic understanding of application security and common OWASP vulnerabilities. We offer*: Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible A competitive salary and good compensation package Personalized career growth Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more) Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing Education reimbursement Memorable anniversary presents Corporate events and team buildings Other location-specific benefits not applicable for freelancers

items.title: Platform Engineer with focus on AI & Automation | SEB, Stockholm
items.card: You will help us improve how we operate our platforms by reducing manual work, strengthening observability and resilience, and exploring how AI and automation can make our operations more proactive and efficient. SEB is more than just a bank with an IT function. We are a progressive tech company powered by innovation and fueled by collaboration. From COBOL to AI and everything in between, we offer you an impressive
items.desc: We are looking for a curious and driven engineer who is passionate about AI, automation and modern platform engineering. You will help us improve how we operate our platforms by reducing manual work, strengthening observability and resilience, and exploring how AI and automation can make our operations more proactive and efficient. SEB is more than just a bank with an IT function. We are a progressive tech company powered by innovation and fueled by collaboration. From COBOL to AI and everything in between, we offer you an impressive tech stack and several technology paths. Together we're innovating for a sustainable society and building the tech arena of the future, a welcoming space for everyone. Are you ready to take on a new challenge? If so, you'll be interested in this opportunity! About the role As a Platform Engineer in our Shared Platforms team, you will work with critical technology and infrastructure supporting SEB's Fixed Income, Commodities, Equities, and Securities Lending business. The role combines hands-on platform engineering with continuous improvement. A key focus will be to help us evolve from reactive and manual operations toward automated, observable and resilient platforms, while introducing new technologies and modern engineering practices. You will work primarily with Windows-based platforms, while helping us develop our capabilities within AI-assisted operations, automation and observability. What you will be doing: Develop automation and tooling that reduce repetitive manual work and improve operational efficiency. Identify and implement practical uses of AI in engineering and operations, including troubleshooting, incident analysis, automation and operational knowledge management. Engineer and improve Windows-based platforms supporting critical trading services. Strengthen monitoring and observability to enable earlier detection and more proactive operations. Improve platform resilience through automation, standardized processes and, where applicable, automated remediation and self-healing capabilities. Collaborate with application teams, infrastructure teams and other technology functions to modernize and continuously improve our platforms. Contribute to the operation, maintenance and continuous improvement of critical platforms, including troubleshooting and incident resolution. To thrive in this role, we believe you have: Have experience with Windows Server and Windows platform engineering. Have software development and scripting skills and enjoy building automation and operational tooling. Have a strong interest in AI and how it can be applied to engineering and operations. Have experience with Git and modern development and automation practices. Understand APIs and system integration and how they can be used to automate end-to-end processes. Are passionate about improving operational resilience, automation and observability. Are curious, proactive and enjoy challenging manual ways of working and turning ideas into practical solutions. Experience with trading or financial technology, Front Arena, monitoring and observability platforms, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), cloud technologies or ITSM processes is an advantage, but not a requirement. What we offer: A modern, agile, and collaborative work environment. The opportunity to work at the intersection of technology and global financial markets. A culture that encourages innovation, experimentation, and continuous learning. The chance to help shape how AI and emerging technologies are used within SEB. A diverse and inclusive workplace where different perspectives are valued. Attractive compensation and access to SEB staff banking with exclusive benefits Remote working possibilities and flexible work schedule Do you want to be part of SEB? It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from. We encourage you to submit your application no later than 20th of December via the link in this advertisement. Kindly note that we do not accept applications via email. Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks. Learn more about working at SEB on our Career website or through our Career podcasts. sebgroup.com/career bit.ly/SEBcareer .

Arbetet innebär: att utveckla, förbättra och förvalta IT-lösningar utifrån kundernas behov och verksamhet att delta i och driva projekt som migreringar, införanden, modernisering och säkerhetsförbättringar att arbeta med incidenthantering, felsökning och teknisk problemlösning i komplexa miljöer att agera tekniskt stöd och rådgivande partner i kunddialoger att bygga långsiktiga relationer med kunder, både på plats och på distans Om dig Vi söker dig som har flerårig erfarenhet inom ett eller flera av våra kompetensområden och som är trygg i din tekniska förmåga. Du har djup kompetens inom ditt område, god förståelse för hur teknik stödjer verksamheten och en vilja att skapa verkligt värde för kund. Du är van att ta ansvar, driva ditt arbete framåt och skapa struktur även i komplexa sammanhang. Samtidigt trivs du i samarbetet med andra och delar gärna med dig av din kunskap. Vi tror att du inspireras av möjligheten att kombinera teknisk specialistroll, kundnära samarbete och konkret påverkan på lösningarna. Du talar och skriver svenska och engelska obehindrat. Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet inom ett eller flera av följande områden: AI Azure Entra ID Nätverk Power BI Power Platform Fortinet Säkerhet Microsoft 365 Intune Windows Linux macOS / OSX Det är meriterande om du även har erfarenhet av: Rådgivning i kunddialoger och tekniskt ansvar i leverans Design och vidareutveckling av moderna IT-miljöer Migreringar, transformation och förbättringsarbete i komplexa miljöer Automatisering, standardisering och effektivisering av IT-processer Din framtida arbetsgivare Nordlo är en ledande aktör inom moln och infrastruktur. Vi erbjuder skalbara driftlösningar och full outsourcing av IT- och digitaliseringstjänster till företag och offentliga verksamheter. Genom nära samarbete och med ansvarsfulla val av innovativ teknik hjälper vi våra kunder växa säkert och hållbart i en samtid som förändras varje dag. Nordlo omsätter 2,5 miljarder SEK, har ca 1000 anställda på orter över hela Sverige och stora delar av Norge. Nordlo strävar efter att skapa en inkluderade arbetsplats med branschens mest engagerade medarbetare. För oss är mångfald och inkludering avgörande för att driva innovation och tillväxt. Vi arbetar aktivt för att attrahera talanger med olika bakgrunder och skapa möjligheter för våra medarbetare att växa. "Är du vår nästa IT konsult? Tveka inte på att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Ansökningar hanteras löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag." Vill du veta mer om oss? Besök gärna nordlo.com där du kan läsa mer om vår verksamhet och våra medarbetare.

items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day Are you an experienced design engineer looking for a new challenge beyond traditional R&D work? In this role, you will be the technical link between R&D, our suppliers, and the supply chain organization. You will use your engineering background to support supplier qualifications, contribute to technical discussions on manufacturing solutions, and ensure that our design requirements are understood and fulfilled. This is a new role with opportunities to influence and shape how we work. With suppliers located around the world, international travel will be a natural part of your work. How You'll Make an Impact Represent R&D in technical discussions and qualifications of new and existing suppliers. Review and clarify technical requirements, drawings, and specifications together with suppliers and manufacturing teams. Support technical evaluations and assessments of supplier capabilities. Provide engineering support to Procurement, Supplier Quality, and internal manufacturing operations. Contribute to improvements in component design, manufacturing processes, and supplier qualification methods. What You Bring A B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field. Experience in mechanical design and product development within R&D. Experience working with 3D CAD, technical drawings, and manufacturing documentation. Good understanding of manufacturing processes and technical requirements. Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across different technical disciplines. Good communication skills in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing. Experience with manufacturing processes such as precision casting, machining, brazing, or coating is considered an advantage. We Believe You Are A curious and proactive engineer who enjoys working with people and exploring new technical challenges. You are comfortable taking responsibility, sharing your expertise, and building strong relationships with colleagues and suppliers. You enjoy combining engineering knowledge with a broader perspective on how components are manufactured and delivered. About the Team You will join our Turbine R&D team, responsible for the design and development of hot gas path components, including turbine blades and guide vanes, as well as turbine rotors for our SGT-600, SGT-700, SGT-750, and SGT-800 gas turbines. Our team combines deep technical expertise with an open and supportive atmosphere where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning are encouraged. Colleagues help each other and work together to solve technical challenges. Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers. items.desc: Join Telavox as a Network Engineer - Platform & Technical Enablement Are you a network engineer with solid routing fundamentals who also feels at home in a Linux shell? At Telavox, our infrastructure team is growing, and we’re looking for a Network Engineer to help scale and secure the backbone of our global communication services. More and more of our network runs on open-source routing software on standard servers, managed as code, alongside traditional network gear. You’ll join a highly skilled, collaborative team that likes automation-first thinking and continuous learning. If you want hard problems with real impact and enjoy working across teams, this role is for you. About the job As a Network Engineer at Telavox, you’ll play a key role in designing, building, and operating our core network infrastructure. That covers data center networking, edge PoPs, cloud native integrations, and infrastructure automation. You’ll work with experienced engineers who share a DevOps mindset and work with autonomy, quality, and speed. Your day-to-day work may include: Designing and implementing scalable network solutions, both on-prem and across distributed global environments Building and operating Linux-based routing alongside our existing network platforms Automating configuration, monitoring, and provisioning with tools like Ansible, Python, and Bash Expanding and maintaining our international edge network of PoP sites Managing our hybrid infrastructure and private cloud, with Kubernetes networking at the core Supporting our infrastructure APIs so product teams can self-serve Ensuring high availability and performance with OSPF, BGP, EVPN, VXLAN and WireGuard/IPsec Collaborating across product and platform teams to turn complex requirements into practical, robust infrastructure This role can be based in either our Malmö HQ or in our Stockholm office. About you You’re a systems thinker with deep networking expertise and a drive to simplify, automate, and scale. You’ve run production networks at scale and know Linux well enough to troubleshoot and build on it, whether you already route on Linux or want to go further in that direction. You’re structured in your approach but flexible in how you find solutions. Key skills and experience we’re looking for: Extensive experience designing and operating production-grade network environments Solid working knowledge of Linux and Linux networking Strong command of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), overlays (VXLAN, EVPN), and secure networking (WireGuard, IPsec) Comfortable with automation and scripting (Ansible, Python, Bash) Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as NetBox, Prometheus, and Grafana Good understanding of network segmentation, zero trust principles, and security practices for critical infrastructure Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset; you enjoy sharing knowledge across team boundaries Good to have: Experience running routing or packet forwarding on Linux with open-source software Experience with Juniper or similar carrier-grade platforms Hands-on experience with hypervisor and container-based workloads, especially Kubernetes on-prem Network or cloud certifications (JNCIE, CCNP, AWS, etc.) Join us at Telavox Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect. Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication. We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture. Read more about our new HQ in Malmö ! How to apply! At Telavox, we don’t focus on fitting in. We focus on making room for everyone, regardless of background, experience, or who you are. We’re always looking for great talent, and we review applications on an ongoing basis. If you’re excited about joining an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, we’d love to hear from you! Apply with your CV and cover letter in English. Please note that, in accordance with GDPR, we only accept applications through our recruitment system, not by email. For any questions, feel free to reach out to Hiring Manager Emil Nilsson at emil.nilsson@telavox.com Learn more about what we do! ️

items.desc: The Department of Neurobiology, Care Sciences and Society (NVS) conducts world leading research in aging, dementia, epidemiology and care sciences. This research extends from basic molecular and cell levels to clinical research and societal studies. NVS educates almost a third of KI students at basic and advanced levels. The Department has approximately 540 employees and a revenue 2025 of 580 million SEK. It comprises seven divisions, located at Campus Flemingsberg and Campus Solna. The Division of Neurogeriatrics consists of about 65 employees. The division conducts experimental and translational research related primarily to Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative diseases, but also more general molecular mechanisms with biomedical relevance are studied. The division is mainly located in BioClinicum, KI Campus Solna, and partially in Neo, KI Campus Flemingsberg. Do you want to contribute to improving human health? In Alzheimer's disease and ALS, proteins such as Tau and TDP-43 build up as aggregates that the cell's quality-control machinery fails to clear. The Ferrari lab, newly established at the Division of Neurogeriatrics, studies aggregates purified directly from patient tissue to understand how they escape this surveillance. As our first research assistant, you will help build the lab from the ground up and gain hands-on training in protein biochemistry with patient-derived material. Your mission We are looking for a motivated research assistant to join a new lab studying protein aggregates in neurodegenerative disease. Your main responsibilities will include: Purifying protein aggregates from patient-derived post-mortem tissue (Tau in Alzheimer's disease, TDP-43 in ALS) and assessing their quality Molecular cloning of expression constructs Expression and purification of recombinant proteins, including by chromatography (ÄKTA) Helping set up the new lab: ordering, inventory, equipment, standard operating procedures, safety documentation and record keeping, and teaching lab routines to master's students Introducing AI-assisted and automated workflows in the lab The position is a full-time (100%) fixed-term employment for 12 months, starting 1 March 2027 or according to agreement. Your profile The candidate we are looking for needs to have: A master's degree in a life science or chemical science, or a bachelor's degree in one of these fields together with at least one year of professional laboratory experience Hands-on experience of protein biochemistry from research or professional laboratory work (e.g. protein expression, SDS-PAGE, western blotting) Very good command of English, spoken and written (corresponding to at least level B2 in the CEFR) It is considered a strong merit if the candidate has: Experience of protein purification by chromatography (e.g. ÄKTA or similar systems) Experience of molecular cloning (e.g. Gibson assembly, Golden Gate, site-directed mutagenesis) Experience of using AI tools to automate tasks, applicable to laboratory workflows As a person, you are structured and quality-conscious: you plan and prioritise your work, keep to timelines and set high standards for accuracy. You have a strong ability to cooperate with others, and the stamina to stay motivated through setbacks until experiments deliver results. Training in handling patient-derived tissue and in sample preparation for mass spectrometry will be provided. What do we offer? Karolinska Institutet is also a state university, which entitles you to several good benefits through our collective agreement. And you get to practice freely in our modern wellness facilities, where trained staff are on site. items.desc: What we offer You will work in the project “HydroImpact: Hydrological Climate Impact Platform” (https://hydroimpact.org/), which is funded by the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) and Innosuisse through the BRIDGE Discovery funding scheme. HydroImpact aims to make targeted hydrological climate impact assessments widely accessible to practitioners and engineers in Europe by building a cloud-based platform that integrates state-of-the-art AI and hydrological modelling tools and follows a stakeholder co-design process. You will be part of the Hydrology Group at the Institute of Geography of the University of Bern, a small and collaborative team working on hydrological modelling and climate change impacts, among other topics. The group is closely connected to the Oeschger Centre for Climate Change Research (OCCR) and offers opportunities to engage with a wide range of hydrological methods and research approaches. The project involves close collaboration with researchers at WSL and ETH Zurich (Prof. Manuela Brunner) and the Swiss Data Science Center (SDSC) at EPFL (Prof. Mathieu Salzmann). This interdisciplinary environment offers opportunities for scientific exchange, collaboration and professional development. You will be supervised by Dr. Pascal Horton, who will coordinate the work in close collaboration with the project partners. Your tasks In close collaboration with other groups and project members, you will: Lead the development of a scalable, cloud-based platform integrating hydrological climate impact modelling workflows into a unified environment. Design and implement a modular platform architecture that enables users to configure, execute, monitor, and visualize hydrological simulations for different regions and applications. Containerize software components (e.g., using Docker) and deploy them on distributed cloud infrastructure. Implement workflow orchestration mechanisms to enable automated, parallel, and reproducible execution of modelling workflows. items.desc: Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default Founded in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN, Proton was built on the belief that privacy is a fundamental human right . What started as an encrypted email service has grown into an ecosystem of privacy-first products, including Proton Mail, VPN, Drive, Pass, and Calendar, used by millions of people worldwide. We're profitable, independent, and building for the long term. Free from venture capital control and advertising-driven business models, we focus on what matters most: our users. Our work helps protect digital freedom, from everyday privacy to supporting journalists and activists in challenging environments. Today, we're an international team of 700+ people, with offices across 9 countries. We have high standards for the people we hire and the work we do. You'll work alongside talented, driven colleagues who challenge each other, take ownership, and care about getting things right. Explore our open-source projects. You'll speak directly with customers, collaborate with Product and Design, and work across the parts of the stack needed to deliver a complete solution. What you will do: Understand and shape the problem: Work with Product, Design and customers to understand user needs, question assumptions and decide what is worth building. Own complete features: Turn problems into practical solutions across clients, services and data. Take work through testing, release and improvement, paying attention to usability, performance and behaviour in production. Build effectively with agents: Define clear tasks, provide context and evaluate generated code. Investigate failures, challenge suggestions and make changes yourself when needed. Improve how software gets built: Turn recurring problems into better agent instructions, tests, tools and automated safeguards. Share improvements that help the whole team. Build for trust: Make privacy, security, reliability and maintainability part of your decisions. Verify important failure cases, communicate what remains uncertain and make sound trade-offs about release readiness. What you will bring: Experience delivering production software: You can explain the problems you solved, the decisions you made and what you learned from maintaining your work after release. Technical depth and adaptability: You have strong expertise in [discipline / relevant technologies] and can contribute beyond it. You don't need equal expertise in every layer, but you understand how your work interacts with the wider system. Practical capability with coding agents: You've used agents to deliver working software and can explain how you guide them, improve unsuccessful approaches and verify their output. Code fluency and engineering judgement: You can navigate unfamiliar code, trace behaviour, diagnose problems and make precise changes. You can assess an implementation regardless of who — or what — wrote it. Product judgement: You connect technical choices to user needs, care about the quality of the experience and distinguish a useful reduction in scope from a shortcut that puts users at risk. Ownership and collaboration: You move work forward through uncertainty, explain trade-offs clearly, seek out expertise and take responsibility for the outcome. Technical leadership: You've led complex projects through ambiguous requirements, made decisions with lasting consequences and helped other engineers develop their judgement while remaining hands-on. What we offer: Work that Matters: Millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments. A Great Team: Diverse, collaborative, and tight-knit, with people from MIT, Harvard, Stanford, Caltech, Cambridge, ETH, and more. Technology: The right hardware and software to do your best work. Learning & Development: We invest in your growth. Proton is one of the fastest ways to accelerate your career — real challenges, real ownership, from day one. Employee Benefits: Strong health coverage, solid retirement options, generous leave, and wellness support. Stock Options: From day one, you have a real stake in what we're building. When Proton wins, you win. In-Person Collaboration: Offices across Geneva, Zürich, Barcelona, London, and more. You'll spend most of your time collaborating face-to-face. Food: Lunch and snacks on us every day in the office. Transport: We cover public transport, bike allowances, or parking — …

items.desc: An exciting opportunity has arisen to join the Specialist Antimicrobial Chemotherapy Unit (SACU) in Cardiff, delivering specialist services and supporting bacteriology laboratories throughout Wales. SACU is the antimicrobial resistance reference service for Wales, providing resistance mechanism detection, specialist antimicrobial susceptibility testing support, and therapeutic guidance to laboratories across the Welsh microbiology network. Alongside our reference laboratory services, we collaborate with academic institutions and commercial partners across Europe, acting as the central laboratory for clinical trials and research studies. These projects focus on antimicrobial resistance, infection management, and reducing unnecessary antibiotic use in primary care through the application of SACU's expertise in microbiology and resistance detection. The unit also supports the evaluation of novel antimicrobials and the validation of new diagnostic and commercial products. The successful candidate will join a supportive and innovative team where full training and mentorship will be provided. We are committed to professional development and will encourage and support you to develop specialist skills. As part of a friendly and experienced team, you will help support the detection, investigation and monitoring of antimicrobial resistance across Wales. As a Band 6 Biomedical Scientist, you will carry out a range of antimicrobial susceptibility testing (AST) methods, including disc diffusion, gradient strip MIC testing and broth microdilution. You will interpret results in line with EUCAST guidelines and contribute to the laboratory's growing molecular service, using techniques such as real-time PCR and whole genome sequencing (WGS). You will also help maintain the laboratory's UKAS ISO 15189:2022 accreditation by taking part in quality activities, including internal quality assurance (IQA), external quality assessment (EQA) and audits. We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic, organised and keen to learn. A flexible approach, good practical laboratory skills and the ability to work well as part of a team are important. You will be encouraged to share ideas, contribute to service improvements and play an active role in delivering a high-quality service for laboratories across the Welsh Microbiology Network. We are Public Health Wales – the national public health agency in Wales. Our purpose is ‘ Working together for a healthier Wales' . We exist to help everyone in Wales live longer, healthier, happier lives. Together with our partners, we work to increase healthy life expectancy, improve health and well-being, and reduce inequalities for everyone in Wales, now and for future generations. Our teams work to prevent disease, protect health, and provide leadership, specialist services and public health expertise. We are the leading source of public health information, research and innovation in Wales. In a world facing complex health challenges, our work has never been so important. We are guided by our Values, 'Working together, with trust and respect, to make a difference'. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace that values equality and diversity. We welcome applications which represent the rich diversity of the communities we serve and are supportive of flexible working arrangements, including part time roles and job sharing. To find out more about working for us and the benefits we offer please visit https://phw.nhs.wales/careers/ For guidance on the application process, please visit https://phw.nhs.wales/working-for-us/applicant-information-and-guidance/ You will be able to find a full Job Description and Person Specification attached within the supporting documents or please click “Apply now” to view in Trac. items.desc: *** THIS VACANCY MAY BE CLOSED EARLY DUE TO THE HIGH VOLUME OF APPLICATIONS RECEIVED *** Are you looking for an exciting new challenge in a place to take your career to the next level? Would you like to join a friendly, progressive, innovative team and play a part in the transformation of pathology services across South Yorkshire and Bassetlaw? Do you want to work in a fully UKAS-accredited, modern laboratory environment where you can make a difference? An exciting opportunity has arisen for an Associate Practitioner based in the Department of Blood Sciences at Doncaster Royal Infirmary and Bassetlaw District General Hospital. The successful candidate will be required to undertake roles in specimen processing in the main laboratory, as well as a range of other duties including computer data entry and operation of laboratory equipment. The post will mainly be based at the Doncaster Royal Infirmary however the successful applicant will need to be flexible and able to work at the Bassetlaw site when required. The individual will be expected to work shifts covering 24/7. DBTH is one of five Trusts involved in the South Yorkshire and Bassetlaw (SYB) Pathology Network. A collaborative Network will also provide rewarding job and career opportunities for all staff. To deliver scientific/ technical procedures previously performed by healthcare scientist practitioners, under the direction of the responsible healthcare scientist practitioner. Assist in maintaining high scientific and technical standards. Promote and maintain a high standard of relevant education and training. Maintains clinical records in relation to activities carried out and may input/ interrogate test results of others. Ensure all procedures are performed efficiently within the assigned time and in accordance with established protocols to the required standards. Assist in monitoring quality standards and perform audit as required. To undertake appropriate ‘in service’ training over an extended period and complete training logs in all relevant areas of the department. You will be working for an organisation which values and respects all its staff and the community it serves. The Trust is a leader in the NHS and research sectors and provides excellent benefits for its staff. This includes commitments to professional development but also many policies to support employees in balancing their personal and professional lives. Recruiters: please do not call or email us regarding this role. Hybrid: three days a week in our Farringdon, London office. On-call: part of the role. On-call runs as a 24/7 rota spread across the engineering team, and you take your turn. Stack: AWS, Linux, containers, CI/CD and infrastructure as code. We run PHP and JavaScript applications across two platforms. Claude Code throughout. About Eventogy Eventogy is a UK event management SaaS company based in Farringdon, London. We are twenty years old, profitable and privately held. Our clients are global banks, law firms and large international enterprises in regulated sectors. The bar for what we ship is set by those customers, not by us. We are ISO 27001 and Cyber Essentials certified, and our clients check. The role This is a permanent role, and it has four parts. First, you are the go-to person for AWS. Our platforms run on it, and when something about the infrastructure needs deciding, building, fixing or explaining, it comes to you. Second, you make sure you are not the only person who knows. You teach the rest of the engineering team how the estate works, write it down, and build the runbooks that let them act without you. Third, you design and run a 24/7, 365-day on-call rota across the engineering team. That means the alerting, the escalation paths, the runbooks and the incident process, and you take your turn on it. Fourth, you own the security of the platform: protecting it, monitoring it, keeping it patched and leading the response when something goes wrong. Security is a headline part of this job, not a compliance side task. If you have been the only infrastructure person somewhere and liked it that way, this is not that job. Success here is a team that can run production without you in the room. One thing to know up front: we run two platforms, and they are at different stages. One is newly built to modern standards. The other is long established and carries much of our client base. Bringing the whole estate to the same standard is a priority for this role. If that kind of work interests you, read on. What you will do Own our AWS environments: design, build, secure and run the infrastructure behind multiple production platforms Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines so releases are fast, repeatable and safe Build monitoring, alerting and observability that catch problems before clients do Design and stand up a 24/7 on-call rota using the wider engineering team, including alert routing, escalation, runbooks and post-incident reviews Lead incident response when it matters, and make sure the fix and the lesson both land Run regular knowledge sharing: pairing, walkthroughs and documentation that bring other engineers up to speed on AWS and our infrastructure Keep our ISO 27001 controls current and produce the evidence our auditors and clients ask for Own backup, disaster recovery and resilience planning, and test it Keep AWS costs under control and know where the money goes Securing the platform Own platform security across the whole estate: protection, monitoring, patching and vulnerability management Build security into the release pipeline and into how we manage access, keys and secrets Lead the response to security incidents, and coordinate fixes for pen test findings Using AI Use AI to speed up infrastructure work: writing and reviewing Terraform, analysing logs and alerts, and drafting runbooks and post-incident reviews. Use AI to bring efficiency and data points to everyday tasks: drafting, summarising, analysing, and spotting patterns and trends. Share what works: help colleagues learn to use AI tools to the same high standard, and help shape how the team uses AI. Use AI responsibly: protect client data and follow our information security policies whenever you use AI tools. What success looks like First 30 days: a full security and resilience review of the estate, with the top risks ranked. First 90 days: platform protection and monitoring in place, patching current, and the on-call rota running across the team. First 6 months: disaster recovery tested, and the team able to run production without you. items.desc: Overview: Senior Information Security Engineer Milton Keynes (hybrid) There's a good chance a blue and yellow can with a little red top is sitting in your shed right now. You've probably never wondered who keeps the company behind it secure. We'd like that to be you. The formula took 40 attempts. We're not expecting you to perfect our security programme on the first try, but we are looking for someone who'll keep at it and knows where to start. WD-40 Company sells in more than 176 countries and territories with fewer than 700 people. That ratio sums up this job: a small team, a global footprint, and a lot of trust placed in each person. Why this role, why now We're growing our global cybersecurity team. You'll be our first security professional based in EMEA. It's a global role. You'll work closely with our Global Information Security Manager in San Diego to shape a shared strategy. You'll be the senior security voice for the whole business during your working day, including our Asia Pacific teams in the hours we share with them. The foundations are in place but not yet mature. You'll help decide what gets better first, then make it happen. UK work authorisation required — visa sponsorship not available Responsibilities: Lead global security operations during UK hours, for EMEA and Asia Pacific. You'll be the senior escalation point for our managed detection and response partner, directing investigations and response, and share on-call with the global team so no one handles a serious incident alone. Act as our senior technical advisor: spot emerging risks, capability gaps and new technology, and help shape the security strategy and roadmap with recommendations to our Global Information Security Manager. Make vulnerability management faster and smarter, prioritising by real-world risk and working with IT Operations to get fixes done. Lead the technical side of global compliance, with UK and EU front and centre: GDPR, emerging AI regulation, and whatever comes next. Turn global standards into controls and guidance local teams can follow, partnering with our Global Information Security Manager on governance. Review new systems, SaaS platforms and AI tools before they go live. Explain to the business, in plain English, what's fine, what needs changing, and why. Strengthen and set the standard for our Microsoft-heavy environment: Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Defender, Intune. Spot what could work better, make the case for it, and see it through. Pick up the small tickets as well as the big projects. We're a lean team, and nobody here is above the small stuff. A quick word about on-call You’ll share on-call with the rest of our global security team: one week on, then two weeks off. There’s no screen-watching. If something urgent comes up, our systems will call or text you, and you’ll log in within the hour. Thanks to strong protections and well-trained colleagues, after-hours alerts are rare: on average, about one every few months. We’d rather you hear about it now than find out later. Qualifications: Deep experience in cyber security, including in a senior engineering role, with real hands-on operations: incidents, vulnerabilities and hardening. Know UK and EU regulation (GDPR at minimum) and how to evidence controls for an audit, because you've done it. Are strong in Azure and Microsoft 365 security, deep enough to design and challenge configurations. We use CrowdStrike, Tenable, eSentire and Check Point. If you've used similar tools elsewhere, that's fine. We care that you know how to ride the bike, not which bike. Work well with little direction, find things out by talking to people, and hold your ground under pushback, while explaining risk in language a marketing manager understands. Use AI in your own work and have an informed view on how to secure it. Can be in our central Milton Keynes office 2–3 days a week. Have the right to work in the UK without sponsorship, now or in the future. Have a bachelor’s degree in IT, cybersecurity, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. Nice to have: CISSP (or working towards it), experience supporting APAC, AWS, scripting in PowerShell or Python.

items.desc: Job Overview About Us At BYOHM, our mission is to transform wastewater into a valuable resource through innovative Microbial Electrolysis Cell technology—a low-carbon, sustainable solution for wastewater treatment, energy recovery and hydrogen production. We are a close-knit, engineering-led team based in Coventry, with project and trial locations across the UK. As we progress from prototype development towards larger-scale deployment and commercialisation, our focus is on developing robust, manufacturable and scalable engineering systems that deliver meaningful environmental impact. The Role We are seeking a practical and technically capable Data Systems Engineer to maintain, develop and improve BYOHM's databases, data pipelines and associated software and IT infrastructure. Working within a small engineering-led team, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliable collection, processing, storage and visualisation of data from laboratory instrumentation, sensors and operational equipment. Desirable Skills and Experience - Experience with Grafana, Grafana Mimir or similar data visualisation and monitoring platforms. - Familiarity with cloud services such as Microsoft Azure, Azure Functions or AWS. - Experience with Neon PostgreSQL, InfluxDB or MongoDB. - Experience deploying and maintaining containerised applications using Docker or Podman. - Familiarity with IoT devices, sensors, data loggers and equipment connectivity. - Understanding of networking, DNS, remote access tools such as ngrok and basic IT troubleshooting. - Awareness of cybersecurity good practices, access controls and Cyber Essentials requirements. - Experience with database migrations, scripting and process automation.
