items.desc: We currently have an exciting opportunity for highly motivated and enthusiastic ACPs to work within DCHS General Practice Service at Castle Street Medical Centre. Are you an existing Advanced Clinical Practitioner with experience of General Practice? We are seeking highly motivated and experienced nurses or allied health professionals to join our existing team of Clinicians. A Band 8a position will be offered to candidates who have already completed an MSc in Advanced Practice (or equivalent) and who can demonstrate contemporary experience working at an advanced level within a relevant clinical environment. If you have a passion for life-long learning, enthusiasm for supporting the development needs of others, excellent communication skills and a commitment to continuous quality improvement we would love to hear from you! As an ACP you will: Provide clinical leadership, including direct clinical care, and advice on complex issues Establish a cohesive team approach for the General Practice Service. Support the Medical Team Leads and managers with audit, innovation, and performance management Assist in feedback for staff appraisals. You will apply advanced clinical expertise, levels of judgement, discretion and decision making to the provision of clinical care to care receivers within a variety of healthcare settings. They will exercise a high degree of autonomy through the application of advanced clinical skills in relation to the assessment, diagnosis, treatment and management of the care receivers (adults and children) within their clinical setting. You will lead and monitor improvements to quality of care through clinical audit, evidence-based practice, clinical supervision, teaching and supporting professional colleagues and the provision of skilled professional leadership. They will lead the implementation of relevant clinical guidelines into practice and contribute to the further development of the evidence base through research and audit. You will work within medical led models of care, alongside multi-professional colleagues. They will play a crucial role in improving care receiver treatment through timely assessment, referral, responsive intervention and anticipatory care planning. Our purpose is to provide community health services to a patient population of over one million people in Derbyshire and Derby, as part of Joined Up Care Derbyshire. We employ around 4,200 substantive staff, caring for patients in 11 community hospitals and more than 30 health centres, as well as in clinics, GP practices, schools, care homes and, increasingly, in people’s own homes and via virtual consultations. It is an exciting time to join primary care and community services as the national Ageing Well programme gathers pace. DCHS is working closely with the Primary Care Networks to transform the care of housebound and vulnerable people across Derbyshire through our Team-Up approach See Job Description attached for full details Working within medical-led models alongside multi-professional colleagues, you will play a crucial role in delivering timely assessment, referral, responsive intervention, and anticipatory care planning for a complex and dynamic caseload of adult and paediatric care receivers. Main Responsibilities Undertake first-line comprehensive clinical assessments for complex presentations using an extended scope of practice, advanced consultation, and physical assessment skills. Request, review, and interpret diagnostic investigations to formulate differential diagnoses and treatment plans. Review and initiate medicines via independent prescribing. Recognise deteriorating patients, implement early interventions, and manage long-term conditions, palliative/end-of-life care needs, and mental capacity/consent frameworks. Act as an acknowledged source of expertise, motivating and inspiring others to deliver excellent standards of care. Participate in clinical audit, research portfolios, and the implementation of evidence-based practice and guidelines. Provide mentorship, appraisals, and clinical supervision to support multi-disciplinary team members, students, and learners. Shape local services in alignment with national policies, integrated care systems, and quality standards. Monitor and challenge risk, evaluate workloads through audit and outcome measures, and promote a continuous learning culture.

items.desc: This is a Locum Consultant post. The remit of the postholder will be to work within the multi–disciplinary and the individual will be required to play an active role in the general workload of the Care Group while having a significant commitment to teaching and training of junior staff. The department undertakes histopathology (including frozen sections), cytopathology, and autopsy pathology. We recently transitioned to a new state ‑ of ‑ the ‑ art reporting system, BEAKER/EPIC, in October 2023. We are also in the process of implementing Digital Pathology reporting, fully integrated with BEAKER/EPIC. This development will enable opportunities for remote reporting and flexible working arrangements for all consultants. Although this role is based at PRUH, the PRUH and Denmark Hill histopathology departments frequently report cases across both sites. With the introduction of digital pathology, cross-site working will become standard practice over the coming year. As part of ongoing improvements to patient care, a Hub ‑ and ‑ Spoke model for laboratory services was implemented last year. This model integrates the laboratory services of King’s College Hospital (PRUH and Denmark Hill sites), Guy’s and St Thomas’ Hospital, and the Royal Brompton Hospital. The central Hub, located at Blackfriars, is where specimen processing takes place. The Spoke sites comprising the individual hospital Essential Services Laboratories (ESLs)are where consultants will be primarily based, ensuring the delivery of high ‑ quality patient care and supporting effective training for trainees. The Trust provides a full range of local and specialist services across its five sites. In June 2026, we launched our new strategy for 2026-31. Our vision is to transform healthcare, and we have agreed six strategic ambitions to help us improve care for patients, and the working lives of our staff. Our six strategic ambitions are delivering high-quality patient care ; creating a great place to work ; leading pioneering research, innovation and education ; building strong and successful partnerships ; providing timely and efficient care ; and ensuring long-term financial sustainability . We have also agreed four new organisational values – Caring, Collaborative, Inclusive, Innovative – and these underpin everything we do, and how our teams interact with the patients under our care. We are at a pivotal point in our history and we require individuals who are ready to join a highly professional team and make a real, lasting difference to our patients and our people. King’s is committed to delivering Sustainable Healthcare for All via our Green Plan. In line with national Greener NHS ambitions, we have set net zero carbon targets of 2040 for our NHS Carbon Footprint and 2045 for our NHS Carbon Footprint Plus. Everyone’s contribution is required in order to meet the goals set out in our Green Plan and we encourage all staff to work responsibly, minimising their contributions to the Trust’s carbon emissions, waste and pollution wherever possible. Facilities The department’s facilities include a surgical dissection station, a cryostat sectioning station, the histopathology and immunohistochemistry laboratories, the cytology laboratory, and a dedicated trainees’ room equipped with histopathology reference books. There is also a pathology seminar room used for multidisciplinary team meetings and teaching, equipped with a digital microscope and full video ‑ conferencing capability. The post holder will have their own office. A high ‑ quality microscope and personal computer will be provided, and Voice Recognition software is available to all clinicians for the efficient dictation of reports and correspondence. As part of the Digital Pathology implementation, all consultants are provided with dual monitors for both office and home use, as well as a laptop to support remote reporting. Surgical pathology The department processes approximately 20,000 surgical pathology requests per year. Case reviews for regular multidisciplinary team (MDT) meetings form an important component of the department’s internal quality control processes. Consultant Histopathologists actively participate in the relevant National External Quality Assurance (NEQA) schemes. Cytopathology The Cytopathology service handles approximately 2,100 non ‑ gynaecological and fine ‑ needle aspiration (FNA) specimens annually. There is no cervical cytology undertaken within the department. Autopsy Around 600 post ‑ mortem examinations are performed annually in the Mortuary, the majority of which are Coronial cases, with a smaller number of hospital autopsies. Participation in the Coronial autopsy service is optional for consultants.

items.desc: The University Hospitals of Morecambe Bay Foundation Trust (UHMBT) wants to provide sustainable high quality medical services that fit with the Better Care Together integrated model of care – high quality specialist hospital services wrapping around community based teams to deliver responsive specialist expertise within both acute hospital and community settings and helping to keep people well and to manage their long term conditions closer to home. We work as a multi-disciplinary team and you will have the opportunity to help improve our pathways of care for our patients at a time of exciting service review and development. As a Trust we actively support you to develop your knowledge and skills via our Annual Development Review programme and there is support for external courses. An exciting opportunity has arisen to join our rapidly developing and innovative podiatry team. In this role you will be responsible for delivering a high quality, accessible and timely evidence based service for patients. Based across the Morecambe Bay area, you will be responsible for the provision of care to the increased/high risk caseload. You will need to be an excellent communicator and able to work independently and confidently. We will consider newly qualified podiatrists in a developmental role (annex 21). Our primary focus is to deliver quality, patient-centred care which is evidenced based and sustainable for the future in an ever changing NHS landscape. To achieve this, we aim to give you the opportunity to develop your skills in a supportive, dynamic and varied environment. We have a strong commitment to staff development and service improvement and provide regular clinical supervision and in-service training. We operate from three main hospitals - Furness General Hospital (FGH) in Barrow, the Royal Lancaster Infirmary (RLI), and Westmorland General Hospital (WGH) in Kendal, as well as a number of community health care premises including Millom Hospital and GP Practice, Queen Victoria Hospital in Morecambe, and Ulverston Community Health Centre. FGH and the RLI have a range of General Hospital services, with full Emergency Departments, Critical/Coronary Care units and various Consultant-led services. WGH provides a range of General Hospital services, together with an Urgent Treatment Centre, that can help with a range of non-life threatening conditions such as broken bones and minor illnesses. All three main hospitals provide a range of planned care including outpatients, diagnostics, therapies, day case and inpatient surgery. In addition, a range of local outreach services and diagnostics are provided from community facilities across Morecambe Bay. To read more information about the advertised role, and the main job duties/responsibilities please open the Job Description and Person Specification located under the supporting documents heading. You can also read more information about University Hospitals of Morecambe Bay visiting our website https://www.uhmb.nhs.uk/

items.desc: Help us turn data into decisions At Nisbets, we want to make it easier for colleagues to find, trust and use the data they need to make good decisions. As our Data & BI Developer, you’ll have the opportunity to make a real difference to how we use data across the business. Working with colleagues across IT, Finance and other teams, you’ll take business questions and turn them into clear, useful insight through Power BI and our wider data estate. The underlying JD specifically combines analysis and report development with data quality, governance and user enablement. You won’t just be building dashboards. You’ll help improve existing reporting, reduce duplication, strengthen data quality and make our BI solutions easier for people to understand, maintain and trust. Where you’ll work The role is based at our Fourth Way office in Avonmouth, with hybrid working available following an initial training period. What you’ll get to work on You’ll have the chance to: Build and improve Power BI reports and dashboards that help colleagues make informed decisions. Work directly with stakeholders to understand the problem they’re trying to solve, not simply take a reporting request. Develop data models, measures and calculations using Power Query and DAX. Use SQL to explore, validate and reconcile data from business systems and the data warehouse. Find useful trends, exceptions and opportunities within data from a variety of sources. Improve data quality and help resolve recurring issues at source. Simplify and consolidate reporting, reducing duplication and improving consistency. Help shape better standards for reporting, governance, security and deployment. What you’ll bring We don’t expect you to know everything, but you’ll need a strong foundation in: Power BI, Power Query and DAX. SQL and relational databases. Data warehousing and dimensional data modelling, including star schemas, facts and dimensions. Turning business requirements into practical reporting and insight. Analysing and validating data, with a strong focus on accuracy. Communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues. Experience of Finance or commercially focused reporting, ETL/SSIS, Power Automate or AI-enabled analytics would be useful, but isn’t essential. About Us Nisbets is committed to providing equality of opportunity for all colleagues. We aim to ensure our workplaces are free from discrimination and that not only colleagues but also our potential future colleagues are treated fairly and with dignity and respect. Therefore, please inform us of any reasonable adjustments that we may need to make to the application or interview process. Here at Nisbets, we aim high and we dream big. From a one-man operation in 1983, to the UK’s market leader today – it’s always been our determination to hit whatever goal we set ourselves, no matter how big. And we’ve done it time and time again. We’re looking for experts. Passionate, forward thinkers who obsess about our customers as much as we do. We need strivers, trailblazers and problem solvers who are as determined to grow, develop and succeed as we are. We’re determined to take the next step. But we need your help to do it. It’s all about you. If you’re looking for a forward-thinking business on which to leave your mark; where your work is valued; Where you’ll test your skills and then develop them further than you thought you could - Nisbets is for you. You’ll be pushing the boundaries with us, day in day out. You’ll work in a fast-paced, ever changing environment. You’ll collaborate with a wide range of other experts around the business, bringing big ideas to life, and play a leading role in taking our journey to the next level. We are a business with heart. From the small indie diner to the Michelin-star restaurant, Nisbets deliver the equipment they need to excel. If you join our team you’ll be working in a family-owned business that isn’t afraid to let you grow. That understands the value of innovation. And that puts our impact on the environment, our commitment to ethical trading and our determination to being a fully transparent business at the forefront of all we do. items.desc: Mental Health Nurse/OT for Adult Eating Disorder Services Do you want to be a part of an award winning team? Then the Suffolk Adult Eating Disorder Team could be the team for you. Having just won the 2024 ‘Clinical team of the year award’ and been finalists at the National GP awards for ‘Community Mental Health improvement’ the Team are excited to offer you the opportunity to join them. We are looking for a motivated, empathetic, resilient individual with excellent communication skills who has a passion for working with individuals with eating disorders to join our team covering Suffolk and will be based in Bury St Edmunds. Our applicants will have experience working within eating disorders, and have mental health training. This opportunity comes at a time of excitement as we are involved in the evolution of a pilot scheme involving the Virtually Intensive Treatment team and Intensive community support. The Post holder will assess, clinically manage, co-ordinate care and treat adults with eating disorders. Working alongside other health care professionals including RMN’s, RGN’s, GP’s, Dieticians and consultant Psychiatrists in order to support services users within their recovery. If you would like to be part of our welcoming and supportive team then please do not hesitate to apply for this exciting chance to join us. You will be required to provide planned nursing care and risk assessment/ screening for patients within their care plan. Provide ongoing evaluation of patients’ needs and identify suitability for potential discharge in conjunction through caseload management and supervision. The successful candidate will have to initiate and attend patient centred reviews, case conferences and other meetings as required and be able to work within the multi-disciplinary team and to form working partnerships. You will have ongoing responsibility for the review of a patient’s care within the team setting and to prioritise and disseminate such information within the team. We will need you to understand and work within the requirements of the Mental Health Act (1983) and to be able to effectively organise your working day, making the best use of time, geographical distances and resources. Ensuring the best clinical practice, promoting the direct involvement of patients and carers in the development of their care plan is essential and to actively participate in training and education. We also need the successful candidate to comply with all Trust policies, guidelines and protocols with particular regard to community services. If you would like to be part of our journey to provide excellent care, then please do not hesitate to apply for this exciting chance to join us. Benefits included with this role are: - NHS pension a comprehensive in house & external training programmes career progression starting annual leave of 27 days per annum increasing to 33 days pa based on length of service (plus paid bank holidays) staff physio service NHS discounts and many more As part of NSFT we do encourage our team to learn, grow and develop. The team has a wealth of experience for in-house learning and where appropriate courses and development opportunities will be considered in line with the role that you will be providing. A full induction will be provided to the successful applicant. You will also be allocated to a Buddy to support your induction period. This is a great team to work for with friendly, supportive colleagues who all have a passion for providing the best service that we can. If this is what you want too, then we welcome your application to come and join us on our journey together Day to day the role will involve core duties some of which are listed below: Providing one to one treatment interventions both face to face and within the community and via online platforms such as Microsoft Teams. Establishing rapport, trust and clear goals with in order to help them recover and thrive Delivering evidenced based care in line with the Thrive model encouraging resilience, growth and personal responsibility to enable young people to reach their goals Please find attached our Job Description and Person Specification for more detail on your Key Accountabilities, then if you feel you have what it takes to make a difference and be part of our exciting and forward-thinking team, then please click APPLY! We look forward to hearing from you. Previous applicants need not apply * You will be required to undertake physical intervention training and remain trained in techniques, as required by role.*

items.desc: Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system. We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber. We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers. We are looking for a Test Automation Engineer with strong Python skills and hands-on experience in hardware and embedded systems testing to join our engineering team. You will work closely with hardware and embedded engineering teams to ensure our devices and their individual components are thoroughly tested through scalable, reliable, and repeatable automation processes. Responsibilities Develop and maintain automated testing frameworks and tools for hardware devices. Design, build, and maintain automated test rigs, test benches, and testing infrastructure. Develop scripts and utilities to automate hardware testing and validation processes. Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated hardware and embedded systems testing. Develop and execute automated test scenarios for device functionality, embedded components, and subsystems. Support embedded firmware testing and hardware-software integration validation. Integrate hardware testing into the overall engineering development and validation workflow. Collaborate closely with hardware and embedded engineers to define testing requirements and improve test coverage. Establish repeatable testing processes to support the development of new devices. Requirements Practical experience in hardware test automation, embedded systems testing, or testing physical devices. Strong proficiency in Python. Hands-on experience developing automated testing scripts, frameworks, or engineering tools. Experience building internal tools or utilities to support testing and engineering workflows. Ability to integrate Python-based automation with hardware interfaces and external equipment. Background in electronics, electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related technical field. Experience building or maintaining automated test rigs, test benches, or hardware testing environments. Understanding of embedded systems, device architecture, and hardware-software interactions. Experience testing embedded firmware, hardware components, or connected devices. Experience with hardware debugging and electronic measurement equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters). Experience with hardware-software integration testing. Benefits Competitive salary and eligibility for equity Biannual bonus scheme Fully expensed tech to match your needs Private health insurance Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees As we hire globally, benefits vary by location.

items.desc: Hungry for a challenge? That’s good, because at Just Eat Takeaway.com (JET) we have abundant opportunity or, as we say, everything is on the table. We are a leading global online food delivery marketplace. Our tech ecosystem connects millions of active customers with hundreds of thousands of connected partners in countries across the globe. Our mission? To empower every food moment around the world, whether it’s through customer service, coding or couriers. About this role: As a Product Designer within the Customer pillar, you'll be part of a UX team looking after the apps and websites our customers use to order their food globally. You’ll work with an empowered cross-functional team that prioritises using research and data to help understand the problem space, before moving through the design process to deliver engaging and user-friendly solutions. We are specifically looking for an AI-forward designer who leverages modern AI tools as a force multiplier—moving rapidly from concept to functional artifacts to accelerate visual exploration, prototyping, and delivery. We want to discover what our users will love as soon as we can. We like to explore user problems in-depth, speak with users regularly, and embrace modern, AI-assisted workflows to help us understand and meet user needs faster. You'll be part of a passionate UX team of 80+ UX designers, UI designers, product designers, service designers, researchers and writers across 7 countries. These are some of the key ingredients to the role: Focus on key user problems and come up with innovative solutions to those problems. Quickly yet thoroughly create process flows, user journeys, wireframes, visual design mock-ups, and AI-accelerated prototypes as needed to effectively conceptualise and communicate detailed interaction behaviours. Work across the entire product lifecycle from concept to delivery; creating documentation, wireframes, hi- & lo-fi prototypes, and pixel-perfect UI. Confidently integrate AI tools into your day-to-day workflow for rapid visual exploration, generative prototyping, and streamlining production tasks across web and mobile platforms. Collaborate with engineering & product management to build experiences and present your work to stakeholders. Collaborate on research alongside UX researchers, conducting usability studies and utilizing AI tools where appropriate to assist with synthesis and insights. What will you bring to the table? Experience in a product design role delivering UX&D work as part of a multi-disciplinary, cross-functional team. Hands-on experience designing and delivering user experiences across mobile app platforms (iOS/Android) or responsive web. Solid design fundamentals (layout, typography, color), high-fidelity prototyping skills (Figma, Axure, etc.), and familiarity working with established design systems. AI curiosity & practice: Hands-on experience or genuine enthusiasm for integrating AI tools (Figma AI tools, AI-prototyping, AI-assisted research synthesis, etc.) into your design workflow as a force multiplier to iterate faster and work smarter. Familiarity with collaborative design processes, including workshop facilitation, design sprints, and working alongside User Research. Good business awareness with the ability to articulate design decisions clearly to product managers, engineering teams, and stakeholders. A proactive approach to taking ownership, creatively solving problems, and contributing directly to business objectives. At JET, this is on the menu: Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment. Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth and about celebrating every aspect of our JETers. Thanks to them we stay one step ahead of the competition. Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day. What else is cooking? Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET morsels. Are you ready to take your seat? Apply now!

items.desc: Présentation de l'agence Service à compétence nationale et directement rattachée au Ministre des armées, l'Agence Ministérielle pour l’Intelligence Artificielle de Défense (AMIAD) est responsable de la mise en œuvre de la politique ministérielle en matière d'IA. Nous travaillons en collaboration avec toutes les entités du Ministère et sur de nombreux domaines d'activité (systèmes d’armes, opérations, renseignement, commandement, soutien et administration). D'ici 2027, nous nous appuierons sur plus de 300 collaborateurs, principalement au sein du pôle technique situé à Bruz, près de Rennes, mais également au sein du campus de l’Ecole Polytechnique pour les activités de recherche académique. Vous souhaitez donner du sens à votre activité ? Vous avez à cœur de contribuer à la montée en puissance de l’activité IA ministérielle et à la souveraineté de la France dans le domaine de l’IA pour soutenir les forces armées ? Vous recherchez un environnement de travail stimulant et innovant ? Alors postulez et rejoignez l’AMIAD, l’Agence Ministérielle pour l’IA de Défense. Vos missions En qualité d'ingénieur en IA sénior, au sein de la cellule « Spécialisation de modèles pour les données issues de Capteurs », dont la compétence porte sur le traitement de l’image (détection, reconnaissance, identification, localisation) et du signal (électromagnétique et acoustique), vous contribuerez au pilotage et à la réalisation technique des projets d’IA portant sur le traitement de l’image ou du signal selon votre appétence. A ce titre, vos principales missions seront les suivantes : Concevoir l’architecture technique d’un projet d’IA pour le traitement de données capteurs. Animer techniquement l’équipe projet, assurer la coordination avec l’échelon de pilotage (responsable produit) et vis-à-vis des instances de décision Être force de proposition sur l’organisation des projets et de l’agence Dans le cadre du rayonnement de l’agence, mener des actions de formation, de sensibilisation ou d’informations sur l’IA. Votre profil Titulaire d’un diplôme de niveau bac+5, vous avez au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans le domaine de l’IA, notamment dans le domaine du traitement d’image ou du traitement de signal. Fort de votre expérience, vous maîtrisez : Les méthodes modernes d’apprentissage profond, de génération d’image ou d'analyse du signal Les techniques de mise en production de modèles (conteneurisation, MLOps…) Le travail en équipe Eventuellement, vous connaissez également : Les techniques de fusion de données L’analyse de profondeur, de distance La détection de petits objets Autonome et passionné, vous savez communiquer et expliquer les solutions à différentes audiences en fonction de leurs enjeux propres. Vous témoignez d’un intérêt pour la gestion de projet et disposez de quelques outils méthodologiques. Nos avantages En rejoignant le ministère des Armées, vous accédez à de nombreux avantages : Restauration collective sur place avec contribution employeur ; protection sociale complémentaire Rythme de travail : 39 heures par semaine sur 5 jours - jours de congés : 25 - RTT : 23 – possibilité de télétravail jusqu’à 2 jours par semaine Deux lignes de bus STAR (80 et 90) desservent le site Stationnement sur le site Offres de formation tout au long du parcours professionnel, grâce à deux centres de formation et à une plateforme en lgine Prestations sociales, culturelles, de loisirs et de tourisme : rendez-vous sur le site www.igesa.fr Possibilité d’accès au parc de logement du ministère.

Pour y parvenir, la collaboration et la confiance sont essentielles. MBDA doit relever des défis uniques pour répondre aux besoins des forces armées face à de nouvelles menaces. Motivés par les challenges technologiques, nous repoussons les limites de l’innovation, de la science et de la technologie pour développer des solutions au meilleur niveau. items.desc: Delen Private Bank is gespecialiseerd in discretionair vermogensbeheer en vermogensplanning. Onze missie? Het vermogen van onze klanten op een actieve en doordachte manier beheren en plannen, met het oog op een evenwichtige groei en een vlotte overdracht naar de volgende generaties. Persoonlijk contact, een langetermijnvisie en een duurzame aanpak kenmerken onze filosofie. Groep Delen is actief in vijf landen en telt meer dan 1000 medewerkers. Ons team Onze IT-afdeling telt meer dan 180 medewerkers op een totaal van ongeveer 800 collega's in België. Delen Private Bank bouwt een intern Delen AI Platform — één beheerd platform waarop elke collega AI kan inzetten op basis van de eigen kennis van de bank en waarop elk team veilig AI-helpers kan bouwen. Het wordt aangeboden binnen Connect, de applicatie van de bank, draait op onze eigen infrastructuur (Red Hat OpenShift, on-premise) en heeft governance ingebouwd in de software: in lijn met de EU AI Act. Het platform wordt gebouwd door de AIHUB , een nieuw opgericht team met senior engineers. Jouw rol Jij bouwt het brein van het platform: de cognitive engine waar agents redeneren, retrieven en handelen. Het is een Python-service (FastAPI + LangChain/LangGraph) zonder publiek endpoint — ze aanvaardt enkel geauthenticeerde calls vanuit de control plane. Je implementeert de agent-orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation over de kennis van de bank in Elasticsearch, de guardrails die elke prompt en elk antwoord screenen, en de Delen-built AI gateway (opgebouwd op een open-source core) waarlangs al het modelverkeer naar een goedgekeurde roster stroomt. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Je bouwt de agent runtime uit en laat die verder evolueren: LangGraph-orchestration, agent type presets, tool-/skill-invocation, human-in-the-loop interrupts en durable state. Je bouwt de RAG-pipeline: hybrid retrieval (vector + keyword) over Elasticsearch, grounding met citations, en retrieval die rekening houdt met de entitlements van elke gebruiker. Je zorgt voor de hardening en het operationeel beheer van de AI gateway op zijn open-source core: provider routing, quota's gekoppeld aan entitlements, audit emission, streaming en DLP-aware routing op basis van dataclassificatie. Je implementeert de guardrails: input screening (prompt injection, PII, policy), output screening (leakage, groundedness) en bescherming tegen indirect injection via opgehaalde content. Je bouwt evaluatie in de workflow met LangSmith: datasets, regression tests voor prompts en agents, en de acceptance harness die de doorstroom naar productie bewaakt. Je werkt samen met de embedded AI-Lab architect om bewezen use-case-patterns naar het platform te migreren. Gewenste werkervaring en kwalificaties 3+ jaar ervaring in production Python backend engineering (FastAPI of vergelijkbaar), plus 1–2 jaar ervaring in het bouwen van LLM-applicaties waar echte gebruikers op vertrouwen. Hands-on ervaring met een agent-/orchestration-framework (LangChain/LangGraph, of een gelijkwaardig framework met bereidheid om over te schakelen), embeddings en vector search, prompt design en evaluatie. Inzicht in de security failure modes van LLM's (prompt injection, data leakage) en de bijhorende mitigation patterns. Ervaring met Elasticsearch of een andere production vector store; streaming APIs; containerised services. Ervaring in een gereguleerde sector is een troef; nieuwsgierigheid en evaluatiediscipline zijn een must. Masterdiploma in Computer Science, Informatics of Engineering. Talen: vloeiend Engels (werktaal); vloeiend Nederlands is een sterke troef (Frans is een pluspunt). Praktisch Contract van onbepaalde duur. Bij Delen Private Bank geloven we dat aanwezigheid op kantoor bijdraagt aan sterke samenwerking en betrokkenheid. Je werkt dagelijks vanuit ons kantoor in Antwerpen, met ruimte voor ad-hoc uitzonderingen wanneer nodig. Wij bieden Aantrekkelijke voorwaarden: je ontvangt een competitief salaris aangevuld met een uitgebreid pakket extralegale voordelen, zoals hospitalisatie- en ambulante verzekering, groepsverzekering, ecocheques, gsm met abonnement, optieplan, extra verlofdagen (bank holidays), Benefits at Work, restaurant met versbereide maaltijden, keuze uit bedrijfswagen of andere (mobiliteits)oplossingen via het mobiliteitsbudget. Ontwikkelkansen & intrapreneurship: jouw groei staat centraal. We luisteren naar je ambities en helpen je actief om stappen te zetten binnen onze organisatie. Via opleidingen, interne mobiliteit en intrapreneurship krijg je de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en nieuwe uitdagingen aan te gaan. Jij bent de architect van je loopbaan – wij zorgen voor de juiste ondersteuning. Persoonlijke aanpak: als familiebedrijf sinds 1936 geloven we in de kracht van een persoonlijke aanpak. Je werkt in een warme en betrokken omgeving waar je écht gezien wordt. Dankzij onze vlakke structuur zijn de lijnen kort en is de directie – inclusief de familie – bereikbaar en betrokken. Ideeën krijgen snel gehoor, …

items.desc: Role Join Citi’s Application, Platform and Engineering group and start your engineering career at the forefront of Generative AI. This is an exciting opportunity for an early-career Software Engineer to work alongside experienced engineers, product managers and AI specialists to build and support modern GenAI platforms and products used across the bank. Working with close guidance and mentorship from senior engineers, you’ll contribute to real-world engineering challenges while developing your skills across backend development, distributed systems, cloud-native technologies and LLM-based applications. You’ll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology, learn quickly and build experience that can shape a long-term career in AI and software engineering. We’re looking for candidates with around 1–2 years of software engineering experience, but we’re equally interested in strong graduates and early-career engineers who can demonstrate their ability through internships, academic projects, personal projects or other hands-on experience. Team You’ll join a growing technology team with a start-up mentality inside a global organisation. The team is focused on shaping the future of AI and engineering across Citi, bringing together talented engineers, product managers and subject-matter experts to turn ambitious ideas into real products. The team works across Generative AI, cloud-native architectures, modern application stacks, security, open source and the Kubernetes ecosystem. We’re highly collaborative, encourage engineers at every level to contribute ideas, and believe in learning through hands-on development, pair programming, experimentation and continuous iteration. As an early-career engineer, you’ll have access to experienced mentors and the opportunity to learn from engineers working on complex AI and distributed systems at scale. Key Responsibilities Contribute to the development and support of Generative AI platforms, services and applications. Build well-defined components of products and platforms, including CLIs, SDKs and supporting tooling. Write clean, tested, maintainable and well-documented code. Work primarily with modern backend technologies, including Golang or comparable languages. Collaborate with senior engineers, product managers and SMEs to understand requirements and deliver solutions. Participate in pair programming, code reviews and collaborative development practices. Contribute to design discussions and develop an understanding of distributed and scalable system design. Support the development and integration of LLM-based applications and GenAI capabilities. Investigate bugs, respond to feedback and help improve the reliability and performance of existing products. Develop an understanding of cloud-native technologies, containers and Kubernetes/OpenShift. Contribute to testing and validating changes as platforms and applications scale. Build your knowledge of GenAI through hands-on engineering, structured learning and mentorship. Work collaboratively with adjacent teams and communicate clearly on technical challenges and progress. Stay curious about emerging technologies and actively identify opportunities to improve how the team builds and delivers software. Skills & Experience Around 1–2 years of hands-on software engineering experience; internships, substantial academic projects and personal projects will also be considered. Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms and coding practices. Experience with Golang (Go) Basic understanding of React and TypeScript fundamentals. Understanding of REST APIs and how modern applications communicate. Basic exposure to Kubernetes, OpenShift or containerised applications. Familiarity with databases or data technologies such as MongoDB and Redis. Basic understanding of authentication concepts such as OAuth and JWT. Awareness of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI, with genuine enthusiasm to learn more. An interest in areas such as RAG, context retrieval, fine-tuning and LLM-based application development. Basic awareness of secure coding practices and modern application security. Exposure to CI/CD, monitoring or observability tools such as Grafana or ELK is advantageous but not essential. Exposure to ETL concepts, data pipelines, vector stores or AI infrastructure is advantageous but not expected. Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity and a proactive approach to learning. items.desc: Description de l'entreprise Rejoignez une entreprise au cœur des activités du Groupe BPCE, de ses évolutions et de son développement. Organe central du Groupe, BPCE assure la coordination, la cohérence et les synergies entre les différentes marques (Banque Populaire, Caisse d’Epargne, Natixis...). Les missions confiées à nos collaborateurs offrent une vision transversale des enjeux économiques et stratégiques du Groupe. BPCE Vie conçoit des solutions d’assurances de personnes (assurance vie, épargne, retraite, prévoyance individuelle, assurance des emprunteurs) pour les clients des réseaux bancaires du Groupe BPCE au premier rang desquels les Banques Populaires et les Caisses d’Epargne. BPCE Vie est une compagnie de BPCE Assurances, le pôle assurances du Groupe BPCE. Groupe coopératif de banque universelle, il est le deuxième acteur bancaire en France. Avec 100 000 collaborateurs, le Groupe BPCE est au service de 36 millions de clients. Intégrer BPCE Vie , c’est : devenir membre d’un collectif dynamique de 900 collaborateurs présents à Paris, Lille (Lezennes), Reims, Rennes (St-Grégoire) et Luxembourg ; rejoindre une entreprise engagée, notamment dans la transition énergétique ; contribuer, dans le cadre du plan stratégique BPCE 2030, au développement des métiers de l’assurance (assurances de personnes, assurance non vie) porté par le professionnalisme de nos équipes ; s’ouvrir de nouveaux horizons professionnels au sein d’un Groupe qui offre de multiples opportunités de carrière et accompagne ses collaborateurs dans une démarche apprenante. Notre ambition ? Offrir à nos équipes et nos clients le meilleur de la relation humaine et digitale dans un esprit exigeant, bienveillant et collaboratif. Poste et missions Rejoignez BPCE en tant que stagiaire de recherche en Data Science à partir du 1er trimestre 2027 ! Au sein de la Direction Intelligence de la donnée de BPCE Vie, le département Intelligence Artificielle conçoit et pilote des modèles d’IA au service des métiers de BPCE Vie. Les Large Language Models (LLM) offrent de nouvelles possibilités pour rechercher, expliquer et synthétiser des connaissances métier. Leur utilisation dans le domaine de l’assurance nécessite toutefois de maîtriser la fiabilité des réponses, leur ancrage dans les sources documentaires et les coûts d’inférence. Dans la continuité d’une première expérimentation, le stage visera à spécialiser un nouveau modèle de base par apprentissage supervisé (SFT), puis à optimiser ses réponses par GRPO. Le modèle obtenu, enrichi par un dispositif RAG sur une base documentaire assurantielle, servira ensuite d’enseignant pour distiller un modèle plus compact. Plusieurs stratégies de distillation hors politique et « on » politique seront étudiées et comparées. Les travaux porteront sur trois axes complémentaires : L’adaptation supervisée — SFT : spécialiser le modèle à partir d’exemples métier ; L’optimisation par GRPO : améliorer les réponses à l’aide de critères de récompense explicitement définis ; La distillation : transférer les capacités d’un modèle enseignant vers un modèle étudiant, afin de réduire les besoins en calcul et en mémoire. Le stage combinera lecture d’articles de recherche, développement en Python et évaluation dans l’environnement interne, avec des ressources GPU dans notre Google Cloud Platform. Les missions du stage Reprendre l’expérimentation et établir les références Analyser les travaux existants et identifier les éléments réutilisables, notamment les scripts, jeux de données déjà disponibles et à épurer et à intégrer les nouveaux jeux de données ; Réaliser un état de l’art ciblé sur l’adaptation et la distillation de LLM ; Sélectionner un nouveau modèle de base selon sa qualité, sa licence et les contraintes matérielles ; Adapter le modèle aux usages assurantiels Préparer des jeux de données d’entraînement et d’évaluation à partir de sources documentaires autorisées ; Mettre en œuvre une SFT, notamment avec LoRA; Expérimenter une optimisation par GRPO ; Définir et analyser les récompenses : exactitude, fidélité aux documents, respect des consignes et capacité à s’abstenir lorsque l’information manque. Expérimenter la distillation vers un modèle compact Étudier puis comparer une sélection de méthodes : Distillation hors politique à partir de réponses ou de distributions de probabilités produites à l’avance par le teacher ; Approches de type MOPD, avec un teacher unique enrichi par différentes configurations RAG, comme variante expérimentale à évaluer ; OPSD, selon la méthode et l’implémentation retenues à l’issue de l’étude bibliographique ; Distillation de préférences, à partir de réponses candidates évaluées par le teacher et de critères métier. Les expérimentations pourront inclure une supervision top-K avec prise en compte de la masse de probabilité restante, ainsi que des mécanismes de sélection des exemples selon la fiabilité du teacher. Évaluer et restituer les résultats Comparer la qualité des réponses avant et …

items.desc: Chez Alfa Laval Golbey, nous concevons et fabriquons des échangeurs thermiques de haute technologie utilisés dans les secteurs de l’énergie, du GNL et des industries de process. Notre savoir-faire reconnu en cryogénie nous permet d’accompagner des projets industriels majeurs à l’échelle internationale. Rejoindre notre site de Golbey, c’est intégrer un environnement industriel stimulant, au sein d’un groupe international innovant, engagé dans la performance durable et la transition énergétique. Quel est le poste ? Dans le cadre de la modernisation de sa méthode de dimensionnement des échangeurs à plaques et ailettes brasées en aluminium, Alfa Laval Golbey souhaite évaluer l’apport de méthodes de type Intelligence Artificielle / Machine Learning. Dans ce cadre, une première étape consistant à construire une base de données a d’ores et déjà été réalisée. Cette base de données contient la description des équipements à la fois d’un point de vue géométrique, mais aussi du point de vue des conditions de fonctionnement. Nous recherchons un stagiaire R&D (H/F) pour poursuivre cette démarche. Vos Missions Seront De Identifier les variables les plus explicatives pour prédire les caractéristiques géométriques des équipements Entrainer, sur la base de données existante, plusieurs modèles visant à prédire certaines caractéristiques géométriques des échangeurs lors de la phase de design de l’équipement Adapter et compléter la base de données pour améliorer la prédiction des modèles, que ce soit par l’ajout de nouvelles variables dans la base de données ou par l’estimation de nouvelles variables à partir de celles déjà disponibles (nombres adimensionnels, …) Ce stage permettra donc d’identifier clairement les apports et limites de telles méthodes, mais également celles associées à la base de données actuellement disponible. Ce travail contribuera au développement d’une nouvelle approche de dimensionnement des échangeurs de chaleur à plaques et ailettes brasées s’appuyant, d’une part, sur des approches physiques et, d’autre part, sur une approche « data » pour améliorer et accélérer le processus de conception en identifiant plus rapidement une géométrie adéquate. Une compréhension de l’approche physique et des échanges réguliers au sein de l’équipe permettront de conduire en parallèle ces deux axes de développement. Qui êtes-vous ? Que connaissez-vous ? Actuellement en Master 2, Ecole d’ingénieur ou équivalent, vous avez une orientation sur l’analyse de données, ou le Machine Learning. Des notions de thermiques et de mécanique des fluides seraient un peu plus pour mieux appréhender le fonctionnement de l’équipement et les relations entre les différentes informations stockées dans la base de données. Vous avez également une forte sensibilisation à l’Intelligence Artificielle, aux outils de Machine Learning et à Python. Votre capacité de communication et votre curiosité vous permettront de mener à bien cette mission. Durée du stage : 6 mois à partir de février ou mars 2027 Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Nous offrons un poste stimulant dans un environnement ouvert et convivial où nous nous aidons mutuellement à nous développer et à créer de la valeur. Votre travail aura un véritable impact sur le succès futur d’Alfa Laval. En nous rejoignant, vous intégrerez un groupe international qui vous donnera accès à de multiples opportunités d’évolution et de mobilité, et ce, dans de nombreux domaines professionnels, notamment grâce à nos programmes d’intégration et d’accompagnement, mais également sur le plan personnel. En effet, vous pourrez bénéficier d’un mode de travail hybride et de nombreux autres avantages mutuelle, restaurant d’entreprise, CE, accord d’intéressement et de participation, etc.

Tässä roolissa pääset mukaan AI-kehittämiseen, jossa organisaatio investoi merkittävästi omaan AI-infrastruktuuriin ja kielimallipalveluiden kehittämiseen. Toimit keskeisessä roolissa AI-palvelupäällikön ja teknisen tiimin kanssa vastaten siitä, että AI-alustan kapasiteetti muuttuu turvallisiksi, skaalautuviksi ja liiketoimintaa aidosti tukeviksi palveluiksi. Expertise et proximité pour EQUANS France, leader des services multi-techniques. La Division Transport d’EQUANS offre des solutions techniques innovantes pour accompagner la digitalisation et la décarbonisation des transports urbains et ferroviaires en France et dans le monde. Nous vous proposons de rejoindre l’Agence Grands Projets, experte dans le développement et le pilotage de projets complexes dans le domaine des transports urbains et ferroviaires. L’agence intervient à toutes les étapes clés des projets : réponse aux appels d’offres, études techniques et économiques puis conduite de projets de construction et de maintenance d’infrastructures ferroviaires et de transport urbain, en France et à l’international. Votre challenge à nos côtés : Dans le cadre des activités de l’agence Grands Projets / Division Transport Systèmes vous contribuez à la transformation digitale sur les aspects IA. A ce titre, vous contribuez au développement des cas d’usages IA s’inscrivant dans la la stratégie de l'entité Transport Systèmes Vos principales Missions : En collaboration avec le Chef de Projet IA de l’Agence Grands Projets / Transport Systèmes vous aurez pour mission de : Concevoir et industrialiser des agents IA et des prompts pour des cas d’usage métiers. EQUANS France s'engage à promouvoir la diversité, l’inclusion et à lutter contre toutes les formes de discriminations à l’accès à l'emploi, à la formation, à la promotion et plus largement dans nos environnements et cadres de travail. L’insertion, la mixité, le soutien et l’accompagnement des jeunes, des seniors, des personnes en situation de handicap sont des priorités essentielles de la politique ressources humaines. En savoir plus sur EQUANS France : Plus de 27 000 collaborateurs contribuent à l’aventure EQUANS France. items.desc: StraTech srl cerca un/una Software Developer per progetti di ricerca e sviluppo, AI applicata e integrazione di sistemi. Cerchiamo una persona con solide basi di sviluppo software, curiosità tecnologica e capacità di trasformare esigenze operative in soluzioni funzionanti. Entrerai nelle attività di ricerca e sviluppo dell’azienda e contribuirai anche all’evoluzione dei prodotti, realizzando applicazioni, servizi, automazioni e integrazioni tra piattaforme e dispositivi. Lavorerai con il team tecnico e con i partner di progetto, partecipando all’analisi dei requisiti, allo sviluppo, ai test e alla documentazione dei risultati. Apprezziamo chi sa proporre soluzioni, approfondire tecnologie nuove e seguire concretamente la risoluzione dei problemi. DI COSA TI OCCUPERAI • Sviluppare servizi backend, API e strumenti per acquisire, elaborare e visualizzare dati. • Integrare funzionalità AI nei software e verificarne il funzionamento su casi reali. • Collegare applicazioni, servizi esterni e, quando necessario, dispositivi. • Contribuire a prototipi, sperimentazioni, collaudi e documentazione tecnica dei progetti di ricerca e sviluppo svolti in partenariato. • Supportare gli altri progetti aziendali con nuove funzionalità, automazioni e miglioramenti. COSA CERCHIAMO • Esperienza concreta nello sviluppo software e buona autonomia su almeno uno stack tecnologico; è particolarmente apprezzata la conoscenza di Python per servizi, dati e automazioni. • Familiarità con API REST, database SQL, Git e debugging. • Capacità di lavorare su codice esistente, eseguire test e documentare le soluzioni. • Attitudine pratica, collaborazione e capacità di apprendere strumenti nuovi. COMPETENZE CHE COSTITUISCONO UN PLUS • AI applicata, elaborazione di immagini o computer vision. • Sviluppo web e dashboard. • Sviluppo Android con Kotlin. • Linux, Docker e distribuzione di servizi. • IoT, sensori, telecamere IP, Raspberry Pi/Jetson, reti o elettronica di base. Non è necessario possedere tutte le competenze preferenziali. Le conoscenze hardware sono apprezzate ma non costituiscono un requisito obbligatorio. ESPERIENZA Il ruolo è pensato per una persona già operativa, indicativamente con 2–5 anni di esperienza. Valutiamo soprattutto l’autonomia e la qualità dei progetti realizzati. CANDIDATURA Invia il tuo CV e, se disponibili, un portfolio, un profilo GitHub o una breve descrizione di uno o due progetti a cui hai contribuito, specificando il tuo ruolo e le tecnologie utilizzate. La selezione è aperta a tutte le persone con competenze coerenti con il ruolo.

items.desc: We are looking for an AI Engineer to build and improve the AI experiences across our education platform, including personalised tutoring, test preparation, college guidance, research and writing support. This is a hands-on engineering role with a substantial focus on prompt development and tuning. You will translate educational and product requirements into dependable AI behaviour, build the services and agent workflows behind it, and take changes from experimentation through to production. You will work closely with the CTO, product team, subject specialists and software engineers. Responsibilities Prompt engineering and tuning Own extensive prompt development, testing and continuous refinement across our AI features, improving accuracy, relevance, clarity, tone and consistency. Design system prompts, reusable templates, few-shot examples, tool instructions and structured output schemas. Refine how agents ask questions, explain concepts, provide feedback and guide students through tasks. Manage the context supplied to models, including conversation history, learner profiles, activity, current workspace and relevant documents or school information. Analyse real conversations and feedback with product and education specialists. Turn ambiguous requirements and recurring failure cases into measurable improvements. AI agents and application engineering Build and maintain Python services, conversational agents and workflows that use tools, retrieve information, generate reports and take authorised actions through platform APIs. Integrate LLM providers and supporting services; evaluate model choices and configure routing, token budgets, streaming and fallbacks. Develop retrieval and grounding approaches that give AI responses the relevant information and preserve source attribution where needed. Connect AI workflows to learner state, task management and platform events. Implement explicit business rules, permissions and reliable execution for actions that change user data. Evaluation and production quality Build evaluation datasets and automated prompt regression tests covering answer quality, educational usefulness, factual accuracy, tool use and multi-turn behaviour. Version prompts and model configurations, compare changes against a baseline, and document results so releases can be reviewed and reproduced. Investigate production failures and improve observability, error handling, retries and recovery. Monitor latency, token usage, cost and task completion. Test prompt injection, inappropriate requests and other adversarial inputs. Implement guardrails and appropriate uncertainty handling for a platform used by students. Requirements Strong Python engineering skills and experience building, testing and maintaining production services and APIs. Practical experience shipping LLM applications, with examples of substantial prompt tuning and evidence of how you measured improvements. Experience with tool calling, structured outputs, conversational state, context management and agent orchestration. An understanding of retrieval, embeddings and grounding, and when these approaches help solve a product problem. A systematic approach to evaluation and debugging, including the ability to distinguish prompt failures from data, model, integration or application issues. Strong written English and the ability to turn complex product and educational requirements into precise instructions and clear technical decisions. Ownership of delivery, sound judgement about quality, latency and cost, and effective collaboration with technical and non-technical colleagues. Nice to have Voice, image or other multimodal AI experiences; model fine-tuning or small-model classification and routing. TypeScript, event-driven systems, cloud deployment, Docker and AI evaluation or observability tooling. Education technology, AI tutoring, assessment, feedback generation or personalised learning. We offer Professional growth opportunities and career prospects 25 days plus public holidays and standard employer contribution depending on location. Any subscription you want - Claude Max, ChatGPT Pro, whatever your stack needs. About Dakota Dakota.Education is building the world's most exciting new education brand. We make AI-native products that teach K–12 students to read, write and think, and help US high schoolers prep for the SAT and write college essays that sound like them. We've partnered with Penguin Random House, HarperCollins and MIT Technology Review. Our advisors come from College Board, ACT, Stanford and Dartmouth. We're a Google Accelerator alumna. We have a clear, opinionated view: the answer to the reading recession and the college admissions arms race isn't another app - it's an education company, built for this moment. We believe AI, built right, can help any student reach their outcomes and their dreams without offloading the thinking — uplevelling them rather than replacing them. Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un profil AI Engineer confirmé, appelé à rejoindre une équipe dynamique de 22 membres composée de Data Engineers, d'Experts IA, de développeurs FullStack et de chefs de projets, organisée en trois équipes dont l'équipe Data & Proximité, en charge du développement de solutions tactiques front/back. La mission s'inscrit dans un environnement technique riche et challengeant, où les méthodologies Scrum et Kanban sont appliquées selon les projets, toujours en proximité directe avec les équipes métier. Le candidat retenu sera rattaché au responsable de l'équipe de développements tactiques et accompagné par un membre de l'équipe maîtrisant les outils de data science. Il sera fréquemment en contact avec les équipes métier, les équipes innovation et d'autres développeurs. L'environnement de travail offre des opportunités d'apprentissage continu, notamment via la plateforme interne NOVA, une plateforme no-code d'orchestration d'agents IA permettant de construire rapidement des solutions combinant IA générative, RAG, NLU, workflows et intégration au SI, sur laquelle le candidat sera accompagné pour monter en compétence. La mission porte dans un premier temps sur deux projets menés pour la direction des risques : le projet RACI, visant à assister la rédaction du Rapport Annuel de Contrôles Internes, et le projet Risk Eye Check, visant à industrialiser et fiabiliser le contrôle de conformité des politiques locales des établissements par rapport aux politiques Groupe. Responsabilités Développer et expérimenter de nouvelles stratégies d'extraction, notamment en s'orientant vers une approche agentique (boucles itératives d'extraction, mécanismes d'auto-vérification, relances conditionnelles) pour réduire la dépendance à la validation humaine. Faire évoluer et optimiser les pipelines d'extraction IA existants (parsing PDF, VLM, pipelines multi-étapes) afin d'améliorer le taux de détection des indicateurs financiers. Contribuer à la stratégie de combinaison et de consensus multi-pipelines, en testant de nouvelles combinaisons et en mesurant leur impact sur la qualité globale du système. Collaborer étroitement avec les Product Owners, les autres membres de l'équipe technique et les équipes métier afin de garantir l'adéquation des solutions développées avec les besoins exprimés. Développer des outils en mode commando et en proximité directe avec le métier, incluant potentiellement la mise en œuvre de solutions faisant appel à de l'IA générative. Accompagner et industrialiser ces solutions dans le parc applicatif des DSI Filières. Proposer la mise en œuvre de solutions innovantes au travers d'un processus de veille technologique et d'études d'opportunités. Participer à des événements internes et externes concernant la data et l'IA. Collaborer sur d'autres projets d'IA générative, RAG et génération de rapports. Télétravail : Occasionnel Localisation : Paris, France PROFIL RECHERCHÉ Indispensables Maîtrise avancée de Python, notamment pour la conception de pipelines de traitement parallèle, indispensable à la réalisation de l'ensemble des développements de la mission. Connaissances approfondies en Intelligence Artificielle générative et en Large Language Models (LLM), en particulier dans le cadre de pipelines d'extraction d'information à partir de documents. Très bonnes connaissances dans la mise en place de prompts, d'outils de RAG et dans les approches agentiques, au coeur des stratégies d'extraction développées sur la mission. Maîtrise avancée de FastAPI pour l'exposition de services, utilisée dans le cadre de l'industrialisation des solutions développées. Expérience dans le traitement de données non structurées et maîtrise du traitement de fichiers de types variés (Word, PDF, PowerPoint, CSV), formats directement manipulés dans les projets RACI et Risk Eye Check. Connaissance de la chaîne CI/CD et des bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel (versioning, tests, documentation), attendues dans le cadre des développements industrialisés au sein des DSI Filières. Fortement Appréciés Connaissances dans les Vision Language Models (VLM), utilisés pour l'analyse de pages de documents sous forme d'images telles que tableaux, mises en page complexes et éléments visuels. items.desc: Senior AI Engineer £100,000 - £120,000 | London, around 3 days a week in office About the Company We’re working with a large international financial technology business on a hire into its customer support function, part of a team spread across two European locations. The work is the agentic intelligence layer sitting at the core of a contact automation system handling genuine volume. These are production systems that resolve real customer problems rather than demos that produce convincing answers, so accuracy, safety and measurable outcomes all carry weight. It’s hands-on across system design, production code, evaluation and integration, with ownership from prototype through to live. What You’ll Be Doing Design, build and operate customer-facing AI systems including assistants, chatbots and agentic workflows Build LLM applications using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or Mastra, integrating with APIs, knowledge bases and business workflows Develop retrieval, tool-calling and orchestration systems that can safely resolve customer problems end to end Build evaluation frameworks covering quality, task completion, hallucination risk, guardrails, latency, cost and customer outcomes Use observability, tracing and experimentation to diagnose failures and improve models, prompts, retrieval and architecture Design the safeguards, fallbacks and escalation paths that customer-facing AI needs to be trusted Work closely with product and design, starting from the customer’s job to be done rather than from the technology Help set the longer-term vision and engineering standards, and manage technical debt deliberately What They’re Looking For Proven experience building, deploying and owning production AI and ML systems end to end Strong hands-on agentic work in production, covering conversational AI, retrieval, tool calling, evaluation and orchestration frameworks Strong Python and backend engineering, including APIs, testing, observability, CI/CD and distributed systems Sound engineering judgement, knowing when to simplify, when to invest and when to defer Cloud experience on at least one major platform, with AWS preferred, plus MLOps and model lifecycle familiarity Strong product judgement, translating customer and business needs into AI that actually helps Willingness to work in TypeScript, since that’s where production lives. Existing TypeScript experience is a differentiator rather than a requirement Preferred: customer-facing product experience in a high-volume service environment, human-in-the-loop and escalation design, and work with sensitive customer data under real security or compliance constraints Nice to have: PyTorch or similar, fine-tuning or model adaptation, vector databases and modern search, and latency or cost optimisation at scale A Note On Background (note from Xcede) A STEM academic background is appreciated here. The client’s strong preference is for people who came into AI engineering from data science or full-stack science, rather than from pure software engineering. Both routes produce excellent engineers, but this team is specifically looking for the modelling and evaluation instinct that tends to come with the former, alongside genuine product awareness. I should highlight that you should still be comfortable with owning productionisation of your work nonetheless. We’re working on other AI engineering roles where the opposite is exactly the profile wanted, so do get in touch either way! What’s On Offer £100,000 to £120,000 depending on experience, with hybrid working and around three days a week in a London office. If this role interests you and you would like to find out more (or find out about other roles), please apply here or contact us via niall.wharton@Xcede.com (feel free to include a CV for review).

Our SaaS product is being used by major hospitals, manufacturing companies, and partners within Europe. Our web platform and VR software currently enables whole teams in various industries, ranging from healthcare to manufacturing, to design optimal workspaces. As a software engineer at Inspacion, you will be part of a team building the future of how organizations plan and operate buildings with the use of machine learning, 3D web-apps and virtual reality technologies. Fast prototyping, testing, and implementation of software components for machine learning approaches and Web3D applications. Benefits We are a growing company in the area of Virtual Reality technology and spatial requirement engineering. Join our team if you would like: Working in an innovative setting using state-of-the-art technologies (Cloud, Web3D, VR, LLMs) and become an expert in these fields Responsibility, creative freedom, and full involvement in creating a revolutionary scalable product Having a tangible impact – develop solutions that actual customers use and give feedback to Possibility to do product development from the start, including related business aspects Be part of a Swiss startup success story with global ambition And a company stock option plan, partially flexible working hours policy, free coffee at the office What you bring We are looking for an excellent software engineer who can master challenging tasks and gets things done. Apart from your ability to work in teams, you should bring along: High level of creativity with an agile and autonomous style of work Experience with the .NET web-stack: Blazor, WASM, ASP.Net, etc. Experience in building and maintaining REST-based web services Computer graphics background with know-how in advanced real-time rendering techniques, WebGL or WebGPU, Blender, game engines, and linear algebra Excellent programming skills (in statically-typed languages like C#, RUST, or similar) and a passion for modern approaches in software development Experience in building solutions on cloud providers (Azure, AWS, GCP) Experience in deploying using containerization tools (Docker, container stacks, K8s or similar) and deploying to cloud and on-premises environments Background in data sciences and machine learning (RAG, LLMs, training) Experience in database design (e.g. relational or vector databases) M.Sc. or higher degree in computer science (or a related field) / B.Sc. with proven experience in the mentioned fields Fluent in English, German is a plus You are eligible to work in Switzerland Contact us Contact us if you would like to know more! If you are motivated to work in a friendly start-up environment in the exciting field of machine learning and VR, do not hesitate to send us a full application (cover letter, contact details, CV, references, diplomas, relevant projects). Applications can be in English or German.

items.desc: Werde Teil unseres Teams, um einen ambitionierten Brand Builder bei seinem Wachstum mit Software und KI zu begleiten und aktiv zu unterstützen. Epic Brands ist ein schnell wachsendes eCommerce Startup aus dem Herzen von Berlin. Wir entwickeln und vermarkten erfolgreich High Quality Produkte in den Bereichen Küche, Home & Living, Sport und Outdoor mit eigenen Brands wie KLAMER, Steinwood und Fitleap und verkaufen über unsere eigenen Onlineshops sowie Marktplätze wie Amazon, OTTO und weiteren. In bereits 26 Ländern freuen sich unsere Kunden über Produkte, die sie im Alltag und auf Reisen zuverlässig begleiten. Um unsere ambitionierten Ziele zu realisieren, unsere Abläufe mit eigener Software und KI weiter zu automatisieren und weitere neue Produkte im Markt zu etablieren, suchen wir nun einen AI Software Engineer im Praktikum, der/die bereit ist, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns unsere Vision in die Realität umsetzt. Deine Aufgaben - Du wirst Teil unseres Teams, wo du zusammen mit den Gründern und dem Tech Team unsere internen Tools und eigenen Backend Services konzipierst und weiterentwickelst - Du baust / orchestrierst konkret KI Agenten und Automatisierungen, die wiederkehrende Aufgaben im Team übernehmen, integrierst Business Kontext und testest neue Modelle - Du verbesserst unsere eigenen Onlineshops, setzt Integrationen um und steuerst Implementierung und Tests von Frontend Optimierungen - Du gehst bei technischen Entscheidungen selbst in den Lead und verantwortest Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zum laufenden Tool. Du bist direkter Ansprechpartner für Kollegen aus anderen Business-Bereichen - Du unterstützt durch deine Expertise die Optimierung von internen Prozessen und sorgst für stabile Systeme, um uns zu helfen, kontinuierlich besser und effizienter zu werden Das bringst du mit - Du hast Interesse an KI, Automatisierung und Softwareentwicklung im eCommerce - Du hast einen Hochschulabschluss in Informatik oder einem verwandten Fach oder bist dabei, dein Studium abzuschließen - Du bist sicher in JS/TS bzw. Node, hast Erfahrung mit Backend Services, Cloud Infrastruktur oder eCommerce Systemen und arbeitest idealerweise schon mit LLM APIs und AI Coding Tools - Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift - Du bringst “Hands on Mentalität” und Initiative mit, bist motiviert und denkst ergebnisorientiert - Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und kannst unabhängig arbeiten - Mit dir zusammenarbeiten macht Spaß! Das bekommst du - Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern zusammen und bekommst persönliches Mentoring, wenn du das möchtest - Du wirst ein integraler Bestandteil des Teams. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf den Erfolg des Unternehmens und unsere Produkte und Kunden - Du lernst aus erster Hand, wie ein Unternehmen und seine Brands von Beginn an aufgebaut werden und international wachsen, und was “unter der Haube” läuft - Du wirst zum/zur Expert/in für KI Agenten, Automatisierung und Softwareentwicklung im eCommerce - Du erhältst von Anfang an Verantwortung und löst echte Herausforderungen - Du lernst die Berliner Startup Szene direkt aus dem Zentrum kennen, in unserem Office an der Oranienburger Straße 91 nahe Hackescher Markt - Eine überdurchschnittliche Vergütung bekommst du bei uns auch Bitte sende deine Bewerbung inkl. MCP-tools en applicatieontwikkeling: Je bouwt en test MCP-tools en kleine interne tools, en helpt mee bij het ontwikkelen van nieuwe functionaliteiten of het oplossen van bugs in de desktopapplicatie. Informatiebeveiliging: Je helpt bij het voorbereiden en testen van Purview- en DLP-beleid en werkt mee aan de rapportages hiervan. items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Médiamétrie développe de plus en plus de produits hybridant la donnée de ses propres mesures et des données de fournisseurs. La Gouvernance de Données adresse la gestion des données de l’entreprise lorsque ces dernières deviennent complexes. Activités De La GDD La Gouvernance de Données définit les principes, règles, procédures et outils permettant de mettre sous contrôle le cycle de vie des données de l’entreprise. Ce cadre prend la forme de politiques de données portées par les Data Owners et appuyées par les Data Stewards, qui fixent les exigences de classification, de qualité, de réglementation, de sécurité, de confidentialité et d’usage des données. Au quotidien, la GDD rédige des recommandations sur la conception et l’exploitation des données, d’un point de vue métier comme technique. Elle anime et accompagne les Data Owners ainsi que les équipes projets et produits, et facilite l’accès et la manipulation des données par les utilisateurs. Elle maintient également le référentiel de gouvernance (SAP LeanIX), dans lequel les données de l’entreprise sont gérées sous forme d’objets de données, et collecte les métadonnées (administratives, descriptives, d’usage, de qualité, de sécurité…) nécessaires aux différents processus. Enfin, elle contrôle la bonne application des politiques de données en les confrontant à ces métadonnées : qui accède aux données et pour quel usage, quelles durées de conservation, quels contrôles mis en œuvre. Vos Missions Projet d’outillage du contrôle des politiques de données Participer à la mise en place d’un outil pour vérifier que les règles de gestion des données sont bien respectées dans SAP LeanIX. Identifier les écarts entre les pratiques actuelles et les règles définies, puis proposer des améliorations. Objectif : créer un premier prototype fonctionnel et rédiger la documentation associée. Gouvernance des données appliquée à l’IA générative Enrichir les règles de gestion des données pour intégrer les enjeux liés à l’IA générative (qualité, accès, traçabilité, compréhension des données). Contribuer à 1 ou 2 projets internes d’IA en apportant un cadrage et des recommandations sur la gestion des données. Animation et accompagnement des Data Owners Accompagner les nouveaux Data Owners dans la prise en main de leurs missions. Aider à mettre à jour et fiabiliser les informations dans l’outil SAP LeanIX. Participer à la création de supports et de documentation pour faciliter l’utilisation des outils et des bonnes pratiques. Ce que l’on cherche De formation supérieure de niveau Master 2 (université, école d’ingénieurs ou école de commerce/gestion) avec une spécialisation en data management, statistiques, data science, big data, management, marketing ou gestion, vous êtes à la recherche de votre stage de fin d’études (6 mois à partir de janvier). Vous justifiez d’une première expérience de développement, de préférence en Python. Vous avez une appétence pour la thématique de la gouvernance des données et vous êtes à l’aise avec l’IA. Environnement Métier : sondages, marketing, médias… Gestion de projet Agile : Kanban, Scrum… Gestion de données : DAMA DMBOK, analyse de données (SQL), modélisation de données, connaissance de la réglementation… Techniques : Python / technologies d’IA (Azure OpenAI, Copilot, AWS Bedrock) / environnement AWS / BI (Tableau)
