Privredna banka Zagreb d.d. je društvo čija je vizija biti uzor i centar izvrsnosti u području financijskog poslovanja u Hrvatskoj. Temelj našeg uspješnog poslovanja su naši zaposlenici, koji aktivno sudjeluju u modernom razvoju banke i kreiranju stalnih promjena. PBZ, kao inovativna i suvremena banka i koja je usmjerena na interni razvoj, pruža okolinu u kojoj se možete razviti u smjeru u kojem želite. Univerzalni način kako ostvariti karijeru kod nas nije nepoznanica: učinkovitim radom, ostvarivanjem ciljeva, kontinuiranim razvojem kompetencija, odgovornim organizacijskim ponašanjem, prihvaćanjem različitosti, timskim doprinosom i osobnom proaktivnošću. Svi preduvjeti su tu, na Vama je samo da iskoristite. 
 Viši/Glavni analitičar (m/ž) u Skrbništvu 
 (mjesto rada Zagreb) 
 Radno mjesto obuhvaća: 
 praćenje, izvršavanje i evidentiranje naloga za namiru i korporativnih akcija proizašlih iz imovine klijenata na skrbništvu 
 razvijanje i održavanje kvalitetnog poslovnog odnosa s klijentima, tržišnom infrastrukturom i inozemnim podskrbnicima 
 ispunjavanje ugovornih i regulatornih obveza iz područja skrbništva 
 izvještavanje i analiza podataka iz područja poslovanja skrbništva 
 sudjelovanje u razvoju i optimizaciji procesa iz domene odgovornosti 
 sudjelovanje u projektnim aktivnostima i implementaciji regulatornih i tržišnih promjena 
 Formalni uvjeti koje svi kandidati moraju zadovoljavati su: 
 VSS ekonomskog usmjerenja 
 iskustvo rada s klijentima 
 aktivno znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu (radno mjesto uključuje svakodnevno komuniciranje na engleskom jeziku) 
 dobro poznavanje MS Office-a 
 prethodno radno iskustvo na poslovima skrbništva ili sličnim poslovima je prednost 
 Uz izraženu želju za radom u dinamičnom okruženju, idealni kandidati za ovo radno mjesto posjeduju: 
 razvijene komunikacijske vještine 
 sposobnost multitaskinga i stalne prioritizacije 
 organiziranost i sistematičnost 
 točnost i brzinu te poštivanje rokova 
 sklonost timskom radu 
 analitičke vještine 
 Što nudimo? 
 Mogućnost napretka u karijeri i profesionalno usavršavanje 
 dinamično i motivirajuće okruženje

items.desc:
VÚB banka je druhá najväčšia banka na Slovensku a súčasť medzinárodnej skupiny Intesa Sanpaolo – jednej z popredných bankových skupín v Európe. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 2 200 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 800 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 400 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 1 800 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch Ťa čaká jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Ak pre Vás nie sú bankové a investičné produkty neznáme pojmy, máte v sebe ducha obchodníka, rád/rada komunikujete a dokážete klientom pomôcť nájsť to najideálnejšie riešenie, ste skvelý typ na osobného bankára/bankárku pre VÚB! 
 Čakajú Vás u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie. 
 Na pozícii Osobný bankár/bankárka bude Vašou úlohou:
 starať sa o Magnifica klientov,
 identifikovať potreby klientov, analyzovať ich požiadavky a hľadať pre nich tie najideálnejšie riešenia,
 poskytovať odborné poradenstvo v oblasti produktov a služieb existujúcim a potenciálnym klientom z portfólia afluentných klientov,
 budovať si s klientmi dôverný vzťah,
 neustále sa vzdelávať o novinkách vo svete financií a odborne rásť.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Stravné plne hradené zamestnávateľom bez doplatku zamestnanca.
 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.
 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).
 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 190 eur ročne ako príspevok na obliekanie.
 Chcete objaviť všetky fantastické výhody, ktoré svojim zamestnancom VÚBka ponúka? Mrknite na našu kariérnu stránku a preskúmajte širokú škálu našich benefitov! 
 Požadované skúsenosti 
 Pozícii vyhovujú uchádzači so vzdelaním:
 stredoškolské s maturitou
 Prax na pozícii/v oblasti:
 minimálne 2 roky skúsenosti s priamym predajom finančných produktov
 Požadované zručnosti, kvalifikácia a znalosti 
 Si pre nás vhodným kandidátom/kandidátkou ak:
 máte minimálne 2 roky skúsenosti s priamym predajom finančných produktov,
 viete aktívne využívať MS Office a nebojíte sa virtuálneho prostredia,
 Vás baví komunikovať a dokážete pomôcť klientom s nájdením optimálneho riešenia,
 Vám bankové a investičné produkty nie sú cudzie,
 máte argumentačné schopnosti a obchodného ducha,
 ste dôveryhodnou a bezúhonnou osobou,
 výhodou je anglický jazyk a vzdelanie ekonomického zamerania.
 ... všetko ostatné Ťa naučíme my :)

Ak Ťa tento popis zaujal a chceš sa stať naším novým VÚBkárom, stačí už len kliknúť na „Reagovať na ponuku" a my sa Ti ozveme. Všetko dôležité o práci vo VÚB si povieme na osobnom/online stretnutí.
Tešíme sa na Teba !

items.desc:
Digital Contact Center Management of Change 
 Description - 
 Job Summary 
• This role is responsible for overseeing large customer projects with moderate complexity, localized/sub-regional scope, and high risks. The role coordinates corporate, customer and third-party vendor efforts to plan, sell and implement solutions to customer problems. The role establishes and nurtures client relationships, leads project teams of less than 20 individuals, and analyzes complex business processes. The role also collaborates with cross-functional teams to ensure expectations are well communicated and customer needs are met.
 Responsibilities 
• Oversees the delivery of large customer projects having moderate complexity, and localized or sub-regional significance, entailing medium to high risks and dealing with legal and commercial matters.
• Collaborates closely with the team for project financials like profit and loss (P&L), consistently meeting or surpassing SOAR approved budgets and delivering dependable financial forecasts to the management.
• Contributes significantly to business development efforts by identifying and nurturing new opportunities within ongoing projects as well as supporting the qualification and assessment of large and moderately complex opportunities.
• Establishes and cultivates client relationships at the middle and upper levels, frequently serving as the organization's representative to external customers and clients.
• Heads the project team, overseeing both internal and external resources with a team size of fewer than 20 individuals, fostering skill development among team members.
• Analyzes complex business and systems processes and synthesizes closed-loop feedback management to address customer issues effectively.
• Collaborates with marketing, sales, and engagement teams to ensure accurate reflection of customers and their needs.
• Identifies tasks and research, determines dependencies, and communicates expectations to team members.
• Solves difficult and complex problems with a fresh perspective, demonstrating good judgment in selecting creative solutions and managing projects independently.
• Leads moderate to high complexity projects, delivering professionally written reports, and supports the realization of operational and strategic plans.

• Four-year or Graduate Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
• Typically has 4-7 years of work experience, preferably in project management, HP Services business units, HP global projects, or a related field or an advanced degree with 3-5 years of work experience.

 Impact & Scope

 Complexity

items.desc: Description du poste: Leader français de l’assurance auto en ligne depuis 1992, Direct Assurance, entité du Groupe AXA, propose également des offres d’assurance habitation, moto et santé. Aujourd'hui, plus de deux millions de clients nous font confiance grâce à un tarif adapté et une gestion des sinistres personnalisée. Dans un marché assurantiel très compétitif, Direct Assurance conçoit des solutions adaptées aux besoins de ses clients en défendant leur pouvoir d’achat. Nous faisons de l'expérience client une priorité en mettant à disposition une gamme de produits simple, claire et performante. Si vous recherchez un environnement convivial, dynamique, digital et tourné vers l'innovation, au sein d'une entreprise en croissance, rejoignez-nous ! Vous allez aimer grandir à nos côtés. Vous allez aimer innover avec nous. Vous allez aimer que nos clients nous adorent. VOTRE RÔLE ET VOS MISSIONS Au sein de la Direction Technique de Direct Assurance, vous rejoindrez l’équipe Provisionnement, qui estime la sinistralité ultime des produits automobile et multirisque habitation. L’équipe dispose déjà de workflows Data Science exécutés sur Databricks. L’enjeu du stage est de fiabiliser, automatiser et industrialiser ces workflows afin de faciliter le développement, le test, le déploiement et le suivi des modèles, tout en garantissant leur reproductibilité et leur maintenabilité. Contexte et problématique : Le stage vise à construire un workflow MLOps fiable et reproductible grâce à Python, Git, MLflow et aux étapes de CI/CD. Vous travaillerez à partir de l’existant afin d’améliorer la qualité du code, l’automatisation des tests, la traçabilité des expérimentations et la mise en production des modèles. Vous occuperez les missions suivantes : Analyser et améliorer les workflows existants sur Databricks. Structurer le code Python et appliquer les bonnes pratiques de versionnement avec Git. Mettre en place des tests automatisés pour le code, les données et les modèles. Intégrer les étapes de CI/CD au workflow existant. Utiliser MLflow pour suivre les expérimentations, versionner les modèles et faciliter leur déploiement. Documenter les solutions et partager les bonnes pratiques avec l’équipe. Ce stage vous permettra de développer une expérience concrète du cycle de vie d’un modèle, de son développement à sa mise en production, dans un environnement Data et Cloud. VOTRE PROFIL Nous recherchons un profil avec les compétences suivantes : Compétences et formation : Étudiant(e) en dernière année d’une école d’ingénieur (X, Centrale, ENSAE…) ou ayant suivi une formation en Statistiques / Data Science / Data engineer. Vous recherchez un stage de fin d’études orienté Data Science et industrialisation. Compétences techniques : Bonne maîtrise de Python et des principales bibliothèques de Data Science. Connaissance de Git, MLflow et des principes de CI/CD. Une première expérience de Databricks, Spark ou d’un environnement Cloud est appréciée. Connaissances en SQL, tests logiciels et qualité des données. Bases solides en mathématiques, statistiques et Machine Learning. Compétences personnelles/relationnelles : Rigueur, curiosité et capacité d’analyse. Autonomie, esprit d’équipe et force de proposition. Bonnes capacités de communication et de documentation. Le poste est basé à Suresnes (92) à proximité de la Défense. POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? Nous sommes persuadés que pour bien prendre soin de nos clients, nous devons commencer par bien prendre soin de nos collaborateurs ! Les avantages que nous proposons à nos salariés sont nombreux. Nous choisir, c’est bénéficier : D’un package de rémunération complet comprenant un salaire fixe, un complément de rémunération variable, des primes, de la participation et de l’intéressement, la possibilité d’acquérir des actions AXA, ou encore des solutions d’épargne avantageuses ; D’un cadre de travail flexible jusqu’à 3 jours de télétravail possible par semaine (selon profil du poste), des tickets restaurant pour les jours télétravaillés ou encore une participation à l’achat d’un écran ou fauteuil ergonomique ; D’une politique visant à concilier vie personnelle et vie professionnelle avec 28 jours de congés payés, entre 14 et 16 RTT selon les années, des formules de travail à temps partiel ou encore des jours d’absence rémunérées pour la rentrée scolaire ou un déménagement par exemple ; De la possibilité de s’engager pour une cause qui vous tient à cœur grâce à nos associations telles que AXA Atout Cœur, AXA Compétences Solidaires ou encore AXA Prévention ; Et bien plus encore ! Perspectives de développement des compétences et de carrières immenses, CE, conciergerie, offres privilèges, soutien en cas d’épreuve personnelle…On s’arrête là, la liste est longue En lien avec nos engagements, nous célébrons chaque arrivée en agissant en faveur de la reforestation mondiale : nous plantons un arbre pour chaque recrutement. Alors, prêt à postuler ? VOTRE ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL Notre raison d’être chez AXA ? …

items.desc: Taken en verantwoordelijkheden In opdracht van een publieke organisatie in Antwerpen zoeken we een Senior Data Analyst / BI Analyst die datagedreven werken verder helpt uitbouwen. Je brengt data in kaart, structureert en visualiseert die, en zet businessvragen om in bruikbare inzichten en rapporteringen. Hiervoor stem je af met diverse stakeholders en technische profielen. Je staat in voor het ontwikkelen, onderhouden en optimaliseren van nieuwe en bestaande datamodellen, dashboards en rapporteringen. Zelfstandig neem je de lopende BI- en datawerkzaamheden voor je rekening. Je onderzoekt functionele behoeften en zet deze om in kwalitatieve BI-oplossingen. De datakwaliteit, performantie en gebruiksvriendelijkheid van de rapportering volg je nauwgezet op. Je werkt mee aan de standaardisatie van rapportering en aan de verdere uitbouw van semantische modellen. Jouw profiel Als BI Consultant, Data Analyst of BI Analyst heb je aantoonbare ervaring opgebouwd. Je bent in het bezit van een bachelor- of masterdiploma. Requirementsanalyse behoort tot je ervaring, net als het onderzoeken van business requirements en het vertalen ervan naar BI-oplossingen. Je hebt gewerkt met Data Management (ETL) en reporting tools. Power BI kent voor jou weinig geheimen, inclusief het ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van dashboards en rapporteringen. Voor het uitwerken van berekeningen en measures pas je DAX toe. Je kunt SQL inzetten voor het analyseren en verwerken van data. Je hebt ervaring met Power BI Service, met inbegrip van workspaces, gateways en toegangsbeheer. Je kent de principes van datakwaliteit, rapporteringsstandaardisatie en performantieoptimalisatie. Daarnaast beschik je over kennis van semantische modellen. Ervaring met BI-projecten binnen de publieke sector vormt een relevante meerwaarde voor deze functie. Je Nederlands bevindt zich op Europees CEFR-niveau C2.

items.desc: Location Dublin, Leinster, Ireland Job ID R-264815 Date posted 19-11-2026 Are you ready to apply your biologics manufacturing expertise to bring life‑changing therapies to patients faster? As a Technical Services Specialist in Dublin (Blanchardstown), you will enable reliable, compliant production of biological bulk drug substance by leading technology transfer, process validation, and on-the-floor support across Upstream and/or Downstream operations. You will work at the interface of science and manufacturing, translating process knowledge into right-first-time commercial batches. Partnering closely with Process Development, Operations, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Regulatory, you will help start up new capabilities, qualify processes, and continually improve performance. How will you shape a robust control strategy that stands up to audit scrutiny while delivering for patients? Accountabilitie s: Technology Transfer Leadership: Plan and execute technology transfers for new and existing drug substance processes to the Dublin site, ensuring process fit, clear acceptance criteria, and on-time milestones. Process Validation and Monitoring: Define and deliver PPQ strategies, establish process monitoring plans and performance dashboards, and apply QRM tools to manage risks and drive sustained process capability. Upstream/Downstream Process Expertise: Provide deep expertise in one or both areas. Upstream examples include media prep, vial thaw, seed expansion, production bioreactors, and harvest clarification. Downstream examples include buffer prep, chromatography, ultrafiltration/diafiltration, viral reduction/inactivation, and DS formulation and bulk fill. Process Ownership: Serve as Process Owner for cell culture unit operations, setting control strategies, aligning critical quality attributes and process parameters, and acting as SME across the lifecycle. Documentation Excellence: Author and review transfer documentation, gap assessments, validation protocols/reports, strategy documents, and technical reports that withstand internal and regulatory scrutiny. Lab and Study Enablement: Identify and scope lab studies to support process fit and decision-making; partner with Process Development to design, execute, and interpret studies that de-risk scale-up. Materials and Supply Integration: Define materials lists, Bills of Materials, specifications, and testing needs; collaborate with Quality, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing to align material readiness with tech transfer and campaign timelines. On-the-Floor Support and Investigations: Provide live manufacturing support, troubleshoot deviations, lead root-cause investigations, and implement effective CAPAs to protect schedule and yield. Change Control Ownership: Lead key process changes via the change control system, ensuring robust impact assessments, stakeholder alignment, and compliant implementation Continuous Improvement: Identify and implement improvements that enhance yield, reduce cycle time, and simplify operations without compromising compliance or robustness. Compliance and Audit Readiness: Uphold cGMP, EHS, and corporate standards; contribute to risk assessments, audits, and incident investigations; provide technical support during internal and external inspections. Regulatory Support: Author and review CTD/CMC sections and technical reports for agency submissions; act as SME for technology transfer and process performance during inspections. Flexible Support During Critical Campaigns: Provide temporary shift coverage or on-call support during engineering runs, validation batches, and key manufacturing events to maintain delivery commitments. Essential Skills/Experience: Minimum 3+ years’ experience in Technical Services / Process Development / Manufacturing Support in a biological bulk drug substance manufacturing organization Technical and operational knowledge of multiple unit operations in cell culture processing Comprehensive understanding of cGMP requirements for biopharmaceutical manufacturing Good interpersonal skills coupled with demonstrated ability to effectively work in a matrix organization, and in local group settings Ability to present and defend technical and scientific approaches in both written and verbal form Ability to drive for results independently and adapt to rapidly changing priorities Detail orientated Technical writing competency B.Sc. in Biochemistry, Biology, Chemistry or equivalent, or B.Eng. Process or Chemical Engineering M.Sc. or other postgraduate qualification in Biochemistry, Biology, Chemistry or equivalent, or B.Eng. items.desc: Jouw aandeel in de bouw van een Feadship De Voogt Naval Architects is verantwoordelijk voor het design, de basic engineering en alle berekeningen die nodig zijn voor de custom-built superjachten. Het technische en creatieve brein van Feadship en de plek voor alle research & development. Als Project Engineer lever je daar een belangrijke bijdrage aan. Met structural, naval architecture, mechanical, interior en exterior, met rekenen, passen en meten in een combinatie van inzicht en vindingrijkheid. Kom jij zorgen dat dromen werkelijkheid worden? Binnen Engineering hebben we een duidelijke stap gemaakt: Exterior, Interior en Mechanical vormen samen één krachtig EIM-team. Als Project Engineer EIM - Mechanical ligt jouw expertise binnen Mechanical Engineering (Marine Systems). Je maakt deel uit van één geïntegreerd EIM-team en coördineert de Mechanical-werkzaamheden binnen jouw projecten. Samen met Exterior-, Interior- en andere engineeringdisciplines zorg je voor samenhang tussen ontwerp, techniek en maakbaarheid. Samen met andere Project Engineers en Specialisten binnen De Voogt pas je nieuwe kennis toe in projecten en breng je projectervaringen terug naar kennisontwikkeling en de samenwerking met Studio en K&I. Heb jij ervaring binnen Mechanical Engineering en kun je technische expertise combineren met het coördineren en begeleiden van engineeringwerkzaamheden? Dan zoeken we jou! Dit ga je doen als Project Engineer Mechanical (Marine Systems) | Hoofddorp Als Project Engineer EIM werk je vanuit jouw vakgebied in multidisciplinaire projectteams aan de integratie van ontwerp, systemen en maakbaarheid. Je coördineert de werkzaamheden binnen jouw discipline en blijft zelf inhoudelijk betrokken bij complexe ontwerpvragen. Samen met de Project Manager Design en betrokken collega’s bepaal je de scope en planning. Je verdeelt het werk, bewaakt de planningen, urenbudgetten en opleveringen en je zorgt dat jouw team weet wat wordt verwacht. Indien nodig werk je zelf ook mee aan leveringen. Met de andere Project Engineers en Naval Architect maak je de multidisciplinaire afwegingen binnen het project. Je maakt de gevolgen van wijzigingen inzichtelijk en bespreekt risico’s, prioriteiten en eventueel meerwerk tijdig met de Project Manager Design. Samen met collega’s werk je toe naar een integraal en realiseerbaar jachtontwerp. Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden/taken zijn: Verantwoordelijk voor het technisch realiseren en integreren van: Machinekamer en Casing lay-outs Technische ruimte lay-outs HVAC integratie Schematics and Diagrams Scope, planning en werkverdeling coördineren en (Sr) Engineers aansturen Kwaliteit, urenbudget en oplevering bewaken en inhoudelijk meewerken Technische integratie afstemmen met disciplines, werf en leveranciers Risico’s, wijzigingen en meerwerk beoordelen en afstemmen met de PMD Bijdragen aan verbetering van werkwijzen, kwaliteit en samenwerking binnen EIM Je maakt deel uit van het team Exterior, Interior & Mechnical Engineering en valt onder de Team Leader van die afdeling. Dit breng je mee HBO werk- en denkniveau met een relevante technische achtergrond Minimaal vier jaar engineeringervaring in de jachtbouw of maritieme sector Kennis van mechanische installaties, integratie en regelgeving Ervaring met coördinatie, teambegeleiding en planning- en urenbewaking Brede technische interesse en het vermogen om over disciplines heen te kijken Ervaring met 2D- en 3D-tekensoftware, zoals AutoCAD, NX of Cadmatic Goede beheersing van Engels; bereidheid Nederlands te leren indien nodig. Jij bent Technisch sterk in het onderbouwen van integrale ontwerpkeuzes Organisatorisch sterk in werkverdeling, planning en budgetbewaking Duidelijk in aansturing, begeleiding en aanspreken op afspraken Besluitvaardig en verantwoordelijk voor de Mechanical (project)scope Verbindend in de samenwerking met disciplines, werf en externe partijen Ons aanbod Ruimte om je binnen EIM te ontwikkelen, zowel binnen je eigen specialisme als in samenwerking met andere disciplines Een sleutelrol in de ontwikkeling naar één geïntegreerd EIM-team Werken aan unieke projecten in de top van de jachtbouw Veel ruimte om jezelf breed te ontwikkelen over disciplines heen Samenwerken in multidisciplinaire teams met ontwerp en werf Hybride werken (kantoor-thuis) en standplaats Hoofddorp Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals: Een salaris in schaal 10 (inschaling a.d.h.v. ervaring en inzetbaarheid) van € 56.000,- tot € 88.000,- bruto per jaar, incl. 13de maand Een 13e maandsalaris Een premievrij pensioen De mogelijkheid om bonussen te behalen 27 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV dagen per jaar op fulltime basis Informele werksfeer met hoge ambities Leuke activiteiten georganiseerd met het team en de hele organisatie De sollicitatieprocedure bestaat uit 1 á 2 gespreksrondes en een online persoonlijkheidsassessment.

items.desc: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Computer Operators at Kyndryl are key in helping revolutionize the way we operate complex computer systems. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology, supervise and control intricate networks and applications, and operate distributed systems in a multi-vendor environment. As a Computer Operator you will be on the technical frontline – performing batch operations as per service agreements, analyzing first-level issues across systems, and resolving/routing issues as appropriate. You will also have the opportunity to develop support system management processes specific to customer requirements, ensuring that we provide the highest level of service to our customers. If you have a passion for technology and a desire to continually improve your skills – this is the position for you. You will work with a talented team of professionals and collaborate on exciting projects that are shaping the future of our industry. Your Future at Kyndryl As a Computer Operator, you will be interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams which makes identifying career paths with Kyndryl easy. Whether you want to delve into the intricacies of automating complex processes, drive essential systems, or ensure top-notch delivery to our customers, there is a path for you – and we’re invested in paving the way. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Expertise •Experience with scheduling software, reporting, and logging •Proficient with Operating Systems (Windows or Mac) Preferred Technical and Professional Experience •Experience with Troubleshooting, Backup/Recovery and Basic Networking Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. What You'll Do You are a curious, versatile creative who is developing genuine range across disciplines and creative practices. Keep human creativity and craft at the centre of everything that goes out the door. Contribute to a high creative standard. Share your perspective when it adds value, engage constructively in feedback, and actively learn from the senior creatives and different disciplines around you. Stay ahead of where design, culture, and communication are going. Bring fresh perspective into the studio and into client conversations — not just within your own practice, but across the creative landscape. Stay curious about the full shape of a project. Begin to connect the dots between what different practitioners are solving and what the work ultimately needs to achieve. YOU’RE GOOD AT Reading a brief carefully and asking the right questions when something is unclear. Moving between creative disciplines with growing confidence. You are building a clear sense of what good looks like across different formats and contexts. Participating in the presentation of creative work, speaking clearly about the decisions behind it and taking feedback constructively. items.desc: Energy Finance & Business Model Analyst Location: Basel, Switzerland (office-based) Employment: Full-time (100%) Contract: One year, with the possibility of extension Experience level: Entry-level / Early career Expected start: To be agreed About BASE BASE Foundation is a Swiss not-for-profit organisation and a specialised partner of the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP). We develop and implement innovative business models and financing strategies to mobilise investment in sustainable energy and climate solutions. Our work focuses on making proven technologies commercially viable, affordable, financially sustainable, and scalable. We collaborate with businesses, financial institutions, governments, and international organisations across Africa, Asia, Latin America, and Europe. We are a hands-on organisation. We don’t just develop concepts or write reports; we design, test, and implement solutions in real markets. The Opportunity We are looking for a curious, analytical, and commercially minded Energy Finance & Business Model Analyst to join our international team in Basel. At BASE, we work on a fundamental challenge: how can we make sustainable energy and climate solutions financially viable, attractive to investors, and accessible to the people and businesses that need them? Our approach combines financial modelling, quantitative risk analysis, commercial thinking, and business model engineering to develop innovative financing and investment solutions. We are looking for someone who enjoys working with numbers but is equally interested in understanding how businesses operate, how markets function, and what makes an investment opportunity attractive. This is an entry-level position , suitable for recent master’s graduates or early-career professionals. You will work alongside experienced colleagues and contribute to real projects involving sustainable energy, cooling, energy efficiency, and other climate solutions. You don’t need to be an engineer or have extensive professional experience. What matters most is your analytical ability, curiosity, and willingness to learn. Key Responsibilities Financial Modelling & Investment Analysis Develop and support financial models to assess investment and commercial viability. Analyse investment costs, revenues, operating expenses, cash flows, and financing structures. Calculate and interpret financial indicators such as NPV, IRR, DSCR, and payback periods. Evaluate alternative business models and financing arrangements. Risk Assessment & Quantitative Analysis Conduct sensitivity analysis, scenario analysis, and stress testing to assess financial risks and uncertainties. Support probabilistic risk assessments, including Monte Carlo simulations. Analyse how changes in costs, revenues, energy prices, and financing conditions affect financial performance. Assess financial risks and contribute to developing appropriate mitigation mechanisms. Financial & Business Model Engineering Support the design and development of innovative business models and financing mechanisms. Analyse revenue models, pricing structures, customer incentives, contractual arrangements, and risk allocation. Explore financing instruments, including debt, equity, leasing, guarantees, insurance, and blended finance. Identify commercial and financial barriers and contribute to developing practical solutions. Help structure business models that are financially viable, affordable, and scalable. Market Analysis & Project Development Research energy markets, investment environments, and financing opportunities. Analyse regulatory and market conditions affecting project viability. Collaborate with technical colleagues, financial institutions, businesses, and other partners. Contribute to feasibility studies, investment proposals, business cases, and project reports. What We’re Looking For Essential Qualifications Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Energy Finance, Financial Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including financial modelling and investment analysis. Good understanding of financial instruments and financing structures. Knowledge of probability, statistics, and financial risk assessment. Strong Excel skills and the ability to develop financial models. Interest in business model innovation, commercial viability, and financial structuring. Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to translate analysis into practical recommendations. Excellent written and spoken English (C1 or higher) . Excellent written and spoken Spanish (C1 or higher) . Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an international environment. Additional Qualifications (An Advantage) Experience through internships, academic projects, or professional work in financial modelling, investment analysis, or project finance. Familiarity with sensitivity analysis, scenario analysis, stress testing, or Monte Carlo simulations. Knowledge of Python, R, or other …

items.desc: Grassroots Rural Development Volunteer (Himalayan Village Immersion) - Volunteer/ Probono Organization: Vandanam Trust Location: Village near Kainchi Dham Mandir, Nainital District, Uttarakhand, India (On-site) Job Type: Volunteer / Honorary Fellowship (Full-Time Immersion) Target Region for Recruitment: Switzerland Duration: Flexible (Minimum 3–6 months preferred; long-term commitment welcome) About Vandanam Trust Guided by the timeless Indian philosophy of "Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam" (The World is One Family), Vandanam Trust is dedicated to transforming rural communities into empowered, self-reliant, and sustainable model villages ( Adarsh Gaon ). Our grassroots work is anchored in GYAN — uplifting G*areeb (the underserved), Y uva (youth), A nnadata (farmers), and N*ari-Shakti (women) through education, sustainable livelihoods, healthcare awareness, and cultural preservation. The Opportunity Are you ready to step away from the conventional corporate routine and dedicate your energy, skills, and heart to meaningful grassroots change? Vandanam Trust is seeking a passionate, self-driven individual from Switzerland to relocate to a serene Himalayan village near the historic Kainchi Dham Mandir in Uttarakhand, India. Inspired by changemakers who have traded fast-paced European careers for deep community service in rural India, this role invites you to live among the villagers, build genuine trust, and co-create sustainable prosperity from the ground up. Key Responsibilities Community Integration & Needs Assessment: Live locally, engage directly with village elders, families, women, and youth, and understand ground-level challenges with humility and empathy. Education & Youth Mentorship: Support local school children with foundational learning, spoken English, digital literacy, and life skills to curb forced youth migration. Women’s Empowerment ( Nari-Shakti ): Collaborate with local women to develop self-help groups, micro-entrepreneurship, and sustainable livelihood skills. Sustainable Agriculture & Eco-Initiatives: Work alongside local farmers ( Annadata ) to promote organic farming, permaculture practices, waste management, and environmental conservation. Global Bridge & Documentation: Document grassroots impact, connect the village’s story with ethical international supporters, and assist in organizing community welfare programs. Who We Are Looking For Nationality / Residency: Based in Switzerland, with a deep respect for Indian culture, rural traditions, and spiritual heritage. Mindset: Grounded, adaptable, patient, and resilient—comfortable living simply in a mountainous, rural environment away from urban luxuries. Background: Open to professionals on a career break, retirees, educators, social entrepreneurs, or sustainability enthusiasts. Prior NGO experience is a plus, though empathy, initiative, and willingness to learn matter most. Language: Proficiency in English is required; basic Hindi (or a strong willingness to learn local Kumaoni/Hindi phrases) is highly valued. What We Offer Purpose-Driven Impact: Direct, transparent, hands-on involvement where you can see the tangible results of your work in people’s daily lives. Authentic Himalayan Living: Simple, safe, and welcoming village accommodation and wholesome local meals in the peaceful foothills of the Kumaon Himalayas, steps away from the spiritual energy of Kainchi Dham. Community & Cultural Immersion: Become an adopted member of a warm, close-knit mountain community. Important Notes on Engagement & Visa This is a non-monetary, voluntary role . Candidates must be financially self-sufficient for their international travel, insurance, and personal expenses. Vandanam Trust will provide an official invitation letter and necessary organizational documentation to support your Indian visa application. How to Apply If this calling resonates with you, please submit: Your updated CV / Resume A 1-page Personal Statement sharing your story, why you wish to transition to grassroots service in Uttarakhand, and what skills or values you hope to bring to the village. Contact: hr.vandanamtrust@gmail.com | assist.vandanam.org@gmail.com Subject Line: Himalayan Village Volunteer Application – [Your Name] Job Types: Internship, Try & Hire Work Location: Remote

Receive, identify, label, prepare and process laboratory specimens and samples. Operate, calibrate and maintain laboratory instruments and equipment. Prepare laboratory reagents, chemicals, solutions and testing materials. Accurately record, analyse and report laboratory findings and results.
items.desc: Job Summary We are seeking a competent, highly motivated and detail-oriented Laboratory Technician to join our professional team. The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting laboratory operations by conducting routine testing, preparing and processing samples, maintaining laboratory equipment, and ensuring accurate documentation of results. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical abilities, excellent organisational skills, and a thorough understanding of laboratory health and safety procedures. They should be capable of working independently as well as collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team. Key Responsibilities Perform routine laboratory tests, investigations and analyses in accordance with established protocols. Receive, identify, label, prepare and process laboratory specimens and samples. Operate, calibrate and maintain laboratory instruments and equipment. Prepare laboratory reagents, chemicals, solutions and testing materials. Accurately record, analyse and report laboratory findings and results. Maintain comprehensive laboratory documentation and ensure data accuracy. Implement quality control procedures and comply with relevant quality assurance standards. Adhere to laboratory standard operating procedures (SOPs), COSHH requirements and health and safety regulations. Ensure the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemicals, specimens and laboratory waste. Maintain a clean, organised and fully operational laboratory environment. items.desc: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in. Locations: Austin TX, Champaign IL, Lisbon Portugal, London England, Atlanta GA, Washington DC, About the team Cloudflare is redefining the way networks are run at scale, and some of the largest networks in the world now run their traffic through us. Cloudflare's network runs in hundreds of cities on general-purpose Linux servers, not dedicated routers, so the routers, firewalls, load balancers, and proxies that carry our customers' traffic are software that we write, ship, and operate ourselves. Our Packet Processing team builds and operates that software: high-performance code that processes customer traffic at the packet level as it moves through Cloudflare's network, in every Cloudflare data center. That includes the L4 load balancer at the front door of every server, a per-customer routing and forwarding data plane, a stateful network firewall, and a TCP/UDP reverse proxy (the engines behind products like Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare Network Firewall, and Spectrum). We are a team of engineers who obsess over performance, correctness, and reliability at massive scale. We own what we build in production, a lot of our work happens close to the kernel and the NIC. About the role For us, performance is a product feature. Customers notice single-flow throughput, packet loss, and latency right away, and every CPU cycle we spend on a packet is multiplied across every server in our network. We're looking for engineers who love finding out where the time goes, and then making it go away. Some of the things you'd work on: Pushing single large flows (e.g., one tunnel carrying a customer's whole data center) to multiple Gbps and beyond, and making that performance consistent Finding out exactly where packets get dropped and why: NIC queues, interrupts and softirq, XDP, veth and namespaces, userspace rings, and everything in between CPU placement: NUMA, RSS, core isolation, and steering traffic to the right cores on servers that also run many other services Cutting the CPU cost per packet in hot paths written in Rust, C, and Go: batching, cache-friendly data structures, fewer copies, fewer locks Measuring all of it: profiling with perf, eBPF tracing, and flame graphs; continuous profiling across the fleet; benchmarks in the lab and careful experiments in production Building the benchmark and test tooling that keeps performance regressions from shipping Helping shape a unified data plane platform so that it's fast from the start We write mostly Go and Rust (plus C for eBPF) on Linux, and the work ranges from NIC configuration and the kernel network stack to userspace packet pipelines. You'll build, deploy, and operate these systems on top of one of the largest edge networks in the world. You'll partner with some of the best engineers and product managers, on our team and across Cloudflare, to solve big problems that have a meaningful impact in the lives of our customers and users. We're looking for curious, empathetic engineers who are excited to join us in changing the way networking is done! Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, and experience Systems programming experience in Rust, Go, C, or C++ Performance analysis on Linux: perf, eBPF-based tracing (e.g., bpftrace, BCC), flame graphs, hardware counters A working model of modern CPUs and memory: caches, NUMA, branch prediction, SIMD, and how they show up in a profile Knowledge of how packets move through Linux: NIC queues, RSS, NAPI, …

items.desc: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in. Locations: Austin TX, Champaign IL, Lisbon Portugal, London England, Atlanta GA, Washington DC, About the team Cloudflare is redefining the way networks are run at scale, and some of the largest networks in the world now run their traffic through us. Cloudflare's network runs in hundreds of cities on general-purpose Linux servers, not dedicated routers, so the routers, firewalls, load balancers, and proxies that carry our customers' traffic are software that we write, ship, and operate ourselves. Our Packet Processing team builds and operates that software: high-performance code that processes customer traffic at the packet level as it moves through Cloudflare's network, in every Cloudflare data center. That includes the L4 load balancer at the front door of every server, a per-customer routing and forwarding data plane, a stateful network firewall, and a TCP/UDP reverse proxy (the engines behind products like Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare Network Firewall, and Spectrum). We are a team of engineers who obsess over performance, correctness, and reliability at massive scale. We own what we build in production, a lot of our work happens close to the kernel and the NIC. About the role We're looking for engineers who want to build the software that forwards, filters, and load-balances packets for a meaningful fraction of the internet. If you've worked on routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, or SDN data planes, and you'd like to do that in software, at Cloudflare's scale, this is the role. We're moving towards a unified data plane platform that all of our L3/L4 products share. Instead of each product having its own data path, with its own configuration, performance work, and failure modes, we build a feature once and every product gets it. Some of the things you'd work on: The shared platform: packet I/O, a graph of processing stages, per-core steering, per-customer isolation, and upgrades that don't drop traffic A userspace forwarding plane that gives each customer their own routing and forwarding, with traffic arriving and leaving over tunnels (GRE, IPsec) and direct connections A stateful packet firewall written in Rust: rule evaluation, rate limiting, intrusion detection, packet capture, and dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 An XDP-based L4 load balancer that touches nearly every connection into Cloudflare and forwards packets between servers and between data centers A fast path that uses XDP and eBPF to forward very large single flows at multiple Gbps Host networking: classifying each packet once and using that result everywhere on the server, instead of separate configs that can disagree Chasing down packet drops, latency, and throughput problems across a fleet of servers in hundreds of cities We write mostly Go and Rust (plus C for eBPF) on Linux, and the work ranges from XDP and the kernel network stack to userspace packet pipelines and the control planes that configure them. items.desc:
Bouldering Community Builder 
 Bratislava
 About the role
 Help us build and grow the bouldering category at athme in Bratislava. Bouldering is one of the most social ways to stay active, and we want athme to be the easiest way to find a game and the people to play with.
 You will work directly with bouldering gyms, climbing clubs, organizers, communities, universities, companies, and informal groups to bring more games onto the platform and turn bouldering into one of athme’s strongest categories.
 This is a hands-on role for someone who wants real startup experience and responsibility. You will work closely with the founding team and receive a clear playbook, support, outreach materials, and weekly priorities.
 You are not expected to build everything from scratch. Your job is to execute, learn quickly, build relationships, and help us understand what makes bouldering grow.
 What you will do
 • Find and connect with bouldering gyms, climbing clubs, organizers, communities, universities, companies, and informal groups
 • Help bring new bouldering events and recurring games onto athme
 • Build relationships with hosts, coaches, and community leaders
 • Help existing organizers fill their sessions and grow participation in their events
 • Identify new formats, partnerships, venues, and opportunities for bouldering, such as social climbing sessions, beginner intros, meetups, and bouldering competitions
 • Support and occasionally attend bouldering events in Bratislava
 • Work closely with the athme team on growth, outreach, pricing, and event strategy
 • Collect feedback from players and organizers to improve the bouldering experience
 • Take ownership of growing bouldering participation and revenue over time
 What success looks like
 The goal is simple: make bouldering on athme bigger every month.
 Over time, this means:
 • More bouldering events happening regularly
 • More people trying bouldering for the first time and coming back
 • More active organizers and hosts
 • More players joining and returning
 • Strong partnerships with bouldering clubs and communities
 • Increasing revenue generated by the bouldering category
 • Building a category that becomes increasingly self-sustaining as it grows
 Who we are looking for
 You do not need previous startup or business development experience.
 You could be a strong fit if:
 • You love bouldering or climbing and understand the community around it
 • You enjoy meeting people and building relationships
 • You are comfortable reaching out to organizers and starting conversations
 • You are proactive, reliable, and willing to learn by doing
 • You like taking ownership and seeing measurable results from your work
 • You are interested in startups, marketplaces, community building, or entrepreneurship
 • You are based in Bratislava and can meet organizers and attend events in person
 • You are currently a student and looking for meaningful hands-on experience
 • You speak fluent English, our working language
 Compensation and growth
 We want this role to work for ambitious people who want to grow with athme.
 This role starts as an unpaid student internship. The focus is on gaining hands-on experience, building the category, and proving what works. For the right fit and results, we will create a financial setup around the role.
 This can include revenue share based on the revenue generated by bouldering events, other performance-based compensation, and the possibility of developing the position into a paid, full-time role.
 There is no fixed one-month structure. The setup can evolve depending on your availability, contribution, and the results you create.
 What we offer
 • Play for free at athme events across bouldering, football, padel, volleyball, badminton, and other sports
 • Access to dedicated team sports sessions and activities
 • Be part of a young team that actually spends time together outside work
 • Dedicated team events, sports days, team buildings, and community activities
 • Hands-on experience with business development, marketplaces, events, growth, and community building
 • Real responsibility for growing one of athme’s core sports categories
 • Direct collaboration with the founding team
 • A clear playbook, regular support, and practical guidance
 • Flexibility alongside your studies or other commitments
 • The opportunity to benefit financially from the category you help grow
 • A clear path toward a paid, full-time position for strong performers
 • As athme expands, opportunities to travel, join activities in new cities, and take on larger responsibilities across markets
 • Long-term opportunities to grow into bigger roles within athme

items.desc: OGA Pasión por la tecnología, por los datos y su capacidad de cambiar el mundo. Curiosidad. Flexibilidad. Compromiso. Confianza. Actitud. Positividad. Trabajo en equipo. Somos OGA Nos ilusiona que estés considerando esta oportunidad de empleo. Somos una compañía pionera en la hibridación de la Inteligencia Artificial y la Investigación Operativa, con sede en Sevilla. Nuestro objetivo es transformar la industria a través de soluciones innovadoras y de alto impacto para nuestros clientes, líderes en sectores como el logístico, supply chain, industrial o el químico. Esto lo conseguimos gracias al talento de nuestro equipo, que incluye a matemáticos/as, estadísticos/as o desarrolladores/as de software, entre otros, y a la confianza de grandes clientes. Además, mantenemos una estrecha colaboración con la Universidad a través de nuestro Consejo Asesor Tecnológico, Grupo CÁTEDRA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional, especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, y con el que reforzamos nuestra propuesta y valor científico. Sobre la posición. Buscamos un/a Técnico en Ingeniería de Telecomunicación (o disciplinas afines) para incorporarse a un equipo multidisciplinar dedicado al desarrollo de soluciones avanzadas para el análisis de comunicaciones inalámbricas y extracción de información procedente de distintos sistemas de radiofrecuencia. Formarás parte de un equipo compuesto por desarrolladores de software, especialistas en Inteligencia Artificial y arquitectos de sistemas, aportando tu conocimiento en procesado de señales y tecnologías SDR para convertir emisiones de radio en información útil que posteriormente será tratada mediante algoritmos de análisis e IA. No buscamos un perfil orientado al diseño de hardware RF o antenas, sino una persona con capacidad para analizar señales, comprender su funcionamiento e integrarse con el equipo de desarrollo para construir soluciones software. ¿Qué harás? Capturarás y analizarás señales de radio utilizando plataformas SDR como USRP, HackRF, BladeRF, LimeSDR o similares. Caracterizarás emisiones radioeléctricas identificando parámetros como frecuencia, ancho de banda, modulación, temporización y otras características de la capa física. Diseñarás e implementarás cadenas de recepción y procesado digital de señal para obtener flujos de datos utilizables por el resto del equipo. Colaborarás en el análisis y comprensión de protocolos inalámbricos comerciales y propietarios utilizados en sistemas de comunicaciones. Trabajarás con herramientas como GNU Radio, Universal Radio Hacker (URH), Inspectrum, SigDigger u otras equivalentes para el análisis y decodificación de señales. Desarrollarás utilidades y automatizaciones en Python para facilitar el análisis y tratamiento de señales. Colaborarás estrechamente con los equipos de desarrollo software e Inteligencia Artificial para integrar las cadenas de procesado dentro de las soluciones desarrolladas por OGA. Participarás en la documentación técnica, elaboración de informes y transferencia de conocimiento al resto del equipo. Timing de primeras semanas en OGA Desde tu primer día, estarás acompañado/a por todo el equipo. El área de People organizará una serie de reuniones de Onboarding en tres niveles con distintos responsables de OGA: aspectos generales y sistemas internos, el propósito de la compañía y las tecnologías que utilizamos. También conocerás a tu Buddy, quien te guiará, especialmente en tu primer mes, durante todo el proceso de integración. Junto a tu Buddy, tendrás reuniones programadas para abordar cualquier tema que facilite tu adaptación. ¿Qué requerimos? Titulación en Ingeniería de Telecomunicación, Ingeniería Electrónica, Física o disciplinas afines. Experiencia profesional en análisis de señales radio, SDR o procesado digital de señal, ya sea en entornos profesionales, proyectos de investigación o desarrollos personales demostrables. Conocimientos de radiofrecuencia y comunicaciones digitales. Experiencia utilizando plataformas SDR (USRP, HackRF, RTL-SDR, BladeRF, LimeSDR o similares). Experiencia con herramientas de análisis y procesado de señales como GNU Radio, Universal Radio Hacker (URH), Inspectrum, SigDigger o equivalentes. Conocimientos de modulaciones digitales y analógicas (FSK, PSK, QAM, OFDM, LoRa, entre otras). Conocimientos de programación en Python para automatización y procesado de señales. Capacidad para interpretar señales desconocidas y colaborar en el desarrollo de cadenas de recepción y decodificación. Nivel de inglés medio. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita, capacidad para elaborar documentación técnica y trabajar de forma colaborativa en equipos multidisciplinares. Estar en posesión, o en disposición de obtener, la Habilitación Personal de Seguridad (HPS) con nivel equivalente a NATO SECRET / …

Our AI-powered software makes complex production environments editable, interactive, and collaborative, turning manufacturing planning into something anyone can engage with, not just the experts. We’re looking for a 3D Data Operator to help power the foundation of our digital factory experiences. This is an entry-level role with defined workflows and plenty of support, ideal if you’re starting your career or moving into 3D and tech. No point cloud experience needed, just an eye for detail and curiosity about 3D. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of 3D reality and AI, transforming raw point cloud data into accurate digital twins of real-world production environments. From data preparation to model generation and delivery, you'll help ensure quality, consistency, and continuous improvement across our data pipeline. At a glance: Location: Düsseldorf, hybrid, with regular days in our Düsseldorf office Full time (40h/week), 12-month fixed-term contract Level: entry-level, a first step into 3D data work Your daily work Process 3D scan data (point clouds) and transform it into usable digital factory models using our internal tools and workflows. Run basic pipeline commands for data preparation and AI processing. Configure and verify model outputs to ensure quality, consistency, and usability for downstream applications (e.g., Nvidia Omniverse, Siemens Plant Simulation and others). Collaborate with AI-assisted tools to validate and correct automated results. Flag and troubleshoot anomalies or edge cases in raw or processed data, and document issues clearly (e.g., as Git issues). Track and report your weekly processing output. Continuously improve workflows and documentation based on team feedback and real-world challenges. Comfortable following defined workflows and standards, and asking for help when something is unclear. Team player with a proactive mindset: you enjoy working in a collaborative team. Fast learner: no prior experience with point clouds required; you're comfortable picking up new tools and workflows quickly. Basic digital literacy: you're confident navigating structured software tools, browser-based interfaces and Microsoft Office. Bonus: Familiarity with 3D environments (e.g., through gaming, CAD, or similar), or a general spatial intuition. English is a must; proficiency in German is a plus for clear communication with the team. Right to work in Germany: You already have the right to work full time in Germany. We can’t offer visa sponsorship for this role. Based in or near Düsseldorf: This is a hybrid role with regular days in our Düsseldorf office, so you should be able to commute there regularly. Nice to have Experience with 3D tools or software (e.g., CAD, 3D modelling, game engines) or 3D scan data, or a general spatial intuition. Familiarity with industrial or manufacturing environments, for example through a technical apprenticeship, studies, or work in production or engineering. This is a 12-month fixed-term position, with the opportunity to extend or move to a permanent contract based on performance and business development. items.desc: Die Stadtwerke Düsseldorf AG sind der Energie- und Wasserversorger für weit über eine Million Menschen in Düsseldorf und den angrenzenden Regionen. Immer nah am Kunden arbeiten wir in den Sparten Strom, Erdgas, Fernwärme, Trinkwasser sowie erneuerbare Energien und Entsorgung. Als einer der größten Arbeitgeber und Ausbildungsbetriebe sind wir ein wesentlicher Wirtschaftsfaktor der Region und ein unverzichtbarer Förderer von Kunst, Kultur, Sport und Wissenschaft. Aufgaben Deine Aufgabe umfasst die eigenständige Planung, Konzeption und strategische Weiterentwicklung für das konzernweit eingesetzte Videoüberwachungssystem, IP-Türsprechstellen und Sicherheitsmaßnahmen. Du agierst federführend bei (Bau-)projekten zum Perimeterschutz von der Planung über den Bau bis zum Betrieb bei Kraftwerken, Wasserwerken und weiteren kritischen Infrastrukturen und übernimmst die Portfoliosteuerung. Du verantwortest unternehmensweit den technischen Betrieb, das Monitoring (abgebildet über Checkmk), die Administration und Entstörung von Videoüberwachungsanlagen sowie die Betreuung vom Kamera-, Server- und Videomanagementsystemen. Dabei erstellst und pflegst du sowohl Betriebsdokumentationen, -handbücher sowie Systemdokumentationen und arbeitest dafür unter anderem mit CAD-Applikationen (wie bspw. AutoCAD). Des Weiteren bewertest du technische Lösungen hinsichtlich Wirtschaftlichkeit, Verfügbarkeit und Betriebssicherheit. Du konzipierst und planst passende Lösungen, erstellst Liefer- und Leistungsbeschreibungen inklusive Kalkulationen, wirkst beim Vergabeprozess mit und begleitest die anschließende Ausführung sowie die Bau-Inbetriebnahme. Du fungierst als zentraler Ansprechpartner für konzerninterne Stabsstellen und Institutionen wie dem Datenschutz, Betriebsrat, Einkauf, Konzernsicherheit und Fachbereiche. Darüber hinaus steuerst du externe Dienstleister, Hersteller und Servicepartner und hast Budgetverantwortung für deine Assets. Profil Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Diplom / Master) im Bereich Informatik, Nachrichtentechnik, Elektrotechnik, Informationstechnik, vergleichbare Qualifikation oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit langjähriger, praktischer Berufserfahrung im Bereich der Sicherheitstechnik bildet die theoretische Basis. Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb technischer Sicherheits- oder Kommunikationssysteme und bringst Erfahrung in der Errichtung von Sicherheitsanlagen sowie in der Erstellung von Sicherheitskonzepten mit. Außerdem besitzt du Kenntnisse in mehreren der folgenden Themengebiete: Videoüberwachungssysteme, Perimeterschutz, Sicherheitstechnik, Netzwerktechnik + IT-Security, IP-Kommunikationssysteme, KRITIS-Umfeld, ISMS / ISO 27001. Des Weiteren bringst du Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Herstellern, Dienstleistern und Fachbereichen mit und bist motiviert das Produktportfolio stetig weiterzuentwickeln. Deine ausgeprägten analytischen und konzeptionellen Fähigkeiten verbindest du mit Kommunikations- und Moderationsstärke. Komplexe technische Sachverhalte vermittelst du verständlich und arbeitest eigeninitiativ, strukturiert sowie lösungsorientiert. Strategisches Denken und die Bereitschaft Verantwortung zu übernehmen runden dein Profil ab. Wir bieten Wir fördern und entwickeln Talente Voller Einsatz, aber mit weniger Stunden Individuelle Entwicklung statt nur Weiterbildung Mehr als sechs Wochen Urlaub Auszeit von bis zu drei Monaten zusätzlich Und viele weitere Benefits Important note Please be advised that a valid work permit for Germany is required for non-EU citizens. Unfortunately, applications without a valid work permit and sufficient German language skills may not be considered. LNKD1_DE

items.desc: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. As a Forward Deployed Software Engineer, you'll spend your time writing code. You'll work with partner technical teams and end users to understand what they actually need, then design and build the solution yourself: architecture, implementation, testing, deployment. You'll be close enough to the mission to see why the problem matters, and you'll ship fast, because what you build gets used in the field almost immediately. Once a solution proves itself, you'll work with our core platform team to fold the durable parts back into the product, so your work keeps paying off beyond the deployment you built it for. Responsibilities Design and build software applications that solve specific operational problems for our partners, owning them end-to-end from architecture through deployment. Take loosely defined, real-world requirements from partner militaries and organizations and turn them into working software, often on tight timelines. Build interfaces and connectors between our platforms and partner systems, and validate data flows end-to-end in the field. Deploy your solutions on site, gather feedback directly from operators, and iterate quickly based on what you see working (or not) in practice. Spot patterns and capabilities worth building into the core product, and work with our platform engineering team to get them there. Debug issues in live operational settings, drive them to resolution, and document what you learn along the way. Build real working relationships with client technical teams and end users so you understand their problems well enough to solve them properly. Requirements 4+ years building and shipping production software, in Python and at least one lower-level language (C++, Rust, Go). A track record of defining and building end-to-end systems: projects, internships, or early-career work where you took an ambiguous problem to a working, deployed solution. Comfortable owning software end-to-end — design, build, debug, deploy — including on Linux, in operational or field conditions. Confident and clear communicating with client technical teams and senior stakeholders, with a bias to action Practical under constraint: ill-defined problems, tight deadlines, and a working solution over a theoretically perfect one. Travel: frequent on site with partners, domestic and international. Proficiency in English is mandatory. Nice to have Prior forward-deployed, solutions engineering, or customer-facing engineering experience. Depth in computer vision, deep learning, mission planning, robotics, or embedded software. Degree from a leading engineering school. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

items.desc: Die Stelle ist ab 1. Januar 2027 in Teilzeitbeschäftigung mit 26 Wochenstaunden für 3 Jahre befristet zu besetzen. Die Vergütung erfolgt nach den Eingruppierungsvorschriften des Tarifvertrages für den öffentlichen Dienst (TV-L) und ist bei Vorliegen der persönlichen Voraussetzungen in der Entgeltgruppe E13 möglich. Das Schneider Lab erforscht, wie die Kommunikation zwischen Organen sowie neuronale, immunologische und metabolische Regelkreise chronische Lebererkrankungen und Leberkrebs beeinflussen. Die Forschung bewegt sich an der Schnittstelle von Hepatologie, Neurobiologie, Immunologie und Systemmedizin. Sie kombiniert modernste experimentelle Krankheitsmodelle mit räumlichen und Einzelzell-Technologien, fortschrittlichen bildgebenden Verfahren, molekularer Profilierung sowie translationalen Studien, die auf gut charakterisierten Patientenkohorten und menschlichem Probenmaterial basieren. Die Doktorandenstelle ist in das ERC Starting Grant-Projekt LIVER-CIRCUITS eingebettet, das die Regulation von Entstehung, Verlauf und zellulärer Organisation von Lebererkrankungen durch das Nervensystem erforscht. Ein besonderer Fokus liegt auf dem Verständnis der Wechselwirkungen neuronaler Signale mit Immun-, Stromazellen und Epithelzellen im Lebermikromilieu und deren Einfluss auf Geweberegeneration und Krankheitsverlauf. Das geplante Promotionsprojekt nutzt komplementäre genetische, pharmakologische und funktionelle Ansätze, um leberassoziierte neuronale Schaltkreise zu kartieren und zu beeinflussen, ihre zellulären und molekularen Folgeeffekte zu definieren und ihre Relevanz für menschliche Erkrankungen zu bestimmen. Experimentelle Modelle werden mit Technologien wie räumlicher Transkriptomik, Einzelzellprofilierung, fortgeschrittener Mikroskopie und der Analyse menschlicher Gewebeproben integriert. Das übergeordnete Ziel ist die Identifizierung bisher unbekannter neuronaler Schaltkreise im Lebermikromilieu. L’objectif de la mission est de concevoir et de déployer des modèles numériques prédictifs afin de simuler l'évolution, le vieillissement et la dégradation de matrices complexes au contact de milieux réactifs et biologiques. Objectifs &
items.desc: Au sein de l'équipe Recherche Avancée d'un grand groupe industriel, vous intervenez sur un projet stratégique axé sur l'écoconception et les matériaux de nouvelle génération. L’objectif de la mission est de concevoir et de déployer des modèles numériques prédictifs afin de simuler l'évolution, le vieillissement et la dégradation de matrices complexes au contact de milieux réactifs et biologiques. Objectifs & Livrables En interface directe avec les experts R&D (spécialistes matériaux, chimistes, ingénieurs procédés), vous assurez : Développement de modèles prédictifs multi-échelles : Modélisation couplée associant mécanique des milieux continus, cinétique réactionnelle et phénomènes de transport (diffusion de masse, gradients de concentration). Implémentation via des codes de calcul par éléments finis (FEA) et/ou approches hybrides associant physique et Machine Learning (PINNs, surrogate models). Compréhension des phénomènes d'interface : Modélisation des mécanismes de surface : dégradation, adhésion, sorption/désorption et transferts de matière. Exploitation et intégration des données expérimentales (chimie analytique, spectrométrie, caractérisations de surface) pour le calage et la validation des modèles. Aide à la décision & valorisation scientifique : Restitution des résultats de simulation sous forme de critères de design exploitables par les équipes de formulation. Rédaction de la documentation technique et contribution aux collaborations scientifiques externes. Profil candidat: Formation : Ingénieur ou Docteur (PhD) en Mécanique, Génie des procédés, Physique des matériaux ou Mathématiques appliquées. Compétences clés : Maîtrise éprouvée de la modélisation multiphysique (couplage transport / réaction / mécanique). Pratique solide de la simulation numérique et du scripting scientifique (Python, C++, MATLAB, solveurs éléments finis). Intérêt ou expérience dans les méthodes d'hybridation physique-IA (Machine Learning appliqué à la physique). Sensibilité à l'interaction entre simulation et essais physico-chimiques expérimentaux. Savoir-être : Capacité à travailler en autonomie au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires, esprit d'analyse et aisance de communication avec des spécialistes aux horizons variés.

items.desc: VisionSpace is a dynamic and experienced consulting, technology and engineering service business that develops and integrates enterprise-level solutions for Space and Defense.
