items.desc: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Locations: Austin TX, Champaign IL, Lisbon Portugal, London England, Atlanta GA, Washington DC, About The Team Cloudflare is redefining the way networks are run at scale, and some of the largest networks in the world now run their traffic through us. Cloudflare's network runs in hundreds of cities on general-purpose Linux servers, not dedicated routers, so the routers, firewalls, load balancers, and proxies that carry our customers' traffic are software that we write, ship, and operate ourselves. Our Packet Processing team builds and operates that software: high-performance code that processes customer traffic at the packet level as it moves through Cloudflare's network, in every Cloudflare data center. That includes the L4 load balancer at the front door of every server, a per-customer routing and forwarding data plane, a stateful network firewall, and a TCP/UDP reverse proxy (the engines behind products like Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare Network Firewall, and Spectrum). We are a team of engineers who obsess over performance, correctness, and reliability at massive scale. We own what we build in production, a lot of our work happens close to the kernel and the NIC. About The Role For us, performance is a product feature. Customers notice single-flow throughput, packet loss, and latency right away, and every CPU cycle we spend on a packet is multiplied across every server in our network. We're looking for engineers who love finding out where the time goes, and then making it go away. Some of the things you'd work on: Pushing single large flows (e.g., one tunnel carrying a customer's whole data center) to multiple Gbps and beyond, and making that performance consistent Finding out exactly where packets get dropped and why: NIC queues, interrupts and softirq, XDP, veth and namespaces, userspace rings, and everything in between CPU placement: NUMA, RSS, core isolation, and steering traffic to the right cores on servers that also run many other services Cutting the CPU cost per packet in hot paths written in Rust, C, and Go: batching, cache-friendly data structures, fewer copies, fewer locks Measuring all of it: profiling with perf, eBPF tracing, and flame graphs; continuous profiling across the fleet; benchmarks in the lab and careful experiments in production Building the benchmark and test tooling that keeps performance regressions from shipping Helping shape a unified data plane platform so that it's fast from the start We write mostly Go and Rust (plus C for eBPF) on Linux, and the work ranges from NIC configuration and the kernel network stack to userspace packet pipelines. You'll build, deploy, and operate these systems on top of one of the largest edge networks in the world. You'll partner with some of the best engineers and product managers, on our team and across Cloudflare, to solve big problems that have a meaningful impact in the lives of our customers and users. We're looking for curious, empathetic engineers who are excited to join us in changing the way networking is done! Examples Of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, And Experience Systems programming experience in Rust, Go, C, or C++ Performance analysis on Linux: perf, eBPF-based tracing (e.g., bpftrace, BCC), flame graphs, hardware counters A working model of modern CPUs and memory: caches, NUMA, branch prediction, SIMD, and how they show up in a profile Knowledge of how packets move through Linux: NIC queues, RSS, NAPI, …

items.desc: We are looking to appoint a Technical Specialist who will be based at our Electrical Engineering Building in West Cambridge to provide highly specialist technical support to enable the effective operation of the LiFi Research & Development Centre (LRDC). Reporting to the Director of the LRDC & Titan Hub, you will be laboratory-based and the role will underpin the delivery of high-quality experimental research by providing tailored, highly specialist technical guidance and support to researchers and students. You will contribute to the development of new experimental methodologies and techniques to support the effective use of the facility and manage day-to-day laboratory operations, ensuring that facilities, equipment, safety systems and technical processes operate efficiently, reliably and in compliance with institutional and regulatory standards. Experimental or industrial development experience is necessary. Working closely with academic staff, researchers and students, the role-holder will enable the successful design, execution and documentation of complex experimental activities. Providing equipment construction and testing services within the Department, the role contributes directly to the Department's research objectives by supporting the efficient and effective delivery of research projects. The successful applicant will hold a degree in a relevant research area/ Level 6 vocational qualifications or possess an equivalent level of practical experience. You will need to demonstrate advanced knowledge of electrical, electronics, photonics, or optics technical work with the ability to operate specialist experimental equipment, such as VNA, waveform generator, oscilloscope, beam profiler, etc. You will have strong written and verbal communication skills and good knowledge of relevant software for circuit analysis/design, optical ray tracing, FPGA programming, or similar. You will have proven practical and experimental experience of dealing with a variety of research projects and communicating research results to a wide variety of audiences as well as experience of implementing health and safety requirements within a research environment. Previous experience of providing training to groups and individuals is also a requirement for this role. If you think you are the right candidate for the role, we would love to hear from you. items.desc: Das Fraunhofer IGCV betreibt produktionstechnische Forschung und Entwicklung mit direktem Anwendungsbezug und bündelt Know-how in den Bereichen Leichtbau-Gusstechnologien, Faserverbundwerkstoffe und intelligent vernetzte Produktion. Die über 120 Wissenschaftlerinnen und Wissenschaftler des Augsburger Instituts generieren Innovationen für die deutsche Industrie. Was Sie bei uns tun Wie lassen sich Materialflüsse für die Batteriezellproduktion der Zukunft gestalten? Und wie können digitale Fabrikmodelle die Planung und Bewertung von Produktionssystemen unterstützen? In der Abteilung „ Nachhaltige Fabrikplanung und -betrieb “ entwickeln wir innovative Ansätze zur Gestaltung und Bewertung von Produktionssystemen. Unsere Forschungsgruppe „ Kollaborative Fabrikplanung “ vernetzt Planungsbeteiligte und digitale Werkzeuge, um Fabriken ganzheitlich zu planen und kurzzyklisch anzupassen. Dafür arbeiten wir mit Unternehmen aus der Luftfahrt, der Automobilindustrie, dem Maschinenbau, der verarbeitenden Industrie und der Softwareentwicklung zusammen. Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir wissenschaftliche Unterstützung mit Promotionsabsicht. Was Sie mitbringen Sie bearbeiten anwendungsnahe Forschungs- und Industrieprojekte und entwickeln Methoden für eine effiziente, nachhaltige und digital unterstützte Fabrikplanung. Ihren fachlichen Schwerpunkt gestalten wir entsprechend Ihren Vorkenntnissen und Forschungsinteressen innerhalb der Materialflusssimulation und der digitalen Fabrikmodellierung. Besonders freuen wir uns über Erfahrung in der Materialflusssimulation mit Plant Simulation sowie Interesse an Building Information Modeling (BIM), NVIDIA Omniverse und Universal Scene Description (USD). Interesse an der Bestandsdigitalisierung von Fabriken mittels Laserscanning und Punktwolkenverarbeitung ist ebenfalls willkommen. abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium in Maschinenbau, Produktionstechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Produktionsinformatik, Informatik, Betriebswissenschaften oder vglb. Interesse an digitaler Fabrikplanung mit Fokus auf Materialflusssimulation und digitale Fabrikmodelle Idealerweise praktische Erfahrung mit Plant Simulation oder vergleichbaren Werkzeugen zur diskreten Materialflusssimulation sowie Interesse an Logistik und Batteriezellproduktion Interesse an BIM und USD; optional auch an der Bestandsdigitalisierung von Fabriken mittels Laserscanning und Punktwolkenverarbeitung Interesse an der Akquisition, Durchführung und Leitung von Forschungs- und Industrieprojekten im produktionstechnischen Umfeld Freude an wissenschaftlichem Arbeiten, Lernbereitschaft und die Absicht, im Bereich Materialflusssimulation und digitale Fabrikmodelle zu promovieren Von Vorteil sind erste Erfahrungen im Produktions- oder Planungsumfeld sowie Kenntnisse in Programmierung, Datenanalyse oder digitaler Fabrikmodellierung Teamfähigkeit, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und hohe Einsatzbereitschaft Spaß an anwendungsnaher Forschung und dem Finden von kreativen Lösungen Reisebereitschaft Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und fließendes Englisch Was Sie erwarten können Schwerpunkt Materialflusssimulation und Batteriezellproduktion: Sie entwickeln durchgängige Logistikkonzepte für eine agile Batteriezellproduktion mit Mini-Environments – lokal eingehausten Produktionsbereichen mit kontrollierter Atmosphäre. Dazu erstellen Sie diskrete Materialflusssimulationen mit Plant Simulation, modellieren Transport-, Lager- und Pufferprozesse und untersuchen die Schnittstellen zwischen den Produktionsbereichen. Sie verknüpfen das Logistikmodell mit weiteren digitalen Modellen und bewerten Konzeptvarianten hinsichtlich logistischer Leistungsfähigkeit, Flexibilität, Wirtschaftlichkeit und ökologischer Auswirkungen. Digitale Fabrikmodelle und vernetzte Planungswerkzeuge: Sie entwickeln und verknüpfen digitale Fabrikmodelle zur Unterstützung der Fabrik- und Logistikplanung. Dabei beschäftigen Sie sich mit BIM, USD, sowie mit der Verknüpfung räumlicher Fabrikmodelle und Materialflusssimulationen. Gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern untersuchen und erproben Sie Ansätze für eine durchgängige digitale Modellbasis zur Planung und Bewertung von Fabriken. Je nach Forschungsinteresse können Sie sich ergänzend mit der Bestandsdigitalisierung von Fabriken mittels Laserscanning und der Verarbeitung von Punktwolken zur Erstellung und Aktualisierung digitaler Fabrikmodelle befassen. Sie arbeiten eng mit Forschungs- und Industriepartnern zusammen, übernehmen Verantwortung für die Durchführung und Koordination von Projekten und veröffentlichen Ihre Ergebnisse in wissenschaftlichen Fachmedien sowie auf Konferenzen. Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt …

items.desc: Lieu : La Ferté-Saint-Aubin, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée Un package de rémunération attractif Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu Votre quotidien Au sein de l’activité Véhicules et Systèmes Tactiques, le site de La Ferté Saint Aubin est spécialisé dans la production de systèmes d’armements terrestres et aéroportés (mortiers, munitions, roquettes…), de systèmes de protection des forces et de contrôle de zone. Fort de ses 450 salariés, ingénieurs, techniciens et ouvriers spécialisés, le site de la Ferté Saint Aubin assure la recherche et développement, la production, les essais ainsi que toutes les fonctions « supports » nécessaires à la conception de systèmes performants essentiels à la réussite des missions opérationnelles. Thales a constitué, avec le groupe allemand de défense DIEHL, une Joint-Venture « JUNGHANS T2M » qui compte 165 salariés permettant aux deux entreprises d’associer leurs compétences d’électronique et de mécanique de précision et de devenir ainsi un des leaders mondiaux dans le domaine des fusées de munitions. Cette Joint-Venture est présente également sur le site de La Ferté saint Aubin. Dans le cadre du développement, de l’industrialisation et de la qualification de nouvelles munitions, vous êtes le garant de la spécification technique, de la conception détaillée, du codage, de la vérification des exigences et des performances des logiciels placés sous votre responsabilité par l’ingénieur logiciel en charge de ces munitions. Ces logiciels, implantés sur des calculateurs embarqués spécifiques, peuvent mettre en œuvre différentes fonctions de navigation, guidage/pilotage, calcul balistique, communication, asservissement ou interface homme/machine. Afin de mener à bien vos missions, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les différents intervenants des services du Centre de Compétence Ingénierie (Ingénierie Système, Electronique…). Vos Missions Vous êtes responsable de la tenue des objectifs en termes de coût, délai et qualité de la partie logicielle qui vous incombe. Vous optimisez un développement complexe combinant différentes technologies logicielles et matérielles. Vous saurez aussi vous adapter au processus imposé par la criticité du logiciel à développer (déclinaison des spécifications systèmes en spécifications logicielles puis rédaction des plans de tests et fiches associées, descriptif fonctionnel du logiciel). Votre profil Vous avez l’ambition et l’envie de vous épanouir au cœur du développement logiciel embarqué ? Vous disposez d’un diplôme d’ingénieur ou équivalent Bac+5 et : Vous justifiez d’une expérience d’un an minimum dans le développement logiciel Vous maîtrisez les langages objet usuels (C, C++, Qt, Java…) et les environnements de développement (Visual Studio, Eclipse, Qt Creat) Vous êtes à l’aise avec les OS standards (Windows XP/Seven Embedded, Linux Debian ou Ubuntu, Android…) Vous savez rédiger des spécifications logicielles, des plans de tests logiciels et décliner des spécifications systèmes L’esprit d’écoute et de synthèse, la rigueur et la ténacité ainsi que le sens du relationnel sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait ? Alors rejoignez- nous ! Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous ! Le poste pouvant nécessiter d'accéder à des informations relevant du secret de la défense nationale, la personne retenue fera l'objet d'une procédure d’habilitation, conformément aux dispositions des articles R.2311-1 et suivants du Code de la défense et de l’IGI 1300 SGDSN/PSE du 09 août 2021.

We describe our culture as dynamic, open, proactive, with a 'can do' attitude, an obsession to win, high flexibility, and being close to our customers. Placement Development Programme We are offering an exciting opportunity to be part of our Placement Development Programme within our Research and Development teams. The roles available encompass hardware and software development opportunities and activities, along with component and system testing in an automotive environment. As a placement engineer, you will have the opportunity to apply new concepts and ideas, learn new development tools, avail yourself of our highly specialized laboratories and gain technical knowledge to develop your career in these exciting fields of engineering. Roles Available We are currently recruiting for a range of roles which include Systems Verification, Hardware, Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC), Mechatronics, and Technology Development across our Newtownabbey site. Tasks/Learning Opportunities Understand how the hardware blocks within our products work together to provide a system-level solution. Perform testing on our current and future products portfolio using Laboratory measurement equipment and our fleet of test vehicles. Full training will be provided. Appreciation that specification and testing have a key relationship in a successful product – defining tests to exercise new hardware. Testing sensors using our full suite of laboratory equipment. Provide support to other teams, liaising with ASIC software and verification teams. Undertake a long-term Research & Development project to increase your knowledge base and add a current gap within the team. Coding to facilitate automated testing. Planning and execution of testing designs and efficient recording and communication of the results to remove defects. Training in PCB Layout Techniques and core EMC Design Principles you will be given an invaluable toolset for your future career. Embedded software design. Component sourcing. PC Application Development. Essential Criteria Currently working towards any relevant engineering degree. High calibre students with drive, enthusiasm and ambition. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Proven ability to work both individually and as part of a team. What Do We Offer? Intern programme. A friendly, open culture where you will work with people from all over the world. Work with skilled subject matter experts. People committed to finding solutions for tough technical and business challenges. A culture where results and performance matter. We are committed, but also take the time to celebrate milestones and get to know each other outside of work. Work with state-of-the-art tools and processes on diverse projects with real-world applications. Additional Information Start times from 7:30 to 9:30 (fully flexible). 33 Days Holidays (pro-rata). Enrolment onto our Placement Programme. Free onsite parking. Sensata is committed to the provision of training and development opportunities. A comprehensive Induction programme is also available to all our new placement students. Please note that all successful candidates must undergo a medical examination which includes a drugs test. Smarter Together Collaborating at Sensata means working with some of the world's most talented people in an enriching environment that is constantly pushing towards the next best thing. Employees work across functions, countries, and cultures gaining new perspectives through mutual respect and open communication. As OneSensata, we are working together to make things work together.

items.desc: Modelling modern weapon systems comes with many unique challenges. As a model developer, you will be working with highly sophisticated models, built up of multiple interdependent subsystems, to provide an accurate representation of the weapon system being used in real-world engagements. This means you'll often encounter new and exciting problems requiring your intuition and innovation to solve. Salary £24,460 Dynamic working The majority of your time you’ll be working onsite in an office environment with a team of people around you to support you with your work. Security clearance British Citizen or a Dual UK national with British citizenship. Restrictions and/or limitations relating to nationality and/or rights to work may apply. As a minimum and after offer stage, all successful candidates will need to undergo HMG Basic Personnel Security Standard checks (BPSS), which are managed by the MBDA Personnel Security Team. Application Deadline This role is scheduled to close for applications at midnight on Monday 4th January 2027 but may close earlier depending on application volumes. What We Can Offer You 1 year placement: starting September 2027, that allows you to apply your university learning to real-world projects and technologies. Perform well on your placement and you could secure a graduate role before your final year. Company bonus: based on company performance and will vary year to year. Pension: maximum total (employer and employee) contribution of up to 14%. Overtime: opportunity for paid overtime. Healthcare Cash Plan: provides support with everyday health related costs – including medical, dental, optical, physio and health & wellbeing. Annual Leave: 25 days plus option to purchase extra holiday. Flexi Leave: up to 15 additional days. Facilities: fantastic site facilities including subsidised meals, free car parking and much more. The opportunity System modelling is a vital tool used to ensure MBDA provides reliable and cost-effective weapon systems to our customers! We build a variety of dynamic system performance models, embedded systems, and real-time models for MBDA products. Our models are developed and used extensively throughout the product lifecycle, from concept through to in-service support. When used internally, our performance models allow our system designers to estimate performance, which they can use to guide the product design. For our customer, performance models provide a method of verifying system performance whilst reducing reliance on prohibitively expensive testing and trials. Our real-time models contribute to training environments for pilots and provide a variety of engineering testing capabilities. Once the product is in service, the customer continues to use our models to understand system capability and assist with operator training. Models of modern weapon systems are made up of a large number of automated subsystems integrated together to provide the overall capability. This provides unique challenges when developing accurate system - or system of system level - models that are both large in scale and highly sophisticated with many interdependencies; or when developing lower fidelity models designed to run at real time whilst maintaining an accurate representation of the weapon system. As a model developer, this means you’ll often encounter new and exciting problems which will require you to apply your intuition and innovation to solve. Programming Languages/Environments Mathworks (MATLAB, Simulink and Stateflow) Fortran C/C++ Our teams implement Agile working practices and dynamic working across multiple projects to meet demand, aided by the use of collaborative tools. We also work closely with other departments and companies to integrate subsystem models and design data. From these interactions you’ll gain a broad understanding of each subsystem that makes up the weapon and how the system architecture makes these subsystems work together to provide an overall capability. This role is best suited to those interested in mathematical modelling and programming, are passionate about solving complex problems within highly technical teams and enjoy working in a supportive environment. What We’re Looking For From You Current undergraduate studying towards a degree in an Engineering discipline (incl. General, Mechanical, Manufacturing/Production, Aeronautical/Aerospace, Software), or Mathematics, Physics, Computing or Natural Science field. Our Company Peace is not a given, Freedom is not a given, Sovereignty is not a given. MBDA is a leading defence organisation. We are proud of the role we play in supporting the Armed Forces who protect our nations. We partner with governments to work together towards a common goal, defending our freedom. items.desc:
¡Hola! 
 Soy Leyre, recruiter de esta posición. Me encanta escribir y leer historias de terror, pero de lo que más disfruto es de una buena comida familiar con las personas que más quiero. Si te gusta la música de los setenta y ochenta tanto como a mí, ¡conectaremos seguro! 
 Quizás somos la décima oferta que lees hoy, en el sofá con Netflix de fondo, o en pleno proceso de cambios… y todas te parecen iguales.   
 ¡Te seré clara, en Zurich no somos perfectos, pero molamos bastante! Y si quieres saber por qué, sigue leyendo.   
 Antes de nada, GRACIAS por interesarte en nuestra compañía. Sabemos que la búsqueda de nuevas oportunidades suele ser un reto, pero… ¡no te preocupes que todo llega!   
 ¡Vayamos al grano! Intentaré resumirte en 2 puntos nuestro ADN: 
 Nos encanta el voluntariado, pero preferimos ser activistas del cambio . ¿Cómo? Poniendo nuestro foco en jóvenes que están en riesgo de exclusión social o luchando contra el cambio climático con acciones como la reforestación de bosques en Madrid y en el Parque de Doñana. En 2025 hicimos más de 28.000 horas de activismo. 
 En Zurich, lo decimos alto y claro: estamos orgullosos de nuestros colores y creemos que un equipo diverso marca la diferencia. Aquí no hablamos de discapacidad, hablamos de habilidad. Que puedas ser tú mismo/a es nuestra prioridad , sin armarios que se interpongan entre nosotros y sin techos de cristal. El 50% de nuestros puestos de responsabilidad están ocupados por mujeres (incluido el Comité de Dirección). ¿Sabes que producimos nuestros propios podcasts sobre identidad sexual? Estamos construyendo una compañía en la que todas las personas son bienvenidas. 
 Y te preguntarás: Leyre, ¿cómo será mi día a día con la camiseta azul? Me encanta que me hagas esta pregunta (yo también me la hice en su momento): 
 Formarás parte de un equipo que está impulsando proyectos de Inteligencia Artificial en el área de Cliente . Tu misión principal será validar que las respuestas que nos dan nuestros modelos de IA son lo que esperamos. Para conseguirlo: 
 Analizarás discrepancias, detectarás oportunidades de mejora y colaborarás con los equipos de desarrollo para que los modelos entiendan cada vez mejor nuestras necesidades. 
 También serás una de las personas encargadas de asegurarte de que todo sigue funcionando como debe, identificando posibles incidencias y contribuyendo a que nuestras soluciones sigan aportando valor día tras día. 
 Además, te incorporarás a un equipo con alta carga analítica por lo que también darás soporte en la realización de análisis específicos. 
 A estas alturas, te estarás preguntando, ¿cómo sé si encajo? 
 No te preocupes, no te voy a pedir que salves el planeta ni que cumplas el 100% de los requisitos. Creemos que puedes encajar si: 
 Estudiante de ADE, Economía, Sociología o titulaciones afines. 
 Capacidad analítica y pensamiento crítico para identificar patrones, tendencias y oportunidades de mejora a partir de datos e información cualitativa. 
 Habilidad para analizar, clasificar y estructurar grandes volúmenes de información procedente de textos, conversaciones y otros contenidos, manteniendo criterios consistentes de categorización. 
 Atención al detalle y capacidad para detectar discrepancias , errores o comportamientos no esperados en los resultados obtenidos. 
 Interés por la Inteligencia Artificial, el análisis de datos y la mejora continua de procesos . 
 Nivel avanzado de Excel para el análisis y tratamiento de información. 
 Capacidad de organización, autonomía y rigor en la ejecución de tareas analíticas. 
 Valorable buen nivel de inglés. 
 ¿Te interesa? Estamos deseando conocerte, pero antes tienes que saber…   
 Se requiere poder realizar un convenio de colaboración con la Universidad y/o Escuela de Negocios de un mínimo de 6 meses con posibilidad de extensión. 
 No paramos de crecer y si esto funciona, ¡nos encantaría contar contigo!   
 Jornada parcial (5h/día de lunes a viernes). 
 La ubicación será en nuestras oficinas de Madrid. 
 Son prácticas remuneradas de 800€.    
 Además, tendrás acceso a formación, ¡y mucho más!   
 Ahora mismo, o estás con la emoción de cuando un pantalón te entra perfecto o estás pensando: “esto no es para mí” (si no es para ti, no pasa nada, ya nos volveremos a encontrar en el futuro). Puedes hacer de celestina compartiendo mi contacto con quien creas que pueda encajar. 
 Si has llegado hasta aquí, GRACIAS por leerme. ¿Qué te ha parecido? ¿Molamos o no? Si has sentido mariposas en el estómago y crees que encajamos, manda señales de humo, o el CV, si no te va bien lo del humo. 
 Y para ir terminando, ¿quieres saber qué opinan otras personas que forman parte de Zurich? Yo te diría que seguimos estando en lo más alto en Top Employers España como carta de presentación, pero te animo a echar un vistazo a nuestro perfil de Glassdoor para que sean ellas quiénes te lo cuenten. Sin trampa ni cartón. 
 Espero conocerte muy pronto. 
 Leyre Romea

 Zentrale Abrechnung Werkstätte (w/m/x). 
 Wien Heiligenstadt. 
 Vollzeit.

 Eigenverantwortliche Bearbeitung von Werkstattaufträgen.
 Erstellung und Prüfung von Rechnungen auf Basis der reparaturbezogenen Leistungen.
 Direkte Abwicklung von Gewährleistungsfällen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Hersteller, inklusive der erforderlichen Dokumentation.

 Hinweis: Bitte bewirb dich ausschließlich online über unser Karriereportal. Bewerbungen auf anderen Kanälen (insb. auch E-Mail) können nicht berücksichtigt werden .

 Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung in der KFZ-Branche.
 Berufserfahrung als KFZ-Techniker*in, Serviceberater*in oder vergleichbarer Position. 
 Idealweiser erste Erfahrung mit Dealer-Management-Systemen wie Incadea/Navision oder SAP.
 Gute EDV-Kenntnisse mit Lernbereitschaft.
 Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
 Sorgfältiges, genaues und selbstständiges Arbeiten.
 Was bieten wir dir? 
 Hauseigene Kantine mit Frühstücks - & Mittagsangebot.
 Mitarbeiterrabatte bei Fahrzeugerwerb (Kauf, Miete, Leasing, Kredit).
 Maßgeschneiderte Aus - und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb der gesamten BMW Group.

 Gestützte Parkgarage bzw. Öffi-Ticket Vergünstigung .

Anstellungsart: befristet bis März 2029 
Arbeitszeit: 38,5 Stunden

items.desc: **Please apply with an English resumé!** Do you want to change how the world creates? At Formlabs, we're building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we're helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before. As the dedicated Field Service Engineer for Formlabs, you will be the primary technical point of contact and face of our company across the DACH region and beyond. This is a role where you will be traveling 80% or more of the time. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of the customer's on-site experience: from the initial installation and commissioning of equipment to delivering comprehensive user training and performing critical repairs. You are not just fixing machines; you are empowering customers to use them. We're a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you're ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us. The Challenge: Installation & Customer Training (On-Site) Equipment Installation: Travel to customer sites to unpack, install, commission, and calibrate new 3D printing systems. User Training: Conduct structured on-site training sessions for new and existing customers. You will teach them how to operate the machinery, utilize software, and perform basic maintenance. Demonstrations: Perform live product demos to inspire confidence in the technology and ensure the customer team is fully up to speed. Break-Fix & Maintenance (On-Site) Rapid Response: Act as a deployable resource for customers facing downtime, often traveling on short notice to perform urgent repairs. Preventative Maintenance: Manage a schedule of annual maintenance visits, ensuring all warrantied customers are serviced within their 90-day target window. Troubleshooting: Employ critical thinking to diagnose electromechanical issues and achieve "single visit resolutions" to minimize travel and downtime. Logistics & Reporting Visit Volume: Execute a high volume of activity. Travel Management: Independently manage a complex travel schedule (flights, trains, hotels, rental cars) and submit expenses on time. Documentation: Maintain meticulous records of installations, training sessions completed, and repairs in Salesforce. Your Profile: You are based in Munich - or within a 45-minute drive (highly preferred due to hub connectivity). You are energized by travel and willing to be on the road 80%+ of the time. You have a strong technical background (electromechanical/hardware) and the soft skills required to teach others how to use that technology. Fluency in German and English (both C1) . You can explain complex technical concepts simply and effectively in German and English. Valid driver's license is required. Bonus Skills: Fluency in French Passion for 3D printing and emerging technologies Experience in rapidly-growing startup environments Our Perks: Shares in the company (we're a double unicorn company!) Cosa possiamo offrirti: Formazione per sviluppare ed aggiornare competenze specialistiche ed attitudini personali Clima di lavoro informale e collaborativo Work-life balance Convenzioni e Benefit Stipendio commisurato alle competenze di cui sei in possesso Possibilità di crescita e realizzazione professionale Consigli per una candidatura efficace: Nella prima fase, dalla selezione alla formazione iniziale, è difficile valutare le hard skills, pertanto sarà il tuo Curriculum Vitae ad evidenziarle. Assicurati che sia completo ed accurato. Accanto a queste vi sono anche molte altre skills che contano: ecco perché ti raccomandiamo di inviarci, insieme al CV, una lettera di presentazione in cui potrai raccontarci le esperienze di studio e lavorative (anche quelle non strettamente attinenti all’informatica), caratteristiche della tua personalità, atteggiamenti e abilità sociali e comunicative. Implantés dans le Grand Ouest, nous sommes présents à Nantes, Paris, Niort, Brest, Bordeaux et Rennes. Et parce que la RSE est inscrite dans notre ADN depuis le premier jour, nous sommes fiers d'être certifiés entreprise exemplaire par l'AFNOR, selon la norme ISO 26000. Description du poste Quel sera ton poste ? Poste : Architecte Stockage & Virtualisation H/F Lieu : Nantes ou Rennes Télétravail : Flexible Contrat : CDI ou Portage Contexte client : Tu rejoins un acteur majeur évoluant dans un environnement IT complexe et critique, engagé dans la modernisation, l'optimisation et la sécurisation de ses infrastructures d'hébergement. Dans un contexte de transformation et d'évolution continue des plateformes techniques, tu interviendras sur des infrastructures à forte volumétrie où les enjeux de disponibilité, de performance et de résilience sont au cœur des préoccupations. En tant qu'Architecte Stockage & Virtualisation, tu apporteras ton expertise sur les choix techniques, les évolutions d'architecture et l'optimisation des environnements de stockage et de virtualisation. Tu auras pour missions de : Définir et faire évoluer les architectures de stockage et de virtualisation. Accompagner les projets d'infrastructure et de transformation technique. Garantir la cohérence, la performance et la robustesse des solutions déployées. Réaliser des études d'architecture et proposer des axes d'amélioration. Participer aux choix technologiques et aux roadmaps d'évolution des plateformes. Accompagner les équipes d'exploitation sur les sujets complexes et stratégiques. Contribuer à l'industrialisation et à l'automatisation des infrastructures. Assurer un rôle d'expertise technique auprès des différentes équipes IT. Participer à la gestion des incidents majeurs et des problématiques de capacité ou de performance. Maintenir une veille technologique active sur les solutions de stockage, virtualisation et cloud. Stack technique : Virtualisation : VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, vSAN. Stockage : SAN, NAS, baies de stockage d'entreprise, réplication, sauvegarde. Systèmes : Windows Server, Linux. Cloud & Automatisation : Azure, AWS, PowerShell, Ansible ou équivalent. Infrastructure : Réseaux, sauvegarde, PRA/PCA, haute disponibilité. Méthodes : Architecture, expertise technique, gestion des évolutions et accompagnement des projets. Profil recherché Ce qui fera de toi notre prochaine pépite Sydienne Tu disposes d'une solide expérience dans les infrastructures de stockage et de virtualisation. Tu es capable d'intervenir sur des sujets d'architecture et d'apporter une vision globale des infrastructures. Tu maîtrises les environnements VMware et les problématiques de haute disponibilité. Tu possèdes une bonne compréhension des infrastructures systèmes, réseaux et cloud. Tu sais accompagner les équipes techniques sur des sujets complexes et stratégiques. Tu es reconnu(e) pour tes capacités d'analyse, de conseil et de prise de recul. Tu apprécies les environnements techniques exigeants et les projets de transformation. Autonomie, rigueur, communication et esprit d'équipe seront des atouts indispensables. Alors, si tu es prêt(e) à relever le défi et à rejoindre une équipe motivée, curieuse et passionnée, n’hésite plus et postule, tu deviendras peut-être la prochaine pépite de la team Infrastructure Management ! Le process de recrutement avec la team RH Étape 1 : Premier échange téléphonique avec un/une chargé(e) de recrutement du Groupe : Dalia Étape 2 : Rencontre physique ou visio avec notre Ingénieur d'affaires : Genoveva Étape 3 : Si ton profil matche, nous enverrons ton dossier de compétences au client. Étape 4 : Rencontre physique ou visio avec le client. Qu’il y ait match ou pas match, nous ne manquerons pas de te tenir au courant. La vie chez SYD Trois grandes valeurs que nous faisons tous vivre au quotidien : Solidarité, Respect, Intégrité. Les évènements : Séminaire d'intégration à ton arrivée, séminaire annuel dans un lieu secret, séminaire d'équipe, arbre de Noël, soirées d'été, évènements sportifs... Toutes les occasions sont bonnes pour se retrouver et passer du temps ensemble. La fondation SYD : Dans le cadre de notre engagement sociétal, nous avons créé en 2011 une fondation sur laquelle nous versons, chaque année, 10 % du résultat du Groupe pour financer des projets proposés et portés par les collaborateurs. Un suivi régulier avec la team RH et les commerciaux tout au long de la mission. La transparence : Pas de secret, tu seras informé dès le début du process du nom du client. items.card: About the role As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will develop and improve software connecting the hardware and software components of our microbiological testing solution. You will work closely with our hardware and software teams to build reliable, maintainable systems for industrial environments. Develop and optimize software in C, C# and Python, including low-level code for Cortex-M7 devices. Improve software
items.desc: About us Spore.Bio is a deeptech start-up born in 2023, building a new paradigm in the quality control systems in Food&Beverage, Cosmetics, and Pharmaceutics factories. After spending a lot of time in factories environments, we saw the pain it was to make sure products were safe. Traditional quality control has heavy constraints and long waiting times. To change that, we decided to build Spore.Bio, a new generation of microbiological testing. Our team is dedicated to bringing technology and developing a cutting-edge solution, based on advanced optical and deep-learning technologies, to detect bacterial contamination within seconds. Spore Bio is seeking a talented and passionate Embedded Software Engineer to contribute to the development of our cutting-edge biophotonics and data science solutions. About the role As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will develop and improve software connecting the hardware and software components of our microbiological testing solution. You will work closely with our hardware and software teams to build reliable, maintainable systems for industrial environments. Develop and optimize software in C, C# and Python, including low-level code for Cortex-M7 devices. Improve software architecture and help structure future developments, including device synchronization such as PTP. Design reliable, maintainable software modules for resource-constrained embedded systems. Test and validate code to support robust operation and integration. Collaborate with hardware and software teams to integrate components across the system. Write clear technical documentation to support development and maintenance. Your Profile Education & Experience: BSc or MSc in a relevant field. Embedded development: Proficiency in C for Cortex-M7, including low-level, unmanaged development with limited resources. Software development: Experience with an object-oriented language, preferably C#, Python or both. Technical documentation: Ability to read manufacturer datasheets and specifications. Working style: Strong analytical skills, autonomy and rigor. Bonus: Experience with embedded systems with real-time constraints, including Zephyr or FreeRTOS; knowledge of Windows or Linux; or experience with Ethernet, UDP and TCP/IP. Why joining us? Work in an innovative and rapidly growing startup. Participate in exciting and impactful projects. Evolve in a collaborative and stimulating work environment. Opportunities for professional development and continuous training. What we offer We believe that flexibility and trust are important parts of a company. Our work environment reflects this thanks to: Flexible remote: If you live in Paris, you can work from our office or from your place with no constraints. On top of that, we offer many perks such as: A budget for remote work equipment A Gymlib subscription for you to stay in shape wherever you are Premium health insurance (Alan in France) A Swile card for your meals, if you are based in France Frequent team events and in-person gatherings every month! Recruitment process Screening Interview (~30 min): A casual call to get to know each other, explore your experience, understand what drives you, and align on expectations. It's also your chance to ask anything about Spore Bio and the role. Technical Case Study (Presentation): A hands-on challenge reflecting the exact types of engineering problems you would face on the job. We care about your reasoning, methodology, and instincts—not textbook answers. Culture-Fit Discussion: A dedicated chat with a Spore Bio collaborator to ensure our values, vision, and team dynamics match what you're looking for. On-site Interview & Lab Visit: A comprehensive immersion day at our Paris headquarters. You will visit the optics lab and assembly area, see our systems in action, and meet the founders. This final step is as much for you to audit us as it is for us to choose you! Reference calls A quick chat with one or two people you've worked with before. You might also be invited to meet other team members at the office for a lab visit and a coffee! This is a unique opportunity for someone who thrives on curiosity and has a genuine passion for technology. If you enjoy taking on challenges and solving complex problems, this role will provide the perfect environment for growth and impact. The ideal candidate is someone who is self-driven, eager to learn, and excited to contribute to shaping the future of microbiology monitoring. Join our innovative and dynamic team, and let's make a difference together! We look forward to meeting you! Find more about us on our website and join us on this incredible journey!

items.desc: At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade. Our R&D focuses on discovering and delivering vaccines and medicines to transform people's lives. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together. In R&D Engineering Services, we provide facilities management, capital project, engineering and scientific services. We tailor our approach to meet the needs of R&D and deliver services that are safe, reliable, compliant and sustainable at R&D’s technical sites globally. We are looking to recruit a seasoned Project Engineer (m/f/d ) with a background in electrical engineering who can support with site operations and projects at our site in Heidelberg. This will include the development and improvement of processes that support the operational and project delivery models, interfacing with other GSK functions, service partners and other 3rd party providers. The role will provide comprehensive programme and project support by coordinating with operations teams to ensure timely information exchange, manage project transitions to operations, maintain an organised engineering library, and analyse risks which must all feed into progress reports to leadership. This role also supports consistent delivery of facilities, engineering services and compliance through provision of engineering and project management skills to support maintenance of infrastructure, management of high-severity risk programmes and sustainability at the site. Project Engineer (m/f/d) Key Responsibilities: Capital Program and Project Support: Liaise with operations teams to ensure that information required by project teams is provided in a timely fashion, and that operations teams and the business are aware of project impacts on site operations across technical planning and construction activities. Act as technical representative for approval of project charter and design reviews ensuring compliance to local and GSK global standards throughout the project lifecycle. Coordinate technical engineering deliverables ensuring action and decisions are tracked using appropriate mechanisms. Manage the transition of completed projects to operations, ensuring all documentation, training, and systems are in place for seamless integration. Manage the Site Engineering Library, ensuring that technical documentation produced by projects is appropriately filed and organized such that it can be quickly found when needed and of sufficient quality for operational needs and GSK requirements. Prepare monthly progress report(s) as needed to keep leadership informed of project progress and escalate any safety issues or delivery issues where resolution cannot be achieved with available resources. Ensure projects implemented comply with GSK’s engineering standards. Engage with regional technical authorities as required for engineering support. Facilities & Engineering Support: Support the governance of all engineering activity onsite through GEMBA, management monitoring, review of engineering data (engineering disruption, maintenance adherence, mean time to failure) and ensure service partner and third-party contractor works are being carried out in compliance with GSK, national, local standards and service level performance. Monitor, report, and escalate to site leadership as well as using formal routes such as VQMS or EHS One where this is not happening. Act as Technical Authority for all areas from the GSK Engineering Standards where the Local Head of Engineering deem the employee competent. Execute gap assessments against Engineering Standards and lead mitigations to manage risk down to acceptable levels (as low as reasonably practicable). Support site audits that require engineering input and manage improvement programs generated by various sources: Audit findings, CAPA, Engineering/EHS Alerts, Preventable Disruptions, Sustainability objectives. Improve the sustainability and efficiency of the facilities, driving the implementation of energy savings projects and operational improvements. Apply technical experience to review operational safety authorisations for facility operations across key building services areas such as: Electrical, Mechanical (HVAC and Refrigeration), Automation/BMS, and containment systems. Support and evaluate critical engineering systems periodic shutdowns providing oversight and assurance on large laboratory interventions. Manage “ad-hoc” business projects as required by Site Operations Manager Qualifications & skills: Minimum Bachelor's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering Qualifications in German engineering standards: DIN VDE 0105-100, DGUV Vorschrift 3, BetrSichV (Ordinance on Industrial Safety and Health), ArbSchG (Occupational Safety Act) Formal status as “Verantwortliche Elektrofachkraft (VEFK)“ or in progress of obtaining this status Extensive hands-on experience as electrical engineer in facility maintenance within …

items.desc: Location: Eindhoven (Strijp-T) | Hours: 40 hours per week | Employment type: Direct employment We're looking for a Platform Engineer to join the Avular Team! At Avular, we are looking for a hands-on and pragmatic Platform Engineer to strengthen our software organisation. Here you will own the "software factory" behind our robots: the CI/CD pipelines, self-hosted build runners, package registries and supply-chain tooling that our ~30 software engineers rely on every day. In this role, you will keep our builds green, our releases reproducible, and our dependencies secure. You'll be the person who makes sure our engineers can ship robotics software quickly, reliably, and safely. YOUR MISSION You own the path from a developer's commit to a reproducible and traceable software artefact. That means both building and improving the platform, and taking operational ownership of it. When a nightly build starts failing, runners become unreliable, or an important pull request gets stuck, you don't wait for somebody else to raise a ticket: you investigate, find the right owner and follow the issue through to resolution. You will: Own and maintain our CI/CD infrastructure and self-hosted build runners. Monitor the health of pipelines, runners and nightly builds, and proactively follow up on failures. Make bottlenecks such as long-running or stale pull requests visible and help teams get them resolved. Improve build reliability, performance and reproducibility. Set up, operate, and maintain internal developer services such as package registries and artefact repositories. Build out our software supply-chain tooling, including SBOM generation and management, dependency scanning, and CVE monitoring. Ensure that software releases and their dependencies remain traceable. Automate repetitive operational work and eliminate recurring sources of failure. Maintain the Linux infrastructure on which these services run, including upgrades, backups and monitoring. Define sensible metrics for the health of our software factory and continuously improve it. Document what you build and make sure the development organisation can rely on it. You won't be responsible for fixing every broken build, vulnerable dependency or stale pull request yourself. You are responsible for making sure problems become visible, get an owner and don't silently remain unresolved. WHO YOU ARE We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of engineering infrastructure and who combines software engineering with pragmatic systems administration. You have: Strong Linux administration skills; most of our infrastructure runs on Ubuntu. Hands-on experience with CI/CD systems and build pipelines. Experience with GitHub Actions is a plus. Experience operating self-hosted build infrastructure or comparable developer tooling. Solid scripting and automation skills, for example in Python, Bash or PowerShell. Experience with package registries, artefact repositories, or dependency management. An understanding of software supply-chain security concepts such as SBOMs, CVEs, and dependency scanning. Enough software-engineering background to understand the problems faced by the developers using the platform. A proactive mindset: you investigate problems, coordinate with the people involved and follow through until they are resolved. Good spoken and written English. Dutch is a plus. A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field is useful, but equivalent practical experience is just as valuable. ➕ Nice to haves C++ and/or ROS, or other embedded and robotics build environments. Docker and virtualisation platforms such as Proxmox. Software composition analysis and vulnerability-management tooling. Software compliance and security frameworks such as the CRA, NIS2 or ISO 27001. GitHub, Jira and Confluence administration or automation. Meet most of the core requirements but not every one? We'd still like to hear from you. WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT HERE At Avular , work meets play in the best possible way. We’re shaping the future of robotics, and we want you along for the ride. Here’s what’s waiting for you: Grow & Shine: Bring your vision and grow your career in a fast-paced, high-tech environment We’ve Got You Covered: Salary based on experience level, A non-contributory pension scheme and travel cost reimbursement mean less stress and more focus on what you love Share in Success: As part of our participation plan, you’ll benefit directly from the company’s growth Play Hard: Game nights, Friday drinks, epic team events, and celebrations make our office more than just a workspace Recharge Your Way: Enjoy 30 paid vacation days (plus national holidays) to unwind, explore, or simply relax Fuel for Greatness: Savour the best coffee, fresh fruit, and snacks to power your day Innovation Central: Work at our brand-new office in Strijp-T, Eindhoven , a buzzing hub of forward-thinking companies and cutting-edge ideas WHO WE ARE At Avular , we’re on a mission to …

items.desc: Helse Sør-øst RHF Research Assistant – Clinical Image Analysis Offentlig forvaltning Oslo University Hospital is looking for a Research Assistant to join the DUALSAVE-FGS project, working towards improved detection and understanding of female genital schistosomiasis (FGS), a neglected tropical disease affecting millions of women and girls in sub-Saharan Africa. The position combines clinical image analysis, deep learning and fieldwork. You will work closely with clinicians and researchers. The position includes 2-3 international research deployments, of up to 90 days each, to sites in South Africa and Mozambique. The DUALSAVE -FGS project runs until August 2027. Oslo University Hospital is a workplace with great diversity. We believe this is crucial for solving our tasks in the best possible way. We want this diversity to be reflected among the applicants for our positions, and we encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of background, to apply! Personlige egenskaper: You enjoy working where technical solutions meet real-world clinical problems. You are structured, curious and comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with clinicians and other researchers. You are able to communicate across disciplines and are willing to contribute to both technical research and the practical tasks required to conduct clinical research. Vi tilbyr: The opportunity to work across the research pipeline, from clinical image and dataset development to deep-learning model development and evaluation, while gaining hands-on experience in clinical research in sub-Saharan Africa. items.desc: Position Overview As part of State Street's transformation journey, we are implementing a product and platform operating model to simplify how the firm operates, modernize platforms and processes, accelerate technology and AI adoption, strengthen resiliency and controls, and improve outcomes for clients, employees and shareholders. Transformation is business-led and enterprise-enabled, with the Transformation Management Office providing enterprise coordination, governance, methodology, execution support and value-realization oversight. The Analyst, Impact Assurance is a hands-on analytical role within the Transformation Management Office supporting consistent measurement, validation and reporting of transformation outcomes. Reporting within the Impact Assurance unit, the role supports baseline development, business-case analysis, benefit tracking, evidence collection, data reconciliation and portfolio reporting. The Analyst works with Finance, business owners, Transformation Directors, Program Leads and data owners to maintain accurate and transparent information on committed, forecast, realized and at-risk transformation value. This is an individual-contributor role operating within established methodologies, controls and escalation processes. The Analyst is expected to deliver accurate, timely analysis, document assumptions and evidence, identify inconsistencies, and escalate issues for review rather than independently establishing assurance standards or approving benefit claims. Primary Responsibilities Baseline & Measurement Support Prepare baseline and target analyses using approved methodologies, source data and templates. Document assumptions, data sources, calculation methods and supporting evidence. Perform reasonableness, completeness and consistency checks on measures and targets. Maintain accurate records of approved baselines, targets, definitions and validation requirements. Escalate missing information, unclear measures or unsupported assumptions for review. Business Case & Benefits Analysis Support review of transformation business cases, including calculations, benefit drivers, costs, timing and supporting documentation. Compare assumptions with approved definitions, financial information and available source evidence. Identify potential duplicate claims, attribution gaps and inconsistencies for senior review. Prepare analyses and supporting materials for business-case and assurance reviews. Update records and analyses based on approved decisions and feedback. items.desc: As an Employee Life Cycle Specialist – Time and Absence, you will be part of the People Services ELC organization supporting markets such as Belgium, Poland and GCC. You will ensure accurate, compliant and timely Time and Attendance and Absence (T&A&A) processing, providing high-touch support to employees and managers and helping make time tracking and absence management simple and reliable. Key Responsibilities Monitor and validate employee time entries in Workday and local T&A systems, ensuring accuracy and alignment with payroll deadlines and local labor regulations. Reconcile T&A&A data for payroll cut-off, including resolving missing punches, overtime, meal breaks and exception reports with employees and managers. Conduct recurring audits and controls (e.g. unsubmitted/unapproved time blocks, time off validations, leave of absence reporting) to identify and mitigate time-related risks. Support collective bargaining agreement (CBA) requirements for hourly and exception-hourly employees where applicable, ensuring accurate earning codes, rules and downstream payroll processing. Partner with HR and cross-functional stakeholders to resolve time and pay-impact issues and to deliver process improvements and optimization initiatives. Work arrangement: This role is hybrid. You will be expected to work two days per week in the Poznan office and also work remotely Qualifications & Experience University degree (Bachelor’s or equivalent experience), ideally in HR Shared Services or Customer Support-related fields. Experience in HR Shared Services, a support centre or customer support environment, with strong stakeholder management and customer service focus. Proven time management, planning and organizational skills, with the ability to work to tight deadlines in a fast-paced, changing environment. Experience with Workday or other HRIS/time systems and an understanding of downstream impacts on payroll; familiarity with case management tools and intranet-based knowledge searching. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong analytical and data-gathering capabilities, and high attention to detail. Good written and spoken Spanish and English. Strong MS Office skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and a high level of integrity with the ability to maintain confidentiality at all times. What We Offer In this role, you will develop deep expertise in Workday Time and Attendance and Absence processes, gain exposure to multiple markets and stakeholders, and contribute directly to a core part of the employee experience. Headquartered in Barcelona, with teams across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, Smadex is a business unit of Entravision (NYSE: EVC). What will you do at Smadex? Starting with a primary focus on ISO 27001 , security audits, and establishing internal security guidelines, you will also get hands-on exposure across our broader security operations—supporting SIEM alert triage, internal security platform tasks, and vulnerability tracking alongside our engineering squads. items.desc: Vill du bidra till ett säkert och hållbart arbete med kemikalier i en organisation med många olika typer av verksamheter? Som kemikaliespecialist på RISE får du ett koncernövergripande uppdrag där du samordnar, utvecklar och följer upp kemikaliesäkerhetsarbetet. Du omsätter lagkrav och specialistkunskap till fungerande arbetssätt och hjälper verksamheten att hantera kemiska risker på ett säkert och systematiskt sätt. Om oss RISE är Sveriges oberoende statliga forskningsinstitut, med uppdrag att verka för hållbar tillväxt genom att stärka näringslivets konkurrenskraft och offentlig sektors förnyelse. Med tillämpad forskning, fler än 130 teknikinfrastrukturer för utveckling, test och demonstration samt tvärvetenskaplig kompetens erbjuder våra drygt 3 300 medarbetare stöd och kunskap hela vägen, från idé till innovation och klivet ut på marknaden. Genom våra uppdrag och samarbeten, både nationellt och internationellt, bidrar vi till omställningen mot ett hållbart samhälle. Rollen är placerad på RISE hållbarhetsavdelning och rapporterar till arbetsmiljöchef. Som kemikaliespecialist blir du en viktig del av vår koncerngemensamma avdelning inom HR & hållbarhetsfunktionen. Du kommer ingå i gruppen Hållbarhet och Arbetsmiljö, där du samarbetar nära med miljö- och arbetsmiljösamordnare. Rollen innebär också breda kontaktytor med chefer, ingenjörer, forskare, skyddsombud och specialister inom bland annat brandskydd, säkerhet och fastighet. Om rollen Som kemikaliespecialist har du ett koncernövergripande samordnings- och utvecklingsansvar inom kemikaliesäkerhet. Du ansvarar för kemikaliehanteringsprocessen samt förvaltar tillhörande styrande dokument, rutiner och metodstöd. En viktig del av uppdraget är att bevaka relevant kemikalie-, miljö- och arbetsmiljölagstiftning och omsätta kraven i gemensamma arbetssätt. Du har mandat att initiera och driva förbättringar samt att ge vägledning och ställa krav på nödvändiga riskbedömningar, åtgärdsplaner och uppföljning. Rollen ger stöd till verksamheten, utan att ta över linjeorganisationens formella arbetsmiljöansvar. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att: samordna och utveckla RISE koncernövergripande kemikaliesäkerhetsarbete ansvara för kemikaliehanteringsprocessen samt förvalta och följa upp rutiner, styrande dokument och metodstöd ge specialiststöd inom kemiska riskbedömningar, substitution, exponering och skyddsåtgärder, bland annat vid nya kemikalier, projekt och verksamhetsförändringar medverka i kemikalierelaterade tillbuds- och olycksutredningar samt följa upp åtgärder i samverkan med HR, chefer och företagshälsovård ge stöd i frågor som rör kemiska arbetsmiljörisker, exempelvis behov av medicinska kontroller och särskilda tillstånd förvalta kemikalieregister och relaterade system samt stödja verksamheten med användning, dokumentation, kvalitetssäkring och rapportering identifiera kompetensbehov samt utveckla och genomföra utbildningar och riktade informationsinsatser driva koncernens kemikalienätverk för erfarenhetsutbyte och förbättringsarbete vara en samordnande kontaktpunkt inom kemikalie- och strålsäkerhetsområdet och stödja verksamheten vid anmälningar, tillstånd, tillsyn och myndighetskontakter, samt hantera vissa registreringar och anmälningar till berörda myndigheter. Tjänsten är placerad i Borås, Göteborg eller Stockholm och resor förekommer ibland och det finns möjlighet till hybridarbete. Vem är du? Du har gedigen erfarenhet inom kemikaliesäkerhet och är van att arbeta i komplexa verksamheter där riskerna behöver förstås, bedömas och hanteras systematiskt. items.card: Är du bra på system och digital teknik och tycker om att identifiera utvecklingsområden samt förbättra processer? Nu söker vi dig som vill jobba med systemutveckling inom vår elevhälsa. Är du vår nya kollega? Vi ser fram emot din ansökan. Din roll hos oss Som systemutvecklare på strategi- och utredningsavdelningen arbetar du och dina kollegor med att ge och utveckla förvaltningens stöd och support till
items.desc: Är du bra på system och digital teknik och tycker om att identifiera utvecklingsområden samt förbättra processer? Nu söker vi dig som vill jobba med systemutveckling inom vår elevhälsa. Är du vår nya kollega? Vi ser fram emot din ansökan. Din roll hos oss Som systemutvecklare på strategi- och utredningsavdelningen arbetar du och dina kollegor med att ge och utveckla förvaltningens stöd och support till systemanvändare inom hela Barn- och utbildningsförvaltningen. Avdelningen ansvar för ett flertal system och nu söker vi dig som vill ta ansvar för Proneta, vårt system för att följa upp och dokumentera elevhälsa och pedagogiska insatser på ett säkert och strukturerat sätt. I systemet administrerar du användare och behörigheter, tar fram manualer och instruktioner samt introducerar och utbildar nya användare. Du utbildar även befintliga användare vid förändringar och uppdateringar av systemet. Du fångar upp verksamhetens behov, analyserar dem och tar fram utvecklingsförslag på exempelvis rutiner, processer och arbetssätt och implementerar dessa. Utöver detta skapar du mallar, kontaktformulär och rapporter, uppdaterar sidor på intranätet som är kopplade till Prorenata samt utför loggkontroller och tar ut rapporter med statistik till exempelvis verksamhetscontroller, verksamhetschefer och rektorer. Du ser till att arbetet bedrivs både med kvalitet och säkerhet utifrån de lagar och föreskrifter som styr området och är behjälplig vid begäran av utlämnande av handlingar. Du arbetar nära elevhälsans professioner och är ett stöd till användarna i förvaltningen kring Prorenata och levererar god service och support samt är förvaltningens kontaktperson gentemot Prorenatas support och kundansvarig. På avdelningen ingår du i delen digitalisering och systemstöd tillsammans sex andra systemutvecklare och en verksamhetscontroller, med vilka du har ett nära samarbete. Utöver systemet Prorenata kommer du även att arbeta med förvaltningens övriga system och arbetsuppgifter kopplade till dessa och det kan även finnas möjligheter att utveckla tjänstens innehåll utifrån intresse och verksamhetens behov. Din närmaste chef är avdelningschefen för Strategi- och utredning. Vem söker vi? Vi vill att du har: examen från högskola eller universitet om minst 120p/180hp med inriktning mot någon av professionerna inom elevhälsan aktuell arbetslivserfarenhet från hälso- och sjukvårdsektorn eller elevhälsan erfarenhet av systemanvändning, journalföring i Prorenata eller liknande system god förmåga att använda system och digital teknik kännedom om lagar och föreskrifter som styr området (hälso- och sjukvårdslagen, patientlagen, lagen om offentlig sekretess, GDPR) förmåga att uttrycka dig muntligt och skriftligt på ett tydligt och professionellt sätt på svenska Det är meriterande om du har: erfarenhet av teknisk support till systemanvändare erfarenhet av att introducera och utbilda god kunskap och förståelse för elevhälsans arbetsprocesser god pedagogisk förmåga Som person är du bra på att identifiera och utveckla processer. Du har god förmåga att planera, organisera, prioritera och följa upp dina arbetsuppgifter. Du har en god administrativ förmåga och är noggrann. Du har lätt för att samarbeta och skapa relationer både internt och externt som karakteriseras av professionalitet, respekt, gott ambassadörskap samt förtroende. Vid erbjudande om anställning krävs att du uppvisar registerutdrag enligt gällande lagstiftning. Det här är vi Avdelningen strategi- och utredning har i uppdrag att stödja förvaltningschef genom att planera, samordna, följa upp och utvärdera det övergripande mål- och resultatarbetet av förvaltningens långsiktiga strategier och årliga verksamhetsplaner. Detta inrymmer såväl det kommunala som statliga uppdraget. Avdelningen ansvarar även för strategisk utveckling av IT och daglig support i digitala verksamhetsstöd samt bistår förvaltningen med stöd i informationssäkerhet, skoljuridiska frågor och klagomålshantering samt hanterar förvaltningens projekt och utredningar. Även intern och extern kommunikation, administrativt arbete kopplat till barn- och utbildningsnämnden samt tillsyn och insyn i fristående verksamheter ingår som ansvarsområden i avdelningen. Avdelningen har ca 20 medarbetare. Barn- och utbildningsförvaltningen bedriver pedagogisk verksamhet som sträcker sig från förskola till vuxenutbildning. I en trygg, kreativ och demokratisk miljö som värnar alla människors lika värde arbetar vi för lärande, kunskap och omsorg. Vi söker dig som vill vara med och forma framtiden! Vi erbjuder Vi är drygt 7000 medarbetare i Kristianstads kommun som gör skillnad i människors vardag, varje dag. Hos oss hittar du medarbetare som brinner för välfärden och vill utveckla idéer till verklighet. Kristianstads kommun erbjuder flera olika karriärvägar så att du kan utvecklas genom hela arbetslivet. Läs mer om våra förmåner och oss som arbetsgivare här. Bra att veta Har du skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte ansöka via ansökningsknapp. …

items.desc: Location: Lenzburg, Aargau, Switzerland Job ID: R0150540 Date Posted: 2026-11-20 Company Name: HITACHI ENERGY LTD Profession (Job Category): Quality Management Job Schedule: Full time Remote: No Job Description: The opportunity Join our semiconductor research and development team in Lenzburg and contribute to advancing the reliability and performance of power semiconductor technologies. items.desc: Application Process & Requirements: Interview Process Technical roles: Our technical roles' process includes submitting a CV and short written statement, 1-2 skills assessments such as technical interviews and take-home coding tests and 2-4 interviews, including a conversation with leadership. We tailor this process as needed for each role and candidate. If you're applying to our technical roles, this privacy policy applies. Non-technical roles: Our non-technical roles' process includes submitting a CV, 2-4 interviews including a conversation with leadership and sometimes presentation or take-home task assessments. While our interviews follow civil service requirements, we do not require answering in STAR or other rigid formats. We recommend preparing to speak about your past career experience and how you would approach problems you would face in your AISI role. Nationality Requirements & Visas Technical roles: we can hire almost all nationalities and sponsor visas. Non-technical roles: you must meet civil service nationality requirements (by having Commonwealth citizenship, indefinite leave to remain, EU settled status, or meeting some other criteria). National Security Vetting Requirements vary by role and not all roles require vetting; check each job ad. Counter Terrorism Check (CTC) and Security Clearance (SC) vettings usually require 2+ years of recent UK residency . Developed Vetting (DV) clearances usually require 10+ years. Technical Salaries On technical job ads, you'll see our total packages include a "base salary" and a "technical talent allowance". This is civil service terminology. The technical talent allowance is part of your total salary and paychecks; there are no restrictions on how you spend it. About the AI Security Institute The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally. We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action. The deadline for applying to this role is Tuesday 8th December, end of day, anywhere on Earth About the team The Red Team conducts cutting-edge research to evaluate the safety measures of frontier AI systems, sharing our findings directly with leading AI companies, UK officials and allied governments. Our work shapes how the most powerful AI systems are deployed - you can read about it in the The New York Times, The Economist, and The Telegraph. Demand for this work is growing faster than we can currently meet - we're scaling to address that gap. The Red Team’s work is crucial to ensuring advanced AI systems are developed and deployed safely. We are composed of three specialised sub-teams: Alignment – developing methods to stress-test whether models reliably act as intended (e.g., our evaluation of GPT-6 Astra, and our research into cheating behaviour in frontier model evaluations) Control – researching methods for stress-testing and evaluating the measures that identify and prevent agents taking harmful actions Misuse - stress-testing safeguards against misuse of dangerous capabilities (e.g. our safeguard testing with Anthropic and OpenAI, and recent work on Boundary Point Jailbreaking, attacks on layered safeguard systems and principles for evaluating misuse safeguards) While each team has its own focus, we share methodologies, infrastructure and tooling across the wider team. Role Description This is an exciting opportunity for motivated and talented researchers to join AISI's Red Team, contributing to priority research objectives within a fast-paced environment in government. We are looking for exceptional candidates currently studying for a PhD, or postdoctoral researchers who have submitted their PhD within the last 2 years, in machine learning, computer science, computer security or a related field. We will by default consider this a 6-month residency but are flexible to shorten or extend per candidate preferences and availability. Following an end of residency review, promising candidates may be offered the opportunity to join their preferred team in a full-time employee role. We are particularly interested in candidates who have one or more of the following. You don't need all of them, and we'd encourage you to apply even if you only match a few: Have research experience in adversarial machine learning, AI security, alignment, AI control or evaluations, or are familiar with this research Have experience with optimisation methods such as reinforcement learning, fine-tuning or evolutionary methods Are familiar with loss-of-control threat models, such as deceptive alignment, research …
