DIE ZUKUNFT DER MOBILITÄT? DIGITAL. 
 TEILE DEINE LEIDENSCHAFT. 
 Mehr als 90 % aller Innovationen im Automobil basieren auf Elektronik und Software. Gerade hier sind große Freiräume und vernetztes Denken gefordert, um die Mobilität neu zu erfinden und ein völlig neues Fahrerlebnis zu ermöglichen. Deshalb geben wir Studierenden bei uns nicht nur die Gelegenheit zum Zuhören, sondern auch zum Mitreden und Weiterdenken.
 Unser Team gestaltet den Einsatz generativer KI im Produktionssystem und Einkauf der BMW Group mit. Während deines Praktikums erhältst du Einblicke in innovative GenAI-Technologien und unterstützt uns dabei, neue Anwendungsfälle zu identifizieren, zu bewerten und technisch umzusetzen.
 Was erwartet dich? 
 Du unterstützt unser Team bei der Identifikation aktueller und zukünftiger Technologietrends rund um generative KI im Produktions- und Automobilumfeld.
 Außerdem beschäftigst du dich mit modernen Large Language Models und erhältst Einblicke in deren Anwendung auf einer modernen IT-Infrastruktur.
 Darüber hinaus wirkst du bei der Bewertung von Machbarkeit und Nutzen potenzieller GenAI-Anwendungsfälle sowie bei der Umsetzung vielversprechender Konzepte mit.
 Dabei unterstützt du die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Fachbereichen und der IT bei der Entwicklung innovativer Lösungen.
 Du wirkst bei der Entwicklung von Applikationen für Impulsprojekte sowie bei der Konzeption und Erprobung von Prototypen mit.
 Darüber hinaus baust du dein Wissen zu GenAI-Applikationen, Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Embeddings und der Evaluation von GenAI-Lösungen, beispielsweise mit Ragas, weiter aus.
 Was bringst du mit? 
 Studium der Informatik, Künstlichen Intelligenz, Softwareentwicklung, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.
 Erste Kenntnisse in Python, AWS oder Machine Learning von Vorteil.
 Interesse an generativer KI sowie erste Berührungspunkte mit Technologien wie LLMs, Chatbots, Prompting, Embeddings, Vector Stores oder Agents.
 Erste Erfahrungen im Automotive- oder Innovationsumfeld von Vorteil.
 Ausgeprägtes Interesse an technischen Innovationen sowie analytisches und strukturiertes Denkvermögen.
 Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
 Du möchtest deine Begeisterung für generative KI einbringen und innovative Anwendungen im Produktionssystem und Einkauf mitgestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!
 Was bieten wir dir? 
 Umfassendes Mentoring & Onboarding.
 Persönliche & fachliche Weiterentwicklung.
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten.
 Mobilarbeit.
 Attraktive & faire Vergütung.
 Apartments für Studierende (nach Verfügbarkeit & nur am Standort München).
 Und vieles mehr siehe jobs/waswirbieten

We are seeking a visionary Generative- and Conversational AI Consultant to drive the next evolution of enterprise customer service. In this role, you will act as the strategic bridge between our clients' business needs and our cutting-edge AI capabilities. You will paint the "target picture" for large-scale service transformations, rapidly build MVPs and mini-POCs, and seamlessly orchestrate our in-house Conversational AI Platform with leading industry engines.
 Crucially, you will act as a proactive technology scout —identifying development potentials for our platform, collaborate with our customers, screening the market for best-in-breed solutions (e.g., advanced VoiceAI, STT/TTS engines, Multimodal models), and integrating these innovations to continuously future-proof our ecosystem.
 Vision & Target Pictures: Design visionary Target Operating Models for enterprise clients, illustrating how human experts and AI (Voice, Chat, Agent Assist) seamlessly collaborate in a unified service flow.
 Rapid Prototyping & MVPs: Hands-on design and development of conversational flows, dynamic demos, and mini-POCs to validate complex use cases and drive stakeholder buy-in early in the sales cycle.
 Strategic Tech Scouting & Gap Mitigation: Continuously screen the AI market for disruptive technologies and products. Identify capability gaps within our current platform based on customer feedback, and evaluate third-party tools (e.g., ElevenLabs, Soniox, specialized LLMs) to strategically compensate for these weaknesses.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, Solution Architects, and Developers to ensure that your MVPs and scouted technologies are feasible, scalable, and effectively integrated into our abstracted "Hub" architecture.
 Consultative Leadership & Transformation Enablement: Provide expert consultative support during pre-sales, discovery, and early delivery phases. Act as a trusted advisor to internal Bosch stakeholders and external clients, actively sharing best practices and enabling the broader organization to successfully navigate the AI transformation process
Language: Fluent in English and German (Level: min. B2-C1).
 Education: Degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science, Business Administration, or equivalent professional experience.
 Experience: Proven track record in Conversational AI consulting, solution engineering, or technical business analysis, with a deep understanding of customer service processes and contact center KPIs (e.g., AHT, Containment Rate, CSAT).
 Storytelling & Translation: Exceptional communication skills—ability to translate complex AI architectures (the "technology zoo") into clear, compelling value propositions and ROI for Business Owners.
 Tech Fluency: Hands-on experience with at least one leading conversational platform (e.g., Google CCAI / Dialogflow CX, Genesys Cloud CX, Cognigy, or Salesforce) and a strong grasp of GenAI prompt engineering.
 Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive, analytical approach to identifying technical bottlenecks and finding creative market solutions to overcome them. Nice to Have 
 Experience with advanced VoiceAI components (STT/TTS engines like Soniox, ElevenLabs) and low-latency streaming architectures.
 Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and how to orchestrate enterprise knowledge (e.g., CRM, web crawling, Docupedia) for AI consumption.
 Knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and basic scripting (e.g., JavaScript, Python) for rapid API prototyping.
 Previous experience operating in a B2B SaaS, Managed Services, or Enterprise IT environment

 Shape the Future: Take on real responsibility from day one and actively influence the roadmap of our Conversational AI offerings.

 Dynamic Role: Enjoy a highly diverse role that perfectly balances strategic consulting (Target Pictures), hands-on building (MVPs), and market research (Scouting).
 Innovation Culture: Be part of a young, dynamic, and forward-thinking team driving real digital transformation for internal Bosch divisions and global external clients.

items.desc:
Overview 
 Microsoft Elevate is Microsoft’s dedicated organization for advancing Education, Nonprofit, Workforce Development, and AI-for-Good outcomes globally. We bring together commercial expertise, technology innovation, partner ecosystems, skilling programs, policy engagement, and philanthropy to help organizations and communities accelerate impact in an AI-powered world. Through our people-first approach, Elevate works to ensure technology creates inclusive economic opportunity, ensuring that artificial intelligence enhances human potential rather than replacing it. 
 As an AI Workforce Specialist in our AI Business Solutions & Security team, you will lead the charge in helping universities, colleges, multi-academy trusts and sector bodies across the UK & Ireland become Frontier institutions, putting AI to work for every student and member of staff. Your primary focus is AI business value conversations with senior education leaders, from Vice-Chancellors, Principals and trust CEOs to their executive teams, connecting Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Cowork, Agents and Copilot Studio to the priorities they own, such as student success and employability, teaching and research, and operational efficiency. You will also help institutions build secure, AI-ready foundations on Microsoft 365, Windows 365 and Azure Virtual Desktop, working with account teams, Solution Engineers and partners to turn executive ambition into adoption and growth. This opportunity will allow you to build trusted relationships with education executives, sharpen your consultative and business value selling, and deepen your expertise in AI and agentic transformation while accelerating your career growth. This role is flexible: you can work up to 100% from home, travelling to institutions across the UK & Ireland as needed.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.   
 Responsibilities 
 You lead business value conversations with senior education leaders, including Vice-Chancellors, Principals, trust CEOs and their executive teams, such as Pro-Vice-Chancellors, COOs, CFOs, Registrars and digital leaders. You show each executive how AI helps deliver their part of the institution’s strategy, whether that is student success and employability, teaching and research, inclusion or operational efficiency.
 You own the business decision, uncovering high-value use cases for students and staff, building business value and ROI cases, and bringing proof through customer stories and your own daily use of Copilot and agents. You create ‘art of the possible’ moments, such as executive workshops and governor briefings, and engage Microsoft executive sponsors when they can accelerate a decision.
 You build and manage a healthy pipeline across your territory, leading with Frontier solutions (Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Cowork, agents and Copilot Studio) and using that momentum to grow each institution’s core Microsoft 365 and Virtual Desktop foundations, backed by a clear territory plan and accurate forecasting.
 You orchestrate the extended team, working with Account Executives, Solution Engineers who lead technical validation, AI Business Process and Security colleagues and customer success teams, while building relationships across each institution’s leadership, academic, professional services and IT communities.
 You co-sell with partners on every opportunity, building joint territory plans with priority partners to extend your reach, strengthen solution design and accelerate deployment across a large and diverse set of institutions.
 You drive adoption and value realisation after the sale, attaching Microsoft deployment and skilling investments, working with FastTrack and partners on rollout, and tracking usage so institutions can evidence impact for students and staff and expand with confidence.

items.desc: Contexte Une équipe d'environ 30 personnes développe et exploite un jumeau numérique applicatif du système d'information, afin de le rendre plus fiable, explicable et prédictif. La plateforme, en production depuis une première phase, représente des milliers de serveurs, routeurs, applications et clusters Kubernetes à partir de données de production continuellement mises à jour. Le projet compte plus de cinq ans d'historique. La plateforme repose sur deux couches de données : la topologie réelle de l'infrastructure stockée dans une base graphe TigerGraph, et la connaissance applicative et documentaire (configurations, documentation éditeur, procédures) conservée dans des bases Memgraph et des espaces LightRAG par agent. Une plateforme agentique LangGraph route les questions vers des agents spécialisés, notamment pour les incidents, le prédictif, Linux, Oracle, Red Hat et la documentation. Les utilisateurs y accèdent via une application web et un bot Microsoft Teams. L'agent de gestion des incidents accélère leur résolution, principal indicateur de performance de la plateforme, tandis que la maintenance prédictive détecte les dysfonctionnements à venir. Les évolutions prévues comprennent le GraphRAG, les agents event-driven et la simulation de pannes. Mission Concevoir, industrialiser et faire évoluer les agents IA de la plateforme de jumeau numérique du SI, en collaboration avec les équipes métier, infrastructure, data et DevOps. Contribuer à la roadmap produit et à la qualité, à la fiabilité et à l'impact mesurable des agents en production. Principales responsabilités Développer de nouveaux agents spécialisés avec LangGraph à partir des besoins des équipes métier. Faire évoluer l'orchestrateur et le routage entre agents, notamment l'arbre de décision et l'agent bibliothécaire. Connecter les agents à leurs outils et données : API ServiceNow, Dynatrace, requêtes TigerGraph et Memgraph, et espaces LightRAG. Construire le GraphRAG en reliant la base vectorielle documentaire (Confluence, ServiceNow, SharePoint, Jira) à la topologie TigerGraph pour permettre le raisonnement croisé. Concevoir des agents event-driven déclenchés automatiquement par une alerte ou une anomalie, capables d'analyser la situation, de formuler des hypothèses et de passer la main à un humain. Contribuer aux premiers travaux de simulation de pannes et d'analyse d'impact des mises en production. Mettre en place les jeux d'évaluation, les critères et le suivi de la qualité des agents avant et après leur mise en production. Industrialiser le cycle de vie des agents et des modèles avec l'équipe : pipeline MLOps, monitoring et déploiement sur Kubernetes. Contribuer à la qualité des données alimentant les agents, notamment par le dédoublonnage, la réconciliation entre sources et la traçabilité. Cadrer les besoins des équipes demandeuses, les aider à enrichir leurs espaces documentaires, mesurer l'impact des agents sur la résolution des incidents et faire évoluer les solutions en conséquence. Environnement technique Développement et orchestration : Python, LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex Bases de données et recherche : TigerGraph, GSQL, Memgraph, base vectorielle, LightRAG, GraphRAG Machine learning et MLOps : PyTorch, scikit-learn, MLflow Infrastructure et déploiement : Kubernetes, Docker, infrastructure IaaS interne Données et outils IT : Dynatrace, ServiceNow, Discovery, Confluence, SharePoint, Jira Accès et intégration : API, API Gateway, SSO, application web, bot Microsoft Teams CI/CD et observabilité : GitLab CI, ArgoCD, Grafana, Prometheus Livrables attendus Agents spécialisés conçus et mis en production pour répondre aux besoins des équipes métier. Évolutions de l'orchestrateur et du routage entre agents. Fonctionnalités GraphRAG reliant la documentation à la topologie de l'infrastructure. Agents event-driven et contributions aux travaux de simulation de pannes et d'analyse d'impact. Jeux de test, critères et suivi des évaluations de qualité des agents. Pipelines et pratiques d'industrialisation, de monitoring et de déploiement des agents et modèles. Améliorations de la qualité et de la traçabilité des données utilisées par les agents. Avantages Impact mesurable : les agents contribuent quotidiennement à la résolution d'incidents sur un SI de plusieurs milliers de serveurs, routeurs et applications. Terrain technique combinant agents en production, bases graphes, GraphRAG et agents event-driven à construire. Équipe pluridisciplinaire réunissant data scientists spécialisés en RAG avancé, bases graphes et machine learning, ainsi que des DevOps et des architectes. Projet mature, avec cinq ans d'historique et des succès reconnus, auquel contribuer dès le début. Compétences / Qualités indispensables : Développement Python et mise en production de solutions LLM ou agentiques, Orchestration d'agents avec LangGraph ou un framework équivalent, RAG et évaluation de la qualité des réponses LLM, API, Docker, Kubernetes et CI/CD, Industrialisation et …

items.desc: Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time. Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence. In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running. At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you. What you will do 1. Build and run automations with AI Automate the employee lifecycle: build, test, deploy and maintain workflows for recruiting-to-onboarding handoffs, employee changes, learning administration and offboarding. Connect the People stack: move data reliably between Pigment and the other People tools (performance, learning, ticketing), using various automation tools, APIs and webhooks. Translate process into logic: sit with People process owners, map how work happens today, and turn it into clean workflows with triggers, conditions, approvals, notifications and error handling. Handle failure safely: design for missing data, unavailable systems and unexpected inputs, and route exceptions to the right owner instead of failing silently. Run what you ship: monitor production workflows, investigate failures and fix recurring issues at the root, and align with the Data & Automation team. 2. Build AI agents and self-service Build People agents: use LLMs and Pigment's native AI capabilities to build agents that answer employee and manager questions, draft responses and route tickets. Prompt and evaluate: write prompts and agent instructions, build test cases, and measure answer accuracy, source quality and appropriate escalation. Keep a versioned library of approved prompts and results. Connect approved knowledge only: link agents to the right sources for each audience, and make sure sensitive or unresolved questions go to a person. Test the market: pilot new AI features and tools, and move them to production when relevant. Spot new opportunities: bring workflow and agent ideas from People teams to the People Strategy & Tech Lead, with a first view of effort and value. 3. Document, monitor and improve Treat People workflow like product code: keep clear documentation, schemas and runbooks for every workflow and agent: purpose, dependencies, logic, owner, monitoring and change history. Keep an inventory: maintain an up-to-date list of the automations, agents, integrations and prompts you support, and retire what no longer works. Measure service health: track success rate, processing time, answer quality, escalation rate and incidents, and report them to the People Strategy & Tech Lead regularly. Apply responsible AI controls: implement the access, data and human-review requirements defined by Security, Privacy and Legal, and re-test after any model, data or configuration change. Support adoption: write short guides and release notes, and help People teams use what you build. Work within company standards: build with the stack and follow the IT and security guidelines set by the Data & Automation team, and document your work so others can support it when you are away. Who you are Experience: 2+ years in AI implementations, automations, data or a similar role, ideally in a fast-growing tech or SaaS company. No HR background needed: what matters is that you have built something real that others rely on, and that you want to turn People into an AI-powered team. Internships and apprenticeships count if you ship real things. The builder mindset: you have built workflows or integrations that other people actually use, with tools such as n8n, Zapier, Make, Workato or Power Automate. Scripting (SQL, Python or JavaScript) or expert-level spreadsheet logic is a strong plus. AI-fluent: you know how to prompt LLMs, you have built or tested an agent or an AI assistant, and you are excited to replace repetitive human steps with reliable automation. Systems thinking: you understand APIs, webhooks, structured data, permissions and conditional logic, and you know how automated services fail. People curiosity: you understand or you are interested in core HR processes (hiring, onboarding, internal mobility, offboarding, …

items.desc: AI Security Engineer – Identity Engineering trust for the next generation of AI We are building the security foundations for a rapidly evolving global environment where cloud platforms, AI applications and AI agents are becoming an increasingly important part of how technology is engineered and operated. We are looking for an AI Security Engineer specialising in Identity to join our Cyber Engineering and Security Architecture team. This is a critical hands-on engineering role, not governance policies and standards. You will have proven DevOps knowledge and have excellent knowledge about key principles of identity and supporting services. Working across Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, Microsoft Foundry, Keycloak, AI agents and enterprise secrets-management platforms - helping us answer one of the most important emerging security questions: How do we establish, control and continuously verify the identity of humans, applications and autonomous AI agents, while ensuring they receive only the access and credentials they need? What you'll be responsible for AI Identity Security Design and engineer identity security patterns for AI agents and agentic applications; and AI applications and services Develop controls covering the full identity lifecycle Build engineering patterns that support least privilege; zero trust; and Just-in-Time access Work with Cloud and AI engineering teams to create patterns for AI workload's, Secrets and Machine Identities What great looks like Success in this role isn't measured by the number of security documents produced. It is measured by engineering outcomes: AI workloads use managed identities instead of static credentials. Secrets disappear from source code and pipelines. AI agents have individually attributable identities. Privileged access becomes temporary and auditable. Identity and secrets controls are automated. Developers can consume secure patterns without becoming identity-security specialists. New AI services inherit security controls by default. Agent permissions can be understood, monitored and rapidly revoked. Security controls scale at the same speed as engineering. What we're looking for You will bring strong experience across several of the following areas. AI changes this job in two ways. First,
items.desc: eCarsTrade is a digital car marketplace serving professional buyers in more than 40 countries. Through our online auction platform, we offer over 20,000 vehicles per week, sourced from leading fleet owners, leasing and rental companies, as well as banks and dealerships. Over the last 3 years we have delivered 40% YoY profitable growth, building a leading market position in Europe. Our platform keeps growing in scale and complexity. We want each part of the product to have one engineer who owns it end to end, from the business problem to the change in production and the effect on our users. About the RoleAs Information Security Officer, you are responsible for all information security in the company. Our internal systems are as important as our public platform. These systems include finance, CRM, admin tools, and the accounts and devices of our staff. A ransomware attack on an internal system can cause as much damage as an attack on the auction platform. AI changes this job in two ways. First, attackers use AI. With AI, they find and use vulnerabilities in hours. They write phishing messages in all languages. They make false copies of the voice and the face of a manager. Second, we use AI in our products and in our engineering work. You must protect the company against attacks that use AI. You must also make our own use of AI safe. You use AI for defense every day. Job requirements You have experience in the security of applications and infrastructure (web apps, APIs, containers). You know AI and LLM security: prompt injection, agent access, the AI supply chain, and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM and Agentic Applications. You use AI tools in your daily work. You know what these tools can do and what they cannot do. You have experience with vulnerability management, penetration test companies and bug bounty programs. You know how to protect staff against social engineering, and you can give security training. You know access control, segregation of duties and audit frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR). You speak and write clear English. You work well with the IT, Product, Finance and Operations teams. Nice to Have Certificates: CISSP, CISM, OSCP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor. For AI: ISACA AAISM, IAPP AIGP, ISO/IEC 42001. Knowledge of PHP/Python, MySQL and Docker. Experience in marketplaces, fintech or e-commerce. Experience in red-team tests of LLM applications. Job responsibilities Platform and internal systems. Protect the auction platform, the APIs and the mobile apps. Give the same priority to our internal systems. Make sure that the backups of all critical systems work, and test the recovery. AI and agents. Set limits for AI agents and AI functions. Protect them against prompt injection. Give them only the access that they need. Make sure that a person approves each production change and each payment action. Keep a log of all agent actions. Decide which AI tools the staff can use and which data they can give to these tools. Vulnerabilities. Operate vulnerability scanners. Order external penetration tests. Start a white-hat program. Install patches quickly. For a critical vulnerability on an internet-facing system, install the patch in hours or days, not in weeks. Social engineering. Protect the company against phishing, voice copies and deepfakes. Train the staff and do drills. Make sure that nobody changes a payment or bank details only because of a call, a video or a chat message. Access control. Give people, service accounts and AI agents only the access that they need. Make sure that one person or one agent cannot do a full business transaction alone. Keep the company ready for audits, including Big Four audits. Incidents. Write procedures to find attacks, stop them and recover from them. Make the procedures fast, because some attacks spread in minutes. Rules and compliance. Write the security policies. Make sure that we obey GDPR, ISO 27001, ISO/IEC 42001, the EU AI Act and NIS2. Job benefits Full remote position under a B2B contract Multicultural, dynamic international team Competitive salary Fast-growing company with startup spirit and growth opportunities Chance to shape the future of digital automotive trading

items.desc: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. The Engineering community In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves! Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of product interaction. We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems! We do security as we do everything else — that is, not quite the traditional way, but always in line with our leadership principles. Joining Alan as a Application Security Engineer team means you're at the forefront of protecting sensitive health data and ensuring our systems are resilient against threats. Want to know more? Read this article on our Engineering career path. The Stack Python/Flask, TypeScript, React, React Native on the coding side. AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Keycloak, PostgreSQL, Redis, Temporal, Terraform/Terramate, Datadog, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions on the platform side, all in a monorepo. AI coding agents are part of everyone's daily work, ours included. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership: you build it, you own it. The Security team Mission Engineers ship secure products, safely, and we catch and contain attacks fast. We protect our members. Their health data and their money are with us. Nobody reaches data they shouldn't see, and a stolen password doesn't open an account. We accelerate Alan. A new deal, country or product gets its security yes by configuration, not by a new project. We use the attacker's tools to defend. Attackers use AI, so do we, on our own code and our own infrastructure, every day. Scope, in three streams Prevent : make the secure path the default one. Authentication and authorization: our Keycloak-based stack for members, health professionals and admins (SSO, MFA, passwordless next), and endpoints that deny by default. Vulnerability management: every signal (scanners, pentests, researchers, AI) triaged and routed to the owning crew. Agents open the fixes, humans review. Sensitive data and AI: end-to-end encryption, secure file exchange, and AI agents and MCPs that only get the permissions they need. Defend : see an attack early and contain it fast. Detection: signals on our cloud, apps and identities that are worth waking up for. Response automation: an access kill switch, one-click host isolation, scripted response on our cloud, automatic isolation at night and on weekends. Investigation: AI-assisted triage, and the runbooks and tooling everyone on the incident rotation relies on. Attack : find our weaknesses before someone else does. Test our own products and infrastructure like an attacker, AI first. Simulate the attacks on the rise: prompt injection, account takeover, automated attacks on our routes. Turn every finding into a guardrail or a detection, with our pentest partners and security researchers. Focus for 2027 Security is growing at Alan. Attacks get faster and cheaper with AI, and we answer the same way: by building. Big topics on the table: authorization secure by default, detection and response automation, and a vulnerability management system that fixes itself. Experience we value 3+ years in software engineering roles, shipping and operating production systems (rollouts, on-call, incidents), or earlier in your career with an outstanding interest in security to show (CTFs, bug bounties, security side projects) You've built systems, libraries or tooling other engineers rely on Hands-on security work in past teams: fixing vulnerabilities at scale, designing auth or crypto flows, building guardrails, CI security gates or detections A plus : incident response, detection engineering, pentest or red team, OAuth/OIDC and IAM, vulnerability management, LLM or agent security Mindset we value Engineer first : whatever the stream, you solve …

Systems thinking: You know when to use agentic AI, deterministic logic or human intervention. Commercial and experimental mindset: You prioritize business impact, challenge assumptions and measure incremental results through controlled experiments. Builder mentality: You're proactive, thrive in ambiguity and take ownership from concept to production. Strong communication: You're comfortable working with both engineers and marketers. Fluent English: German and experience in B2B SaaS or two-sided marketplaces are a plus. Why this role is different A genuine greenfield opportunity: Become the first engineer in Marketing and shape our growth architecture from the ground up. Real-world complexity: Solve fascinating engineering challenges within a two-sided marketplace driven by network effects, customer behavior, supply and demand. items.desc: Bij Zerocopter werken we aan één missie: de digitale wereld veiliger maken. We helpen organisaties zichzelf te beschermen door slimme technologie te combineren met de vaardigheden van enkele van de beste ethische hackers. Van SaaS tools voor security tot handmatige tests, we bieden een breed scala aan diensten, altijd met een menselijke aanpak. We brengen onze diensten samen binnen één heldere structuur, met gedeelde tools, eenvoudige processen en waarden die richting geven aan ons werk. We geloven in innovatie en eerlijkheid en bouwen aan een team dat daar net zo over denkt. Jouw rol Als Medior Pentester bij Zerocopter maak je deel uit van een snelgroeiend cybersecuritybedrijf dat platformgedreven beveiliging combineert met tests door experts. Je werkt binnen onze Operations circle, samen met ethische hackers, developers en assessment leads. Hier vindt de uitvoering plaats, worden echte securityuitdagingen opgelost en zetten we onze beloften aan klanten om in concrete resultaten. Je voert zelfstandig security assessments uit op applicaties, API's, infrastructuur en cloudomgevingen, en je beoordeelt meldingen van externe researchers voor onze klanten. In deze offensive security rol breng je ook diepgang in het team: je begeleidt junior collega's, verbetert onze manier van testen en bent aanspreekpunt voor klanten. Je standplaats is flexibel. We werken standaard hybride, met regelmatige aanwezigheid in Groningen voor samenwerking met het team en contact met klanten. Voordat je solliciteert Voor deze functie moet je het Nederlands op professioneel niveau beheersen. Daarnaast verwachten we dat je regelmatig aanwezig bent op ons kantoor in Groningen. Kandidaten moeten in Nederland of elders binnen de EU wonen en zonder visumsponsoring in Nederland mogen werken. Verantwoordelijkheden Security assessments uitvoeren op webapplicaties, API's, mobiele applicaties, cloudomgevingen (AWS/Azure) en interne infrastructuur. Assessments van begin tot eind in eigen hand nemen, met gestructureerde methodieken zoals OWASP en PTES, die je ook verder aanscherpt. Heldere, bruikbare rapporten schrijven met concrete aanbevelingen, en met klanten het gesprek voeren over het oplossen en beperken van de risico's. Meldingen van researchers uit onze Bug Bounty- en Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure-programma's beoordelen en valideren: reproduceerbaarheid en impact vaststellen, dubbele meldingen en false positives eruit filteren en communiceren met researchers. Junior pentesters ondersteunen en begeleiden. Bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van tooling, methodieken en diensten. Op de hoogte blijven van nieuwe dreigingen en aanvalstechnieken, deelnemen aan onderzoeksinitiatieven en kennis delen binnen het team en de bredere community. Jouw profiel Opleiding en certificeringen Twee tot vijf jaar ervaring in offensive security, pentesting of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied. Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in IT, cybersecurity of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied. Een OSCP- of CWEE-certificering is vereist. OSWE of OSEP is een pluspunt. Vaardigheden en ervaring Diepgaande praktijkkennis van (cloud)infrastructuur, API- en webarchitecturen vanuit een offensief perspectief. Ervaring met offensieve securitytools, zoals Burp Suite, Nmap, testssl.sh, ffuf, Subfinder en Shodan. Programmeer- en scriptingvaardigheden, bijvoorbeeld in Python, PowerShell of Bash, om waar nodig eigen tooling te bouwen. Ervaring met Active Directory-aanvallen en privilege escalation. Ervaring met het beoordelen van kwetsbaarheden aan de hand van CVSS 3.1. Je denkt als een aanvaller: creatief, vasthoudend en in staat om risico's over verschillende omgevingen heen te beoordelen. Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels, en het vermogen om technische bevindingen te vertalen naar heldere, risicogerichte adviezen. Een combinatie van eigenaarschap, goed oordeelsvermogen en teamgeest, en het vermogen om hybride te werken en je eigen opdrachten te managen. Mooi meegenomen Ervaring met AI/LLM-tools, zoals Claude Code, Codex of Antigravity CLI, en het toepassen daarvan in offensive security-werk. Interesse in of ervaring met agentic automation: LLM's of autonome agents inzetten voor recon, het vinden van kwetsbaarheden of exploitatie. Actieve deelname aan CTF's, bijvoorbeeld via Hack The Box of TryHackMe. Wat wij bieden Een functie met veel eigenaarschap, verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte om te groeien. Een sterk multidisciplinair team dat kwaliteit boven kwantiteit stelt. Begeleiding door ervaren ethische hackers en leads. Een marktconform salaris op basis van je ervaring. Duidelijke groeimogelijkheden richting een specialistische functie of leadrol. De tools en werkomgeving die je nodig hebt om je werk goed te doen. Een werkomgeving waarin jouw bijdrage rechtstreeks invloed heeft op de ontwikkeling van Zerocopter. Salaris: €3.750,00 - €4.750,00 per maand Werklocatie: Hybride werken in 9723 Groningen

items.desc: Who are we? At Vertiv, we’re on a mission to empower the people that will power the future. From a simple swipe to life-changing medicines, from push notifications to generative AI. We design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected. With $6.9 billion in sales, a strong customer base and global reach spanning nearly 70 countries, we are uniquely positioned to deliver greater value to our customers and create new opportunities for our people. We are now looking for a Next Predict Operations Engineer to join our team in Timisoara, Romania ! Next Predict is Vertiv’s predictive maintenance service for critical data-center equipment, covering both cooling and power. Telemetry from equipment in the field flows into a cloud platform. A diagnostic engine analyses it and turns the results into findings. The findings are then delivered to the people who act on them: monitoring centers, service engineers and customers. The Next Predict Operations team keeps this service running reliably in production. We connect new equipment and keep data flowing. We monitor how the platform and the diagnostic engine behave. We use what we learn to improve the product. What you’ll do Work in an international team. Join daily standups with colleagues from across Europe. Work closely with data scientists, developers, domain experts and service teams. Onboard customers and equipment. Set up data ingestion for new customers, and onboard new equipment models: parsers, telemetry mapping and ingestion configuration. Build and run monitoring across the current setup, from data ingestion and processing to results delivery. Make sure problems are caught early and handled quickly, and act as second-level (L2) support when they are not. Track, evaluate and adapt the product. Follow how the diagnostic engine and the platform perform in real-world use, measure the results, and turn what you learn into improvements. Deploy and promote changes through development, testing and production environments, and validate them before and after release. Keep data consistent between the systems involved, and maintain the pipelines, reports and dashboards that the team and stakeholders rely on. Build and maintain integrations between the platform and other enterprise systems: regional monitoring platforms and other Vertiv solutions such as ConnectedCE. Develop custom use cases for customers on top of the platform. Run onboarding and integration projects. Plan the work, track progress and dependencies, coordinate activities within the team and with stakeholders, and keep everyone informed until the project is live. Help build agentic applications. Support prompt engineering and integration for AI-based tools that work with platform data. Document and share knowledge. Write and update runbooks, procedures and training material, and help colleagues get the most out of the tools. What we’re looking for Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash or similar) and a habit of automating repetitive work. Solid SQL and experience working with data pipelines and data warehouses. Experience on both the backend (APIs, services, message queues) and the frontend (web apps, dashboards). You don’t need to be an expert in both. Cloud experience with AWS, Google Cloud or Azure. Familiarity with containers, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines is a plus. An understanding of multi-tenant applications: tenant isolation, per-tenant configuration and access control. An understanding of operational metrics for predictive systems: thresholds, false-positive and false-negative rates, precision and recall, lead time, and drift. Experience setting up monitoring and alerting, and running releases across environments. Project coordination skills. You can run several technical projects in parallel, keep track of tasks, deadlines and dependencies, and coordinate people across teams. Curiosity and ownership. You look at issues from a fresh angle, ask “why” one more time, and dig into things that don’t add up even when no one asked you to. Clear communication in English, written and spoken, with technical and non-technical colleagues. Nice to have Knowledge of data-center infrastructure (cooling, UPS, power distribution) or industrial IoT. Experience with time-series data, telemetry or device modelling. Experience with BI tools such as Power BI. Exposure to tools built on large language models (LLMs) or AI assistants in an operational setting. How we work Kanban, not sprints. Work flows continuously through a shared board in Jira, and priorities are kept visible and up to date. Team meetings: short daily standups, plus regular team syncs to plan, review and improve how we work. Extended team meetings: regular syncs with the wider Next Predict organisation (data science, development, service operations), plus a “sync of syncs” that keeps all the teams aligned. Microsoft Teams for day-to-day communication, alerts and meetings. GitLab for source code and CI/CD. We are …

items.desc: Who are we? At Vertiv, we’re on a mission to empower the people that will power the future. From a simple swipe to life-changing medicines, from push notifications to generative AI. We design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected. With $6.9 billion in sales, a strong customer base and global reach spanning nearly 70 countries, we are uniquely positioned to deliver greater value to our customers and create new opportunities for our people. We are now looking for a Full-Stack Engineer - Customer Portal & Ask Next to join our team in Timisoara, Romania! Next Predict is Vertiv’s predictive maintenance service for critical data-center infrastructure: cooling and power. A diagnostic engine analyses telemetry from equipment in the field and turns it into findings. Our customer applications are where people see and act on those findings. You will work on two of them: Customer Portal, where customers and service teams see the health of their equipment: sites on a map, live and historical telemetry, health incidents and predictive insights, service requests and exportable reports. Ask Next, an AI assistant that helps remote technical support and monitoring center (NOC) engineers investigate incidents, using the diagnostic engine’s outcomes and Vertiv’s equipment knowledge. You will work across the whole stack: the TypeScript frontend, the Node.js APIs and the containerized deployment. Our current applications use Angular. We care more about strong engineering than about one framework, so solid experience with React, Vue or a similar framework is just as welcome. What you’ll do Build and maintain backend services and REST APIs in Node.js and TypeScript, with an OpenAPI-first contract (request validation, interactive API docs, generated types). Build rich, data-heavy frontend features: interactive charts and dashboards, map-based views, internationalization, and PDF and image export. Build the Ask Next application on top of the diagnostic engine’s outcomes and our AI orchestration platform: conversational UI with streaming responses, conversation history, user feedback, and the APIs behind them. Help separate Ask Next’s frontend from its backend, so the application can evolve and scale independently of the engine. Write efficient queries against our cloud data warehouse (Snowflake) and local caches, and schedule background and reporting jobs. Implement authentication and authorization: Keycloak (OAuth 2.0/OIDC), JWT, and session and cookie handling. Own quality at every layer: unit and integration tests, linting and formatting, pre-commit hooks and coverage. Ship through CI/CD: container image builds, registries, and Helm/Kubernetes deployments across environments. Work with product, the AI platform team, the diagnostic engine team and operations on new features and integrations. What you bring 4+ years of professional full-stack experience, with a strong backend side. Node.js backend experience with Express, Fastify, NestJS or similar; REST API design; and OpenAPI. Strong experience with at least one modern frontend framework (Angular, React or Vue) and solid TypeScript. You are willing to work in Angular day to day. Experience with reactive or state-management patterns, such as RxJS, signals, Redux/Zustand or Pinia. Experience building applications on top of LLM APIs: streaming responses, prompt and context handling, and dealing with latency, cost and failures. SQL skills; Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse is a plus. Experience with OAuth 2.0/OIDC and JWT-based security; hands-on Keycloak (realms, clients, roles, token handling) preferred. Hands-on Docker and CI/CD experience. GitLab CI is preferred; Kubernetes/Helm exposure is a plus. Care for testing, code review and maintainable code. Clear communication in English, written and spoken. Nice to have Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent or tool-calling patterns, or MCP. Data visualization and charting (Highcharts, ECharts, D3) and geospatial UI (Leaflet, Mapbox). Time-series or IoT data, or industrial and data-center domain knowledge. Cloud experience (AWS or Azure). Experience with micro-frontend architectures (Web Components, Module Federation). The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principals & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities. OUR CORE PRINCIPALS: Safety, Integrity, Respect, Teamwork, Diversity & Inclusion. Low Code & Conversational AI Experience: Experience presenting conversational AI and generative AI technologies. items.desc: Founder & CEO — Group Buying Agent Protocol Our AI agents are already saving us money, but they are leaving savings on the table. Build the protocol that lets AI agents pool their users and negotiate as one, starting with insurance. Location: London Start date: ASAP About Founders Factory: Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Created by IPO-exited founders, we offer founders capital, operational support from a team of hands-on experts, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry-leading corporate partners. Since 2015, Founders Factory's 450+ portfolio companies have secured 500+ pilots and commercial contracts with our partners. Our Studio partners with entrepreneurs at day one, developing new ideas, technologies and business models into high-growth companies. In partnership with Aviva, one of the UK's leading insurers, we are building a new portfolio of ventures out of London. About the Venture: People and businesses are starting to hand their buying to AI agents. The share of UK adults who have used or would use an AI agent to shop rose from 31% to 48% in a year. But every agent still shops alone: it gets a quote for one person, one business, one policy at a time. A careful, low-risk customer looks the same as any other request, and intermediaries take a big cut. Insurance brokers earned about $180bn in fees and commissions worldwide in 2024. We are building the layer that lets agents buy together. Any agent can enrol its user, with consented and verified data, into cohorts that share a profile: for example small businesses with a clean claims record, or EV owners with a garage and a home charger. Suppliers bid for the cohort in set windows, and each member still gets an individual price. We start with insurance, where verified data changes the price most, and where the best cohorts can eventually share in their own risk through a profit-share pool or group captive. Then we take the same rails to any category where pooled demand gets a better deal: energy, software, procurement. The timing is right. The FCA's Mills Review expects AI to act for consumers "within agreed parameters". The Data (Use and Access) Act created powers for smart data schemes, so agents can bring verified facts to every quote. And general-purpose agents are launching at scale. Jobs to be Done: As Founder & CEO, you will be responsible for turning a strong thesis into a scaled, defensible business. Pick the first market. Decide where group buying works first: SMEs and mid-sized businesses, or consumers through their agents, and which product line to start with. Build the rails. Design the protocol and infrastructure that lets any AI agent enrol users, share verified data with consent and join a cohort. Prove the price. Run the first pilot cohorts with Aviva and show that verified, pooled demand earns a better price than shopping alone. Win the agents. Get agent builders and platforms to plug in, so demand flows to you rather than to comparison sites. Build the company. Hire the initial team, raise capital, and extend the rails beyond insurance to any category where buying together wins. Your Ideal Experience: You don't need an insurance background. We're looking for an AI-native builder who wants to build the infrastructure the agent economy runs on. Founder or early technical or product leader who has built infrastructure, APIs, protocols or marketplaces. Deep, hands-on fluency with AI agents: you build with them every day and have strong views on where agentic commerce is going. Platform and partnership instinct: you know how to get developers and other platforms to adopt your rails. Exposure to fintech, insurtech, marketplaces or procurement is a plus, not a requirement. Comfortable operating in ambiguity: defining a category that doesn't exist yet and making irreversible calls with incomplete data. Credibility with a large corporate partner and with forward-looking venture investors. Most importantly, you believe agents will soon buy most things for us, and you want to build the layer that makes them buy better. This is your company. We're here to help.

items.desc: Lijkt het je gaaf om AI niet alleen te bedenken, maar vooral te bouwen, toe te passen en continu te verbeteren? Dan zit je bij Sawiday goed! AI-agents, slimme workflows en voorspellende modellen zijn bij ons geen toekomstmuziek, maar dagelijkse praktijk. We zoeken iemand die deze toepassingen verder uitbouwt en met slimme technologie onze organisatie steeds een stap vooruithelpt. Sawiday is een toonaangevende speler in de sanitairbranche. Ons team van meer dan 280 gemotiveerde medewerkers beheert onze online webshops (Sawiday.be, Sawiday.fr, Sanitairwinkel.nl), zestien showrooms in Nederland en vier winkels in België. Jouw rol als AI Engineer / Data Scientist Bij Sawiday draait AI niet meer in een hoekje als experiment, maar in de dagelijkse praktijk. Onze AI-agents bereiden klantvragen in Zendesk voor en handelen ze af, workflows nemen handwerk over bij Inkoop en HR, en modellen helpen Marketing kiezen waar het budget naartoe gaat. Als AI Engineer / Data Scientist bouw je deze toepassingen, breng je ze naar productie en zorg je dat ze blijven werken. Je komt in ons Data & IT team en werkt nauw samen met onze data/pricing analist, met IT en met een externe groep senior data consultants. Je werkt direct voor de afdelingen die jouw oplossingen gebruiken: Klantenservice, Marketing, Inkoop, Logistiek en Finance. Wat ga je doen? Bouwen, verbeteren en beheren van AI-agents die in productie draaien, zoals onze klantenservice-agents: prompts, skills, tools (MCP) en de koppelingen met onze systemen. Meten of het werkt: evaluatiesets opzetten, gesprekken en overdrachten naar collega’s analyseren, en op basis daarvan de agents bijsturen. Samen met IT zorgen dat AI veilig en beheersbaar draait: deployment via CI/CD, sleutels in een vault, monitoring en privacy (PII-filtering, DPIA, AVG). Afdelingen helpen hun processen te automatiseren met AI en workflows (bijvoorbeeld n8n), van inkoop en orderverwerking tot HR en finance. Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van voorspellende modellen, aanbevelingssystemen en marketingattributie (MTA), samen met onze data/pricing analist en de externe consultants. Snel prototypen en resultaten zichtbaar maken: van een analyse of dashboard tot een werkend prototype waarop de business kan beslissen. Collega’s wegwijs maken in AI: kennissessies geven, best practices vastleggen en meedenken over welke toepassingen we wel en niet bouwen. Wie ben jij? Je hebt een master in de richting van Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Econometrie of iets vergelijkbaars. Minimaal twee jaar werkervaring als data scientist, ML-engineer of AI-engineer, bij voorkeur met toepassingen die echt in productie draaien. Aantoonbare ervaring met het bouwen van toepassingen op large language models (zoals Claude of GPT): prompt engineering, agents en tool use, RAG of MCP. Je weet hoe je de kwaliteit van een AI-toepassing meet: met evaluaties, testsets en foutanalyse. Je beheerst Python en SQL, R is een plus. Je werkt vanzelfsprekend met Git, CI/CD en API’s. Ervaring met cloud, bij voorkeur Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Run, Vertex AI), en met containers (Docker, Kubernetes). Een stevige basis in machine learning en statistiek, zodat je ook een voorspel- of attributiemodel kunt bouwen en beoordelen. Kennis van privacy en security rond AI (AVG, omgaan met persoonsgegevens) is een pré. Werkervaring binnen de retail/e-tail of met klantenservicesystemen zoals Zendesk is een pré. Ervaring met workflow-automatisering (bijvoorbeeld n8n) of dashboarding is een pré. Competenties Je bent communicatief vaardig en legt technische keuzes helder uit aan niet-technische collega’s. Je hebt een hands-on-mentaliteit en maakt dingen af tot ze in productie draaien. Je beschikt over probleemoplossend vermogen en een kritische blik: je wilt weten of iets werkt, niet alleen dat het draait. Je kunt zelfstandig werken maar bent ook een teamspeler. Je hebt een uitstekende kennis van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift. Je bent proactief en ziet zelf kansen voor AI in de organisatie. Je bent nieuwsgierig en leergierig, en houdt het snel bewegende AI-veld bij. Je documenteert je werk en draagt het over, zodat wat je bouwt niet alleen van jou afhangt. Wat bieden wij? Een competitief salaris op basis van opleiding en werkervaring 8% vakantiegeld, 25 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. 40 uur) en een optie om extra dagen bij te kopen. Een plekje in een jong en energiek team, waar iedereen iets toevoegt. Succes maak je samen. Jezelf ontwikkelen en steeds uit blijven dagen. Als jij wil groeien in je vak, faciliteren we je ambities graag. Uitzicht op een vast contract. Faciliteren van opleidingen en/of cursussen via onze eigen Sawiday Academy. Aantrekkelijke pensioen- en fietsregeling. Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken. Reiskostenvergoeding en thuiswerkvergoeding. Een hoge korting op ons eigen assortiment sanitair- en badkamerartikelen. Een geweldig team van collega’s waarbij teamwork en collegialiteit van groot belang zijn. De werksfeer is goed en …

Fortinet’s AI-Native Security Fabric secures the full AI lifecycle, from the AI data centre to the agentic application. FortiGate Hyperscale firewalls protect high-performance AI infrastructure, while FortiAIGate applies runtime guardrails to LLMs, agents and MCP tools, defending against prompt injection, data leakage and model abuse. The newly launched FortiGuard Inline AI Security Service brings those protections, plus shadow-AI discovery, AI data-loss prevention, token-spend governance and agent visibility, to existing FortiGate customers with no additional infrastructure. Development in FortiAIGate adds agent red-teaming, MCP tool scanning and continuous AI assurance, while the FortiAI family (FortiAI-Protect, FortiAI-Assist and FortiAI-SecureAI) embeds AI across the platform itself, all backed by FortiGuard Labs threat intelligence. items.desc:
ABOUT BLACK FOREST LABS

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.




WHY THIS ROLE

FLUX is the model developers want. BFL still has to become the platform they choose. In 2026 that platform is judged by a single question, asked by both humans and the agents acting on their behalf: how fast can I go from idea to a production-shaped call, and how good does it feel along the way?

We're hiring one person to own that answer end-to-end. Not the SDK alone, not the dashboard alone, not the API alone — the whole developer experience, for both the humans building on BFL and the agents building on their behalf. You're the person on the team who breathes DevExp: spotting where the platform is friction for a developer or for an agent, deciding whether the fix lives in the API contract, the SDK, the console, the docs surface, the MCP server, or the onboarding flow — and then shipping it.

You sit inside product engineering. You work shoulder-to-shoulder with the API/platform eng team (think: designing the next API revision), with research as new capabilities land, and with DevRel. Your job is to make BFL the platform that wins on developer experience, the way Stripe won payments and Vercel won frontends.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

 - Own DevExp as a product surface — wherever the bottleneck is, that's where you ship next. One sprint that might be the API contract, the next it's the dashboard onboarding, the next it's an MCP server, the next it's a Python SDK abstraction

 - Partner with platform engineering on API design before it ships, not after — bring the developer-and-agent perspective into the room when the contract is being decided

 - Work with product engineering on the developer-facing surfaces of the dashboard — playground, API keys, usage, request inspectors, webhook debugging — bringing the DevExp lens to features the rest of the team is already shipping

 - Make BFL the best visual AI platform for agents to use. Own the MCP server, skills, agent onboarding paths, and the machine-readable surfaces of the platform. Design the reference patterns and SDK primitives developers reach for when building agentic workflows on FLUX. Stress-test every API and SDK change against "would Claude / GPT / an autonomous agent get this right on the first try?" — and treat agents as a first-class user across the whole product (errors an LLM can recover from, capabilities discoverable without a human reading docs, audit trails that make sense when most of the traffic on an account isn't a person).

 - Own the portfolio of entry points developers and agents reach for — SDKs (Python, TypeScript, more on demand), MCP server, skills, OpenAPI / typed surfaces — and treat them as a portfolio, not a hierarchy. SDKs add composable workflows and sane defaults for async / polling / retries; MCP and skills make BFL trivially usable from any agent loop. DevRel and the Creative Technologist team partner on examples, content, and showcase work on top of these surfaces — you own the surfaces themselves.

 - Partner with the Growth engineer and Product on the developer funnel — signup → first key → first call → first production call → repeat — and own the DevExp fixes for the cliffs they surface

 - Be opinionated. Versioning, error formats, breaking change policy, idempotency, naming — you have takes and you can defend them. The bar is Stripe: an API and SDK so well-designed the docs almost feel unnecessary.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years building software, with meaningful time on developer-facing products — SDKs, APIs, dashboards, consoles, platforms developers actually use

 - Full-stack comfortable. TypeScript / React / Next on the front, Python (and ideally Go or Rust) on the back. You don't need a separate person to wire the two halves of a feature together.

 - Deep instincts on API design — you have opinions about error formats, pagination, async job shapes, breaking changes, and you've lived with the consequences of bad ones

 - Fluent in the 2026 agent stack — MCP, tool use, the major agent runtimes — and you know what breaks when an LLM is the one reading your error message or browsing your API

 - You've shipped developer-facing product that real external developers depend on. Not internal tooling.

 - You ship. This is product engineering, not …

items.desc:
Join CERN's Scientific Information Service and contribute to the evolution of INSPIRE, a key information platform serving the global high energy physics community.
 INSPIRE provides access to scientific literature, research data, author profiles and other scholarly information, supporting researchers in discovering, exploring and connecting scientific knowledge.
 As an AI Engineer, you will explore and develop AI capabilities to enhance scientific information discovery, access and curation within INSPIRE. Your work will focus on evaluating and improving existing AI prototypes, investigating retrieval augmented generation (RAG), semantic search and agentic approaches, and exploring how emerging technologies can support researchers and information specialists.
 You will also contribute to the development and evaluation of AI integration capabilities, including the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling AI assistants and other applications to interact with INSPIRE's scientific information and services.
 Working closely with software engineers, platform engineer and domain experts, you will design prototypes, establish evaluation methodologies and assess the feasibility of integrating promising solutions into INSPIRE, considering performance, reliability and CERN's computing infrastructure.
 Your responsibilities: 
 Evaluate existing INSPIRE AI prototypes and explore approaches such as LLMs, RAG, semantic search and agentic workflows to improve scientific information discovery and curation.
 Develop and assess AI integrations, including MCP services, enabling AI assistants to interact with INSPIRE's data and services.
 Design and implement evaluation methods to assess accuracy, relevance, reliability, performance and resource requirements of AI solutions.
 Investigate deployment options within CERN's infrastructure, integrate and release validated AI features into production, and monitor their performance and reliability.
 Your profile: 
 Practical experience developing AI or machine learning applications through professional, research or substantial project work.
 Experience implementing solutions using modern AI technologies, such as LLMs, embeddings, retrieval systems or agentic approaches.
 Experience designing experiments, evaluating model outputs and comparing technical approaches.
 Experience developing Python applications and integrating APIs or external services.
 Experience deploying AI applications or integrating them into production systems.
 Skills: 
 Strong Python programming and software engineering skills, including API development, testing and integration.
 Hands-on experience with AI/ML frameworks and modern AI technologies, such as LLMs, embeddings, RAG and agentic workflows.
 Ability to design, develop and evaluate AI solutions, including benchmarking, quality assessment and performance optimisation.
 Experience integrating AI models and services into existing applications.
 Knowledge of containerisation (Docker), deployment practices and CI/CD workflows.
 Familiarity with MCP, model serving, Kubernetes or cloud infrastructure would be an asset.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently, investigate emerging technologies and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria: 
 You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .
 You have a professional background in Computer Science (or a related field) and have either: a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;
 or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.
 You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 14.12.2026 at 23:59 CET. 
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Hybrid
 Target start date: 01-February-2027
 Job reference: OSI-SIS-TS-2026-178-GRAP
 Field of work: Information Technologies
 Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer
 Global Benefits 
 A monthly net stipend of either 6372 or 7004 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
 Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
 Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

items.desc:
Join our Team
 About this opportunity: 
 Do you want to help shape the future of Ericsson and work with 5G and 6G? Join one of the most exciting and challenging R&D businesses in the world. This role is for you.
 PEU (Product Engineering Unit) RAN Performance Layer 2 UPC Software is part of BA Networks. We are responsible for the Baseband L2 product, its quality and architecture on GPP (x86/ARM/GPU) platforms. Our organization is spread across Sweden, Canada, the US and India.
 The industry is at a unique moment, full of opportunities. 5G and Cloud RAN are already a reality, and Ericsson is leading the way in bringing 6G and AI RAN to market. We challenge established ways of working with new methodologies, we are active in open-source communities, and we are rapidly becoming an AI-powered organization. There has never been a better time to make your mark. With us, you won't just wonder what the future holds. You will help define it.
 Joining us lets you take your career in the direction you choose, with hundreds of opportunities in locations around the world. You will work in a speak-up environment where empathy and respect are cornerstones of how we work, and where work-life balance is a priority. And you will have plenty of fun along the way.
 What you will do: 
 As a member of the design team, you will help develop the User Plane Control Layer (L2) components of Ericsson's Baseband software for our world-leading 5G RAN and future 6G solutions. You will:
 Contribute to baseband product development, including systemization, design, testing and troubleshooting, and gain hands-on exposure to advanced integrated and Cloud RAN products
 Take part in design and code reviews, testing and quality assurance
 Implement solutions using production-grade, agentic AI workflows
 Learn industry best practices, agile ways of working and state-of-the-art development environments, and apply that knowledge to drive product innovation
 Learn from experienced colleagues who are glad to share their knowledge, with support to grow your skills and career from day one.
 The skills you bring: 
 A Master's degree, PhD or equivalent in telecommunications, computer science, signal processing, wireless communications or embedded systems
 Talent and passion for software development and problem solving, and an understanding of computer systems. You enjoy discussing software and sharing your knowledge
 A collaborative approach that makes you a great teammate
 Programming knowledge in at least one of C, C++, Java or Python
 Knowledge of computer architecture.
 Additional qualifications we value 
 Experience using AI in software development
 Ability to develop and deploy embedded software on GPP hardware (x86, ARM, GPU or others)
 Good understanding of Linux or other operating systems
 Familiarity with 4G/5G/6G wireless technologies, 3GPP/O-RAN standards and/or telecom signal processing
 You don't need to tick every box. If you are curious, motivated and excited about this work, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to build an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.
 Why join Ericsson? At Ericsson, you'll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You'll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You'll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.
 What happens once you apply? Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, learn more.

 Overview 
 Contribuirai all'evoluzione tecnologica dei servizi di Contact Center della Banca, partecipando alla progettazione e alla governance di soluzioni basate su architetture Cloud (CCaaS) e modelli ibridi. Sarai coinvolto in iniziative progettuali innovative, con particolare attenzione all'integrazione di soluzioni di AI conversazionale e agentica, tra cui virtual agent, chatbot e voicebot, per evolvere i modelli di interazione con la clientela, favorire l'automazione dei processi di customer care e migliorare la Customer Experience. 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Collaborare alla progettazione e all'evoluzione delle piattaforme Contact Center Cloud e on-premise, a supporto dei canali voce e digitali. 
 Partecipare alla definizione di architetture ibride e all'integrazione tra sistemi legacy e piattaforme Cloud. 
 Analizzare i requisiti di business e contribuire alla definizione di soluzioni tecnologiche scalabili e resilienti. 
 Partecipare a progetti di integrazione di soluzioni di AI conversazionale e agentica. 
 Contribuire all'evoluzione dei servizi di routing, IVR e automazione delle interazioni con i clienti. 
 Verificare la conformità delle soluzioni agli standard aziendali di architettura, compliance e Cybersecurity. 
 Collaborare con team progettuali e fornitori nella gestione delle attività e delle criticità tecniche. 
 Supportare le attività di troubleshooting, incident management e analisi delle problematiche sulle piattaforme Contact Center. 
 Chi stiamo cercando 
 Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: 
 Esperienza di 1-3 anni nel ruolo 
 Conoscenza delle piattaforme Contact Center Cloud in particolare Genesys Cloud e on-premise, dei sistemi IVR e di Voice Recording. 
 Competenze di networking, protocolli VoIP e SIP, routing e integrazione applicativa. 
 Conoscenza di database SQL, NoSQL e servizi dati Cloud. 
 Conoscenza delle architetture ibride e dei principi di Cybersecurity, Data Governance e Change Management. 
 Familiarità con soluzioni di AI conversazionale e agentica, virtual agent, chatbot e voicebot. 
 Conoscenza della lingua inglese almeno di livello B2 secondo il QCER. 
 Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria o discipline STEM affini. 
 Costituiscono un plus: conoscenza di architetture a microservizi, linguaggi di programmazione come Python e Java e piattaforme di monitoring. 
 Saranno considerate in via preferenziale le candidature di coloro che abbiano maturato significative esperienze professionali o di studio in contesti internazionali. 
 Cosa ti offriamo 
 Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da 35.650 € 
 Il Gruppo prevede una componente variabile della remunerazione così come disciplinata dalle Politiche di Remunerazione consultabili sul sito di Gruppo 
 Elementi complementari disciplinati dal Contratto Collettivo Nazionale Credito e accordi aziendali di secondo livello 
 Iniziative di sviluppo professionale a supporto della crescita delle nostre persone 
 Ampia offerta formativa tramite la Corporate Academy dedicata allo sviluppo continuo delle competenze professionali, manageriali e trasversali a tutti i livelli 
 Possibilità di aderire al lavoro flessibile e alla settimana corta 4x9 
 Sistema moderno e integrato di welfare aziendale ( link ) 
 Copertura sanitaria e previdenza complementare a decorrere dall’assunzione 
 Vantaggi sui prodotti e servizi bancari del Gruppo 
 Costituisce titolo preferenziale aver svolto percorsi di studio e/o lavoro in ambito internazionale 
 Chi siamo 
 Siamo leader in Italia e uno dei principali gruppi bancari in Europa. Unisciti a noi e fai parte della nostra storia di successo! Con oltre 20 milioni di clienti in Italia e all'estero siamo un vero e proprio motore di crescita sostenibile con un forte impegno per l'ambiente e un impatto tangibile sulla società. 
 Le persone sono al centro, ce ne prendiamo cura impegnandoci nel creare una cultura inclusiva all'interno del Gruppo in cui tutti si sentano protagonisti e valorizzati. 
 L’Area Chief Data, A.I. & Technology Officer è la realtà IT del Gruppo che coniuga l’agilità di una fintech con la solidità di un grande gruppo; avrai l'opportunità di lavorare in un contesto innovativo con tecnologie all’avanguardia e con forte spinta alla trasformazione digitale. 
 Unisciti alla nostra realtà internazionale. Il futuro non si aspetta, si sceglie! 
 #sharingfuture 
 Garantiamo un ambiente inclusivo e di pari opportunità. Considereremo tutte le candidature a prescindere da razza, religione, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, stato civile, età, disabilità o qualsiasi altra categoria protetta nel rispetto dei D.lgs. 198/2006, 215/03 e 216/03. 
 Per la valutazione delle candidature, i dati saranno utilizzati da Intesa Sanpaolo S.p.A. come Data Controller. Ti invitiamo a prendere visione dell’ Informativa Privacy dedicata.

items.desc: EngineeringRemote, France/Morocco time zoneFull timeReports to Walid Boulanouar, CTOCompensation: competitive, shared at interview AI Engineer : You build it, it ships to production You are the builder. RAG, multi-agent systems, orchestration: you build inside our clients' tools, and what you write ships to production. / The role What you take on You wire an agent into a system that was never designed for it A client CRM or ERP has ten years of history and empty fields where the agent expects clean data. What leaves your machine runs in front of real users the following week. Cost control, model choice, caching: that is your problem, not the client's. You are on call when it breaks A production system goes down on a Tuesday evening: you are the one who gets called, and you are the one who fixes it. You train while building Part of your time goes to explaining to the client's non-technical teams what the system does and how to adjust it. / Your first 90 days Weeks 1-2, you take over a system already in production and evolve it. From month 2, you carry your own workstreams end to end, under the technical direction of Walid Boulanouar, our CTO.
