items.desc: Groupe de conseil international fondé en 2019, Ekkiden anime un écosystème de consultants passionnés et engagés qui mènent des projets de transformation organisationnelle, opérationnelle et technologique dans l'IT/Digital, l'Industrie/R&D et la sustainability, chez les grands comptes et PME, en France, Suisse, Espagne et Allemagne. Le rôle : Développeur Java IA Nous recherchons un Développeur Java expérimenté, ayant évolué vers les technologies d'Intelligence Artificielle, pour rejoindre une équipe basée à Annecy et accompagner la modernisation d'une application métier historique en Java et son évolution vers une solution augmentée par l'IA. Au sein d'une équipe IA/LLM en construction, tu interviendras sur la conception et le développement de solutions Data et IA destinées aux équipes R&D, notamment dans l'univers du footwear. Tu travailleras en proximité avec les Product Owners et les équipes métier R&D afin de transformer leurs besoins en solutions concrètes et industrialisées. Responsabilités : Faire évoluer une application métier historique développée en Java vers une solution intégrant l'IA, notamment les LLM, les assistants et l'automatisation. Concevoir et développer des briques IA dans le cadre d'une architecture définie avec l'équipe. Contribuer à la transformation digitale des processus de développement produit en déployant des solutions Data et IA pour les équipes R&D. Industrialiser les prototypes en garantissant la qualité du code, les tests et le déploiement cloud (AWS, Azure). Collaborer quotidiennement avec les Product Owners et les utilisateurs R&D, dans le cadre de cycles de 2 à 3 mois. Assurer la traçabilité et la documentation des développements. Intervenir sur différents projets concrets de l'équipe R&D : Convertisseur de designs : transformer des designs Adobe Illustrator (SVG) en dessins techniques 2D. Stockage et traçabilité : concevoir un système de stockage des données et de suivi des projets informatiques Colorisation intelligente : développer un outil d'IA basé sur Snowflake Cortex et Streamlit, combinant données techniques et données couleur pour assister la création des colorways. Color Science : étudier le comportement de la couleur selon les matériaux afin de réduire les écarts colorimétriques entre jumeaux numériques et produits physiques. Ce que nous recherchons : Expérience : 5 à 10 ans d'expérience en développement Java, avec une évolution vers les technologies IA. Java : solide maîtrise du développement applicatif et de la maintenance évolutive. IA / LLM : expérience dans l'intégration de modèles, le prompt engineering et l'utilisation d'assistants de code. Python : compétence fortement souhaitée. Snowflake Cortex et Streamlit : connaissances appréciées. Data Engineering : connaissances appréciées. Cloud : connaissances des environnements AWS et Azure appréciées. Vision par ordinateur : un plus. Adobe Illustrator (SVG) et Grasshopper : un plus. Color Science et outils d'optimisation : un plus. Salaire proposé: En CDI : Entre 43 à 48K selon expérience. Ce que nous proposons : ? Nous rejoindre au bon moment pour faire ta place au sein d'une organisation en très forte croissance ? Des missions variées dans un environnement challengeant qui te permettront d'avoir un réel impact sur la boite ? La possibilité de travailler de façon autonome et d'être force de proposition pour grandir ensemble ? Un parcours de carrière adapté à ta personnalité, aussi bien au niveau du rôle que de la localité ? Une formation exigeante en continu pour libérer tout ton potentiel ? Une culture de la performance avec de belles primes de résultats ?? Une mutuelle très complète (la GEREP) et des titres-restaurant (carte Swile) Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement chez Ekkiden ? Chez Ekkiden, nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience positive à chaque candidat. Premier contact : Notre équipe de recrutement vous contactera pour discuter de vos motivations et attentes. Entretiens : Vous passerez un ou deux entretiens avec nos business managers, en fonction du poste pour lequel vous postulez. Rencontre avec le client : Enfin, vous aurez l'opportunité de rencontrer le client. Bien que ce soit notre processus standard, nous pouvons l'adapter en fonction des circonstances spécifiques. items.desc: Location: Oostkamp, Belgium (CERM HQ) Type: Full-time For more than 40 years, CERM has been building cutting-edge MIS solutions for the label and packaging printing industry. Our software helps label and packaging printers streamline their operations and boost productivity, backed by deep industry knowledge and a drive to keep innovating. We're looking for a hands-on, curious QA Test Engineer who makes sure our ERP software works the way our customers expect, every release, in every environment. You'll test both our on-premises Windows software and our cloud solutions. You'll define how we test, build and maintain automated tests, check how our software holds up under load, and still roll up your sleeves for manual testing where it adds the most value. You'll work closely with developers, product owners and our implementation and support teams. And you won't stop at finding bugs. You help the team prevent them, by making quality part of how we build software from day one. What you'll do Shape our test strategy Define and maintain test strategies and test plans for both our on-premises Windows software and our cloud solutions. Test performance and load Set up and run load and performance tests to check how our software behaves under realistic customer volumes. Analyse results, pinpoint bottlenecks and work with developers and IT to resolve them. Test hands-on Carry out manual and exploratory testing where automation is not the best fit, such as new features, complex workflows and usability. Run regression testing before releases and validate fixes and hotfixes. Log clear, reproducible defect reports and follow them up until they are resolved. Test realistic end-to-end business scenarios, from order entry to production and invoicing, and installation and upgrade scenarios for on-premises customers. Build quality into the team Work as part of agile development teams and take part in refinements, sprint planning and reviews. Share testing knowledge with developers and help them write better tests themselves. Explore how AI and agentic tools can make our testing faster and smarter. Experience testing both Windows desktop software and web applications. Good understanding of functional business processes such as order handling, planning, production, purchasing and invoicing, or a strong interest in learning them. Solid knowledge of testing techniques and methods: test design, regression testing, exploratory testing and risk-based testing. Hands-on experience with test automation for web front ends, like Playwright, Selenium or Cypress. Scripting skills in a language such as TypeScript/JavaScript, Python or PowerShell. Fluent in Dutch and English. Bonus points if you: Basic SQL knowledge to prepare test data and validate results in the database. Experience with load or performance testing tools, such as JMeter, k6 or similar. API testing experience (for example with Postman, Bruno or Playwright's API testing features). The mindset you bring to the team You have a critical eye and a sharp attention to detail, and you like to understand how things really work. You're hands-on and solution-oriented, and you prefer preventing bugs to finding them. You communicate clearly and constructively, also when the news is not what people want to hear. You have a strong interest in automation and AI, and you keep learning new tools and techniques. You feel at home in agile teams and a fast-paced international environment. items.desc: We are currently seeking a Business Analyst (M/F) to join our team based in Nanterre, France. Mission Drive business with data. You will drive the Business Analysis BI × AI programme: an ecosystem of AI agents combining external signals (FIDs, tenders, competitor moves), external databases (Rystad, S&P, LinkedIn) and internal data (CRM, Reference, Tendering, etc.). The goal is to automate competitive intelligence, Key Account Management (KAM) reports and market analysis, while challenging CRM data on pipeline, win probabilities and competitive positioning. The outputs will support bid/no-bid calls and business decisions. You will also manage CRM data and drive CRM development projects to generate commercial insights. You will bridge business and IT, translating analyst needs and data into clear requirements and working closely with the IT team to build, test and roll out the solution. Key responsibilities Drive the project end to end: manage scope, roadmap, risks and progress reporting, from pilot to production. Work closely with IT: translate business needs into user stories, define data access and security requirements. Shape the AI agents: define each agent’s role (competitive intelligence, KAM reports, market analysis, CRM challenge), sources and standard outputs. Bring in the data: map and onboard external signals, licensed databases and internal systems with data owners. Challenge the CRM: establish rules and indicators to test pipeline completeness, win probabilities and competitive positioning. Support decisions: ensure outputs inform bid/no-bid calls, account plans and management reviews. Drive adoption: train analysts, sales teams and KAMs, collect feedback, and measure time saved and decision quality. Ensure governance: maintain data quality, source traceability, AI policy compliance and human review of key outputs. Develop CRM: Participate to CRM development project to update data that can be used to drive business. Profile Must have Master's degree in engineering, business, data or a related field. Experience in business intelligence, market analysis or consulting. Proven experience running data or digital projects with IT teams. Good understanding of AI and generative AI (LLMs, agents), including their capabilities and limitations. Strong analytical mindset, including market sizing, competitive analysis and pipeline analysis. Clear communicator, able to work with sales, executives and technical teams. Fluent English; French is a plus. Nice to have Knowledge of the energy, infrastructure or EPC sector. Hands-on experience with Salesforce, Power BI or similar tools. Familiarity with market databases such as Rystad or S&P.

items.card: What you'll do Own the end-to-end quality of the Nebuly platform — from new feature releases to production deployments across customer environments Catch issues before they reach customers — proactively test, break things, and surface edge cases that engineers miss Work closely with engineers and the PM during feature development to define acceptance criteria and flag quality risks early Own and maintain test
items.desc: Location : Turin, Italy (hybrid) Type : Full-time Level : Mid–Senior Reporting to: CTO About Nebuly Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI. Every enterprise function — sales, customer support, HR, finance — is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working?Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there — millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents — but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer — is this working, and where — and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value — with no data ever leaving your environment. Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI — turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value. Our customers include Oura, CNH Industrial, Vodafone, and Moncler. Demand is accelerating fast, and we're building the team to match. Why this role matters Our customers are some of the largest enterprises in the world — running mission-critical AI agents that touch millions of users. They chose Nebuly because they trust us to give them an accurate, reliable picture of what's happening across their AI deployments. That trust is built on product quality, and product quality is built by you. This role exists because we hold ourselves to an unusually high bar. Bugs that would be acceptable at most startups are not acceptable here. A broken chart, a wrong metric, a failed deployment — these are not minor inconveniences. They are credibility issues with a Fortune 500 customer. You shouldn't apply if you see QA as a gate at the end of the engineering process. You should apply if you believe quality is a mindset that starts before a single line of code is written — and you want to be the person who holds the entire engineering team to that standard. What you'll do Own the end-to-end quality of the Nebuly platform — from new feature releases to production deployments across customer environments Catch issues before they reach customers — proactively test, break things, and surface edge cases that engineers miss Work closely with engineers and the PM during feature development to define acceptance criteria and flag quality risks early Own and maintain test environments that accurately reflect production conditions, including enterprise self-hosted deployments Investigate and reproduce bugs reported by customers, triage severity, and coordinate fast resolution with the engineering team Build internal QA processes and documentation as the team scales — you are the first dedicated QA hire, and you will define how this function works What we're looking for 4+ years of experience in QA engineering in a B2B SaaS environment Strong experience with test automation frameworks (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar) Solid understanding of backend systems — ability to test APIs, data pipelines, and database outputs, not just UI Experience testing data-heavy or analytics products is a strong plus Familiarity with Python, Typescript and SQL — you don't need to be a developer, but you need to be able to read code and write queries Experience with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into the release process High attention to detail and a genuine intolerance for shipping things that aren't right Strong communication skills in English — you will work closely with engineers, the PM, and occasionally with customers What we offer Real ownership. The processes, standards, and test infrastructure you build will define quality at Nebuly for years. High stakes, high impact. Our customers run mission-critical AI products. Your work directly protects their trust in us — and you'll feel that weight and that satisfaction every day. A high-growth environment. As we scale, so do the opportunities. You'll grow with the product and the company. Competitive pay + equity. Top-of-market salary for a startup role, plus meaningful stock options in a fast-scaling company. Sound like you? Apply now! Compensation Range: €25K - €35K

items.desc: Who are we? CLEVR delivers digital transformation at scale by implementing Siemens and Mendix solutions to serve industries like manufacturing, retail, energy, and more. We leverage PLM, MOM/MES, and low-code technologies for manufacturing optimization and business process automation while ensuring seamless integration with other core systems like SAP, IBM, and Salesforce. CLEVR brings together technology and industry expertise to provide strategic solutions that streamline operations, drive efficiency, and enable digitalization to fit market demands. We're a platinum partner of both Siemens and Mendix, which means our people work on the full picture: PLM and MOM/MES on the shop floor, AI augmented low-code applications that tie it together, and the integrations into the systems our clients already run. With seven offices across six countries we're big enough to take on serious industrial challenges, and close enough that you can reach any colleague in Europe directly and actually get an answer. AI isn't a side initiative here but a strategic priority, so you'll help build what comes next rather than maintain what came before. And we like being around each other: we have lunch at the office, prepared by our dedicated facilities team, celebrate successes as they happen, and take the time to enjoy getting where we're going. About the Job : At CLEVR, AI is not a side initiative; it is a strategic priority and a key pillar of our future growth. On a factory floor that ambition becomes very concrete: connecting data that is currently trapped in separate systems, giving operations the visibility they do not have today, and amplifying it with AI where it genuinely adds value, people and AI agents working together in a governed way. As a MOM/MES Business Consultant, you'll be the person who makes sense of how a manufacturing operation actually runs. On Monday a product takes four hours; on Tuesday the same product takes six, and nobody can say why. You spend time on site, work out what is really happening, not what the process documentation says is happening, and turn that into an action plan the customer can commit to. From there you help build it on the Siemens MOM portfolio suite. You'll work hands-on with the systems themselves, from demonstrations through to assessing how far they can be extended for a given customer, and you'll advise on where digitalization creates the most value and which MOM/MES solutions will get your client there. Beyond actual project implementation, you'll contribute to strengthening our team. You'll share your knowledge and experience with colleagues, support newer consultants within project teams, and contribute to pre-sales activities and project estimations, while continuing to explore how AI and manufacturing data can be combined into smarter, more impactful solutions for our customers. Let's Build Tomorrow Together! What makes this role unique: Join CLEVR in Amersfoort as a MOM/MES Business Consultant. In this role, you start by listening on site, spending time at customers' plants to quickly understand their processes, ask the right questions, and spot what others miss. You take ownership of the full journey: analysis, gap identification, action plans, solution concepts, test cases, and customer presentations. This is a hands-on advisory role where credibility comes from showing results, not just describing them. At CLEVR, you'll work with experienced manufacturing experts at a platinum Siemens and ICX partner, while helping connect deep industry knowledge with new AI capabilities. Ready for the challenge? Your role will include: Running assessments at customer sites: mapping how production actually works, identifying gaps and inefficiencies, and building an action plan you present to the customer, including how the proposed solution would be tested and where it would prove itself first. Working hands-on with Siemens MOM portfolio, from demonstrations through to working in the system and assessing extension options. Developing a thorough understanding of each customer's business strategy, way of working, needs, and improvement potential. Being the trusted advisor: understanding the process well enough to ask questions that change the conversation. Working with customers and prospects to secure internal funding and support for improvement initiatives. Exploring where AI and industrial data can add real value on top of MOM/MES, and identifying the opportunities worth pursuing. Supporting newer consultants within project teams and sharing your experience with colleagues. Contributing to pre-sales activities and project estimations, helping shape solutions that meet client needs and deliver business value. What you bring to the table Experience in a consultative, client-facing role, or a background close to production that you want to take into consulting, supported by a real understanding of how a shop floor actually behaves. items.desc: Application Engineer – Industriële software English will follow. Als een fabriek een probleem heeft, ben jij degene die uitzoekt waarom. Onze software draait live op productielijnen bij grote producenten van voedingsmiddelen, dranken en farmaceutische producten in Europa en Noord-Amerika. De software laat in realtime zien hoe hun lijnen presteren, waarom die stilvallen en hoe ze dat kunnen oplossen. Klopt er iets niet (een teller die afwijkt, een koppeling die niet meer synchroniseert, data die nergens op slaat), dan komt het ticket bij jou terecht. Jij duikt erin, vindt de oorzaak en legt het helder uit aan de klant. Geen scripts voorlezen, geen tickets heen en weer schuiven: echt onderzoekswerk. Waarom DECIDE4ACTION? We groeien snel. Elk jaar nieuwe klanten, nieuwe landen en nieuwe producten. Je komt binnen op een moment dat jouw werk meebepaalt hoe we groeien. Grote namen, echte impact. Onze klanten zijn grote internationale producenten. Wat jij oplost, zie je dezelfde dag terug op hun productievloer. Innovatieve projecten. Industriële data, IIoT-connectiviteit, realtime analyses, en we staan op het punt onze eigen AI-agent te lanceren. Geen onderhoud van verouderde systemen. Vanaf dag één internationaal. Je werkt dagelijks samen met collega's in Frankrijk, Canada en de VS, aan projecten in Nederland, België, Frankrijk en daarbuiten. Ruimte om te groeien. In een klein Nederlands team valt jouw werk op. Sterke mensen groeien bij ons door naar deployment lead, technical lead of een projectrol. Wat ga je doen? Technisch onderzoek (de kern van je rol) Je neemt geëscaleerde tickets over van ons Level 1-team en blijft eigenaar tot ze opgelost zijn Je onderzoekt grondig: SQL-databases bevragen, logs analyseren, serverconfiguratie controleren, het probleem reproduceren Je lost het probleem zelf op, of documenteert het nauwkeurig voor ons R&D-team als het om een productbug gaat Je koppelt terug naar de klant met een heldere uitleg: wat er gebeurde, waarom, en wat eraan gedaan is Implementaties Je werkt mee aan nieuwe klantimplementaties: installatie, configuratie en integratie van onze applicaties Je bent af en toe op locatie bij go-lives (Nederland, België, Frankrijk) Wat breng je mee? SQL: je schrijft vlot queries (SELECT, JOIN, UPDATE) en onderzoekt data in SQL Server of Oracle. Vereist. Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in een technische functie: applicatiesupport, IT, systeembeheer of vergelijkbaar Goede basiskennis van Windows Server, IIS, netwerken en SSL-certificaten Een onderzoekende mindset: je wilt begrijpen waarom, niet alleen het ticket sluiten Je legt een technisch probleem helder uit aan zowel een plantmanager als een developer Nederlands: B2 of hoger (B1 bespreekbaar als je B2 wilt halen; wij ondersteunen je met taaltraining) Engels: vloeiend Je bent gerechtigd om in Nederland te werken Pluspunten Ervaring met industriële software (MES, SCADA, OEE, LIMS) of een productieomgeving Ervaring met rapportagetools (Crystal Reports, Power BI) Wat bieden wij? €3.500 – €4.500 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring Goede pensioenregeling Hybride werken: op kantoor in Den Bosch en thuis, met een volledig ingerichte werkplek Reiskostenvergoeding Een intensief onboardingtraject met ons internationale team, zodat je snel operationeel bent Echte doorgroeimogelijkheden in een bedrijf dat volop groeit Klaar om problemen op te lossen die ertoe doen, op echte productielijnen? Solliciteer nu! ———————————————————— Application Engineer – Industrial Software When a factory has a problem, you're the one who finds out why. Our software runs live on production lines at major food, beverage and pharma manufacturers across Europe and North America. It shows them in real time how their lines perform, why they stop, and how to fix it. When something doesn't add up (a counter that drifts, an interface that stops syncing, data that makes no sense), the ticket lands with you. You dig in, find the root cause, and explain it to the client clearly. No scripts to read from and no ticket ping-pong: actual investigation. Why DECIDE4ACTION? We're growing fast. New clients, new countries and new products every year. You join at a time when your work shapes how we grow. Big names, real impact. Our clients are major international manufacturers, and what you fix shows up on their production floor the same day. Cutting-edge projects. Industrial data, IIoT connectivity, real-time analytics, and we're about to launch our own AI agent. This is not legacy maintenance. International from day one. You'll work daily with colleagues in France, Canada and the USA, on projects in the Netherlands, Belgium, France and beyond. Room to grow. A small Dutch team means your work is visible. Strong people here move toward deployment lead, technical lead or project roles. About the MDR service Our Managed Detection and Response (MDR) business provides a world-leading managed service that detects and responds to cyber-attacks on behalf of our clients, using a strong combination of people, process and technology. Much of the technology is designed and built in house by the engineering team specifically to support the managed service, or as leveraged products that also provides to the wider market. The MDR team comprises several sub teams: the Detection & Response Team (DRT), who uncover adversaries on our client's networks and contain attacks using their Incident Response skill; the Research Team, who uncover new and emerging offensive and defensive techniques; and the Technical Operations team, who maintain and develop the attack detection infrastructure to ensure it remains at the bleeding edge. This is not a side project; it is the direction of the service, and it reshapes what a Threat Hunter does. As the repetitive work is delegated to agents, the value of the human hunter concentrates where machines are weakest: hunting the threats no rule has been written for, judging the quality of what the agents produce, and teaching the automation where it is wrong. The role Currently we are looking for a Threat Hunter to join our growing DRT team. DRT actively monitors customer estates protected by sensors, actively hunts for threats in the vast amount of data we continuously collect, and does the detection engineering. You will be one of the people who decide what quality means in an agentic SOC, and you will hold the agents to that standard every day. This is a position where you can grow in several technically advanced areas — hunting, detection engineering, AI-assisted operations — and use this experience to hunt for unseen threats.  Bring Intelligence Center X to life for leading companies, through business-relevant enterprise agentic AI use cases. 
 About Intelligence Center X 
 Intelligence Center X (ICX) is Siemens' industrial AI platform. ICX combines Siemens' own core graph, ontology, machine learning and agentic AI technology with our industrial software foundations to bring truly differentiated capabilities to market. It connects a company's enterprise and operational data into an enterprise ontology, and uses machine learning and agentic AI to reason over it and act on it.
 Our customers are leaders in automotive, aerospace and defense, semiconductors and electronics, industrial machinery, pharma and financial services.
 How we engage with customers: 
 Beyond typical demos, we work forward-deployed with the customer — on relevant data, against their problem — and build a working agentic AI solution, grounded in an enterprise ontology. It is how we establish value with customers: where they see the use case come to life, and where we earn the right to move forward.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 The role
 As an ICX Engineer, you lead the ideation and creation of these engagements. This is a presales FDE role: you take a business problem and a complex data landscape, model the domain as an enterprise ontology, build agents and machine learning that reason over it and act on it, and deliver a working agentic application with a business case compelling the customer to invest in Intelligence Center X with Siemens.
 You work alongside sales teams and strategic partners, and report to the ICX Engineering Manager for the EMEA region.
 An example engagement 
 An industrial manufacturer wants its engineers to answer in minutes a question that today takes weeks of chasing across teams: what does this change affect? The answer is spread across a dozen systems that each describe the same products, parts and suppliers differently. You connect them, model how they fit together as an enterprise ontology, build an agent that reasons over the result, and show the customer what it is worth with a compelling agentic user experience.
 Requirements: 
 Who you are
 You are hands-on with agentic AI and ontology . You build working things, and agentic development tools are how you work. If some of this is new to you, you will learn fast.
 You are entrepreneurial. You take ownership, move at startup pace and find a route to an outcome before the problem is fully defined — with some of the largest companies in the world.
 You think in business value, and you want to be in the room with customers.
 Skills and experience 
 We look for experience or strong potential in the following areas.
 Customer-facing technical communication — running working sessions with technical and business stakeholders, including when the solution is still taking shape.
 Data engineering and analytics — making sense of how a company's data is spread across its systems, bringing it together and modelling it.
 Modern data and AI platforms — experience architecting or integrating solutions across modern cloud, data and AI ecosystems such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Google Cloud, AWS data lakes, Palantir or C3.ai.
 Agentic AI — designing agents and AI solutions grounded in enterprise data: LLMs, retrieval, tool use, MCP.
 Agentic development tools — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar, used to build quickly and well.
 Enterprise ontology — modelling a real business domain as an ontology or knowledge graph and putting it to work in an enterprise.
 Machine learning and data science — building models that solve real business problems, such as forecasting, anomaly detection or classification.
 FDE, presales or innovative professional services — experience on a team that builds with customers.
 Technical consulting — designing and building agentic AI, data and analytics solutions for clients at a consultancy or systems integrator.
 Experience in our industries — manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, pharma, aerospace or financial services.
 We hire across levels, from recent graduates to experienced data and AI professionals, with no minimum years of experience. What matters is evidence that you build, and the drive to do it with customers.
 Travel 
 Some travel is expected, up to 25%. For people who want to spend even more time on site with customers, there is room for it.

 Grow with ICX. Lead as Siemens brings Intelligence Center X to the market as a leading industrial AI platform.

 Bring Intelligence Center X to life for leading companies, through business-relevant enterprise agentic AI use cases. 
 About Intelligence Center X 
 Intelligence Center X (ICX) is Siemens' industrial AI platform. ICX combines Siemens' own core graph, ontology, machine learning and agentic AI technology with our industrial software foundations to bring truly differentiated capabilities to market. It connects a company's enterprise and operational data into an enterprise ontology, and uses machine learning and agentic AI to reason over it and act on it.
 Our customers are leaders in automotive, aerospace and defense, semiconductors and electronics, industrial machinery, pharma and financial services.
 How we engage with customers: 
 Beyond typical demos, we work forward-deployed with the customer — on relevant data, against their problem — and build a working agentic AI solution, grounded in an enterprise ontology. It is how we establish value with customers: where they see the use case come to life, and where we earn the right to move forward.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 The role
 As an ICX Engineer, you lead the ideation and creation of these engagements. This is a presales FDE role: you take a business problem and a complex data landscape, model the domain as an enterprise ontology, build agents and machine learning that reason over it and act on it, and deliver a working agentic application with a business case compelling the customer to invest in Intelligence Center X with Siemens.
 You work alongside sales teams and strategic partners, and report to the ICX Engineering Manager for the EMEA region.
 An example engagement 
 An industrial manufacturer wants its engineers to answer in minutes a question that today takes weeks of chasing across teams: what does this change affect? The answer is spread across a dozen systems that each describe the same products, parts and suppliers differently. You connect them, model how they fit together as an enterprise ontology, build an agent that reasons over the result, and show the customer what it is worth with a compelling agentic user experience.
 Requirements: 
 Who you are
 You are hands-on with agentic AI and ontology . You build working things, and agentic development tools are how you work. If some of this is new to you, you will learn fast.
 You are entrepreneurial. You take ownership, move at startup pace and find a route to an outcome before the problem is fully defined — with some of the largest companies in the world.
 You think in business value, and you want to be in the room with customers.
 Skills and experience 
 We look for experience or strong potential in the following areas.
 Customer-facing technical communication — running working sessions with technical and business stakeholders, including when the solution is still taking shape.
 Data engineering and analytics — making sense of how a company's data is spread across its systems, bringing it together and modelling it.
 Modern data and AI platforms — experience architecting or integrating solutions across modern cloud, data and AI ecosystems such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Google Cloud, AWS data lakes, Palantir or C3.ai.
 Agentic AI — designing agents and AI solutions grounded in enterprise data: LLMs, retrieval, tool use, MCP.
 Agentic development tools — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar, used to build quickly and well.
 Enterprise ontology — modelling a real business domain as an ontology or knowledge graph and putting it to work in an enterprise.
 Machine learning and data science — building models that solve real business problems, such as forecasting, anomaly detection or classification.
 FDE, presales or innovative professional services — experience on a team that builds with customers.
 Technical consulting — designing and building agentic AI, data and analytics solutions for clients at a consultancy or systems integrator.
 Experience in our industries — manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, pharma, aerospace or financial services.
 We hire across levels, from recent graduates to experienced data and AI professionals, with no minimum years of experience. What matters is evidence that you build, and the drive to do it with customers.
 Travel 
 Some travel is expected, up to 25%. For people who want to spend even more time on site with customers, there is room for it.
 Why Join Us 
 Grow with ICX. Lead as Siemens brings Intelligence Center X to the market as a leading industrial AI platform.

Voor een vooruitstrevende KMO in de regio Gent zoekt Kwery een gedreven Software Engineer met kennis of interesse in AI. Samen met een gedreven team ontwikkel je slimme AI-functionaliteiten die de digitale oplossingen van het platform naar een hoger niveau tillen. Hoe zal jouw takenpakket eruit zien? Je detecteert opportuniteiten om AI toe te passen binnen het platform en vertaalt deze naar slimme functionaliteiten met directe meerwaarde. Je ontwikkelt en implementeert AI-oplossingen van dataverwerking en modelontwikkeling tot integratie in productie. Een masterdiploma Burgerlijk Ingenieur en hebt reeds een eerste ervaring achter de rug binnen IT. Je hebt een goede (basis) kennis van Python en hebt ervaring in één of meerdere gangbare AI/ML-frameworks. Ervaring met LLMs, RAG, fine-tuning of prompt engineering is alvast een mooie troef! Tot slot heb je eenechte passie voor AI en volgt het domein op de voet. Je kan zelfstandig werken, bent verantwoordelijk en gedreven om je eigen weg te vinden. Wat bieden zij jou? Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €3.500 en €5.000, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en kennis. De keuze uit een premium bedrijfswagen met laadpas of een mobiliteitsbudget. Zo kies jij wat het beste bij je past! Daarbovenop krijg je een volledige waaier aan extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, verzekeringen, GSM, abonnement en een mooie nettovergoeding. Extra's die echt het verschil maken! Een mooie work-life balance dankzij flexibele, tot 2 dagen thuiswerk en 32 vakantiedagen om op tijd en stond even uit te blazen. Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met de founders en krijgt een duidelijke stem in de verdere ontwikkeling van het product. Jouw ideeën en inzichten worden gehoord en kunnen daadwerkelijk het verschil maken. Tot slot kom je terecht in een warme maar gedreven teamsfeer waar jij als Software Engineer kan groeien en écht impact hebt op het product en de organisatie. Klaar voor jouw nieuwe uitdaging? Solliciteer dan snel!

The Avy Agent OS runs AI agents that do real operational work for the Nordics' largest property companies: they follow procedures, use tools and resolve cases from start to finish. Our first agent, Davy, handles customer support. At one customer, inbound email fell 70%, phone calls 50% and case volume 33%. We're looking for a Software Engineer (AI Engineer) to build the Agent OS: the orchestration, tools, retrieval, evals and observability that let our agents resolve real cases on their own. Swedish or another Nordic language. Proptech Experience in a matrixed scale-up. Why Avy Your work reaches 500,000+ households, so the impact is real You'll shape how the Agent OS works across Europe (our portfolio companies) Competitive salary, benefits and room to develop An office in central Stockholm Avy recruits internally for this role. We don't work with external agencies.

items.desc: Word de beste versie van jezelf als AI Engineer Als Medior AI Engineer bij Sogeti bouw je AI-oplossingen die dagelijks worden gebruikt. Je werkt op het snijvlak van data, AI en software engineering en ontwikkelt betrouwbare, schaalbare en uitlegbare toepassingen. Met jouw ervaring vertaal je klantvragen naar oplossingen die organisaties helpen beter te beslissen en te innoveren. Binnen onze Data & AI-community werk je samen met onder anderen Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers en Data Engineers. Je blijft betrokken van de eerste klantvraag en het prototype tot integratie, productie en doorontwikkeling. Daarbij verdiep je je verder in Generative AI, Agentic AI, MLOps en Responsible AI. Waarom jij het verschil maakt Je kijkt kritisch naar wat AI daadwerkelijk oplevert en ontwikkelt samen met je team robuuste oplossingen die aansluiten op de vraagstukken van klanten. Daarbij houd je oog voor kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en verantwoord AI-gebruik. Vertaal klantvragen naar concrete AI-usecases en robuuste oplossingen die in productie waarde leveren; Ontwikkel Generative AI-oplossingen met LLM's, prompts en eigen databronnen, waaronder RAG-toepassingen; Bouw Agentic AI-oplossingen waarin agents zelfstandig taken uitvoeren binnen vooraf bepaalde kaders; Integreer AI-oplossingen via API's in applicaties en bedrijfsprocessen en borg uitlegbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid; Test, monitor en verbeter antwoorden, agentgedrag, prestaties en kosten en onderzoek fouten en hallucinaties. Hiermee word je de beste versie van jezelf Je maakt impact binnen de Data & AI-organisatie van Sogeti, waar vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en samenwerking centraal staan. Je komt terecht in een hechte community met communitydagen, workshops, open podia en intervisiesessies. Je krijgt toegang tot inhouse trainingen in AI, MLOps, communicatie en leiderschap, afgestemd op jouw ambities. Je ontwikkelt je consultancyvaardigheden en deelt actief kennis met collega’s en klanten. Je groeit verder als inhoudelijk expert, lead engineer of richting thought leadership. Je werkt aan opdrachten bij toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland, waar jouw werk zichtbaar bijdraagt aan innovatie en betere besluitvorming. Je kunt daarnaast rekenen op Een vast contract van 32, 36 of 40 uur met een beloningsbudget tot €7.100, bruto per maand incl. vakantiegeld en mobiliteitsvergoeding; Je kunt bij ons kiezen voor de manier van reizen die het beste bij je past zoals een leaseauto (elektrisch), kilometervergoeding en je krijgt een NS-Business Card, of een combinatie daarvan; We motiveren een actieve levenstijl daarom bieden wij daarbovenop een fietsleaseplan via Lease A Bike; 26 vakantiedagen met optie tot bijkopen, een onkostenvergoeding en een jaarlijkse bonus vanaf C-Grade; Met onze Benefits at Work krijg je kortingen bij webshops zoals bol.com, HEMA en Wehkamp, én voordeel op activiteiten, elektronica en meer; Een sterk inhouse L&D-programma, een onbeperkt opleidingsbudget en actieve vakinhoudelijke communities waar kennisdeling en groei centraal staan; Ruimte om bij te dragen aan een duurzamere toekomst via een duurzaamheidsbudget en flexregelingen; Aandacht voor (mentale) gezondheid, met initiatieven zoals OpenUp, ouderschapstrainingen, vitaliteitswebinars en een korting op je sportabonnement; Toegang tot inspirerende events zoals Women@Sogeti en SoPlay, waar tech en verbinding samenkomen. Jouw talenten en ervaring Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau en 2 tot 4 jaar relevante ervaring als AI/ML Engineer of in een vergelijkbare data-rol. Je hebt sterke kennis van machine learning, LLM’s en software engineering en ervaring met prompt engineering. Je programmeert in Python, werkt met Git en kunt code schrijven, testen, documenteren en onderhouden. Je hebt ervaring met frameworks zoals PyTorch, TensorFlow en/of scikit-learn. Je werkt met API's, dataverwerking en moderne data- en cloudomgevingen en begrijpt MLOps en deployment. Je kunt technische keuzes, bijdragen en resultaten helder uitleggen aan technische en niet-technische stakeholders. Je bent communicatief vaardig, nieuwsgierig, neemt eigenaarschap en staat open voor feedback. Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift (C1-niveau). Meer over Sogeti Bij Sogeti krijg je de ruimte om de beste versie van jezelf te worden als professional, collega én mens. Je werkt in een warme community waar kennis delen vanzelfsprekend is. Dankzij onze sterke lokale aanwezigheid werk je aan projecten met echte impact, die je samen met jouw team tot een succes maakt! Bij Sogeti geloven we in diversiteit en inclusie: iedereen is welkom en mag zichzelf zijn. Klaar om impact te maken? Solliciteer als Medior AI Engineer Twijfel je of deze functie bij je past? Solliciteer gerust! Onze recruiters bekijken je cv en nodigen je bij een mogelijke match uit voor een kennismaking om samen de mogelijkheden te verkennen. Word de beste versie van jezelf. Responsabilidades principais Desenvolver agentes de IA e workflows de automação inteligente; Integrar LLMs com fontes de dados, APIs e sistemas empresariais; Implementar pipelines de orquestração e soluções RAG com pesquisa vetorial; Integrar agentes com ferramentas e sistemas externos através de MCP; Definir arquiteturas cloud, híbridas ou on-premises; Automatizar a geração de documentos e relatórios; Validar os resultados gerados por IA e implementar mecanismos de supervisão humana; Contribuir para as boas práticas de desenvolvimento, testes e governance de IA. Perfil Formação superior em Engenharia Informática, Sistemas de Informação ou área semelhante; Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência relevante para a função ; Conhecimentos sólidos de Agentic AI , ciclo de vida dos agentes e limitações e riscos da IA generativa; Experiência com Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry e Azure AI Search ; Conhecimentos de n8n , criação de workflows, integração de APIs e transformação de dados; Experiência em RAG , vetorização, indexação e recuperação de informação; Experiência com agentes conversacionais e integrações através de MCP — Model Context Protocol ; Experiência na geração automática de documentos, incluindo Word, PDF, Excel e relatórios; Conhecimentos de Azure DevOps e Miro ; Experiência em pelo menos um projeto com duração superior a 6 meses e em colaboração com outro AI Engineer; Experiência na entrega autónoma de um projeto completo, da conceção à produção, incluindo integrações com serviços ou produtos; Capacidade para identificar necessidades de negócio e desenvolver soluções adequadas; Bons conhecimentos de testes unitários, capacidade analítica, iniciativa e espírito de equipa; Domínio de português e inglês , oral e escrito. Valorizamos também Mais de 1 ano de experiência com Scrum e/ou Kanban; Mais de 1 ano de experiência com Azure DevOps; Conhecimento do setor energético; Experiência na utilização de agentes de IA para apoiar o desenvolvimento, testes, documentação e manutenção de software. Se queres desenvolver soluções de Inteligência Artificial aplicadas ao negócio, envia-nos a tua candidatura. Na Mootiva, ligamos talento à inovação. Junta-te a nós.

items.card: You will work with multidisciplinary teams to help organizations transform complex enterprise data, unstructured data and domain expertise into trusted, governed and AI-ready knowledge , enabling advanced analytics, Generative AI and intelligent agent-based solutions. Accenture’s Global Center for AI & Data is a unified capability center intended to bring together Accenture’s AI and data talent across its global
items.desc: Are you ready to be a part of the AI reinvention of industry and revolutionize your career? In today’s world, our mission for AI reinvention is to be the leading reinvention partner for global enterprises by building a strong digital core and unleashing artificial intelligence to create 360° value at speed. That’s where Global Center for AI & Data comes in. We bring together strategic visionaries, industry experts, data and AI practitioners, analytics professionals, and technology specialists to co-create each client’s unique path to reinvention. You will work with multidisciplinary teams to help organizations transform complex enterprise data, unstructured data and domain expertise into trusted, governed and AI-ready knowledge , enabling advanced analytics, Generative AI and intelligent agent-based solutions. Accenture’s Global Center for AI & Data is a unified capability center intended to bring together Accenture’s AI and data talent across its global reinvention efforts to help clients reinvent faster, scale AI, and accelerate priority skills development. WORK YOU’LL DO As part of the Global Center for AI & Data (out of Greece) , you will design and implement the knowledge foundations that enable modern AI and Generative AI solutions. As an AI Knowledge Engineer , you will work at the intersection of data, semantic technologies and Generative AI , transforming structured and unstructured enterprise information into reusable, trusted knowledge that can be effectively discovered and used by people, applications and AI agents. You will work across knowledge graphs, semantic models and layers, enterprise search and document retrieval, RAG and agent context engineering , helping AI systems access the right enterprise knowledge with the appropriate meaning, context and governance. There will never be a typical day, and you will continuously learn and grow while working on innovative Data & AI initiatives across industries. Key Responsibilities Design and maintain enterprise knowledge models, semantic layers, ontologies, taxonomies and knowledge graphs that represent business concepts, entities and relationships. Transform structured and unstructured enterprise information into trusted, reusable and AI-ready knowledge , applying appropriate metadata, semantics and relationships. Design and implement enterprise search, document retrieval and RAG solutions , combining semantic, vector, keyword and graph-based retrieval where appropriate. Develop knowledge ingestion and enrichment capabilities, including entity and relationship extraction, classification, linking and entity resolution , using NLP and LLM techniques. Contribute to agent context engineering , ensuring AI agents receive relevant enterprise knowledge, metadata, instructions and contextual information to support reliable responses and actions. Support the design of appropriately scoped agent memory , enabling agents to retain and reuse relevant context while considering privacy, security, provenance and lifecycle requirements. Integrate knowledge solutions with enterprise data platforms, document repositories, metadata/catalog platforms, APIs and AI applications. Apply knowledge quality, provenance, lineage, access control and governance principles to improve the trustworthiness and traceability of knowledge used by AI solutions. Apply software engineering best practices to develop scalable, maintainable, testable and production-ready solutions. Collaborate with AI engineers, data engineers, architects, domain experts and business stakeholders to translate business knowledge into effective technical solutions. WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Systems , or another relevant discipline. A Master’s or PhD is considered an advantage. 4+ years of relevant experience in Data/AI, data engineering, software engineering or related areas, with recent hands-on exposure to Knowledge Graphs, semantic technologies or Knowledge Engineering. Strong understanding of knowledge representation and semantic modeling , including entities, relationships, ontologies, taxonomies and semantic models. Hands-on experience with knowledge graphs or graph databases and associated query/modeling approaches such as RDF/SPARQL or property graphs/Cypher. Strong programming skills in Python , with experience integrating APIs and processing structured and unstructured information. Understanding of Generative AI and LLM architectures , including embeddings, vector search, semantic search and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Experience with information retrieval, document processing or NLP , including techniques such as entity extraction, classification or entity resolution. Understanding of how semantic layers, metadata and enterprise knowledge can provide trusted business context to AI applications. Familiarity with software engineering practices including Git, testing, CI/CD, APIs, and …

items.card: The role As an Applied AI Engineer II on Autonomous Supply Chains, you'll build the agents and AI-powered applications that make Flexport's operations faster and increasingly autonomous. You'll find the most painful problems in our operations, design the solution and ship it to operators moving freight across 135 countries. This isn't a role where you join a team and pick up tickets. What you'll do Design and ship
items.desc: About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes - from emerging brands to Fortune 500s - use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. Applied AI Engineer, Autonomous Supply ChainsAbout Flexport Look around you. Almost everything in the room crossed an ocean to get there. Moving one container from a factory to a warehouse takes 10 to 15 companies: truckers, customs brokers, port terminals, ocean carriers, insurers, lenders and warehouses, each with its own systems, paperwork and rules. A freight forwarder runs that whole journey, so the brand that makes the goods doesn't have to. Most forwarders still run it on email, spreadsheets and phone calls. We call it email freight forwarding. Flexport runs it on one platform, where AI agents do the routine work and experts step in where judgment matters. We've moved $175B of goods for more than 13,000 brands across 135 countries. Our agents handle 21 million tasks a year, and up to 80% of customs work is automated. Global logistics is a $13 trillion industry, and even the largest forwarder earns less than 3% of global logistics outsourcing revenue. People-powered operations don't scale: to grow, you hire. Software broke that ceiling for taxis with Uber, and for payments with Adyen and Stripe. Freight is next. Amsterdam is one of Flexport's six engineering hubs, alongside San Francisco, Seattle, Chicago, Shanghai and Shenzhen. We own four domains end to end: Customs Technology, Autonomous Supply Chains (Applied AI), Platform and Security. See what we build at amsterdam-engineering.flexport.com. The team: Autonomous Supply Chains Logistics is famously hard to automate, because the happy path rarely happens. One customer won't take deliveries on a Tuesday. Another wants invoices only on Fridays, with some lines merged and others renamed. Until recently, people handled all of that by hand. Now operators use Forge, the agentic platform we build, to automate their own work: catching anomalies, routing exceptions, escalating stuck containers and adjusting invoices to each customer. Forge remembers every customer's rules and learns from every workflow run, so it gets smarter every day. Autonomous Supply Chains is our Applied AI team: small, senior and reporting to the VP of Engineering. Self-driving cars are rated from level 0 to level 5. Most of the freight industry still runs at level 0: people emailing spreadsheets. Our goal is level 5 for freight, with Forge as the best agentic platform there is, handling every complexity, every calamity and every odd preference without skipping a beat. Stack: TypeScript, Rust, Next.js, Temporal, Postgres and Snowflake, with models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google. The role As an Applied AI Engineer II on Autonomous Supply Chains, you'll build the agents and AI-powered applications that make Flexport's operations faster and increasingly autonomous. You'll find the most painful problems in our operations, design the solution and ship it to operators moving freight across 135 countries. This isn't a role where you join a team and pick up tickets. What you'll do Design and ship end-to-end AI agents that handle real logistics work, such as customs compliance, document processing, invoice validation and exception management. Build the evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop flows that make an agent trustworthy enough to run 24/7. Stay on top of what's happening in the world of AI, and channel those innovations straight into the product. When Jev came out this fall, we had three use cases live within two weeks. Work directly with operators, domain experts and leadership to turn ambiguous problems into shipped products, and measure whether they worked. Move fast from idea to production, and treat every deployment as a chance to learn. Cross organizational boundaries to understand problems deeply and get things done without waiting for permission. You should have 3+ years of software engineering experience, and you've built seriously with LLMs, whether in production, in side projects or just because you couldn't stop yourself. LLM fluency: agent patterns, tool use, RAG, prompt design and evaluation. You know the difference between what works in production and what looks good in a demo. This role sits within our Engineering Services practice , where AI is applied to real-world engineering and R&D challenges across industries such as aerospace, defense, and healthcare, with a particular focus on embedded software, mechanical engineering, and AI-enabled engineering solutions. Key Responsibilities Embed directly with client engineering and business teams to deploy, scale, and operationalize AI platforms — Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, Google, Salesforce, SAP, or Palantir — inside enterprise environments Own production outcomes end-to-end: time-to-value, reliability, adoption velocity, and scalability, with business metrics attached — not just delivery milestones Move from ambiguous business problem to working production system through rapid experimentation: days to prototype, weeks to production-ready Design and govern AI architectures across the full enterprise stack: identity, data, security, governance, platform layer, and workflow integration Translate technical architecture into business impact for client CTO, CFO, and CISO; shape use case roadmaps, ROI backlogs, and AI adoption strategy Build reusable patterns, playbooks, and accelerators that the client owns after you leave — enabling the client team to run it without you Lead design workshops, proofs of concept, architecture walkthroughs, and code-with sessions with client engineering and leadership teams Codify patterns and delivery learnings that scale across engagements and contribute to the growth of the FDE practice Engineering experience with cloud-native systems (APIs, microservices, containerization, serverless). Deep expertise in designing and deploying agentic solutions (agents, orchestration, context engineering, RAG, workflows) in production environments. Experience with AI platforms — OpenAI, Claude, Vertex AI, plus open-source models — including building abstraction layers to manage multi-provider pipelines. Extensive experience in deploying to production , CI/CD, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm), monitoring, and debugging. items.desc: Role Summary: This Financial Technology Vendor is seeking a hands-on AI Engineer at mid-level or senior level to build and deploy LLM-powered applications and agentic features. The successful candidate will work closely with Product and Engineering to turn ideas into reliable production software. Location: London — hybrid, two days per week in the office. Responsibilities: AI Application Development Build LLM-powered features and agentic workflows using tools, APIs, and business data. Implement retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs, and integrations with existing systems. Production Delivery and Improvement Take features from prototype to production, including backend development, testing, deployment, and monitoring. Develop evaluations and safeguards to improve accuracy, handle failures, and protect sensitive data. Optimise model choices, latency, and running costs using evidence from testing and production. Required Skills and Experience: Hands-on experience building and deploying AI applications used by real users. Strong Python skills and software engineering practices, including APIs, testing, and version control. Practical experience with LLM APIs, tool calling, retrieval, and agentic workflows. Experience deploying and operating applications in a cloud environment. Ability to debug across prompts, models, data, and application code, with sound judgement about AI limitations. Job specification: AI Engineer Expectations by Level: Mid Level Independently deliver well-defined AI features, with support on architecture and broader technical decisions. Write maintainable code, evaluate results, and resolve production issues. Work with the team to break requirements into practical implementation steps. Senior Own complex AI capabilities from problem definition through deployment and ongoing improvement. Lead architecture and make trade-offs across reliability, security, performance, and cost. Set standards for evaluation and production readiness, mentor engineers, and guide technical decisions. Desirable Experience Familiarity with Kubernetes. Experience with model fine-tuning, open-source model deployment, document processing, or multi-agent systems. Personal Attributes Practical, curious, and focused on solving customer problems. Clear communicator with a strong sense of ownership and a collaborative approach.

items.desc: APPLICATION DEADLINE: We encourage you to apply soon if interested, this role will be taken offline based on applicant volume. Who We Are M-Files is redefining how work gets done. Our context-first document management system offers purpose-built business use cases—spanning universal and industry-specific workflows—to enable secure collaboration, automate processes, and ensure governance. Unlike traditional systems, M-Files organizes content around the context of your business, connecting documents to related people, projects, and transactions. With our unique metadata-driven architecture, organizations can model content in line with their business processes, unify information across silos, and apply AI at scale. The result is greater productivity, reduced risk, and smarter, faster decisions for over 6,000 customers in 100+ countries. For more information, visit www.m-files.com We are looking for an AI-Native Engineers (Agentic Development) to help shape how software is built at M‑Files in an AI‑native way. This role goes beyond traditional software development by combining software engineering, quality engineering, solution design, and end‑to‑end delivery through agentic AI systems, specification‑driven development, and modern cloud‑native practices. While the role has a broad scope, its exact focus will evolve based on your background, strengths, and interests. Some engineers may lean more towards agentic delivery workflows and specification‑driven development, while others focus more deeply on platform foundations, quality automation, or AI‑native product capabilities. What matters most is impact—not covering every area at once. You will work with AI as a core engineering primitive, using agentic workflows, executable specifications, and automation to accelerate delivery while maintaining production‑grade quality, governance, and maintainability across the Microsoft ecosystem. Location note: This is a hybrid role within Finland. Our offices are in Tampere, Helsinki, and Lappeenranta , and we are only considering candidates who are currently located in Finland. Mission Build and scale AI‑native software delivery capabilities where specifications become executable artifacts, testing is autonomous and continuous, AI agents accelerate implementation, and engineering teams deliver high‑quality systems significantly faster without compromising reliability or governance. Responsibilities AI‑native software delivery Design, build, test, and operate enterprise‑grade software using AI‑first engineering practices Use agentic workflows to accelerate implementation, refactoring, testing, documentation, and operational tasks across the software development lifecycle. Specification‑driven development Translate business and product requirements into clear, machine‑readable implementation specifications Define behavioral contracts and acceptance criteria using specification‑driven, BDD‑ and TDD‑aligned practices, enabling AI‑assisted generation and validation of production‑ready systems. Quality engineering and autonomous validation Embed quality into delivery through continuous, AI‑assisted validation rather than manual or phase‑based QA Implement automated testing approaches such as contract testing, regression analysis, and synthetic test generation, ensuring strong traceability between specifications, code, and tests. Cloud and platform engineering Build scalable, cloud‑native solutions within the Microsoft ecosystem Contribute reusable engineering patterns, templates, and guardrails, and help design secure, observable, and production‑ready systems using modern cloud and infrastructure‑as‑code practices. Product and delivery collaboration Work closely with product managers, architects, and fellow engineers to refine specifications into deliverable outcomes Support rapid experimentation and iterative delivery while ensuring alignment with business goals, governance requirements, and measurable results Ownership and impact Take end‑to‑end responsibility for outcomes together with the team, focusing on delivery quality, reliability, and long‑term maintainability while creating leverage for the wider engineering organization Requirements Required Skills & Experience Core software engineering Strong experience in modern software engineering and cloud‑native systems Advanced proficiency with .NET / C#, APIs, and distributed or event‑driven architectures Experience building and operating enterprise‑grade, production systems on Azure AI‑native engineering Hands‑on experience using AI‑assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar coding agents Experience designing, building, or orchestrating AI agents and agentic workflows Solid understanding of prompt and context engineering, RAG patterns, tool‑calling agents, and multi‑agent systems. Specification‑driven development and quality Experience with specification‑driven development practices, including BDD, TDD, executable specifications, and automated …

items.desc: APPLICATION DEADLINE: We encourage you to apply soon if interested, this role will be taken offline based on applicant volume. Who We Are M-Files is redefining how work gets done. Our context-first document management system offers purpose-built business use cases—spanning universal and industry-specific workflows—to enable secure collaboration, automate processes, and ensure governance. Unlike traditional systems, M-Files organizes content around the context of your business, connecting documents to related people, projects, and transactions. With our unique metadata-driven architecture, organizations can model content in line with their business processes, unify information across silos, and apply AI at scale. The result is greater productivity, reduced risk, and smarter, faster decisions for over 6,000 customers in 100+ countries. For more information, visit www.m-files.com We are looking for an AI-Native Engineers (Agentic Development) to help shape how software is built at M‑Files in an AI‑native way. items.desc: Votre rôle De l'intelligence artificielle générative aux cas d'usage métiers concrets Vous prendrez en main l'écosystème d'agents existants et les architectures de prompts structurées au sein de l'environnement Live Intelligence. Vous participerez à la conception et à l'automatisation de flux interconnectés associant Power Automate, scripts Python et connecteurs d'API pour fluidifier l'échange de données entre référentiels documentaires et agents conversationnels. Vous contribuerez au prototypage d'interfaces légères et d'outils d'assistance destinés aux utilisateurs métiers de la Direction Cloud France. Vous participerez à l'élaboration de bancs de tests, à l'évaluation qualitative des réponses des modèles et à la mesure de performance des chaînes de traitement. Vous présenterez vos réalisations aux équipes métiers, intégrerez leurs retours d'expérience et participerez aux démonstrations dans une démarche d'amélioration continue. Ce que vous développerez : une maîtrise concrète de l'ingénierie des agents IA, du prompt engineering structuré, des architectures d'automatisation d'entreprise et de la valorisation de la donnée métier. Votre profil Vous préparez un Master 2 ou une dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs en informatique, génie logiciel, intelligence artificielle ou systèmes d'information, et vous recherchez votre stage de fin d'études. Vos compétences techniques Maîtrise du langage Python pour la manipulation de données, le scripting et l'interfaçage avec des API REST. Familiarité avec les concepts LLM, du prompt engineering et des architectures d'agents conversationnels. Intérêt pour les outils d'automatisation d'entreprise, les flux Power Automate ou les environnements Sharepoint. Bases en développement applicatif web ou prototypage d'interfaces pour rendre les solutions accessibles aux équipes non techniques. Vos qualités personnelles Vous faites preuve de curiosité technologique, d'esprit d'initiative et d'une réelle autonomie face à des technologies en évolution rapide. Vous possédez de bonnes capacités d'analyse, de rigueur méthodologique et une aisance relationnelle pour interagir efficacement avec les profils techniques comme métiers. Entité Au sein de la Direction Cloud France du Groupe Orange, le programme d'accélération et de transformation opérationnelle déploie un écosystème d'intelligence artificielle générative et agentique. Ce programme vise à outiller les équipes de pilotage, augmenter les métiers de Service Management, Contract Management, Project Management par des agents intelligents interconnectés, intégrés dans l'environnement Sharepoint et la plateforme IA du groupe Orange Business Live Intelligence. L'objectif du stage est d'accompagner le développement, l'intégration et l'évaluation opérationnelle d'agents IA et de flux d'automatisation dédiés au pilotage des activités Cloud. Vous participerez à la conception d'outils concrets reliant les modèles de langage aux processus métiers quotidiens Vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique et pluridisciplinaire au cœur de l'innovation IA opérationnelle, combinant compétences d'architecture logicielle, gestion de la donnée, expertise métier Cloud et pilotage de programme

items.desc: As a GenAI Security Researcher, you will conduct red teaming and security research to identify vulnerabilities across generative AI models, agents, applications, and supporting infrastructure. As a Security Researcher, you will: Conduct black-box and gray-box red teaming of GenAI systems, agents, APIs, and infrastructure. Review and analyze harsh content in the child-safety domain. Research attacks such as prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, RAG poisoning, data leakage, and unsafe tool use. Identify vulnerabilities in prompts, models, agents, tool integrations, memory, and automated workflows. Develop adversarial prompts and automated security testing techniques. Evaluate and bypass AI guardrails and security controls. Work with engineering and research teams to reproduce issues and improve defenses. Stay current with emerging AI security, offensive security, and adversarial ML Must Have: 3+ years of offensive security experience, or advanced research experience in AI or cybersecurity. Experience with GenAI red teaming, prompt injection, jailbreaks, RAG, or agent security. Strong Python and/or JavaScript skills. Strong analytical, research, and communication skills. Workplace & Security Compliance: Ability to work full-time (5 days a week) on-site at our London office within a strictly secured, access-controlled environment. Preferred Skills: Offensive security certifications or an advanced degree in Computer Science, AI, or Cybersecurity. Familiarity with cloud security, AI security frameworks, and automated security testing. Experience with AI agents, tool calling, MCP, or multi-agent systems. Alice is a trust, safety, and security company built for the AI era. We safeguard the communicative technologies people use to create, collaborate, and interact- whether with each other or with machines. In a world where AI has fundamentally changed the nature of risk, Alice provides end-to-end coverage across the entire AI lifecycle. We support frontier model labs, enterprises, and UGC platforms with a comprehensive suite of solutions: from model hardening evaluations and pre-deployment red-teaming to runtime guardrails and ongoing drift detection. Alice is widely considered a global leader in online safety and AI security. We have some of the most forward-thinking and passionate minds in the world working to safeguard over 3 billion users across the largest AI and tech platforms. If you're creative and driven to secure the future of AI, we want to hear from you!

From onboarding Forward Deployed Engineers and Deployment Strategists to leading customer workshops and
items.desc: (f/m/x) As an AI Enablement Engineer at Wonderful your mission will be to help our teams, customers and partners develop the skills to take enterprise AI from concept to working solution. What You’ll Do You’ll combine hands-on AI engineering with technical teaching, designing and delivering programs where people learn by building on the Wonderful platform. From onboarding Forward Deployed Engineers and Deployment Strategists to leading customer workshops and partner certification, you’ll equip people to deploy confidently and work independently. Teach by building. Guide customer teams through a scoped AI agent or application, connecting architecture, integrations and development practices to a working solution with practical business value. Get our teams ready to deliver. Own technical onboarding for Wonderful’s Forward Deployed Engineers and Deployment Strategists, preparing them to work independently in customer environments. Lead Wonderful Academy programs. Design and deliver platform workshops, hands-on training and role-based learning for technical and business audiences. Enable our partners. Build training for systems integration partners covering the Wonderful platform, deployment methodology and implementation standards. Own certification end to end. Define learning paths and assessments, evaluate readiness and manage certification, further training and recertification. Practice what you teach. You’ll regularly join live customer projects as an FDE, keeping your skills sharp and showing what’s possible through hands on delivery. Keep learning relevant. Track progress, gather feedback and use product changes and field experience to improve content, delivery and outcomes. Why should you You’ll be part of what is tipped as the fastest growing startup in Europe. Work on a cutting edge agentic solution, the hottest topic in enterprise right now. You’ll join a team of high agency builders coming from the best tech companies out there. Combine hands-on AI engineering with teaching, facilitation and customer partnership. Own programs from curriculum through certification, shaping how Wonderful develops technical capability across employees, customers and partners. See the impact of your work in the solutions people build and their ability to keep developing independently. What You’ll Bring 5+ years in technical enablement, customer education, technical training or a related role within SaaS, cloud, data or AI. Strong written and spoken English communication skills. Strong hands-on AI engineering experience, including system architecture, LLM and agent integration, design patterns and modern software development practices. A practical understanding of enterprise software, APIs, integrations and data flows, with the ability to learn and teach a complex platform. A track record of designing and delivering technical onboarding, workshops and certification programs, from curriculum and assessments through to measuring results. Strong instructional design and facilitation skills. You can make complex concepts clear, keep groups engaged and adapt to different levels of technical experience. Credibility with technical stakeholders and the confidence to lead discussions, explain platform capabilities and connect learning goals to business needs. An ownership mindset, excellent communication skills and a clear focus on helping people become self-sufficient. Apply here, everyone will get a response. Candidate Privacy Notice
