items.desc: Dans le cadre de son développement, le campus ESSCA d'Angers recrute un ou une stagiaire Développeur, Développeuse iA (H/F) pour appuyer le Responsable de la Cellule Nouvelles Technologies dans le développement et la maintenance des applications et des modules spécifiques utilisés par l'association. MISSIONS PRINCIPALES Participer à la conception fonctionnelle et technique d’outils exploitant l’IA générative (chatbots, assistants, modules d’analyse ou de création de contenus, etc.), en lien avec les besoins des utilisateurs internes ; Développer et intégrer des modèles de langage ou d’autres modèles génératifs (LLM, texte, image, etc.) dans les applications métiers : utilisation d’API, adaptation des prompts, fine-tuning si nécessaire ; Mettre en place des pipelines de traitement de données pour l’entraînement, l’évaluation et l’amélioration continue des modèles (collecte, nettoyage, structuration, annotation) ; Rédiger la documentation technique et fonctionnelle des solutions développées, à destination des utilisateurs et des équipes techniques ; Effectuer des tests unitaires et fonctionnels sur les modules IA, et accompagner les utilisateurs métiers lors des phases de recette et de déploiement ; Assurer la maintenance évolutive des outils IA existants : correction de bugs, optimisation des performances, adaptation aux nouveaux usages ou modèles. Assurer une veille technologique sur les avancées en IA générative, proposer des expérimentations ou des améliorations innovantes. Profil Recherché Actuellement en formation pour obtenir un Master 1 ou un Master 2 en développement informatique, vous avez une appétence pour les nouvelles technologies et l'intelligence artificielle. Vous maitrisez les outils bureautiques Microsoft et vous êtes à l'aise avec l'utilisation d'outils d'intelligence artificielle polyvalent (copilot est un plus). Vos connaissances de SQL Serveur et SSIS, Python, en développement d’applications Office 365 et de l’outil Microsoft Docnet sont des atouts pour la réussite de ce stage. Vous êtes une personne reconnue pour vos capacités de synthèse et d'analyse. Vous maitrisez le prompting, le machine learning et deep learning et bénéficiez de connaissances approfondies des modèles de langage (LLM). Votre aisance à communiquer et dialoguer avec différents types d'interlocuteurs, votre capacité à gérer plusieurs tâches en même temps sans oublier votre sens de l'organisation et de l'anticipation sont des qualités incontournables pour cette mission. Pour mener à bien votre stage, votre esprit d'équipe et votre rigueur seront également des atouts essentiels. Enfin, ce stage sera l'occasion pour vous de mettre en pratique vos connaissances théoriques et d'acquérir une expérience significative dans développement d'application. Caractéristiques Du Poste Proposé Type de contrat : Stage Durée du stage : 4 à 6 mois Gratification : selon la loi en vigueur (4,5€/heure) Élément périphérique : Titres restaurant (10€ par jour travaillé - 50% à la charge du stagiaire) L’ESSCA est engagée en faveur de la diversité, de la non-discrimination et de l’égalité des chances. Nos postes sont accessibles aux personnes en situation de handicap.

items.desc: Location/s: UK-wide Recruiter contact: Josh Hoyland Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy with over 20,000 employees across more than 50 countries and 140+ offices. We work across incredible global industries, delivering exciting work that is defining our future and making an important societal impact in the communities we serve. Our people power our performance – we succeed when they do. With countless opportunities to collaborate, learn, and grow, the possibilities for excellence are as varied as every individual. Whether you want to grow as a subject matter expert or broaden your experience with roles across our international community, you’re surrounded by global specialists who want to combine their expertise and champion you to be your best. As a proudly employee-owned business, we benefit our clients, our communities, and each other, investing in creating the right space for everyone to feel empowered, included, and valued. Whatever your ambition, Mott MacDonald is where people come to be brilliant. About The Team Mott MacDonald's Central Digital function supports the wider company's project delivery. It builds the tools, systems and capabilities that change how we deliver engineering, infrastructure and advisory work for our clients. In Central Digital, the AI team develops and runs applied AI and agentic capability. That means turning promising ideas into secure, governed, reusable products that project teams across our service lines can use. Our work covers several connected areas, including: AI-native project delivery: We're building a new company-wide platform that changes how projects are set up, run and governed. AI agents work alongside project teams to capture information, automate routine setup and delivery tasks, and keep data consistent, while people review and approve key decisions. Transforming how our business lines deliver: We work directly with priority areas of the business to redesign how their work gets done. That includes finding where AI can make the biggest difference, building solutions with their subject matter experts, and helping teams adopt them and measure the impact. The team brings together a broad mix of expertise, including data science, AI and software engineering, digital consulting, architecture, cloud infrastructure and responsible AI governance. Day to day, we work with engineers, subject matter experts and product owners. Together we turn real business problems into practical solutions and take them from prototype to production. We hold ourselves to high standards on evaluation, responsible AI, information security and data protection, because our solutions support decisions on real infrastructure. We're a collaborative team that values ideas from every grade and background, and we put real effort into helping people develop. You'll have room to own meaningful work and learn quickly. Overview Of The Role As a Data Scientist specialising in computer vision and AI, you'll turn imagery and spatial data into insight that engineers and project teams can use. You'll work with data such as satellite and drone imagery, 360 captures, lidar, BIM and documents, using both traditional and generative AI methods, and take solutions from early exploration through to deployed pipelines. Much of the value comes from reuse: we already have tools and toolkits that work well, and you'll help extend them to new problems across our service lines. You'll work with subject matter experts to understand what a good result looks like, choose the right measures of success, and explain clearly what the results mean. Key responsibilities and duties include: Develop computer vision and AI solutions using both traditional and generative AI methods, from exploration through to deployed pipelines. Work with imagery and spatial data such as satellite/raster, drone captures, 360 imagery, lidar, BIM and PDFs, and advise on appropriate formats and usage. Build and maintain AI/ML pipelines on Azure Machine Learning and/or Azure Databricks. Choose and generate the right metrics for each use case, interpret results and communicate what they mean for the decision at hand. Extend existing tools and toolkits to new problems, spotting where a solution already built can be reused. Contribute to code review and good GitHub practice across the team. Value and learn from colleagues at every grade and experience level, and help build a supportive team. Candidate specification Essential: Strong Python, including pandas and NumPy. Comfortable writing, debugging and maintaining code by hand, and effective at using AI coding agents to accelerate delivery while critically reviewing what they produce. Familiar with GitHub, including versioning and code review practice. Experience building AI/ML pipelines or applications; computer vision experience preferred. Experience with at least one of: satellite/raster, PDF, BIM, 360 imagery, drone imagery or lidar. Experience …

items.desc: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office At Thermo Fisher Scientific, we develop technologies that help our customers make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Behind these innovations are talented engineers building software that supports scientific discoveries and real-world applications. We're looking for a Full-Stack Engineer with a strong C#/.NET background to join our experienced team of seven engineers in Brno. Our team is currently transitioning towards AI-native software development, and we're looking for someone who's excited to be part of that journey. You'll have the opportunity to explore modern AI-assisted development tools, influence how we build software, and contribute to applications used in the field of spectroscopy. If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, exploring new technologies, and working with people who share your passion for engineering, we'd love to meet you! What will you do? Develop and enhance software applications using C#/.NET, ASP.NET Core, and Microsoft SQL Server, with opportunities to work across the full stack. Contribute throughout the entire software development lifecycle, from early research and feasibility studies to implementation and long-term maintenance. Explore AI-native development practices, using AI-assisted tools and emerging agentic workflows to improve how software is designed, developed, and maintained. Collaborate with experienced engineers and the Product Owner to turn requirements into reliable, scalable software solutions. Investigate complex systems, troubleshoot technical challenges, and find creative solutions to engineering problems. Occasionally build proofs of concept and experiment with new technologies, including AI-powered development approaches. Develop an understanding of spectroscopy and how our software supports scientific applications. What technologies will you work with? Backend: C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Microsoft SQL Server Frontend: React, TypeScript, Electron Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Docker, GitHub, Jenkins, JFrog Additional technologies: C++, Python, VB6, batch scripting AI-assisted development: Modern AI coding assistants and emerging agentic development tools Who are we looking for? At least 2 years of professional experience in backend development, particularly with C# and .NET. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand and navigate complex software systems. Practical experience with Microsoft SQL Server, database design, and SQL queries (at least 1 year). Genuine interest in AI-assisted software development, including familiarity with current AI tools, AI/ML concepts, and emerging agentic workflows. A proactive, collaborative mindset and the ability to communicate effectively within an international engineering team. Good command of English. A university degree or equivalent qualification. What would be a plus? Experience with React and TypeScript, or motivation to develop your frontend skills. Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud technologies such as AWS. Experience working with established software products, legacy codebases, or complex architectures. Curiosity about scientific applications or spectroscopy. What do we offer? Work-life balance: Flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and 5 sick days per year. Financial benefits: Annual bonus, pension contribution, and preferential rates on life and health insurance. Everyday perks: Discounted mobile plans for you and your family, a free MultiSport card, meal allowance, an on-site canteen, and fresh fruit or vegetables every day. items.desc: Mentimeter is an engagement company with a simple goal: to make every leader better. Through interaction, insights and recommendations, its platform helps organizations turn participation into better understanding and stronger performance. Founded in Stockholm in 2012, Mentimeter is used by 20 million people each month across 1.3 million organizations. At Mentimeter, we believe better leadership starts with listening and that the strongest results are achieved together. That’s why we foster a culture built on curiosity, collaboration and shared ownership. By joining us, you’ll help leaders turn participation into deeper understanding and stronger performance, advancing our ambition to help more than one billion people listen, learn and work better together. The role We're building a Revenue Operations function where AI, automation and systems design are the core of how we scale. Not as a layer on top of how we work, but as the way we work: systems handle what can be systematised, so our reps spend their time on what only people can do, building relationships, reading a room, making the judgement call. This role sits at the centre of that. It is a full-stack internal product role. Your users are our Enterprise GTM reps and leaders; your job is to understand how they work, find where friction or guesswork slows them down, and solve it with tailored, proactive solutions. That means designing how our revenue stack connects, embedding AI into live revenue workflows, and shaping the role-specific surfaces our teams work from. You own how it's architected, how it's automated, and how it evolves as the business does. You'll sit in the RevTech & Ops team within Revenue Operations, reporting to the RevTech & Operations Director, and work day-to-day with Sales, Marketing, CS and Analytics. You treat "can this be automated?" as the first question, not the last. You care as much about whether we're solving the right problem as about how it's solved, which means understanding how a sales person actually spends their day. And you'd rather ship a working v1 this week than a perfect design next quarter.You decide how things should be built, build a lot of it yourself, and leave behind architecture someone else can read and extend. What You'll Do Build internal tools. Design, build and maintain the role-specific UI our Enterprise reps and leaders work in every day. Connect it to the full revenue stack, iterate with the people using it, and keep it fast and reliable as the business changes. Remove manual work from GTM roles. Find the repetitive work in revenue teams and automate it with n8n, Clay, CRM automation and AI where it earns its place. Set the automation principles so what you build stays maintainable. Own the architecture. Keep the revenue toolstack (sales and marketing) healthy: data models, routing logic, account recycling, activity tracking, invoice objects and the automation between them. Fix what breaks, and design so it breaks less. Connect the systems. Build and maintain integrations across the stack via APIs so data moves cleanly and reliably. Guard the data. Set governance standards, ownership, definitions, structure, compliance, so reporting stays trustworthy as the stack grows. Shape what's next. Assess new tools and architectural changes and lead the complex ones: toolstack replacements, lifecycle redesigns, projects where the outcome is known but the path isn't. Work like a modern engineer / builder. Understand logic and dependencies. Use Cursor, Claude code, Vercel and GitHub to scale your own output. What Success Looks Like The metric this role moves is ARR / Cost of GTM . In practice: reps spending their time in one place instead of six, fewer hours of manual work in GTM roles, fewer break-fixes, integrations that works, and data people trust without double-checking. What You Bring 3+ years in RevOps, Engineering, GTM systems or a similar role with real technical depth Hands-on experience with a CRM system (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot): architecture, automation, objects, reporting A good understanding of APIs, webhooks, git and system integrations A current grasp of what agentic AI can and can't do today, and the curiosity to keep up High business understanding: you can tell a real problem from a loud one and prioritise accordingly Systems thinking: you care about clean architecture and long-term maintainability, not just getting it working A strong bias toward execution: proactive, action-oriented, builder's hat on by default Strong candidates may also have An engineering background and/or built internal tools for operational teams Experience in a Sales or Marketing role, so you know what the people using your work actually need Managed a sales tool stack and its integrations end to end Driven a toolstack replacement or large-scale CRM re-architecture Experience with context engineering, building and maintaining agentic harnesses and guardrails Why this role matters Every revenue team at Mentimeter …

If you thrive in a complex, regulated environment and excel in stakeholder management, let’s connect! About the job Job purpose As a Microsoft 365 GenAI Product Owner, your main objective is to Translate the Product Manager’s strategy and funding guardrails into day-to-day direction, service scope, boundaries, operating model and governance. Assess entity demand, Microsoft and related product roadmaps, strategic fit and tenant activation status to maintain one prioritized backlog and a transparent BAU roadmap. Review priorities and release targets at least quarterly. Own and make product decisions to prioritize, release, delay, adapt, scope, block or not pursue capabilities within agreed guardrails and required approvals. Resolve competing demands, set sequencing and make design-to-cost capacity trade-offs, weighing value, cost, feasibility, dependencies and tenant-wide risk. Communicate rationale and deferred or rejected requests; recommend investment changes and escalate decisions outside strategy or funding authority to the Product Manager. The Product Owner owns product priorities and feature decisions. Risk owners retain formal Security, Privacy, Legal and Compliance approval. Dependency, Implementation, Readiness and Support retain accountability for assurance-gate closure, engineering and deployment, entity readiness and communications, and service operations respectively. The Product Owner assesses and challenges solutions without taking responsibility for engineering them. Main missions Your responsibilities include: Communicated product direction, value proposition, scope and boundaries aligned with the Product Manager’s strategy; an operating model defining governance, roles, decision rights and escalation paths. One backlog covering entity demand, Microsoft changes, compliance needs, service improvements and technical evolution, supported by assessments of fit, value, affected populations, urgency and cross-entity relevance. A BAU roadmap reviewed at least quarterly, with clear priorities, release targets, sequencing and design-to-cost capacity and investment recommendations. Timely, communicated and auditable feature decisions, prioritization criteria, assumptions, trade-offs and next steps, including deferred, blocked and rejected requests. Governance and executive reporting, decision papers and recurring stakeholder forums with recorded decisions, actions and follow-up. Product objectives, KPI definitions and outcome reviews evidencing roadmap clarity, backlog alignment, decision timeliness, execution predictability, service outcomes, usage, adoption and value realization. Product input to release planning, readiness, service introduction and post-release reviews; improvement recommendations informed by entity feedback, outcomes and Microsoft developments. Ability to use Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence or equivalent tools for backlog, roadmap, decision and dependency management, and interpret service, usage and adoption dashboards, including Power BI. Ownership of Microsoft 365, digital workplace, GenAI or collaboration products, particularly in insurance, financial services or another regulated industry; global-tenant experience across legal entities with differing regulatory and risk requirements. Practical knowledge of Copilot Studio, Agent Builder, SharePoint Agents, Agent 365 and agent governance; Power Platform governance/environments; exposure to Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI or enterprise AI integration patterns. Familiarity with Purview DLP, sensitivity labels, audit, eDiscovery and DSPM for AI, and Entra ID application permissions, authentication and authorization models. items.desc: Location/s: UK-wide Recruiter contact: Josh Hoyland Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy with over 20,000 employees across more than 50 countries and 140+ offices. We work across incredible global industries, delivering exciting work that is defining our future and making an important societal impact in the communities we serve. Our people power our performance – we succeed when they do. With countless opportunities to collaborate, learn, and grow, the possibilities for excellence are as varied as every individual. Whether you want to grow as a subject matter expert or broaden your experience with roles across our international community, you’re surrounded by global specialists who want to combine their expertise and champion you to be your best. As a proudly employee-owned business, we benefit our clients, our communities, and each other, investing in creating the right space for everyone to feel empowered, included, and valued. Whatever your ambition, Mott MacDonald is where people come to be brilliant. About The Team Mott MacDonald's Central Digital function supports the wider company's project delivery. It builds the tools, systems and capabilities that change how we deliver engineering, infrastructure and advisory work for our clients. In Central Digital, the AI team develops and runs applied AI and agentic capability. That means turning promising ideas into secure, governed, reusable products that project teams across our service lines can use. Our work covers several connected areas, including: AI-native project delivery: We're building a new company-wide platform that changes how projects are set up, run and governed. AI agents work alongside project teams to capture information, automate routine setup and delivery tasks, and keep data consistent, while people review and approve key decisions. Transforming how our business lines deliver: We work directly with priority areas of the business to redesign how their work gets done. That includes finding where AI can make the biggest difference, building solutions with their subject matter experts, and helping teams adopt them and measure the impact. The team brings together a broad mix of expertise, including data science, AI and software engineering, digital consulting, architecture, cloud infrastructure and responsible AI governance. Day to day, we work with engineers, subject matter experts and product owners. Together we turn real business problems into practical solutions and take them from prototype to production. We hold ourselves to high standards on evaluation, responsible AI, information security and data protection, because our solutions support decisions on real infrastructure. We're a collaborative team that values ideas from every grade and background, and we put real effort into helping people develop. You'll have room to own meaningful work and learn quickly. Overview Of The Role As a Data Scientist specialising in computer vision and AI, you'll turn imagery and spatial data into insight that engineers and project teams can use. You'll work with data such as satellite and drone imagery, 360 captures, lidar, BIM and documents, using both traditional and generative AI methods, and take solutions from early exploration through to deployed pipelines. Much of the value comes from reuse: we already have tools and toolkits that work well, and you'll help extend them to new problems across our service lines. You'll work with subject matter experts to understand what a good result looks like, choose the right measures of success, and explain clearly what the results mean. Key responsibilities and duties include: Develop computer vision and AI solutions using both traditional and generative AI methods, from exploration through to deployed pipelines. Work with imagery and spatial data such as satellite/raster, drone captures, 360 imagery, lidar, BIM and PDFs, and advise on appropriate formats and usage. Build and maintain AI/ML pipelines on Azure Machine Learning and/or Azure Databricks. Choose and generate the right metrics for each use case, interpret results and communicate what they mean for the decision at hand. Extend existing tools and toolkits to new problems, spotting where a solution already built can be reused. Contribute to code review and good GitHub practice across the team. Value and learn from colleagues at every grade and experience level, and help build a supportive team. Candidate specification Essential: Strong Python, including pandas and NumPy. Comfortable writing, debugging and maintaining code by hand, and effective at using AI coding agents to accelerate delivery while critically reviewing what they produce. Familiar with GitHub, including versioning and code review practice. Experience building AI/ML pipelines or applications; computer vision experience preferred. Experience with at least one of: satellite/raster, PDF, BIM, 360 imagery, drone imagery or lidar. Experience …

items.desc: Technology, Innovation and Enablement Practice – Siemens Assurance (FIN A) Your opportunity Work side by side with assurance teams working on audit, internal controls, enterprise risk management and project excellence governance, understand real business challenges and rapidly engineer secure, scalable and reusable software, data and AI solutions that deliver measurable impact Your Role You will be embedded in assurance activities and collaborate directly with practitioners to turn complex problems into practical digital solutions. You will identify and shape high-value opportunities, build prototypes and minimum viable products, and help move validated solutions into productive use. The focus is not innovation for its own sake, but technology that improves assurance quality, coverage, productivity and risk transparency. You combine modern software engineering with hands-on experience in generative and agentic AI. Working closely with Product Owners and DevSecOps partners, you contribute across the solution lifecycle, from discovery, requirements and architecture to development, integration, deployment and continuous improvement. You build solutions with reuse in mind, creating scalable components that can be applied to similar challenges across different areas of assurance. What You Will Do Discover and prioritize: Work directly with assurance teams to understand complex business challenges, assess digitalization potential and independently identify and prioritize software, data and AI use cases with clear business value Shape the digital landscape: Translate functional needs from Audit, Internal Controls, Enterprise Risk Management and Project Excellence into scalable solution concepts and actively shape the strategic digitalization and technology landscape for FIN A. Engineer solutions end to end: Take technical ownership from solution design and architecture through development and integration to productive deployment, ensuring secure, scalable, maintainable and user-centered solutions. Build with modern technologies: Lead and coordinate the development of modular applications, interfaces and data flows using technologies such as Python, Snowflake, Azure cloud and low-code platforms such as Mendix. Shape and apply AI strategically: Co-create the AI strategy for FIN A and translate it into practice by designing and introducing GenAI applications, AI agents and agentic workflows with appropriate governance, guardrails and control mechanisms. Move solutions into production: Drive validated prototypes and MVPs towards production-ready solutions together with Product Owners and DevSecOps partners, making sound technical decisions and actively managing dependencies, risks and trade-offs. Design for scale and reuse: Define reusable solution patterns and components that can be transferred across assurance teams and integrated sustainably into the existing application landscape. Drive adoption and measurable impact: Enable data- and AI-driven transformation across FIN A, measure delivered business value, continuously improve solutions and systematically transfer knowledge and capabilities to assurance teams. What You Bring Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a can-do mindset and the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar assurance processes, practitioner needs and business contexts, and translate them into meaningful opportunities and solutions A master's degree in computer science, business informatics, data science, engineering or a comparable field. At least 5+ years of hands-on experience in software development, data engineering, analytics or AI engineering, ideally in an enterprise environment. Strong expertise in several relevant technologies, such as Python, Azure cloud &AI stack, Snowflake, Mendix or comparable platforms. Practical experience building and introducing GenAI applications, AI agents or agentic workflows. A sound understanding of software architecture, data models, testing, version control, DevSecOps and lifecycle management. A strong ownership mind set and confidence working directly with auditors and other assurance practitioners, and communicating technical options, decisions and trade-offs clearly to Product Owners and management. Experience with audit, risk, controls or comparable assurance processes is an advantage. Alternatively, you can demonstrate strong process expertise and the ability to build assurance knowledge quickly. Curiosity, ownership and a strong willingness to learn in a continuously evolving technology environment. Business-fluent English. What Success Looks Like Measurable improvements in assurance quality, coverage, productivity or risk transparency Solutions that move beyond prototypes, are used in production and are continuously improved. Secure, scalable and reusable software, data and AI components. Strong user adoption and sustainable capability building across assurance teams. items.desc: Batch Robotics is revolutionizing how robots operate in factories — not through rigid programming or teaching by human demonstration, but with smart perception and AI intelligence. We are a team of 8 motivated people with 50 years of experience in industry and robotics. Our mission is to make robots smarter and more flexible, enabling batch-size-1 automation for surface treatment economically. Our technology helps factories in Europe to remain competitive with intelligent robotics. We are now looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer with at least 3 years of full-time industry experience (or a PhD finishing within 4 months), technical excellence and entrepreneurial drive to join us in developing the next generation of AI-driven robotic systems! Tasks End-to-End ML Systems: Design, implement, and train state-of-the-art AI models for perception and control of robot arms. Data Pipelines & ML Ops: Collect real-world data from factory deployments to optimize model training and update models in the field. Simulation & Synthetic Data: Work and improve simulation-based tooling (e.g., NVIDIA Newton Physics Engine) for physical AI and scalable synthetic data generation. Model Development: Build ML components across perception and policy pathways, including video models, multimodal encoders, world models, and diffusion/transformer architectures. Systems Integration: Work with real-world, multimodal datasets (vision, force/torque, tactile) and ensure models operate reliably under real-time constraints on physical hardware. Evaluation & Iteration: Test models in realistic environments, analyze failures, and refine for stability, latency, and robustness. Requirements Background (must-have): Either (a) a Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science or a related field plus at least 3 years of full-time professional experience after graduation – internships, working-student jobs and thesis projects do not count towards these 3 years – or (b) a PhD in one of these fields that is completed or will be completed within the next 4 months . Availability (must-have): You can start full-time in Munich (hybrid) within a maximum of 4 months. Deep experience: Hands-on work with reinforcement learning (RL) and imitation learning within physics simulations. Software Engineering: Strong proficiency in Python and ideally Rust; ability to write clean, modular, and performance-optimized code for distributed workloads using AI agents. Real-World Mindset: Proven track record of deploying models on physical robotic manipulators and handling noisy, temporal, or large-scale datasets. Soft Skills: Entrepreneurial drive, solution-oriented mindset, high agency and the ability to take direct responsibility in a fast-paced startup environment. Benefits Impact: The unique opportunity to rethink industrial automation for batch-size-1 with cutting-edge AI to maintain European manufacturing sovereignty. Growth: Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts in a high-growth VC-funded startup. Ownership: opportunity to actively shape the company's technical direction; potential shares in the company. Environment: A modern, central workspace in Munich with a collaborative, international culture. Please note: We can only consider applications that meet the must-have criteria above – i.e. at least 3 years of full-time professional experience after your Master's (internships and working-student positions excluded) or a PhD completed within the next 4 months, and availability to start within 4 months. Please state your earliest start date (and, if applicable, your expected PhD completion date) in your application. Want to shape the future of industrial robotics? We look forward to meeting you!

items.desc: Job Number: R0253929 Target Analyst The Opportunity: As a Target Analyst you will be a member of a team of experts conducting thorough research and analysis to develop Target Materials (TMs) for Electronic Target Folders (ETFs) of relevant facility, individual, virtual, equipment, and organizations in support of HQ European Command (EUCOM). As the subject matter expert, you will be required to produce TMs IAW with Joint Publications (JP), Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff Instruction (CJCSI) standards, and EUCOM Standard Operating Procedures (SOP). You will integrate advanced analytics, automation, and AI‑driven decision‑support tools to produce high‑quality Target Materials and support EUCOM’s evolving operational needs. This is your chance to expand your knowledge and strengthen your analytic skills cooperation through teamwork, leadership, and commitment to the EUCOM mission. Work with us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our warfighters and nation’s leaders. Join us. The world can’t wait. You Have: 3+ years of experience performing Intermediate Target Development (ITD) 3+ years of experience as an imagery analyst, including imagery exploitation and creating imagery products 3+ years of experience as an all-source intelligence analyst, including using analytic tools to research data from multiple intelligence sources and analyze findings 1+ years of experience in the EUCOM AOR Experience with tools such as MIDB, MARS, WARPATH, iSpy, and DiEE Experience applying AI‑enabled analytic platforms, including Maven Smart Systems to accelerate target discovery, development, and validation Experience working with partners across the Intelligence Community Ability to support rotational 24/7 scheduling and perform effectively in a high-operational-tempo intelligence environment TS/SCI clearance Associate's degree and 7+ years of experience with Intelligence Analysis, Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of experience with Intelligence Analysis, or 10+ years of experience with Intelligence Analysis in lieu of a degree Nice If You Have: Experience performing Collateral Damage Estimation (CDE) Experience conducting Phase 1 and Phase 2 BDA Experience with data analytics and visualization Knowledge of national or commercial imagery Knowledge of GEOINT tasking and collection processes and protocols Knowledge of the intelligence cycle or Joint Targeting cycle Possession of excellent interpersonal skills Possession of excellent verbal and written communication skills, including briefing TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph Graduate of JITD Clearance: Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.  Job Overview
The PDC Process Improvement Engineer is responsible for providing engineering expertise to the Parts Distribution Centers (PDC) by improving end-to-end material ﬂow, designing systematic layouts, optimizing space utilization and leading continuous improvement initiatives. This role provides analysis to leadership to ensure that operational processes are eﬃcient, cost- eﬀective, and of highest quality to meet customer requirements and strategic objectives. The location of this position resides at the Parts Distribution Center (PDC) in Jacksonville, FL.
 Responsibilities
 Leads cross-functional teams tasked with identifying and eliminating ineﬃciencies within layout, process, and material ﬂow to ensure the most cost-eﬀective and quality design.
 Designs storage locations to maximize the PDC's available cubic space to reduce labor and material handling costs while utilizing optimal WMS conﬁgurations.
 Project manager for all Lean Management initiatives across Home Oﬃce and PDC Network teams including training, sponsoring, facilitating and transitioning of knowledge for others to use and apply to improve end-to-end supply chain ineﬃciencies.
 Support Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) initiatives by identifying and resolving non-compliant processes within PDC.
 Collaborates with international and domestic leadership to support ad-hoc process improvement and standardization opportunities that ensure the most eﬀective and eﬃcient processes.
 Represents the PDC as a liaison for understanding unique site infrastructure, storage system conﬁgurations, and planning for all business unit and IT integration projects.
 Develops recommendations for PDC productivity targets by analyzing labor code data and presenting ﬁndings to PDC leadership for approval.
 Manages large-scale strategic initiatives across all project planning phases including initiation, planning, execution, and closure that add value to internal and external customers.
 Support enterprise-wide initiatives to define the future-state systems landscape and optimization of the physical footprint of the North American logistics network.
 Calculates cycle time using work measurement techniques, determines standard work, and communicates the results to leadership to enhance daily labor planning tools.
 Evaluates alternative and emerging warehouse technologies and their potential beneﬁts to safety, quality and productivity to the North American PDC Network.
 Lead efforts to standardize processes, procedures, and best practices to ensure consistency in operations, documentation, and reporting across the PDC network.
 Consistently engage and communicate with PDC leadership to ensure excellent collaboration through common understanding of the operation that enables continuous improvement.

items.desc: Siamo l’azienda partner di riferimento nella distribuzione di prodotti per il fissaggio e montaggio in diversi settori, e insieme ci impegniamo a costruire una Customer Experience all'avanguardia. In questo scenario di crescita, i pilastri su cui basiamo le strategie di sviluppo del nostro business sono omnicanalità, innovazione, digitalizzazione, sostenibilità e valorizzazione del capitale umano. Condividiamo un unico obiettivo: sviluppare il cliente, contribuendo a costruire relazioni di fiducia, comprendere i bisogni dei clienti e proporre soluzioni concrete, innovative e sostenibili. Dare to Build Different è la nostra purpose: per noi significa innovare, valorizzare le diversità e trasformare le competenze in impatto reale. Qui puoi osare, fare la differenza e costruire il futuro insieme a noi. Posizione: In Würth Italia sappiamo che ci vuole coraggio per cambiare le regole del gioco: stiamo cercando un/una Stagista, da inserire in un progetto trasversale tra le funzioni Cybersecurity e Artificial Intelligence , con l'obiettivo di facilitare la collaborazione tecnica e operativa tra i due ambiti, favorendo lo sviluppo rapido, sicuro e conforme delle soluzioni AI aziendali. Principali attività: Affiancare i team nell’analisi delle soluzioni AI, contribuendo a individuare possibili rischi di sicurezza e a promuovere buone pratiche di sviluppo sicuro. Collaborare con i team per facilitare la condivisione dei requisiti di sicurezza e il confronto sui progetti. Supportare le attività di AI Governance, contribuendo alla raccolta delle informazioni sui sistemi AI, alla documentazione e alle valutazioni dei rischi. Partecipare al miglioramento dei processi di sviluppo e verifica, anche individuando opportunità di standardizzazione e automazione. Requisiti: Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria Informatica o simili Conoscenza della lingua inglese Conoscenze di base di cybersecurity, sicurezza applicativa, reti e architetture informatiche. Conoscenza del linguaggio Python e dei principali strumenti e processi di sviluppo software, come Git. Conoscenza di base dei concetti di Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning e LLM. Capacità di analisi e problem solving Costituiscono un plus eventuali esperienze universitarie con strumenti di sviluppo e automazione, o la familiarità con temi come AI Agents, DevSecOps e AI Governance. Altre informazioni: Opportunità di sperimentarti in un contesto internazionale nel mercato B2B per la durata di almeno 6 mesi presso la nostra sede di Egna (BZ), attraverso un tirocinio extracurriculare che prevede rimborso mensile di 900 Euro e il ristorante aziendale gratuito. Possibilità di imparare confrontandoti con professionisti esperti del settore Occasione di crescere professionalmente in una realtà aziendale solida, orientata al futuro e che punta moltissimo sulla crescita e sullo sviluppo dei propri collaboratori Cosa succederà dopo aver inviato la tua candidatura? items.desc: NordicNeuroLab AS 5009 Bergen Om jobben Lagre favoritt Stillingstittel Hardware-/ Electronics Engineer Type ansettelse Fast, heltid 100% Antall stillinger 1 Arbeidsspråk Engelsk Frist: Applications are reviewed continuously NordicNeuroLab is expanding their work within interventional MRI (iMRI), and developing a communication system for these workflows. As part of this initiative, we are building a dedicated engineering team, where we are looking for an experienced Hardware / Electronics Engineer to strengthen the iMRI team. In this role, you will take ownership of key technical challenges and help shape the solution, driving it from its current early stage towards a commercial product over the next two years. What will you be working with? Your work may include: Analog and mixed-signal circuit design Schematic and PCB design Embedded hardware and component selection Prototyping and technical concept evaluation Testing, measurement, troubleshooting and verification EMC/EMI and noise mitigation, including filtering, grounding and shielding Hardware and system integration Development with manufacturability and cost in mind Collaboration with suppliers, consultants and specialist resources when required Because the system will operate in the MRI environment, you will work with technical challenges where the solution may not always be obvious from the outset. A hands-on approach to testing, experimentation and problem-solving will therefore be important.Some testing will take place in real MRI environments, so some travel should be expected. Who are we looking for? You have a relevant background in electronics, hardware engineering or a related discipline, combined with practical experience developing electronic products or systems. Experience in analog and mixed-signal electronics is particularly interesting to us, ideally combined with schematic and PCB design. At the same time, the role requires technical breadth and an interest in working across disciplines. You should also have strong English communication skills, both written and spoken, and work well in a collaborative, fast-paced development environment. Most importantly, we are looking for someone with the drive to make things happen. Someone who takes ownership of a problem, digs into it and keeps moving when the first approach does not work. We believe you will thrive in this role if you: Have a hands-on engineering mindset Take initiative and ownership of technical challenges Enjoy creating and developing new solutions Work independently while collaborating closely with others Are comfortable challenging technical decisions and discussing different approaches Are curious and willing to work outside a narrowly defined specialist area Can balance technical quality with progress, manufacturability and cost Additional experience that would be valuable Experience or familiarity with any of the following would be an advantage: Wireless systems, such as Bluetooth LE and Wi-Fi Audio electronics, including ANC and ENC RF Collaboration with suppliers, consultants and specialist resources Design for manufacturability Medical devices or regulated product development Electronics for demanding electromagnetic environments MRI-related technology AI-assisted engineering tools and familiarity with agentic AI Experience with medical devices or electronics for the MRI environment would be highly relevant, but is not a prerequisite. You do not need to tick every box. You may be particularly strong in one area and have broader experience or interest across others. We value strong engineering fundamentals, practical experience and the ability to learn and work across disciplines. Why NordicNeuroLab? You will join the iMRI initiative at an early stage of the development process and have the opportunity to influence important technical decisions.. You will work with challenging technology, where real clinical workflows and the MRI environment shape the engineering challenges. NordicNeuroLab offers a flexible and collaborative working environment, with the opportunity to take on significant technical responsibility and contribute your expertise across different areas of product development. For questions regarding this position, please contact Michelle Kolskår, Head of Sales at Folk AS. Phone: +47 48 13 66 56 E-mail: michelle@folkas.com Since its establishment in 2004, Folk AS has assisted both Norwegian and international companies in finding highly skilled professionals within technical and administrative disciplines for project-based, temporary, and permanent positions. This is what we do best, and where our expertise lies. Our core values are: ethical, personal, committed, and flexible. We see opportunities in your competence! items.desc: Blue Light Card. Individually great, together unstoppable The Role and the Team Our newest product has just left the testing phase, and the aim now is simple: connect more of our members with independent businesses across the UK. Members get great discounts, those businesses gain new customers, and the whole team is working together to make it succeed. Reaching and supporting partners at that scale is too big a job to do by hand, which is where AI comes in. This is a brand new, fixed-term contract role, running until the end of April 2027. It is a marketing role powered by AI rather than an engineering one: you'll use AI tools and automation to find the right businesses, reach them in smarter ways and keep partners engaged, so that each new partner needs fewer human touches to bring on board. You'll work across two teams, one focused on bringing businesses on and one focused on keeping partners happy, and you'll report to our Head of Go-to-Market. There's no set playbook, and that's part of the appeal. We have a clear general strategy, but you'll be the expert on how AI can help us deliver it, and we're keen to hear your ideas and test them quickly. If you've tried something that worked well in a previous role, we'd love to hear about it. What You'll Do Build and run AI-led outreach to independent businesses, using multi-touch plans where every message adds something new from our own data and a reply stops the sequence Assess specialist providers and work with them, alongside our in-house product and engineering colleagues, to introduce voice and web agents as a new way for partners to engage with us Review how the agents are performing, from the number of calls made to conversion, then refine them and make sure partners can always reach a person when they need one Help create and maintain a trusted list of target businesses based on our ideal customer profile, cleaning and enriching the data, checking its accuracy regularly and fixing gaps as they appear Use AI to work out which prospects are best qualified and worth approaching first, then pass them to our acquisition team and our sales and partnerships colleagues Guide new businesses through the onboarding funnel and re-engage dormant partners, encouraging more of them to use the Business Hub each month Track the cost and the number of human touches involved in bringing each new partner on board, and use what you learn to keep improving Work across both teams, sharing what you're testing and learning so everyone understands what's working What You'll Bring Experience in marketing, growth or marketing operations, ideally in outbound or lifecycle marketing, with a solid understanding of how marketing hands over to sales Hands-on experience using AI tools and automation to run marketing or sales workflows, whether in a professional setting or through your own projects, with no engineering background needed Experience building multi-touch outreach sequences and measuring how well they perform Experience working with prospect or CRM data, including cleaning and enriching it so it's ready to use Comfort using data to track cost and conversion, and to decide what to change, keep or stop Proven experience working at pace in a fast-moving team, communicating clearly with colleagues across different functions and taking ownership of your work from brief to delivery Experience building or deploying AI agents (outreach, voice or chat), working in B2B or SME marketing, or passing qualified prospects to a sales team would be a bonus, but none of these is essential Our Culture Our mission is simple: make heroes happy. Our members are real-life heroes who keep us all safe, cared for, and thriving. It's what gets us up in the morning, what makes us want to think bigger, and create something that truly matters. By focusing on their happiness, we create amazing experiences, deliver unrivalled discounts, innovative products, and world-class service. We don't just follow the usual path - we look for smarter, bolder ways to deliver real impact. We take ownership, move fast, and work shoulder to shoulder to build something special. We promote hybrid working, and value in-person collaboration so encourage time in our offices – either the HQ in Leicestershire, or London, Holborn office. The frequency and office location will vary depending on the role and team. We aim to be flexible, but we aren't able to offer fully remote working. Blue Light Card is an equal opportunities employer. We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team where different perspectives and experiences help us grow, innovate, and better reflect the communities we serve. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. In the event of a high number of applications, we'll prioritise candidates who meet both the essential and desirable criteria for the role. What We Offer 25 days annual leave plus public holidays and an additional day off for your birthday A Moments that Matter day …

items.desc: About Us: Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people. How We Work: At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values: Bold in how we dream and innovate Responsive to feedback, challenges and opportunities Accountable for results and best in class outcomes Visionary in future focused problem-solving Exceptional in execution and impact The Role We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our ITE (Inbound Threat Engineering) backend services team, providing the core inbound email scanning engine. Our stack comprises services written in Python and deployed in AWS across the world, with some new development planned for Go. AI tools feature heavily in our development and support processes, and we continue to explore how to best utilise the technology. At our team level we work closely with other parts of the business so we can provide maximum efficacy and protection for our users. Responsibilities In our Engineering teams, we deeply appreciate DevOps culture, as we build and run our services. Our day to day involves working with Product Management to provide increased efficacy and implement new features, optimising our infrastructure for cost and reliability and integrating with other Proofpoint systems to expand our product offering. You’ll have the opportunity to: Design and build reliable distributed systems that handle volumes of data with low latency. Maintain and support business-critical systems where scale and latency are front-of-mind. Contribute code to production regularly using our CI/CD pipeline Address challenges related to processing highly sensitive data in a secure and privacy-conscious way. Learn to build with security in mind. Provide technical leadership, mentor peers in a supportive way, contribute to design reviews, and collaborate on solving complex challenges. Make your mark on ambitious projects. What You Bring to the Team Essential Experience: Experience with Python or Go for backend development Knowledge of AWS (or other Cloud Provider) Services Demonstrated ability to plan, coordinate, and execute engineering projects Beneficial Experience: High volume NoSQL and SQL databases such as Dynamo DB, Postgres Terraform built environments Experience working with data and infrastructure at scale Event driven architecture such as Kafka/Kinesis Our standards around security, quality, and service availability can only be the highest, but at the same time we foster psychological safety, as we are comfortable with the unknowns and love to experiment to find the right solution, which get things done and keep the eyes on results. We use data to validate our decisions, measuring our progress and success. Data informs our decision making, our goals, and our roadmap. We are sure you will love joining us if you share our focus on outcomes rather than outputs and leverage factual evidence to justify your arguments and influence the direction of the team. Our main challenge ahead is scaling, both vertically (size of individual tenants) and horizontally (number of total tenants). We will consider experience working with data and infrastructure at scale as a bonus. If you are not sure that you exactly fit all the above criteria, please do get in touch anyway. We are always willing to speak to great candidates even if you do not feel you meet every criteria listed! Why Proofpoint? At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us: Competitive compensation Comprehensive benefits Career success on your terms Flexible work environment Annual wellness and community outreach days Always on recognition for your contributions Global collaboration and networking opportunities Our Culture: Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success-every day, for everyone. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to accessibility@proofpoint.com. How to Apply Interested? Submit your application along with any supporting information- we can’t wait to hear from you!

items.desc: About The Role We’re seeking a Data Scientist to join our growing Data & AI team, helping our clients use data, Machine Learning and AI to solve complex business problems and create measurable value. You’ll work alongside experienced Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Data Engineers and business stakeholders to explore data, develop models and turn analytical ideas into practical solutions. You’ll have the opportunity to work across a variety of industries and technologies, building your technical expertise while developing the consulting skills needed to deliver successful Data & AI solutions. This is a hands-on role for someone early in their career who has strong foundations in data science and is curious about how emerging technologies, including Generative AI, are changing the way organisations use data. Please Note Security Clearence: To be successfully appointed to this role, must be eligible to obtain Security Check (SC)clearance. To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements. Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process. What You'll Be Doing In this position you will play a key part in: Exploring, preparing and analysing complex datasets to identify patterns, insights and opportunities. Developing, testing and evaluating Machine Learning and statistical models to solve real-world business problems. Translating business questions into analytical approaches and communicating findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Using Python and modern data science frameworks to build repeatable analytical solutions and prototypes. Working with AI Engineers and Data Engineers to help take models and analytical solutions from experimentation towards production. Applying appropriate model evaluation, validation and experimentation techniques to understand and improve solution performance. Exploring emerging areas such as Generative AI, Large Language Models, RAG and Agentic AI where appropriate to client challenges. Working collaboratively as part of multidisciplinary teams, contributing ideas, sharing knowledge and learning from experienced colleagues. Considering responsible and ethical AI principles throughout the development lifecycle. Working closely with our clients, helping them gain insight from their data. Role As part of your role, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth through activities that form part of the following categories: Business Development – Support the development of client demonstrations, proofs of value, proposals and presentations that showcase how Data Science and AI can solve business challenges. Internal Contribution – Contribute to reusable code, accelerators, frameworks and internal Data & AI communities that help our teams deliver more effectively. Capability Development – Continuously develop your technical skills through training, certifications and hands-on experience, while contributing to knowledge sharing, blogs, hackathons and emerging technology initiatives. What You'll Bring We’d love to meet someone with: A strong foundation in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering or another quantitative discipline. Around 2 years of relevant professional experience applying Data Science, Machine Learning or advanced analytics to real-world problems. We will also consider candidates with equivalent experience gained through postgraduate study, research or substantial project work. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and use data to develop evidence-based solutions. Hands-on experience using Python for data analysis and modelling, using libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn or similar. Experience developing and evaluating Machine Learning models using appropriate metrics, validation approaches and experimentation techniques. A good understanding of core statistical and Machine Learning concepts, including regression, classification, clustering, feature engineering and model evaluation. The ability to explore and communicate data effectively using visualisation techniques and tools. An interest in Generative AI and emerging Data & AI technologies, with an enthusiasm for learning and experimentation. Good communication skills and the confidence to explain analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. A collaborative and curious mindset, with the willingness to learn quickly and work effectively in multidisciplinary teams. Experience Required Your Technical Expertise This list shows the technologies …

A pozíció fókuszában nem az üzleti igények dokumentálása, hanem azok kézzelfogható megvalósítása áll. Olyan szakembert keresünk, aki képes különböző AI-modellek, platformok és eszközök segítségével működő megoldásokat létrehozni, workflow-kat és automatizációkat építeni, valamint AI-alapú alkalmazásokat és prototípusokat fejleszteni. A munkakörben lehetőséged lesz különböző AI-technológiákkal kísérletezni, új eszközöket kipróbálni, üzleti rendszereket összekapcsolni, és a felmerülő problémákra gyors, működő megoldásokat kialakítani. Fontos a gyakorlati szemlélet, a kísérletező hozzáállás és az, hogy az ötletekből rövid idő alatt használható eredmények szülessenek. Főbb feladatok AI-alapú megoldások és automatizációk önálló kialakítása, tesztelése és továbbfejlesztése. Különböző generatív AI-modellek, AI-agentek és platformok gyakorlati alkalmazása, konfigurálása és paraméterezése. Többlépéses AI-workflow-k kialakítása, különböző modellek, API-k és vállalati rendszerek összekapcsolásával. Promptok, rendszerutasítások és modellek működési logikájának kialakítása és optimalizálása. AI-alapú alkalmazások, belső eszközök és prototípusok gyors létrehozása, akár vibe coding és AI-assisted development eszközök segítségével. RAG-alapú megoldások kialakítása, belső tudásbázisok és dokumentumok AI-alapú feldolgozásának megvalósítása. Új AI-modellek, technológiák és fejlesztőeszközök folyamatos tesztelése, üzleti alkalmazhatóságuk felmérése. Meglévő üzleti folyamatok automatizálása és AI-alapú továbbfejlesztése. A létrehozott megoldások működésének, pontosságának, megbízhatóságának és teljesítményének tesztelése, optimalizálása. items.desc: About Amitours Amitours Group is one of Europe’s leading transport providers, specializing in ski-focused mobility and integrated travel services. We’re not just about transfers — at Amitours, we are building the next generation of travel, Health tech and finance tech products: Alps2Alps, Mountly , Alveda and more. With 15+ years in the market, Alps2Alps covers most Alpine destinations with airport-to-ski-resorts transfers, as well as offering affordable ski rentals, ski passes, and beyond. We believe in Travel tailored with love, powered by innovation, and driven by a commitment to the Earth. We are looking for motivated and ambitious candidates who are ready to join a team of “A-players” and advance their careers in the global market. We look forward to meeting you! The Opportunity: Not Your Typical Product Role What if you could take an idea on Monday and have a working prototype in front of real users by Friday? That's the kind of energy we're looking for. We're searching for a Product Builder who lives and breathes AI, loves solving real problems, and gets genuinely excited about turning ideas into working products. Let's make one thing clear: this is NOT a traditional Product Manager role. Previous Product Management experience is a must, but you won't spend your days writing endless specs or managing Jira tickets. And you're not joining us just to write code, either. You'll own the entire journey: problem → validation → prototype → MVP → first users. Your playground? Claude, Cursor, OpenAI, Lovable, n8n, APIs, AI agents , and whatever new tools help you build smarter and faster. Key Responsibilities Go from idea to MVP - fast. Validate ideas, prototype, and independently ship MVPs. Know when a simple landing page is enough and when a more advanced solution is needed. Build it. Launch it. Get people using it. Design and run lean marketing and distribution experiments to attract early users and validate demand. Make AI do the heavy lifting. Identify inefficiencies, automate workflows across business functions, and build solutions using APIs, AI agents, and modern AI tools. Find problems worth solving. Analyze stakeholders or customer pain points, scalability, and business potential to identify opportunities worth pursuing. Work directly with decision-makers. Collaborate with founder, marketing, and different departments to turn business challenges into working products. Bring structure to chaos. Take ambiguous ideas, figure out what matters, and turn them into real solutions quickly. Required Skills You've been in the product world. You have 2–3 years of experience in Product Management, Product Operations within startups, you built your own products or had similar builder roles. AI isn't just a buzzword on your CV. You actively use Claude, Cursor, n8n, and other AI tools and genuinely enjoy experimenting with them. You know when NOT to build. You're analytical, data-driven, great at prioritization, and comfortable killing ideas that don't make business sense. You think beyond features. You understand product thinking, UX, customer needs, and operational workflows. You don't need someone to tell you every next step. You're independent, proactive, and comfortable with ambiguity. If you don't know something, you know how to learn it. You enjoy the startup roller coaster. You're flexible, adaptable, and energized by changing priorities. You're a builder, not just a planner. You take ownership, move fast, and know when to involve developers without depending on a full engineering team. Most importantly: you'd rather show us a working prototype than spend two weeks explaining how you plan to build one. This Probably Isn't Your Kind of Role If You'd rather manage builders than build things yourself. You need a large team to move projects forward. You prefer theory and planning over hands-on execution. You're uncomfortable with experimentation, uncertainty, or changing priorities. We're not looking for someone who has all the answers. We're looking for someone who knows how to find them, test them, and turn them into something real. Why Join us? Work from anywhere. Fully remote, worldwide (except sanctioned countries), within the CET time zone . Potential relocation support. For candidates in countries where we don't usually hire, relocation support may be considered after successful completion of probation, subject to company discretion and applicable requirements. Real ownership, real impact. Take ideas from concept to launch and see the results of your work. A fast-moving startup environment. Less bureaucracy, more experimentation, and plenty of opportunities to learn. AI at the center of what you do. Explore emerging technologies and apply them to real challenges across multiple industries. Direct access to founder and teams. Collaborate closely with decision-makers and influence what gets built. items.desc: Siamo l’azienda partner di riferimento nella distribuzione di prodotti per il fissaggio e montaggio in diversi settori, e insieme ci impegniamo a costruire una Customer Experience all'avanguardia. In questo scenario di crescita, i pilastri su cui basiamo le strategie di sviluppo del nostro business sono omnicanalità, innovazione, digitalizzazione, sostenibilità e valorizzazione del capitale umano. Condividiamo un unico obiettivo: sviluppare il cliente, contribuendo a costruire relazioni di fiducia, comprendere i bisogni dei clienti e proporre soluzioni concrete, innovative e sostenibili. Dare to Build Different è la nostra purpose: per noi significa innovare, valorizzare le diversità e trasformare le competenze in impatto reale. Qui puoi osare, fare la differenza e costruire il futuro insieme a noi. Posizione: In Würth Italia sappiamo che ci vuole coraggio per cambiare le regole del gioco: stiamo cercando un/una Stagista, da inserire in un progetto trasversale tra le funzioni Cybersecurity e Artificial Intelligence , con l'obiettivo di facilitare la collaborazione tecnica e operativa tra i due ambiti, favorendo lo sviluppo rapido, sicuro e conforme delle soluzioni AI aziendali. Principali attività: Affiancare i team nell’analisi delle soluzioni AI, contribuendo a individuare possibili rischi di sicurezza e a promuovere buone pratiche di sviluppo sicuro. Collaborare con i team per facilitare la condivisione dei requisiti di sicurezza e il confronto sui progetti. Supportare le attività di AI Governance, contribuendo alla raccolta delle informazioni sui sistemi AI, alla documentazione e alle valutazioni dei rischi. Partecipare al miglioramento dei processi di sviluppo e verifica, anche individuando opportunità di standardizzazione e automazione. Requisiti: Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria Informatica o simili Conoscenza della lingua inglese Conoscenze di base di cybersecurity, sicurezza applicativa, reti e architetture informatiche. Conoscenza del linguaggio Python e dei principali strumenti e processi di sviluppo software, come Git. Conoscenza di base dei concetti di Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning e LLM. Capacità di analisi e problem solving Costituiscono un plus eventuali esperienze universitarie con strumenti di sviluppo e automazione, o la familiarità con temi come AI Agents, DevSecOps e AI Governance. Altre informazioni: Opportunità di sperimentarti in un contesto internazionale nel mercato B2B per la durata di almeno 6 mesi presso la nostra sede di Egna (BZ) , attraverso un tirocinio extracurriculare che prevede rimborso mensile di 900 Euro e il ristorante aziendale gratuito. items.desc: About Us Founded in 2011, Modus is a global, fully remote team of world-class technologists who thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment. We're a digital product engineering partner for forward-thinking businesses. Our global teams work side-by-side with clients to design, build, and scale custom solutions that achieve real results and lasting change, partnering with industry leaders including AWS, GitHub, and Atlassian. We were fully remote before it was cool! Recognized as one of the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies for nine years and a top remote work company by FlexJobs, we have helped some of the world's largest brands deliver powerful digital experiences. As an award-winning Atlassian partner with a world-class team, we help organizations innovate and solve complex challenges for Fortune 500 companies and beyond, we want to hear from you. Opportunity! We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work at the intersection of engineering, AI, and customer delivery. You'll partner directly with clients to understand complex business and technical challenges, rapidly design and build solutions, and integrate modern AI capabilities into real-world applications and systems. This role is ideal for an engineer who combines strong application development skills with a customer-focused mindset and enjoys taking solutions from initial discovery and architecture through implementation and deployment. Requirements: Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production-ready applications and services. Solid application engineering experience, including designing, developing, testing, and deploying scalable software solutions. Hands-on experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into applications and existing technology ecosystems. Strong experience designing and integrating APIs and distributed systems, including third-party services and enterprise platforms. Experience building solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI technologies. Experience working with major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and/or GCP. Proficiency with TypeScript and modern application development frameworks. Experience with agent orchestration, AI workflows, tool calling, or similar agentic architectures. Strong customer-facing and consulting skills, with the ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Experience with solution architecture, including designing scalable systems and making technical decisions based on customer and business requirements. Ability to work closely with customer stakeholders, product teams, and engineers throughout the solution lifecycle. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. Bonus points: Experience delivering technical solutions directly within customer environments. Experience designing or implementing RAG, AI agents, or multi-agent systems. Exposure to MLOps, model deployment, and AI observability. Experience working in consulting, professional services, solutions engineering, or similar customer-facing technical roles. Experience rapidly building prototypes and proofs of concept and evolving them into production-ready solutions. Familiarity with modern data platforms, vector databases, and AI infrastructure. You'll Love: Working directly with customers to solve complex, real-world technical challenges. Building and deploying AI-powered solutions that move quickly from concept to production. Combining hands-on engineering with solution architecture and customer collaboration. Working across application engineering, cloud technologies, and modern AI systems. Exploring emerging AI technologies and finding practical ways to apply them to meaningful business problems. By joining our team, you'll be part of a winning squad that plays to each other's strengths and celebrates every success together.

items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäftsprozesse unserer Kunden. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Deine Rolle - Das wartet auf dich Du möchtest AI nicht nur entwickeln, sondern dort wirksam machen, wo sie gebraucht wird? Du verstehst Geschäftsprozesse, schreibst selbst Code und bringst Lösungen gemeinsam mit Kunden in den produktiven Einsatz? Dann gestalte mit uns die nächste Generation intelligenter Anwendungen. Als Forward Deployed Engineer arbeitest du eng mit den Fachbereichen und IT-Teams unserer Kunden zusammen. Du übersetzt konkrete Herausforderungen in funktionierende AI-Lösungen und begleitest sie von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Nutzung. Dabei verbindest du Kundennähe und technische Umsetzung mit dem Know-how unserer AI-, Data- und Cloud-Spezialist:innen. Kunden verstehen & Potenziale erkennen: Du arbeitest direkt mit Kundenteams zusammen, analysierst ihre Geschäftsprozesse und identifizierst AI-Anwendungsfälle mit messbarem Mehrwert. Gemeinsam definierst du Ziele, Erfolgskriterien und einen realistischen Umsetzungspfad. Hands-on entwickeln: Du übersetzt Anforderungen in lauffähige Software und entwickelst Prototypen, die du iterativ zu produktionsreifen Anwendungen ausbaust – beispielsweise mit Large Language Models, RAG oder AI Agents. Systeme & Daten integrieren: Du verbindest AI-Komponenten mit bestehenden Anwendungen, APIs und Datenquellen. Dabei berücksichtigst du die technischen Rahmenbedingungen sowie Sicherheits- und Berechtigungsanforderungen unserer Kunden. Produktiven Einsatz verantworten: Du treibst die technische Umsetzung bis zum Go-live voran und sicherst Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit und Wirtschaftlichkeit durch Tests, AI-Evaluationen und Monitoring – gemeinsam mit den zuständigen Entwicklungs- und Betriebsteams. Zusammenarbeit & Nutzung fördern: Du bringst Fachbereiche, IT und unsere AI-Spezialist:innen zusammen, machst technische Entscheidungen verständlich und befähigst Kundenteams, AI-Lösungen wirksam einzusetzen – durch gemeinsames Experimentieren, AI-gestützte Entwicklung und die kontinuierliche Verbesserung anhand von Nutzerfeedback. Wiederverwendbare AI-Komponenten entwickeln: Du konzipierst und entwickelst modulare AI-Komponenten, die sich in die Systemlandschaft unserer Kunden integrieren und für weitere Anwendungsfälle nutzen lassen. Dabei schaffst du eine skalierbare technische Basis, auf der Kundenteams neue AI-Lösungen effizient aufbauen können. Deine Skills - Das bringst du mit Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Du hast ein Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebiets abgeschlossen oder bringst eine gleichwertige praktische Qualifikation mit. Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und hast Anwendungen bis zum produktiven Einsatz begleitet. Software Engineering: Du entwickelst sicher mit Python und idealerweise einer weiteren Sprache wie TypeScript, Java oder C#. APIs, Datenbanken, Git, automatisierte Tests und wartbarer Code gehören für dich zum Engineering-Alltag. Applied AI: Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit LLM-basierten Anwendungen, RAG oder agentischen Workflows. Du verstehst ihre Möglichkeiten und Grenzen und kannst Qualität, Kosten und Antwortzeiten systematisch bewerten. Integration & Betrieb: Du kennst mindestens eine gängige Cloud-Plattform und hast Erfahrung mit Deployment, CI/CD und Monitoring. Datenschutz, Zugriffskontrollen und sichere Systemintegration denkst du von Anfang an mit. Kundennähe & Kommunikation: Du übersetzt fachliche Herausforderungen in technische Anforderungen und stimmst Lösungswege mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern ab. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse. Für die direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden vor Ort bringst du eine projektabhängige Reisebereitschaft mit. Ownership & Pragmatismus: Du gehst strukturiert mit offenen Fragestellungen um, holst aktiv Feedback ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse. Du erkennst, wann du selbst umsetzt und wann du spezialisierte Kolleg:innen einbindest.
