items.desc:
Meta is seeking a User Experience Researcher to lead qualitative research programs that shape the future of our products and platforms. In this role, you will drive large-scale, complex research initiatives that generate deep human insights, informing product strategy across multiple teams and business areas. You will apply rigorous qualitative methodologies to understand user attitudes, behaviors, and motivations, translating findings into clear, compelling narratives that influence product direction at scale. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role for a researcher who operates with significant autonomy, contributes to organizational strategy, and is recognized as a subject matter expert across the research community.
Lead large-scale qualitative research programs from study design through synthesis and stakeholder communication, operating independently on high-complexity, ambiguous projects Define and drive research strategy and roadmaps across multiple product teams, aligning research priorities to long-term business and user needs Design and execute rigorous qualitative studies including in-depth interviews, ethnographic research, diary studies, and participatory design sessions to uncover user attitudes, behaviors, and motivations Integrate qualitative and quantitative methods to build comprehensive research programs that address complex, cross-functional business questions Translate research findings into clear, concise narratives and data visualizations tailored to diverse audiences including product teams and leadership Collaborate with product management, design, data science, and engineering partners to ensure research insights are embedded in product decisions and roadmaps Coach and advise peers on qualitative research methodology, analytical frameworks, coding schemas, and best practices for insight generation Proactively identify high-priority research questions and emerging user needs, contributing to organizational strategy and goal-setting across teams Develop and refine analytical frameworks that improve the consistency, interpretability, and impact of qualitative findings across the research organization Manage end-to-end project planning for multi-stakeholder research initiatives, including scoping, resource estimation, timeline management, and stakeholder alignment
8+ years of experience conducting qualitative user experience research in a product development environment Experience independently leading complex, large-scale qualitative research programs including study design, participant recruitment, data collection, analysis, and synthesis Experience applying a range of qualitative research methods such as in-depth interviews, ethnographic research, diary studies, concept testing, and usability research Experience communicating research findings and strategic recommendations to cross-functional teams and leadership through written reports and data presentations Experience collaborating with product, design, and data science partners to integrate research insights into product strategy and roadmaps Experience integrating qualitative and quantitative research methods to address complex product questions at scale Experience applying emerging qualitative research tools and techniques, including AI-assisted analysis, to accelerate insight generation Experience conducting research on social platforms, communication products, or consumer technology at significant scale Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) Experience developing research frameworks or methodological standards that improve research quality and consistency across a team or organization Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

items.desc:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 The Global Payments Performance Team identifies payment optimisation opportunities for Stripe’s merchants. The Global Payments Performance team serves a critical role both in demonstrating thought leadership on challenging payment topics, and also partnering with our high-potential merchants to set them up for long term success. We want a partnership with Stripe to be a competitive advantage for our customers, large and small, by providing them with best-in-class technology in concert with insightful and specific advice on how to harness this technology to achieve their business goals.
 What you’ll do 
 The Payments Performance EMEA team will be responsible for leading data-driven discussions with existing and prospective merchants on optimisation strategies across a variety of areas including, card network costs, acceptance, fraud, and cross-border flows to start. You will be instrumental in building our optimisation narratives/tools and delivering on our merchant engagement model. You will also collaborate with Sales, deploying your knowledge to differentiate Stripe to win deals, and partner with our Customer Success organization to ensure that merchants are successful working with Stripe.
 Responsibilities 
 Lead discussions with existing and prospective merchants, and provide the Sales team with tools and training to lead discussions with merchants and prospects.
 Serve as both an internal and merchant-facing expert on payment optimisation strategies.
 Gather and build on Stripe’s wide-ranging payments expertise to create optimisation narratives/tools supported by rigorous analysis.
 Use existing tools to deploy sophisticated optimisation playbooks and analyses across Stripe’s customer portfolio.
 Synthesise and relay customer feedback and our findings to inform Stripe’s product roadmap.
 Provide feedback on our tools and playbooks to help continuously improve our self serve offerings
 Who you are 
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements 
 7+ years in payments or operations at a leading technology company, or consultancy in the payments industry. 
 Understanding of e-commerce payments, cards based payments processing and optimisation strategies
 A proven ability to build collaborative working relationships with cross-functional teams.
 The ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment.
 A proven ability to be a self-starter capable of driving business results without significant supervision.
 Experience presenting directly to merchants and serving as a subject matter expert providing both internal and customer-facing advisory in the payments domain.
 Develop optimization playbooks and stay updated on industry best practices and Stripe innovations
 A track record of delivering measurable improvements in payment acceptance, conversion, fraud outcomes or payment costs across a portfolio of underlying merchants or sellers.
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
 Strong data processing, organizational and analytical skills.
 Language proficiency in French is essential for this role.
 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience with SQL, dashboard building, modeling, or reporting
 Understanding of card network rules and regulations, local payment methods, and the regulatory environment (PSD2/PSD3)
 Experience presenting to senior business leaders
 Experience working with SaaS Platform or marketplace business models is a plus
 Familiarity with Stripe Connect or comparable platform-payments solutions, including connected-account models, payment flows, and the allocation of fees and risk responsibilities.

 The Global Payments Performance Team identifies payment optimisation opportunities for Stripe’s merchants. The Global Payments Performance team serves a critical role both in demonstrating thought leadership on challenging payment topics, and also partnering with our high-potential merchants to set them up for long term success. We want a partnership with Stripe to be a competitive advantage for our customers, large and small, by providing them with best-in-class technology in concert with insightful and specific advice on how to harness this technology to achieve their business goals.
 What you’ll do
 The Payments Performance EMEA team will be responsible for leading data-driven discussions with existing and prospective merchants on optimisation strategies across a variety of areas including, card network costs, acceptance, fraud, and cross-border flows to start. You will be instrumental in building our optimisation narratives/tools and delivering on our merchant engagement model. You will also collaborate with Sales, deploying your knowledge to differentiate Stripe to win deals, and partner with our Customer Success organisation to ensure that merchants are successful working with Stripe.
 Responsibilities
 Lead discussions with existing and prospective merchants, and provide the Sales team with tools and training to lead discussions with merchants and prospects.
 Serve as both an internal and merchant-facing expert on payment optimisation strategies.
 Gather and build on Stripe’s wide-ranging payments expertise to create optimisation narratives/tools supported by rigorous analysis.
 Use existing tools to deploy sophisticated optimisation playbooks and analyses across Stripe’s customer portfolio.
 Synthesise and relay customer feedback and our findings to inform Stripe’s product roadmap.
 Provide feedback on our tools and playbooks to help continuously improve our self serve offerings
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements
 7+ years in payments or operations at a leading technology company, or consultancy in the payments industry. 
 Understanding of e-commerce payments, cards based payments processing and optimisation strategies
 A proven ability to build collaborative working relationships with cross-functional teams.
 The ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment.
 A proven ability to be a self-starter capable of driving business results without significant supervision.
 Experience presenting directly to merchants and serving as a subject matter expert providing both internal and customer-facing advisory in the payments domain.
 Develop optimisation playbooks and stay updated on industry best practices and Stripe innovations
 A track record of delivering measurable improvements in payment acceptance, conversion, fraud outcomes or payment costs across a portfolio of underlying merchants or sellers.
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
 Strong data processing, organisational and analytical skills
 Experience leveraging AI tooling for complex analysis, and building AI based playbooks for scaling expertise.
 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience with SQL, dashboard building, modelling, or reporting
 Understanding of card network rules and regulations, local payment methods, and the regulatory environment (PSD2/PSD3)
 Experience presenting to senior business leaders
 Language proficiency in French or German is a plus 
 Experience working with SaaS Platform or marketplace business models is a plus
 Familiarity with Stripe Connect or comparable platform-payments solutions, including connected-account models, payment flows, and the allocation of fees and risk responsibilities.

Join our Team
 About this opportunity: 
The Service Owner - Mobile is accountable for the end-to-end performance and lifecycle of the Customer’s mobile services, linked to a strategic Managed Service Agreement. This includes Mobile Core and Mobile Access NOC services and their interfaces to field operations, site infrastructure, cloud platforms and partners. The role provides customer-facing leadership across service architecture, reliability, and improvement. 
You will work with domain specialists, NOC and field teams, global tool owners, OEMs, ASPs, and Customer stakeholders to deliver one coherent mobile service, combining customer engagement with operational insight and lifecycle ownership. 
 What you will do: 
• Own service outcomes, Customer experience, and contractual delivery for the mobile service scope, including core platforms, data centres, RAN, and transmission. 
• Lead the mobile Service Operations team and align architecture, reliability, and improvement priorities with field, infrastructure/cloud, tools teams, and partners. 
• Maintain visibility of availability, performance, capacity, and SLA/KPI results; ensure risks and corrective plans have accountable owners. 
• Act as the Customer’s primary service contact; lead service reviews and report trends, incidents, risks, and decisions clearly. 
• Coordinate incident, major-incident, problem, change, release, and restoration outcomes across NOC, field, OEM, and supplier teams. 
• Ensure operational readiness for new or changed services, including acceptance, documentation, runbooks, training, and monitoring. 
• Oversee the service lifecycle and technical roadmap, raising capacity, resilience, security, and obsolescence needs through governance. 
• Ensure in-scope data-retention activities are delivered by authorized, appropriately located personnel per contractual and Australian requirements. 
• Coordinate field dependencies such as dispatch, site access, maintenance, spares, and restoration. 
• Sponsor service improvement and transformation, including automation, analytics, and measurable customer-experience and productivity gains. 
• Represent risk, security, continuity, and disaster-recovery requirements in operational decisions and governance. 
• Drive governance across infrastructure and fiber providers, covering SLA performance, dependencies, and escalation. 
• Lead proactive Problem Management to eliminate root causes and prevent repeat incidents. 
 You will bring: 
• Minimum 10 years experience of mobile telecommunications operations, managed services, or service assurance. 
• Knowledge of mobile core, RAN, transmission, data-centre or cloud dependencies, and field operations. 
• Strong service-management capability across incident, problem, change, capacity, performance, and availability. 
• Experience coordinating multi-vendor delivery across NOC, field, infrastructure, and engineering teams. 
• Ability to interpret network data, explain customer impact, and prioritize actions. 
• Customer-facing communication, governance, escalation, and relationship skills. 
• A proactive approach to improvement, automation, and resilience. 
• Commitment to security, data protection, continuity, and safe working practices.

 Mit deiner Dienstleistungsorientierung, deinem technischen Verständnis und deiner Hands-on-Mentalität trägst du täglich dazu bei, dass unsere Gebäude und Infrastrukturen zuverlässig, sicher und professionell betrieben werden.
 Du führst selbstständig Unterhalts-, Reparatur- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten aus und sorgst dafür, dass Gebäude, Anlagen und Einrichtungen jederzeit in einwandfreiem Zustand sind.
 Du bearbeitest Störungsmeldungen und Aufträge im CAFM-System, sowie das Gebäudeleitsystem, insbesondere die Lichtsteuerung. Du holst Offerten ein, koordinierst externe Fachfirmen und begleitest deren Einsätze vor Ort.
 Zudem wirkst du bei der Budgetplanung mit und unterstützt die Erstellung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung des Instandhaltungsplans.
 Du organisierst und begleitest Auf- und Abbauten für Veranstaltungen, berätst Nutzer:innen vor Ort.

 Als wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen Nutzer:innen, Dienstleistern und Fachbereichen stellst du eine effiziente Zusammenarbeit und einen störungsfreien Betrieb sicher.
 Mit der Übernahme von Schichtdiensten gemäss der Öffnungszeiten der Gebäude gewährleistest du den zuverlässigen Betrieb bei Bedarf auch ausserhalb der regulären Arbeitszeiten sowie Stellvertretungen im Wochenenddienst.

 In einer offenen, inspirierenden Atmosphäre bilden Vertrauen, Verlässlichkeit und gegenseitiger Respekt das Fundament unserer Zusammenarbeit. items.desc:
Role highlights: 
 Title: AIT Engineer - Electronics
 Department: Global Manufacturing Organisation
 Location: Greece
 Reporting to: AIT Engineering Team Leader
 Type of Contract: Permanent
 Working model: On-site (occasional travel for environmental test and launch campaigns)
 Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required). 
 Why this role matters: 
 The Electronics AIT Engineer transforms satellite electrical designs into reliable, flight-ready hardware. You are the technical authority for electrical and electronic hardware in Athens: how the satellite is wired and connected, what proves it works, and what evidence exists that every build was done correctly.
 You own the integration readiness of the electrical subsystems, define the AIT processes, test means and ground support equipment the facilities need, and make sure the design, the processes and the tooling can carry production to high throughput. You also feed what you learn on the floor back into design, so that each build is more manufacturable, more testable and more reliable than the last.
 Who We Are 
 ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.
 ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system. ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future. Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
 Your day-to-day responsibilities 
 AIT Process Definition and Industrialisation 
 Define the electrical MAITE processes for building sub-assemblies and satellites: integration flows, standard sequences, work packages and test strategy.
 Qualify the critical electrical integration and test processes, and define the acceptance criteria and standardised procedures that go with them.
 Specify the test means, tooling and workstations each process needs, anticipating them ahead of programme milestones, and lead the transfer from prototype to series so that processes and tooling can carry production to high throughput.
 Design Maturity and Co-Engineering 
 Work with Engineering from the concept phase so that design and production constraints are aligned, applying design for manufacturing, assembly and testability (DFM, DFA, DFT) and bringing harness routing, connector access, test points and diagnostic provisions into internal design iterations before the design is frozen.
 Support internal and supplier design and readiness reviews (e.g. PDR, CDR, PRR, IRR, TRR), ensuring designs are mature and ready for transition into production, and identify industrial risks early with the action plans that close them.
 Electrical Integration and Assembly 
 Own the integration readiness of the satellite electrical subsystems, including avionics, power, data handling and communications.
 Lead and execute electrical integration of satellites and sub-assemblies: harness routing and connection, electrical and RF connections, connector handling, grounding and bonding.
 Own the electrical build standard, including crimping and soldering practice, connector identification, continuity and insulation verification, cleanliness and ESD discipline.
 Perform and oversee in-house PCB assembly and rework according to defined work packages and workmanship standards.
 Verify electronic assemblies before integration and support the floor hands-on during build, connection and test setup.
 Functional and Environmental Test 
 Plan, prepare and lead functional, interface and performance test campaigns at subsystem and satellite level, and support the electrical side of environmental campaigns including EMC, thermal vacuum and vibration.
 Develop and maintain automated and semi-automated test scripts, and monitor telemetry and telecommand during test execution.
 Act as first responder for electrical anomalies during integration and test, performing initial diagnosis with laboratory instruments and taking findings to root cause.
 Electrical Ground Support Equipment 
 Specify, design, procure and validate Electrical Ground Support Equipment and flatsat configurations required for functional and environmental testing.
 Define the setup, configuration and validation requirements for EGSE, and verify it before use on flight hardware.
 Supplier Parts and Electronic Assemblies 
 Act as the technical authority for electronic parts and assemblies from suppliers, covering capability assessment, special process review …

 Why this role matters
 As an EHS Specialist, you will take on a brand new role at the heart of ICEYE's new facility in the Netherlands, a site we are building from the ground up. As the standalone EHS Specialist on site, you will have a rare chance to set up our Environment, Health & Safety programs from day one: keeping our people safe, our operations compliant, and building a strong safety culture as the team and operations scale. You will work hands-on, in close cooperation with local leadership and global EHS management.
 Who we are
 ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.
 ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.
 ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.
 Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
 Your day-to-day responsibilities 
 Compliance and governance 
 Ensure the facility complies with local, national and international EHS regulations
 Maintain and update local EHS policies, procedures and standards
 Manage permits, licences and regulatory reporting requirements
 Support environmental permit compliance and audits
 Risk prevention and incident management 
 Conduct regular workplace inspections, hazard identification and risk assessments in line with global practices
 Lead incident investigations and root cause analyses, and follow up on corrective and preventive actions
 Maintain accurate records of near-misses, incidents, injuries and environmental events
 Report EHS metrics and KPIs to management on a regular basis
 Environmental and contractor management 
 Monitor and manage waste, emissions, water and energy consumption
 Coordinate with contractors and vendors to ensure EHS requirements are met on site
 People, culture and emergency readiness 
 Develop and deliver EHS training programmes for employees at all levels
 Coach supervisors and team leaders on their EHS responsibilities and best practices
 Drive local safety culture initiatives
 Represent the Netherlands in ICEYE's Global OHS Network
 Maintain and test emergency response plans and procedures
 Coordinate fire drills, evacuation exercises and first aid and emergency response teams
 What we're looking for 
 Must haves: 
 Bachelor's or master's degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering or a related field
 5+ years of EHS experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment
 Solid working knowledge of Dutch EHS legislation and regulatory frameworks
 Proficiency in EHS management systems (ISO 45001 and ISO 14001) and data reporting tools
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including root cause analysis methods such as 5-Why or fishbone
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
 Organised and detail-oriented, able to manage multiple priorities at once

 Experience in the ramp-up of new facilities or operations

 Experience working with contractors and managing permit-to-work systems

 Final Interview

As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

La sua formazione sarà continua attraverso corsi, certificazioni e partecipazione a conferenze del settore e con la possibilità di specializzazione nell’intersezione tra AI e Cybersecurity, un ambito in forte crescita e ad alto valore. Qualifiche richieste: Laurea in discipline STEM (Ingegneria Informatica, Informatica o affini) con specializzazione in Intelligenza Artificiale. items.desc: Our Purpose At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here. About Us SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters. Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity. What Are We Looking For? We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes. As a Professional Services Architect (AI SIEM & Hyperautomation), you will be tasked with designing and implementing effective security data and automation solutions for complex customer environments, drawing on strong SIEM and SOAR expertise and strong hands-on delivery experience. This is a hands-on, customer- and partner-facing technical role, and you will collaborate with partners and customers throughout the pre-sale to deployment lifecycle. You are not a people manager, and you are not primarily pre-sales; you are a skilled technical practitioner who brings technical credibility, clear communication, and a consultative approach to every engagement you lead. You will work effectively alongside partners, including MSSPs, system integrators, and resellers, providing direct technical guidance and contributing to the partner's ability to deliver independently over time. What Will You Do? Primary responsibilities include: Serve as the go-to expert on SentinelOne AI SIEM & Hyperautomation internally and with partners and customers; maintain a deep, up-to-date understanding of product architecture, integrations, use cases, and deployment models; stay informed on evolving threat landscapes, industry trends, and competing technologies to guide best practices. Participate in technical discovery and requirements analysis for customer engagements, contributing to solution designs and implementation approaches that address each customer's security objectives and technical constraints. Support pre-sales and post-sales efforts, including scoping, architecture design, RFP responses, SOW development, and technical deep dives. Support new and strategic delivery partners during their initial onboarding projects to build partner competence and assess their readiness to work independently; work alongside channel delivery partners, providing direct technical guidance during joint customer engagements to ensure implementations are executed to the agreed standard. Provide strategic advisory services on risk mitigation, compliance alignment, and solution optimization. items.desc: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. We also support broader business initiatives, including partnership integrations , accountant tools , referral systems , and brand campaigns that strengthen Alan's market position. items.desc: Chez Bouygues Construction, nous sommes 35 600 collaborateurs à travers le monde, tous animés par la plus grande et la plus enthousiasmante des responsabilités : bâtir pour la vie. Pour nos clients, dans plus de 80 pays, nous réalisons bien plus que des ouvrages. Nous bâtissons pour créer des lieux, des liens et des opportunités. Nous améliorons ainsi le quotidien de millions de personnes en réalisant des ouvrages qui accueillent la vie dans toute sa diversité, au service de tous nos besoins : logement, santé, éducation, travail, tourisme, loisirs, services publics, etc. Bouygues Construction IT est la Direction des Systèmes d'Information (DSI) de Bouygues Construction. Nous accompagnons les différentes entités du Groupe Bouygues Construction, en répondant aux besoins digitaux des secteurs de la construction et des fonctions supports. Nous soutenons les métiers opérationnels et fonctionnels dans la mise en œuvre de la digitalisation des processus, en France et à l’International. Au sein de l’équipe en charge de l’IA du Groupe, l’Architecte IA / AI Platform Engineer assure l’accompagnement technique et contribue à la co-construction de la plateforme IA mutualisée. Cette plateforme doit permettre aux équipes de concevoir, déployer, exploiter et faire évoluer des solutions d’intelligence artificielle, qu’elles reposent sur le machine learning, le deep learning, l’IA générative ou des systèmes agentiques. À la croisée de l’architecture, de l’ingénierie de plateforme et du développement produit, il ou elle travaille avec les équipes infrastructure, sécurité, data, métiers et les partenaires de delivery. Son objectif est de mettre à leur disposition un socle partagé, sécurisé et industrialisé, adapté à la diversité des usages et des niveaux d’autonomie des équipes. Missions principales : Architecture et co-construction de la plateforme IA Concevoir et faire évoluer l’architecture de la plateforme IA mutualisée, en lien avec les parties prenantes techniques et métiers. Identifier, assembler et développer les composants et services communs nécessaires aux différents usages : accès aux modèles, environnements d’exécution, gestion des données et des contextes, outils, interfaces et services partagés. Contribuer aux choix technologiques et aux arbitrages entre solutions managées et auto-hébergées, au regard des besoins, de la sécurité, des coûts et des contraintes d’exploitation. Ingénierie agentique et intégration au système d’information Concevoir et développer les capacités permettant de créer, exécuter et superviser des agents IA : orchestration, accès aux modèles et aux outils, gestion du contexte et garde-fous. Favoriser l’interopérabilité des agents entre eux et avec le SI, notamment au moyen d’API et de standards tels que MCP et A2A. Contribuer à la réalisation de cas d’usage de bout en bout, des services IA aux interfaces métiers, afin de valider et d’améliorer les capacités de la plateforme. Sécurité, exploitation et gouvernance technique Intégrer les exigences de sécurité, de protection des données, de souveraineté et de conformité, notamment en lien avec le RGPD et l’EU AI Act. Contribuer à l’évolution de l’AI Gateway Gravitee pour sécuriser et piloter les accès aux modèles et aux outils : routage, quotas, traçabilité et maîtrise des coûts. Mettre en place l’observabilité, l’évaluation et les mécanismes de contrôle des services et flux IA, en s’appuyant sur les standards et outils adaptés. Participer à la définition des architectures d’identité et d’habilitation des agents et des services, en cohérence avec les principes de sécurité du Groupe. Compétences techniques indispensables : Développement Full-Stack : Maîtrise de Java pour les back-ends robustes et de React pour les interfaces interactives. Maîtrise de Python pour l'écosystème IA. IA & Agentique : Architectures multi-agents, function calling, RAG, intégration MCP (Model Context Protocol). Cloud & DevOps : Azure, AWS, GCP, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Terraform, patterns de résilience (circuit breaker, fallback). Sécurité : Gestion des identités machines, conformité RGPD / EU AI Act. Engagés pour la diversité, nous accueillons et valorisons tous les Talents.

DEKRA recherche son/sa futur/e Senior DevOps Engineer pour rejoindre son équipe Plateformes. Au sein d'un environnement technique innovant et en forte évolution, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la conception, l'automatisation et l'industrialisation de notre Internal Developer Platform (IDP). Votre mission consistera à fournir aux équipes de développement des outils et services permettant de déployer, exploiter et superviser leurs applications de manière sécurisée, standardisée et performante. Votre rôle : En tant que Senior DevOps Engineer, vos principales missions seront : Concevoir, déployer et faire évoluer les composants de l'Internal Developer Platform ; Automatiser l'infrastructure et les services à l'aide des principes Infrastructure as Code ; Industrialiser les processus de déploiement et d'exploitation via les chaînes CI/CD ; Accompagner les équipes produit dans l'adoption des bonnes pratiques DevOps et Cloud Native ; Garantir la fiabilité, la sécurité et la scalabilité des plateformes ; Participer à la définition et à l'amélioration continue des standards techniques ; Rédiger la documentation technique et assurer le partage de connaissances auprès des équipes ; Assurer une veille technologique sur les domaines Cloud, DevOps et Platform Engineering. Vous aussi, vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise engagée et contribuer à construire les plateformes de demain ? Depuis plus de 100 ans, DEKRA œuvre pour un monde plus sûr et plus durable. Rejoignez-nous et participez activement à cette mission. Le profil recherché Chez DEKRA, nous recherchons avant tout des professionnels passionnés, rigoureux et engagés, capables d'évoluer dans des environnements techniques complexes tout en favorisant la collaboration entre les équipes. Votre savoir-être Rigoureux/se, autonome et orienté/e résultats ; Doté/e d'un excellent esprit d'équipe et d'un sens du service développé ; Curieux/se, force de proposition et animé/e par l'amélioration continue ; Capable de vulgariser des sujets techniques et d'accompagner les équipes dans leur montée en compétences ; À l'aise dans les environnements dynamiques et en constante évolution. Votre savoir-faire Titulaire d'un diplôme Bac+3 à Bac+5 en Informatique, Génie Logiciel ou équivalent ; Vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en DevOps ou Platform Engineering au sein d'environnements de production ; Vous possédez une solide maîtrise d'un cloud public majeur (Azure, AWS ou GCP) ; Vous disposez d'une expérience significative sur Kubernetes et Docker ; Vous maîtrisez les pratiques d'Infrastructure as Code, notamment avec Terraform ; Vous possédez de bonnes compétences en scripting (Python, Go ou Bash) ; Vous avez une expérience confirmée des outils CI/CD modernes tels que GitLab CI, GitHub Actions ou Jenkins ; Vous savez produire une documentation technique claire et accompagner les équipes utilisatrices ; Vous disposez d'un niveau d'anglais professionnel, à l'écrit comme à l'oral (B2/C1). Quel que soit votre âge, genre, couleur de peau, origine sociale, religion, situation de handicap ou orientation sexuelle, chez DEKRA, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité dans nos équipes est l'une de nos forces. Nous nous engageons à étudier chaque candidature avec la même considération. DAS SHS IT en quelques mots DAS SHS IT DEKRA est un groupe d'origine allemande, fondé en 1925, qui compte plus de 48 000 collaborateurs dans le monde. DEKRA est l'un des leaders mondiaux de l'inspection, de la certification, des services et de la gestion des sinistres, dans les secteurs de l'automobile, du transport et de l'industrie. DEKRA est organisée sous la forme d'une association (DEKRA e.V.), ce qui confère à ses actions une certaine indépendance et renforce son engagement durable en faveur de la sécurité et de la prévention. Guidé par des valeurs fortes — esprit d'équipe, prévention, sens client, esprit d'entreprise et intégrité — DEKRA agit au service de la sécurité des biens et des personnes. Dès votre intégration, vous serez sensibilisé à ces enjeux, au cœur de notre mission. items.desc: Job Description: To support Airbus Defence and Space we are looking for a Cyber Security Hardware Architect (d/m/w). Airbus DS is seeking a highly skilled Cyber Security Hardware Architect (d/m/w) to design, develop, and implement secure hardware solutions for our critical aerospace systems. This role is crucial in safeguarding our products against evolving cyber threats, ensuring the integrity and reliability of our cutting-edge technology. This role is also possible with reduced weekly working hours and an adapted scope of duties. Your Location Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Do you enjoy sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg can be reached within an hour and offer a wide variety of leisure activities. Our Benefits for You Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, e.g., company pension schemes, mobility offers (such as bicycle leasing), or employee discounts at cooperating companies in accordance with our respective valid guidelines. Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave according to the collective bargaining agreement (35h/week); work-life balance (flextime, mobile working, part-time, job sharing, sabbatical) Advancement Made Easy: Excellent training opportunities and international, group-wide development perspectives Well-being at the Workplace: Company doctor; comprehensive health offerings (sports courses, preventive care, and much more), canteen and cafeteria, partly on-site kindergarten Diversity Connects: Working in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, support, and diversity are lived Your Tasks and Responsibilities Define and develop robust cyber security architectures for hardware components and systems across various Airbus products. Conduct threat modeling, risk assessments, and vulnerability analysis of hardware designs and implementations. Specify and select secure hardware components, cryptographic modules, and security mechanisms. Collaborate with hardware design, software development, and system integration teams to embed security by design principles. Develop and implement security requirements, guidelines, and best practices for the hardware development lifecycle. Perform security reviews and audits of hardware designs, schematics, and layouts. Stay abreast of the latest hardware security vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and countermeasures. Contribute to the research and development of innovative hardware security solutions and technologies. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers on hardware security topics. Desired Skills and Qualifications Master's degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Cyber Security, or a related field. Proven experience (5+ years) in hardware security architecture, design, and implementation. In-depth knowledge of hardware security principles, secure boot processes, trusted execution environments (TEE), and cryptographic hardware. Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to hardware security (e.g., NIST, Common Criteria). Experience with hardware description languages (VHDL, Verilog) and FPGA/ASIC design. Strong understanding of embedded systems security and real-time operating systems. Knowledge of the Space and Aerospace domain, preferably having worked in the secure architecture of aerospace projects. Fluency in English is required; German or French is a plus. Not a 100% match? items.desc: Who/What is Artefact? Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact. With 2,000+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 26 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L'Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. At our German offices, we are on a rapid growth trajectory, advising leading national and international clients cross-industry on how to unlock the full potential of their data, build scalable data architectures, and implement cutting-edge AI solutions. As a Senior AI Strategist (m/f/d) , you will sit at the center of this mission. You won't just deliver static slides; you will bridge the gap between technical possibilities and business imperatives, guiding clients from a focused short-term engagement with Mittelstand manufacturers to multi-phase AI transformations with enterprises. In this role, you will take ownership of cross-functional workstreams, drive data-driven decision-making, and actively shape the digital future of our clients. What you will do: Client advisory & strategy: Work closely with (international) clients to understand their business needs and translate them into data-driven recommendations that support strategic decision-making and business transformation. Data & analysis: Collect, synthesise and iterate data to create actionable insights. You work with a modern, AI-native toolstack - from LLM-powered environments (e.g. Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) and agentic workflow tools (e.g. n8n, Lovable) to coding assistants and automation platforms - and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Familiarity with SQL or Python remains a plus, but the ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis and delivery is what we value most. Project delivery: Take ownership of project workstreams and ensure high-quality, timely delivery in alignment with overall project goals. Work collaboratively within interdisciplinary teams across consulting, data, and tech functions. Data & AI solutions: Support the development of data strategies, AI use cases, and business intelligence solutions, contributing to governance frameworks and implementation roadmaps where relevant. Knowledge sharing & collaboration: Contribute to a strong team culture by sharing knowledge, staying up to date with digital and AI trends, and supporting continuous team development. Business development & thought leadership: Actively contribute to Artefact's growth in Germany - supporting client proposals, shaping new service offerings, and creating intellectual capital such as frameworks, point-of-views, and benchmarks that strengthen our market position. Candidate Profile At our heart, we define ourselves by a culture of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and cooperation. We are looking for driven, capable talents who bring strong motivation and curiosity for new challenges. Experience: You have at least 2–3 years of experience in management consulting, technology consulting, or in-house corporate strategy roles, with a proven track record of participating in data/AI strategy, cloud transformation, or applied AI/Machine Learning projects. Education: A completed university degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Business Administration, Economics, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Physics, Mathematics, or a comparable quantitative field. Data & AI Fluency: You possess a strong affinity for data management and modern AI technologies. You are familiar with concepts like Generative AI, LLMs, or predictive analytics and are eager to bridge the gap between business needs and AI deployment. Ideally, you have hands-on experience in AI use case conceptualization or data platform tracking. Business & analytical mindset: You combine strong analytical skills with a business-oriented perspective. You enjoy identifying business problems and translating them into practical AI and data-driven solutions. Technical skills: You are confident working with PowerPoint and Google Slides to produce polished client-ready output. More importantly, you know how to leverage AI tools - from LLM environments to agentic workflows - to run analysis, generate insights, and accelerate delivery. Experience with SQL, BI tools, or programming languages is not a requirement, but comfort with structured data and a hands-on attitude toward new tools is expected. Communication & collaboration: You communicate complex technical topics clearly in both German and English. You enjoy working in interdisciplinary teams and collaborating across different levels and functions (e.g., translating requirements between business stakeholders and data scientists). items.desc: Sviluppatore Full-Stack (Django + React Native) – Tempo pieno, remoto dopo un onboarding a Firenze Outdoora è una startup che organizza tour in bici auto-guidati. I clienti prenotano un'esperienza, ritirano la bici presso uno dei nostri partner e partono con la nostra app, che li guida lungo il percorso con navigazione GPS vocale. Il prodotto è composto da tre parti: App mobile per i ciclisti: navigazione, attivazione del tour, contenuti lungo il percorso Pannello admin per gestire tour, prenotazioni e partner Portale partner per i noleggi e i negozi che consegnano le bici Le prenotazioni arrivano anche da piattaforme come GetYourGuide e Viator, integrate tramite Bókun. IL RUOLO Cerchiamo uno sviluppatore o una sviluppatrice full-stack che entri a tempo pieno nel team tecnico e ci aiuti a far crescere la piattaforma. Non cerchiamo un aiuto temporaneo: vogliamo una persona che cresca con noi nel lungo periodo e che abbia un ruolo centrale nelle scelte tecniche. Nel quotidiano ti occuperai di: sviluppare nuove funzionalità e risolvere bug su backend, app e portale progettare e realizzare in autonomia funzionalità complete, dall'analisi al rilascio mantenere e migliorare le integrazioni con i sistemi di prenotazione partecipare alla code review, alla pianificazione e alle decisioni sull'architettura I progetti dei prossimi mesi: un sistema intelligente di gestione delle prenotazioni, che smista ogni richiesta al partner giusto in base a disponibilità e zona l'automazione delle prenotazioni presso i partner, per esempio la prenotazione delle bici a seguito di un ordine agenti AI di assistenza clienti, che rispondono alle domande più frequenti prima e durante il tour la creazione automatica dei tour a partire dalle tracce GPS, e la generazione delle tracce stesse con l'aiuto dell'AI ONBOARDING A FIRENZE Per i primi 2-3 mesi lavorerai in presenza nel nostro ufficio di Firenze, insieme al team. È il modo migliore per conoscere il prodotto, le persone e il nostro modo di lavorare. Ti aiuteremo a trovare una soluzione abitativa per questo periodo. Dopo l'onboarding, il lavoro prosegue full remote. COSA CERCHIAMO Requisiti: laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica o in un ambito affine almeno 3 anni di esperienza professionale come sviluppatore, su prodotti reali in produzione esperienza concreta con Python e Django (modelli, API REST, Django admin) esperienza concreta con React Native, con app pubblicate su iOS e Android esperienza nello sviluppo di funzionalità basate su AI generativa: integrazione di LLM e delle loro API, agenti AI, RAG o strumenti simili uso quotidiano di Git, con pull request e code review capacità di lavorare in autonomia da remoto e di comunicare in modo chiaro ottima conoscenza dell'italiano e buona conoscenza dell'inglese tecnico disponibilità a lavorare in presenza a Firenze per i primi 2-3 mesi Costituiscono un plus: esperienza con React e Next.js esperienza con mappe e dati geografici (Mapbox, tracce GPX, GPS) conoscenza di Material UI, AWS (S3) e Heroku integrazioni con API di terze parti, pagamenti (Stripe) o sistemi di prenotazione passione per la bici e il turismo outdoor COSA OFFRIAMO Contratto di lavoro dipendente a tempo pieno, a tempo determinato di 12 mesi, con la prospettiva concreta di una stabilizzazione Retribuzione commisurata all'esperienza, da definire in fase di colloquio I primi 2-3 mesi in presenza a Firenze, con il nostro supporto nella ricerca di un alloggio; poi full remote, con orari flessibili Un prodotto reale, già usato dai clienti, e la possibilità di guidare lo sviluppo dei nuovi progetti di AI Un team piccolo, con contatto diretto con i founder e un impatto concreto sulle decisioni tecniche COME CANDIDARSI Candidati tramite Indeed oppure scrivi a info@outdoora.app, con oggetto "Candidatura Sviluppatore Full-Stack", inviando: il tuo CV il link al tuo profilo GitHub o ai progetti su cui hai lavorato, in particolare con Django, React Native e AI qualche riga su di te e su quando potresti iniziare La selezione prevede un colloquio conoscitivo, un colloquio tecnico e una prova pratica simile al lavoro che svolgerai con noi, della durata massima di 2 ore. Annuncio rivolto a candidati di entrambi i sessi (L. 903/77 e D.Lgs. 198/2006). Sede di lavoro: Firenze per i primi 2-3 mesi, poi da remoto. Retribuzione: €32.000,00 - €45.000,00 all'anno Sede di lavoro: Ibrido/da remoto (Firenze, Toscana)

items.desc: About the Company G.D is a leading organization headquartered in Bologna, Italy. As a key player in high-tech machinery production, we specialize in cutting-edge technologies that shape the future of industrial automation. Our business portfolio encompasses a wide range of innovative making and packing solutions, in particular for Modern Oral and Next Generation products. We strive to continuously expand our offerings and enhance our capabilities to meet the evolving needs of our customers. For more detailed information about G.D and its comprehensive business landscape, please visit www.gidi.it. G.D is part of Coesia, a group of innovation-based industrial and packaging solutions companies operating globally, headquartered in Bologna, Italy. Coesia operates in 34 countries with 21 different companies and employs over 8,000 people as of 2026. About the Role We are looking for a Mechanical Designer to join our Machine Management team, a central engineering team based at our Bologna site. The role supports the performance and evolution of automatic machines throughout their lifecycle, combining mechanical design with technical analysis, troubleshooting and the management of machine modifications. Working across multiple projects and technical areas, the successful candidate will collaborate closely with different functions and stakeholders, while also coordinating dedicated external resources. Key Responsibilities Analyze technical issues (QN) arising during machine assembly and operation, identifying their root causes through structured investigation. Define practical and technically sound solutions through troubleshooting, root cause analysis and problem-solving activities. Modify existing machine assemblies and mechanical components according to technical, safety and production requirements. Design or redesign mechanical components and small machine assemblies when changes require a new or substantially revised solution. Assess alternative commercial components and verify their technical suitability, integration impact and lifecycle implications (OBS). Support the Assembly team in implementing, testing and completing ongoing machine modifications. Collaborate continuously with Assembly, Purchasing and Engineering to align technical decisions, priorities and implementation plans. Coordinate with dedicated external designers, ensuring the quality and timely completion of assigned activities. What You Need to Be Successful Technical diploma (ITIS) or ITS Maker qualification 5 to 10 years of experience in mechanical design, preferably within the automatic machinery industry. Strong knowledge of mechanical solutions, machine components, and standard commercially available components, combined with a solid understanding of project lifecycle management. Proficiency in parametric mechanical design tools; knowledge of Creo or comparable CAD software is considered an advantage. Good command of Microsoft Office; knowledge of SAP and Oracle is an advantage English proficiency at B2 level Analytical, precise and practical approach, with strong problem-solving skills; collaborative, flexible and curious mindset, with effective communication and openness to constructive dialogue. Our Offer Compensation for this role includes a base salary starting from EUR 40000 in line with experience. The actual offer may exceed this minimum based on the candidate's qualifications and fit for the role. A range of additional benefits (e.g., insurances, etc.) is also available in accordance with Company policy. The applicable collective agreement is the CCNL Metalmeccanico. Join the Team! Coesia is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in fair, merit-based recruitment and assess all candidates exclusively on the basis of their qualifications, skills, experience and suitability for the role. Job Reference: CGS13537

items.desc: As a Reporting Expert , you will represent NN's Polish entities in the Core Finance & Architecture Program. The program is creating a shared finance environment across the NN Group based on SAP, standardizing processes, data, and reporting. You will combine your expertise in accounting and reporting with shaping the future finance operating model. Your impact at NN: what you will do You will join the Foundation phase as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in the areas of accounting, tax, statutory and regulatory reporting, and consolidation. You will help create the Global Design Solution, a shared model for processes, data, and reporting, ensuring that Polish legal, regulatory, and business requirements, as well as local and Group reporting needs, are reflected in the future solution. Key responsibilities: Represent NN's Polish entities in international project workshops, solution design sessions, and working groups. Identify local requirements for life and non-life insurance entities, pension fund management companies, and service entities, and ensure they are reflected in the Global Design Solution. Co-design finance processes, data models, and SAP business requirements that support high-quality local and Group reporting. Analyze gaps between the current and target operating model and assess the impact of proposed solutions on Polish processes and regulatory requirements. Participate in the configuration, testing, and validation of solutions during the Foundation and Build phases, including preparing data, test scenarios, and acceptance criteria. Ensure compliance with accounting standards, solvency requirements, tax regulations, and other local legal requirements. Support standardization based on the "design once, deploy many" principle and recommend improvements and automation opportunities. Who you will work with You will collaborate with subject matter experts from NN's Polish entities, as well as Finance, IT, and Data teams, and experts from other NN Group countries. In this role, independence, strong organizational skills, a proactive mindset, and the ability to synthesize information and communicate effectively within a project environment are key to success. What we offer: A modern office in Warsaw's Powiśle district and a flexible hybrid working model. Private medical care, insurance, and benefits available through our cafeteria platform. A comprehensive onboarding program and employee referral program. Opportunities for professional development within NN and across the NN Group, including access to a learning platform. Diversity and inclusion initiatives, sports activities, and a volunteering day. Additional paid paternity leave and attractive discounts on products and services offered by our partners. Participation in one of the largest finance transformation initiatives within the NN Group and the opportunity to help shape the future global finance model. Collaboration with international experts across Finance, IT, and Architecture. A real impact on the future of NN's finance processes, reporting, and finance architecture. Development opportunities in SAP, data management, and modern finance solutions. Experience at the intersection of finance, technology, and organizational transformation. Who we are looking for: At least 5 years of experience in financial accounting, statutory reporting, regulatory reporting, or consolidation within the insurance sector (mandatory requirement). Strong knowledge of General Ledger processes, including month-end and year-end closing activities. Experience in preparing financial statements in accordance with Polish and international accounting standards, as well as Solvency II reporting requirements. Ability to analyze business processes and define business requirements. Experience in projects or transformation initiatives will be considered an advantage. Excellent command of English and confidence working in an international environment. Ability to synthesize information, prepare materials, and communicate effectively within a project environment. A self-driven approach, strong organizational skills, and a proactive mindset. You are interested in a project-based role with an initial duration of approximately 12 months, with the possibility of extension depending on project needs and business requirements. Don't meet all the requirements 100%? We still encourage you to apply. We'd love to learn more about your strengths, skills, and perspective. Join the people who help keep NN running smoothly Has this opportunity caught your interest? Would you like to develop your career within the NN Group finance environment? We encourage you to apply. We would love to learn what motivates you and discover the experience and skills you can bring to our organization.

Strong understanding of testing probabilistic systems, large language models, prompt engineering, and dialogue flow validation. Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) focusing on Logs Explorer, BigQuery, and PostgreSQL. Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or Bruno. items.desc: Clue is growing! We are now hiring a Hardware Engineer ➪ About Clue At Clue, we research, design, and manufacture new computing technologies to enable innovative intelligent systems. Our motto is to create simple solutions to big problems. Clue focuses on next-generation avionics, offering a series of general-purpose computers for aerospace systems based on modular and flexible architecture. We also develop machine-learning applications especially built to run in our airborne hardware. The development of Systems on Chips (SoC) and ASICs for safety-critical applications is part of our roadmap as well. Clue is not only a company where you will fulfill your innovation appetite but it is also a company with a unique work environment. It is not common to find many companies with a fresh mentality like Clue has, where continuous improvement is part of our DNA. Furthermore, employee satisfaction is the cornerstone of our talent retention strategy. Training programs, personalized strategies to always maintain a high level of motivation among our employees, schedule and work location flexibility, charming work sites, healthy and delicious meal service, team building activities, BBQ gatherings… you name it! Our employees are our biggest asset and we have the strong conviction that their satisfaction is paramount for the productivity within our company. Thus, at Clue we are more than happy to invest in the well-being of our employees. We know that choosing the next step in your career is not always easy, everyone has doubts when it comes to starting a new job. So, we encourage you to apply to this position and come and meet us to see with your own eyes how there really is something special about Clue that will reassure your interest in becoming a Cluer ! ➪ What is the job about? The main responsibility of the Hardware Electronic Engineer is the research, design, and development of electronic devices for aviation applications. The Hardware Electronic Engineer works in the HW team within the R&D department in a cross-disciplinary and international environment. What will you do? Plan, document and develop new hardware items from the initial specification and requirements through prototypes to production series. Analyze the current state-of-the-art technologies. Perform analysis, simulations, and design justifications for the technical architecture proposals. Design, validate and verify the hardware developments. Schematic capture PCB layout design (Support to PCB designer or own layout) Technical documentation Design requirements and test cases Support to system definition Support to regulatory and safety certification ➪ What profile are we looking for? Mandatory: Telecommunications, Industrial, or Electronic Engineering Degree. 5+ years of experience in the design of hardware products, prototyping, and debugging. PCB design over ECAD tools (Altium, Orcad, Mentor…) Electronic simulations (LTSpice, TINA, Saturn…) SoC and FPGA designs (NXP, Xiilink, Intel, Microchip) and High-Speed interface designs. Background in the definition of technical documentation. Background in verification and validation activities. Fluent written in English. You will take technical ownership of some of our larger AI engagements and make sure the solution delivers the outcome the client is paying for. This is not about pilots. You redesign the process. You map how the work gets done today, find where AI creates the most value, and design the new way of working, including where people stay in control. You build. You join sales conversations to scope work realistically and say what is feasible. You bridge ambition and constraints. You turn what marketing and communications leaders want into systems that ship, explain trade-offs in terms they understand, and take part in IT security reviews. You raise the bar. You set technical standards, review the team's work, coach colleagues, and turn what works well into something we can reuse. What good looks like after 12 months You have taken at least two client AI engagements from first workshop to production, with solutions that deliver the outcome agreed with the client Clients trust you enough to involve you early in their next AI decisions You have helped raise the technical quality of the team, with shared standards that others follow Who you are You have spent years in marketing and communications and built the technical depth to put AI to work in it. You have a consultancy mindset. You work directly with clients and colleagues, solve the problem they actually have and turn needs into action. You speak marketing as fluently as you speak tech, and can explain a RAG pipeline to a head of brand and a brand brief to an engineer. You start from the business outcome and the process behind it and work back to the solution. You are ready to challenge how things are done today, and you think in constraints, not just possibilities. You are comfortable with ambiguity and can move without complete information. You care about craft: the agents, prompts and architectures you ship hold a high standard and keep running after the project closes. items.desc: About Nordic Air Defence Nordic Air Defence, headquartered in Stockholm, develops cutting-edge defensive solutions for both civilian and military applications. We combine expertise in electronics, mechanical design, embedded systems, software engineering, and AI. In September 2024, Nordic Air Defence unveiled its first product, the Kreuger 100, a dual-use drone-interceptor platform engineered in Sweden by a diverse, international team. Today, our employees represent more than 20 nationalities, creating a dynamic and collaborative environment where different perspectives drive innovation. Our engineers and operators bring experience from leading defence, drone, and technology organisations worldwide, including Palantir, Kratos, SAAB, Anduril, and others. The Role As a Electrical Engineer at Nordic Air Defence, you will be responsible for the design and development of low-latency analog sensor systems. You will interface with our other engineers across embedded software engineering, mechanical design, aerospace engineering to build customer-ready additions to our K200 flight vehicle. Responsibilities Design and implement high-speed analog amplifiers and filters. Develop and test new analog sensing technology for the “seeker” of the K200 flight vehicle. Work together with our supply-chain team to have your designs manufactured, shipped, tested. Validate and prove the efficacy of your designs in simulation environments and on the lab bench. Participate in real-world flight demonstrations of your work. Overall system design to ensure good EMI performance. Requirements (Required) Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, or related field. A PhD is considered a plus. 5+ years experience with optoelectronics, RF, RADAR, or LiDAR. Familiarity with using simulation tools (i.e. AWR Microwave Office, LTSpice). Proven experience the design and building of sophisticated analog circuitry. Strong understanding of signal processing both in the analog and digital domains. Experience designing and manufacturing PCBs using Altium, Eagle, KiCAD or similar. Knowledge and experience in designing for environmental constraints (temperature, humidity, and vibration). Ownership of your work from start to finish. Fluency in English, both written and oral. Exceptional organization and communication skills (both written and oral). Requirements (Nice-to-have) Experience in autonomous systems or drones. Experience from the defence or aerospace industry. Familiarity liaising with mechanical design teams to fit your circuit designs in a variety of physical spaces. Experience working in a startup environment. Experience building products using a NATO supply chain. Proficiency in MATLAB, Python, or C++ for algorithm development. Antenna design experience. A bit about us • At Gamma we provide voice, data, and mobile solutions to businesses across the UK, Germany, Spain, and the Benelux region. Our people are at the heart of everything we do. When you join us, you’ll be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team that’s transforming how businesses connect and communicate globally. We’re growing fast, but we never lose sight of what matters: our people. Whether you're looking to develop your skills, take on new challenges, or make a meaningful impact, Gamma is the place to do it. Gamma Enterprise Gamma Enterprise designs, builds and runs secure networking, cyber, collaboration and customer experience solutions for large corporate and public-sector organisations. We hold Cisco Powered Service designations for Security and SD-WAN, work alongside leading partners including Palo Alto Networks and Microsoft, and back everything with UK-based, 24x7 support. Our Customer Solutions team is where it all starts: we sit with customers, cut through complexity and design solutions that deliver real operational and commercial value. Networks have changed. Users, apps and data are everywhere, AI is reshaping the threat landscape on both sides, and quantum computing has put today’s encryption on a countdown clock. We’re looking for a network security architect who wants to be at the sharp end of that shift – designing the secure networks that keep large organisations protected and open for business. What is the role responsible for? As our Solutions Architect – Network Security, you’ll be the go-to security mind in front of enterprise and public-sector customers. You’ll own the security architecture on strategic deals, turning boardroom concerns about risk, resilience and compliance into practical, commercially sharp designs. Your specialism is network security: Security Service Edge (SSE) and SASE, Zero Trust access, next-generation firewalling and segmentation, built on Cisco, Palo Alto Networks and Microsoft. You’ll go deep in at least one, and be confident designing integrated, multi-vendor solutions across all three. You’ll also help customers get ahead of what’s next – securing how their organisation uses AI, using AI to strengthen detection and response, and building a credible path to post-quantum cryptography. Working alongside Direct Sales, Lead Solutions Architects, Solutions Consultants and our Secure Managed Networks specialists, you’ll shape the opportunity, lead the technical story and stay with the solution all the way to a clean handover into delivery. What will you be doing day-to-day? Lead discovery workshops with CISOs, IT leaders and network teams to uncover technical, operational, security, compliance and commercial requirements. SSE and SASE: design architectures spanning secure web gateway, CASB, ZTNA, firewall-as-a-service and DLP, using platforms such as Cisco Secure Access, Palo Alto Networks Prisma Access and Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access. Zero Trust networking: bring identity, segmentation, next-generation firewall, threat protection and security monitoring together with SD-WAN, internet, LAN and Wi-Fi into one coherent design. AI security: help customers adopt AI safely – controlling shadow AI and protecting sensitive data flowing into generative AI tools – and show how AI-driven detection and automation strengthen their security operations. Quantum readiness: advise customers on “harvest now, decrypt later” risk, crypto-agility and planning for post-quantum cryptography in line with NCSC guidance. Produce high-quality solution descriptions, high-level designs, bills of materials, assumptions and proposal content that win. Provide technical leadership on major bids and tenders, making sure every solution is deliverable, governed and commercially sound. Present architectures and recommendations with confidence, from engineering teams to the boardroom. Spot design risks, constraints and dependencies early, and take solutions through our technical assurance and approval process. Keep technical ownership throughout the sales lifecycle and deliver a structured, accurate handover into delivery. Feed customer insight and market trends back to Proposition Management to help shape our next generation of security services. Coach and develop colleagues through knowledge sharing, design reviews and hands-on guidance. What you’ll bring: 5+ years in security pre-sales, solution architecture, sales engineering or a similar customer-facing technical role. A strong track record designing enterprise network security solutions and turning customer requirements into effective architectures. Deep expertise in at least one of Cisco, Palo Alto Networks or Microsoft security, with working knowledge of the others and experience integrating multi-vendor solutions. Hands-on understanding of SSE, SASE and Zero Trust – …

items.desc:
About the team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development.



About the role

Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) lead complex end-to-end deployments of frontier models in production alongside our most strategic customers. You will own discovery, technical scoping, system design, build, and production rollout, partnering directly with customer engineering and domain teams.



You will measure success through production adoption, measurable workflow impact, and eval-driven feedback that changes product and model roadmaps. You’ll work closely with our Product, Research, Partnerships, GRC, Security, and GTM teams.



This role is based in Dublin. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required.



In this role you will

 - Own technical delivery across multiple deployments from first prototype to stable production

 - Build full-stack systems that deliver customer value and sharpen how we learn

 - Embed closely with customer teams, understand their needs, and guide adoption of what you build

 - Scope work, sequence delivery, and remove blockers early

 - Make trade-offs between scope, speed, and quality; adjust plans to protect delivery

 - Contribute directly in the code when progress or clarity depends on it

 - Codify working patterns into tools, playbooks, or building blocks that others can use

 - Share field feedback that helps Research and Product understand where the models succeed and where they can improve

 - Keep teams moving through clarity and follow-through



You might thrive in this role if you

 - Bring 5+ years of engineering or technical deployment experience that includes customer-facing work

 - Have scoped and delivered complex systems in fast-moving or ambiguous environments

 - Write and review production-grade code across frontend and backend using Python, JavaScript, or comparable stacks

 - Have built or deployed systems powered by LLMs or generative models and understand how model behaviour affects product experience

 - Simplify complexity and make fast, sound decisions under pressure

 - Communicate clearly with engineers, product teams, and customer stakeholders

 - Spot risks early and adjust without slowing down

 - Model calm and judgment when the stakes are high



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
