items.desc:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.


The Opportunity
 
We are looking for an experienced Robotics Systems Engineer (Mechanical) to join our team of product developers and robot enthusiasts. We build competitive products for our customers, and they depend on tightly integrated, complex mechatronic systems. In this role, you bridge mechanical design and system-level engineering. You own how mechanical subsystems fit into the overall robot architecture, from requirements and interfaces through integration, verification, and field support.
You will work closely with specialists from R&D, electronics, and software development to define, evaluate, integrate, and validate the robotic system across the full product development process. You will also work continuously with our operations team so that system decisions meet product target costs, manufacturability, and quality standards as ONE TEAM. Your work makes our robots more nimble, robust, and user-friendly, and opens new ways to optimize system performance and capabilities. We are passionate about excellent hardware design and system performance at competitive costs.
 
The Impact
 
As a Robotics Systems Engineer (Mechanical), you will play a crucial role in shaping the architecture and design of our future robotic systems. You will turn customer and product needs into system and mechanical requirements, define and manage subsystem interfaces, and drive trade-off decisions on performance, robustness, weight, cost, and serviceability. Your contributions will directly increase the reliability and attractiveness of our products.
With your innovative mindset and industrial experience, you will bring new ideas and methods to how we develop, integrate, and verify our robots. Your hands-on experience with mechatronic systems makes you key to improving and upgrading the robot’s functions. Working alongside our R&D experts, you will strengthen our ability to sustain and continuously improve our product portfolio in the field.
 
 
Market & Our Technology
 
ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sectors by bringing robotics to a wide range of new applications that were previously out of reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LiDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality, consistent inspection results. We develop a wide range of custom hardware in-house, including the complete robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related mechanical hardware, and integrate it into one reliable system.

Your Contributions:
Define system and mechanical requirements from customer needs and use cases
 Shape the system architecture and design integrated mechatronic subsystems
 Define and manage interfaces between platform, actuators, sensors, payloads, and charging systems
 Drive trade-offs on performance, robustness, weight, cost, and serviceability
 Plan and run system integration, verification, and validation

items.desc:
We Are Waiting for You 
 Hi there! 
 I am Álvaro, the recruiter for this position. Nice to meet you! 
 First, a little bit about what I like most about working at Zurich Technology Delivery Center: the environment is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset encourages continuous learning and growth, creating a place where everyone can thrive. I can’t wait to share this opportunity with you. 
 First of all, thank you for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be challenging, but I’ll try to make it easier. 
 Who Are We? 
 Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group, a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to our Technology Delivery Center (TDC). Established in Barcelona in 2006, the TDC operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich’s local and global business units. 
 In essence, Zurich TDC is where technology meets the vast reach of a multinational company. We specialize in areas such as software development, data analytics, cybersecurity and IT infrastructure. Our primary mission is to support Zurich’s strategic goals and enhance operational efficiency through innovative technology solutions. 
 If you’re considering a role with us, know that you’ll be joining a hub of technological excellence dedicated to driving Zurich’s success on a global scale. 
 What Can You Expect? 
 As an Enterprise Office Architect, you will maintain a coherent enterprise architecture direction across Zurich’s federation of Business Units. This role combines disciplined EA Office coordination with credible architectural judgement and is not a purely administrative position. 
 Maintain the enterprise catalogue of architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, patterns and terminology, including approvals, versioning, ownership and review dates. 
 Coordinate the Federation Council calendar, agenda and inputs, prepare decision-ready papers and pre-reads, capture decisions and dependencies, and follow up on actions through to closure. 
 Validate domain strategies, target architectures, roadmaps and proposed standards against enterprise priorities and principles, identifying contradictions, overlaps, omissions and cross-domain impacts. 
 Communicate a consistent enterprise architecture narrative, technology position statements and guidance, clearly distinguishing what is mandatory, recommended or locally discretionary. 
 Identify missing standards, outdated artefacts, unowned capabilities, conflicting positions and cross-domain dependencies, assigning accountable owners, due dates and escalation paths. 
 Maintain a trusted, searchable architecture repository and concise management view covering strategies, standards, roadmaps, decisions, exceptions, ownership and review status. 
 Use approved AI assistants and evidence retrieval to compare artefacts, flag inconsistencies, map strategy to standards, draft communications and assemble council packs and action summaries. 
 Challenge weak evidence, inconsistent definitions and misaligned proposals constructively, recommending resolutions while keeping decision and implementation accountability clear. 
 What Makes You a Great Fit? 
 While we’re not seeking perfection or expecting you to save the world, we believe that if you meet some of these requirements, you’ll be a fantastic fit for our team. We are waiting for you! 
 Experience 10+ years of relevant technology and architecture experience, including enterprise architecture governance, standards management and cross-domain coordination in a complex, federated organisation. 
 Architecture judgement A strong technical architecture foundation across application, cloud, infrastructure, security, identity, data, AI and integration, with the ability to challenge domain proposals and reconcile differing positions. 
 AI fluency Demonstrable use of AI for architecture knowledge retrieval, comparison, gap analysis, reporting and communication, with appropriate source verification, access controls and human accountability. 
 Standards assurance Experience maintaining architecture principles, standards, definitions, reference models and roadmaps with clear ownership, lifecycle controls, change management and exception handling. 
 Coordination Experience facilitating architecture councils or comparable governance forums across Business Units, regions and technical domains, supported by strong writing, presentation and stakeholder skills. 
 Execution A track record of managing decision and action registers, prioritising cross-domain gaps, securing accountable owners and pursuing commitments to evidenced closure. 
 Education A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated environment is preferred; enterprise architecture, governance …

Join our Team
 About this opportunity: 
 If you want to help shape the future of Ericsson by bringing AI into product security verification teams, this could be the role for you.
 Ericsson’s products need to be secure, reliable and ready for the demands of the networks of tomorrow. As a junior developer in the Product Security sector, you will help to drive the integration of AI capabilities into the Vulnerability Analysis (VA) workflow, automating repetitive tasks, improving detection accuracy, and accelerating triage and reporting while maintaining the security posture of the products.
 You’ll collaborate with experienced colleagues across Product Security and verification, learning how complex telecom products are developed and assessed. This is an opportunity to build your skills at the intersection of AI, software engineering and cybersecurity, while contributing to Ericsson’s work on current and future RAN technologies.
 What you will do: 
 As a member of our team, you will strengthen our AI capabilities and support teams in developing AI agents and workflows. You will:
 Identify opportunities to use AI/ML to streamline engineering processes and workflows.
 Prototype and develop AI agents and workflow automations for practical tasks across the engineering lifecycle, from analysis through verification.
 Introduce AI-enabled solutions to verification teams, document AI tools, workflows, and best practices for team adoption.
 Maintain and improve AI/ML tools and solutions together with experienced colleagues
 Support the integration of AI solutions into existing CI/CD pipelines and VA toolchains
 Help build and maintain data pipelines to collect, clean, and prepare VA data
 Contribute to developing and integrating LLM-based tooling (e.g., AI agents, RAG systems) to assist with VA analysis, report writing, and knowledge retrieval
 Explore how AI agents can work with tools, APIs, and existing development or verification workflows.
 Stay current on AI/ML trends relevant to cybersecurity and vulnerability analysis and contribute to knowledge-sharing sessions
 Analyze and communicate results, insights, and recommendations to other colleagues
 Consider security, privacy, and responsible AI practices when exploring and applying AI/ML.
 The skills you bring: 
 Master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
 Solid foundation in machine learning and data analytics, with an interest in applying AI/ML to practical engineering challenges.
 Programming skills primary in Python.
 Experience with LLM, prompt engineering, API development and AI agents.
 Familiarity with AI platforms and frameworks such as AWS/Kiro, OpenAI, RAG, MCP, or similar is an advantage.
 Good practices in software development.
 Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments and version control tools such as Git.
 An interest in software development workflows, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and continuous integration and delivery. Experience building or improving these workflows is a plus.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a willingness to experiment, evaluate results.
 Motivation to learn testing, verification, and how to validate automated results.
 A self-driven, proactive, and collaborative approach, with clear communication skills and good written and spoken English.
 An interest in cybersecurity, prior security knowledge or experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

 Die ETH-Bibliothek , fördert Wissen, unterstützt Forschung und Lehre und macht als vertrauenswürdige Institution die Welt von gestern, heute und morgen für dich besser begreifbar. Unser Team Discovery and API Management in der Gruppe Digital Business Solutions entwickelt und betreut die dafür notwendigen Systeme.
 Auf den 1. März 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung suchen wir eine:n Full Stack Software Engineer – Discovery Services (m/w/d) mit einem 80 % Pensum.

 Wir suchen eine erfahrene und engagierte Persönlichkeit, die in einem kleinen Team technische Verantwortung für zwei zentrale Services übernimmt: das Suchportal «ETH swisscovery» und den Resource Information Bus, die API-Drehscheibe der ETH-Bibliothek.

 Hochschul- oder Fachhochschulabschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation mit entsprechender Praxiserfahrung

 Supporterai il disegno e l'evoluzione di strutture e modelli organizzativi in ambito Cybersecurity.

 Familiarità con DORA e con i principali framework normativi in ambito ICT e Cyber.

 Occasional travel, approximately 1-2 times per year, for client meetings or industry events 
 About the Team 
 The US Life & Health Market Unit is a dynamic and client-focused team within Swiss Re's broader Life & Health Reinsurance division. The team is responsible for managing and growing Swiss Re's reinsurance relationships with life and health insurance clients across the United States — delivering innovative solutions, strategic insights, and trusted partnership.  About You 
 You are a proactive , highly organized professional who knows how to turn broad direction into action . You are comfortable supporting senior stakeholders and client-facing teams , managing multiple priorities at once , and taking ownership of deliverables from start to finish.

items.desc:
This is Adyen 
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 
 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. 
 Implementation Engineer 
 As an Implementation Engineer at Adyen, you will partner with fast-growing and enterprise businesses to design, integrate, and scale how they use Adyen’s payment platform.
 This role sits at the center of complex technical delivery and pre-sales collaboration, where you help merchants make architectural decisions that directly impact performance, scalability, and global expansion. You’ll work on complex integration challenges where design decisions shape how global merchants operate at scale.
 We are looking for candidates with strong experience in APIs, integrations, and technical delivery. You will act as the primary technical partner for merchants, owning projects from solution design through to successful launch.
 What you’ll do: 
 Deliver end-to-end implementation projects from solution design through to go-live
 Design and help merchants build high-performance, API-based integrations for complex systems.
 Partner closely with Sales during pre-sales to shape solutions, assess feasibility, and support technical discussions with prospective merchants
 Act as the primary technical partner for merchants, guiding architecture and integration decisions
 Build alignment across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Project Management to drive the best outcomes for merchants
 Guide merchants through technical design decisions, testing, and production readiness
 Improve delivery quality by sharing best practices and helping elevate team knowledge
 Support a culture of growth by sharing knowledge and helping others unblock and succeed
 Act as the voice of the merchant internally, translating customer needs and pain points into actionable insights for Product and Engineering
 Advocate for improvements in Adyen’s products and integration experience based on recurring merchant challenges and feedback
 Who you are: 
 6+ years of experience in technical consulting, integrations, or software engineering
 Deep understanding of APIs and experience working across frontend and backend systems
 Comfortable making decisions in ambiguous environments
 Solid communicator who can lead technical discussions and build credibility with both technical and business stakeholders
 Proactive builder who takes initiative to see projects through to completion.
 Pragmatic approach focused on working, scalable solutions
 You proactively share best practices to help the team grow and to ensure merchants deliver high-quality, reliable integrations
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 
 Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 
 Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application! 
 What’s next? 
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility. 
 This role is based out of our London office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

items.card: In this role, you'll play a key part in ensuring the reliability and performance of our software, which helps medical device companies bring their products to market faster. You'll take ownership of your tasks for which you will be working closely with engineers to design robust automated tests, integrate them into CI pipelines, and ensure high-quality releases. Your contributions will directly support the delivery
items.desc: Job Title: Software Quality Engineer Employment Status: Full-time Location: Vienna, Austria, Hybrid (office days: Mon, Wed, Fri / home office: Tue, Thu). Ideally, you're already located in Vienna or able to relocate quickly. Unfortunately, we are unable to support people without an existing work permit for this position in Austria at this time. Compensation: Starting at €80,000* + variable + equity options Final compensation is negotiable based on experience and qualifications. Benefits: free in-office: lunch, drinks, coffee, snacks, Wiener Linien ticket, a yearly company retreat, regular team events About Ketryx Ketryx is an AI software platform that enables healthcare life sciences companies to ship life-saving regulated products in weeks instead of years. Exploding product complexity is burying companies in compliance paperwork and blocking innovation. Our AI software removes this friction, dissolving the historical tradeoff between innovation and compliance, and enables regulated industries to innovate at the pace of modern software. Since launch, Ketryx already touches the lives of 100M patients and powers all of the world's top five medical device manufacturers. Backed by Lightspeed Ventures, our founders are the former Head of AI at Amgen and CTO of Wolfram Cloud. Healthcare and life sciences is just the beginning for us. Automotive, aerospace, energy: if it's regulated, it's because society decided it matters. These products move humanity, shape our future, and are safety-critical. Come join us and help build the AI platform to power safe innovation. Job Summary Our customers use Ketryx to prove their medical software is safe. That means our own product has to be held to a higher bar than almost any SaaS tool. As a Software Quality Engineer, you'll own how we earn that trust: designing automated test coverage, keeping releases reliable, and making quality part of how every engineer works. We're a small team where each person has real ownership. You won't be a gatekeeper at the end of the pipeline. You'll shape what we test, how we test it, and how fast we can ship without cutting corners. What's hard: our product sits in a regulated domain, the test surface is wide, and AI is changing how quickly code gets written. Your job is to make sure quality keeps up. How we work with AI AI is in the loop on everything our engineering team does. We expect you to use AI coding agents every day: writing and refactoring tests, investigating failures, and exploring edge cases faster than you could alone. In a regulated domain, speed only counts if the output is right. We want engineers who treat AI as a fast collaborator, not an authority. You review what it produces, you know when it's wrong, and you build checks that catch it. We give you time and budget to experiment with new tools, and we expect you to share what works with the rest of the team. What You'll Do Design, build, and maintain end-to-end automated tests using Playwright, Vitest, TypeScript, and Cucumber Use AI agents daily to expand test coverage, debug flaky tests, and speed up verification without lowering the quality bar Work with engineers, product managers, and designers early, so new features are testable before they're built Improve the stability, speed, and scalability of our test framework and CI pipelines (GitHub Actions) Run verification and validation activities that show our product meets its requirements and industry standards Write clear manual test cases where automation doesn't fit yet, and turn them into automation when it does Find new ways AI can make our quality process faster and more reliable, and help the team adopt them What We're Looking For 4+ years in software testing, including 3+ years of test automation for web applications 1+ year of hands-on TypeScript, or 2+ years of JavaScript Experience with Playwright or Cypress (Protractor, WebdriverIO, or Nightwatch also count) Solid grounding in QA methodologies and BDD practices, ideally with Cucumber Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in your own workflow, with the judgment to verify everything AI produces before it ships Experience at an early-stage, product-based startup Clear written and spoken English for working across teams Bonus Points (Ideal Skills) Experience in a regulated industry such as healthcare, finance, or automotive Knowledge of ISO 13485 or IEC 62304 Test case management tools (TestRail, HP ALM, or Azure DevOps) Performance or security testing experience You've built your own AI-assisted workflows or agents for testing, and can show us how they work Our Tech Stack Frontend: TypeScript, React, items.desc: Orange Cyberdefense recrute en CDI Localisation : La Défense, Toulouse ou Rennes Qui sommes-nous ? Orange Cyberdefense est l’entité stratégique du Groupe Orange dédiée à la sécurité numérique. Nous accompagnons les entreprises de toutes tailles, organismes critiques, administrations et collectivités locales dans la conception de leurs stratégies de cybersécurité, leur mise en œuvre et leur gestion opérationnelle. Nous leur apportons notre expertise afin d’assurer le meilleur niveau de protection de leurs données, de leurs équipements et des services qu’ils offrent à leurs clients ou leurs administrés. Avec un CA de 1,3 Md€ en 2025, 7% ce croissance et plus de 3.300 experts dédiés à la cybersécurité, nous nous positionnons aujourd'hui comme le Leader européen sur le marché de la cyberdéfense. Notre vocation est de construire une société numérique plus sûre. Vos missions : En tant qu'Ingénieur Développement Logiciel, vous intégrez les équipes Xtended-SOC. Accélérer les évolutions de la plateforme Xtended : concevoir des systèmes multi-agents (orchestration, harness, validation et contrôle humains) qui livrent de nouvelles fonctionnalités en heures plutôt qu'en semaines. 2. Moderniser l'outillage existant : remplacer progressivement les briques vieillissantes par des composants agentiques, sans rupture de service. 3. Porter le virage agentique du SOC : automatiser triage, enrichissement et réponse aux incidents, avec les analystes. 4. Construire les briques communes : connecteurs (MCP), mémoire, context engineering, garde-fous, intégration des LLM et modèles ML. 5. Garantir la qualité en production : évals, suivi des régressions, sécurité, observabilité, maîtrise des coûts. 6. Transmettre : documenter, assurer la veille, former l'équipe. items.desc: Expert.e Qualité logiciel et performance applicative F/H Référence de l’offre: 73670 Site de l’emploi (court): Saint Denis, France, 93210 Vous intégrez la Direction Système d'Information (DSI) de GRDF, créatrice de valeur et partenaire des métiers, qui a comme mission d’assurer le fonctionnement et l'adaptation du SI conformément aux besoins des utilisateurs et au moindre cout. Rattaché.e au Pôle en charge de l’ingénierie logicielle de la DSI, vous serez responsable des offres transverses de qualité logicielle et de performance applicative de la DSI. Vous piloterez les équipes en place pour concevoir, organiser et développer ces offres pour qu’elles apportent de la valeur aux projets et aux équipes GRDF. VOS FUTURES MISSIONS L’IA générative fait évoluer les pratiques de développement et de test. Vous aurez pour mission d’inscrire ces offres dans une DSI augmentée. Cela passe par trois chantiers : Garantir la cohérence des offres. Les offres qualité logicielle et tests de performance partagent de plus en plus de pratiques. Vous veillerez à leur cohérence pour proposer aux projets un accompagnement lisible et complémentaire. Déployer le shift left. Les tests doivent être intégrés au plus près du cycle de développement. Augmenter les pratiques de test par l’IA. Vous mettrez en place des agents et des skills pour assister la conception, l’écriture et l’exécution des tests. Vous définirez aussi une phase de QA capable de valider un livrable au sein d’une orchestration globale d’agents. Vous conduirez également une étude sur les nouvelles solutions de gestion du cycle de vie logiciel. L’IA générative et l’orchestration d’agents font émerger de nouvelles méthodologies, et l’outillage doit pouvoir les accompagner. Périmètre des offres : ALM (cycle de vie logiciel) : méthodologies et bonnes pratiques ; accompagnement des projets ; outils : Squash, Jira et Confluence. Expertise en tests fonctionnels automatisés (UFT, Playwright) Expertise en tests de performance (NeoLoad, K6) Concrètement, vous devrez : porter l’expertise technique et méthodologique en qualité logicielle et en performance ; piloter les deux équipes en charge des offres et assurer la cohérence entre elles ; assurer l’alignement des offres avec les besoins de la DSI et des projets ; faire évoluer les offres en intégrant l’IA générative (agents de test, génération et exécution augmentées, QA intégrée aux orchestrations agentiques) ; mener l’étude des nouvelles solutions de gestion du cycle de vie logiciel adaptées à l’IA générative, et formuler des recommandations ; assurer une veille sur les outils et méthodologies, notamment sur l’évolution du cycle de vie logiciel avec l’IA. VOTRE PROFIL Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme Bac+5 en informatique avec au moins 7 ans d’expérience professionnelle dans l’IT. Vous avez déjà piloté des équipes ou souhaitez évoluer vers le management (suivi de charge, feuille de route, animation, risques, …) Vous avez une bonne connaissance des pratiques de développement (TDD, BDD, GitFlow, CI/CD…). Vous maîtrisez les outils d’ALM et les méthodologies associées. Vous avez une très bonne connaissance des outils de test (UFT, Playwright, Robot Framework, JMeter, NeoLoad, K6…) et savez concevoir les stratégies de test associées. Vous vous intéressez à l’IA générative appliquée au développement logiciel : assistants de code, agents, orchestration. Vous avez envie d’en faire un levier de transformation des pratiques qualité. Une expérience d’étude ou de choix de solutions outillées est un plus. Doté(e) d'une bonne communication, tu fais preuve d'agilité, de souplesse et d'un fort esprit d'équipe. Intéressé(e) ? Alors, n'hésite pas à postuler !

items.desc: 3D PLUS, Société du Groupe HEICO, conçoit, fabrique et commercialise des composants microélectroniques 3D ultra miniaturisés utilisant des technologies très avancées d’empilage et d’interconnections 3D de composants semi-conducteurs. Nos technologies brevetées permettent de créer des composants électroniques intégrant des composants hétérogènes (actifs, passifs, puces, boîtiers, wafer,…) de différentes tailles et de technologies dans un même boîtier ultra miniaturisé. Elles confèrent à nos produits de très hautes performances, une grande fiabilité et une ultra miniaturisation qui répondent aux besoins des équipements électroniques d’aujourd’hui et de demain, particulièrement pour des applications spatiales nécessitant un gain de surface important. La place de l'humain est au centre de notre société qui cultive l’innovation, l’exigence et l'agilité. L’Ambition, l’Audace et la Performance sont l’ADN de 3D PLUS. Cela nous permet de contribuer à des missions d’envergure internationale comme Persévérance et Mars Sample Return du JPL, et le programme Artemis de retour sur la Lune de la NASA. Nous sommes également soucieux du rôle que nous devons tenir au sein de notre écosystème et sommes labellisés Engagé RSE par l’AFNOR pour témoigner de notre contribution effective aux objectifs de développement durable. Pour nos clients, comme pour chacun de nos collaborateurs, « Notre Mission est que vous réussissiez la vôtre. » Plus d’informations sont disponibles sur www.3d-plus.com Au sein de la DSI, nous renforçons nos équipes et à ce titre nous recherchons un Ingénieur Data & Développeur BI. Solide connaissance des architectures décisionnelles (Data Warehouse, Data Mart, ETL/ELT), de la modélisation des données et des principes garantissant qualité, cohérence et traçabilité. Avec une forte expertise en informatique et mathématiques appliquées, les projets de recherche du centre Inria d’Université Côte d’Azur touchent toutes les dimensions des sciences et technologies du numérique, et génèrent de l’innovation. Implanté principalement à Sophia Antipolis, mais également à Nice ou Montpellier, il regroupe 47 équipes de recherche et neuf services d’appui. Il est présent dans les domaines de l’intelligence artificielle, la science des données, la sécurité des systèmes informatiques, la robotique, l’ingénierie de réseaux, la prévention des risques naturels, la transition écologique, la biologie numérique, les neurosciences computationnelles, les données de santé… Le Centre Inria d’Université Côte d’Azur est un acteur majeur en termes d'excellence scientifique par les résultats obtenus et les collaborations tant au niveau européen qu'international. Contexte et atouts du poste Dans le cadre du projet H2020-AGRIFOOD-TEF, ACENTAURI propose un poste d'ingénieur spécialiste sur l'acqusition et le traitement de données multispectrales. L’ objectif est de faire des acqusitions de données et de les traiter afin d'alimenter des applications de monitoring de l'environnement. Il s'agira donc: d'acquérir des données de caméras multi-spectrale avec un drone de développer des outils de traitement et d'analyse de définir des index pertinents à des fins de monitoring d'alimenter un Decision Support System de conduire avec des spécialistes des secteurs agriculture, agrifood et forêt des études et analyse pour le monitoring des maladies et croissances des produits de l'agriculture et forêt Des déplacements réguliers sont prévus pour ce poste pour aller faires des acqusition sur site. Le permis B est obligatoire ainsi que le brevet de télépilote de drone. items.desc: Contexte : La mission se déroulera au sein d'une équipe dynamique, innovante et motivée en charge de la gestion des Référentiels Transverses du groupe logée dans la direction Tech Expertise & Solution. Intégrez une équipe dédiée à la gestion et à la centralisation des données Référentiels stratégiques du groupe. En tant que Business Analyst Senior, le consultant sera au c?ur de projets transformateurs, apportant sa créativité et sa rigueur pour concevoir des solutions innovantes qui répondront aux besoins du Groupe . L'équipe fonctionne en mode Agile (Scrum), et intègre la méthodologie BDD pour la rédaction des spécifications, et ainsi faciliter les échanges et le suivi avec les équipes de développements, ainsi que l'automatisation des tests. MISSIONS En tant que Business Analyst sénior, le consultant interviendra sur 2 périmètres de l'écosystème Application du groupe. Axe 1 : Mise en ?uvre d'un nouveau référentiel 'Produits' Groupe En réponse à une recommandation de la Banque Centrale Européenne (BCE), le consultant sera chargé de mettre en ?uvre un référentiel Groupe référençant l'ensemble des produits IT du groupe (On entend par 'Produit', tout élément informatique nécessaire à une application métier ou à un serveur, rattaché à une tierce partie, qui dispose d'un versioning et dont le suivi est nécessaire à l'échelle du Groupe, comme, par exemple, pour le suivi de son obsolescence.) A date, les actifs identifiés sont les OS, SGBD, middleware sur la couche technique et Framework de développement et progiciels sur la couche applicative. Ce projet ambitieux vise à centraliser l'ensemble des Produits/Solutions IT du groupe, en vue de l'intégration dans le référentiels des assets IT. La solution proposée utilisera des technologies innovantes pour l'intégration et la consolidation des données issues de divers systèmes. Tout l'enjeu va consister à identifier, analyser et mettre lien l'ensemble besoins groupe sur le sujet. Ce projet, transverse au groupe, se compose d'une équipe projet déjà en place, représenté notamment par un business owner, un BA, un référent applicatif et des relais dans les métiers de la banque. Axe 2 : Participation aux développements du référentiel Applications du Groupe. Le consultant participera également aux évolutions du Référentiel Applications Groupe. Ce référentiel, largement utilisé dans l'ensemble du Groupe est un pilier important du SI du Groupe. Accompagné d'un BA déjà présent sur le sujet, le consultant sera en charge de l'analyse des nouveaux besoins Groupe, des échanges avec le métier, de la rédaction des spécifications (méthodologie BDD), ainsi que du suivi des évolutions. Profil candidat: Cette mission requiert une formation supérieure en système d'information; une expérience significative de Business Analyst ou PO dans un environnement projet Agile (+9ans XP), avec une connaissance de l'approche BDD (Behaviour Driven Development); structuration des données et des documents, rigueur et autonomie; une appétence particulière pour le travail en équipe; de communiquer de manière claire et concise, en Français comme en Anglais qui sera d'ailleurs une langue essentielle à la bonne conduite de la mission dans la mesure où une partie de l'équipe est localisée au Portugal. de réelles qualités de coopération transversale et d'orientation client ; une bonne maîtrise des outils Office 365 ainsi que Jira et Confluence seront essentiels

Dedicated to your personal and professional growth , offering opportunities to learn, develop, and thrive. A company that values impact , where your work truly makes a difference and contributes to something meaningful. About us Do you want to shape the future of aviation? items.desc: Brembo è un leader globale nell’innovazione per la mobilità e sviluppa soluzioni avanzate per veicoli e applicazioni racing. Guidata dal proprio purpose, “Shaping a Zero-Accident Future”, Brembo unisce eccellenza industriale e innovazione digitale per rendere sicurezza, prestazioni e sostenibilità parte integrante dell’esperienza di guida. Attraverso i propri brand – AP Racing, ByBre, Brembo, J.Juan, Marchesini, Öhlins e SBS Friction – il Gruppo offre un ecosistema integrato di tecnologie, che comprende sistemi frenanti, ammortizzatori, frizioni e cerchi, oltre a soluzioni software abilitate dall’intelligenza artificiale. Da oltre 50 anni, il Gruppo Brembo è protagonista nel motorsport ai massimi livelli, fornendo team nei campionati più prestigiosi e contribuendo alla conquista di oltre 1.000 titoli. Fondata nel 1961 in Italia e con sede a Bergamo, Brembo è quotata alla Borsa di Milano dal 1995. Il Gruppo conta circa 16.000 persone in 18 Paesi, con 39 siti produttivi e commerciali, 10 centri di ricerca e sviluppo e 2 Brembo Inspiration Lab. Nel 2025, i ricavi hanno raggiunto i 3,7 miliardi di euro. Siamo alla ricerca di una persona da inserire all'interno della Global Central Function Research & Development che si occuperà di: Definire le funzionalità a livello veicolo, sistema e sottosistema, traducendo le esigenze del cliente e gli obiettivi di dinamica veicolo in requisiti tecnici e funzionali; Definire use case, scenari operativi, condizioni di funzionamento, parametri caratteristici e KPI tecnici, identificando i comportamenti attesi del veicolo e del sistema al fine di guidare lo sviluppo delle funzionalità e la definizione delle relative performance anche attraverso l’uso di tool di simulazione; Definire e mantenere l'architettura funzionale e di sistema, assicurandone la coerenza con i requisiti e la corretta integrazione dei diversi domini coinvolti nello sviluppo di sistemi meccatronici complessi; Gestire l'interfaccia tecnica con clienti internazionali, contribuendo alla definizione e alla condivisione delle soluzioni tecniche, alla gestione dei requisiti e delle relative evoluzioni e assicurando l'allineamento tra le aspettative del cliente e lo sviluppo del prodotto; Implementare le azioni necessarie sui sistemi in sviluppo a supporto dell'omologazione del veicolo e assicurare che il prodotto sia sviluppato in conformità con il processo di sviluppo aziendale e con gli standard applicabili ai sistemi meccatronici automotive, con particolare riferimento ad Automotive SPICE, Functional Safety (ISO 26262) e Cybersecurity (ISO/SAE 21434). Requisiti: Laurea in Ingegneria dell’automazione, meccatronica, elettronica, automotive, con competenze nell'ambito della dinamica veicolo e dei sistemi di controllo; Esperienza di 5-7 anni in ruoli di System Engineering in ambito automotive; Esperienza consolidata nello sviluppo di sistemi meccatronici complessi dalla fase di concetto fino alla produzione di serie; Solida conoscenza della dinamica del veicolo e capacità di tradurre obiettivi di comportamento e performance del veicolo in use case, requisiti funzionali, parametri caratteristici e KPI misurabili; Esperienza e autonomia nella gestione di clienti internazionali e stakeholder interni ed esterni; Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese. Il pacchetto include: Inquadramento a partire dal livello B2 del CCNL Metalmeccanico, in funzione di seniority e competenze RAL a partire da € 34.209,89 (minimo previsto da CCNL per il livello B2), in funzione di seniority e competenze Premio di risultato (valore medio lordo a raggiungimento del target): € 6.000 Sistema aziendale di benefit Sede di lavoro: Stezzano (BG) L'azienda garantisce il trattamento dei dati ai sensi del Regolamento Europeo n. 2016/679, rinviando all’informativa privacy disponibile proseguendo con la presente candidatura. Verrà data risposta alle sole candidature ritenute interessanti sia relativamente alla posizione aperta sia per altre posizioni che di volta in volta potrebbero aprirsi. Brembo ritiene essenziale il rispetto del principio della parità di trattamento, essendo interdetta e preclusa qualsiasi forma di discriminazione o molestia, diretta o indiretta, nei confronti di ogni persona. #LI-GM1 #LI-Hybrid

items.desc: MBDA Italia è l'azienda italiana che fa parte del gruppo multinazionale MBDA, leader mondiale nel settore dei sistemi missilistici MBDA rappresenta il primo Gruppo a livello europeo con capacità di produzione e progettazione in grado di coprire l’intera gamma corrispondente alle attuali e future esigenze delle forze armate (terra, aria e mare). All’interno della Direzione Digital Excellence , MBDA Italia SpA è alla ricerca di un IT Operations Specialist con profonda esperienza degli ambienti Microsoft On Premise. Titolo di studio richiesto : Diploma Scientifico Certificazioni gradite: Certificazioni Microsoft in ambito Windows Server, Security o Identity & Access Management. Certificazione ITIL Foundation. Esperienze pregresse nella gestione di migrazioni o coesistenza ibrida (es. Exchange On-Premise verso Exchange Online o PKI locali verso soluzioni Cloud/Mesh). Esperienza professionale Esperienza consolidata (almeno 5-7 anni) nella gestione e governance di infrastrutture Microsoft Enterprise On-Premise. Forte competenza nell'architettura e amministrazione di Microsoft AD CS (Active Directory Certificate Services), gestione di Root CA (Offline/Online), Subordinate CA, Certificate Templates e CRL/OCSP. Competenza specialistica nell'amministrazione e nel troubleshooting avanzato di Microsoft Exchange Server (gestione database, flussi di posta/mail routing, architettura DAG). Conoscenza approfondita di Skype for Business Server (gestione dei ruoli Front-End, Edge, flussi audio/video e integrazione con centralini/telefonia). Solida conoscenza di Microsoft Active Directory (GPO, DNS, Identity) e dei sistemi operativi Windows Server. Padronanza avanzata di PowerShell per l'automazione dei processi amministrativi, dei controlli di routine e del monitoraggio delle scadenze dei certificati. Familiarità con le metodologie di IT Service Management (ITIL v3/v4). Attività previste per il ruolo : Il candidato ideale assume la piena responsabilità end-to-end (stabilità, sicurezza e compliance) dei servizi IT core basati su tecnologia Microsoft On-Premise. Il ruolo si focalizza verticalmente sulle piattaforme di Unified Communications & Collaboration (Exchange, Skype for Business), sui sistemi di Endpoint & Patch Management (SCCM/MECM) e sulla governance della sicurezza crittografica aziendale tramite la gestione della Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) e della Certification Authority (CA) interna. Governance e Ciclo di Vita della PKI (CA) Progettazione, manutenzione e hardening della Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) interna e dei servizi Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS). Gestione completa del ciclo di vita dei certificati digitali (rilascio, rinnovo, revoca, monitoraggio delle scadenze) per server, postazioni di lavoro, apparati di rete e identità utente. Manutenzione delle Certification Authority (Root CA offline e Subordinate CA online), pubblicazione delle CRL (Certificate Revocation List) e gestione degli endpoint OCSP. Gestione dei Servizi di Collaboration & Unified Communications Supervisione operativa e capacity planning dell'infrastruttura Microsoft Exchange Server (gestione database, configurazione dei DAG per l'alta affidabilità, flussi di mail routing interni ed esterni). Monitoraggio e troubleshooting dell'ambiente Skype for Business On-Premise (gestione dei server Front-End/Edge, flussi audio/video, federazioni esterne e integrazioni telefoniche). Endpoint, Software & Patch Management (SCCM/MECM) Governare l'infrastruttura SCCM / MECM per la distribuzione massiva degli aggiornamenti di sicurezza (Patch Management/WSUS) su tutto il parco Server e Client aziendale. Coordinamento e supervisione del deployment di software, configurazioni di sistema e immagini del Sistema Operativo (OS Deployment). Incident, Problem & Change Management Fungere da punto di escalation finale (3° livello) per incidenti critici e bloccanti sulle tecnologie di competenza. Conduzione delle analisi della causa radice (Root Cause Analysis - RCA) a seguito di Major Incident, definendo i piani di azione correttivi. Pianificazione, approvazione e supervisione dei Change infrastrutturali complessi in finestra di manutenzione per minimizzare gli impatti sul business. Sicurezza, Conformità e Fornitori Collaborazione con il team di Cyber Security per l'applicazione di policy di hardening, gestione delle identità e auditing dei log crittografici. Gestione delle relazioni tecniche con il supporto Microsoft (Unified/Premier) e controllo della conformità del parco licenze on-premise assegnato. Competenze Professionali : Architetture PKI e Crittografia: Profonda conoscenza dei concetti di crittografia asimmetrica, standard X.509, gestione dei Certificate Templates, configurazione di HSM (Hardware Security Module) e architetture di CA gerarchiche …

As a key player in the high-tech machineries production, we specialize in cutting-edge technologies, shaping the future of industrial automation. Our business portfolio encompasses a wide range of innovative making and packing solutions, in particular for Modern Oral and Next Generation products. About the Role We are looking for a Specialized Systems Technician who will contribute to the design and implementation of pneumatic and fluid systems installed on G.D automatic machines. Ardena supports pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies in bringing innovative, complex molecules from discovery to market. The Ardena Group operates from five sites across Europe and the United States, employing more than 700 professionals. Evaluating and releasing analytical runs and (interim) results, and ensuring the accuracy, integrity, quality, and confidentiality of study data. Assisting in the preparation, review, and finalization of study reports and related documentation. Knowledge of GxP standards (GLP and GCP) and regulatory guidelines for bioanalysis (e.g. FDA, EMA, ICH M10), and experience working in a regulated environment with LIMS. Fluent in Dutch and English. items.desc: Location & Employment Details: Poland | Full-Time | Remote with mandatory travel to Hannover, Germany (twice a month) | Fluent German required We are looking for an experienced OpenStack Enterprise Architect to help shape and develop the cloud and data center infrastructure of an established German hosting and cloud provider. This role is suited for a mature, experienced architect who thinks about the whole architecture rather than single solutions and is comfortable working independently in complex cloud and network environments. About the Project: The client is a family-owned data center and cloud services company based in Hannover, operating a high-security data center certified under ISO/IEC 27001, 27017 and 27018. They serve over 100 customers, from mid-sized companies to large enterprises, and are preparing their infrastructure for AI and high-performance computing workloads. You will join their Managed Services & Cloud Services team, working remotely and visiting the Hannover office twice a month. Responsibilities: Plan and develop the architecture and topology of the client's OpenStack cloud environments; Plan and coordinate infrastructure and cloud projects together with the client's team; Automate infrastructure, deployment and operations processes; Maintain and optimize the cloud services offered to the client's customers; Handle scaling and performance of the Ceph storage system; Design network architectures based on SDN, BGP and EVPN; Ensure redundancy and high availability across the infrastructure; Manage virtualization environments such as VMware and KVM/libvirt. Qualifications: 5+ years of experience designing, planning and implementing OpenStack-based cloud architectures; Expert knowledge of OpenStack core services (Keystone, Neutron, Glance, Cinder, Nova) and additional services such as Magnum, Barbican, Designate and Cyborg; Expert knowledge of Ceph, especially scaling and performance tuning; 5+ years of experience with Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD using Ansible and Terraform, plus workflow tools such as AWX or Kestra; In-depth understanding of network architectures, particularly SDN, BGP and EVPN; Strong expertise in redundancy, high availability and virtualization (VMware, KVM/libvirt); 5+ years of project management experience (PRINCE2 or similar), including agile methods; Ability to explain complex architectures clearly to both technical teams and management; Fluent German (mandatory); Business-fluent English; Availability to travel to Hannover, Germany twice a month (mandatory). Recruitment Process: Initial interview with our recruitment team; Technical interview with the client; Final decision and offer. items.desc: We Are Waiting for You Hi there! I am Álvaro, the recruiter for this position. Nice to meet you! You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group, a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to our Technology Delivery Center (TDC). Established in Barcelona in 2006, the TDC operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich’s local and global business units. Maintain the enterprise catalogue of architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, patterns and terminology, including approvals, versioning, ownership and review dates. Coordinate the Federation Council calendar, agenda and inputs, prepare decision-ready papers and pre-reads, capture decisions and dependencies, and follow up on actions through to closure. Identify missing standards, outdated artefacts, unowned capabilities, conflicting positions and cross-domain dependencies, assigning accountable owners, due dates and escalation paths. Maintain a trusted, searchable architecture repository and concise management view covering strategies, standards, roadmaps, decisions, exceptions, ownership and review status. Use approved AI assistants and evidence retrieval to compare artefacts, flag inconsistencies, map strategy to standards, draft communications and assemble council packs and action summaries. Challenge weak evidence, inconsistent definitions and misaligned proposals constructively, recommending resolutions while keeping decision and implementation accountability clear. What Makes You a Great Fit? While we’re not seeking perfection or expecting you to save the world, we believe that if you meet some of these requirements, you’ll be a fantastic fit for our team. We are waiting for you! Experience 10+ years of relevant technology and architecture experience, including enterprise architecture governance, standards management and cross-domain coordination in a complex, federated organisation. Architecture judgement A strong technical architecture foundation across application, cloud, infrastructure, security, identity, data, AI and integration, with the ability to challenge domain proposals and reconcile differing positions. AI fluency Demonstrable use of AI for architecture knowledge retrieval, comparison, gap analysis, reporting and communication, with appropriate source verification, access controls and human accountability. Standards assurance Experience maintaining architecture principles, standards, definitions, reference models and roadmaps with clear ownership, lifecycle controls, change management and exception handling. Coordination Experience facilitating architecture councils or comparable governance forums across Business Units, regions and technical domains, supported by strong writing, presentation and stakeholder skills. Execution A track record of managing decision and action registers, prioritising cross-domain gaps, securing accountable owners and pursuing commitments to evidenced closure. Education A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated environment is preferred; enterprise architecture, governance or AI qualifications are valued. And… What Makes Us …

There is real scope to shape your role… around what you do best If you have a special interest in frailty, virtual wards, hospital admission avoidance, front-door streaming or ambulatory care, we would actively welcome a conversation. We are flexible in how roles are built and happy to tailor job plans to align with your interests, experience and development goals. Whether you are passionate about clinical leadership, pathway development, education, or system working across primary and secondary care, there is space here for you to make a meaningful impact. This is an opportunity to join a service with momentum… and ambition You will be joining a team that is honest about the challenges of acute care, but equally committed to doing things better: for patients and for staff. Our vision is clear: the right patient, in the right place, at the right time, led by the right clinician. If you’re looking for a role where your expertise is valued, your ideas welcomed, and the service is genuinely evolving rather than standing still, we’d encourage you to get in touch for an informal discussion. New leadership and investment at North Cumbria Integrated Care has created an opportunity for 5 new Acute Medical Consultants who will be integral to the redesign of our Acute Medicine services. New funding will mean we can facilitate early senior decision making, expand Medical SDEC facilities and advise from the point of referral in our new single point of access Hub. The investment will support a modern Acute Medical service, including a significantly expanded and purpose-built Medical Same Day Emergency Care unit, with protected consultant presence and strengthened multidisciplinary working. Our future model prioritises early senior review, ambulatory pathways, frailty-focused care and better use of virtual wards and community services. This is about delivering safer care, reducing unnecessary admissions, and improving across the whole hospital… not firefighting in Emergency Department corridors. Our CEO, Trudie Davies, and Executive Medical Director, Adrian Clements, would love to hear from you to discuss your future career in North Cumbria. To arrange an informal chat, please contact Sally Rushton on Sally.Rushton1@ncic.nhs.uk for Trudie and Julia McClune on Julia.mcclune@ncic.nhs.uk for Adrian. At NCIC, we have an ambition to deliver outstanding healthcare services to the population of North Cumbria. The Trust is committed to creating a centre of excellence in providing rural and remote healthcare and provides a wide range of community and acute services throughout our county. Our 5 key principles demonstrate our belief in the delivery of ‘safe, high quality care every time’: Being a clinically led organisation Quality and safety at the heart of our Trust A positive patient experience every time A great place to work Managing our money well As an organisation we are serious about supporting a diverse workforce that reflects our local community and are very much focused on being an inclusive and compassionate place to work. items.desc: Qui sommes nous ? Fondé en France, Talan est aujourd’hui un groupe international qui accompagne ses clients dans leur transformation Data & IA, de bout en bout, en combinant conseil en management et expertise technologique. Avec plus de 6000 collaborateurs sur 5 continents, nous accélérons les transformations de nos clients à travers des partenariats de long terme, en créant un impact mesurable et durable. Notre proposition de valeur repose sur un écosystème d’innovation structuré : 2 500 experts Data & IA, des solutions propriétaires construites sur des modèles avancés et un laboratoire de recherche appliquée, de développement expérimental et d’innovation. Nous traduisons l’innovation technologique en avantage concurrentiel depuis plus de 20 ans dans des secteurs stratégiques : banques et services financiers, énergie, transport et mobilité, luxe et distribution, santé. Porté par sa promesse de Positive Innovation, Talan s’impose comme un acteur de référence pour répondre à la complexité croissante des environnements économiques, technologiques et réglementaires. www.talan.com Et Talan Sud Est ? Talan Sud-Est est présent depuis 2007 à Lyon et compte environ 350 collaborateurs répartis entre Aix-Marseille et Lyon. En plein développement, les équipes s'agrandissent ! Nous continuons de développer aujourd'hui nos activités auprès de grands comptes et d’ETI, principalement dans les secteurs de l’Energie et de l’Environnement, du Transport et de la Logistique, de l’Industrie, de la Distribution, de la Santé et des Services Publiques. L’expertise, la bonne humeur, le collectif et de l’esprit d’entreprendre, constituent notre ADN. Description du poste L’Intelligence Artificielle Générative transforme en profondeur la façon de concevoir, développer et industrialiser les solutions digitales. Chez Talan Sud-Est, notre équipe Data Analytics, forte de 70 collaborateurs, accompagne déjà nos clients sur leurs enjeux Data, Cloud et IA. Aujourd’hui, nous souhaitons accélérer cette dynamique en renforçant notre expertise GenAI afin de concevoir les prochaines solutions à forte valeur ajoutée : assistants métier, copilots, agents IA, architectures RAG et solutions basées sur les LLM. C’est dans ce contexte que nous recrutons notre futur(e) Forward Deployed Engineer AI . Qu'est-ce que nous vous proposons ? L’opportunité de rejoindre une équipe d’experts passionnés et de jouer un rôle clé dans le développement de notre expertise IA Générative. Vous contribuerez à imaginer, concevoir et industrialiser des solutions innovantes pour nos clients, tout en participant à la structuration de notre future communauté GenAI. Vos missions En tant que Forward Deployed Engineer AI , vous serez amené(e) à : Concevoir et développer des solutions basées sur les LLM, RAG, agents IA et copilots. Définir les architectures techniques des projets GenAI et accompagner leur industrialisation. Réaliser des PoC, MVP et projets de production autour de l'IA Générative. Participer aux choix technologiques et à la veille sur les nouveaux modèles et frameworks. Intervenir sur les phases d’avant-vente et contribuer aux réponses aux appels d’offres. Partager votre expertise au travers d’ateliers, formations et communautés techniques. Contribuer au développement de nos accélérateurs et assets GenAI. Qualifications Passionné(e) par l’Intelligence Artificielle et les nouveaux usages, vous expérimentez continuellement et aimez transformer des innovations en solutions concrètes. Vous disposez idéalement : D’une expérience significative en développement, Data Science, IA et GenAI. D’une solide maîtrise de Python et de l’écosystème IA moderne. D’une expérience autour des LLM, RAG, agents IA ou fine-tuning. D’une bonne connaissance des frameworks tels que LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face ou équivalents. D’une culture cloud et DevOps (Azure, AWS ou GCP). D’une forte curiosité technique et d’un goût prononcé pour l’expérimentation. Une expérience autour de sujets tels que les agents autonomes, MCP, Knowledge Graphs, MLOps ou AI Engineering constitue un véritable atout. Plus qu’un diplôme ou un parcours, nous recherchons avant tout une personne passionnée, capable de challenger les standards, de tester les dernières innovations et de partager ses découvertes avec le reste de l’équipe.

Wir suchen eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit im Bereich AI Engineering / AI Software Development, die moderne AI-Technologien mit fundiertem Software-Engineering-Know-how verbindet. In dieser Rolle entwickelst du intelligente Softwarelösungen auf Basis von Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning und Generative AI. Du bringst neue Technologien in produktive Anwendungen und gestaltest die technische Weiterentwicklung unserer AI-Lösungen aktiv mit. Deine Verantwortung Konzeption, Entwicklung und Implementierung moderner AI-basierter Softwarelösungen. Entwicklung und Integration von Machine-Learning-Modellen sowie Generative-AI-Anwendungen. Arbeit mit Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG-Architekturen und AI Agents. Integration von AI-Technologien und externen AI-Services in bestehende Softwarearchitekturen. Entwicklung und Optimierung von skalierbaren Backend- und API-Lösungen. Sicherstellung der Qualität, Performance, Skalierbarkeit und Wartbarkeit der entwickelten Anwendungen. Evaluation neuer AI-Technologien, Frameworks und Entwicklungsansätze. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Software Engineers, Data Scientists und weiteren technischen Stakeholdern. Mitgestaltung der technischen Architektur und strategischen Weiterentwicklung der AI-Landschaft. Was Wir Suchen Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Software Engineering, AI Engineering oder Machine Learning Engineering. Fundierte Programmierkenntnisse, insbesondere in Python. Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Implementierung von AI- und Machine-Learning-Anwendungen. Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs) und idealerweise RAG-Systemen. Erfahrung mit Frameworks und Technologien wie PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain oder vergleichbaren Lösungen. Solides Verständnis von Softwarearchitektur, APIs, Cloud-Technologien und modernen Entwicklungspraktiken. Erfahrung darin, technische Konzepte in produktionsreife Softwarelösungen zu überführen. Kundengespräch: Schließlich haben Sie die Möglichkeit, den Kunden kennenzulernen. Obwohl dies unser Standardprozess ist, können wir Anpassungen vornehmen, die auf spezifischen Umständen basieren.

items.desc: Faceel-it, un collectif qui te ressemble. Deec ses collaborateurs comme avec ses clients. Parce qu'on croit que la technique ne travaille pas pour un métier, mais avec. Aujourd'hui, rejoins une organisation pensée pour t'accompagner dans ton développement de carrière et ta montée en compétences. Tu intégreras notre Business Unit Data , pilotée par Robin Rins, son directreur , et tu seras suivi(e) tout au long de ta mission par Léna Lebecq , la Responsable Ressources Humaines . _________________________________________________________________________ 🟢 Une mission faite pour toi. Maintenant parlons du poste : Notre client du secteur Retail , basé à Lille , cherche à renforcer son équipe avec un(e) IA Engineer . Un profil capable de concevoir et mettre en production des applications d'IA générative (assistants LLM, systèmes RAG, agents autonomes), conformes à l'AI Act européen. ✹ Les missions qui te seront confiées : Applications LLM : Conçoit des applications LLM en choisissant et intégrant les modèles adaptés à chaque cas d'usage (Gemini, OpenAI GPT, Claude, Mistral, open source), et rédige et optimise les prompts. Systèmes RAG : Construit des systèmes RAG : ingestion et découpage des documents, embeddings, bases vectorielles, recherche hybride et mesure de la qualité des réponses. Agents IA : Développe des agents IA en orchestrant des workflows multi-étapes et multi-agents avec LangGraph et LangChain, et en branchant outils et API (function calling, MCP). Automatisation Métier : Automatise les processus métier en connectant les LLM aux outils. Industrialisation : Déploie dans le cloud, suit les coûts et la latence, met en place l'observabilité et garantit la sécurité (injection de prompt, fuite de données). ✹ Les compétences techniques demandées : Python & API REST : Très bonne maîtrise. LangChain / LangGraph : Orchestration de workflows et d'agents. LLM : Gemini, OpenAI GPT, Claude, Mistral et modèles open source. RAG : Embeddings, bases vectorielles, recherche hybride. Function calling / MCP : Connexion des agents aux outils et aux API. Cloud & Observabilité : Déploiement, suivi des coûts et de la latence. AI Act & RGPD : Connaissance des enjeux de conformité. ✹ Ce qu'on attend de toi : Bac+5 (école d'ingénieurs, master en informatique, data ou IA). Expérience concrète de projets LLM : au moins un projet RAG ou agent déployé ou testé par de vrais utilisateurs. Français bilingue et anglais professionnel. Capacité à expliquer des sujets techniques à des interlocuteurs métier. _________________________________________________________________________ 🔵 Un environnement pensé pour toi. Un management adapté à ton métier et à ta réalité terrain. 🎯 Un suivi personnalisé par ta Directrice de BU et une RH spécialiste de ton secteur. Un plan de carrière co-construit avec toi : expertise technique, fonctionnelle, management, gestion de projet. Des formations et certifications accessibles via notre plateforme Udemy avec plus de 50 000 modules disponibles. 🎓 Un périmètre client varié : grands noms du retail, de la banque et de l'assurance. Un espace de travail dédié à l'agence pour tes jours en télétravail. 💻 Un package à la signature d'une valeur de 3 000 € (prime vacances, prime mobilité, etc.). 💰 Un abonnement à la salle de sport Basic Fit à deux pas de l'agence, pris en charge. 💪 Un CSE chez Giftéo et tes titres-restaurant sur carte Swile . 🎁 Une culture du vivre-ensemble avec des événements organisés chaque mois : afterworks, activités, et bien d'autres. 🎉 Alors on te rencontre en entretien ? Faceel-it, Faceelitez votre passion ! 💚

items.desc: Position Overview JOB DESCRIPTION We are seeking an AI Engineer to join our Global AI team in London. This role is focused on the end-to-end lifecycle of production-grade AI, from training and fine-tuning specialized models to architecting high-performance inference pipelines. You will be responsible for writing high-quality, maintainable Python code and ensuring that every solution, whether a voice agent or a document processor, is built for reliability, low latency, and global scale. Key Responsibilities Production Engineering: Build and maintain real-time AI pipelines using WebSockets and SSE, ensuring seamless low-latency delivery for voice and text applications. Architecture & MLOps: Deploy and orchestrate models within containerized microservice architectures (Docker/Kubernetes), ensuring robust monitoring, security, and scalability. Evaluation & Testing: Build the testing and evaluation that show whether an AI system is working, and use it to release with confidence. Retrieval: Design and tune retrieval pipelines, including hybrid search, reranking and evaluation. Inference Optimization: Architect and optimize inference pipelines to minimize TTFT (Time to First Token) and maximize throughput. This includes implementing quantization, caching strategies, and efficient batching. Collaborative Delivery: Work closely with Business Analysts and internal stakeholders to bridge the gap between commercial requirements and technical implementation. Qualifications Technical Requirements Professional Experience: 5+ years in AI/ML engineering with a documented history of moving complex models from research into production. Python Mastery: Deep proficiency in Python. You have a strong commitment to clean coding standards (SOLID/DRY), modular design, comprehensive unit/integration testing, and asynchronous programming. LLM Applications: Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, tool calling and structured outputs. Fine-tuning (PEFT) is a plus. Inference Stack: Experience with high-performance inference servers (e.g., vLLM, TGI, or SGLang) and an understanding of how to optimize models for GPU deployment. Infrastructure: Comfortable working in Linux-based environments and proficient in managing containerized workloads and automated CI/CD pipelines. Advanced RAG: Experience building production-ready Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems, including vector database management, semantic, hybrid and lexical search, reranking, and evaluating retrieval quality. Preferred Qualifications Experience in the insurance or financial services sector. Experience adapting LLMs for domain tasks with LoRA/QLoRA. Experience with speech technology (ASR/TTS) and streaming audio. Deep knowledge of GPU architecture, CUDA, and hardware-level performance optimization. Familiarity with Document Intelligence frameworks (OCR, layout analysis, and multimodal extraction). We offer in return! Competitive salary & pension scheme, discretionary bonus scheme, 25 days annual leave plus ability to purchase 5 additional days, hybrid working options, Private Medical cover, Employee Share Purchase Plan, Life Assurance, Subsidised gym membership, Comprehensive Learning & development offerings, Employee Assistance program. A business that’s engaged in mutual trust and respect for its employees and partners. A place where colleagues perform at the highest levels. And a working environment that’s collaborative and supportive. Diversity & Inclusion. At Chubb, we consider our people our chief competitive advantage and as such we treat colleagues, candidates, clients, and business partners with equality, fairness and respect, regardless of their age, disability, race, religion or belief, gender, sexual orientation, marital status or family circumstances. We are committed to ensuring our recruitment process is inclusive and accessible to all. items.desc: At Allianz Global Investors, we are shaping the future of investment management through technology, data and innovation. We are looking for a Data & AI Engineer (f/m/d) to join our Investment Technology team and build next-generation data and AI (Artificial Intelligence) capabilities for our investment business. The role has a strong focus on modern data engineering and the Databricks ecosystem. You will design, build and operate scalable data platforms, pipelines and services supporting investment research, analytics, decision-making and AI-enabled solutions. You will work with technologies including Python, SQL, Spark/PySpark, Delta Lake and Unity Catalog, with exposure to emerging Databricks capabilities such as SDP, Feature Store and Mosaic. You will take ownership from day one, working with engineers, data specialists and investment experts to deliver production-grade solutions and help shape our future data and AI platform capabilities. This position will be preferably based in Frankfurt, but applications from Munich are also welcome. What You Will Do Design, build and operate scalable data solutions using Databricks and cloud-native technologies. Build batch and streaming pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows across structured and unstructured investment, market, reference and alternative data. Develop robust data models and lakehouse solutions, incorporating data quality, governance, security and observability. Build reusable Python and SQL components, APIs and backend services supporting data products and platform capabilities. Apply CI/CD, automated testing, Infrastructure as Code and DevOps practices across the engineering lifecycle. Build and integrate Generative AI and agent-based solutions, including RAG approaches using enterprise and investment data. Explore emerging capabilities across Databricks, AI and machine learning, including SDP, Feature Store and Mosaic. Partner with investment teams, analysts, engineers and architects to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Take end-to-end ownership from technical design through implementation, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement. What You Bring 5+ years of professional experience in data, backend, platform or software engineering. Strong hands-on experience with Databricks and Spark/PySpark, building and operating production-grade data solutions. Experience with the Databricks ecosystem, ideally including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog and Workflows/Jobs. Exposure to capabilities such as SDP, Feature Store or Mosaic is advantageous. Strong Python and SQL engineering skills. Proven experience building scalable data pipelines, data models and distributed processing workloads. Experience with cloud-native data platforms, APIs and integration patterns. Strong software engineering practices including Git, automated testing, CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code; familiarity with Docker/Kubernetes is advantageous. Understanding of Generative AI, LLMs and RAG, with practical experience advantageous. Ability to take ownership of complex technical problems and contribute to technical and architectural decisions. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Investment management or financial data experience is advantageous. What We Offer We empower our employees by ensuring flexible work arrangements that maintain a balance between performance, productivity, career development and personal priorities (e.g., hybrid model/ flexible working hours) Securing your future: Access to company pension/savings plans Family support (relocation/ childcare facilities) Company share purchasing plan Mental health and wellbeing programs Mobility solutions (Jobrad bike leasing, subvention Jobticket) Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group Self-guided learning & development Volunteering time … and so much more! About Allianz Global Investors Allianz Global Investors is a leading active asset manager, managing assets for individuals, families, and institutions worldwide. Our shared goal to shape a future of opportunity for our clients is foundational to our culture and our values. We look to attract, and actively nurture, individuals with the drive to achieve excellence at every stage of the investment experience. We believe an inclusive culture is key to a flourishing workforce. Not only do we celebrate the broad range of experiences, backgrounds, and attributes that our workforce brings, but we support our people to live and work in a way that promotes their own wellbeing. Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer. We are united by a shared commitment: to put our clients first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions. Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a …

items.desc: ABOUT THE ROLE Elaiia’s AI Twins are generative models of how real people decide, and they run in production today. This role exists to push those models further: more faithful to real populations, more stable under new questions, and reliable enough that a research team would trust them. You’d bring deep experience with generative methods and work directly with behavioural scientists, psychometricians and cognitive scientists. They know what a realistic response looks like. You’d know what a generative model can be made to do, and the interesting work happens where those two don’t line up. We’re an early-stage startup, so the role is broad: model architecture one week, evaluation, data or a client question the next. Priorities shift and answers are often unclear. You’d be comfortable making progress anyway. RESPONSIBILITIES – Design, train and the generative models behind Elaiia’s AI Twins – Turn behavioural theory into model behaviour you can test, working with our researchers – Build evaluations that check generated populations against real outcomes – Take generative models from prototype to production, with latency, cost and failure modes in mind – Improve how models use real behavioural data, including retrieval and grounding – Pick up whatever the team needs, from data pipelines to client conversations YOU MAY BE A FIT IF – Substantial hands-on experience designing, training and evaluating generative models (transformers, diffusion, VAEs, flows) – A deep understanding of how generative methods work, where they fail, and how to tell them apart in practice – Strong Python – Solid ML fundamentals and statistical literacy: you know a model that looks right from one that holds up – Comfort with high uncertainty and a generalist mindset – Comfort working close to research: you can take a methodological argument seriously and push back on it – Using AI tools as part of your normal development work STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO HAVE – A PhD in machine learning, computer science, computational neuroscience or a related field – Experience with large language models (LLMs): evaluation, deployment, prompt management – Experience building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems – A background in neuroscience, psychology or cognitive science – Previous experience at an early-stage startup ABOUT DELTA LABS Delta Labs uses AI to simulate and predict consumer behaviour at scale. We build Elaiia, a simulation engine that generates AI Twins — intelligent synthetic agents that mirror real consumer populations. Clients use Elaiia to simulate customer decisions before committing to them: pricing, product launches, campaign messaging and channel allocation. We replace surveys, focus groups and intuition with simulation-based evidence. We’re a small, focused team and intend to stay that way. We give people ownership, trust and autonomy. We work with urgency and intellectual honesty and look for people who are curious, rigorous and want their work to have demonstrable impact. THE STACK TypeScript frontend (Next.js/React), PostgreSQL, Python microservices, durable background jobs, integrated LLM APIs, LangGraph agents with tracing. Deployed on Vercel and Microsoft Azure. LOCATION Zürich, Switzerland. Delta Labs is an in-person company. Candidates should be in the Zürich area or open to relocation. BENEFITS You’d own systems, not tickets. You’d work directly with behavioural scientists, experimental economists, psychometricians and cognitive scientists. Global enterprises use the product for decisions that matter, and you’d help shape an early-stage company. Delta Labs is an equal opportunity employer, welcoming applicants of all backgrounds. If you need any accommodation during the process, tell us and we’ll arrange it.
