items.desc: ⚡ STAGIAIRE AI ENGINEER — DISRUPTION & IA ALTERNATIVES (F/H) Decathlon Digital — Pôle People Data & AI L'essentiel 🎓 Contrat : stage de fin d'études (six mois) 📅 Démarrage : premier trimestre 2027 📍 Lieu : Paris 🎯 Niveau : Bac+5 Le contexte Envie de bousculer le statu quo et de réinventer le quotidien technologique de 100 000 collaborateurs ? Au sein de Decathlon Digital, nous recherchons un profil audacieux pour concevoir, prototyper et tester des alternatives radicales fondées sur l'IA générative et agentique. Ici, zéro maintenance : ton rôle consiste à challenger l'existant. Ce qui rend le projet unique 🚀 Terrain d'expérimentation réel : tu audites les systèmes internes pour concevoir des solutions de rupture (agents autonomes, architectures RAG avancées, automatisation de pointe). 🛠️ Stack technique moderne : GCP, Vertex AI, modèles de fondation récents et ressources dédiées pour tester tes prototypes à l'échelle. Missions principales 🔍 Audit & Discovery : repérer les zones de friction dans nos outils et identifier les cas d'usage où l'IA surpasse les solutions en place. 🤖 Prototypage & R&D : coder et éprouver des architectures agentiques et des pipelines RAG avancés. 📊 Évaluation & LLMOps : mesurer la performance de tes modèles selon des critères précis (latence, précision, coût, valeur métier). 🔗 Protocoles d'interaction : tester l'intégration de standards récents (MCP, échanges Agent-to-Agent) avec notre écosystème Data et SIRH. 🎙️ Restitution & impact : présenter tes démonstrations aux équipes produit et tech pour orienter les architectures de demain. Profil recherché 🎓 Formation : étudiant(e) en dernière année de cursus Bac+5 (école d'ingénieurs ou master en IA, Data Science ou Informatique). 💻 Technique : maîtrise de Python, aisance sur le cloud (GCP, Vertex AI) et culture solide en IA générative (LLM, embeddings, RAG, agents). 💡 Savoir-être : profil « builder », esprit critique, curiosité technique et clarté à l'oral. 💬 Langues : français courant et anglais professionnel (échanges quotidiens à l'international). Processus de recrutement ⏱️ Étude du profil avec retour sous deux semaines. Premier échange de cadrage RH et culture. Entretien technique approfondi avec ton futur encadrant et un membre de l'équipe. DECATHLON DIGITAL Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits. Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

items.desc: Chez Thales, nous sommes fiers de travailler ensemble pour imaginer des solutions innovantes qui contribuent à construire un avenir plus sûr, plus vert et plus inclusif. Un avenir de confiance. Mais ces technologies ne viennent pas de nulle part. L'intelligence humaine est le moteur derrière la technologie qui fait la renommée de Thales. Les projets que nous conduisons sont complexes et nos clients exigeants. Pour répondre aux besoins actuels et futurs de nos clients, nous maîtrisons plus d’une centaine de disciplines, de l’optique à la physique quantique, du traitement du signal à la connectivité et à l’intelligence artificielle. Rejoindre Thales, c’est repousser les limites de la technologie et la mettre au service du progrès et du développement durable de nos sociétés. C’est donc être au cœur d’une formidable aventure technique. Une attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs au service de leur réussite. C’est pourquoi, notamment, nous nous efforçons de créer un environnement de travail accueillant et d’accorder la flexibilité nécessaire à l’équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. Nous savons que cet équilibre est essentiel à votre épanouissement et à la réussite des projets que nous vous confierons. Des parcours professionnels riches. Chez Thales, nous jouons collectif. Ce qui signifie travailler en équipe, côtoyer des experts et donc apprendre et développer ses compétences en permanence tout en faisant bénéficier le Groupe de son savoir-faire. C’est aussi la possibilité d’évoluer, de changer de fonction ou d’activité, voire de pays. Lieu : Issy-les-Moulineaux, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Notre savoir-faire technologique Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…) Votre quotidien Vous intégrez CortAIx Factory , l'entité du groupe Thales dédiée à l'industrialisation de solutions d'IA avancées pour les systèmes des forces armées, des avionneurs et des aéroports. Dans un contexte de déploiement de systèmes multi-agents en production, vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe Data & IA, en lien étroit avec les équipes de delivery, les architectes et les Product Owners. En tant que stagiaire ingénieur IA, vous contribuerez au développement d'un harnais agentique de confiance : un cadre de garanties runtime pour encadrer l'autonomie des agents IA, avec une architecture d'octroi et de révocation de mandat d'autonomie. À Ce Titre, Votre Mission Principale Sera De Concevoir Et Développer Un Prototype De Supervision Et De Contrôle Des Agents. Pour Ce Faire, Vous Serez Amené à Réaliser un état de l'art des approches de supervision et de contrôle d'agents IA (garde-fous, sandboxing, niveau d'autonomie graduel) ; Concevoir une architecture de mandat d'autonomie : définition des périmètres d'action accordés à un agent et de leurs conditions d'octroi ; Développer les mécanismes de révocation du mandat en cas de comportement hors périmètre, d'anomalie ou d'incident ; Mettre en place la traçabilité et l'observabilité des décisions des agents (journalisation, alertes, remontées aux superviseurs) ; Intégrer les contraintes du contexte critique : cybersécurité, explicabilité et conformité ; Évaluer le harnais sur des scénarios multi-agents représentatifs (cas nominaux et cas dégradés) ; Présenter une démonstration (PoC) et documenter vos travaux pour faciliter l'industrialisation ultérieure. Votre profil Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau BAC+5 (école d'ingénieurs ou Master) spécialisé en IA, Data Science ou informatique, et vous recherchez un stage de fin d'études de 4 à 6 mois ? Vous vous intéressez aux agents IA et aux LLM (orchestration, RAG, frameworks d'agents) et à la question de leur supervisabilité ? Aucune expérience avancée sur ces sujets n'est attendue : votre curiosité et votre capacité à apprendre vite comptent davantage. Analyse, autonomie, proactivité et travail en équipe sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnaît ? Un intérêt pour la cybersécurité, les architectures modernes (microservices, conteneurs, CI/CD) et un anglais technique permettant de lire la documentation seraient un plus. Solid working knowledge of IEC 61508 and/or ISO 13849, including FMEDA, MTTFd/PFH calculation, diagnostic coverage, and Category/architecture requirements. Experience conducting FMEA analysis and translating results into concrete, verifiable engineering requirements. Ability to specify hardware and embedded software diagnostic requirements that can be verified by test. Comfort working across disciplines — able to speak credibly with HW design engineers, SW engineers, controls engineers, mechanical/electrical designers, and regulatory/compliance stakeholders. Strong technical writing skills; able to produce clear, defensible safety documentation (safety cases, hazard logs, verification/validation plans and reports). Familiarity with SOTIF (ISO 21448) or equivalent "safety of the intended function" thinking, where the hazard arises from performance limitations rather than component failure. items.desc: We're building Krans, the company brain for teams that run on customer conversations. Krans connects every meeting, email, message and document a company has, and turns it into evidence: what customers actually said, which deals are really moving, and what to do next. It's live, customers have been onboarding since August, and feedback comes in directly to the founders. We've been building fast. But we see what Krans could be, and we want to get there even faster. That's where you come in. We're looking for the best AI engineer out there. Not a generalist who also does AI. Someone who lives in this stuff, ships fast, and wants ownership over what we build next. How we got here Builders is an AI venture studio in Rotterdam. We co-found AI enterprise companies with founders from day zero, which means we sit inside dozens of founder conversations, customer calls and pipelines at the same time. And we kept running into the same problem: the real picture of a company lives in meetings, inboxes and chats, and nobody has all of it. Teams run on the story they tell themselves, not on what their customers actually said. In December 2025, Michael started building the fix himself, during his holiday. It quickly became the operating system of our own studio. In August 2026 it became a company with its own name, and we onboarded our first external customer. Krans was built inside a venture studio because nothing else worked. Our vision is simple: every company is built on Krans. We start with company builders and portfolio holders who run multiple ventures, and we won't stop there. What Krans actually does Connects meetings, email, Slack, WhatsApp, documents and CRM into one knowledge graph per company Links every claim back to the exact passage where a customer said or wrote it Grades what customers say, from implied interest to real commitment, and keeps internal beliefs separate from customer statements Tracks how claims change over time, so drift is visible instead of overwritten Spots what's missing: unnamed budgets, unasked questions, stalled deals Writes nightly company summaries you can view as of any past date, and suggests concrete next steps Opens the graph to Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor through MCP: read-only, sourced and scoped by permissions Gives portfolio holders one view across all their ventures Think of it as the colleague who was in every meeting, read every email, and always knows where something was said. What you'll work on You'll be one of the core engineers on Krans and own large parts of the AI stack. Concretely, you'll be working on things like: Extraction and synthesis pipelines that hold up across messy, multi-channel, multi-speaker, multi-language data Claim extraction, grading and versioning: turning raw conversation into structured, source-linked evidence that stays correct as new information comes in Agent orchestration: the agents that watch accounts, detect gaps and draft next steps, in real time Multi-tenant architecture for hundreds of companies and portfolios: permissions per person and per company, strict isolation, no cross-company reads The developer surface: API, MCP server and CLI, so external agents can work with Krans data Integrations: new sources, more reliable sync, less noise Eval infrastructure so we can actually tell when extraction and summaries get better, not just feel it Latency, cost and quality trade-offs in production, not in a slide deck You will ship to real users in week one. That's the standard. Our stack (high level) You don't need to match this exactly, the specific versions and providers will keep moving. This is the shape of what's already running for real customers. Language: TypeScript end-to-end, Python where the AI tooling needs it App and infra: Next.js and React on Vercel, with real-time agent orchestration and background pipelines running there Data: Supabase, Postgres with pgvector, Prisma, Zod, S3 Models: mixed by job, currently Anthropic and Gemini, with AssemblyAI for transcription Sources: Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Granola, Read.ai, Circleback, Slack, WhatsApp, Gmail, Outlook, Notion, Google Drive, Google Calendar, HubSpot and GitHub Privacy posture: EU-hosted in Frankfurt, encrypted in transit and at rest, customer data is never used for training, permissions per person and per company. A company's context is its most valuable asset, and that shapes a lot of our architectural decisions. Where we'd love your fingerprints: real evals around claim extraction and grading, smarter entity resolution across channels (who is who across email, Slack and meetings), the portfolio view, faster and cheaper nightly synthesis, and a developer platform other agents love to build on. You'll probably love this if you Have built and shipped real production AI systems: RAG, agents, knowledge graphs, doesn't matter, but it has to have actually run for real users Have 5+ years building production platforms, ideally multi-tenant SaaS Are AI-first: you use …

Use telemetry, insights, and traces to identify optimization opportunities and failure patterns independently. What You'll Bring To The Team 3+ years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent) delivering production software. Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript (or similar modern languages). Experience building and shipping integrations using APIs and working with cloud services or enterprise systems. Comfort operating in customer-facing environments with strong written and verbal communication. Ability to independently drive scoped projects, manage risks, and deliver against deadlines. Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed. Our core principles Customer Centric: Stay close to customer users and stakeholders; anchor decisions in outcomes, adoption, and long-term success. Breaking Silos: Collaborate across Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customer teams to unblock delivery and align on the right solution. Improving Agility: Prototype, test, ship, observe, and iterate—treat deployments and feedback loops as the fastest way to learn. Dealing with Ambiguity: Make progress with incomplete information; clarify requirements through discovery, iteration, and pragmatic tradeoffs. Building Focus: Prioritize the highest-impact workstreams, manage scope actively, and deliver durable solutions that customers can run and evolve. Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Use-Cases entlang der SAP-Prozesse erkennen: Entlang der SAP-Prozesslandschaft (z. B. Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, HR) spürst du
items.desc: DEINE ROLLE KI greifbar machen: Als AI & Automation Consultant bildest du die Brücke zwischen Fachbereichen und Technologie: Du identifizierst KI- und Automatisierungs-Use-Cases, erstellst Business Cases und begleitest die Umsetzung von der Idee bis in den produktiven Betrieb. Use-Cases entlang der SAP-Prozesse erkennen: Entlang der SAP-Prozesslandschaft (z. B. Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, HR) spürst du Potenziale auf, priorisierst Use-Cases und übersetzt sie in konkrete Maßnahmen. Workshops & Discovery-Sessions gestalten: In Formaten zu SAP Business AI, Joule Agents, Document AI und SAP Build Process Automation arbeitest du gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen an tragfähigen Lösungen. Joule-Lösungen konzipieren: Du verantwortest die fachliche Konzeption von Joule Skills und Agents und begleitest deren Konfiguration in Joule Studio gemeinsam mit dem Development-Team – inklusive Anbindung von MCP-Servern. Roadmaps und Datenfundament definieren: Du entwickelst Roadmaps und Business Cases für KI-Initiativen und berätst zu SAP Business Data Cloud (inkl. Datasphere) als Basis für datengetriebene Anwendungen. Change aktiv begleiten: Durch Schulungen, Demos und engen Austausch mit Fachanwender:innen treibst du das Change Management voran und stärkst die Akzeptanz von KI-Lösungen. DEIN PROFIL Qualifikation: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science, Computer Science oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bildet deine Basis. Beratungserfahrung: Idealerweise verfügst du über Erfahrung in der SAP-Beratung, IT-Beratung oder einer ähnlichen Rolle mit Schwerpunkt Digitalisierung und Prozessoptimierung. KI-Verständnis: Begriffe wie LLM, GenAI, RAG und MCP kannst du erklären, einordnen und weißt, wann welcher Ansatz sinnvoll ist. Tool-Erfahrung: Du verfügst über erste fundierte praktische Erfahrungen mit SAP; idealerweise hast du bereits mit SAP S/4HANA gearbeitet. Berührungspunkte mit SAP Business AI / Joule, SAP BTP oder Document AI sind ebenfalls von Vorteil. Erfahrungen mit vergleichbaren Plattformen – etwa Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate oder Google Vertex AI – erleichtern dir den Einstieg zusätzlich. Brücke zwischen Welten: Komplexe KI-Themen bereitest du so auf, dass Fachbereiche sie verstehen – du fühlst dich sowohl in der Business- als auch in der IT-Welt zuhause. Kommunikationstalent: Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, intern sowie extern. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

items.desc:
Berlin, Germany - Hybrid
 At Sonova, we are transforming how CRM supports our consumer-facing businesses globally. As our new B2C CRM Business Partner, you will play a key role in bringing our B2C and B2B2C CRM activities into a more connected, scalable and globally managed environment.
 This position will act as the link between our local markets, commercial and marketing teams and IT. You will be a SME, ensuring consumer and patient journey needs are clearly understood, translated into actionable CRM requirements and successfully delivered through our technology platforms.
 What you'll do 
 Act as a SME, who will map CRM-related touchpoints across patient onboarding, consumer engagement and partner-to-consumer journeys
 Partner with local markets, regional teams, marketing, digital and IT to understand and translate B2C and B2B2C CRM needs
 Own and prioritise the B2C CRM requirements backlog, ensuring that business needs are documented, validated and ready for implementation
 Review proposed technical solutions and ensure they reflect the intended business and consumer experience
 Monitor CRM delivery against agreed requirements, managing scope changes, risks, dependencies and potential deviations
 Provide structured delivery updates and escalate relevant risks, blockers and scope changes through the appropriate governance channels
 What you'll bring 
 At least 5 years of experience in consumer marketing, CRM management, digital consumer experience or business analysis within a B2C or B2B2C environment
 Strong understanding of consumer journeys, patient or customer engagement, personalisation and digital marketing workflows
 Experience with the implementation of CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics or an equivalent solution
 Experience managing requirements, project delivery, backlogs, risks and organisational change
 Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate across local markets, regional teams, headquarters and technology functions
 Experience in MedTech, medical devices, hearing care or another regulated industry is a strong plus
 Fluent English. Additional languages such as German, French, Italian or Spanish would be an advantage.
 Why join us 
 You will have the chance to shape how B2C CRM is managed across Sonova, influence the development of a central platform and contribute directly to the company’s digital consumer journey.
 As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model.
 30 days of paid annual leave
 Subsidized VBB or Deutschland ticket
 Dedicated learning & development budget and weekly learning time + LinkedIn Learning license
 Company Urban Sports Club membership
 Mobility allowance for relocation if you are relocating to join our team #LI-NB1

 Maintain clear traceability between business requirements, compliance requirements and implemented solutions.
 undefined

 Act as the connection point across Logistics, Customs & Compliance, Finance/Tax, Operations and Digital Technology.
 Facilitate discussions where business requirements, regulatory obligations and system constraints need to be reconciled.
 Engage regional and country stakeholders to understand local regulatory requirements while driving global standardization where feasible.
 Provide subject-matter guidance to programs and projects requiring Customs & Compliance expertise.
 Influence stakeholders toward solutions that balance compliance, customer experience, operational efficiency, cost and technology sustainability.
 Key Deliverables

 End-to-end logistics solution designs
 Business capability and process architecture
 Customs & Compliance solution requirements
 Business requirements and functional design inputs
 Process/control requirements and traceability
 Architecture/design assessments
 Gap and impact assessments
 Solution options and recommendations

 Experienced Business Solution Architects, Logistics/Trade Transformation professionals, or Customs & Compliance leaders with strong technology and process-design experience who can bridge business, regulatory and digital requirements to design scalable end-to-end logistics solutions.

items.card: Tâches et responsabilités Pour piloter le développement d’un produit interne visant à optimiser l’utilisation transverse d’une plateforme stratégique au sein de l’organisation, nous recherchons un Product Owner expérimenté. Titulaire d’un master et en mesure de travailler en français, néerlandais et anglais, vous assurez la coordination des équipes de développement et garantissez la livraison d’un produit répondant
items.desc: Tâches et responsabilités Pour piloter le développement d’un produit interne visant à optimiser l’utilisation transverse d’une plateforme stratégique au sein de l’organisation, nous recherchons un Product Owner expérimenté. Titulaire d’un master et en mesure de travailler en français, néerlandais et anglais, vous assurez la coordination des équipes de développement et garantissez la livraison d’un produit répondant aux besoins stratégiques et opérationnels. Vos principales missions comprennent : Formaliser les objectifs stratégiques du produit et en définir la vision avec les parties prenantes. Identifier puis rédiger les user stories répondant aux besoins métier, avant de gérer et prioriser le backlog. Veiller au respect des délais et à la qualité des livrables en coordonnant l’équipe de développement. Animer et préparer les cérémonies Scrum, dont le Sprint Planning, les Daily Scrums, les Sprint Reviews et les rétrospectives. Soutenir l’adoption et l’utilisation efficace du produit, tout en facilitant son intégration dans les différents départements. Évaluer l’efficacité et l’impact du produit dans l’organisation en définissant des indicateurs clés de performance. Collaborer avec l’équipe technique pour identifier les obstacles et mettre en place des solutions adaptées. Votre profil Compétences techniques et expérience Vous disposez d’au moins 10 ans d’expérience récente et démontrée comme Product Owner ou Product Lead, de préférence sur des produits techniques ou des plateformes transverses. Vous possédez une compréhension approfondie des architectures IT et plus de 10 ans d’expérience dans des environnements fondés sur le cloud AWS, le PaaS, la SOA, l’EDA, l’ESB, REST et l’intégration de systèmes complexes. Vous maîtrisez parfaitement les outils de gestion agile, notamment Jira et Confluence ou des solutions équivalentes. Vous avez une expérience confirmée de la définition d’une vision produit, de la construction de roadmaps stratégiques et de la gestion de backlogs complexes impliquant de multiples parties prenantes. Vous avez déjà géré et coordonné des écosystèmes d’API et de microservices, ainsi que les dépendances applicatives entre les équipes techniques et métier. Vous connaissez bien les architectures d’intégration, les stratégies API et les enjeux associés à la modernisation des plateformes digitales. Vous avez participé à des projets de transformation cloud et de migration vers des infrastructures cloud modernes. Vous maîtrisez les méthodes Agile Scrum et connaissez les frameworks à l’échelle, tels que SAFe. Vous avez animé des cérémonies Agile et collaboré avec des équipes de développement internes et externes. Vous disposez de connaissances en analyse métier, en modélisation des processus et en formalisation des exigences, notamment BPMN, UML et requirements engineering. Vous avez évolué dans des environnements réglementés présentant des exigences élevées en matière de sécurité, notamment pour la gestion des identités numériques, des accès et de l’authentification. Vous avez piloté des produits et services digitaux au sein de grandes organisations réunissant de nombreuses parties prenantes, des équipes IT, des architectes et des responsables métier. Vous détenez une certification Scrum Product Owner, telle que CSPO, et pratiquez solidement les approches Agile orientées valeur. Vous connaissez des outils complémentaires de gestion de produit et de collaboration, comme Azure DevOps, Miro, Figma, Adobe XD et InVision. Une expérience ou une certification en blockchain représente un atout pour analyser des solutions et évaluer de nouveaux services numériques. Vous avez une expérience dans le secteur de la sécurité sociale. Qualités personnelles Vous faites preuve d’un leadership naturel et savez mobiliser des équipes techniques. Vous possédez d’excellentes aptitudes de communication pour fédérer les parties prenantes techniques et métier. Vous êtes orienté résultats et capable de convertir une vision stratégique en produit concret et opérationnel. Vous vous adaptez facilement et êtes à l’aise dans la gestion de situations complexes et évolutives. Vous avez un esprit analytique, le sens de la priorisation et la capacité de décider selon la valeur métier et l’impact utilisateur. Vous savez établir le lien entre les métiers, l’architecture et les équipes d’ingénierie pour aligner les objectifs stratégiques sur les contraintes techniques. Vous disposez d’excellentes aptitudes de facilitation, d’écoute active et de gestion des parties prenantes dans des contextes complexes et transverses. Vous avez accompagné le changement et l’adoption de plateformes ou de services digitaux à l’échelle de l’organisation. En plus du CV, la candidature doit apporter une réponse à la question suivante. Toute réponse absente ou insuffisante entraîne l’élimination : comment priorisez-vous les éléments du backlog produit et sur quels critères vous appuyez-vous pour déterminer les priorités ?

items.desc: Groupe de conseil international fondé en 2019, Ekkiden anime un écosystème de consultants passionnés et engagés qui mènent des projets de transformation organisationnelle, opérationnelle et technologique dans l'IT/Digital, l'Industrie/R&D et la sustainability, chez les grands comptes et PME, en France, Suisse, Espagne et Allemagne. Le rôle : Notre client, un grand groupe de distribution B2B présent sur l’ensemble du territoire à travers un réseau de filiales et d’agences, lance un projet stratégique : remplacer son CRM actuel, un progiciel du marché utilisé par plus de 4 000 commerciaux, par une solution CRM développée en interne . Le projet couvre les besoins des équipes commerciales (pilotage et suivi de l’activité) et marketing (gestion des contacts, engagement, campagnes). Il démarre en 2027, pour une mise en service progressive d’ici fin 2029. Vous rejoindrez la DSI, au sein du domaine CRM, aux côtés de chefs de projet internes et d’une équipe mixte d’internes et de prestataires. Responsabilités : Participer à la conception et au développement du nouveau CRM, de l’architecture aux fonctionnalités métier. Développer les fonctionnalités front et back : gestion des comptes, contacts, opportunités, pilotage commercial, modules marketing. Concevoir et développer les intégrations avec le SI existant (ERP, outils marketing, data, référentiels clients). Contribuer à la reprise des données et à la transition depuis le CRM actuel. Intégrer des briques d’IA (assistance aux commerciaux, scoring, automatisation) selon la roadmap du projet. Participer aux ateliers avec les métiers, rédiger la documentation technique et contribuer à la qualité du code (revues, tests, CI/CD). Accompagner les phases de mise en production, d’hypercare et de maintien en condition opérationnelle. Ce que nous recherchons : 5 à 10 ans d’expérience en développement d’applications métier. Une expérience sur des projets CRM , en développement spécifique ou sur un progiciel du marché. De bonnes compétences en architecture applicative et en conception d’API. La maîtrise d’une stack moderne La connaissance des pratiques DevOps : Git, CI/CD, tests automatisés. Une capacité à échanger avec les équipes métier et à comprendre les enjeux commerciaux et marketing. Français et anglais professionnels. Les plus Une expérience de développement intégrant de l’IA : LLM, IA générative, machine learning appliqué. Une expérience d’un projet de construction d’un outil from scratch ou d’une migration de CRM. La connaissance de Salesforce, utile pendant la phase de transition. Une expérience dans la distribution B2B ou le retail. Salaire proposé: 40 000 à 50 000 Ce que nous proposons : Nous rejoindre au bon moment pour faire ta place au sein d'une organisation en très forte croissance Des missions variées dans un environnement challengeant qui te permettront d'avoir un réel impact sur la boite La possibilité de travailler de façon autonome et d'être force de proposition pour grandir ensemble ✨ Un parcours de carrière adapté à ta personnalité, aussi bien au niveau du rôle que de la localité Une formation exigeante en continu pour libérer tout ton potentiel Une culture de la performance avec de belles primes de résultats ❤️ Une mutuelle très complète (la GEREP) et des titres-restaurant (carte Swile) Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement chez Ekkiden ? Chez Ekkiden, nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience positive à chaque candidat. Premier contact : Notre équipe de recrutement vous contactera pour discuter de vos motivations et attentes. Entretiens : Vous passerez un ou deux entretiens avec nos business managers, en fonction du poste pour lequel vous postulez. Rencontre avec le client : Enfin, vous aurez l'opportunité de rencontrer le client. Bien que ce soit notre processus standard, nous pouvons l'adapter en fonction des circonstances spécifiques. Retrouvez aussi toutes nos offres d'emplois sur notre site internet https://jobs.ekkiden.com/

items.desc: About Reqtest Reqtest is the leading Nordic SaaS platform for quality assurance in digitalisation projects. We're a small, focused team with high ambitions and strong commitment. Our 200 customers in Sweden and abroad include well-known brands such as Lantmännen, Scania and Philips Healthcare. We already have a product our customers love: 4.5 out of 5 on Capterra, and customers stay with us for 8 years on average. But we still see big opportunities to make it even better. Our vision is to help our customers succeed with their digitalisation by taking control, working in a structured way and collaborating successfully in their digitalisation projects. Reqtest is part of the Nordtech Group, which acquires and develops successful tech companies. Reqtest is entering its most important phase yet: moving development in-house and rebuilding the product around AI. About the role As software architect at Reqtest, you set the technical direction for how we build with AI. You design the architecture and the agent-driven way of working behind it, and you're hands-on enough to build new functionality yourself, including generative AI features and integrations, with a focus on quality and value for the customer. You're part of the dev team, report to our CPO and collaborate closely with both the CPO and our CTO. We're a small company with a flat organisation, so you're close to everyone and see the impact of what you build. You'll work agent-driven, where agents do much of the work and you direct, review and own the result. You follow your features all the way, from understanding the need, sometimes in meetings with customers, through technical decisions, implementation and testing, to release and follow-up. You'll also help us make the move to an AI-native way of working and shape what it looks like. In short, you will be working with: designing the architecture and building features end to end developing generative AI features in the product building and maintaining integrations with other systems building a self-improving, automated architecture, where agents build, test and deploy, and quality is checked automatically at every step making technical and architectural decisions together with the CPO and CTO turning needs into technical solutions, working closely with the product, operations and customer teams using AI tools as a natural part of the development workflow, not just as an add-on To succeed in this role, we believe you have Several years of software development, including designing and owning architecture. Hands-on experience of agent-driven development, including setting up agents and basic AI infrastructure. Experience shipping generative AI features to production. Experience of test automation, from unit to E2E, and continuous deployment. Experience building integrations via REST APIs. Fluent English and Swedish Nice to have A clear product mindset and experience of SaaS environments. Experience of introducing new ways of working or technologies in a team. Your style You're curious about more than the code – you want to understand the product and the customers who use it, and you're comfortable joining a customer meeting when it helps. You don't wait for a detailed spec: you take a problem, ask the right questions and find a solution. You thrive with a lot of responsibility and freedom. You keep up with AI because you want to, not because you have to – you try new tools and models, share what works and like to prototype before deciding. You're not afraid to have an opinion, but you listen before you decide – and you're happy to let the best idea win. Your time at Reqtest Real influence over the product, the tech and our move to an AI-native way of working Short decision paths and close contact with customers Modern offices at Convendum, Gävlegatan 16 in Vasastan, Stockholm. We're on site about 4 days a week, because that's where the culture is built, with flexible hours Breakfast, gym and a good work environment We interview on an ongoing basis. The process: Screening call with our recruitment partner First interview: competencies and soft skills Alva Labs tests Tech interview/case: about 2-3 hours of independent prep work, then you present your solution to us References and background check Offer We want to get to know you properly, and we hope you want to get to know us :) Send your application today - we look forward to hearing from you! Avdelning Tech Plats Stockholm

items.desc:
Role Highlights 
 Title: Freight & Customs Clearance Specialist
 Department: Global Manufacturing Organization (Logistics)
 Reports to: Head of MAITE, Optics / Logistics Manager
 Location: Warsaw, Poland
 Type of Contract: Permanent
 Working model: On-site
 Security Clearance: Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)
 About the role 
 ICEYE is looking for a Freight & Customs Clearance Specialist to manage international freight forwarding, customs compliance, and logistics operations supporting our manufacturing activities in Warsaw, Poland. Given the significant workload involving dual-use items, this is a key position responsible for cooperating with customs agencies and carriers to ensure seamless import/export clearance and timely deliveries.
 You will manage end-to-end inbound and outbound freight flows, execute international trade compliance (including ITAR, EAR, and dual-use export controls), coordinate customs brokerage services, and oversee shipping documentation. You will work closely with Procurement, Production Planning, Quality, and external logistics partners to ensure all shipments arrive on schedule while adhering to compliance and budget requirements.
 What you will do 
 Oversee inbound and outbound logistics, including air, sea, and road freight forwarding, customs clearance, and carrier coordination.
 Execute full compliance with international trade regulations, dual-use items, ITAR, and EAR export controls.
 Manage relationships and operational workflows with external customs agencies (such as Customs Support Group/Rusak Business Services) and freight forwarders (such as Gebrüder Weiss).
 Prepare, verify, and archive essential shipping and customs documentation (e.g., AWB, SAD/ZC429, commercial invoices, DSK declarations).
 Ensure proper tariff classification (HS/CN codes), valuation, and origin determination for satellite components and specialized aerospace equipment.
 Monitor freight costs, duty payments, and customs duty guarantees, driving cost optimization and efficiency in transport activities.
 Coordinate specialized handling, shock-sensitive packaging, and transport requirements for high-value space hardware in accordance with AS9100 and ECSS standards.
 Mitigate logistics risks, supply disruptions, and customs delays through proactive tracking and contingency planning.
 What we're looking for 
 Must haves: 
 3–5 years of hands-on experience in international freight forwarding, customs clearance, and shipping operations.
 Proven experience working in a structured production environment (Aerospace, Defense, Automotive, or Electronics).
 Strong expertise in customs procedures, EORI, SAD/ZC429, tariff classification, and dual-use item regulations.
 Experience handling international trade controls (ITAR, EAR, export licenses).
 Proficiency with ERP systems and WMS workflows.
 Strong command of MS Excel / Google Sheets for reporting and freight tracking.
 Fluency in English and Polish (essential for daily communication with local customs authorities and international stakeholders).
 Certification for dangerous goods transport by road, sea, and air (ADR, IMDG, IATA)
 Application Process 
 Screening with Talent Team
 Hiring Manager Interview
 Technical Case / Assessment
 Final Interview
 Working at ICEYE 
 At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.
 How We Work (Our Values) 
 Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.
 Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.
 See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.
 Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams.
 Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.
 Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Aberration through cover-layer depth is the dominant optical problem in this product, and this is the role that owns it. What you will own Beam shaping and delivery — collimation, expansion, polarization management, and the whole path from source to media. Objective lens design and numerical aperture — high-NA optics, depth of focus, and the working distance the mechanism has to hold. Aberration management across cover-layer depth, through a deep multi-layer stack. Wavelength separation — dichroic and filter design, spectral separation and rejection ratio. Stray light, background rejection and inter-layer crosstalk. Optical tolerancing and alignment strategy, and an assembly process that holds in volume rather than only on a bench. Optical modeling in Zemax, CODE V or equivalent, correlated to measurement — and the optical interface to the media design. How the role changes with level Staff Engineer to Principal Engineer — Design and tolerance assigned elements of the optical path, model them, and prove them against measurement. Own the alignment method for what you designed. Technologist to Senior Technologist — Own the optical architecture end to end, from source to detector, including the aberration budget through the full layer stack and the alignment process that survives volume manufacture. Carry the technical relationship with optics suppliers and the optical interface to the media design. Qualifications What you need Degree in optical engineering, physics or photonics; an advanced degree is usual at Principal and above. 10+ years of relevant experience. Optical system design taken into a manufactured product, with tolerancing and an alignment process that worked in volume. Fluency in Zemax, CODE V or equivalent — and in correlating the model to measured hardware. High-NA optics and aberration control demonstrated on a real system. What would help Eight or more years in Blu-ray or BDXL optical pickup development — the strongest single signal for this role. Multi-layer optical system design, and aberration correction through thick or layered media. Confocal or multi-photon microscopy optical design. Spectral filter design. Whether you’re exploring healthcare engineering jobs, pharmacy automation roles, healthcare IT careers, or healthcare logistics opportunities, you’ll be part of a team that’s driving innovation in medication management and hospital workflows around the world.  Make an impact

 What you need to succeed 
 Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Project Management or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
 Approximately 5+ years of relevant experience in PMO, project coordination or cross-functional project delivery, ideally in an international organization.
 Strong planning, prioritization, communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence without formal authority.
 Confident use of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and collaborative project tools, with the ability to create clear dashboards and concise management reports.
 Experience in HR transformation, HRIS projects, process improvement or organizational change is an advantage.
 Familiarity with Agile or Waterfall methods, PMO frameworks or certifications such as PRINCE2, PMP or CAPM is an advantage.
 Willingness to travel approximately 30–40%
 .
 Languages:
Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken. Additional European languages are an advantage.
 Our Vision: Lead Change for Better Care 
 Swisslog Healthcare empowers hospitals and healthcare facilities with advanced pharmacy and transport automation solutions that streamline medication management and support clinical workflows. With over 1,200 dedicated employees serving more than 3,500 health facilities worldwide, we’re committed to improving patient safety and giving healthcare professionals more time for what matters most: caring for patients. Join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

items.desc: Job Title : AEROSPACE ENGINEER Role Overview KILONEWTONS is seeking a visionary, highly accomplished, and expert AEROSPACE ENGINEER with a decade of specialized experience to spearhead advanced aerospace structures and high-performance material integration at our engineering hub in Toulouse, FRANCE . As an experienced Windows Server engineering expert, you will play a critical hands-on role in designing, implementing, administering, and optimizing the enterprise server infrastructure supporting Moderna's research, pharmaceutical production, and business operations. Bringing deep expertise across Microsoft Windows Server technologies, infrastructure security, advanced troubleshooting, and automation, you will help ensure the stability, scalability, and resilience of our enterprise environments. Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, infrastructure diagrams, server configurations, and accurate system inventories to support operational consistency, knowledge sharing, and effective infrastructure management. Develop and leverage PowerShell scripts and other automation tools to streamline server provisioning, deployment, configuration, maintenance, and recurring operational activities, improving efficiency and reducing manual intervention. Create detailed server and application implementation plans, custom scripts, validation processes, and testing procedures to ensure successful deployments, system stability, and operational reliability. Proactively identify opportunities to optimize server performance, enhance infrastructure scalability, improve system security, and strengthen operational processes through automation, standardization, and continuous improvement. Explore opportunities to leverage Generative AI tools to enhance troubleshooting, scripting, technical documentation, and infrastructure operational workflows, in alignment with Moderna's security and governance requirements. Take hands-on ownership of complex technical challenges, working independently to investigate issues, develop solutions, and implement sustainable improvements across the server environment. items.desc: About Parexel Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere. We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose - moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart. About the Role We are seeking a Statistical Programmer to join our team. As a Statistical Programmer, you will support the full lifecycle of clinical trial data - from dataset creation through regulatory submission - helping bring new therapies to patients faster and with greater confidence in data quality. This position plays a key role in producing and quality-checking the programming deliverables that underpin clinical study results. You will work across multiple studies and drug programs, contributing directly to CDISC-compliant SDTM and ADaM datasets, as well as the tables, listings, and figures that inform regulatory decisions. You will collaborate closely with lead programmers, biostatisticians, and cross-functional study teams, following established SOPs and industry guidelines. You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through precise data programming, cross-functional collaboration, and consistent delivery against study timelines. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, Statistical Programmers at Parexel can explore career paths and expand skills across the full breadth of clinical research programming. Key Responsibilities Perform both production and quality control (QC) programming of SDTM datasets, analysis datasets, tables, listings, and figures (TLFs) across multiple clinical trials using SAS and/or R Integrate and reconcile data across multiple studies or drug programs to support portfolio-level reporting and submissions Deliver programming work with minimal supervision under the direction of a lead programmer, maintaining high standards of accuracy and compliance with CDISC standards Proactively communicate risks to timelines or technical issues to the lead programmer or technical lead, enabling plans to be adjusted before deadlines are impacted Manage a moderate to large volume of complex programming tasks simultaneously, including ad-hoc requests, with minimal guidance Participate in team meetings and maintain availability during core working hours to support effective collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders Apply knowledge of ICH and FDA/EMEA guidelines and drug submission requirements to programming deliverables (Programmer II and III levels) Candidate Profile You will thrive in this role if you bring: Strengths in SAS and/or R programming, data integration, and clinical trial dataset development Experience working in a pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO environment with exposure to regulated data standards The ability to manage competing priorities, communicate proactively, and collaborate across teams A detail-oriented mindset and a strong commitment to data accuracy and quality control Comfort working independently with minimal supervision while knowing when to escalate Familiarity with CDISC standards (SDTM, ADaM) and regulatory submission requirements Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Biology, Social Science, or a related scientific discipline Programmer I: Entry-level candidates with foundational SAS and/or R programming knowledge and exposure to clinical data environments are encouraged to apply Programmer II: Minimum of 3 years of SAS programming experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, with extensive knowledge of CDISC standards and working knowledge of drug submission requirements and relevant ICH and FDA/EMEA guidelines Programmer III: Minimum of 5 years of SAS and/or R programming experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, with extensive knowledge of drug submission requirements and relevant ICH and FDA/EMEA guidelines, and deep expertise in CDISC standards Strong items.desc: Who We Are At prado, we build invisible home technology for the world’s best architects. What began with a single flagship product in 2021 is now an integrated ecosystem of lighting, ventilation, power and security solutions, carried by more than 150 colleagues across Europe, North America and the Middle East. We are a family of brands that keeps on growing. We want every colleague to spend their time on the work that really matters. To support our continued growth, we are looking for an AI & automation engineer who builds agents and automations together with our departments, on top of one shared data layer, so routine work takes less time and good ideas reach daily use fast. What You Will Do Find the routine work worth automating together with department heads in Sales, Customer Care, Finance, Operations, Marketing and HR: order entry, quote preparation, invoice handling, planning checks, product data, onboarding flows and more. Build AI agents and automations that query and act on company data (our ERP, CRM and e-commerce platforms), with the same access rights as the person using them. Take each automation from idea to daily use: prototype fast, test with the users, put it in production and measure what it saves. Make automations reliable: monitoring, error handling, logging and clear documentation, so nothing fails without anyone noticing. Build reusable building blocks and templates, so colleagues can build simple automations themselves. Work closely with the IT team, building on our shared middleware and data platform. Share what you ship: show results to the teams, help colleagues use the tools well, and keep improving based on their feedback. What We Are Looking For 3+ years of experience building automations, integrations or software in a business context. Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents: prompting, tool use, retrieval (RAG) and agentic workflows, for example with Claude, OpenAI or MCP. Strong in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, and comfortable with APIs, webhooks and SQL. Experience with workflow tools such as n8n, Make or Zapier is a plus, as is knowledge of Odoo or another ERP. A strong sense for business processes: you understand how sales, finance or operations work and talk easily with non-technical colleagues. Ownership and drive: you ship fast, measure the result and pick the work with the highest return. Security-minded: you handle company data and access rights with care. Excellent English; Dutch and/or French is a plus. What We Offer Real impact: what you build changes how every department works, and you see the result in days, not months. A small, sharp IT team that builds with AI and gives you the room to experiment. The prado family: a warm, family-driven culture with international ambition, where you quickly feel at home. Room to grow: a challenging scope with plenty of opportunities to learn, both professionally and personally. A competitive salary package, tailored to your experience and skills. Interested? Any other questions? Don't hesitate to apply.

items.title: Agentic AI Engineer
items.card: you will architect and ship production multi-agent systems that reason, plan, retrieve verified intelligence, and execute controlled actions across complex enterprise and engineering workflows. You won't just build individual agents—you will help define the platform, standards, and reusable capability catalogue for how Thales deploys agentic AI at scale. Location: Crawley / Bristol / Reading / Glasgow / Belfast /
items.desc: Location: Crawley, United Kingdom Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services. Most GenAI roles ask you to wrap a public API around a chat interface and hope for the best. At Thales UK, you’ll be tackling a much harder—and far more interesting—engineering problem: how to make autonomous AI agents safe, deterministic, and trustworthy inside regulated, high-security, and mission-critical environments. Working at the heart of Thales UK’s AI capability alongside cortAIx Factory , you will architect and ship production multi-agent systems that reason, plan, retrieve verified intelligence, and execute controlled actions across complex enterprise and engineering workflows. You won't just build individual agents—you will help define the platform, standards, and reusable capability catalogue for how Thales deploys agentic AI at scale. Location: Crawley / Bristol / Reading / Glasgow / Belfast / Cheadle (Hybrid) What You’ll Actually Be Building Production Multi-Agent Workflows: Design and deploy stateful, tool-using agents (using frameworks like LangGraph, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel) that handle complex planning, memory, structured outputs, and graceful fallbacks—far beyond the PoC stage. Zero-Trust Tooling & Interoperability: Architect secure orchestration layers and API contracts using emerging standards like MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent-to-agent patterns, enforcing identity-aware access and least-privilege execution. High-Assurance Knowledge Pipelines: Build robust RAG and GraphRAG pipelines with strict metadata filtering, document provenance, and permission-aware retrieval across complex technical datasets. Sovereign & Constrained Model Deployment: Select, optimize, and serve models based on strict latency, cost, and data-sovereignty constraints—including on-premise, disconnected, and air-gapped environments. Adversarial Defense & AI Security: Engineer guardrails against prompt injection, data exfiltration, and excessive agency. Lead threat modeling, red-teaming, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) approval gates so autonomy stays bounded. True LLMOps & Evaluation: Replace "vibe checks" with automated regression testing, golden evaluation datasets, distributed tracing, observability, and strict prompt/model release controls. What You Bring To The Table We care more about production engineering rigor than hype. You’ll thrive here if you have: Strong Software Engineering Roots: Deep fluency in Python, API design (REST/gRPC), automated testing, secure coding, Docker, and Kubernetes. Hands-On Agentic Experience: Proven track record taking LLM/agentic applications from discovery into live production—managing state, memory, retries, and non-deterministic failure modes. Deep Retrieval & Context Engineering: Practical command of embeddings, vector and knowledge graph stores, hybrid search, and data governance. Evaluation & Observability Mindset: Experience measuring and debugging agent behavior in production using tracing, telemetry, and automated/human eval frameworks. Security-First Instincts: A solid grasp of IAM, secrets management, sandboxing, supply-chain security, and Responsible AI principles (explainability, robustness, safety assurance). Bonus Points For: Deploying open-weights models in sovereign, classified, edge, or resource-constrained environments. Experience in defense, aerospace, critical national infrastructure, FinTech, or other heavily regulated engineering domains. Acting as a technical authority, defining reference architectures, or contributing to open-source AI tooling/standards. Why Thales UK? High-Stakes Engineering: Your work directly impacts aerospace, defense, space, and critical national infrastructure—solving real operational problems rather than chasing vanity metrics. Access to cortAIx: Collaborate directly with Thales’s dedicated AI research and accelerator ecosystem, bridging cutting-edge R&D with hardened enterprise engineering. Shape the Blueprint: Join early enough in our agentic capability build-out to influence our core architecture, tech stack, and engineering standards from the ground up. Qualifications: Degree/Master’s in Computer Science, AI, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field—or equivalent hands-on engineering track record. Benefits Performance-related bonus Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with opportunity to buy up to 40 hours/year (pro rata) 24 hours volunteering paid for Private healthcare Pension scheme Life cover 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app Employee discount shopping schemes on …

items.desc: Rothschild & Co Rothschild & Co est un groupe international de services financiers de premier plan, contrôlé par la famille depuis sept générations et au centre des marchés financiers depuis plus de 200 ans. Notre expertise, notre savoir-faire et notre réseau mondial nous permettent de proposer une vision unique qui bénéficie à l’activité et la richesse de nos clients et de nos parties prenantes, en respectant notre planète. Nos équipes de 4 200 spécialistes du conseil financier présents sur le terrain dans plus de 40 pays, apportent une vision internationale unique à travers quatre activités de premier plan – Global Advisory, Wealth Management, Asset Management et Five Arrows. En notre qualité de groupe familial fondé sur les relations humaines, nous attachons une importance particulière au recrutement et au développement de carrière de nos collaborateurs afin qu'ils puissent s'épanouir dans leur parcours professionnel. Rothschild & Co Martin Maurel recherche un(e) stagiaire pour une durée de 6 mois à partir de Janvier 2027. Le/la stagiaire sera intégré(e) au sein des équipes Assurances de Marseille. Au sein de l'équipe Assurance, vous participerez à un projet de transformation digitale visant à automatiser et optimiser des processus opérationnels grâce à l'intelligence artificielle. En lien direct avec les équipes métier, vous interviendrez de l'identification des besoins jusqu'à la conception, au paramétrage et au test de solutions d'automatisation et d'agents IA. Vos principales missions analyser et cartographier les processus existants identifier les tâches répétitives et chronophages pouvant être automatisées imaginer et concevoir des solutions d’automatisation et des agents IA développer des cas d’usage autour de la gestion documentaire, du suivi des dossiers, des contrôles et des relances automatiser certains traitements opérationnels tester les solutions et mettre en place les contrôles nécessaires, avec une validation humaine lorsque celle-ci est requise documenter les outils développés et accompagner les utilisateurs dans leur prise en main Des réalisations concrètes Vous travaillerez sur de véritables cas d'usage métier. L'objectif sera de développer des prototypes puis des solutions suffisamment abouties pour permettre leur industrialisation, tout en améliorant la fiabilité et l'efficacité des traitements. Votre profil Vous préparez une formation Bac+4/Bac+5 en école d'ingénieurs, informatique, Data, intelligence artificielle, systèmes d'information, transformation digitale, ou en école de commerce avec une spécialisation Data, IA ou transformation digitale. Vous avez une réelle appétence pour l'intelligence artificielle appliquée aux métiers et l'automatisation des processus. Compétences appréciées Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate ou Power Apps ; Microsoft 365, SharePoint et Excel ; Python et/ou utilisation d’API ; IA générative et principes de RAG. Vos qualités curiosité et esprit analytique ; autonomie et capacité à proposer des solutions ; rigueur et sens du contrôle ; aisance dans les échanges avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques capacité à documenter clairement les solutions ; sensibilité aux enjeux de confidentialité et de sécurité des données. La connaissance du secteur de l'Assurance constitue un plus, mais n'est pas indispensable. Votre capacité à comprendre rapidement un processus métier et à imaginer comment la technologie peut le simplifier et le sécuriser sera essentielle .

items.desc: Dans le cadre du déploiement de Microsoft Copilot et de l’accélération des usages de l’intelligence artificielle au sein de Distribution France, la Direction recherche deux stagiaires pour accompagner les collaborateurs dans l’appropriation opérationnelle des nouveaux outils. Les stagiaires interviendront prioritairement sur l’identification des besoins des collaborateurs, la création d’une bibliothèque de prompts, la diffusion des bonnes pratiques et la mesure de l’adoption. Identifier les cas d’usage collaborateurs à forte valeur Rencontrer les collaborateurs des différentes équipes de Distribution France. Observer et analyser les tâches récurrentes ou chronophages. Recueillir les besoins liés à la recherche, la rédaction, la synthèse, l’analyse et la préparation de rendez-vous. Identifier les usages possibles dans Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook et Teams. Prioriser les cas d’usage selon leur valeur opérationnelle, leur fréquence et leur potentiel de généralisation. Construire une bibliothèque de prompts Distribution France Transformer les besoins métiers en prompts simples et immédiatement utilisables. Créer des prompts adaptés aux principales situations rencontrées par les collaborateurs. Organiser les prompts par métier, outil Microsoft 365 et type de besoin. Proposer plusieurs niveaux d’utilisation, de la prise en main à l’usage avancé. Documenter les données nécessaires, les résultats attendus et les points de contrôle. Tester et fiabiliser les prompts Mettre en œuvre une démarche structurée : besoin métier, prompt, test, amélioration, validation utilisateur et diffusion. Constituer des groupes d’utilisateurs pilotes. Recueillir leurs retours et améliorer les prompts. Vérifier la simplicité, la fiabilité et la réutilisabilité des solutions proposées. Documenter les limites et les précautions d’utilisation de chaque cas d’usage. Organiser la diffusion et l’appropriation Produire des kits de prompts par métier ou par situation. Concevoir des fiches « 5 prompts utiles pour… ». Créer des démonstrations courtes et des tutoriels pratiques. Présenter des exemples avant/après permettant d’illustrer les gains obtenus. Organiser des ateliers de prise en main et des permanences Copilot. Mettre en place des formats de partage des bonnes pratiques entre équipes. Identifier et animer un réseau d’utilisateurs relais au sein de Distribution France. Mesurer l’adoption et la valeur créée Suivre le nombre de collaborateurs rencontrés et accompagnés. Mesurer le nombre de cas d’usage identifiés. Comptabiliser les prompts testés, validés, diffusés et réutilisés. Identifier les usages qui rencontrent la plus forte adoption. Recueillir les gains de temps déclarés par les utilisateurs. Mesurer la satisfaction et les difficultés persistantes. Alimenter un tableau de bord partagé avec le stagiaire chargé des usages managériaux. Profil Vous êtes curieux(se), attiré(e) par l’intelligence artificielle et avez envie de contribuer concrètement au développement de nouveaux usages ? Ce stage est fait pour vous ! Étudiant(e) en école de commerce ou à l’université, vous recherchez un stage à partir de janvier ou mars 2027. Vous avez une forte appétence pour l’intelligence artificielle générative, une bonne maîtrise de Microsoft 365 et aimez expérimenter de nouveaux usages. Curieux(se), autonome et rigoureux(se), vous disposez également d’un bon relationnel, de qualités rédactionnelles et d’un réel sens pédagogique. Une compréhension de Python et de ses principaux éléments de langage constitue un plus. Envie de rejoindre un groupe dynamique, engagé auprès des jeunes talents, labellisé HappyTrainees depuis 8 ans ? Rejoignez-nous ! Classe CCNA 4 Fonction ASSISTANT METIER - 194

items.desc: Summary Location: Espoo, Finland | Kista, Sweden | Copenhagen, Denmark | Oslo, Norway Scope: Cross-Nordic As Integrated Insights Business Partner Nordics, you will be a strategic partner to our Commercial and Value & Access (V&A) teams, generating actionable insights that enable better, faster and more informed business decisions across the Nordic organization. You will bridge strategy and execution by translating Therapeutic Area (TA) and V&A priorities into clear insights and business analytics questions. Working closely with the Data, Analytics & Platforms (DAP) pillar and external research partners, you will orchestrate the delivery of integrated insights across market research, performance analytics, competitive intelligence and forecasting. This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional role with the opportunity to influence strategic decision-making across the Nordics and help turn complex data into meaningful insights that ultimately support better outcomes for patients. About The Role Key Responsibilities Integrated Insights Partnership & Demand Shaping Act as the primary Integrated Insights partner for assigned Therapeutic Area(s) and/or V&A, consolidating insight and analytics needs across Commercial, TA and V&A stakeholders. Translate strategic priorities into clear insight needs and key business analytics questions. Plan and execute primary and secondary market research, including patient journeys, segmentation, positioning, market mapping, competitive intelligence and landscape assessments. Integrate internal KPIs with external data sources to generate holistic insights on market, customer, patient and brand performance. Maximize the use of existing international and local research through knowledge-management platforms before commissioning new research, reducing duplication and increasing efficiency. Act as a key Nordic point of contact for internationally driven primary market research. Coordinate external data acquisition, including panels and syndicated data sources, in line with Integrated Insights standards. Support effective reporting and build data literacy around market, sales and patient data. Act as the TA point of contact for relevant secondary data sources, including IQVIA datasets and solutions. Forecasting & Market Model Support Develop and maintain relevant market assumptions for forecasting, including epidemiology, market uptake, competitor events and access milestones. Partner with DAP to translate business assumptions into dashboards and analytics, co-creating research designs as well as KPI and Commercial Success Indicator requirements. Collaborate with TA, Finance and V&A to provide market and access inputs into product and TA forecasts and scenario planning. Assess growth opportunities and help establish a single, aligned set of market assumptions across functions. Provide relevant insights and inputs to Field Excellence for incentive target setting. Data Analysis & Interpretation Define and align relevant KPIs to measure business performance and support strategic decision-making. Analyze complex datasets from multiple sources to identify meaningful trends, patterns, opportunities and risks. Generate insights across areas such as market and financial performance, competition, source of business, customer engagement and patient dynamics. Conduct in-depth analysis of market trends, customer behaviors and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and potential threats. Reporting & Data Storytelling Transform complex data and analysis into clear, actionable business insights and recommendations. Develop compelling reports, presentations and data stories for senior and cross-functional stakeholders. Collaborate with data teams to ensure data quality and integrity and identify opportunities to enhance existing data products, dashboards and analytics capabilities. Key Performance Indicators Success In This Role Will Include Delivery of prioritized TA and V&A insight roadmaps within agreed timelines. Quality, relevance and actionability of insights for Commercial, TA and V&A stakeholders. Robust and clearly articulated market assumptions supporting forecasting and scenario planning. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments. We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions. WHY JOIN US The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty. You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms. We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing. About The Team You will join STARK’s Internal AI & Infrastructure team. Rather than building theoretical tools, we embed into cross-functional teams across Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Corporate functions to ship secure, production-ready AI workflows that streamline operations and empower teams. YOUR MISSION As an AI Solutions Engineer, you will bridge the gap between frontier AI capabilities and operational workflows. You will partner with teams—from hardware engineering to C-level executives—to structure processes, rapidly build reliable AI solutions, and upskill colleagues through documentation and coaching. What You Will Do At Stark Partner with cross-functional teams to identify high-leverage use cases and translate loose requirements into structured workflows. Prioritize high-ROI automations and rapidly ship working v0.1 prototypes to users. Build production-ready AI solutions (agentic workflows, custom skills, MCP connectors, LLM tools) using Gemini Enterprise, Python, and APIs. Establish evaluation standards, test harnesses, and clean data pipelines to ensure tool reliability and usability. Ensure enterprise-grade security, defence data privacy compliance, robust database persistence, and documentation. Coach and upskill colleagues through pair-building, workshops, and Show & Tell sessions. Stay ahead of AI developments, evaluate new models, and represent STARK in local AI communities. What You Bring To The Mission Degree in CS, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience with software architecture, databases, APIs, and Python/TypeScript. 1–2+ years of hands-on experience with modern AI technologies: agentic workflows, MCP connectors, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and evals. Executive presence and ability to work autonomously with stakeholders from shop-floor technicians to C-level leaders. Strong communication skills with a passion for teaching and enabling others. Solid engineering discipline regarding data hygiene, compliance, documentation, and maintainability. Willingness to travel ~1x/month between Munich, Berlin, and international STARK sites. Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory. NICE TO HAVE Experience as Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, or Freelance Builder. Experience with Google Cloud / Gemini Enterprise or deploying on-premise open-weight models in secure environments. Fluency in German, making it even easier to run local workshops across our Munich and Berlin offices. If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English . We're looking forward to meeting you! . 
 Overview 
 All’interno della Direzione Chief Audit Officer, entrerai nell’Audit ICT e Sicurezza e contribuirai a rafforzare la resilienza digitale del Gruppo. Il ruolo prevede lo svolgimento di audit sui sistemi di Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI e Agentic AI, con l’obiettivo di valutarne principalmente gli spetti di affidabilità, robustezza, ciclo di sviluppo, sicurezza e conformità, in un contesto internazionale, innovativo e in continua evoluzione. 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Svolgere audit sui processi ICT e sui sistemi di Artificial Intelligence e Generative AI, valutandone governance, affidabilità, robustezza, ciclo di sviluppo, sicurezza e conformità. 
 Verificare l’intero ciclo di vita delle soluzioni AI: progettazione, sviluppo, addestramento, validazione, rilascio, monitoraggio e dismissione. 
 Progettare, sviluppare, eseguire ed analizzare il risultato di test volti a verificare la qualità dei dati, explainability, bias, allucinazioni, prompt injection, data leakage e uso improprio delle informazioni. 
 Valutare l’adeguatezza del framework di AI Governance, verificando ruoli e responsabilità, processi di approvazione, classificazione dei casi d’uso, gestione dei rischi e monitoraggio continuo. 
 Valutare la robustezza del sistema dei controlli interni e predisporre i report degli interventi di audit, monitorando l’attuazione dei piani di azione concordati con le strutture coinvolte 
 Contribuire all’evoluzione delle metodologie di audit e all’analisi dei rischi connessi all’Artificial Intelligence, collaborando con stakeholder tecnici e di business. 
 Chi stiamo cercando 
 Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: 
 Laurea in discipline informatiche, ingegneristiche, matematiche, economiche o ambiti affini; 
 Lingua inglese almeno a livello B2 secondo la scala CEFR; 
 Information Technology, Risk Management o Internal Audit; 
 Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning e Generative/Agentic AI, con particolare riferimento ai relativi cicli di vita, ai Large Language Model (LLM), alle architetture RAG e ai principali framework e strumenti per lo sviluppo di soluzioni di AI; 
 Capacità di analizzare e valutare i controlli implementati nel ciclo di vita e di disegnare / svolgere test tecnici sulle soluzioni di AI; 
 Rischi dei sistemi AI: bias, allucinazioni, prompt injection, data leakage, qualità dei dati, explainability e utilizzo improprio delle informazioni; 
 AI Governance, gestione del rischio e principali piattaforme e tecnologie AI. 
 Costituiscono titolo preferenziale la conoscenza approfondita di AI Act, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISACA AI Framework, ISO IEC 42001, COBIT e ISO IEC 27001, nonché certificazioni in Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics, Internal Audit o Risk Management. 
 Sono richiesti almeno 5 anni di esperienza in ambito: Artificial Intelligence, IT Audit, Cybersecurity o attività affini .
