items.desc: Tec6 recrute ! Consultant(e) IA & Transformation numérique (H/F) Et si vous accompagniez les entreprises dans leur révolution IA ? L'intelligence artificielle transforme rapidement les usages professionnels. Mais pour beaucoup d'entreprises, une question demeure : comment passer de la découverte de l'IA à son utilisation concrète au quotidien ? C'est pour répondre à cette question que Tec6 développe une nouvelle activité de conseil et d'accompagnement à l'intégration de l'intelligence artificielle dans les entreprises. Nous recherchons un(e) passionné(e) d'informatique et d'IA générative, capable de faire le lien entre les nouvelles technologies et les besoins réels de nos clients. Qui sommes-nous ? Fondée en 2008, Tec6 est une entreprise de services numériques (ESN) à taille humaine, spécialisée dans l'accompagnement informatique des entreprises. Nos activités couvrent notamment : L'infogérance et l'administration des systèmes informatiques. Les infrastructures, le cloud et l'hébergement. La cybersécurité et la protection des données. Le conseil et l'accompagnement dans la transformation numérique. L'intégration de solutions technologiques, avec une forte sensibilité aux logiciels open source. Notre approche repose sur la proximité avec nos clients, la maîtrise technique et la recherche de solutions pragmatiques. Aujourd'hui, nous souhaitons franchir une nouvelle étape en accompagnant nos clients dans l'adoption et l'intégration des technologies d'intelligence artificielle. Votre mission : rendre l'IA utile et accessible aux entreprises Vous participerez activement à la création et au développement de notre nouvelle activité IA. Au contact direct de nos clients, vous interviendrez sur plusieurs dimensions. 1. Conseil et accompagnement Comprendre les métiers, les processus et les problématiques de nos clients. Identifier les opportunités d'utilisation de l'IA dans leurs activités. Proposer des solutions adaptées à leurs besoins et à leur environnement informatique. Accompagner les entreprises dans leur transition vers les outils d'IA. 2. Intégration et déploiement Installer, configurer et intégrer des solutions d'IA générative. Mettre en œuvre des assistants IA adaptés aux différents métiers. Connecter les outils d'IA aux applications et aux données des entreprises. Participer à l'automatisation de processus grâce à l'IA. Contribuer à la sécurité et à la confidentialité des données utilisées. 3. Formation et adoption Présenter les possibilités et les limites de l'IA générative. Former les utilisateurs aux bonnes pratiques du prompting. Accompagner les collaborateurs dans la prise en main des outils. Favoriser l'adoption durable des nouvelles technologies. 4. Veille et innovation Tester les nouveaux modèles et outils d'IA. Comparer les solutions commerciales et open source. Participer à la création de démonstrateurs et de preuves de concept (POC). Contribuer à la construction de notre catalogue de services IA. Les compétences que nous recherchons Formation et expérience Formation supérieure en informatique, Bac +3 minimum. Expérience professionnelle d'au moins 2 ans dans l'informatique, le développement, l'intégration ou le conseil technique. Intérêt marqué et pratique régulière des technologies d'intelligence artificielle. Compétences IA Vous connaissez et utilisez plusieurs outils d'IA générative, notamment : ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini et Microsoft Copilot pour les usages professionnels. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot ou des assistants de développement similaires. Les techniques de prompt engineering : construction, structuration et optimisation des prompts. Les principes de fonctionnement et les limites des grands modèles de langage (LLM). Vous manifestez également une réelle curiosité pour l'écosystème open source, notamment : OpenWebUI, pour la mise à disposition d'assistants IA. OpenCode, pour le développement assisté par IA. Ollama, pour l'exécution locale de modèles. Les modèles ouverts tels que Qwen, Mistral ou DeepSeek. Une expérience sur ces dernières technologies serait appréciée, mais nous recherchons surtout une personne désireuse de les explorer et de les maîtriser. Compétences techniques complémentaires appréciées Connaissances en Python, JavaScript ou scripting. Utilisation des API REST et des formats JSON. Notions de Docker et d'environnements Linux. Expérience des outils d'automatisation comme n8n. Connaissances des principes de RAG (exploitation de documents et de bases de connaissances par l'IA). Sensibilité aux enjeux de sécurité et de confidentialité des données. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes. SentinelOne is looking for a Professional Services Architect with solid enterprise cybersecurity expertise, strong hands-on delivery experience, and a proven ability to design and implement effective security solutions for complex customer environments. This is a hands-on, customer-facing technical role. You are not a people manager, and you are not primarily pre-sales. You are a skilled technical practitioner who takes ownership of customer engagements from discovery and solution design through to deployment, handover, and long-term customer success. You bring technical credibility, clear communication, and a consultative approach to every engagement you lead. Deploy and configure Prompt Security across enterprise scenarios, including employee AI tool access, developer AI workflows, home-grown AI applications, and browser-based controls via enterprise MDM. Advise customers on AI governance, data protection, and policy enforcement, addressing risks such as prompt injection and shadow AI usage. Troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges during active deployments, escalating appropriately when complex architectural decisions arise. Partner with pre-sales teams to scope engagements and provide technical input into Statements of Work (SOWs). Work alongside channel partners (MSSPs, system integrators, resellers), providing technical guidance during joint engagements, building their delivery capability over time. Contribute to internal and partner-facing delivery documentation, implementation guides, and technical reference materials. Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and represent their technical needs internally. What skills and knowledge should you bring? Ideal candidates will have: 5+ years of experience in enterprise cybersecurity, with meaningful time in customer-facing technical roles such as Professional Service or Security Engineering. Solid hands-on experience with enterprise EDR/XDR, including deployment, configuration, integration, and migrations from incumbent platforms. Good understanding of endpoint telemetry, detection and response workflows, and integration with SIEM, identity, and cloud security platforms. Experience contributing to engagement scoping, effort estimation, and SOW input. Strong communication skills across technical and business stakeholders. Proficiency across Windows, Linux, and/or macOS environments (installation, configuration, administration, security best practices). items.desc: Build a dependable path to production Advania’s AI organisation is developing a sovereign Trusted AI Platform and a growing product portfolio for organisations with high requirements for security, reliability, traceability and data residency. As our AI DevOps Engineer, you will build, develop and operate the delivery platform that takes changes from source code to production. During your first year, your main focus will be to establish reusable CI/CD and GitOps workflows that give engineering teams fast feedback, repeatable deployments and secure defaults. This is a senior individual contributor role without personnel responsibility. As the team’s first specialist with dedicated DevOps responsibility, you will have significant influence over shared standards and ways of working. What you will build and operate You will take end-to-end responsibility for the delivery chain by: building and standardising CI/CD pipelines in GitLab operating, scaling, upgrading and troubleshooting GitLab Runners establishing GitOps-based delivery with Flux CD or equivalent technology creating reliable patterns for deployment, versioning and promotion between environments managing artefacts, packages and container images in Artifactory or an equivalent solution developing reusable pipeline templates and self-service workflows integrating security and quality controls into the delivery process contributing to metrics, logs, traces, dashboards and alerting documenting standards and turning operational learning into lasting improvements Our technical environment includes GitLab, Artifactory, Flux CD, Snyk, SigNoz and Kubernetes using Talos Linux. When a pipeline fails, a runner becomes unavailable or a GitOps reconciliation gets stuck, you investigate the cause, restore the flow and help prevent the problem from recurring. Operational responsibility and incident handling are part of the role, but the main focus is developing and improving sustainable platform solutions. Your responsibility and collaboration You will independently identify needs, prioritise improvements and take solutions through to production. Within your area, you make operational decisions and balance delivery speed with security, quality and stability. Larger changes affecting architecture or the overall technical direction are aligned with the Platform Tech Lead. You will also work closely with the Platform Engineer, engineering teams and specialists within security and infrastructure. A central part of the role is understanding how engineering teams work and translating their needs into practical improvements. You communicate recommendations and risks clearly, involve the right expertise and build solutions that reduce manual work and the need for specialist support. What you need to bring We are looking for someone with: deep hands-on experience designing, building and operating CI/CD solutions in GitLab, including reusable pipelines and GitLab Runners practical experience with GitOps and declarative application delivery experience managing artefacts, container images, versioning and promotion between environments demonstrated experience independently building, operating and troubleshooting production-critical delivery platforms used by several engineering teams the ability to investigate complex technical problems and make sound trade-offs between delivery speed, security, quality and stability very good spoken and written English Experience with Flux CD and Artifactory is particularly relevant, but equivalent tools and ways of working are equally valuable. It is also meritorious to have experience with Kubernetes and Helm, software supply-chain security, regulated or security-sensitive production environments, or AI/ML and GPU-enabled infrastructure. Swedish is valuable but not required. You do not need previous AI experience or expertise in every technology in our environment. Your ability to create dependable delivery workflows and take responsibility for them in production will carry the greatest weight. Our difference is you. We look forward to receiving your application! Please apply as soon as possible, as we are interviewing on a rolling basis. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, with different experiences and perspectives, because we know that greater diversity enriches each of us and strengthens both the efficiency and creativity of our work. As part of our recruitment process, final candidates undergo a mandatory background check, which is an important quality step for us ahead of any hiring decision. items.desc: Be part of a new approach to community mental health care in Westminster Are you an experienced mental health practitioner who wants to help shape a more accessible, joined-up and community-focused model of support? You will be a qualified Nurse, Social Worker or Occupational Therapist with experience of community mental health settings. We are looking for an enthusiastic and highly skilled Neighbourhood Mental Health Practitioner to join the developing Westminster Neighbourhood Mental Health Centre at The Gordon. The NMHC will bring together mental health, primary care, social care, voluntary and community organisations to provide a welcoming and accessible neighbourhood offer. People will be able to approach the service through walk-in, telephone, digital and partner routes, including people who are not currently known to secondary mental health services. Rather than relying on repeated assessments or passive signposting, the service will work alongside people to understand their immediate needs, strengths and risks, provide a proportionate response and connect them with the right clinical, social, practical and community support. As a Band 7 MH Practitioner, you will be a senior autonomous practitioner and a visible source of clinical leadership within the NMHC. You will: undertake specialist, holistic assessment, formulation and collaborative care planning within your area of expertise; provide evidence-informed brief interventions within your professional competence; support people experiencing complex needs, acute distress, deterioration or urgent risk; provide senior advice, consultation and safe escalation; promote continuity through active navigation and handovers; provide clinical supervision, reflective practice and practice support; contribute to clinical governance, audit, incident learning and quality improvement; support staff development across the integrated workforce; and help develop and evaluate pathways, standards and outcome measures for the new service. The postholder will work closely with CNWL community services, primary care, Integrated Neighbourhood Teams, social care, housing, employment, voluntary and community organisations, peer workers and urgent-care services. You will act as a senior point of reference when colleagues are managing complex presentations, safeguarding concerns or clinical uncertainty. You will help ensure that the NMHC remains open and welcoming while maintaining safe, proportionate assessment, risk management and escalation arrangements. This is an opportunity to help establish a genuinely integrated neighbourhood model from its early stages. You will have the scope to influence clinical practice, develop new pathways, strengthen relationships across local services and improve how people experience access to mental health support. You will join a team committed to: open and inclusive access; continuity rather than repeated referral and assessment; co-production with residents and people with lived experience; ‘no wrong door’ handovers and trusted relationships; recovery, independence and community connection; reducing inequalities in access and outcomes; and creating a psychologically safe and learning-focused workforce. The role also offers opportunities for professional development, supervision, multidisciplinary learning, service evaluation and quality-improvement work. Main Responsibilities Profession-Specific Clinical Leadership Provide advanced assessment and intervention using the knowledge and scope of the appointed profession while contributing fully to shared multidisciplinary practice. Provide senior clinical advice on mental-state assessment, risk, physical health, medicine-related concerns within competence, relapse prevention and coordination with medical and nursing pathways. Develop profession-specific pathways, standards and outcome measures which complement the wider integrated team offer. Provide professional supervision and practice support according to the appointee’s registration, competence and agreed governance arrangements. Maintain a balanced focus on immediate response, longer-term recovery, physical health, social context and functional outcomes. Clinical Practice and Open-Access Response Provide specialist, holistic and proportionate assessment of mental health, psychosocial needs, strengths, risk, safeguarding and protective factors, using professional judgement in situations of uncertainty and complexity. Develop collaborative formulations and person-centred plans which support immediate safety, recovery, continuity, independence and connection to neighbourhood resources. Provide evidence-informed brief interventions within professional competence and support access to longer-term treatment where indicated. Act as a senior clinical point of reference for staff responding to complex needs, deterioration, safeguarding concerns and urgent risk. items.desc: Devoteam Data Driven est l’entité spécialisée en Data & IA du Groupe Devoteam. Elle accompagne les entreprises dans la définition et le déploiement de stratégies Data & IA adaptées à leurs enjeux métiers et business. Avec plus de 900 experts répartis dans la région EMEA, Data Driven intervient sur des projets Data & IA ambitieux et à fort impact , en mobilisant les technologies les plus avancées pour répondre à des problématiques métiers concrètes et créer de la valeur durable. Description Du Poste Développer des applications de GenAI au sein d’une plateforme Data & IA (Databricks Genie ou équivalent) : solutions RAG, chatbots, assistants métiers et agents IA. Construire les pipelines de données non structurées : extraction, chunking, embeddings, Vector Search Concevoir et optimiser les prompts, les chaînes et les workflows agentiques (tools, MCP) Évaluer et monitorer la qualité des réponses (LLM-as-a-judge, jeux de tests, observabilité) Industrialiser et exposer les solutions (API, Model Serving, CI/CD) Faire de la veille sur les modèles et frameworks et la partager avec les équipes Exemples d'environnement technique Les technologies varient selon les missions et les clients. Voici des exemples d'environnements sur lesquels vous pourrez intervenir : Databricks : Mosaic AI (Agent Framework, Vector Search, Model Serving, AI Gateway), Genie, MLflow, Unity Catalog Modèles : OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral Frameworks : LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, MCP Langages & outils : Python, FastAPI, Docker, Git, CI/CD Qualifications Prérequis Bac+5 obligatoire. 3 ans d’expérience minimum sur un poste similaire. Anglais courant indispensable. Expérience confirmée en GenAI : LLM, RAG et Agentic AI. Maîtrise de Python. Connaissance de Databricks Mosaic AI et/ou Genie. Notions d’industrialisation : API, conteneurs et CI/CD. Les plus Certification Databricks Generative AI Engineer Associate. Expérience en fine-tuning et évaluation de LLM. Expérience en cabinet de conseil ou ESN. Savoir-être Curiosité technique et veille technologique. Sens du service client et posture de conseil. Esprit d’équipe, rigueur et capacité de vulgarisation. Informations supplémentaires Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Des projets data et IA à fort impact chez de grands comptes, sur des technologies de pointe Une communauté d'experts pour partager, apprendre et progresser Un accompagnement de votre carrière et de vos certifications Devoteam est un groupe international de conseil spécialisé dans la stratégie digitale, les plateformes technologiques, la Data et la cybersécurité. Le Groupe accompagne les entreprises dans leur transformation digitale afin de renforcer leur agilité, leur compétitivité et leur croissance durable. Ce poste est ouvert à toutes et à tous. Devoteam s'engage en faveur de la diversité et de l'inclusion, et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

items.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Data & AI, Azure)
items.card: you will work where the problem is: with the client. Our Data & AI team builds custom, code-based solutions for enterprise clients. These include knowledge assistants and search over company content, AI agents connected to business systems, and the data platforms these solutions depend on. You will run discovery, turn business needs into a solution architecture on Azure and build the first working version yourself.
items.desc: Are you a solution architect who still enjoys writing code? Do you like working directly with clients, turning vague business needs into working Data & AI solutions? Would you like to help build SoftwareOne's AI capability in Hungary, with Microsoft Foundry, Fabric and Databricks? Practical Information: Location: Budapest, Hungary | Reports to: Team Lead Dat a | Work Arrangement: Hybrid (3 days in the office as customer requirement) | Visa Requirements: Valid work visa for Hungary | Language Requirements: P rofessional level English & Hungarian As a Forward Deployed Engineer (Data & AI, Azure) , you will work where the problem is: with the client. Our Data & AI team builds custom, code-based solutions for enterprise clients. These include knowledge assistants and search over company content, AI agents connected to business systems, and the data platforms these solutions depend on. You will run discovery, turn business needs into a solution architecture on Azure and build the first working version yourself. Then you will either hand it over to our engineers or stay with it into delivery. You will work alongside data platform specialists (Microsoft Fabric, Databricks), AI application engineers and SoftwareOne's international AI community. Our main AI platform is Microsoft Foundry (formerly Azure AI Foundry), together with the wider Azure ecosystem. Key Responsibilities: Lead discovery workshops with business and IT stakeholders, and assess AI use cases for value, feasibility and data readiness Design target architectures on Azure: Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Search, Fabric or Databricks, integration, identity, networking and security Build proofs of concept hands-on and take them through to client acceptance Assess data prerequisites: data quality, access rights, governance, and the platform changes an AI solution needs Estimate effort and shape scope for proposals, together with presales and sales Hand over solutions to delivery teams with a clear architecture, documented decisions and a realistic backlog Review solutions for production readiness: security, evaluation, monitoring and running cost Present to technical teams and decision-makers, and explain trade-offs in plain language Job Requirements 6+ years in IT, including at least 3 years as an architect, tech lead or senior engineer on client-facing project Solid Azure architecture knowledge: Entra ID and RBAC, networking (VNet, private endpoints), Key Vault, monitoring and cost management Hands-on data experience: you have designed or built a data platform or data pipelines (Databricks, Microsoft Fabric or Synapse), with strong SQL and data modeling skills At least one LLM-based solution (RAG, agent or document processing) that reached real users, where you shaped the architecture. You can explain how it was built, how its quality was measured and what went wrong Ability to build a working prototype in Python yourself Ability to run a workshop and turn a vague business request into a scoped, estimated solution Fluent Hungarian and professional working English What we offer: Global Company Culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture (https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values) The opportunity to work on complex enterprise Data & AI transformation projects. Access to Microsoft, Databricks, and cloud training and certification programs. Collaboration with experienced architects, engineers, security specialists, and AI experts. Career development opportunities across engineering, architecture, consulting, and technical leadership paths. Structured Onboarding: A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action Home Office Allowance: Monthly financial support for your remote working days. Cafeteria Package (including SZÉP card) Commuting Support: If you live outside Budapest, we cover commuting costs to the office and client locations. Health & Wellbeing: Private Medicover health insurance and additional health fund contribution. Work-Life Harmony: Extra day off for your birthday and additional company-specific days off. The Human in the Loop: Regular team events and opportunities to connect and collaborate beyond daily work. Company description SoftwareOne is a global software and cloud solutions provider and distributor, powered by around 12,000 people across more than 70 countries. But what really makes us SoftwareOne is our people: curious minds, different perspectives, and talented teams working together to solve real challenges and create meaningful impact. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to grow, explore new possibilities, and build a career that’s uniquely yours, while helping shape what’s next in technology.

items.desc: Who We Are At Taptap, we are not just shaping the future of advertising technology — we are building it today. Guided by teamwork, respect, and determination, we challenge the status quo, connect ideas with impact, and create innovative solutions that drive real results. Our culture thrives on visionary thinking, collaboration, and a deep respect for people — because good people doing great things is what makes us stronger. As a global team, we believe in pushing boundaries, fostering growth, and exceeding expectations. We are authentic, ambitious, and passionate about what we do, and we never settle for less than excellence. If you're looking to be part of a company that values creativity, problem-solving, and the power of technology, we'd love to hear from you. Short Job Description Reporting directly to the AI & Automation Manager and based in Madrid, the AI & Automation Engineer will join a small, fast-moving team building our internal AI platform — a multi-agent system used every day by the Revenue, Operations, Product, and People teams across the company. This is an entry point into the field, and we mean that literally: we are looking for someone who has just finished their degree (or is about to), who already lives inside tools like Claude and ChatGPT, and who wants to turn that fluency into real engineering work. We are hiring for potential and fluency, not for years on a CV. You will not be shadowing someone for six months: you will be shipping agents, tools, and automations that people use the same week you build them. If you have spent the last year building things with LLMs because you found it genuinely interesting — not because a course told you to — this role is designed for you. What You Will Do Build and evolve AI agents on our internal platform: system prompts, tool definitions, MCP connections, retrieval sources, and evaluation of their output quality. Build and orchestrate automation workflows in n8n — this will be one of your core tools. You will design, maintain, and scale the workflows that connect our internal systems (Slack, Google Workspace, Jira/Confluence, our own DSP) and remove manual work from other teams' day-to-day. Work with data and metrics as a first-class part of the role. Build and maintain dashboards in Grafana, query our data sources, and turn campaign and platform data into signals that both people and agents can act on. Integrate and maintain MCP servers and tools, connecting agents to real data sources and real actions. Work on the RAG layer: curating knowledge bases, improving retrieval quality, and closing the loop between what users ask and what the agent actually knows. Read, debug, and extend TypeScript/JavaScript code in our orchestration layer — you will spend real time in the codebase, not only in a prompt editor. Sit with internal users, understand their workflow, and iterate on the agent until it actually solves their problem. Measure what you build: usage, adoption, failure patterns, and where the agent gets it wrong. Stay ahead of the curve. This field changes monthly; part of the job is bringing new capabilities to the team before we are asked for them. Requirements Of The Role A technical background — how you got it matters less than what you can do with it. A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field works, but so does a vocational qualification (FP in development or similar), an AI-focused bootcamp, or a self-taught path backed by things you have actually built. Attitude and real understanding of the field carry more weight here than the name on the certificate. Working knowledge of JavaScript and TypeScript — you can read an existing codebase, understand what it does, and modify it with confidence. Real, hands-on fluency with AI tooling. You use Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar as part of how you work every day, and you know where they help and where they fail. A solid grasp of how modern AI systems actually work, and comfort with the vocabulary we use daily: agents, system prompts, context windows, conversation history, memory, tools and function calling, MCP, RAG, and the harness/orchestration layer that ties it all together. Basic understanding of databases and REST APIs. Curiosity and autonomy: you are comfortable with ambiguity, you look things up, and you propose solutions rather than waiting for specs. English at a level that lets you work comfortably with technical documentation (B1 is enough). Most of our tooling, docs, and model providers are English-only; you do not need to be fluent in conversation. Nice to have Python. Personal or academic projects involving LLMs, agents, or automation — repos, side projects, hackathons. We care more about this than about your grades. Experience with automation platforms such as n8n, Make, or Zapier. PostgreSQL, and familiarity with vector databases or embeddings. Git and basic Docker. Exposure to agent frameworks or SDKs (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, …

items.desc: WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK We are proud to be consistently recognised as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH As the premier consulting partner for the private equity industry, Bain's PEG boasts a global practice that is over three times larger than any competitor. Our network of over 1,000 professionals supports private equity and institutional investor clients through every stage of the investment life cycle, from deal generation and due diligence to portfolio value creation and exit planning. Bain & Company is developing a suite of cutting-edge data and software solutions designed to revolutionise how the private equity industry uses data for investment insights and decision-making. The PEG Innovation team's mission is to create analytical solutions for Bain clients, teams, and the broader institutional investor space using proprietary software and data products. This includes the development, commercialisation, and daily management of Bain's proprietary datasets, data, and software businesses. WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM AI/ML Engineers on the Diligence Platform build and maintain the data, feature, and retrieval pipelines that power production RAG and ML systems. You work under the guidance of Senior ML Engineers and the Engineering Manager to implement and operate components of the ingestion, embedding, and retrieval stack, ship well-tested production code, and grow your ownership of these systems over time. You partner with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and the Agent / AI squad on defined pieces of larger pipelines and RAG workstreams, and you build the habits, tooling fluency, and production judgment expected of a Senior ML Engineer. This is a hands-on, growth-oriented engineering role: you are expected to ship reliable, observable code from your first weeks, and to take on increasing ownership as your track record builds. WHAT YOU’LL DO Core ML and Data Pipeline Engineering (65%) Implement and maintain components of production data and ML pipelines: ingestion jobs, feature and embedding pipelines, and Celery-based workers, under the direction of senior engineers. Build and support pieces of the RAG and retrieval stack: chunking, embedding calls, indexing into pg-vector, and basic retrieval and re-ranking logic, following established patterns. Write production-quality Python: type hints, tests, and linting to the team's standards, with code reviewed by senior engineers before merge. Instrument the pipelines and services you own with structured logs and metrics, and help build the dashboards and alerts that make issues visible. Reproduce, triage, and fix bugs in pipeline and serving code, escalating ambiguous or high-severity issues to senior engineers. Collaboration and Support (25%) Partner with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and the Agent / AI squad on defined tasks within larger pipeline, retrieval, and evaluation workstreams. Contribute test cases and sample data to evaluation harnesses and golden datasets, under the direction of senior engineers. Participate in design reviews and code reviews, both as reviewer and reviewee, building judgment about production trade-offs. Keep runbooks, READMEs, and pipeline documentation current as you build and change the systems you touch. Other (10%): Use AI coding assistants to accelerate scaffolding and boilerplate, and review generated code against team standards before committing. Use LLMs to draft documentation and status notes; validate and refine outputs before sharing them. Take on interviewing and hiring-loop participation as your experience grows. ABOUT YOU Education and Work Experience: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 2+ years of experience building software, data, or ML systems, ideally including some exposure to production pipelines or services. Exposure to model deployment, serving, or monitoring is a plus. Experience working with structured feedback and code review, and a track record of improving code quality over time. Experience collaborating with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, or the Agent / AI squad to ship features that depend on retrieval or ML outputs. Comfort with Python as a primary language; exposure to a modern cloud environment (Databricks, Azure, or AWS) is a plus. Demonstrated ability to take a well-scoped task from …

items.desc: Job Description: Was dich erwartet Betreuung und kompetente Unterstützung durch erfahrene Mitarbeiter Gestaltungsfreiraum, der neue Perspektiven für das Engagement jedes Einzelnen eröffnet Einblick in die Raumfahrtbranche eine Möglichkeit, die Zukunft von Tesat mitzugestalten und etwas zu bewegen flexible Arbeitszeit attraktive Praktikumsvergütung werteorientiertes Handeln und die Begeisterung für das was wir tun Deine Aufgaben AI Infrastruktur: Du unterstützt den Ausbau unserer AI Infrastruktur um unseren Entwickler/innen die tägliche Arbeit zu erleichtern AI Tools: Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von AI Agenten und testest diese (Datenverarbeitung, Dokumentengenerierung) AI Integration: Du unterstützt bei der Integration der AI Infrastruktur und der AI-Tools in die vorhandenen Prozesse (RAGs, Metriken, Analysen) Data Management: Du optimierst die Datenablage durch den Einsatz moderner Datenbankmethoden und -technologien. Dabei arbeitest du mit Entwicklungsdaten und entwickelst Lösungen, um diese effizienter in Datenbanken zu verarbeiten und nutzbar zu machen. Deine Qualifikation Studium: Du bist in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang eingeschrieben, z. B. Informatik, Software Engineering, Data Science, AI/Machine Learning oder vergleichbar. AI-Kenntnisse: Praktische Erfahrung mit Large Language Models (LLMs) und Prompt Engineering, auch mit strukturierter Ausgabe (z. B. JSON); du kennst ihre Grenzen, z. B. Halluzinationen. Grundlagen von Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Chunking, Embeddings, Volltext- und Vektorsuche. Du kannst die Qualität einer Suche oder eines AI-Agenten mit Testfragen messen. Sorgfältiger Umgang mit vertraulichen Daten beim Einsatz von AI. Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit AI-Agenten oder Coding-Assistenten (z. B. Claude Code, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot), MCP, lokal betriebenen Modellen (z. B. vLLM, Ollama) oder Suchmaschinen wie OpenSearch oder Elasticsearch. Dokumente: Du kannst Inhalte aus Word- und PDF-Dokumenten automatisiert auslesen (z. B. mit Docling oder python-docx) und als JSON weiterverarbeiten. Datenbanken: Kenntnisse über relationale Datenbanken sowie SQL. Optional: Kenntnisse in PLSQL sowie Oracle APEX. Anforderungsmanagement: Erfahrung mit Requirementmanagement-Tools wie ReqView, DOORS oder Polarion ist von Vorteil. Programmierung: Du bist fit in Python. Tools: Du kennst Linux und die Kommandozeile, Git/GitLab und Docker oder Podman. Sprachen: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift **Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil der Mission!** This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. Company: Tesat-Spacecom GmbH & Co. items.desc: Estamos à procura de um/a AI Developer para integrar uma equipa tecnológica dinâmica e inovadora, com foco no desenvolvimento e implementação de soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial. O/A profissional selecionado/a será responsável por desenvolver, integrar e otimizar soluções de Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML) e Generative AI , contribuindo para a criação de aplicações inteligentes, escaláveis e orientadas para as necessidades do negócio. Responsabilidades Desenvolver, implementar e manter soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning ; Conceber e integrar modelos de Generative AI e Large Language Models (LLMs) em aplicações e processos de negócio; Desenvolver soluções utilizando Python e frameworks de Inteligência Artificial; Implementar e otimizar APIs para integração de modelos de AI com sistemas e aplicações existentes; Trabalhar com técnicas de Prompt Engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e bases de dados vetoriais; Participar no desenvolvimento, treino, avaliação e otimização de modelos de Machine Learning; Colaborar com equipas de desenvolvimento, Data Science e outras áreas de negócio; Garantir a qualidade, segurança, escalabilidade e performance das soluções desenvolvidas; Acompanhar novas tecnologias e identificar oportunidades de inovação e melhoria contínua. Requisitos Técnicos Formação superior em Engenharia Informática, Ciência de Dados, Inteligência Artificial ou áreas similares; Experiência em desenvolvimento de software, preferencialmente com Python ; Conhecimentos sólidos de Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Generative AI ; Experiência com frameworks como TensorFlow, PyTorch ou Scikit-learn ; Familiaridade com LLMs e APIs de modelos de Inteligência Artificial , como OpenAI ou Azure OpenAI; Conhecimentos de LangChain, LlamaIndex ou ferramentas semelhantes; Experiência no desenvolvimento e integração de REST APIs ; Conhecimentos de bases de dados SQL e NoSQL; Experiência com Git e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software; Familiaridade com ambientes Cloud, nomeadamente Azure, AWS ou Google Cloud . Conhecimentos Valorizados Experiência na implementação de soluções RAG e bases de dados vetoriais ; Conhecimentos de MLOps, CI/CD e Docker ; Experiência com AI Agents e sistemas multiagente ; Familiaridade com técnicas de Fine-Tuning e otimização de modelos; Experiência com serviços de AI em ambientes Cloud; Conhecimentos de processamento de linguagem natural ( NLP ); Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções de AI em ambientes empresariais. Pagamento: 1 800,00€ - 2 800,00€ por mês Localização do trabalho: Trabalho remoto híbrido em Lisboa

Intégrer l'équipe Delivery & Operations au sein du Sovereign Group, en charge de la livraison industrialisée et de l'exploitation en production de trois plateformes souveraines (SNC Cloud
items.desc: CDI IT, Technologie & Produit CESSON-SEVIGNE, FR, 35510 Hybride Hybride VOTRE MISSION Site Reliability Engineer F/H/N Au sein de votre équipe #OneTeam Rejoindre le département IT, Technology & Product, qui conçoit, développe et opère les produits, les services et les infrastructures d'OVHcloud. Intégrer l'équipe Delivery & Operations au sein du Sovereign Group, en charge de la livraison industrialisée et de l'exploitation en production de trois plateformes souveraines (SNC Cloud Platform, OPCP et BMPOD SNC). Contribuer à la livraison en autonomie de services d'infrastructure (Terraform, Ansible, FluxCD, Kubernetes) et assurer la tenue des engagements de disponibilité, de performance et de sécurité en production. Participer à l'intégration de briques d'IA opérationnelles (agents, copilotes d'exploitation, RAG sur les runbooks, détection d'anomalies) pour augmenter l'équipe au quotidien. Vos principales responsabilités Industrialiser et fiabiliser la livraison des plateformes (provisioning, configuration, mise en service et décommissionnement) via une approche GitOps. Maintenir et faire évoluer le socle Kubernetes ainsi que les opérateurs gérant le cycle de vie des plateformes. Garantir la disponibilité, la performance et la sécurité des plateformes en pilotant les indicateurs SLI/SLO et les budgets d'erreur. Détecter les anomalies en optimisant l'observabilité (métriques, logs, traces), traiter les causes racines et participer aux rotations d'astreinte. Automatiser le toil pour réduire les interventions manuelles et piloter la gestion de capacité des infrastructures. Assurer le durcissement (hardening), le patch management et la conformité SecNumCloud de l'infrastructure en versionnant la documentation comme du code. Industrialiser et opérer les outils IA d'aide à l'exploitation (copilotes de diagnostic, RAG, agents MCP, revue automatisée d'IaC). Votre futur impact Dans 6 mois Vous aurez contribué à l'industrialisation et à la livraison automatisée de nouvelles briques d'infrastructure sur nos plateformes souveraines. Vous maîtriserez le socle technique du périmètre (Kubernetes, FluxCD, Terraform) et traiterez efficacement la gestion des incidents et des astreintes. Vous aurez intégré vos premiers cas d'usage d'IA appliquée aux opérations (RAG sur les runbooks, assistance au triage ou génération d'outils). Et dans 1 an Vous gagnerez en autonomie sur l'architecture et le design des évolutions des plateformes SNC Cloud Platform, OPCP et BMPOD SNC. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la réduction du toil et l'amélioration continue des SLI/SLO du périmètre. Vous aurez déployé des agents ou copilotes d'exploitation fiables et sécurisés, apportant une valeur directe au quotidien de l'équipe SRE. Compétences requises : Vous maîtrisez les fondamentaux de Linux, du réseau (TCP/IP, DNS) et l'écosystème conteneurs/Kubernetes en production. Vous déployez en mode GitOps (FluxCD/ArgoCD) et automatisez vos infrastructures avec Terraform, Ansible, Git et CI/CD. Vous avez une expérience solide en exploitation de production (SLI/SLO, astreintes, Grafana/Prometheus/Loki/OpenTelemetry). Vous développez en Python et/ou en Go pour créer des outils et des services internes robustes. Vous intégrez l'IA dans votre quotidien opérationnel et possédez des connaissances solides en cybersécurité et hardening. Vous êtes fluent en anglais, faites preuve de proactivité, d'exigence technique et d'un fort esprit d'équipe. C'est un + Vous avez déjà intégré des LLM dans des applications (RAG, agents MCP, prompt engineering) ou opéré des charges GPU/serveurs d'inférence (vLLM, KServe). Vous disposez d'une expérience sur Openstack, SecNumCloud, le provisioning bare-metal ou le développement open source. Vous êtes doté d'un grand sens du service et appréciez transmettre vos connaissances pour faire monter l'équipe en compétence. Cette offre ne correspond pas tout à fait à votre profil ? Candidatez spontanément sur notre portail candidat: nos recruteurs pourront penser à vous pour d'autres opportunités. Avertissement : offre publiée par OVHcloud, seules les informations figurant sur careers.ovhcloud.com font foi. Toute reproduction ou extraction automatisée de nos offres, notamment pour la fouille de textes et de données ou l'entraînement d'IA, est interdite, sauf par nos partenaires de diffusion ayant obtenu l'autorisation d'OVHcloud au préalable. items.card: you will be responsible for managing the financial performance of the BIOSerenity group: monthly reporting, budget, reforecast and landing, cash flow forecasts and business plan.You will drive the automation of FP&A processes and the use of AI within them. You will manage a junior FP&A analyst, first an intern and then a work-study apprentice. Permanent position (CDI), executive status (cadre), based at our Paris
items.desc: Rattaché(e) au Responsable administratif et financier, et en interaction directe avec le Directeur administratif et financier groupe, vous êtes garant(e) du pilotage de la performance financière du groupe BIOSerenity : reporting mensuel, budget, reforecast et landing, prévisions de trésorerie et business plan. Vous êtes moteur de l’automatisation et du déploiement de l’IA dans les process FP&A. Vous encadrerez un(e) FP&A analyste junior stagiaire, puis apprenti(e). Poste en CDI, statut cadre, basé au siège à Paris. BIOSerenity développe des solutions médicales connectées pour aider à diagnostiquer et à surveiller les patients atteints de maladies chroniques dans les domaines de la neurologie, des troubles du sommeil et de la cardiologie. Nous utilisons des capteurs physiologiques, une plateforme IoT, des applications et l'intelligence artificielle pour détecter des biomarqueurs numériques. Nous travaillons avec plus de 200 hôpitaux en Europe et aidons à diagnostiquer plus de cent mille patients par an. En tant que FP&A Manager, vous travaillez avec la direction générale, les directions opérationnelles et les équipes Finance, et avez sous votre responsabilité les missions suivantes : 1. Reporting et pilotage de la performance Produire le Monthly Report à destination de la direction, du board et des actionnaires, dans les délais cibles ( J+8) et avec un haut niveau de fiabilité (chaîne de production outillée, contrôles de cohérence automatisés). Préparer et animer les business reviews mensuelles par activité (Neurologie, Sommeil, Cardiologie) : analyse des drivers, plans d’actions et suivi dans le temps. Préparer et animer la revue du pipeline commercial avec les équipes Sales (Salesforce). Construire et suivre les indicateurs opérationnels clés (activité, productivité, effectifs). 2. Budget, reforecast et landing Piloter le processus budgétaire annuel avec les cost center managers. Produire les reforecasts et le landing, analyser les écarts entre le réalisé, le budget et le reforecast, et proposer des plans d’actions. 3. Cash et financement Établir le cash flow reforecast et les analyses du BFR (DSO, DPO, stocks). Suivre les covenants bancaires et contribuer aux reportings destinés aux prêteurs. Contribuer aux opérations de financement (equity, venture debt) : investor updates, modélisations, data room. 4. Business plan et modèles économiques Construire et maintenir le modèle business plan / budget / forecast (P&L, bilan et cash flow intégrés) et le plan de financement. Modéliser les business cases des nouvelles offres et relais de croissance, avec scénarios et sensibilités, en lien avec les directions concernées. 5. Data, automatisation et IA Unifier et fiabiliser les sources de données avec l’équipe Data-BI (SAP, Salesforce, Power BI, BiosConnect). Automatiser les process de production et de projection, déployer l’IA dans les process FP&A, et documenter les process et modes opératoires. 6. Clôture et coordination avec la comptabilité Contribuer aux clôtures mensuelles avec l’équipe comptable : contrôle des imputations analytiques, provisions, cohérence entre comptabilité et contrôle de gestion. 7. Management Encadrer, former et faire progresser le/la FP&A analyste junior (stagiaire jusqu’au 30/06/2027, puis apprenti(e) à partir de septembre 2027) ; organiser la délégation des travaux de production et contribuer à son recrutement. Interlocuteurs principaux Responsable administratif et financier, Directeur administratif et financier, direction générale, directions opérationnelles (Sales, Opérations, Affaires médicales, R&D), équipes Comptabilité, Facturation & recouvrement, Data-BI et RH. Formation et expérience Formation Bac+5 d’excellence : grande école de commerce ou d’ingénieurs, ou master finance de premier plan. 3 à 5 ans d’expérience, idéalement comme FP&A analyste ou contrôleur de gestion en scale-up, ou comme senior en transaction services (Big 4 ou cabinet spécialisé). Une expérience en conseil en performance financière, en banque d’affaires ou en entreprise sous LBO est également appréciée. Compétences techniques Excellente maîtrise de la modélisation financière : P&L, bilan et cash flow intégrés, scénarios et sensibilités. Solide maîtrise des sous-jacents comptables et financiers : comptes sociaux et consolidés, IFRS, BFR, dette. Maîtrise des process FP&A : budget, reforecast, landing, analyse des écarts. Aisance avec les outils d’IA et l’automatisation des process (Power Query, Python, SQL ou VBA appréciés). Excellente maîtrise d’Excel et de PowerPoint ; connaissance de SAP, Salesforce et Power BI appréciée. Anglais professionnel courant, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. Qualités personnelles Esprit critique et analytique très développé : vous challengez les chiffres, les hypothèses et les sources. Capacité à faire parler les chiffres et à restituer de façon synthétique des sujets complexes, jusqu’au niveau direction et board. Rigueur, fiabilité et sens de l’ownership : vous allez au bout des sujets. …

items.desc: EngineeringRemote, France/Morocco time zoneFull timeReports to Walid Boulanouar, CTOCompensation: competitive, shared at interview Data Engineer : The foundation everything else rests on An AI agent is only worth the data you give it. That is this role. / The role What you take on You classify a client source as Bronze, Silver or Gold And discover that half of it is unusable as it stands. Our model exists precisely for that: surfacing, from the audit onwards, what must be cleaned before an agent relies on it. You wire in an export that cannot be replaced The client has an old ERP, nobody wants to change it, and the pipeline still has to run on it every night. You build the corpus that feeds a RAG pipeline And test its quality. A badly structured corpus gives wrong answers with the same confidence as right ones. Part of your job: finding those holes before the client finds them in production. You deploy into the client's cloud account, not yours Our systems run in the client's infrastructure (data sovereignty, GDPR, AI Act). That means learning their environment (AWS, GCP or Azure) rather than imposing yours. You tell a client no about the quality of their data And you propose what comes next. This is not a technical aside: it is a conversation with someone whose dashboard is blocked and who does not want to hear it. You build a reporting agent that puts a number in front of a decision-maker Every week, with no manual intervention. / Your first 90 days Month 1, you take over the pipelines of a live client and learn how our systems consume the data downstream. Month 2, you own the data layer of a full engagement. Month 3, you step in upstream, during the audit phase, where what is feasible gets decided. / The profile What we are looking for Languages Excellent SQL, solid Python Data Modelling, ETL/ELT, Bronze/Silver/Gold architecture, large volumes Architecture CRM/ERP integrations, cloud, queries that hold up in production Applied AI RAG corpora and data quality, reporting agents Field work Can tell a client their data is not ready, and propose what comes next Background 3 to 8 years in data engineering What we are not looking for Someone who wants a stable scope. Every client has a different stack. / The context Where it differs from neighbouring roles Role What they do Who owns the outcome Data Analyst Queries data that is already clean Whoever decides from the number owns the outcome Analytics Engineer Transforms and models inside the warehouse The data team consuming the models owns the outcome In-house generalist data engineer One stack, one company That company's data team owns the outcome Data Engineer, AI Makers Unifies siloed systems at each client, deploys into their cloud You own the outcome, on a different stack every engagement / Where Remote, in a time zone compatible with France and Morocco (Europe, North Africa or nearby), with no residency requirement, and occasional travel to our clients, expenses covered.

Una persona che ha messo prodotti in produzione e che chiude il cerchio, non sistema un segmento e passa la palla. Una persona AI-first: l'architettura del progetto la pensa con la sua testa, poi usa gli strumenti giusti per costruirla, riprogettarla, accelerarla. L'AI è leva, non scorciatoia. Una persona che sappia cogliere le opportunità che ha davanti, comprenderle e contestualizzarle senza creare frizione. Porta il tuo talento in Humans.tech! Costruisci soluzioni digitali per aziende globali come Airbnb, Amazon, Angelini… e siamo solo alla lettera A! In 10 anni abbiamo lanciato oltre 700 prodotti, lavorando per il 70% con clienti globali tra Europa e Stati Uniti. Abbiamo sedi a Frosinone e San Francisco. Siamo tra le 1000 aziende europee in più rapida crescita per Financial Times & Statista e tra le top 5 aziende per cui lavorare in Italia per la Gen Z secondo Great Place to Work 2026. Lavoriamo con l'AI dal 2015, non da quando è diventata un trend. I nostri Partner si chiamano OpenAI, Meta, AWS, Translated. Non siamo la solita consulenza. I prodotti li costruiamo davvero: dall'analisi all'architettura, dal codice al delivery. E come lavorare dentro un team prodotto, solo che il team prodotto siamo noi. In qualità di Solution Architect (Backend-focused): Scriverai codice in Node.js e TypeScript, su servizi AWS e in ambienti Docker. Sarai il punto di riferimento del tuo team e ne farai crescere i membri con code review, one-to-one e momenti di confronto. Trasformerai le esigenze del cliente in soluzioni funzionali, robuste e scalabili, con piena ownership del prodotto. Sarai l’interlocutore del cliente: ascolterai le sue richieste e le trasformerai in prodotti concreti, definendo roadmap, tempi e costi e guidando il team nei passi successivi. Orchestrerai ogni giorno agentic coding tools, restando tu la mente. Porterai avanti progetti internazionali e rapporti con i clienti in un inglese fluente. Hard skills TypeScriptNode.jsPostgreSQLAWSDockerCI/CDTeam & tech leadershipProduct ownershipBusiness-oriented consultancyAI-orchestrationProfessional English Benefit aziendali Piano di crescita personalizzato e bonus legati a performance Coffee & Water 24/7, Buoni pasto (full-ticket) Accesso a piani con crediti illimitati dei top-tier AI tools Hardware top di gamma: MacBook Pro, ovviamente. Supporto alla salute fisica e mentale Abbiamo a cuore la salute fisica e mentale dei nostri collaboratori. Coperture sanitarie integrative e la partnership con Unobravo ne sono esempi. Benessere finanziario Promuoviamo l'educazione finanziaria, a lavoro e fuori dal lavoro, affinché i nostri Humans possano gestire al meglio le proprie risorse e garantirsi un futuro migliore. Hackathon Organizziamo e partecipiamo a challenge e momenti di confronto ad alta intensità, in cui i nostri Humans mettono alla prova metodo, creatività e velocità di esecuzione. HackParty 2026 Eventi Abbiamo portato la nostra visione nei palchi più importanti a livello nazionale e internazionale. × Cosa dovresti sapere prima di candidarti Non vogliamo che tu abbia le risposte pronte. Vogliamo che tu sappia fare le domande giuste. In Humans.tech, si supporta l'idea migliore, non la propria. "Abbiamo sempre fatto così" non è una risposta accettabile. Le persone qui restano: questo significa team stabili, basso turnover , alta continuità sui progetti. È il nostro indicatore migliore. Non candidarti se: Ti servono specifiche iper-dettagliate per partire ed hai bisogno di mesi per "trovare il ritmo". Ti aspetti micro-management o un ambiente pensato per proteggere chi non performa. Vedi solo il tuo pezzetto. Se ragioni a "questa è la mia task, il resto non è mio problema", blocchi tutti. Aspetti validazione su ogni scelta: l'ownership si prende, non si delega.

items.desc: All the details Summary Marks & Spencer is seeking an Exposure and Attack Surface Management (EASM) Specialist to join the EASM team within Cyber Security. The team owns external attack surface management and internal vulnerability management across the full M&S estate. This role discovers and assesses exposures across our internet-facing and internal infrastructure, drives remediation through accountable asset owners within the M&S SLA framework, and independently verifies that remediated vulnerabilities are genuinely fixed through hands-on testing with Kali Linux, Burp Suite and other offensive security tools. We are building an AI-enabled function, and this role will design and build AI agents and automation that scale discovery, triage, verification and reporting, replacing manual effort wherever it is safe to do so. The ideal candidate combines a vulnerability management background with practical penetration testing or red team skills, is genuinely enthusiastic about AI and automation, and can translate technical findings into clear risk language for engineers and leadership alike. What you'll do Discover and maintain visibility of internet-facing assets, and run vulnerability scanning across on-premises, cloud and endpoint estates using tools such as BitSight, Censys, Qualys VMDR, Wiz and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. Prioritise exposures using the M&S CVSS-led SLA model and threat intelligence (including CISA KEV), support Rapid Exposure Assessment of newly disclosed vulnerabilities, and triage HackerOne bug bounty findings. Independently verify that remediation is genuinely effective through hands-on, authorised testing with tools such as Kali Linux, Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit and Nuclei, recording auditable evidence in BMC Helix. Drive remediation with asset owners, BISOs, TISOs and suppliers, escalating overdue or high-risk exposures, and contribute to EASM policies, playbooks, compliance and audit activity (CIS, PCI DSS, ISO 27001). Design and build AI agents and automation (Python, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, n8n) to scale discovery, triage, verification and reporting, with sound AI governance, and produce Power BI metrics, KPIs and KRIs for technical teams and leadership. Who you are Typically 5 or more years of experience in vulnerability management, penetration testing, red teaming or a closely related security discipline. Hands-on proficiency with Kali Linux, Burp Suite Professional, Nmap and Metasploit, with proven ability to safely reproduce, retest and validate remediation. Practical experience with vulnerability and exposure management platforms (Qualys, Wiz, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Tenable or Rapid7), and a strong understanding of the external attack surface and cloud architectures (Azure, AWS). Sound knowledge of CVSS, EPSS, the CISA KEV catalogue and exploit intelligence, and how they inform prioritisation. Experience using AI tools, APIs and scripting (Python preferred) to automate security tasks, plus Power BI reporting, clear communication with technical and senior stakeholders, and strong analytical skills and judgement. What’s in it for you? Working at M&S means being part of something bigger - helping to deliver quality, value and service to millions of customers every day. We’re inclusive, fast-moving and always evolving, with a strong sense of purpose and a focus on doing the right thing. Here are just a few of the benefits that make working here even more rewarding: 20% colleague discount on all M&S products and many third-party brands for you and someone in your household, available once you’ve completed your probation Competitive holiday allowance with the option to buy more Discretionary bonus schemes linked to your performance and ours Strong pension and life assurance to help plan for the future Tailored induction and training to support your development from day one Exclusive perks and savings through our M&S Choices portal Market-leading family policies, including parental, adoption and neonatal leave 24/7 wellbeing support, including virtual GP access and mental health services One paid volunteer day a year to support a cause that matters to you Everyone’s welcome We are ambitious about the future of retail. We’re disrupting, innovating and leading the industry into a more conscientious, inspiring digital era. We’re transforming how we work together and offering our most exciting opportunities yet. Marks & Spencer strives to be an inclusive organisation, trusted and admired by our colleagues, customers and suppliers. Join us and make change happen. We are committed to building diverse and representative teams, where everyone can bring their whole selves to work and be at their best. We support each other and work together to win together. If you feel you'd benefit from any support or reasonable adjustments during any stage of the recruitment process, please don’t hesitate to let us know when completing your application. items.desc: Location London / Greater London Other Locations London / Greater London Glasgow Salary From £54,000 Contract Permanent (Full Time ) Reference 5284 Closing Date 30 November 2026 Job description We are looking for a Product Owner to lead the ongoing development and adoption of the Analytics Marketplace, creating a trusted and easy-to-use front door to data, insight, metrics and analytical products across the Society. This is a senior individual-contributor role. You will own the product vision, strategy and roadmap, ensuring the Marketplace solves priority colleague and customer needs and delivers measurable value. You will bring together business, data, technology, governance and user experience perspectives, making clear choices about outcomes, sequencing and investment. At Nationwide we offer hybrid working wherever possible. More rewarding relationships are supported through our hybrid approach, bringing colleagues together across our UK wide estate, whilst also supporting generous access to home working. We value our time in the office to solve problems, to learn, and to feel connected. For this job, you'll spend at least two days per week, or if part-time, you'll spend 40% of your working time, based at our Swindon, London or Glasgow office. If you’re based at our Glasgow office, this will apply from 1 April 2027 and ahead of that there will be a need to regularly connect with colleagues for collaboration events . If your application is successful, your hiring manager will provide further details on how this works. You can also find out more about our approach to hybrid working here. Whilst these locations are where we are primarily looking to fill the role, if you’re an internal applicant based in a different location, we would welcome your application and, if successful, your hiring manager will provide further details on how this could work for this specific role. Nationwide is committed to the redeployment of our employees impacted by change, as such applications for redeployment candidates will be prioritised in this recruitment process. If you’re a colleague on long-term absence (for example, on parental leave) or a temporary worker, please use your personal email address to submit an application. What you’ll be doing Owning, communicating and continually developing the product vision, strategy and roadmap for the Analytics Marketplace is central to this role. You will turn customer, colleague and business needs into clear product outcomes, propositions, features and prioritised backlog items, creating and maintaining a transparent roadmap that balances strategic ambition, user value, risk, dependencies, technical sustainability and delivery capacity. As the accountable product decision-maker, you will set priorities and make evidence-based trade-offs across discovery, build, launch and continuous improvement activities. Working closely with colleagues across BI, analytics, data engineering, platform, architecture, governance, risk and design, you will ensure the delivery of an integrated and effective product experience. items.desc:
About Analog Devices 
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .
 AI/ML Software Engineer - Enterprise AI 
 About the role 
 Join the Enterprise AI team to build and run production LLM and agentic systems that serve ADI customers and internal teams, such as agents for customer support, product marketing and market intelligence. You will work on individual products and on shared platform components.
 Responsibilities 
 - Build and operate LLM-powered services and multi-step agents, covering retrieval, tool use, orchestration and guardrails
 - Build and maintain evaluation pipelines (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression tests) so that prompt, model and retrieval changes are measured, not guessed
 - Improve retrieval quality over technical content using hybrid search, embeddings, reranking and query understanding
 - Help run these systems in production, managing latency, token cost, rate limits, model failover and observability
 - Apply security and responsible-AI practices, including prompt-injection defences, least-privilege tool access and data-handling controls, and support architecture and RAI reviews
 - Work with product managers, UX designers and engineers to turn requirements into working solutions
 - Contribute to reusable platform components and shared services used across teams
 - Take part in code review, architecture discussion and technical planning
 - Keep up with how the field is moving (models, agent frameworks, protocols such as MCP) and share what is worth adopting
 Required 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience
 - 2+ years of software engineering experience, including hands-on work building LLM-based applications (RAG, prompt engineering, agentic workflows)
 - Strong Python, with good engineering practice (testing, code review, CI/CD, version control)
 - Familiarity with agent and orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or LlamaIndex, and with tool or function calling
 - Experience evaluating LLM outputs
 - Experience with a major cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP) and its managed AI services (for example Azure AI Foundry/OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Vertex)
 - Experience with relational and vector databases (PostgreSQL/pgvector, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search)
 - Docker, and an understanding of microservice or serverless architectures
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills
 Preferred 
 - Experience running LLM systems in production
 - Experience with MCP and similar protocols
 - Kubernetes
 - Observability and product analytics (PostHog)
 - Classical ML (PyTorch, scikit-learn) for ranking, classification or embeddings
 - Semiconductor industry experience
 For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.

Shift Type: 1st Shift/Days

items.desc: IQVIA provides scientific services spanning clinical trials, real world evidence, and consulting in all areas of the product lifecycle. Our Clinical Outcomes Assessments (COAs) organisation leads the industry in generating data to ensure that the patient voice is incorporated into the development and commercialisation of medication and other drug/non-drug interventions. We focus on understanding and meeting the needs of our clients – mostly life science/pharmaceutical companies – through the application of broad consulting expertise and technical scientific knowledge to conduct scientifically rigorous research. This research is broad and includes qualitative, quantitative, and passive approaches to understand patient, caregiver, and healthcare professional experiences and expectations of disease and treatment. To further scale the impact of IQVIA’s COA expertise, the COA Accelerator ecosystem is expanding its AI-enabled capabilities, including tools designed to support evidence-backed COA strategy development, instrument selection, endpoint planning, regulatory precedent review, and expert decision support. These capabilities are intended to transform curated COA knowledge, regulatory precedent, scientific literature, clinical trial evidence, and internal consulting expertise into reliable AI-enabled workflows for internal and external users. To meet our client expectations and retain the excellent reputation built up over time, the IQVIA COAs team is committed to recruiting, training and supporting driven individuals who have life science, consulting, product development, data, and/or artificial intelligence skills that can be applied to COA research and technology-enabled offerings. Individuals joining us are assured of a rewarding and progressive career in patient-focused research. You’ll have the opportunity to address challenging client issues, across multiple geographies, with a hands-on influence in developing and delivering innovative solutions. We operate in a truly multi-cultural, collegial and collaborative work environment that is rich in development and growth. Role & Responsibilities Design, develop, and optimise AI capabilities that support COA strategy generation, evidence synthesis, recommendation development, and expert review workflows. Own the technical implementation of AI reasoning, retrieval-augmented generation, model orchestration, prompt architecture, evaluation pipelines, and domain adaptation for COA-related use cases. Build AI workflows that can interpret therapy area, indication, target product profile, study phase, endpoint objectives, target population, regulatory context, and trial design considerations. Develop AI capabilities that generate structured, evidence-backed COA strategy recommendations, including recommended instruments, endpoint considerations, rationale, evidence gaps, and supporting source material. Design and optimise retrieval pipelines across structured and unstructured sources, including COA libraries, psychometric evidence, scientific literature, regulatory labels, HTA documents, clinical trial records, and internal consulting outputs. Implement semantic search, hybrid search, metadata filtering, reranking, source attribution, context-window optimisation, and citation-supporting workflows. Evaluate when to use foundation models, fine-tuned models, smaller specialist models, embeddings, rerankers, deterministic rules, or hybrid approaches. Develop mechanisms that allow AI outputs to distinguish between strong evidence, weak precedent, outdated information, unsupported claims, and areas requiring expert judgement. Create and maintain model evaluation frameworks to assess factuality, retrieval relevance, citation accuracy, recommendation consistency, clinical reasoning quality, and hallucination risk. Partner with COA scientists, product managers, data engineers, software engineers, security teams, legal stakeholders, and commercial teams to ensure AI capabilities are scientifically credible, secure, explainable, and commercially useful. Support demos, prototypes, pilots, and client-facing proof-of-concept work where AI functionality needs to be explained clearly to scientific, commercial, or technical audiences. Document model behaviour, assumptions, known limitations, evaluation results, decision logic, and change history. Contribute to AI governance practices for responsible AI use in clinical research, COA strategy, and regulated decision-support contexts. Skills & Qualifications Degree in computer science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, data science, computational linguistics, biomedical informatics, bioinformatics, engineering, or a related technical field. Experience building AI, NLP, LLM-powered, or machine learning applications in production environments. Practical experience with retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and LLM orchestration. Strong Python …

items.desc: À propos Fondée fin 2024, Histia est une startup incubée à l’incubateur HEC Paris et CentraleSupélec, qui conçoit une technologie d’intelligence de marché basée sur l’Intelligence Artificielle en partenariat de recherche avec l’institut Polytechnique de Paris Basés à Station F, nous formons une équipe d’une petite dizaine de personnes (ingénieurs IA, devops, devs webs, graphistes et commerciaux), issus de Polytechnique, HEC Paris, 42, etc. Le Produit Nous développons Stolos, la plateforme de référence de l’innovation, qui aide les fonds d’investissement, incubateurs et autres acteurs clés, à dénicher et suivre les pépites de demain. Notre outil cartographie l’écosystème entrepreneurial mondial en générant des fiches d’informations exclusives sur toutes les startups du marché, en suivant en temps réel leurs évolutions, et en recommandant sur mesure des projets à accompagner ou dans lesquels investir à nos clients. Démo du produit consultable ici : https://drive.google.com/file/d/1au-xDX8unW9G6e9veGULw7xwvw8kmj09/view?usp=sharing Descriptif du poste Contexte et Missions Histia entre dans une phase d’accélération commerciale, notre outil est actuellement en bêta test chez de gros partenaires en préparation de son lancement global, et nous venons de décrocher le label Deeptech de la BPI pour un programme de R&D intensif. Pour porter ces ambitions de recherche et d’industrialisation, nous recherchons le bras droit de notre CTO : un(e) ingénieur(e) IA qui travaillera directement à ses côtés, de la recherche jusqu’au produit. Votre rôle ? Appui à la direction technique : assister le CTO dans la prise de décisions techniques (architecture des systèmes d’agents, choix des modèles et des frameworks, arbitrages coût / performance) Structuration de la R&D : définir avec le CTO les sujets de recherche, les approches techniques et les méthodes de travail (notamment les protocoles d’évaluation des agents), en lien avec nos laboratoires partenaires Mise en oeuvre de la R&D : travailler sur les projets de R&D (conception et prototypage de systèmes multi-agents, orchestration d’outils, expérimentations et évaluation des agents) Opérationnel et produit : participer aux missions opérationnelles et produit de l’équipe IA, en concevant, déployant et fiabilisant les agents qui alimentent Stolos (collecte, extraction et structuration de l’information) Rejoindre Histia à ce poste, c’est travailler au plus près des décisions techniques, avec une vision complète de la chaîne, de la recherche à la mise en production, au moment où nous passons de startup à future scaleup. Le défi technique Construire un moteur IA conçu pour automatiser la collecte et la structuration d'informations en base de données, cartographier les relations complexes entre des millions d’entités différentes (startups, fonds d’investissements, individus, etc.) et capter les signaux faibles, afin de produire des modélisations avancées (scores de recommandations, de prédictions, etc.) Cela implique des sujets complexes : multi-agents IA, LLM, extraction d’information, scoring de sources, entrainement et finetuning de modèles, recherche sémantique, architecture échelonnable de cartographie d’entités, optimisation des coûts, etc. Par ailleurs, vous serez amené à piloter et dimensionner notre propre infrastructure serveur physique dont les fondations ont déjà été posées par nos DevOps. Profil recherché Vous êtes fait pour ce poste si vous avez : Une formation ingénieur, un master en informatique / IA, ou une expérience équivalente ; Une très bonne maîtrise de Python ; Une bonne compréhension du fonctionnement des LLM : tokens, embeddings, context window, prompting, RAG, tool calling, etc. ; Une expérience concrète de la conception d’agents IA et de systèmes multi-agents (orchestration, tool calling, mémoire, évaluation), avec des frameworks comme LangGraph, CrewAI ou équivalents ; Un goût pour la recherche appliquée : lire des papiers, mener des expérimentations rigoureuses et en tirer des conclusions ; La capacité à prendre du recul et à formuler des recommandations techniques argumentées ; Une bonne culture software engineering : code propre, maintenable, structuré, versionné ; Une aisance avec Git et le développement collaboratif. Des bases en Machine Learning ou NLP, ainsi qu’une première expérience des sujets DevOps et de mise en production (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, CI/CD, monitoring), seront un plus. Au-delà de l’expertise pure, nous cherchons une personne autonome et rigoureuse, qui aime autant prendre part aux réflexions de fond qu’avancer concrètement sur le code. Nous recherchons un esprit vif et proactif, doté d’une bonne intelligence relationnelle pour travailler en binôme avec le CTO et avec toute l’équipe (une expérience passée en startup sera valorisée) , mais aussi pour passer d’agréables moments avec nous en dehors du travail !
