items.desc: IQVIA provides scientific services spanning clinical trials, real world evidence, and consulting in all areas of the product lifecycle. Our Clinical Outcomes Assessments (COAs) organisation leads the industry in generating data to ensure that the patient voice is incorporated into the development and commercialisation of medication and other drug/non-drug interventions. We focus on understanding and meeting the needs of our clients – mostly life science/pharmaceutical companies – through the application of broad consulting expertise and technical scientific knowledge to conduct scientifically rigorous research. This research is broad and includes qualitative, quantitative, and passive approaches to understand patient, caregiver, and healthcare professional experiences and expectations of disease and treatment. To further scale the impact of IQVIA’s COA expertise, the COA Accelerator ecosystem is expanding its AI-enabled capabilities, including tools designed to support evidence-backed COA strategy development, instrument selection, endpoint planning, regulatory precedent review, and expert decision support. These capabilities are intended to transform curated COA knowledge, regulatory precedent, scientific literature, clinical trial evidence, and internal consulting expertise into reliable AI-enabled workflows for internal and external users. To meet our client expectations and retain the excellent reputation built up over time, the IQVIA COAs team is committed to recruiting, training and supporting driven individuals who have life science, consulting, product development, data, and/or artificial intelligence skills that can be applied to COA research and technology-enabled offerings. Individuals joining us are assured of a rewarding and progressive career in patient-focused research. You’ll have the opportunity to address challenging client issues, across multiple geographies, with a hands-on influence in developing and delivering innovative solutions. We operate in a truly multi-cultural, collegial and collaborative work environment that is rich in development and growth. Role & Responsibilities Design, develop, and optimise AI capabilities that support COA strategy generation, evidence synthesis, recommendation development, and expert review workflows. Own the technical implementation of AI reasoning, retrieval-augmented generation, model orchestration, prompt architecture, evaluation pipelines, and domain adaptation for COA-related use cases. Build AI workflows that can interpret therapy area, indication, target product profile, study phase, endpoint objectives, target population, regulatory context, and trial design considerations. Develop AI capabilities that generate structured, evidence-backed COA strategy recommendations, including recommended instruments, endpoint considerations, rationale, evidence gaps, and supporting source material. Design and optimise retrieval pipelines across structured and unstructured sources, including COA libraries, psychometric evidence, scientific literature, regulatory labels, HTA documents, clinical trial records, and internal consulting outputs. Implement semantic search, hybrid search, metadata filtering, reranking, source attribution, context-window optimisation, and citation-supporting workflows. Evaluate when to use foundation models, fine-tuned models, smaller specialist models, embeddings, rerankers, deterministic rules, or hybrid approaches. Develop mechanisms that allow AI outputs to distinguish between strong evidence, weak precedent, outdated information, unsupported claims, and areas requiring expert judgement. Create and maintain model evaluation frameworks to assess factuality, retrieval relevance, citation accuracy, recommendation consistency, clinical reasoning quality, and hallucination risk. Partner with COA scientists, product managers, data engineers, software engineers, security teams, legal stakeholders, and commercial teams to ensure AI capabilities are scientifically credible, secure, explainable, and commercially useful. Support demos, prototypes, pilots, and client-facing proof-of-concept work where AI functionality needs to be explained clearly to scientific, commercial, or technical audiences. Document model behaviour, assumptions, known limitations, evaluation results, decision logic, and change history. Contribute to AI governance practices for responsible AI use in clinical research, COA strategy, and regulated decision-support contexts. Skills & Qualifications Degree in computer science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, data science, computational linguistics, biomedical informatics, bioinformatics, engineering, or a related technical field. Experience building AI, NLP, LLM-powered, or machine learning applications in production environments. Practical experience with retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and LLM orchestration. Strong Python …

items.desc: Twoja rola: Współpraca z klientami: Przeprowadzanie analizy potrzeb klientów oraz identyfikacja możliwości zastosowania sztucznej inteligencji i uczenia maszynowego w danym obszarze biznesowym. Projektowanie rozwiązań: Opracowywanie i proponowanie innowacyjnych rozwiązań w oparciu o technologie Microsoft, które spełniają konkretne wymagania i cele biznesowe klientów. Projekty: Uczestnictwo w projektach wdrożeniowych z zakresu wdrożenia nowoczesnych aplikacji napędzanych przez sztuczną inteligencje (Chatbot, inteligentne wyszukiwarki, automatyzacja przetwarzania dokumentów z wykorzystaniem NLP itp.) a także w projektach związanych z zaawansowaną analityką wykorzysującą metody Machine Learning (prognoza, segmentacja, detekcja anomalii itp.) Badania i rozwój: Śledzenie najnowszych trendów, technologii i narzędzi w dziedzinie sztucznej inteligencji i uczenia maszynowego, oraz wnioskowanie o ich potencjalnym zastosowaniu w projektach. Przygotowanie aplikacji demo w ramach wewnętrznego R&D. Czego oczekujemy? Doświadczenie w projektach związanych z implementacją rozwiązań uczenia maszynowego, obejmujące budowę, trenowanie, optymalizację, wdrażanie, monitorowanie oraz utrzymanie modeli ML w środowisku produkcyjnym. Praktyczne doświadczenie w tworzeniu, trenowaniu i wdrażaniu modeli ML, w tym ich integracji z systemami produkcyjnymi oraz utrzymaniem w chmurze w usługach Azure Machine Learning oraz Fabric. Znajomość Databrics oraz Synapse będzie dodatkowym atutem Znajomość zasad MLOps, obejmująca w szczególności automatyzację pipeline’ów ML, wersjonowanie modeli i danych, monitorowanie ich jakości oraz zarządzanie pełnym cyklem życia modeli. Doświadczenie w walidacji modeli ML oraz ich wersjonowaniu w środowisku produkcyjnym, z uwzględnieniem monitoringu, testów regresyjnych i kontroli dryfu. Znajomość narzędzi do zarządzania eksperymentami ML, takich jak MLflow, Azure ML, oraz praktyczne doświadczenie w walidacji, porównywaniu i fine‑tuningu modeli. Znajomość języków programowania – wymagane: Python; mile widziane: SQL, C#. Umiejętność efektywnej komunikacji i pracy z klientami, w tym tłumaczenia złożonych zagadnień technicznych na język zrozumiały dla odbiorców nietechnicznych. Znajomość koncepcji i doświadczenie z technikami generatywnej AI, takimi jak prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, bazy wektorowe oraz podstawy fine‑tuningu LLM‑ów. Doświadczenie w pracy z dużymi modelami językowymi (LLM) Znajomość MAF (Microsoft AI Framework) , LangChain, LangGraph jako narzędzi wspierającegych budowę aplikacji wykorzystujących modele językowe i usługi Azure AI. Znajomość narzędzi i platform Microsoft związanych z AI, takich jak Azure Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Services. Co oferujemy? Swobodę w działaniu oraz decyzyjność Kulturę organizacyjną opartą na odpowiedzialności, zaufaniu i realizacji założonych celów Elastyczne godziny pracy, możliwość częściowej pracy zdalnej Szkolenia i certyfikacje Microsoft Opiekę medyczną, Kartę Multisport, Ubezpieczenie na Życie, naukę języka angielskiego

items.desc: Job Description: Was dich erwartet Betreuung und kompetente Unterstützung durch erfahrene Mitarbeiter Gestaltungsfreiraum, der neue Perspektiven für das Engagement jedes Einzelnen eröffnet Einblick in die Raumfahrtbranche eine Möglichkeit, die Zukunft von Tesat mitzugestalten und etwas zu bewegen flexible Arbeitszeit attraktive Praktikumsvergütung werteorientiertes Handeln und die Begeisterung für das was wir tun Deine Aufgaben AI Infrastruktur: Du unterstützt den Ausbau unserer AI Infrastruktur um unseren Entwickler/innen die tägliche Arbeit zu erleichtern AI Tools: Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von AI Agenten und testest diese (Datenverarbeitung, Dokumentengenerierung) AI Integration: Du unterstützt bei der Integration der AI Infrastruktur und der AI-Tools in die vorhandenen Prozesse (RAGs, Metriken, Analysen) Data Management: Du optimierst die Datenablage durch den Einsatz moderner Datenbankmethoden und -technologien. Dabei arbeitest du mit Entwicklungsdaten und entwickelst Lösungen, um diese effizienter in Datenbanken zu verarbeiten und nutzbar zu machen. Deine Qualifikation Studium: Du bist in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang eingeschrieben, z. B. Informatik, Software Engineering, Data Science, AI/Machine Learning oder vergleichbar. AI-Kenntnisse: Praktische Erfahrung mit Large Language Models (LLMs) und Prompt Engineering, auch mit strukturierter Ausgabe (z. B. JSON); du kennst ihre Grenzen, z. B. Halluzinationen. Grundlagen von Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Chunking, Embeddings, Volltext- und Vektorsuche. Du kannst die Qualität einer Suche oder eines AI-Agenten mit Testfragen messen. Sorgfältiger Umgang mit vertraulichen Daten beim Einsatz von AI. Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit AI-Agenten oder Coding-Assistenten (z. B. Claude Code, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot), MCP, lokal betriebenen Modellen (z. B. vLLM, Ollama) oder Suchmaschinen wie OpenSearch oder Elasticsearch. Dokumente: Du kannst Inhalte aus Word- und PDF-Dokumenten automatisiert auslesen (z. B. mit Docling oder python-docx) und als JSON weiterverarbeiten. Datenbanken: Kenntnisse über relationale Datenbanken sowie SQL. Optional: Kenntnisse in PLSQL sowie Oracle APEX. Anforderungsmanagement: Erfahrung mit Requirementmanagement-Tools wie ReqView, DOORS oder Polarion ist von Vorteil. Programmierung: Du bist fit in Python. Tools: Du kennst Linux und die Kommandozeile, Git/GitLab und Docker oder Podman. Sprachen: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil der Mission!** This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. items.desc: Senior / Lead Dutch Data & AI Engineer | Azure | Amsterdam | Hybrid Team focused, collaborative company with a bruto base + bonus construction: Package from: €6500 to €10,500 package including collaborative bonuses + car allowance etc A real focus on people and intelligence. Be rewarded well financially from your collected outcomes. These values that genuinely mean something at this 23-person specialist Data, AI & Cloud consultancy in Amsterdam . They're led by inspiring owners with strong development backgrounds themselves. They understand engineers, understand the technology and have created a collaborative environment where people have a voice. They're also increasingly sought after for their expertise — bringing exciting new customer projects, real business growth and plenty of opportunity for the people joining them. And now they're looking for a few Senior or Lead Data & AI Engineers. What will you build? You'll work hands-on across Data, Cloud & AI , taking solutions from idea through to production: ⚡ Modern data platforms, pipelines & lakehouses ⚡ Azure, Microsoft Fabric & Databricks ⚡ Python, SQL & Spark ⚡ Azure AI Foundry & Azure OpenAI ⚡ GenAI, LLMs, RAG & AI Agents ⚡ CI/CD & MLOps/LLMOps Their mission is to unlock the real value of data through an intelligent ecosystem — combining Data Engineering, Business Intelligence and Data Science & AI to turn raw data into real business impact. And you won't be hidden behind a backlog. You'll talk directly to customers, understand their challenges, challenge ideas and help design and build the solution. Who are we looking for? You're probably already a experienced Dutch Data Engineer, AI Engineer or ML Engineer with around 5 or more years' experience . Maybe you're already building GenAI solutions. Or perhaps you're a strong Azure Data Engineer moving deeper into AI. Either way, you're curious, hands-on and want to understand why you're building something — not just how. Why consider it? Your perfect opportunity to join a small, fast growing, people first team that focuses on the Modern Azure & AI stack. You'll make direct customer impact and have real ownership, all working together. Permanent contract from the outset A 70/30 basis for salary / bonus to show we’re serious about teamwork and people Midlance type package: €6500 to €10,500 bruto base + collaborative bonuses depending on level Laptop Generous pension contribution 25 days' holiday Flexible working conditions €500 mobility allowance

items.title: Google Cloud AI Engineer (all genders)
items.card: Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen liegen. Mit einem Workload, der zu dir passt. Und mit einer Arbeitsweise, die sich an deinen Zielen orientiert. Wie du dich vernetzen, weiterbilden und persönlich wachsen willst, liegt bei dir. Es ist deine Karriere. Wir helfen dir, sie so zu gestalten, wie du es dir vorstellst. Dein Kontakt Noch Fragen offen? Dann wende dich gerne an unser Recruiting Team per E-Mail an
items.desc: Generative KI wird dann zum echten Mehrwert, wenn sie zuverlässig, sicher und wirtschaftlich in produktiven Geschäftsprozessen eingesetzt wird. Gestalte genau diesen Schritt mit uns. Deine Mission Als Google Cloud AI Engineer Consultant konzipierst, entwickelst und betreibst du KI-Agenten, GenAI-Anwendungen und die zugrunde liegenden Datenplattformen auf Google Cloud für führende Unternehmen. Du verbindest tiefes technisches Know-how mit Architekturkompetenz und Business-Verständnis. Du triffst Architekturentscheidungen, setzt technische Standards, entwickelst selbst mit und übernimmst die technische Verantwortung von der Konzeption bis zum stabilen Betrieb. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Fach- und IT-Teams unserer Kund:innen sowie mit Expert:innen aus verschiedenen Bereichen zusammen. Bei Accenture gestaltest du dir selbst das Umfeld, in dem du aufgehst – mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel. Und wirst Teil eines Teams voller einzigartiger Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen. Das erwartet dich Konzipiere und entwickle KI-Agenten und GenAI-Lösungen: Du verantwortest Design, Entwicklung und Implementierung intelligenter KI-Agenten und GenAI-Lösungen auf Google Cloud, insbesondere mit Gemini-Modellen, der Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Agent Studio, dem Agent Development Kit (ADK) und Agent Runtime. Dazu gehören auch Conversational-AI- und Voice-Lösungen sowie fortgeschrittenes Prompt- und Context Engineering. Gestalte Lösungsarchitekturen und moderne Datenplattformen: Du triffst Architekturentscheidungen für komplexe KI- und Datenlösungen, definierst technische Standards und Best Practices und entwickelst leistungsfähige Datenplattformen sowie ETL-/ELT-Pipelines in der Google Cloud. Entwickle RAG und semantische Suche: Du baust RAG-Pipelines, Vector Search und semantische Suche auf strukturierten und unstrukturierten Unternehmensdaten, z. B. mit Agent Search, RAG Engine, Vector Search, BigQuery und AlloyDB. Integriere Lösungen und bringe sie in Produktion: Du integrierst Lösungen über MCP-Server, A2A und Agent Gateway in komplexe Unternehmensarchitekturen und berücksichtigst Security, Agent Identity, Datenschutz und regulatorische Anforderungen. Mit automatisiertem Testing, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Agent Observability, Agent Evaluation und Kostenkontrolle stellst du die Produktionsreife sicher. Berate unsere Kund:innen: Du leitest Workshops mit Fachbereichen und IT, identifizierst und bewertest Use Cases hinsichtlich Machbarkeit, Datenlage und Geschäftsnutzen und machst technische Lösungsansätze sowie notwendige Investitionen für Management und Fachbereiche verständlich. Darauf freuen wir uns Fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit sehr guten Python-Kenntnissen sowie mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung mit Cloud-nativer Softwareentwicklung auf Google Cloud, AWS oder Azure; Kenntnisse der Google Cloud, insbesondere Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Agent Runtime, BigQuery, Cloud Run oder GKE, sind von Vorteil. Praktische Erfahrung mit Generative AI, z. B. Prompt Design und Retrieval-Augmented Generation, sowie mit LLMs und Agenten-Frameworks wie Google ADK, LangChain/LangGraph oder CrewAI in produktiven oder produktionsnahen Umgebungen; idealerweise bringst du auch Kenntnisse in MCP und A2A mit. Erfahrung mit Conversational AI, Prompt Engineering und KI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung sowie mit modernen Coding Agents und Entwicklungswerkzeugen, z. B. Google Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor oder GitHub Copilot. Solide Data-Engineering-Kenntnisse in Data Warehousing, SQL und modernen ETL-/ELT-Pipelines sowie Erfahrung mit produktionsreifen Engineering-Praktiken wie CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Monitoring und automatisiertem Testing. Business-Verständnis und Beratungskompetenz sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln und als kompetente:r Sparringspartner:in für Fachbereiche, IT und Management zu agieren; verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift, mindestens B2. Was wir dir bieten Flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell und mobiles Arbeiten Umfangreiche Fort- und Weiterbildung, inklusive Google-Cloud-Zertifizierungen Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Google Cloud Engineering und Produktteams sowie Zugang zu technischen Trainings und neuen Entwicklungen im Google-AI-Ökosystem Die Möglichkeit, unsere Google Cloud AI Practice mit aufzubauen, technische Standards zu entwickeln und Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte zu übernehmen Attraktive Aufstiegschancen Die Accenture-Kultur: Hier machst DU den Unterschied Deine Fähigkeiten, dein Naturell und deine Ambitionen machen dich einzigartig. Und wenn die unterschiedlichsten Talente, Stärken und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entsteht etwas Großartiges: Ideen, die in der Welt etwas bewegen. Deshalb setzen wir bei Accenture auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung. Schaffe dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du aufgehst. Mit Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen …

items.card: About the Role Are you a heavy-hitting Software Engineer who loves solving complex technical problems but hates being buried behind endless, back-office Jira tickets? Do you thrive when sitting at the intersection of deep engineering, production-grade AI architecture, and real-world customer impact? We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE ) to act as the ultimate elite builder-consultant. In this role,
items.desc: Forward Deployed Engineer | AI & Enterprise Solutions | Berlin / Remote Location : Berlin, Munich, or Frankfurt (Hybrid / Up to 80% Remote within Germany) Employment Type : Full-time, Permanent Experience Level : Senior (5+ years in Software Engineering / Technical Delivery) Stack Focus : Python, Java, or TypeScript | Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) | APIs & Data Pipelines About the Role Are you a heavy-hitting Software Engineer who loves solving complex technical problems but hates being buried behind endless, back-office Jira tickets? Do you thrive when sitting at the intersection of deep engineering, production-grade AI architecture, and real-world customer impact? We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE ) to act as the ultimate elite builder-consultant. In this role, you won't just build software in a vacuum - you will be embedded with our most strategic enterprise accounts to bridge the gap between core product capabilities and production-grade reality. You will move beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, map legacy data landscapes, and ship bespoke, mission-critical solutions directly within customer environments. What You Will Do Embed & Bu ild: Partner closely with enterprise engineering teams and stakeholders to run technical discovery, define requirements, and ship end-to-end solutions. Data Integration & Migration: Own the complexity of moving customer data from legacy systems into modern cloud infrastructures, building robust ETL pipelines and API connectors. AI & Solution Architecture: Architect and deploy production-grade AI workflows, RAG systems, and agentic tools, utilizing AI coding assistants to move fast across polyglot stacks. Product Feedback Loop: Act as the ultimate line of defense in the field. Turn real-world friction and deployment blockers into actionable feedback for our Core Product and R&D teams to shape the future road map. Deliver Rapid Value: Build lightweight custom UIs (React/TypeScript) or low-code automation wrappers where speed is required, ensuring every deployment delivers measurable ROI. What You Bring The Code: 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a strong backend focus, ideally in Python, Java, Go, or TypeScript. The Mindset : Proven experience in a customer-facing or field-facing capacity (e.g., as a Solutions Engineer, Tech Consultant, or Early-stage Founding Engineer). You can translate deep tech into business value. The Data Skills: Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), REST/GraphQL APIs, database schema design, and data validation/reconciliation. AI Literacy: Active, day-to-day use of AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.) and familiarity with modern LLM/vector database setups is highly preferred. Language: Fluency in written and spoken English (C1+). Professional German language skills are a massive advantage but not mandatory. What’s in It for You? Ultimate Autonomy: A highly entrepreneurial role with flat hierarchies and direct, visible impact on company growth. Flexible Hybrid Culture: Modern office hubs in Germany's top tech cities with flexible remote work setups. Continuous Learning: Deep exposure to frontier AI tech stacks, enterprise systems integration, and commercial scaling. More: Competitive salary package, state-of-the-art equipment, and local wellness/mobility benefits.

items.title: AI Native Engineer – Quality & Testing
items.card: you will design, build, and deploy production-grade agentic AI systems across the full enterprise technology stack. You will work directly with client engineering teams, lead technical design sessions, and build reusable patterns and accelerators that scale beyond individual engagements. This role sits at the heart of the AI engineering talent market — demand is growing faster than supply and will continue to do so.
items.desc: Role Description You build the systems that actually make AI work in enterprise environments, not demos, not prototypes that stall after a pilot, but production agentic architectures running inside real client organizations. The difference between an AI Engineer and what we are looking for is straightforward: you have shipped a multi-agent system in production, you have owned the eval harness, and you know what happens when your agent fails at 2am because you have lived it. As an AI Engineer (Agentic/Applied), you will design, build, and deploy production-grade agentic AI systems across the full enterprise technology stack. You will work directly with client engineering teams, lead technical design sessions, and build reusable patterns and accelerators that scale beyond individual engagements. This role sits at the heart of the AI engineering talent market — demand is growing faster than supply and will continue to do so. We offer what no single product company can: breadth across every industry, every enterprise technology stack, and every level of organizational complexity, combined with vendor fellowship access inside Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google engineering teams and a direct pathway to the Forward Deployed Engineer programme. This role sits within our Quality Engineering practice , where AI is applied to modern software testing and quality engineering, with a strong focus on AI-driven test automation, intelligent validation, and building more efficient and scalable testing solutions. Key Responsibilities Design and build production-grade agentic systems end-to-end: multi-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, policy-based routing, tool invocation, memory management, and lifecycle observability Build and own RAG pipelines: embeddings, chunking strategy, vector search, context window engineering and tuning against real quality targets Integrate and abstract across multiple LLM providers — OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI, and open-source models — with fallback routing, token, cost, and latency management Implement LLMOps in production: eval harnesses with real quality metrics, prompt versioning, observability tooling (LangSmith, Braintrust, or equivalent), cost and safety monitoring Embed directly with client engineering teams to design, prototype, and deploy agentic solutions — workshops, proofs of concept, code-with sessions, and architecture walkthroughs Build reusable patterns, accelerators, and playbooks that scale beyond the individual client engagement and enable the next one to start faster Define and use metrics to measure agent accuracy, latency, safety, and cost-effectiveness; present findings and recommendations to client stakeholders in business terms Basic Qualifications Several years of software engineering experience in production environments Hands-on experience designing and deploying agentic AI solutions in a production environment — non-negotiable Demonstrated experience with agentic orchestration frameworks: LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent — at production depth, not tutorial level Direct experience calling LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI) in production code: provider abstraction, token management, latency and cost tradeoffs RAG pipeline ownership: embeddings, chunking strategy, vector databases, and context engineering LLMOps fundamentals: eval harness design, prompt versioning, and production observability Cloud-native engineering maturity: Kubernetes, Docker, microservices, serverless, CI/CD, and IaC (Terraform or Helm) Strong Python; Java or equivalent backend language acceptable; production debugging and observability experience Quality of experience is weighted over years, a candidate who has shipped three production agentic systems in four years is preferred over a generalist with passive AI exposure Hands-on full-stack engineering depth. Cloud-native engineering maturity. Practical use of AI in software development. Client-facing German language proficiency.

items.desc: Et si ton prochain projet Data te permettait d'industrialiser l'IA jusqu'en production ? Chez Zenika, on ne te propose pas juste une mission. On te challenge sur des projets à fort impact où la donnée est le carburant indispensable de l'intelligence artificielle. Le poste en une phrase : Tu conçois et industrialises les plateformes de données de nos clients sur Google Cloud, et tu construis les chaînes de données qui alimentent leurs systèmes d'IA générative (RAG, agents), jusqu'à leur mise en production. Notre modèle : Majeure Data / Mineure IA Chez Zenika, chaque consultant de la filière Data s'appuie sur une majeure (sa spécialité d'ancrage) et développe une mineure (une compétence secondaire maîtrisée sur un métier connexe) : Ta Majeure Data Engineering : Le cœur de ton quotidien. Ta Mineure Forward Deployed AI Engineering : Tu déploies l'IA en production, là où la qualité et la structuration de la donnée font toute la différence. Pas besoin d'être déjà un expert IA : l'envie d'en faire un vrai axe de progression voire une première expérience concrète suffisent. Est-ce toi ? Tes expériences en Data Engineering t'ont permis d'avoir une solide maîtrise de Python, SQL et de l'écosystème Google Cloud. Une pratique éprouvée du streaming (Kafka, Pub/Sub), de l'orchestration (Airflow, Kestra ou Dagster), de la modélisation de données et de l'IaC / CI-CD. Côté IA, tu sais parler d'un premier cas d'usage GenAI mené jusqu'en production ou pilote avancé (RAG, agent, extraction…) et une bonne compréhension des briques clés (LLM, embeddings, bases vectorielles). Un état d'esprit Software Craftsmanship (tests, revue de code, architectures durables) et le goût du partage. Ton terrain de jeu technique parle de toi : Langages : Python, SQL avancé, Spark / PySpark (Java/Scala en plus) Plateformes et ingestion : Google Cloud (BigQuery, Dataflow/Dataproc, Pub/Sub), S3NS, Kafka / Confluent, dbt / Dataform (Databricks, Snowflake en plus) Orchestration et Ops : Airflow, Kestra ou Dagster, Terraform, GitLab CI / GitHub Actions (Docker, K8s, MLflow en plus) IA : Vertex AI / Gemini, LangChain / LangGraph, Google ADK, MCP, FastAPI, pgvector / Qdrant / Chroma / BigQuery Vector Search (vLLM, TGI en plus) Tes missions et projets Au sein de nos clients rennais ou sur des projets d'envergure nationale, tu interviens sur la modernisation de plateformes Cloud/souveraines, des architectures compliance by design et des enjeux FinOps / Green Data. Côté Data Engineering : Concevoir et industrialiser des pipelines batch et streaming (Kafka/Confluent, Pub/Sub) et des architectures Lakehouse / médaillon. Automatiser les déploiements (Terraform, CI/CD) et garantir la gouvernance des données (PII, RLS/CLS, catalogage). Optimiser en continu la performance, la scalabilité et l'empreinte (coût et carbone) des traitements. Côté IA en production : Construire les pipelines d'alimentation IA : préparation, chunking sémantique, embeddings, indexation vectorielle et Context Factory. Mettre en production des cas d'usage RAG et agentiques (FastAPI, protocole MCP), avec guardrails, observabilité et évaluation continue. Piloter le FinOps IA (coûts de tokens et d'inférence) et conseiller nos clients avec pragmatisme : savoir quand l'IA apporte de la valeur, et quand une approche classique suffit. Ce qui rend l’aventure Zenika différente Zéro stagnation : Au moins 2 certifications financées et préparées par an (GCP Data Engineer, ML Engineer, Agentic Architect, Databricks, Confluent, Terraform…), des guildes techniques nationales, du pair programming et du temps dédié au partage (talks, formations, open source). Une évolution sur mesure : Expertise, conseil, management, formation, speaker, leadership, contributions business, notre career lader t'aide à faire le liant entre tes ambitions et nos enjeux. Un cadre sain et transparent : Télétravail hybride flexible, grille salariale respectant l'équité à la compétence, management basé sur la confiance et vrai respect de l'équilibre vie pro / vie perso. Un process clair, humain et rapide 3 étapes en 3 semaines maximum Échange pour comprendre ton parcours et tes envies Entretien tech avec notre Head of Data et/ou un pair Discussion conseil & culture avec un·e manager Nous parlerons de ta rémunération et de notre fonctionnement interne dès le premier échange. Prêt·e à relever le défi ? Postule directement ici, on a hâte d'échanger avec toi ! Chez Zenika, la RSE a une place centrale dans toutes nos décisions, c’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à garantir l’égalité de traitement pour chaque candidature. Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité apporte de la valeur, et l’expérience candidat est au cœur de nos préoccupations. Si tu as des besoins spécifiques, nous adapterons ton processus de recrutement et ton intégration en conséquence. Propulsez votre carrière au sein d'une communauté qui vous ressemble. We already support clients from different verticals to have agentic and RAG systems live in production across healthcare, financial services, retail and global logistics. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you work embedded in
items.desc: Role Description gravity9 is expanding its Forward Deployed Engineering team to build production agentic AI systems for enterprise clients, in partnership with leading frontier-model providers. We already support clients from different verticals to have agentic and RAG systems live in production across healthcare, financial services, retail and global logistics. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you work embedded in the client's environment, from discovery, through architecture and build, to production and handover. This is end-to-end agent engineering, not proofs of concept and not advisory work. Two flavours of engagement: Internal enterprise use cases, such as reconciliation and KYC workflows in financial services, clinical and claims workflows in healthcare, operations and supply-chain workflows in logistics. Product- and customer-facing agents, more greenfield, often exploratory, built into the client's own product. Engagements are typically a team of engineers over a few months, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the client's team including architects, DevOps and QA. Embed with the client. Work hand-in-hand inside the client's environment, codebase and cloud tenancy, often in a hybrid team alongside their engineers. You are visible to the client from day one. Design and build production agentic AI systems. Multi-agent orchestration, tool and function calling, retrieval, planning and routing, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, state and checkpointing, guardrails, failure handling and recovery. Do the unglamorous data work. A large share of every engagement is data engineering: ingestion, flattening deeply nested structures, extracting content from unstructured documents, classification, summarisation, tagging, enrichment, indexing. Models reason over data, bad data beats a good model every time. Own evaluation and accuracy. Establish a baseline eval dataset at the start of the engagement, automate grading, and track groundedness, faithfulness and retrieval quality per tool, not just at the agent level. Be ready to defend accuracy numbers to a sceptical enterprise stakeholder. Engineer for cost and latency. Model selection and routing (cheaper, faster models for non-reasoning steps; frontier models where reasoning genuinely earns it), prompt and context budgeting, caching. Cost is a non-negotiable metric on every engagement. Ship it properly. Observability and tracing, CI/CD, IaC, monitoring the client can actually operate, security and compliance review. Transfer knowledge deliberately. We don't run a long-term support business. Every engagement is designed so the client owns and can extend the system after we leave. You architect with their team in the room, pair with their engineers, and hand over working monitoring and documentation. Technical skills Essential Programming: Strong Python (async, typing, testing, packaging). Working competence in TypeScript / Node is a plus. LLM application engineering: Hands-on production experience with frontier models: prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, tool and function calling, streaming, token and context-window management. Agentic architecture: Built and shipped multi-agent or agentic workflows, planner/router patterns, supervisor and sub-agent designs, ReAct-style loops, state and checkpointing, retries and interrupts, human-in-the-loop review gates. Frameworks: At least one of: Anthropic Agent SDK, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or an equivalent orchestration framework, plus the judgement to know when to use none of them. RAG and retrieval: Chunking strategy, embeddings, hybrid and semantic search, re-ranking, citation and provenance, natural-language-to-query translation. Data platforms: NoSQL databases such as MongoDB (aggregation pipelines, Atlas Search, Atlas Vector Search) or a strong equivalent, plus SQL. Comfortable designing schemas for agent retrieval, not just for OLTP. Data engineering: Building ingestion and enrichment pipelines over messy structured and unstructured sources, documents, PDFs, object storage. Evaluation: Building eval harnesses and eval datasets, LLM-as-judge with its limits understood, regression testing of prompts and agents, metric selection per use case. Cloud: Production delivery on AWS (incl. Bedrock), Azure or GCP, containers, serverless, networking basics, secrets management, IAM. Engineering discipline: Git, code review, testing, CI/CD, IaC (Terraform or equivalent), observability. Strong advantage Anthropic certification (Claude Developer / Anthropic-issued credential), an explicit advantage at shortlisting. Anthropic Agent SDK production experience, a significant bonus. MCP (Model Context Protocol): building servers and clients, tool exposure, auth patterns. Claude Code as an autonomous SDLC agent: sub-agents, hooks, custom skills, agent marketplaces, context sharing across a team. LLM observability and tracing tooling (LangFuse, LangSmith, Arize, Braintrust or similar). Regulated-environment delivery: HIPAA, GDPR, …

Cette immersion vous permettra de découvrir concrètement le fonctionnement d'une équipe Agile dans un environnement industriel et de développer vos compétences en collaboration, communication et organisation de projet. Vous serez encadré·e tout au long de votre stage par un·e ingénieur·e expérimenté·e de l'équipe qui vous accompagnera dans votre montée en compétences, la définition de vos objectifs et la réalisation de vos missions. Nous considérons qu'un stage est avant tout une opportunité d'apprentissage réciproque. Ainsi, vous bénéficierez d'un environnement bienveillant favorisant la découverte, l'expérimentation et le développement de vos compétences techniques et professionnelles ; et vous aurez l’occasion de partager vos apprentissages et connaissances avec l’équipe. Vos missions L'objectif de ce projet est de construire une vision stratégique et technique de l'utilisation de l'IA générative dans nos activités de test logiciel. Mission 1 : Découverte générique du contexte technique Vous inventorierez les méthodologies de test actuellement utilisées dans l’équipe pour en comprendre les avantages et les inconvénients, Vous procéderez à un état de l’art des méthodes et technologies offertes sur le marché pour effectuer du test par IA, Suite à ces deux activités, vous évaluerez quelles sont les phases de développement pouvant le plus bénéficier de tests par intelligence artificielle, ainsi que le type de test ou de pratique à mettre en place pour en tirer le plus parti et les éventuels coûts typiquement associés. Mission 2 : Prise en compte de contraintes Vous évaluerez les contraintes découlant de la stratégie d’entreprise vis-à-vis de l’intelligence artificielle, Vous évaluerez les contraintes techniques et légales vis-à-vis de l’intelligence artificielle, A l’aide de ces nouveaux éléments, vous mettrez à jour l’évaluation que vous aurez réalisée lors de la première mission. Mission 3 : Partage de connaissances En reprenant l’ensemble des éléments des missions précédentes, vous sélectionnerez des solutions techniques à mettre en place afin de prouver par la réalisation d’un PoC la faisabilité de vos propositions, Vous définirez, en collaboration avec votre tuteur de stage, les critères d’acceptation de votre solution et les performances à atteindre, Vous évaluerez votre PoC vis-à-vis des critères sélectionnés pour en tirer des conclusions à ajouter au travail d’évaluation des missions 1 et 2. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. Who You’ll Work With As the premier consulting partner for the private equity industry, Bain's PEG boasts a global practice that is over three times larger than any competitor. Our network of over 1,000 professionals supports private equity and institutional investor clients through every stage of the investment life cycle, from deal generation and due diligence to portfolio value creation and exit planning. This includes the development, commercialisation, and daily management of Bain's proprietary datasets, data, and software businesses. WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM AI/ML Engineers on the Diligence Platform build and maintain the data, feature, and retrieval pipelines that power production RAG and ML systems. You partner with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and the Agent / AI squad on defined pieces of larger pipelines and RAG workstreams, and you build the habits, tooling fluency, and production judgment expected of a Senior ML Engineer. This is a hands-on, growth-oriented engineering role: you are expected to ship reliable, observable code from your first weeks, and to take on increasing ownership as your track record builds. What You’ll Do Core ML and Data Pipeline Engineering (65%) Implement and maintain components of production data and ML pipelines: ingestion jobs, feature and embedding pipelines, and Celery-based workers, under the direction of senior engineers. Write production-quality Python: type hints, tests, and linting to the team's standards, with code reviewed by senior engineers before merge. Instrument the pipelines and services you own with structured logs and metrics, and help build the dashboards and alerts that make issues visible. Reproduce, triage, and fix bugs in pipeline and serving code, escalating ambiguous or high-severity issues to senior engineers. Collaboration and Support (25%) Partner with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and the Agent / AI squad on defined tasks within larger pipeline, retrieval, and evaluation workstreams. Contribute test cases and sample data to evaluation harnesses and golden datasets, under the direction of senior engineers. Participate in design reviews and code reviews, both as reviewer and reviewee, building judgment about production trade-offs. Keep runbooks, READMEs, and pipeline documentation current as you build and change the systems you touch. Other (10%): Use AI coding assistants to accelerate scaffolding and boilerplate, and review generated code against team standards before committing. Use LLMs to draft documentation and status notes; validate and refine outputs before sharing them. Take on interviewing and hiring-loop participation as your experience grows. About You Education and Work Experience: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 2+ years of experience building software, data, or ML systems, ideally including some exposure to production pipelines or services. Exposure to model deployment, serving, or monitoring is a plus. Experience working with structured feedback and code review, and a track record of improving code quality over time. Experience collaborating with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, or the Agent / AI squad to ship features that depend on retrieval or ML outputs. Comfort with Python as a primary language; exposure to a modern cloud environment (Databricks, Azure, or AWS) is a plus. Demonstrated ability to take a well-scoped task from …

items.desc: About EarthID EarthID is a multi-award-winning trust infrastructure platform that helps organisations establish verifiable trust in identity and data, enabling faster, more secure and accountable decisions. The Role You'll design and build AI-powered services and intelligent workflows that form a core part of our technology platform, turning research ideas into production systems that customers depend on. You'll work directly with the founders, prototype quickly, and own problems end to end: from initial experimentation to services running reliably in production. If you like measuring whether an AI system is actually trustworthy, not just whether it produces plausible output, you'll fit in well here. Evaluation, reliability and evidence are central to what we do. What You'll Do Build and deploy production-ready AI services using Python, FastAPI and Docker. Design and optimise LLM-powered applications, including RAG pipelines, structured reasoning and retrieval workflows. Develop agentic AI workflows involving orchestration, tool use and multi-step decision-making. Build evaluation and benchmarking frameworks to measure correctness, reliability, robustness and performance. Implement validation, guardrails, tracing and observability to improve the reliability and explainability of AI systems. Optimise AI systems for latency, scalability and cost. Collaborate with founders, researchers and customers to translate complex problems into working solutions. What We're Looking For We care more about evidence than years of experience. We want to see what you've built, how you've approached difficult problems, and whether you've delivered working solutions. Core focus: Production AI engineering, agentic workflows, reasoning and evaluation. You'll likely bring: Strong Python development skills and experience building production services using frameworks such as FastAPI. Hands-on experience developing LLM-powered applications using commercial or open-source models. Practical experience with RAG, retrieval techniques, embeddings and vector databases. Understanding of agentic architectures, orchestration, tool integration and multi-step AI workflows. Experience designing evaluations, benchmarks and testing approaches for AI systems. Familiarity with AI orchestration, observability and evaluation frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, Langfuse, LangSmith, DeepEval or similar. Experience with Docker, Git, APIs and production deployment practices. Ability to independently design, implement, test and deliver working solutions. Strong problem-solving, communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions clearly. As a rough guide, this role suits someone with 4+ years of software engineering or ML experience , including demonstrable hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications. However, strong practical experience and evidence of delivered systems matter more than years of experience. Bonus: Knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, MCP, multi-agent systems, structured reasoning, fine-tuning, local models, and cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS or Azure. You'll Thrive Here If You Prefer building and shipping solutions over endless experimentation. Learn quickly and enjoy solving unfamiliar technical challenges. Take ownership of problems rather than waiting for detailed instructions. Are comfortable working independently and collaboratively in a fast-moving startup. Care about building AI systems that are reliable, explainable and demonstrably correct. Enjoy turning complex research concepts into practical engineering solutions. Why Join EarthID? You'll join at a stage where your work directly shapes the platform. No legacy systems, no tuning prompts in isolation. You'll help define how reliable, explainable and auditable AI gets built and deployed in industries where trust is non-negotiable. You'll work closely with experienced technology founders on challenging problems spanning agentic AI, decision intelligence, explainable AI, verifiable credentials and privacy-preserving systems. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge research and development while building technology that solves real customer problems. How to apply Send your CV plus anything that shows how you think about architecture - a GitHub, a system you've designed, or a short write-up - to careers@myearth.id EarthID is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. Pay: £50,000.00-£80,000.00 per year Benefits: UK visa sponsorship Ability to commute/relocate: London, Greater London: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (preferred) Application question(s): Located in UK Work authorisation: United Kingdom (preferred) Location: London, Greater London (preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in London

items.desc: Who You Will Be Working With As a Data Engineer at Capgemini, you'll design, build and operate reliable, scalable data pipelines and data products: the trusted foundations that power analytics, AI, GenAI and increasingly agentic systems. You'll work hands-on with modern data engineering tooling and cloud services to ingest, transform and serve data, and you'll prepare and govern the datasets that AI models and AI agents depend on to behave safely and correctly. You'll also use AI-assisted engineering to accelerate your own delivery, while keeping clear human ownership of every outcome. You'll be part of the Data Platforms team within the Insights and Data Global Practice, which has seen strong, sustained growth across a wide range of sectors. Data Platforms is home to Data Engineers, Platform Engineers, Solution Architects and Business Analysts driving our customers' digital and data transformation on modern cloud platforms. We specialise in the latest frameworks, reference architectures and technologies across AWS, Azure and GCP, and data platforms such as Databricks and Snowflake. Please Note Security Clearance: To be successfully appointed to this role, must be eligible to obtain Security Check (SC)clearance or DV (Developed Vetting clearance). To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements. Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process. The Focus Of Your Role You'll build and run the data products that modern AI depends on. That means classic, high-quality data engineering (batch and streaming pipelines, lakehouse and warehouse patterns, well-governed and auditable datasets), and the newer discipline of engineering data for AI and agents: retrieval pipelines, embeddings and vector stores, feature and context preparation, and the observability needed when the systems consuming your data are non-deterministic and can't simply be unit tested. You'll build and run the data products that modern AI depends on. That means classic, high-quality data engineering (batch and streaming pipelines, lakehouse and warehouse patterns, well-governed and auditable datasets), and the newer discipline of engineering data for AI and agents: retrieval pipelines, embeddings and vector stores, feature and context preparation, and the observability needed when the systems consuming your data are non-deterministic and can't simply be unit tested. What You’ll Be Doing You'll work within agreed security and compliance boundaries throughout, which matters in the regulated and public sector environments we operate in. Build and maintain data pipelines and data products. Use appropriate ETL/ELT and distributed processing to ingest, transform and curate trusted data in cloud storage and analytics platforms. Engineer data for AI and agentic use cases. Prepare curated, governed datasets and features for analytics and ML; build retrieval and embedding pipelines (vector stores, chunking, metadata) that serve RAG and agent workflows; and help expose data to AI systems through patterns such as APIs and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Apply data modelling, quality and governance. Develop scalable models, apply validation and quality checks, and maintain lineage and documentation so data products are reliable and auditable. This matters even more when an AI agent, not just a human, is acting on them. Build in observability for non-deterministic systems. Implement logging, alerting and SLAs for production pipelines, and contribute to evaluation and monitoring of AI-facing data and outputs (e.g. drift, retrieval quality, anomaly detection) with clear human review. Use AI-assisted engineering responsibly. Accelerate development, testing and documentation with coding assistants, applying good prompt hygiene, protecting confidential data, and owning the results. Collaborate across teams. Work with business analysts, platform engineers, data scientists and DevOps to deliver secure, well-tested solutions in an agile environment, communicating your design decisions clearly. Keep raising the bar. Use version control, code review, automated testing and CI/CD; share knowledge, contribute to accelerators and standards, and keep current with modern data and AI engineering practice. Experience And What You'll Bring You'll bring solid, hands-on experience delivering data engineering in production, and a genuine interest in how AI and agentic systems change what good data engineering looks like. You don't need to have done all of the AI-specific work below already, but you should be eager to, and able to show the engineering fundamentals that make it possible. …

Our people power our performance – we succeed when they do. With countless opportunities to collaborate, learn, and grow, the possibilities for excellence are as varied as every individual. Whether you want to grow as a subject matter expert or broaden your experience with roles across our international community, you’re surrounded by global specialists who want to combine their expertise and champion you to be your best. As a proudly employee-owned business, we benefit our clients, our communities, and each other, investing in creating the right space for everyone to feel empowered, included, and valued. Whatever your ambition, Mott MacDonald is where people come to be brilliant. About The Team Mott MacDonald's Central Digital function supports the wider company's project delivery. It builds the tools, systems and capabilities that change how we deliver engineering, infrastructure and advisory work for our clients. In Central Digital, the AI team develops and runs applied AI and agentic capability. That means turning promising ideas into secure, governed, reusable products that project teams across our service lines can use. Our work covers several connected areas, including: AI-native project delivery: We're building a new company-wide platform that changes how projects are set up, run and governed. AI agents work alongside project teams to capture information, automate routine setup and delivery tasks, and keep data consistent, while people review and approve key decisions. Transforming how our business lines deliver: We work directly with priority areas of the business to redesign how their work gets done. That includes finding where AI can make the biggest difference, building solutions with their subject matter experts, and helping teams adopt them and measure the impact. The team brings together a broad mix of expertise, including data science, AI and software engineering, digital consulting, architecture, cloud infrastructure and responsible AI governance. Day to day, we work with engineers, subject matter experts and product owners. Together we turn real business problems into practical solutions and take them from prototype to production. We hold ourselves to high standards on evaluation, responsible AI, information security and data protection, because our solutions support decisions on real infrastructure. We're a collaborative team that values ideas from every grade and background, and we put real effort into helping people develop. You'll have room to own meaningful work and learn quickly. Overview Of The Role As a Software Engineer, you'll build modern web applications that solve real engineering and project-delivery problems, including the interfaces people use to work with our AI capabilities. The role is frontend-leaning, with React and TypeScript at the core, and you'll take features from early requirements and UI design through to implementation, integration and production support. You'll work with AI engineers, data scientists and the people who use what we build, connecting front ends to APIs, backend services and AI-enabled features. We care about software that is fast, accessible and easy to maintain, and there will be opportunities to broaden into backend and cloud work. Key responsibilities and duties include: Build modern web applications that solve engineering and project-delivery problems, with React and TypeScript at the core. Take features from early requirements and basic UI design through implementation, integration and production support. Integrate front ends with RESTful APIs, backend services and AI-enabled functionality, including LLM-based features. Create basic wireframes and prototypes where needed. Make maintainable changes to existing codebases, with automated testing, Git, CI/CD and Agile delivery. Look after web performance and accessibility. Contribute to backend services and cloud integrations as opportunities arise. Candidate specification Essential: Professional experience building web applications with React and TypeScript. Solid understanding of component-based architecture, state management and responsive design. Understanding of web performance and accessibility, using tools such as Lighthouse. Experience integrating front ends with RESTful APIs. Familiar with automated testing, Git, CI/CD and Agile delivery. Comfortable writing, debugging and maintaining code by hand, and effective at using AI coding agents to accelerate delivery while critically reviewing what they produce. Desirable: Next.js, including server-side rendering. TanStack Query, Material UI and ESLint. Full-stack …

items.desc: Ortivity GmbH Entwickle KI-Lösungen, die den Alltag an über 150 Standorten verbessern. Ortivity gehört mit über 150 Standorten und mehr als 3.000 Mitarbeitenden zu den führenden Gruppen für ambulante Orthopädie in Deutschland. Bei uns gestaltest du die Digitalisierung der Gesundheitsversorgung aktiv mit und entwickelst KI-Lösungen sowie maßgeschneiderte Software für Ärztinnen und Ärzte, Praxisteams und unsere zentrale Verwaltung. Deine Lösungen können im gesamten Netzwerk eingesetzt werden und mehr Zeit für die Versorgung von jährlich über 1,5 Millionen Patienten schaffen. Das Erwartet Dich Bei Uns Raum für eigene Ideen und die Möglichkeit, technische Lösungswege mitzugestalten Direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und den Anwendern, damit du siehst, was deine Arbeit bewirkt Ein eigenes Aufgabenfeld mit gemeinsam abgestimmten Prioritäten, passend zu deinem Stellenumfang Dein Beitrag Du entwickelst KI-gestützte Funktionen für Praxis und Verwaltung, etwa für Dokumentation oder Terminprozesse, und integrierst Sprachmodelle über APIs Du baust maßgeschneiderte Anwendungen, automatisierst wiederkehrende Abläufe und bindest bestehende Systeme über Schnittstellen an Du stimmst Anforderungen und Prioritäten mit dem Projektmanager Digitalisierung & KI Healthcare, dem COO und der zentralen IT ab Du prüfst KI-Funktionen anhand realistischer Testfälle und verbesserst Ergebnisqualität, Zuverlässigkeit, Antwortzeiten und Kosten Du begleitest deine Lösungen vom Prototyp bis zum produktiven Einsatz und sicherst ihren Betrieb gemeinsam mit der IT durch automatisierte Tests, Monitoring und Dokumentation ab Du entwickelst bestehende Anwendungen weiter, etwa Ortivity Connect, unsere interne Plattform zur Vernetzung der Ärzteschaft Das Bringst Du Mit Du hast relevante Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise aus einem Start-up, und hast Produkte bis in den Live-Betrieb gebracht Du entwickelst sicher in Python oder TypeScript/JavaScript und bringst Erfahrung mit Web-Frontends, Backends, SQL-Datenbanken, Git und REST-APIs mit Du hast LLM-Anwendungen gebaut und beherrschst die Anbindung über APIs, Prompting und die Verarbeitung strukturierter Ausgaben. Erfahrung mit Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) oder Tool-Aufrufen ist willkommen Du kannst KI-Ergebnisse mit geeigneten Testfällen bewerten und kennst typische Fehlerquellen wie Halluzinationen und Prompt Injection sowie geeignete technische Schutzmaßnahmen Du arbeitest mit Coding-Agenten, strukturierst Entwicklungsaufgaben klar und prüfst den erzeugten Code eigenständig, einschließlich Tests und Sicherheitsaspekten Du kennst die Grundprinzipien der DSGVO und setzt sichere Datenflüsse, Zugriffsrechte und Datenminimierung technisch um. Den Umgang mit Gesundheitsdaten stimmst du mit IT und Datenschutz ab Du lernst gern dazu, arbeitest selbstständig und tauschst dich mit anderen über technische Fragen aus Ein Plus sind Erfahrung mit TypeScript, React/Next.js und PostgreSQL sowie mit Software in regulierten Branchen wie dem Gesundheits- oder Finanzwesen Das Bieten Wir Dir Flexibilität: Du arbeitest vollständig remote und profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten Arbeitsumfang: Du wählst flexibel zwischen 50 und 100 % und erhältst einen unbefristeten Vertrag Attraktive Vergütung: Du erhältst ein Jahresbruttogehalt von 70.000 bis 80.000 € (bei 100 %) Weiterentwicklung: Dir stehen ein Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.000 € pro Jahr und die Angebote der Ortivity Academy zur Verfügung Vorsorge: Du profitierst von einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss und der Option auf eine Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherung ohne Gesundheitsprüfung Zusätzliche Benefits: Du erhältst Zugang zu Corporate Benefits und Bikeleasing Guter Start: Ein strukturiertes Onboarding und gemeinsame Team-Events erleichtern dir den Einstieg Kontakt Bewirb dich jetzt in nur wenigen Klicks und werde Teil unseres Teams. Klicke auf „Jetzt bewerben“ und übermittle uns deine Unterlagen schnell und unkompliziert über das Portal – wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Bei Fragen sind wir jederzeit gerne für dich da. Mitglied im Ortivity Netzwerk Auf der Webseite und dem Ortivity Karriereportal werden die folgenden Bilder von iStock und Freepik verwendet. items.card: you will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of the IT infrastructure that supports our internal applications and DevOps toolchain. You will work across a diverse application landscape and contribute to the success of our software development and business operations. In this role, you will: Manage and support business-critical applications and IT infrastructure.
items.desc:
Where do people love what they do, and being great at what they do? 
 At Swisslog, that’s where! Our teams are the heart of a world-leading Robotics company that’s harnessing the power of technology to shape the future of intralogistics. The result? We’re transforming performance and efficiency for customers across the globe, giving them the vital edge in their markets.
 Make an impact 
 As a Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of the IT infrastructure that supports our internal applications and DevOps toolchain. You will work across a diverse application landscape and contribute to the success of our software development and business operations.
 In this role, you will:
 Manage and support business-critical applications and IT infrastructure.
 Design, develop, and continuously improve application infrastructure solutions.
 Perform system patching, upgrades, and stability improvements.
 Monitor application performance and proactively optimize system health and availability.
 Analyze and troubleshoot application, server, and database performance issues.
 Lead incident investigation and resolution activities to minimize downtime.
 Provide 2nd and 3rd level technical support.
 Configure, administer, and enhance internal tools and platforms.
 Collaborate with developers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable solutions.
 Create and maintain clear technical documentation.
 Contribute to the ongoing evolution of our DevOps and infrastructure capabilities.
 What you need to succeed 
 Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
 Experience in infrastructure engineering, automation, or industrial IT environments.
 Strong knowledge of networking, servers, virtualization, and operating systems.
 Experience with troubleshooting and resolving complex technical issues.
 Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a project-based environment.
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
 Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
 Fluent in English; additional language skills are an advantage.
 #LI-DJ1
 Our promise to you 
 Swisslog is a world of opportunity for people who can deliver a game changing mission: driving the future of intralogistics, by shaping an era of robotic and data-driven automated solutions that create exceptional customer value.
 Join us on this journey and you’ll be part of a global enterprise that’s proud of its Swiss roots - and hugely excited by the worldwide opportunities open to everyone in the Swisslog family. So come and realize your potential, in a team that’s united by passion and driven by the OneSwisslog team spirit.
 Join the journey! 
 We´re looking forward to receiving your application!
 Talent Acquisition Manager: Scott McIntee

items.desc: En tant qu'organisateur de forums de recrutement, Talents Handicap accompagne de très nombreuses entreprises & organisations en France dans leurs recrutements de collaborateurs en situation de handicap. Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums. L'entreprise Sopra Steria recherche actuellement des profils : Sopra Steria, acteur majeur de la Tech en Europe avec 56000 collaborateurs dans près de 30 pays, est reconnu pour ses activités de conseil, de services numériques et d’édition de logiciels. Il aide ses clients à mener leur transformation digitale et à obtenir des bénéfices concrets et durables. Le Groupe apporte une réponse globale aux enjeux de compétitivité des grandes entreprises et organisations, combinant une connaissance approfondie des secteurs d’activité et des technologies innovantes à une approche résolument collaborative. Sopra Steria place l’humain au centre de son action et s’engage auprès de ses clients à tirer le meilleur parti du digital pour construire un avenir positif. En 2023, le Groupe a réalisé un chiffre d’affaires de 5,8 milliards d’euros. The world is how we shape it \n\n Description de l'entreprise Leader technologique européen, Sopra Steria accompagne les organisations dans le déploiement de leurs projets stratégiques en s’appuyant sur ses expertises en conseil, intégration, solutions métiers, intelligence artificielle et cybersécurité. Dans un contexte où la souveraineté numérique, la résilience des infrastructures et la maîtrise des données sont devenues essentielles, Sopra Steria contribue à renforcer l’autonomie stratégique de l’Europe, notamment au service des infrastructures critiques et des missions régaliennes dans les domaines des services financiers, de la défense, du spatial, de l’aéronautique et des services publics. Fort de 51000 collaborateurs dans près de 30 pays et d’un chiffre d’affaires de 5,6 milliards d’euros en 2025, Sopra Steria aide ses clients à renforcer leur compétitivité et à obtenir des bénéfices concrets et durables, en combinant une connaissance approfondie des métiers et des technologies à une approche collaborative, avec l’ambition de répondre durablement aux grands défis de notre époque. Description du poste Au sein de la Direction Groupe du Vertical Services Financiers , vous rejoignez une équipe qui ne se contente pas de parler d'IA : elle l' applique , à sa propre organisation comme aux projets de ses clients banques et assurances. Votre stage a deux terrains de jeu : l' interne (nos façons de travailler) et l' externe (nos offres et nos propositions commerciales ). NOTRE MISSION Une équipe Groupe au contact des clients et de tous les pays européens. Nous mobilisons les expertises et les assets de toutes les entités (conseil, intégration) pour proposer des offres globales sur l' IA générative et agentique , les paiements de demain , les actifs numériques , l' identité numérique , l' Open Finance et le quantique . VOS MISSIONS En interne : transformer nos ways of working Automatiser nos reportings : cartographier les reportings du vertical, identifier ce qui peut être automatisé et le construire (flux de données, agents, tableaux de bord) ; Outiller la transformation : prototyper des assistants et agents IA pour les tâches récurrentes, accompagner leur adoption et mesurer le temps gagné ; En externe : booster nos offres et nos propales Créer des assets IA pour nos offres : démonstrateurs, prototypes et accélérateurs, nourris par une veille sur les modèles, agents et start-ups ; Intégrer l'IA dans nos propositions commerciales : identifier, pour chaque client, où l'IA crée de la valeur, et le traduire en solution et en démo. POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE Les deux faces de l'IA en entreprise : la construire pour soi et la proposer aux autres. Vos outils serviront à l'équipe dès les premières semaines, vos assets seront présentés à des grands comptes financiers européens , au contact direct de la direction du vertical . Qualifications Étudiant(e) en école d'ingénieur (Bac+5), stage de fin d'études ou césure, idéalement spécialisé(e) en IA, data science ou informatique ; Solides bases techniques : Python, manipulation de données, APIs ; pratique des LLM (prompting, RAG, agents) ; Goût du concret : vous aimez prototyper vite et voir vos outils utilisés ; Pédagogie : expliquer une solution technique à un public métier, en français et en anglais ; Plus : intérêt pour la banque, l'assurance ou le conseil ; pratique d'outils low-code ou de data visualisation. Informations supplémentaires Un accord télétravail pour télétravailler jusqu’à 2 jours par semaine selon vos missions. Un package avantages intéressants : des titres restaurants, accès aux subventions des activités sociales & culturelles. Plusieurs centaines de formations accessibles en toute autonomie depuis l'app mobile avec Sopra Steria Academy La possibilité de s’engager auprès d’une association grâce à notre plateforme d’engagement citoyen. items.title: Cybersecurity & AI Governance Consultant
items.card: The role You will run several client engagements at the same time as a hands-on governance, risk and compliance (GRC) consultant. You turn security from a compliance exercise into a business enabler: risk-informed rather than risk-averse. You will advise CISOs, CIOs, boards and risk committees, and help clients govern new technology, including generative AI and AI agents, with confidence. What you will do • Lead
items.desc: Cybersecurity & AI Governance Consultant (Contract, multiple client engagements) Agents Stack | Global: Dubai, Singapore, Malaysia, UK or US (hybrid, client sites as needed) Pay: US$10,000 a month fixed + commission on engagements won and delivered About Agents Stack Agents Stack (AGENTSSTACK PTE LTD) is an AI and cybersecurity consulting firm based in Singapore. We help banks, government-linked organisations, maritime, healthcare and growing businesses adopt AI safely and build cyber resilience, from governance and risk frameworks to AI agent security and regulatory readiness. The role You will run several client engagements at the same time as a hands-on governance, risk and compliance (GRC) consultant. You turn security from a compliance exercise into a business enabler: risk-informed rather than risk-averse. You will advise CISOs, CIOs, boards and risk committees, and help clients govern new technology, including generative AI and AI agents, with confidence. What you will do • Lead cybersecurity and technology risk assessments for clients across IT, cloud and, where relevant, OT environments; identify control gaps and drive remediation plans • Design and implement governance frameworks, policies, standards and procedures aligned to MAS Technology Risk Management (TRM) Guidelines, MAS Notice 655/658, the Cybersecurity Act, IM8, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF and CSA Cyber Trust / Cyber Essentials • Build and run living risk registers, Key Risk Indicators and reporting for management and risk committees • Set up AI governance: AI use-case inventories, risk classification, AI risk and impact assessments, and lifecycle controls for AI models and agents (aligned to IMDA's Model AI Governance Framework, ISO/IEC 42001 and NIST AI RMF) • Assess third-party and outsourcing risk: vendor due diligence, control reviews and ongoing monitoring • Prepare clients for audits and regulatory inspections; review evidence, control design and operating effectiveness • Translate deep technical risk into clear business language for senior stakeholders and boards • Support business development: scope proposals, contribute to pitches and grow accounts (commission-linked) What you bring • 8+ years in cybersecurity GRC, technology risk management, information security or security architecture, ideally in banking, government or Big Four / consulting • Working knowledge of MAS TRM, IM8, ISO 27001, NIST and Singapore's Cybersecurity Act; exposure to AI governance is a strong plus • Experience running risk assessments, policy frameworks, audits and remediation programmes end to end • Comfortable managing several clients and deadlines at once with a high degree of autonomy • Strong writing and stakeholder skills; able to challenge constructively and influence without authority • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor or AIGP are an advantage • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security or a related field Why Agents Stack • Varied, high-impact work across banks, public sector and fast-growing companies • Fixed monthly pay plus uncapped commission • Work at the edge of AI and cybersecurity with a founder-led team (ex-McKinsey, Cloudflare, GE) How to apply Send your CV and a short note on a governance or risk programme you led to aanchal@agentsstack.com, or book a call: calendly.com/aanchal-agentsstack Pay: €10,000.00 per month Work Location: Hybrid remote in Dublin, County Dublin

Commuting and business travel allowance, as well as work from home and internet allowance. Opportunities to develop yourself with a training program as well as weekly research and knowledge meetings. items.desc: About The Role We are seeking an enthusiastic and technically curious intern to support the development of agentic AI workflows and intelligent automation within an enterprise content management system (CMS) environment. Working with software engineers, product owners, content specialists, and other stakeholders, you will help design, build, test, and document workflows that use AI models, APIs, and automation tools to improve content creation, validation, publishing, and platform operations. This is an opportunity to gain practical experience at the intersection of AI, web development, software engineering, and digital content operations in a collaborative, enterprise environment. Key Responsibilities Support the design and implementation of AI-enabled workflows for CMS and web-platform processes. Develop integrations between AI services, CMS platforms, APIs, databases, search services, and business tools. Build or configure agent tools that can retrieve information, generate structured content, validate data, and initiate approved actions. Contribute to workflow orchestration using code and automation platforms. Create prompts, schemas, validation rules, and human-review steps to improve the reliability of AI-generated outputs. Develop tests and evaluation scenarios to assess accuracy, safety, performance, and error handling. Implement appropriate logging, monitoring, retry logic, audit trails, and escalation paths. Help identify and mitigate risks such as hallucination, prompt injection, unauthorized actions, data leakage, and excessive permissions. Document technical designs, workflows, operating procedures, assumptions, and known limitations. Participate in agile ceremonies, peer reviews, demonstrations, and continuous improvement activities. Essential Requirements Currently studying toward a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, artificial intelligence, information systems, or a related discipline. Practical programming experience in Python and working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript. Understanding of web development concepts, including HTML, HTTP, REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and databases. Experience using Git and applying basic software development and testing practices. Basic understanding of large language models, prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, and AI limitations. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn new technologies quickly. Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Desirable Requirements Experience with a CMS such as WordPress, Drupal, Contentful, Sanity, Strapi, or Sitecore. Familiarity with workflow automation, serverless functions, queues, webhooks, or scheduled jobs. Exposure to retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, semantic search, or vector databases. Experience with agent or workflow frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or n8n. Familiarity with Playwright, Selenium, Docker, cloud platforms, CI/CD, or observability tools. Understanding of content governance, SEO, accessibility, localization, metadata, or digital asset management. Portfolio, academic project, hackathon, or open-source contribution demonstrating practical software development or AI automation.
