items.desc:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Data and GenAI Architect to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS data-driven and AI solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle, with a specific focus on data architecture, AI/ML implementations, and generative AI solutions.
Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Data and GenAI Architect you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure data platforms and AI solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current data infrastructure, and propose effective strategies for implementing modern data architectures and GenAI solutions on AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging AI technologies, and innovative data solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption, with particular emphasis on data modernization and AI transformation. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for: 
1. Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
2. Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
3. Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
4. Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
5. Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts
Language Requirement: Candidate must be able to speak Italian at a professional level.
About the team
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud. 
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. 
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

items.desc: Après une phase de transformation réussie, Partoo (SaaS B2B, 42M ARR) entre en 2026 dans une nouvelle étape clé : celle de l'accélération. Nous sommes aujourd'hui une scale-up européenne solide, rentable et en croissance, classée au French Tech 120, avec une ambition claire : devenir la référence de l'expérience client locale pour les réseaux de points de vente. Notre mission : aider les entreprises à mieux gérer leur visibilité, leurs échanges et la relation client locale, grâce à une plateforme tout-en-un, pensée mobile-first et AI-first. L'innovation a du sens ici, l'impact est concret et la réussite se construit collectivement. Chez Partoo, l'IA n'est pas un sujet de slide. Elle est dans le produit (génération de réponses aux avis, contenus, nouveaux canaux de visibilité liés aux moteurs IA) et dans notre façon de travailler : nos équipes tech utilisent Claude et Claude Code au quotidien, de la spec à la revue de code, et construisent ensemble les bonnes pratiques qui vont avec. EQUIPE Tu évolueras au sein de l'équipe Tech , composée de plus de 30 personnes et pilotée par Stéphane, notre CTO. Elle est organisée en Tribus et Impact Teams : chaque Tribu est dirigée par un binôme Engineering Manager et Lead Product Manager, et les Impact Teams, mixtes design, produit, développement et QA, travaillent en Scrum avec des sprints de 2 semaines en moyenne. Ton rôle : concevoir et livrer des fonctionnalités de bout en bout sur notre stack Python / React, pour des milliers de points de vente qui utilisent Partoo au quotidien. Contribuer aux bonnes pratiques d'usage de l'IA dans l'équipe : revue de code assistée, génération de tests, prompts, skills et agents partagés, sécurité et confidentialité des données. Partager tes apprentissages avec les autres développeuses et développeurs (démos, documentation, rituels). Qualité et fiabilité Écrire du code testé, lisible et maintenable, et participer activement aux code reviews. Contribuer à la réduction de la dette technique et à la performance de services qui tournent à grande échelle. Participer au suivi de la production et à la résolution des incidents. Leadership project En parallèle du produit, tu portes un projet transverse qui apporte de la valeur à toute l'équipe Tech. Quelques exemples : industrialiser l'usage de Claude Code dans la CI et les code reviews, créer des agents ou des connecteurs MCP internes pour automatiser les tâches répétitives, faire évoluer le design system Partoo, améliorer nos pratiques de test. Mois 2 : premières fonctionnalités livrées en autonomie, participation active aux code reviews, choix de ton leadership project. items.desc: Job Details: Job Description: Join Us in Shaping the Future The world is transforming, and so is Intel. Intel is a company of bold and curious inventors and problem solvers who create some of the most astounding technology advancements and experiences in the world. With a legacy of relentless innovation and a commitment to bringing smart, connected devices to every person on Earth, our diverse and brilliant teams are continually searching for tomorrow's technology and embracing the challenge of changing the world for the better. We work every day to design software and hardware technologies that empower modern computing. Come join us and help build the compiler technologies that drive the next generation of AI and accelerated computing. Role Overview Join our compiler team and lead the design, development, and optimization of AI compiler technologies for Triton, Domain Specific Languages (DSLs), and emerging AI programming models. Our teams develop software that enables high-performance execution of AI workloads across Intel CPUs, GPUs, and accelerators, enabling developers to write highly efficient kernels that power modern machine learning frameworks and high-performance computing applications. You will work on modern compiler infrastructures including LLVM and MLIR, driving innovations that improve performance, scalability, programmability, and portability across diverse hardware architectures. This role provides opportunities to contribute to open-source ecosystems while solving challenging problems in compiler design, code generation, optimization, runtime integration, and performance engineering. By joining us, you'll help build the software foundations that enable developers and researchers to unlock the full potential of Intel's AI and accelerator platforms while influencing the future direction of compiler technologies for heterogeneous computing. Key Responsibilities Lead the design, implementation, testing, and maintenance of compiler technologies for Triton, Domain Specific Languages (DSLs), and related AI programming models. Drive development of advanced compiler optimizations, analyses, and transformations that improve performance, scalability, and developer productivity. Own significant components of the compiler stack, including front-end, optimization, code generation, runtime integration, or tooling technologies. Collaborate with hardware architects, compiler engineers, AI framework developers, and performance engineers to enable new platform capabilities. Analyze and resolve complex functional, correctness, and performance issues across the compiler stack. Drive technical discussions, architecture reviews, and engineering best practices. Mentor junior engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, and code reviews. Contribute to the technical roadmap and influence the direction of compiler technologies within Intel's AI software ecosystem. En réunissant ces compétences, la Régie de l'Eau Bordeaux Métropole agit de manière cohérente et intégrée face aux enjeux environnementaux. Intégrer nos équipes, c'est s'épanouir dans un métier porteur de sens, c'est écrire ensemble l'avenir de la Régie de l'Eau Bordeaux Métropole et contribuer à la construction d'une entreprise performante, humaine, exemplaire et innovante. L'eau est une ressource vitale Pour la préserver, la régie permet de développer une politique ambitieuse et efficace au regard de l'urgence climatique et des enjeux de la préservation de la ressource. L'eau est un bien commun La gestion publique avec la régie de L'Eau Bordeaux Métropole permet d'impliquer les citoyens et leurs représentants pour construire collectivement le territoire en transition. L'eau est un service essentiel L'ambition de la régie est d'encourager notamment par l'intermédiaire d'une structure tarifaire adaptée, une consommation maîtrisée en prenant en compte les publics les plus fragiles. Dans le cadre de la démarche d'innovation et d'amélioration continue de la Régie, le stage vise à étudier en priorité la mise en oeuvre de grands et petits modèles (LLM et SLM) open source ou non, exécutés sur une infrastructure maîtrisée. Ces modèles serviront de socle à des solutions de génération, de recherche augmentée par les données (RAG). Le stage s'inscrit dans une logique de prototypage, d'expérimentation ou de mise en place dans un environnement de production. Objectifs du stage Rattaché au sein de la DSI et de l'équipe data - dev, vous aurez la charge de : - Identifier et prioriser des cas d'usage adaptés à des LLM dans les métiers de l'eau et de l'assainissement. - Prototyper des agents IA capables de traiter des données structurées et non structurées - Tester des solutions d'IA pour automatiser ou enrichir des tâches métiers (analyse, synthèse, classification, prédiction) - Évaluer les performances des agents (précision, pertinence, UX) - Évaluer les apports concrets de l'IA dans un cadre opérationnel Missions - Définir des scénarios d'expérimentation avec des agents IA - Cadrer 2 à 3 scénarios représentatifs avec les métiers et formaliser un jeu de tests et des critères de réussite mesurables. - Développer des prototypes, agents conversationnels, moteurs de recommandation, outils d'analyse sémantique, utilisation de modèles open source - Mettre en place des protocoles de test et d'évaluation - Documenter les travaux et présenter les résultats Profil recherché - Étudiant(e) Bac+5 en informatique, intelligence artificielle, data science ou formation équivalente. - Bon niveau de développement, idéalement en Python, et compréhension des API et bases de données. - Sensibilité aux problématiques de cybersécurité, de protection des données et d'IA responsable. - Autonomie, curiosité, esprit d'analyse Environnement technique - Python, Jupyter, FastAPI, DotNET - PostgreSQL ou autre base de données - Outils IA : LangChain, spaCy, n8n, Transformers, etc. - Outils collaboratifs : Azure devops Ref : 31723499

items.desc: Date de publication : Nov 23, 2026, 5:02PM Durée du contrat : 5 mois Plongez au cœur de l’innovation en rejoignant nos équipes Cloud, Ops et IA agentique. Nous recherchons un·e étudiant·e de niveau Bac+5, intéressé·e par le cloud computing, l’automatisation et la conception de systèmes d’agents basés sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM). En collaboration avec les équipes opérationnelles, vous contribuerez à identifier, concevoir et expérimenter des cas d’usage d’agents IA pour les environnements cloud publics et privés. Vous explorerez notamment les architectures agentiques, l’orchestration de tâches en plusieurs étapes, l’usage d’outils et d’API par les agents, ainsi que leur intégration aux processus Ops. Vos missions pourront inclure : Identifier des cas d’usage pertinents pour des agents IA dans les activités d’exploitation cloud ; Concevoir des prototypes d’agents capables d’analyser des informations opérationnelles et d’utiliser des outils autorisés ; Étudier l’intégration de sources de connaissances, par exemple via la génération augmentée par récupération (RAG), et de protocoles d’interconnexion tels que MCP ; Participer à l’automatisation de tâches Ops, avec des mécanismes de validation et de supervision humaine pour les actions sensibles ; Évaluer les prototypes à l’aide de scénarios de test, de critères de performance et de suivi des appels aux outils ; Appliquer les principes de sécurité by design : gestion des accès, protection des données, traçabilité, garde-fous et conformité aux règles d’usage de l’IA. Vous êtes attiré·e par les infrastructures d’exploitation et les environnements cloud, publics comme privés. Curieux·se et motivé·e par l’innovation, vous souhaitez développer vos compétences en IA générative et en IA agentique, et contribuer à leur mise en pratique dans un contexte Ops sécurisé. Vous êtes reconnu·e pour votre capacité d’apprentissage, votre esprit d’initiative et votre aptitude à analyser des problèmes complexes. Vous savez également synthétiser des informations techniques et les restituer clairement. Compétences et intérêts souhaités : Bases en programmation, notamment en Python ; la connaissance de PHP est un plus. Familiarité avec au moins un environnement cloud : AWS, Microsoft Azure ou Google Cloud. Intérêt pour les LLM et leurs usages : prompt engineering, appels d’outils (tool calling), sorties structurées et évaluation des réponses. Intérêt pour la conception d’agents : orchestration de tâches, gestion d’état et de mémoire, workflows multi-étapes, supervision humaine et garde-fous. Connaissance, même académique ou pratique, de frameworks et technologies tels que LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, GraphRAG, MCP ou ACP. Sensibilité aux enjeux de sécurité et de confidentialité : gestion des accès, protection des données, traçabilité et contrôle des actions des agents. Une première expérimentation avec des LLM ou des prototypes d’agents — dans un projet personnel, académique ou professionnel — constitue un atout. La connaissance de modèles ou d’outils spécifiques n’est pas indispensable : les technologies évoluant rapidement, la curiosité et la capacité à apprendre comptent avant tout. Découverte de domaine innovant (ia agentique) dans un contexte opérationnel d’exploitation Intégration d’une équipe soudée diverse et dynamique Expérience dans une entreprise leader dans son domaine DATSI est l’entité des activités transverses de la DSI d’Orange France, elle gère les grandes transformations du SI que sont le Move To Cloud et la refonte de notre modèle de production Au sein de DATSI, ASEQ (Automatisme, Soutien, Expertise de données et Qualité) est l'entité en charge pour tout le SI, de la maîtrise d'œuvre d'applications avec peu d'évolutions (cristallisées), de la qualité des données, de l'automatisation des tâches d'exploitation, de l'anonymisation des données ainsi que de l'exploitation d'applications hors SI. Ce département est géré par Marc DELMAS. Date de début souhaitée : Feb 01, 2027, 12:00AM Chez Orange, seules vos compétences comptent. Quel que soit votre âge, genre, origine, parcours, religion, orientation sexuelle, handicap, neuroatypie, ou apparence, nous encourageons activement la diversité au sein de nos équipes, car elle constitue une force pour le collectif et un vecteur d’innovation. Orange est une entreprise handi-accueillante : n’hésitez pas à nous faire part de vos besoins spécifiques.

items.desc: Digital Value creator. At Siemens, we have bold ambitions for driving digitalization and building a truly data- and AI-driven enterprise. Platform Evaluation & Vendor Integration: Lead technical evaluations, proofs-of-concept, and architectural integration for modern governance tools and open-source standards (e.g., enterprise data catalogs, OpenLineage, Great Expectations, feature stores, model observability platforms). items.desc: Job Description Data Analytics - Senior Associate - Conversational Analytics The Chief Data Office (CDO) is seeking a Senior Associate to join the Enterprise Data & Analytics team in our London office. This role suits an early-career technology enthusiast who can be productive quickly, someone with strong fundamentals and some hands-on experience (through industry roles, internships, or substantial project work) and the ambition to take ownership in a fast-moving analytics and AI environment. The Enterprise Data & Analytics team reports to the Chief Data Officer and supports decision-making across Fitch Group through insights, analytics, and data-driven solutions. The team operates globally, with colleagues in London and New York, and builds capabilities that help business units drive revenue growth, product innovation, productivity gains, and stronger business performance. Within this global function, you will join the team scaling our conversational analytics capability - taking a proven approach and extending it across a growing number of dashboards, partnering closely with each dashboard's product owner along the way. What We Offer: High ownership from day one, with clear goals and access to experienced colleagues for targeted support and review. The opportunity to contribute to high-impact analytics and reporting initiatives that support decision-making across Fitch Group. A supportive, collaborative environment with access to experienced colleagues across a global function. Exposure to a broad range of stakeholders, data sources, and business questions. What you'll work on (indicative, not exhaustive): Agentic AI Workflows - Build and iterate on an already-established prototype that lets users interact with our data and dashboards through natural-language conversation. AI-Ready Data - Partner with dashboard product owners to shape their dashboards into an AI-ready form the agent can query cleanly and reliably. Semantic Layers & Ontologies - Contribute to semantic models (metrics, definitions, and metadata) so a given metric means the same thing everywhere it's asked about, however the question is phrased. Knowledge Base Authoring - Author and maintain the knowledge base that tells the agent how to answer questions correctly for each dashboard. Agent Routing - Develop the orchestration logic that routes user prompts to the correct dashboards and data as the AI-ready dashboard estate grows. Testing & Quality - Test each newly onboarded dashboard for accuracy and correct permissioning before it goes live, and help build repeatable checks the team can reuse for every future dashboard. Evaluation & Benchmarking - Help define evaluation criteria - accuracy, latency, cost, and user impact - to support decisions on what to scale. What You Need to Have: A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience), plus evidence you can deliver in real-world settings (e.g., 1-3 years experience, internships, or substantial end-to-end projects). Genuine curiosity about AI, LLMs, and the evolving analytics landscape, and enthusiasm for driving AI-led initiatives forward. A genuine interest in data: how it's modelled, joined, structured, and optimised - and the judgement to think about what "good" looks like in a data model. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. You'll be working directly with dashboard product owners across the business, so you need to be comfortable running conversations, asking good questions, and keeping people engaged. Ability to work independently: you can scope tasks, manage your time, and make pragmatic trade-offs to deliver value with minimal supervision. What Would Make You Stand Out: Understanding of data modelling concepts, metadata management, or semantic layers. Exposure to conversational AI, LLM-powered tools, or agent-based workflows. Experience with MCP connections. Familiarity with BI platforms (e.g., Qlik, Power BI, Tableau). Familiarity with version control (Git). Our global network of colleagues comes together to accomplish things greater than they ever could alone. Every team member is essential to our business and each perspective is critical to our success. We embrace a diverse culture that encourages a free exchange of ideas, guaranteeing your voice will be heard and your work will have an impact, regardless of seniority. We are building incredible things at Fitch and we invite you to join us on our journey. Fitch Group is a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries. Deploy on cloud infrastructure (GCP, Azure, or AWS) using containers, serverless, and infrastructure-as-code. Build and maintain the data pipelines that feed AI systems, across warehouses, lakehouses, and vector stores. Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor) daily, with good judgment about verification and review. You will design, build and optimise the AI models and prompt architectures that allow EMMA to understand patient needs, retrieve accurate clinical information, and respond naturally across text and voice channels. This is a hands-on,
items.desc: About Quantumloopai QuantumLoopAI is transforming how patients access healthcare. Our AI-powered reception system, EMMA, serves millions of patients, helping GP surgeries manage demand, reduce phone queues, and ensure patients get the right care at the right time. Backed by leading healthcare investors and working with stakeholders across England, we are building the future of primary care access. As we prepare for our Series A and expand our team, we are looking for exceptional people who want to make a genuine difference to healthcare. About The Role As our AI/ML & Prompt Engineer, you will own the intelligence behind EMMA — the LLM and RAG systems that power our chatbot, voice agent and telephony services. You will design, build and optimise the AI models and prompt architectures that allow EMMA to understand patient needs, retrieve accurate clinical information, and respond naturally across text and voice channels. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where your work will directly shape patient outcomes across hundreds of GP surgeries. What You Will Do Architect and deploy LLM- and RAG-based systems that ingest data sources, generate accurate responses, and power both chatbot and voice agent interactions. Design, iterate and optimise prompts and voice-agent dialogue flows to maximise response relevance, reduce latency and ensure clinical safety across text and voice channels. Partner with frontend (Next.js, React) and backend (NestJS, Python) teams to integrate AI and voice agent components into our Azure-hosted microservices architecture. Instrument AI and voice-agent pipelines, analyse logs and user feedback, troubleshoot edge cases, and implement continuous-learning improvements. Stay abreast of the latest advances in LLMs, RAG, conversational AI frameworks, and (GDPR, DTAC) to inform our technical roadmap. Define and execute rigorous test plans in collaboration with QA to validate model accuracy, voice-agent performance and compliance with healthcare standards. Mentor junior engineers and advocate for best practices in MLOps, prompt engineering, voice-agent design and model governance. Requirements ESSENTIAL Demonstrable hands-on experience with prompt engineering, LLMs (e.g. GPT, LLaMA, Mistral), RAG frameworks, and voice-agent or dialogue-system design, with shipped projects or open-source contributions. Advanced proficiency in Python for ML/AI development. Experience building APIs in NestJS and familiarity with Next.js/React for frontend integration. Strong understanding of Azure services (App Services, Functions, Cognitive Services), containerisation (Docker), and relational databases (MySQL). Experience designing microservices, distributed architectures and RESTful or GraphQL APIs. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI and voice-agent concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Comfortable working remotely and collaborating asynchronously with a UK-based team during UK business hours (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM GMT/BST). DESIRABLE Contributions to open-source LLM or RAG tooling. Experience with MLOps pipelines, model monitoring and automated evaluation frameworks. Background in speech-to-text, text-to-speech, or telephony integration. LOGISTICS Education: We value skills and experience over formal qualifications. Working arrangements: Fully remote from India, aligned to UK business hours (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM GMT/BST). Start date: Flexible. Benefits WHAT WE OFFER Competitive package depending on experience Potential share options Professional development including conference attendance and CPD support Remote working with a collaborative, supportive team How We Are Different At QuantumLoopAI, you will join a team that is genuinely improving primary care. We move fast, take ownership, and celebrate wins together. Our culture values: Impact over optics. We measure success by patient outcomes, not busy work Transparency. Open communication, honest feedback, shared context Ownership. You will have real autonomy to shape your work and our product Learning. We are building something new, and we learn from every experiment DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION We believe diverse teams build better products. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. If you are excited about this role but do not meet every requirement, we would still love to hear from you. RECRUITMENT SAFETY NOTICE QuantumLoopAI will never ask candidates for payment or sensitive financial information during the recruitment process. All official communications come from @quantumloopai.com email addresses. COME WORK WITH US We would love to hear from you. Questions about this role? Contact careers@quantumloopai.com

items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Prozess- & Strategieberatung: Du berätst unsere Kunden zu ihren Customer-Service-Prozessen, identifizierst Automatisierungspotenziale und entwickelst Strategien, wie AI Agents KPIs (wie AHT oder CSAT) messbar verbessern können. Workshops & Enablement: Du führst Anforderungs-Workshops durch, um Use Cases zu definieren, und schulst Kundenteams im Umgang mit Conversational-AI-Plattformen, damit diese ihre virtuellen Agenten langfristig selbst pflegen können. Prompt Engineering & Persona: Du entwickelst die „Persönlichkeit“ des Bots und erstellst System-Prompts, die sicherstellen, dass der Agent empathisch, markenkonform, zielführend und innerhalb der Guardrails kommuniziert (Conversation Design). Low-Code Realisierung: Du setzt die konzipierten Dialoge in der Conversational-AI-Plattform um, indem du Agents und Flows baust sowie Generative-AI-Nodes konfigurierst – mit Fokus auf Logik und Ablauf statt auf komplexes Coding. Presales & Scoping: Du unterstützt unseren Vertrieb technisch-fachlich, indem du Aufwände schätzt, bei der Angebotserstellung hilfst oder in Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) zeigst, was die Technologie leisten kann DEIN PROFIL Customer Service Expertise: Du hast idealerweise 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Umfeld von Kundenservice, Contact Centern oder CRM-Systemen und verstehst, wie Service-Teams arbeiten und welche Probleme sie lösen müssen. GenAI & Prompting Literacy: Du verstehst die Prinzipien von LLMs, RAG und Agentic AI und hast ein intuitives Gespür dafür, wie man Prompts formulieren muss, um hochwertige Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Wünschenswert sind Erfahrungen in einschlägigen Conversational-AI-Plattformen wie beispielweise Cognigy, Parloa, Google, Kore.ai oder Amazon Lex. Analytisches Prozessdenken: Du kannst chaotische Business-Anforderungen in strukturierte Flussdiagramme und klare Wenn-Dann-Logiken übersetzen, die die Basis für jeden funktionierenden Bot bilden. Technisches Grundverständnis: Du hast keine Angst vor dem „Blick unter die Motorhaube“. Du verstehst das Konzept von APIs (REST), kannst JSON lesen und weißt grob, wie Daten zwischen Frontend und Backend fließen. Consulting-Drive: Du bist proaktiv, dienstleistungsorientiert, kommunizierst zielgruppengerecht und hast den Anspruch, nicht nur eine Software zu konfigurieren, sondern eine wertstiftende Lösung für den Kunden zu erschaffen. Sprachgefühl & Design: Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch auf hohem Niveau und hast Spaß am Schreiben von Dialogen, die nicht wie ein Computer klingen, sondern eine positive User Experience schaffen. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

You capture requirements, translate them into robust implementations, and take fonio live at customers – including integrations, automations, and ongoing optimization. You work closely with Product/Engineering and Go-to-Market, making sure deployments are fast, stable, and repeatable
items.desc: ☎️ About Fonio fonio.ai is a market leader in AI agents for SMBs. We started with phone agents and now also cover WhatsApp, web chat, email and a full AI phone system. We’re growing fast across Europe, the UK, the US and Brazil. We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months, then went from $10M to $20M in about 8 weeks. Today we serve 10,000+ customers. We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings. Join one of the fastest-growing companies! 🚀 Your Role As a Forward Deployed Engineer for our London market , you work directly at the intersection of product and customer setups. You capture requirements, translate them into robust implementations, and take fonio live at customers – including integrations, automations, and ongoing optimization. You work closely with Product/Engineering and Go-to-Market, making sure deployments are fast, stable, and repeatable across the London market . What To Expect Capture customer requirements and translate them into concrete implementation plans Build and roll out fonio setups in production: workflows, logic, prompts, guardrails Implement integrations with third-party systems (APIs, webhooks, CRM, calendar, ticketing, etc.) Develop smaller features and glue code to cleanly map customer cases Debug under production conditions: calls, flows, edge cases, fast fixes Build reusable templates and deployment playbooks to make setups scalable Deliver product feedback: bring pain points and feature gaps to the team, prioritized and concrete What We Are Looking For Solid coding skills: you can implement independently, not just configure Strong understanding of AI systems and LLMs (prompting, tool-use, RAG, failure modes) Workflow thinking: translate complex processes into robust, testable flows Experience with APIs, webhooks, auth, and common integration patterns Cloud fundamentals: deployments, observability, debugging in production Highly pragmatic working style: ship fast, make it stable, iterate Bonus: Voice/Telephony, n8n, TypeScript/Python, SQL, monitoring/tracing, GDPR English at native or near-native level What You Get Competitive salary: €65,000-€95,000 per year, plus equity 100% Remote:Onboarding in London 100% Focus Time (no regular meetings) Unlimited budget when the ROI is right Extreme speed (we ship almost daily) Thousands of enthusiastic customers building the product together with us Interview Process 15 min Intro Call 90 min Deep Dive with our Head of Commercial Deployment and our Head of Delivery 20 min Culture Interview How we hire? We're AI-native, including in hiring. AI helps us to remain efficient, but people make every decision. fonio is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for talent and ownership, whatever your background is. Need an adjustment in the process? Just tell us. Please send your CV in English. Then knock us off our feet 🚀

items.card: Vos missions En tant que stagiaire Ingénieur(e) études et développement IA Native, vous participez à : Analyser les besoins métiers et identifier les cas d'usage de l'IA générative Concevoir et développer des fonctionnalités intégrant des LLM (assistants, RAG, agents IA) Rédiger et optimiser des prompts, et évaluer la qualité et la pertinence des réponses Développer les services back-end et interfaces front-end
items.desc: En tant qu'organisateur de forums de recrutement, Talents Handicap accompagne de très nombreuses entreprises & organisations en France dans leurs recrutements de collaborateurs en situation de handicap. Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums. L'entreprise Sopra Steria recherche actuellement des profils : Sopra Steria, acteur majeur de la Tech en Europe avec 56000 collaborateurs dans près de 30 pays, est reconnu pour ses activités de conseil, de services numériques et d’édition de logiciels. Il aide ses clients à mener leur transformation digitale et à obtenir des bénéfices concrets et durables. Le Groupe apporte une réponse globale aux enjeux de compétitivité des grandes entreprises et organisations, combinant une connaissance approfondie des secteurs d’activité et des technologies innovantes à une approche résolument collaborative. Sopra Steria place l’humain au centre de son action et s’engage auprès de ses clients à tirer le meilleur parti du digital pour construire un avenir positif. En 2023, le Groupe a réalisé un chiffre d’affaires de 5,8 milliards d’euros. The world is how we shape it \n\n Description de l'entreprise Leader technologique européen, Sopra Steria accompagne les organisations dans le déploiement de leurs projets stratégiques en s’appuyant sur ses expertises en conseil, intégration, solutions métiers, intelligence artificielle et cybersécurité. Dans un contexte où la souveraineté numérique, la résilience des infrastructures et la maîtrise des données sont devenues essentielles, Sopra Steria contribue à renforcer l’autonomie stratégique de l’Europe, notamment au service des infrastructures critiques et des missions régaliennes dans les domaines des services financiers, de la défense, du spatial, de l’aéronautique et des services publics. Fort de 51000 collaborateurs dans près de 30 pays et d’un chiffre d’affaires de 5,6 milliards d’euros en 2025, Sopra Steria aide ses clients à renforcer leur compétitivité et à obtenir des bénéfices concrets et durables, en combinant une connaissance approfondie des métiers et des technologies à une approche collaborative, avec l’ambition de répondre durablement aux grands défis de notre époque. Description du poste Votre futur environnement de travail Et si votre premier projet numérique avait un impact concret sur la société ? Rejoignez les équipes Services Publics et contribuez à des projets au cœur d'enjeux sociétaux majeurs : santé, écologie, retour à l'emploi… Intégré(e) à une équipe projet à taille humaine, vous découvrez comment concevoir des applications natives IA, où l'intelligence artificielle est au cœur du produit, et participez concrètement à leur réalisation. Parce que vos premiers pas sont essentiels, vous bénéficiez d'un accompagnement de proximité : votre tuteur(rice) et un(e) chef(fe) de projet expérimenté(e) vous aident à approfondir vos connaissances, développer vos compétences et gagner progressivement en autonomie. Selon les projets, vous évoluez dans des environnements variés : Python, Java et Spring Boot côté back-end ; Angular, React et TypeScript côté front-end ; LLM, IA générative, RAG et agents IA (Azure OpenAI, LangChain…). Vous travaillez en Agile avec des outils tels que IntelliJ IDEA, Visual Studio Code et GitHub Copilot. Vos missions En tant que stagiaire Ingénieur(e) études et développement IA Native, vous participez à : Analyser les besoins métiers et identifier les cas d'usage de l'IA générative Concevoir et développer des fonctionnalités intégrant des LLM (assistants, RAG, agents IA) Rédiger et optimiser des prompts, et évaluer la qualité et la pertinence des réponses Développer les services back-end et interfaces front-end associés Réaliser les tests et corrections pour garantir la qualité, la sécurité et la fiabilité des développements Participer aux cérémonies Agile et aux activités de votre équipe Les apports Mettre en pratique et approfondir vos compétences en développement et en IA générative sur un projet concret Découvrir les bonnes pratiques de conception d'applications natives IA (RAG, agents, IA responsable) Utiliser l'IA au quotidien comme levier de productivité (GitHub Copilot) Gagner en autonomie avec votre équipe et votre tuteur Comprendre les enjeux de l'IA dans la modernisation des services publics Qualifications Votre profil A la recherche d'un stage de dernière année en école d'ingénieurs ou formation équivalente. Connaissances en programmation (Python, Java ou JavaScript) et intérêt marqué pour l'IA générative. Polyvalent(e), créatif(ve), doté(e) d'un esprit de synthèse et d'analyse. Curieux(se), vous souhaitez acquérir des compétences techniques et fonctionnelles dans des domaines métiers variés. Vous aimez le travail en équipe et le contact client. Informations supplémentaires Un accord télétravail pour télétravailler jusqu’à 2 jours par semaine selon vos missions. Un package avantages intéressant : une mutuelle, un CSE, des titres restaurants, un accord d’intéressement, des primes …

items.desc: AI Large Language Model (LLM) Technology Architect Career Level: Associate Manager / Specialist Location: London, Bristol, Manchester, Birmingham, Leeds, Newcastle or Edinburgh Please Note: Any offer of employment is subject to satisfactory BPSS and SC security clearance which requires 5 years continuous UK address history (typically including no periods of 30 consecutive days or more spent outside of the UK) and declaration of being a British passport holder with no dual nationalism at the point of application YOU ARE As a hands-on AI/LLM Architect, you will be at the heart of designing and building advanced AI systems that power the modern enterprise. This is a deeply technical, hands-on role — you will spend the majority of your time in the architecture and engineering of real-world AI solutions across classical machine learning, generative AI, and agentic systems, delivering these within active client engagements. You will translate requirements into concrete architecture decisions: selecting design patterns, evaluating and benchmarking technical frameworks, assembling reusable components, and making deliberate technology choices that balance innovation with enterprise-grade reliability. You will design and build AI agent architectures — including multi-agent orchestration, tool use, skills use, and memory systems — and work hands-on with foundation models through fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and custom model integration. A part of your work will also involve engineering the AI context layer that makes these systems intelligent in practice — connecting enterprise knowledge bases, structured and unstructured data sources, and domain-specific content so that AI outputs are grounded, accurate, and relevant to the client's business. You will design and validate systems against enterprise non-functional requirements across security, observability, governance, performance, and scalability. A core output of this role is the production of tangible engineering and architecture deliverables. This means writing and owning software components — building, integrating, and testing AI system modules as a practitioner — alongside producing detailed architecture artifacts including architecture decision records (ADRs), component diagrams, data flow diagrams, and integration specifications that guide and enable broader engineering teams. You will work with cross-functional delivery teams alongside data engineers, ML engineers, and application developers, and this role is an opportunity to develop deep expertise across the full AI architecture stack, sharpen your engineering instincts on complex, real-world problems, and build a foundation for growing into a lead or principal architect over time. THE WORK Independently design, build, and deliver software components across the AI architecture — owning them end to end from design through implementation, integration, and testing as a hands-on practitioner Design and build AI agent architectures — including individual agents, their prompts, tools, and skills, multi-agent orchestration, and memory systems — making deliberate design pattern and technology choices Design and implement agent orchestration patterns that handle task handoffs, communication, state management, and error recovery, validating them through hands-on prototyping Evaluate multiple design options and technical approaches, making deliberate, justified design choices that balance capability, cost efficiency, performance, and enterprise-grade reliability Design, build, and run evaluation strategies and harnesses that measure agent and system quality on metrics such as accuracy, relevance, and faithfulness, translating findings into design improvements Architect and implement foundation model integrations — selecting the right models, invocation patterns, and customization approaches (fine-tuning, RAG, custom integration) based on capability, cost, TFSL is an FCA-authorised payment institution providing Account Information Services (AIS) and Payment Initiation Services (PIS) in the UK, with products including direct payments, settlement-enabled payment journeys and Variable Recurring Payments (VRP). What’s it all
items.desc: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Tink is a Visa solution delivering open banking payment services and data capabilities through a technology-led, API-based platform. TFSL is an FCA-authorised payment institution providing Account Information Services (AIS) and Payment Initiation Services (PIS) in the UK, with products including direct payments, settlement-enabled payment journeys and Variable Recurring Payments (VRP). What’s it all about ? This is the appointed UK Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) and Nominated Officer role for TFSL. Reporting to the Group MLRO, the role provides ownership, independent, entity-level second-line oversight of TFSL’s anti-money laundering (AML), counter-terrorist financing (CTF), proliferation financing (PF), sanctions and wider financial crime framework. The MLRO will be a trusted adviser to the Tink UK Board, Tink leadership, Compliance Operations and business-line stakeholders, while retaining the independence, authority and access necessary to discharge statutory and regulatory responsibilities This is a senior individual-contributor role. The successful candidate must be hands-on, capable and prepared to personally execute and operate across a matrixed / global environment, including oversight of shared and outsourced activities, while preserving TFSL’s local accountability and governance. What we expect of you, day to da y Statutory MLRO and Nominated Officer responsibilities Act as TFSL’s appointed UK MLRO and Nominated Officer and assume full responsibility and ownership of the TFSL’s financial crime program, with appropriate independence, authority, access to information and direct escalation to the Tink UK Board and senior management. Receive and assess internal suspicious activity reports, determine whether knowledge or suspicion meets the threshold for external disclosure, submit Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) to the National Crime Agency (NCA), and manage Defence Against Money Laundering requests where applicable. Maintain complete and timely decision records, SAR registers, confidentiality controls, tipping-off safeguards and business continuity arrangements for the Nominated Officer function. Act as TFSL’s principal financial crime contact for the FCA, NCA and relevant law-enforcement authorities, coordinating responses and regulatory notifications as required. Build strong, active partnerships with peer Tink MLROs and MLROs across Visa’s regulated entities, breaking down organisational silos and establishing a coordinated group-wide approach to common financial crime risks, regulatory challenges, intelligence sharing and control enhancements, while preserving local legal-entity accountability and independent judgement. Business-wide risk assessment and risk appetite Own and maintain TFSL’s Business-Wide Risk Assessment (BWRA/FCRA) covering money laundering, terrorist financing, proliferation financing and sanctions, and ensure it remains proportionate to the nature, scale and complexity of the open banking business. Maintain the financial crime risk appetite, high-risk and prohibited industry position, country-risk approach and Product Risk Assessment requirements, translating assessment outputs into clear controls, conditions, remediation and governance decisions. Provide independent advice and approval on higher-risk Merchants/Partners, products, markets and material changes, including AIS, PIS, settlements, Sweeping VRP, Commercial VRP and new Pay by Bank propositions. Independent oversight of the control framework Oversee and challenge the design and effectiveness of Know Your Business/Client (KYB/KYC), Client Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), ongoing due diligence, transaction monitoring, client activity monitoring, sanctions screening, quality assurance and suspicious activity controls that operate out of the first line of defence (1LoD). Assess whether controls adequately address open banking typologies and red flags, including transaction laundering, fraudulent sales, refund abuse, e-wallets, gambling, money remittance, crypto exchanges and other higher-risk payment use cases. Oversee the governance, calibration, testing, performance and incident management of financial crime systems and models, working with Compliance Technology Operations, product and engineering teams to ensure tools remain fit for purpose. In addition to work carried out by the Global Quality Assurance …

items.desc: La société Chez Next Decision , on aime la Data sous toutes ses formes, et on la traite avec le plus grand respect. Cabinet de conseil spécialisé en Big Data, Business Intelligence, MDM et Data Science, nous cultivons une approche humaine : nous travaillons très sérieusement, sans jamais nous prendre au sérieux. Notre agence lyonnaise est en pleine croissance, et notre activité IA est en plein boom ! Suite à plusieurs déploiements réussis de cas d'usage IA chez nos clients en proximité dans la région Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes (dans le monde de l'industrie, du retail et du tourisme), nous voulons passer à la vitesse supérieure. Pour continuer à structurer cette offre et transformer l'essai, nous recherchons notre futur·e Ingénieur·e IA & Porteur d'Offre. Un mouton à cinq pattes ? Non. Simplement un·e passionné·e de technique qui a aussi la fibre business et l'envie de bâtir une offre de A à Z pour faire rayonner Next Decision. Tes missions, si tu les acceptes Dans ce rôle hybride et hautement stratégique, tu divises ton temps entre l'expertise technique, l'avant-vente et l'évangélisation. L'EXPERTISE TECHNIQUE & DELIVERY (L'INGÉNIEUR IA) Concevoir et déployer des solutions d'IA innovantes (Machine Learning, Deep Learning, IA Générative / LLM) pour répondre aux cas d'usage concrets de nos clients régionaux. Architecturer l'IA sur mesure : Intégrer ces modèles dans des environnements Data & Cloud modernes. Tu sais tirer parti des plateformes leaders (fortes affinités avec Microsoft Azure AI ou Snowflake appréciées) tout en maîtrisant l'écosystème des LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, Llama...). Intégrer les enjeux de souveraineté : Tu es capable de concevoir des architectures garantissant la confidentialité des données (Cloud souverain, déploiement de modèles open-source en local). Garantir l'industrialisation (MLOps) et la scalabilité des solutions développées. LE PORTEUR D'OFFRE & STRATÈGE (L'ARCHITECTE DE L'OFFRE) Structurer, packager et faire évoluer notre catalogue d'offres IA sur la région (capitalisation sur nos succès dans l'industrie/retail/tourisme, ateliers de cadrage, etc.). Assurer une veille technologique constante pour recommander le bon modèle pour le bon usage (propriétaire vs open-source, US vs souverain). Animer la communauté interne autour de l'IA (partage de connaissances, mentoring des consultants). LE BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & AVANT-VENTE (LE PARTENAIRE BUSINESS) Accompagner l'équipe commerciale en rendez-vous : tu es le/la garant(e) de la crédibilité technique et du ROI des projets. Cadrer les besoins, animer des workshops et rédiger les propositions techniques et financières. Participer au rayonnement de l'agence (rédaction d’articles de blog, présence sur les salons tech lyonnais). Ton profil TON PARCOURS ET TON EXPÉRIENCE Tu es diplômé·e d'une école d'ingénieurs ou d'un Master 2 spécialisé en Data Science, IA ou Informatique. Tu as déjà forgé tes armes avec 4 à 5 ans d'expérience sur un poste similaire, en cabinet de conseil, en ESN ou chez un client final, ce qui te permet de maîtriser la gestion de projets IA de A à Z. TON BAGAGE TECHNIQUE Sur le plan technique, tu maîtrises parfaitement Python et tu possèdes une excellente culture de l'écosystème GenAI ainsi que de ses frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex...). Conscient(e) qu'il n'y a pas d'IA performante sans de solides fondations, tu as idéalement une très bonne connaissance des architectures Data (DataLake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse) . Une familiarité avec les offres des grands Cloud Providers, de Snowflake ou des solutions souveraines sera également un atout majeur pour réussir à ce poste. TON ÉTAT D'ESPRIT Tu es un·e véritable passionné·e par les accélérateurs qu'offre l'IA, tout en gardant les pieds sur terre. Tu as profondément conscience de l'importance de la gouvernance des données et du maintien du contrôle humain (human-in-the-loop) pour garantir une approche éthique et sécurisée. Doté·e d'un fort esprit intrapreneurial et d'un vrai sens du service, tu sais rendre les concepts complexes accessibles pour convaincre et accompagner les décideurs. Ce que nous t'offrons Une agence à taille humaine à Lyon, où la convivialité et le partage sont de mise. L'opportunité de porter une offre au sein d'une structure reconnue, en capitalisant sur une dynamique régionale déjà très forte. Un parcours de formation et de certification personnalisé (partenariats avec les plus grands éditeurs, tout en gardant notre indépendance de conseil). Une politique de télétravail flexible. Un package salarial attractif avec de nombreux avantages ! Le process de recrutement chez nous ? Simple et transparent. Un premier échange RH pour faire connaissance, un entretien technique/business avec le directeur d'agence, et une rencontre avec l'équipe. Tes (futurs) avantages Ton abonnement annuel aux transports en commun pris en charge à 100% : Parce qu’aller travailler ne devrait pas peser sur ton budget. Une mutuelle Alan ultra avantageuse : Une couverture santé premium …

A core output of this role is the production of tangible engineering and architecture deliverables. You will work with cross-functional delivery teams alongside data engineers, ML engineers, and application developers, and this role is an opportunity to develop deep expertise across the full AI architecture stack, sharpen your engineering instincts on complex, real-world problems, and build a foundation for growing into a lead or principal architect over time. You will work with customers who are experts in their domains, translating data, infrastructure, and workflow constraints into production systems
items.desc:
About the team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with life sciences organizations to deploy production AI systems across scientific and operational workflows. We work at the boundary of customer deployment and core platform development, using early engagements to define repeatable system patterns, evals, and operating standards for life sciences environments.



About the role

We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to lead end-to-end deployments of our models inside life sciences organizations and research institutions, focusing on workflows across discovery, clinical development, submissions, and scientific operations. You will work with customers who are experts in their domains, translating data, infrastructure, and workflow constraints into production systems and helping define how frontier models can be applied in regulated environments.

You will measure success through production adoption, workflow impact, and eval loops that define workflow-specific benchmarks, acceptance criteria, and launch evidence for production use. You’ll work closely with Business, Research, Platform/Product, Engineering, and Security/GRC, using deployment learnings to improve both customer systems and the product and model roadmaps supporting them.



This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 30% is required.



In this role you will

 - Own deployments from initial scoping through production adoption, including technical decisions, sequencing, and launch readiness.

 - Partner with customers and internal teams to frame problems, define scope, and translate ambiguous workflow needs into system requirements and measurable endpoints.

 - Define launch criteria for regulated contexts, including validation evidence, outcome metrics, and acceptance thresholds tied to production use.

 - Enforce operating standards for auditability, traceability, and inspection readiness in the systems you ship.

 - Design evals that measure model and system quality against workflow-specific scientific benchmarks and acceptance criteria.

 - Use evaluation results, error analysis, and deployment learning to improve model selection, system design, and product feedback.

 - Distill deployment learnings into reference architectures, validation templates, benchmark harnesses, and other technical primitives that can be reused across life sciences environments.



You might thrive in this role if you

 - Bring 6+ years of software, ML/AI, or deployment engineering experience with customer-facing ownership in biotech, pharma, clinical research, scientific software, or adjacent technical domains.

 - Have operated as a senior engineer, tech lead, or deployment owner who is trusted to make technical decisions in ambiguous environments.

 - Have owned customer GenAI deployments end-to-end from scoping through production adoption.

 - Have improved deployed systems through eval design, error analysis, and evidence generation that hones acceptance criteria over time.

 - Have delivered AI systems in workflows such as discovery, clinical development, regulatory writing, submissions, or scientific operations where validation strategy, auditability, compliance constraints, and reviewer expectations shaped system design and rollout.

 - Communicate clearly across scientific, clinical, model research, technical, and executive audiences, translating technical tradeoffs into decisions, operating procedures, and measurable outcomes with credibility and a clear point of view.

 - Apply systems thinking and engineering judgment, turning failures, escalations, and audit findings into improved operating standards, validation artifacts, and repeatable deployment patterns.





About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. 

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf.

items.desc: Emporix is an AI-driven Autonomous Commerce Execution Platform that gives enterprises full control over how their commerce works. It orchestrates operations end-to-end so companies can scale faster, respond smarter, and deliver better customer experiences. We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer (Agentic AI-oriented) to build and operate robust, enterprise-ready autonomous solutions capable of multi-step reasoning, context retrieval, tool integration, and executing complex workflows. In this role, you’ll design and operate reliable AI agents using technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, MCP, FastAPI, vector databases, and Google Cloud. You will work with Python-based agentic services, while also integrating them with Java commerce services, cloud functions, APIs, and frontend applications. You can work from our modern office in Gliwice or remotely from anywhere in Poland, with a visit to the office at least once per month to meet the team. What You’ll Be Doing Agentic AI Development Develop robust, enterprise-grade autonomous agents utilizing LangChain along with LangGraph. Architect complex stateful workflows, dynamic routing logic, and multi-step reasoning pathways. Integrate function calling, schema enforcement, conversational context retention, real-time responses, and human review loops. Construct domain-specific agents capable of seamless interaction across enterprise APIs and internal microservices. Establish robust guardrails, retry patterns, automated fallbacks, and oversight mechanisms to manage non-deterministic outcomes. Monitor and optimize system accuracy, runtime latency, consistency, and API token expenditure. MCP and Tool Ecosystem Construct and sustain Model Context Protocol servers to surface core platform capabilities directly to autonomous agents. Architect modular, repeatable toolsets for information retrieval, workflow execution, and external ecosystem integration. Connect intelligent agents seamlessly with core internal microservices, client enterprise APIs, and serverless cloud functions. Establish robust security boundaries for tooling execution, incorporating multi-tenant isolation, rigorous input validation, and enterprise auth controls. RAG & System Integration Design and implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines. Develop persistent memory and knowledge retrieval strategies for autonomous agents. Assess retrieval performance and pinpoint degradation from stale, missing, or extraneous context. Production Reliability and Observability Architect agentic infrastructures optimized for high concurrency, robust security, and continuous operational resilience. Embed structured logging telemetry, distributed tracing, performance metrics, and diagnostic tooling across agent execution flows. Ensure complete observability and auditability for model decisions, tool invocation paths, retrieved context windows, and runtime exceptions. Diagnose and resolve production anomalies across language model outputs, retrieval pipelines, external integrations, and distributed microservices. Continuously refine token budgets, response latencies, model selection strategies, and cloud infrastructure expenses. Develop automated test suites for deterministic execution paths alongside rigorous evaluation frameworks for stochastic behavior. Commerce and Platform Integration Interface autonomous agents with core Emporix commerce domain capabilities and critical enterprise workflows. Bridge Python-based agentic microservices with enterprise Java and Spring Boot backend services. Extend core Java services and deploy serverless Google Cloud Functions to meet platform requirements. Leverage enterprise APIs, event-driven architectures, asynchronous jobs, and cloud-native distributed design patterns. Transform complex commercial requirements into resilient, enterprise-grade tooling ecosystems and agent orchestration pathways. Frontend and User Experience Partner with cross-functional teams to build agent administration portals and interactive conversational interfaces using React and TypeScript. Translate sophisticated multi-step reasoning models into intuitive, seamless UI/UX workflows. Enable real-time token streaming, agent state visualization, human-in-the-loop approvals, source attribution, and graceful error handling in client applications. Collaboration and Optimization Collaborate with AI developers, product managers, and domain experts to understand business use cases and translate them into AI solutions. Documentation Write and maintain clean, well-structured documentation for LLMs/SLM. Contribute to knowledge bases and architecture diagrams for long-term maintainability and onboarding. What We’re Looking For Minimum of 5 years background in production software engineering roles. Proven history crafting backend services, external APIs, software integrations, and distributed microservices architectures. Familiarity using frameworks like LangChain or LangGraph for agentic …

As a Senior ServiceNow Architect, you will be responsible for designing, defining, and governing end-to-end solutions across multiple ServiceNow modules. You will own the technical vision, establish architecture standards, and guide development teams to deliver solutions that are scalable, secure, and aligned with best practices, platform standards, and client needs. We focus particularly on projects within IRM / GRC, HRSD, SecOps, CMS and ITOM, and experience in these areas will be highly valued. Lead code reviews, design reviews, testing cycles, and quality assurance to ensure reliable delivery. Support platform enhancements, upgrades, performance improvements, and issue resolution. Define and oversee the implementation of dashboards, reporting, and Performance Analytics elements. Cooperate with teams working across ServiceNow modules, including IRM / GRC, HRSD, SecOps, CMS, ITOM, and others. Skills and attributes for success To excel in this role, you must possess a comprehensive understanding of the platform and exhibit confidence when leading design, implementation, customization, or maintenance projects. This may be demonstrated through: Strong hands-on knowledge of at least 4 ServiceNow modules (preferably IRM / GRC, HRSD, SecOps, CMS or ITOM). Practical experience with solution design, workflow architecture, automation, scripting (server/client), and custom application development. Deep familiarity with integrations (REST, SOAP, MID Server) and broader enterprise architecture patterns. Strong understanding of relationships between platform workflows, data models, and cross module dependencies, and the ability to design for them. Excellent stakeholder communication and ability to translate complex requirements into architecture and technical solutions. To qualify for the role, you must have At least 7–8+ years of ServiceNow implementation experience, including solution or technical architecture responsibilities. Proven architecture and development background delivering multiple end to end ServiceNow projects. ServiceNow CAD and/or CIS certifications (with IRM, HRSD, SecOps, or ITOM preferred). ServiceNow CTA (Certified Technical Architect) is a strong plus but not mandatory. Strong understanding of ITIL and enterprise service management concepts. Ideally, you'll also have English (C2) or other European languages would be an advantage but not mandatory. A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical or business-related field. What we look for We are in search of ServiceNow Architects who are passionate about creating innovative and bespoke solutions for our clients. We value individuals who wish to expand their product knowledge, work with global stakeholders across different workflows of the platform, and potentially progress to lead architect, enterprise architect, tech lead, or project management roles. If you are keen on shaping the technical direction, initiating discussions and overseeing projects right up to post–go live activities – we are looking for you. What we offer EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across nine locations – Argentina, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. items.desc: Logistics doesn’t need more complexity - it needs better decisions. At Logivity, our ambition is to make every transport more sustainable through optimizing the entire logistics ecosystem using real data and trusted collaboration. We are a logistics software company, originally founded within the Volvo Group. Our solutions help transport buyers turn fragmented data into clear, actionable insight. By connecting systems, actors, and data in one place, we make it easier to plan, track, and improve transport operations every day. To complement our team of curious and innovative minds, we are now searching for an AI Engineer. The Opportunity We are rebuilding how software gets built. Our platform helps companies manage digital supply chains - bookings, carrier coordination, live tracking, customer notifications. It runs at scale, and it needs to grow fast. We are transforming our engineering organization around agentic development: AI agents assist at every stage of the process, from requirements and prototyping through to coding, testing, deployment and monitoring. The result is a leaner, faster, higher-quality engineering operation. We are looking for AI Engineers who want to be at the center of that transformation - not as an experiment, but as the new permanent way of working. The Role As an AI Engineer you own one or several product domains end to end. You take confirmed requirements and prototypes from the Product Owner and turn them into production-quality software - with AI agents doing the heavy lifting on code generation, test writing, and deployment. You are not a prompt engineer who reviews AI output passively. You are an architect and reviewer who designs the system, sets the standards, and ensures that what ships is correct, secure, and maintainable. You will – Own the design and implementation of your product domains – Translate prototypes and epics into production-ready architecture – Write the Agent Briefing for your codebase so AI agents work correctly within your system – Review and approve all agent-generated code before it merges – Maintain test coverage above 85% — agents generate the tests, you set the standards – Operate your services in production — you build it, you run it – Continuously improve the prompt library and development guidelines for your domain – Mentor junior engineers in agentic workflows What we look for You need to have – Hands-on experience with Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot in real work — not just toy projects – 7+ years of professional software engineering – Production experience with common development languages and concepts. – Solid understanding of REST API design and event-driven architecture – Experience with relational databases – Ability to critically review AI-generated code for correctness, security and maintainability – Experience writing and maintaining automated test suites – Comfort operating services in production - logging, alerting, incident response It is a bonus if you have – Experience in logistics, supply chain, or transport platforms – Familiarity with prompt engineering and LLM evaluation – Knowledge of CI/CD pipeline design and IaC (Terraform) – Contributions to internal developer tooling or platform teams – Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS platforms What makes this different End-to-end ownership — You own a domain from API design to production monitoring. No handoffs to separate ops teams. AI as your co-pilot - You will spend less time writing boilerplate and more time on architecture, judgement and quality. New approach from day one - You are not joining a team that will try AI tools eventually. This is the operating model now. Real-world scale - This platform serves enterprise customers in live logistics operations. The code you write matters. Influence on the process - As an early hire you help shape how the Dev Machine evolves - tooling, guidelines, agent standards. Career trajectory - The skills you develop here - agentic engineering, AI-supervised delivery - are the direction the industry is moving. How to apply Send us three things: – A brief note on how you currently use AI tools in your engineering work - what works, what doesn't, where you see the limits – Your CV – A cover letter

items.desc: Role - Principal Technology Architect Location - Erlangen/Stuttgart, Germany Technology - Hands-On GenAI & Agentic Systems Role Overview We are seeking a skilled Senior AI Architect with deep, hands-on expertise across foundation models, LLMs, GenAI workflows, agentic systems, and large-scale retrieval pipelines. This role requires demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade GenAI applications end-to-end. Key Responsibilities Architect and deliver advanced GenAI solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG pipelines, multi-agent architectures, and enterprise-scale retrieval workflows. Design and implement modular, composable AI workflows using orchestration frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph. Develop and optimize embeddings, chunking strategies, retrieval flows, and vector search for large-scale AI applications. Build secure, scalable, and compliant AI architectures aligned with enterprise IT and data ecosystems. Lead hands-on experimentation, benchmarking, evaluation, prompt engineering, and model optimization. Collaborate with data science, ML engineering, product, and business teams to drive high-impact AI adoption. Required Skills & Experience Deep expertise in foundation models and Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT‑4o, Claude, Llama, and open‑source alternatives. Hands-on experience with GenAI patterns: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), summarization, reranking, chunking, vector indexing, and prompt engineering. Strong proficiency with orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph) for building production-ready AI workflows. Experience designing and implementing agentic systems including tool use, agent patterns, and multi-agent collaboration. Expertise in vector databases such as PGVector, Pinecone, Amazon Titan, or Azure AI Search. Strong understanding of scalable data pipelines, data chunking strategies, and high‑performance retrieval systems. Experience integrating AI/LLM solutions into enterprise applications using APIs, microservices, and middleware. Familiarity with MLOps/GenAIOps practices including CI/CD for LLMs, model monitoring, safety layers, and continuous improvement. Experience with cloud AI/ML stacks (AWS Sagemaker, Azure ML, Google Vertex AI). Deep understanding of AI governance, security, compliance, and responsible AI frameworks. Proven ability to deliver enterprise-grade GenAI applications such as search, chatbots, content generation, digital twins, or design automation. Collaboration & Leadership Ability to work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, architects, product managers, and business stakeholders. Strong communication skills to articulate deep technical concepts and architectural decisions. About Infosys Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting.
