items.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Security
items.card: About the Role HERE is looking for a senior Security Solutions Engineer to lead the security conversation with our most high profile customers, and to bring what they learn in the field back into how we build. You'll work with CISOs, security architects and engineering teams at banks, government agencies and other regulated organisations. You'll help them design, configure and validate HERE Enterprise Browser
items.desc: Forward Deployed Engineer - Security Location: London, UK / Hybrid Remote We have an office in London and this position can either be based in the office, or hybrid remote, with the expectation of attending the office on Wednesdays and Thursdays (subject to your existing legal right to work in the jurisdiction). About HERE Everything works right here™. Traditional browsers weren't built for work. In today's enterprise environment—where security threats are constant and productivity is critical—legacy browsers fall short. That's why we built HERE, the browser purpose-built for work. Powered by Chromium, HERE Enterprise Browser combines enterprise-grade security, seamless productivity, and native AI integration in one secure, intelligent workspace. Designed for regulated industries, HERE offers deep policy controls, identity-based access, secure workspace isolation, and full interoperability across SaaS, legacy, and virtualised environments. Our platform enables teams to work faster, more securely, and more intelligently—without compromise. HERE technology is trusted by 90% of global banks and also used within the U.S. Intelligence Community and other sectors. We're backed by some of the world's most respected financial institutions and venture firms, including Bain Capital Ventures, Bank of America, J.P. Morgan, Wells Fargo and IQT, the not-for-profit strategic investor that accelerates the introduction of groundbreaking technologies to enhance the national security of America and its allies. About the Role HERE is looking for a senior Security Solutions Engineer to lead the security conversation with our most high profile customers, and to bring what they learn in the field back into how we build. You'll work with CISOs, security architects and engineering teams at banks, government agencies and other regulated organisations. You'll help them design, configure and validate HERE Enterprise Browser deployments that meet strict security requirements. Because you'll see the threat landscape and customer expectations more clearly than anyone, you'll also have a direct voice in our product security roadmap. Working closely with our CTO, product and engineering leadership, you'll shape our security roadmap and deepen the security expertise of the teams around you. Responsibilities Customer and Prospect Security Engagements: Lead technical security discussions with prospects and customers, from CISO discovery through detailed architecture reviews. Design and configure secure HERE deployments, including identity, browser policies, DLP, fleet management, network security and SIEM integration. Lead security-focused POCs and evaluations, defining success criteria, threat scenarios and milestones. Own technical responses to security questionnaires, and RFPs, aligning HERE capabilities with industry security and compliance frameworks. Develop reusable security reference architectures, deployment guides and demo environments to accelerate customer adoption and field enablement. Shaping Product Security Direction: Turn what you hear from customers, prospects, researchers and the wider threat landscape into clear, prioritised input for the product and engineering roadmap. Help engineering leadership assess security findings and investment options by real-world exploitability, customer impact and market expectations, and shape what we prioritise next. Evolve and scale how HERE handles security issues end to end, including severity standards, response expectations and how findings feed the roadmap, with our Support team running day-to-day intake. Contribute to the security risk reporting we present to senior leadership. Raising Security Capability Across HERE: Bring the attacker's view and the customer's security expectations into product design, through threat-modelling sessions and design reviews on significant new features. Help our engineering, product and customer-facing teams deepen their security expertise, using lessons from real customer engagements and security findings. What We're Looking For 10+ years in information security, including significant time in customer-facing technical roles (sales engineering, solutions architecture or similar) at security product companies. Deep, hands-on knowledge of enterprise security architecture, covering identity, endpoint, network and web security and how they fit together in large regulated organisations. Strong understanding of browser and web security threats and controls. Experience with browser security, browser isolation, secure web gateway or DLP products is a significant plus. Experience assessing vulnerabilities and security gaps for real-world risk, and turning that assessment into product or engineering priorities. Exposure to coordinated disclosure or a vendor security response programme is a plus. Comfortable configuring and troubleshooting enterprise deployments yourself, including MDM and Group Policy, identity providers, proxies and SIEMs, rather than only …

The company develops cutting-edge solutions that drive the advancement of cloud services, cybersecurity, as well as software and hardware platforms used by millions of users and businesses worldwide. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to advanced research and development initiatives in the field of embedded software and system modeling. Your tasks Architect and implement models as well as validation firmware/software for various silicon components (e.g., boot ROMs, PCIe, USB, compute clusters) Lead the technical development of models, firmware, and embedded software Collaborate closely with hardware and software architects to define specifications and ensure system-level integration Mentor junior engineers in software design, firmware development, and best engineering practices Participate in design and code reviews, ensuring high-quality and maintainable solutions Drive debugging and optimization efforts to improve performance and reliability Provide clear technical documentation for developed models, APIs, and workflows Work in a diverse, multidisciplinary team and actively contribute to a collaborative environment Communicate progress, risks, and technical challenges effectively to stakeholders and management Requirements Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field At least 5 years of professional experience in embedded software development Strong proficiency in C or C++, with hands-on experience in SystemC and a passion for developing low-level software that interfaces directly with hardware Solid understanding of operating systems, including drivers, memory management, bootloaders, and scheduling, together with excellent debugging skills (GDB or equivalent) Proven ability to translate ambitious, ambiguous goals into concrete requirements, architectures, APIs, and delivery plans, while providing clear updates to stakeholders Practical experience with industry-standard SystemC simulators (e.g., Virtualizer, Helium) and scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell Track record of shipped products containing firmware or embedded software, preferably developed in pre-silicon environments Knowledge in one or more of the following domains: drivers, DMA, PCIe, NVMe, image/video decoders, networking controllers, memory controllers/training, boot flows, or power management Communicative proficiency in English Residing in Poland required Job no. items.desc: Job title: AI Lead Location: UK/London Employment Type: Full Time position Workplace Type: Hybrid - 2 days in office per week (Zensar office in London City) About the Role Build AI that makes it into production and makes a difference. As AI Lead, you will combine hands-on engineering with the confidence to advise client CTOs on their next steps. Your experience will go beyond presentations, prompt engineering, demos and short-lived pilots to systems people actually use. This role brings together two equally important opportunities: architecting and delivering AI-native programmes end to end, and helping clients build their own AI capability. You will share an informed view of the market and guide decisions on practice structure, operating models, tooling and governance. Reporting to a senior AI delivery leader, you will bring the same breadth of capability: designing systems, building them hands-on, and explaining and defending technical decisions with executive stakeholders. You will bring 12–15 years of engineering experience, with a strong foundation built before large language models (LLMs). We value experience running production systems, managing outages, and learning from architecture decisions that did not go to plan. Engineering Foundation Your engineering foundation comes first. These essential skills are what we screen on before exploring your AI expertise. Data modelling across SQL and NoSQL, with a clear understanding of the limitations of each. Production experience with event-driven architecture using Kafka, RabbitMQ or equivalent, including ordering, replay, idempotency and dead-letter handling. An understanding of distributed systems failure modes, including partial failure, retries, backpressure, timeouts and circuit breakers. Hands-on experience with caching strategy and invalidation at scale, including the consequences of getting it wrong. Practical observability experience: instrumenting systems yourself, not only using existing dashboards. Deep expertise in at least one cloud platform, rather than surface-level knowledge of several. Experience designing APIs and integration patterns for enterprise systems, including ERPs, CRMs and data platforms. Hands-on experience with CI/CD, containers and release engineering. Ownership of live production systems, including on-call support and incident management. You will apply these foundations to agent systems: distributed systems with a non-deterministic component. Strong engineering fundamentals are essential to making the AI layer work reliably in production. AI Engineering Alongside your engineering foundation, bring practical experience in these two core areas of AI engineering. Evaluation and Error Analysis Experience building evaluation sets for non-deterministic systems and using the results to make decisions. The ability to identify whether failures stem from the model, retrieval, data or product design. A systematic approach to debugging agent behaviour using traces and evidence. Context Engineering Thoughtful management of what information enters the model at each turn, and why. Memory strategies that define what persists across steps and sessions, and what should not. Tool design that defines what an agent can access, the scope of that access, and how tool failures are handled. Experience treating cost and latency as design constraints from the outset. Consulting and Client Leadership Put your engineering expertise to work in a client-facing services role, where consulting and technical delivery carry equal weight. Develop and share an informed view of models, tooling and delivery patterns, translating market developments into practical advice tailored to each client. Lead discovery workshops, solution reviews and delivery cadences in partnership with client teams. Help clients build their own AI capability, covering practice structure, operating models, skills, governance, build-versus-buy decisions and adoption across their engineering organisation. Shape and defend technical proposals, proof-of-concept plans and roadmaps, taking ownership of the narrative from start to finish. Translate business problems into clear technical architectures for C-suite stakeholders, without relying on jargon. Offer honest guidance, including explaining when agents are not the right solution and why. Delivery and Architecture Turn your architectural decisions into working AI systems, with ownership from initial design through production. Own the end-to-end delivery of AI-native programmes, from architecture through production. Design multi-agent orchestration using LangGraph, CrewAI or equivalent, covering agent topology, tool routing, memory, state, fallback and recovery paths. Connect agent systems to real enterprise systems of record, working beyond demonstration datasets. Skills and Experience Required ✅ 5+ years of software engineering experience, including hands-on delivery of AI, LLM, or applied ML solutions in production environments. ✅ Strong Python programming skills, with working knowledge of TypeScript, Java, or Node.js as an advantage. ✅ Hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI Service, AWS Bedrock, or equivalent LLM platforms. ✅ Practical experience building copilots, AI agents, or intelligent automation using Copilot Studio, Azure AI Studio, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent frameworks. ✅ Strong understanding of RAG design, vector embeddings, chunking strategies, and retrieval optimization. ✅ Experience integrating systems using REST APIs, OData, GraphQL, or event-driven architectures. ✅ Understanding of cloud deployment, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines for AI workloads. ✅ Good understanding of enterprise security patterns including OAuth 2.0, managed identities, RBAC, secret management, and data residency considerations. Preferred / Good to Have ✅ Experience integrating AI services with SAP S/4HANA. ✅ Knowledge of SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, SAP AI Core, or SAP Joule. ✅ Familiarity with Azure AI Search, OpenSearch, Pinecone, LangSmith, Azure Monitor, or AWS CloudWatch. ✅ Experience with model evaluation, guardrails, and responsible AI implementation in enterprise settings. Candidate Attributes ✅ Customer-focused: understands business use cases and builds solutions that solve measurable problems. ✅ Challenger mindset: brings new ideas, learns quickly, and improves existing ways of working. ✅ Committed: owns delivery, follows through, and supports production-quality engineering standards. ✅ Clear communicator: explains complex AI concepts simply to technical and business stakeholders. ✅ Connected collaborator: works effectively across product, SAP, platform, security, and business teams. Success Measures ✅ Production-ready AI solutions delivered securely and reliably. ✅ Measurable business value through automation, productivity, or better decision support. ✅ High-quality AI responses supported by testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement. ✅ Strong stakeholder adoption and collaboration across business and engineering teams.

Rattaché(e) au responsable Data & IA, votre mission sera de transformer les besoins métiers en produits IA/RPA exploitables, tout en étant capable de prototyper vous-même ces solutions (POC, MVP) via des outils no-code/low-code ou du scripting léger, afin d'accélérer l'itération et la validation des cas d'usage avant leur industrialisation par les équipes techniques. items.desc: WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH As the premier consulting partner for the private equity industry, Bain's PEG boasts a global practice that is over three times larger than any competitor. Our network of over 1,000 professionals supports private equity and institutional investor clients through every stage of the investment life cycle, from deal generation and due diligence to portfolio value creation and exit planning. Bain & Company is developing a suite of cutting-edge data and software solutions designed to revolutionize how the private equity industry uses data for investment insights and decision-making. The PEG Innovation team's mission is to create analytical solutions for Bain clients, teams, and the broader institutional investor space using proprietary software and data products. This includes the development, commercialization, and daily management of Bain's proprietary datasets, data, and software businesses. WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM Full Stack Software Engineers build, ship, and operate the end-to-end products and shared platform services that power Bain's PE due diligence platform within PEG Engineering. You work across the entire stack: responsive React and Svelte frontends styled with Tailwind, Node.js (TypeScript, Express) and Python (FastAPI) backend services, RESTful and type-safe APIs, PostgreSQL data models, and the scheduled and event-driven jobs that keep data flowing. Our environment is deliberately polyglot and fast-moving, and we expect this engineer to be comfortable moving across languages, frameworks, and layers rather than staying in one lane. A significant portion of this work is AI-enabled: integrating LLMs and agentic patterns into real analyst workflows through retrieval pipelines, structured outputs, streaming interfaces, and human-in-the-loop review. We weight strong engineering fundamentals as the foundation and treat AI as a reviewed co-pilot, not an autopilot. This is an engineering role in the full sense, we expect you to understand the problem, weigh approaches, and own the design and the outcome, not only produce code. AI accelerates the implementation, the engineering judgement behind it stays with you. Every AI-assisted change is expected to be understood, validated, and owned by the engineer who commits it. You are expected to deliver production-quality code, write tests for the workflows you build, own features end-to-end, and partner with Product and Design to turn requirements into reliable user experiences. Engineers operate with increasing independence and breadth across the grade: earlier in the grade with guidance from senior engineers on the most complex or ambiguous work, and toward the upper end owning delivery independently, leading implementation of features, and providing technical guidance to peers and more junior engineers. Most of our systems run on Microsoft Azure, with some workloads on AWS. You collaborate with Platform Engineering for shared services such as Auth/RBAC, Audit, Notifications, and File handling, and with the AI teams to integrate intelligent features safely and correctly. WHAT YOU'LL DO Product and Platform Delivery Across the Full Stack (80%) Build and maintain product UI features in React and Svelte with TypeScript and Tailwind, following established component patterns and the shared design system. Build and maintain backend services in Python (FastAPI, Pydantic v2) and Node.js (TypeScript, Express), following established code conventions and PR standards. Design and implement RESTful and type-safe API contracts (Zod, Pydantic, OpenAPI codegen, or similar); own the contract boundary between frontend and backend services and manage consumer impact when it changes. Model and evolve PostgreSQL schemas via SQLAlchemy and equivalent patterns; write safe, backwards-compatible migrations using the expand/contract approach. Build and operate scheduled and event-driven jobs (cron-based and queue-driven systems) for ingestion, enrichment, and background processing; make them idempotent, observable, and safe to re-run. Integrate AI-enabled features into product workflows: LLM calls, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, structured and streaming outputs, and human-in-the-loop review, following established safety and evaluation patterns. Integrate correctly with shared …
